rgyud 'bum/ (k+ṣi (79)0399 dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ 3dang po/ 'jug pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ sngags dgod pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 4gsum pa/ yi ge bcu pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 5bzhi pa/ snying po'i sngags btu ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 7lnga pa/ sngags btu ba'i le'u/ 8drug pa/ sngags btu ba'i le'u/ 11bdun pa/ kha zas gnyis su med par bsgrub pa nges pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 12brgyad pa/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags su gsungs pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 14dgu pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyis thams cad dag pa'i le'u/ 16bcu pa/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i las kyi le'u/ 17bcu gcig pa/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyi

'dod pa dang / bcud kyis len dang 'gugs pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 18bcu gnyis pa/ phyag rgya chen po bsgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 20bcu gsum pa/ skye ba bdun pa la sogs pa thams cad dgug pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 22bcu bzhi pa/ lha dgod pa dang dbang bskur ba dang / bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 23bco lnga pa/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod pa dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 26bcu drug pa/ g.yon pa'i mchod pa dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 29bcu bdun pa/ gzugs bzang ma blta ba dang gi wang dang gzhan gyi sde rengs pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 30bco brgyad pa/ ro langs chen po bsgrub pa'i thabs lha thams cad dang rtse zhing bde ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 31bcu dgu pa/ bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid dang / mchod pa dang rtse ba'i rtsed mo'i cho ga'i le'u/ 32nyi shu pa/ gling bdun gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u/ 34nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u/ 36nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ ro langs chen po'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 38nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyis dgug pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 39nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i go bzlog pa'i snying po'i dgug pa dang bskrad pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 41nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ gsang ba'i brda'i cho ga'i le'u/ 42

nyi shu rtsa drug pa/ lag pa'i brda dang rnal 'byor ma'i mtshan ma dang /phyag rgya'i mtshan ma'i cho ga'i le'u/ 44nyi shu rtsa bdun pa/ nang gi bsam gtan dang bzlas pa rnam par dag pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 46nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa/ sbas pa'i sngags dang dam tshig srung ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 48nyi shu rtsa dgu pa/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i snying po'i sngags kyi cho ga'i le'u/ gosum cu pa/ rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi tshe 'phel ba dang / mchod pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 52sum cu rtsa gcig pa/ rdo rje phag mo'i yi ge drug gi sngags kyi las thams cad kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 53sum cu rtsa gnyis pa/ de nyid sngags kyis gzugs thams cad yongs su brje ba dang / dbang du byed pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 54sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 56sum cu rtsa bzhi pa/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i nye ba'i snying po'i sngags btu ba'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 57sum cu rtsa lnga pa/ phyag rgya chen po sgrub pa'i klu'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 58sum cu rtsa drug pa/ gdug pa thams cad kyi bsam gtan gyi cho ga'i le'u/ 61sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ char dbab pa dang / gza' rgyu ba dang / 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kyi sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 62sum cu rtsa brgyad pa/ bskrad pa dang gsang ba'i sngags kyi las kyi cho ga'i le'u/ 64sum cu rtsa dgu pa/ 'khor los sgyur ba drug gi bsam gtan dang sngags btu ba'i cho ga'i le'u/ 65bzhi bcu pa/ dpa' bo drug gi go cha dang / lha'i grangs dang lag pa'i 3

mchod pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 68bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa/ dus bzhi'i mtha'i rnal 'byor ma dang lag pa'i brda'i cho ga'i le'u/ 69bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa/ skye ba bdun pa'i bsgrub bya dang / rtsu yig bzhi rnam par dag pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 71bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ kun gyi rnam pa'i sgyu ma ltar bstan pa'i le'u/ 72bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ thams cad so sor gsal ba'i mngon par shes pa brgyad nges par bstan pa'i cho ga'i le'u/ 75bzhi bcu rtsa lnga pa/ 76rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen a dwa ya badz+ra dang bod kyi lots+tsha ba chings yon yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(79) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(94)0400 rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa/ 95dang po/ lha rnams kyi gnas kyi rnam par dag pa gnas pa bstan pa/ 95gnyis pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bstan pa/ 96gsum pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun lha rnams kyi rnam par dag pa bstan pa/ 97bzhi pa/ dpa' bo'i rnam par dag pa bstan pa/ 99lnga pa/ lha'i gnas kyi sa bstan pa/ 100drug pa/ rang gi mtshan ma dang / zhal dang phyag rgya dang / sku mdog dang mtshon cha bstan pa/ 102bdun pa/ go cha gnyis bstan pa/ 104

brgyad pa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drang ba dang bsdu ba bstan pa/ 104dgu pa/ 'jug pa bstan pa/ 105bcu pa/ gtor ma dang / mchod pa tshes bcur bya ba srung ba bstan pa/ 106bcu gcig pa/ thams cad rnam par dag pa bstan pa/ 107bcu gnyis pa/ rgyud thams cad las nges par byas pa'i de kho na nyid kyi gnas gcig pu bstan pa/ 109bcu gsum pa/ ā li kā li dang / las thams cad kyi nges pa gnyis su med par bstan pa/ 111bcu bzhi pa/ dpa' bo bzhi dang yang dag par sbyor ba'i lag pa'i mchod pa bstan pa/ 113bco lnga pa/ gnyis su med pa'i brtul zhugs dang gsang sngags bstan pa/ 114bcu drug pa/ dngos grub kyi nges pa dang dpal he ru ku'i mdzad pa bstan pa/ 115bcu bdun pa/ de kho na nyid dag pa la sogs pa bstan pa/ 117zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba 'gos lha btsas kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(121) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(128)0401 rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor gyi rgyud ces bya ba/ 129dang po/ tshogs kyis bsgyings pa'i rgyud chen po zhes bya ba'i brtag pa/ 129gnyis pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi brtag pa/ 134gsum pa/ dam tshig chen po'i bdud rtsi lnga zhes bya ba'i brtag pa/ 137bzhi pa/ de kho na nyid kyi man ngag sbyor ba bzhi'i cha zhes bya ba'i brtag pa/ 139lnga pa/ sbyin sreg rab gnas kyi brtag pa/ 141drug pa/ de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba'i brtag pa/ 1435

bdun pa/ 145dpal in+d+ra ཿ ti'i zhabs kyis bkol cing gsal bar mdzad/bod kyi lots+tsha ba chings yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur te/ slad kyis de nyid kyi tshe paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis la yang gtugs te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(148) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(153)0402 phag mo mngon par brjod pa bshad pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/phag mo mngon par byang chub pa zhes bya ba/ 154rgya gar gyi mkhan po tshwa nā ka ra'i zhal snga nas dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba khu sdu/ /ngos grub kyis bsgyur te gtan bsdur mchan/(172) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(179)0403 mkha' 'gro ma thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes rdo rje phag mo mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 180rtsa ba'i rgyud bstan pa/ 180dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 180gnyis pa/ ston pas zhal gyis bzhes pa'i le'u/ 182gsum pa/ lta ba bstan pa'i le'u/ 183bzhi pa/ sgom pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 184lnga pa/ spyod pa'i rab tu dbye ba'i le'u/ 1866

drug pa/ brda'i le'u/ 188bdun pa/ dbang bskur ba'i le'u/ 191brgyad pa/ 'bras bu'i le'u/ 195dgu pa/ sku dang mchod rten gdab pa'i le'u/ 201bcu pa/ rnam par rgyal ba rnam pa lnga'i le'u/ 203rgyud phyi ma bstan pa/ 204dang po/ bskyed rim bstan pa'i le'u/ 205gnyis pa/ rdzogs rim bstan pa'i le'u/ 206paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas lots+tsha ba gyi jo zla ba 'od zer gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(209) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(211)0404 rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs cenas drarmi ba 212rgya gar gyi mkhan po mkhas pa chen po dzā ya se na'i zhabs dang / lots+tsha ba btsun pa dharma yon tan gyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(214) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(215)0405 yang dag par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po/ 216rtsa rgyud bstan pa/ 216brtag pa'i rgyal po dang po/ 216rab tu byed pa dang po/ 216rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 222rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 229rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 2327

brtag pa'i rgyal po gnyis pa/ 238rab tu byed pa dang po/ 238rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 244rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 249rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 254brtag pa'i rgyal po gsum pa/ 258rab tu byed pa dang po/ 258rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 261rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 265rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 268brtag pa'i rgyal po bzhi pa/ 277rab tu byed pa dang po/ 277rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 278rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 279rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 282brtag pa'i rgyal po lnga pa/ 283rab tu byed pa dang po/ 283rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 285rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 290rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 295brtag pa'i rgyal po drug pa/ 299rab tu byed pa dang po/ 299rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 304rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 307rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 311brtag pa'i rgyal po bdun pa/ 317rab tu byed pa dang po/ 317

rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 336rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 341rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 356brtag pa'i rgyal po brgyad pa/ 376rab tu byed pa dang po/ 376rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 380rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 382rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 386brtag pa'i rgyal po dgu pa/ 391rab tu byed pa dang po/ 391rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 398rab tu byed pa bzhi pa/ 400brtag pa'i rgyal po bcu pa/ 403rab tu byed pa dang po/ 403rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ 405rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ 406rab tu byed pa bzhi ba/ 408paṇ+ḍi ta gā ya dzha ra dang bdag nyid chen po 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/slad kyis thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis rgya dpe rtsa 'grel dang bstun nas hor kong bsabs shing 'gyur bcos legs par mdzad pa las bris/rgyud phyi ma bstan pa/ 410rgya gar gyi mkhan po kā yas pa ga ya dha ra'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/ slad nas kyang bod kyi lots+tsha ba gzhan rnams 9

gzhan gyis bsgyur ba la zur mi 'dra bar bcos nas/ rang gi ming bcug cing gzhan gyi ming 'ji ba de dag dang / mi shes pa de dag sun dbyung ba'i phyir/slad nas kyang rgya gar gyi rgyud bzhi dang /dge slong shākya ye shes de nyid kyis gtugs nas bcos te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(469) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(529)0406 dpal gsang ba rdo rje rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 530dang po/ gleng bslang ba'i le'u/ 530gnyis pa/ rtog pa sel ba'i le'u/ 530gsum pa/ gsang ba rtog pa'i le'u/ 531bzhi pa/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i de kho na bstan pa'i le'u/ 532pa'i ta rat+na badz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(536) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(537)0407 dpal gsang ba thams cad gcod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 538pa'i ta ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(558) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(560)0408 dpal 'khor lo sdom pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 56110

shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(570) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(571)0409 dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/572paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / dge slong shākya ye shes kyis zhus shing bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(579) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(580)0410 dpal nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 581rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(585) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(586)0411 dpal sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 587paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(599) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(601)0412 dpal rin chen phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 602rgya gar gyi mkhan po rin chen rdo rje dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(614) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(616)0413 dpal dam tshig chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 61711

lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(623) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(624)0414 dpal stobs po che'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 625dang po/ mngon par rtogs pa'i le'u/ 625gnyis pa/ mtshan ma thams cad brtag pa'i le'u/ 628gsum pa/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i le'u/ 629bzhi pa/ ye shes brtag pa'i le'u/ 631lnga pa/ ye shes chen po brtag pa'i le'u/ 632paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyi bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(633) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(634)0415 dpal ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 635rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra mā la dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(639) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(640)0416 dpal ye shes phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 641rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra mā la dang / dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(645) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(646)0417 dpal ye shes 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 64712

sing snya la'i gling gi rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra mā la dang / dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(651) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(652)0418 dpal zla ba'i phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 653rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(657) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(658)0419 dpal rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 659rnal 'byor ma zla ba'i phreng ba dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(666) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(667)0420 dpal nyi ma'i 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 668rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(672) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(673)0421 dpal ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 674rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(677) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(677)13

0422 dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 678rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(682) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(683)0423 dpal gsang ba me 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 684pa'i ta ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(688) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(689)0424 dpal gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 690rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(695) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(696)0425 dpal dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 697paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(702) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(703)0426 dpal rdo rje rgyal po chen po'i rgyud/ 704rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra mā la dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(709) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(709)14

0427 dpal ye shes bsam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 710paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(713) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(713)0428 dpal chags pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 714rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra mā la dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(722) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(723)0429 dpal mkha' 'gro ma'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 724rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(728) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(729) 0430 dpal me'i phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 730rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus/bsdur mchan/(734) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(734)0431 dpal mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 735rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(739) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(740)15

0432 dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi rgya'o/ po/ 741paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(743) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(744)0433 dpal stobs chen ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 745rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(750) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(751)0434 dpal rdo rje grub pa dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ 752le'u dang po/ mtshan gyi rgyud bstan pa/ 753le'u gnyis pa/ ye shes rgyu dang gnas la sogs pa/ 754le'u gsum pa/ 'khor lo bzhi bstan pa/ 756rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ya dha ra dang /lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(757) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(758)0435 de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po don gyi rgyud/ 759dang po/ gleng gzhi'i le'u/ 759gnyis pa/ lta ba'i le'u/ 76016

gsum pa/ dbang gi le'u/ 762bzhi pa/ sgom pa'i le'u/ 763lnga pa/ phan yon gyi le'u/ 765rje btsun gu ru'i zhal snga nas dang /lots+tsha ba seng kur shākya 'od kyis bsgyur cing gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(767) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(767)0436 dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dur khrod kyi rgyan rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba/ 768paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(780) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(782)0437 rgyud kyi rgyal po rnyog pa med pa zhes bya ba/ 783rgya gar gyi mkhan po pa'i ta ga ya dha ra dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(788) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(789)0438 dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 790le'u dang po/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dum bu/ 790le'u gnyis pa/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dum bu/ 792le'u gsum pa/ las sna tshogs kyi dum bu/ 79317

'gyur du mdzad pa/bsdur mchan/(795) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(796)0439 dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khros pa'i mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ 797dang po/ gsang ba mngon par byang chub pa'i le'u/ 797gnyis pa/ gsang ba spyi la dgongs pa'i le'u/ 800gsum pa/ gsang ba'i rim pa'i le'u/ 803bzhi pa/ gsang ba mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u/ 807lnga pa/ gsang ba lha'i gnas mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u/ 810drug pa/ gsang ba sngags kyi le'u/ 814bdun pa/ gsang sngags rim par bstan pa'i le'u/ 819brgyad pa/ gsang sngags dang 'khor lo bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 822dgu pa/ drag po'i mngon spyod bstan pa'i le'u/ 825bcu pa/ drag po'i sbyin sreg bstan pa'i le'u/ 828bcu gcig pa/ dur khrod kyi bdag po rnams dang / pho nya ba khyad par ba rnams dang ma mo dang zhing skyong gi phrin las bstan pa'i le'u/ 830bcu gnyis pa/ phyi dang nang gi dngos po pho nya ma'i las bstan pa'i le'u/ 835bcu gsum pa/ lha mo'i 'khor lo dang las bsgrub pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 836bcu bzhi pa/ dkyil 'khor ba'i mgon po dang yum dang bcas pa'i gsang sngags dang phrin las kyi le'u/ 839bco lnga pa/ phyi nang gsang ba dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten gzugs pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 842bcu drug pa/ gtso bo dang 'khor du bcas pa mchod pa'i le'u/ 84418

bcu bdun pa/ gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar byed pa'i le'u/845bco brgyad pa/ dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i le'u/ 847bcu dgu pa/ khyad par du 'phags pa rnam thos sras gnod sbyin chen po brgyad dang bcas pa bsgrub pa'i le'u/ 848nyi shu pa/ rgyal po rnam thos sras la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i le'u/ 851nyi shu rtsa gcig pa/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa bsgrub pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 853nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa/ las nye bar bsgrub par bstan pa'i le'u/ 855nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ sna tshogs pa'i las kyi rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 858nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa/ gsum du sgrub pa'i dbang phyug tu bstan pa'i le'u/ 863nyi shu rtsa lnga pa/ gsang ba grub pa dang gtor ma'i le'u/ 867rgya gar gyi mkhan po ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta ma bha yā ka ra gusnya pā da'i zhal snga nas dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba mkhas pa chen po khe'u rgad 'khor lo grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus/yang slad nas mkhas pa chen po sangs rgyas grags pa'i spyan sngar kre bo shes rab dpal gyis kyang zhu tig bgyis/bsdur mchan/(869) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(885)19

༄ga /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba/①༄༄na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī te ru kā rgyu da ya ②nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba/ dpal ho ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mchog tu rmad byung zhugasang ba ni/ /gang zhig mis 0ni yang dag rig /sgrub po dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /tshes grangs med cing skar ma'ang (nyemed/ /smyung ⑥ba med par brjod bya ste/ /dag pa dang ni mi gtsang med/ /mi smra chu yi bya ba med/ /dus dang tshod las rnam par grol / /gtsang sbra'i spyod pa rnam par spangs/ /de yis ⑦grong pa'i chos mi spyad / /rtsod ldan dus su dngos grub 'gyur/ /rdzogs ldan yon tan gcig 'grub ste/ /de bzhin gsum ldan yon tan gnyis/ /gnyis ldan yon tan gsum du gsungasal/ /rtsod ldan yon tan bzhi nyid de/ /dngos grub nyid du the tshom med/ /dpal khrag 'thung 6)mngon par 'byung ba las 'jug pa'i cho ga'i 73—3

le'u zhes bya ba ste dang po'o// //de nas gzhan ni rab bshad bya/ /rgyud rnams kun tu sbas pa ste/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyud chen du/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub par byed/ /sa yi cha mnyam 1yid 'ong bar/ /dri yi chu yis nyer byugs te/ /sna tshogs spos ni yid 'ong dang / /me tog sna tshogs gcal tu bkram/ /gtsang zhing dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ /sngags shes pas ni bsrung bar bya/ /phyogs ni bcing bar bya ba'o/ /de ltar 5cho ga yang dag ldan/ /mkhas pas dgod bya dgod par bya/ /sems ni shin tu dga' ba 5yis/ /kun nas kun tu cho ga bsam4)/ /bud med phyag rgya ge sar bcas/ /dang po'i 5tsheg drag rjes dbyangs dang / /ring dang thung bar rab tu grags/ /gru gsum gnyis ni yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin ma ningamayi bzhi po dang / /bud med skyes bu rnam pa bzhi/ /de bzhin gnyis pa dang po'i dbyangs / /ring dang thung bar shes bya ste/ /dbyangs kyi phyi mo dgod par bya/ /dbyangs kyi sde ni dang por dgod/ /lce rtsa'i dbyangs ni gnyis par dgod/ /tsheg drag dbyangs ni gsum par rotho/ /dbus su pad ma bzhi par ((ro lnga pa ta yi sde tshan te/ /drug pa pa yi sde tshan yin/ /an tas+tha ni bdun par 'dod / /dro ba'i yi ge brgyad pa ste/ /mtha' ma ru ni bsdus pa yin/ /de ltar rig cing rnam shes pas/ /sngags kyi gtso bo nyid ni btu/ /bkod pa las ni sngags nyu chibatus pas1lha/ /myur du dngos grub 'bras nyi bu 'thob/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las sngags dgod pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste gnyis pa'o// //79—4

de nas sngags kyi cho ga bshad/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub bsgrubastohu)pa'o/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sgrub pos dngos grub 'thobasgoni/'gyur ba'o/ /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /drug pa yi ni lnga pa nyid/ /de nyid kyi ni bzhi pa dang / /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /an tas+tha yi bzhi pa nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni dang po dang ske/ /an tas+tha yi bzhi pa nyidage/ /de nyid kyi ni gnyis pa dang / / urmi ṇadza4)yi dang por brjod/ ci /yon tasba yi dang po nyid/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /urmi ṇa yi bzhi pa nyid/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang / /an tas+tha yi gsum pa nyid / /gnyis pa yi nishegasum pa dang / /urmi ṇa yi gsum pa nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /drug pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /an tas+tha yi dang por brjod/ /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /bzhi pa yi ni dang por brjod/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa nyid/ /de bzhin du ni bcu bdun pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun pa ni mchog /de bzhin sum cumanyam gnyis pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bdun mchog nyid dang / /an tas+tha yi dang por 7ribarjod/ /lnga pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /uṣ+ṭha ṇa yi gnyis pa nyid/ /bcu bdun pa yi (2nomachog nyid do/ /an tasba yi gnyis pa dang / /de bzhin du yang tsho/rigasum pa'o/ /de nas bcu dgu pa yi mchog /drug pa yi 3༷ ni gnyis pa nyid / /urmi ṇa yi gnyis pa dang / /sum cu rtsa gcig de nas blang / /drug pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /yang na 31bcwa nya brgyad pa nyid dang / /an tasba yi dang por brjod / /urmi ṇa yi gsum pa dang / /de nyid kyi yang bzhi pa nyid/ /de bzhin du yang gsum pa nyid/ /drug pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /gsum pa yi ni gsum pa nyid / /drug pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /uṣ+ṭha ṇa yi gsum pa nyid/ /an tas+tha yi 79—5

gnyis pa dang / /de nyid kyi ni dang po nyid/ /drug pa yi ni dang po dang / /an tasba yi gnyis pa nyid/ /'di ltar drod kyi ①dang po dang / /drug pa'i dang por brjod par bya/ /urmi ṇa yi dang po nyid/ /de bzhin dha ②yig rnal 'byor ma / /lnga pa yi ni dang po dang / /uṣ+ṭha ṇa yi dang por ②brjod/ /an tasba yi gsum pa nyid/ /de bzhin du ni bcwa brgyad pa/ /bzhi pa yi ni dang po dang / /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa nyid/ /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /an tas+tha yi gnyis pa nyid/ /bzhi pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /byā duyi yi ge dang por brjod/ /de nas nyi shu pa nyid dang / /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa bzhi mchog /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /drug pa yi ni lnga pa nyid/ /an tas+tha yi gnyis par ⑤brjod/ /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /an tasba yi de bzhin nyid/ /de nyid kyi ⑥ni dang po dang / /drug pa yi ni lnga pa nyid/ /drod kyi sde tshan bzhi pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni bzhi pa nyid/ /'di ltar drug pa'i lnga pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /de bzhin mkhas pas bcu bdun pa/ /an tasba yi gnyis pa dang / /de nyid kyi yang bzhi pa nyid/ /drug pa'i dang po'ang brjod par bya/ /drod kyi sde tshan gnyis pa dang / /an tasba yi dang por b.rabarjod/ /ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ bhan dha bhan dhadu/tā sa ya tā sa ya(pe/ khyo bha ya 7khyo bha ya0/ lhu hre/ hraḥhraḥ/ phe 47/ phaṭa phaṭa / da ha da /be+eha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa/ ba su tsoru dhi ra an+t+ra mā ⑫lā ba lo bi ne/ groṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍa'i/ sap+ta pā ta 0la ga tā bhu rdza gi sar+bha bā 8tadz+dza ya tadz+dza ya/ ā kuḍa nye ya ā kuḍa nye ya/ hro hro/ ’ rnyi/ rgyu rgyu/ tsā tsā/ tī 〉tso / r+ghaṃ hūṃ/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa sku / oṃ gyi yi ge dang po ste/ /hūṃ phaṭa yi ge tha mar sbyar/ /rtsa ba'i sngags 79—6

su rab tu grags/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las yi ge btu ba'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste gsum pa'o// //snying po 'dir hu)ni bshad par bya/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub byed pa'o/ /khams gsum rnam (9rgyal zhes bya bas/ /chos don 'dod dang thar bar skyel/ /drod kyi sde tshan gsum pa la/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pa sbyar bar bya/ /dang po ru ni yongs su grags/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /de nyid kyi ri ni bzhi pas ni/ / 'og gi char ni rnam par brtag /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /dbyangs yig gsum par sbyar ba yin/ /drod kyi sde tshan gsum pa la/ /dbyangs yig lnga par yang dag ldan / /bzhi pa ru ni yongs su grags/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /de nyid kyi ni bzhi pas ni/ /4)'og gi char ni the tshom 3)med/ /drod kyi sde tshan bzhi pa la4)/ /dbyangs yig lnga pa yang dag ldan/ /steng du nā 7da sbyar ba ni/ /drug pa ru ni yongs su grags/ /drug pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /bzhi pa'i dang por brjod par bya/ /dang po yi ni tshig rkang ste/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'bras bu ster/ /gcig ma tshang ba'i nyi shu la/ /me yi bus ni dbye bar bya/ /dbyangs yig gsum parasnyeyang dag spuldan/ /dang po 3 ru ni yongs su grags/ /drod kyi sde tshan bzhi pa la/ /lnga pa'i lnga pa yang dag ldan/ /lan gnyis su ni yongs su grags/ /drod kyi sde tshan bzhi pa la/ /bcwa lnga pa yis brgyan 37byas te/ /bzhi pa'i mtha' dang yang dag ldan/ /lnga pa ru ni yang dag grags/ /drug pa yi ni gnyis pa dang ske/ /bzhi pa yi ni dang po ste/ /thams cad mtshan nyid yang dag ster/ /tshig rkang gnyis par brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa yi ni gsum pa la/ /me yi sa bon 79—7

yang dag gnas/ /dbyangs yig gsum pa yang dag ldan/ /dang po ru ni yongs su grags/ /drod kyi sde tshan bzhi pa la/ /lnga pa'i lnga pa yang dag ldan/ /dbyangs yig gnyis par sbyar ba ste/ /drug pa yi ni dang po dang / /de ltar yang ni gnyis lda ba bo1ri/ /drod kyi sde tshan bzhi pa la/ /bzhi pa'i mtha' dang yang dag ldan/ /de nas bcwa lnga pa yis brgyan / /drug pa yi ni gnyis pa dang ske/ /bzhi pa yi ni dang po dang / /tshig rkang gsum par brjod pa yin/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrubasaXsne pa'o/ /dang po yi ni gnyis pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /an tas+tha yi dang po dang / /drod kyi sde tshan bzhi pa la/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum yang dag ldan/ /mchog tu dge zhing dam pa'o/ / drug pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /geragacig ma tshang ba'isngon)nyi shu dang / /an tas+tha yi bzhi pa la/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa yang dag ldan/ /thig le yis ni steng du brgyan ske/ /an tas+tha yi bzhi pa dang / /nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa nyid la/ / me yiphrobus ni rnam par dbye/ /drod kyi sde tshan bzhi pa la/ /lnga pa yis ni yang dag brgyanan / /steng du stong pas rnam par brgyan1)/ /drug pa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /bzhi pa yi ni dang po ste/ /'di rnams rkang pa bzhi pa yin/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa po/ /bzhi pa yi ni sngags 'di dag /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro / /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung hu rib las snying po'i sngags btu ba'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas sngags rnams 'di dag ni/ /dpa' bo rnams la sbyar bya ba31/ /rnal 'byor ma ni rnams yin te/ /sngags kyi cho ga shes pas nyugebazlas/ /gnyis 73—8

med dngos grub rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis pa yi ni yi ge la/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum par ni ldan/ /drug pa'i yi ge bye brag tu/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig pas ni ldan/ /bdun par yongs su grags pas ni/ /dbyangs yig bzhi pas ldan pa yin/ /yi ge brgyad pa dag la ni/ /dbyangs yig bcu gnyis yang dag ldan / /yi ge bcu gnyis 3)pa dag nani/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pas rnam par dbye / /yi ge bcu gnyis dag la ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pas ldan byas te/ /drug pa'i dang po nyid kyis ni/ /'og gi gnas su rab tu brtag /yi ge bcu bzhi pa dag ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pa dag dang ldan/ /dge zhing mchog tu phan pa yin/ /yi ge bcwa lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ /dbyangs yig gsum par ldan byas te / /lnga pa yi ni lnga pas ni/ /'og gi cha ru yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin yi ge bcu drug nyid/ /steng du nā 4 das sbyar ba yin/ /yi ge bcu bdun pa nyid la / /dbyangs yig gsum pas g.yang dag ldan/ /yi ge bcwa brgyad pa la ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pas yang dag ldan/ /yi ge nyi shu gcig pa ni/ /dbyangs yig gnyis par yang dag ldan/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa gsum pa/ /dbyangs yig lnga pas mnyam par ldan/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum par ldan pa/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi yin/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po yis/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga pa dang ldan/ /mkhas pas rtag tu ldan pas ni/ /nyi shu rtsa drug pa la brjod/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pas ldan pa ru/ /mtshon byed gnyis ni mtshon par byed/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa / /de bzhin bcwa lnga pas ni mtshon/ /gcig ma tshang ba'i 67sum cu la/ /bzhi pa'i dang po sbyar ba dang / /dbyangs yig gnyis pa yang dag ldan/ /me dang yang dag ldan par bya/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pas 7ldan pa ni/ /sum cu 79—9

rtsa gcig yi ge yin/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis yi ge la/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pas ni ldan/ /sum cu rtsa gsum yi ge la/ /nyi ma57yis ni rab tu dbye/ /sngags rnams kun gyis5ge nogasal ba ste/ /de ltar the tshom med pa yin/ /sum cu rtsa bzhi yi ge la/ /dbyangs kyi bzhi pas ldan pa ste/ /go 'phang mchog tu dge ba yin/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pas ldan pa ni/ /de bzhin sum cu rtsa bdun yin/ /sum cu rtsa brgyadamugeyi ge la/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pas ldan par bya/ /dngos grub thams cad rnam par nges/ /de bzhin bzhi bcu rtsa gnyisashel/ /nyi ma yis ni sbyar ba yin/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gsum yi ge la/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pas sbyar bar bya/ /de yang dge ba'i mchog yin no/ /bzhi bcu rtsa lnga rab gsungs pa/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pas ldan par bya/ /de ltar nyid du the tsom med/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pas ldan pa ni/ /de bzhin bzhi bcu rtsa drug pa'o/ /bzhi bcu rtsa bdun pa nyid la/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pas mnyam par bya/ /de bzhin lnga bcu rtsa gcig la/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pas sbyar bar bya/ /'dis ni thar pa grub pa nyid / /dbyangs kyi gnyis pas ldan pa ni/ /mkhas pas lnga bcu rtsa gnyis brjod / /dbyangs yig bcu gsum par ldan pa/ /lnga bcu rtsa gsum yi ge yin/ /lnga bcu rtsa drug yi ge la/ /dbyangs kyi drug par ldan pa yin/ /gcig ma tshang ba'i drug cu la/ /an tas+tha yi7bzhi par sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pa sbyar bar bya/ /steng du nā 58)das rnam par brgyanasti/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pas ldan pa ni / /drug cu rtsa gcig pa la sbyar/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas ldan pa ni/ /drug cu rtsa gnyis bye brag gotsha/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig ldan pa ni/ /drug cu rtsa gsum mkhas pas brjod/ /dbyangs yig lnga pas sbyar ba ni/ /yi ge drug cu rtsa 79—10

bzhi pa'o/ /de bzhin drug cu rtsa lnga la/ /mes ni nges par sbyar bar bya/ /dngos grub thams cad ces bya ba/ /'dzin pa ru ni the tshom med/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas7ldan pa ni/ /drug cu rtsa drug phye ba yin/ /rigs dang rigs min rab bsgrubashepa'o/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pas yang dag ldan/ /drug cu rtsa bdun bshad pa ni/ /dpa' bo mchod pa zhes ni bya/ /an tasba yi bzhi pa yis③ /drug cu rtsa brgyad rab tu grags/ /bdun cu rtsa gcig yi ge la/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis par ldan par byas/ /bdun cu rtsa bzhidzageyi ge la/ /de bzhin dbyangs yig gnyis pas ldan/ /mtshon cha ru ni rab tu grags/ /bdun cu rtsa lnga pa nyid la/ /dbyangs kyi drug pas sbyar ba yin/ /de ltar du ni gyur pa yin/ /bdun cu rtsa drug yi ge la/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pas ldan byas te/ / me yi7bus ni rnam par dbye/ /lnga pa'i bzhi pas sbyar bar bya/ /bdun cu rtsa bdun yi ge la/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pas ldan pa yin/ /bdun cu rtsa brgyad mkhas pas brjod/ /brgyad cu rtsa gcig de bzhin mchog /dbyangs kyi lnga pas sbyar ba yin/ /brgyad cu rtsa gnyis yi ge la/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis par ni)sbyar bar bya/ /chos don 'dod dang thar pa sterag/ /dpa' bo rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /rigasapa'i rgyal po zhes bshad do/ /dpal khrag 'thung nyu)mngon par 'byung ba las sngags btu ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas dngos grub gsang chen gyi/ /de yi snying po nye snying po/ /sngags kyi cho ga shes pas gsang / /zab pa rgya mtsho chen po bzhin/ /lnga bcu pa yi dgu steng du/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas pa ste/ /bcwa lnga pas ni rnam par brgyan / /79—11

dbyangs kyi bzhi pas yang dag ldan/ /dngos grub kun gyi gzhimatsho)yin no/ /rnal 'byor snying la tshad med pa'o/ /yi ge re re gnyis gnyis la/ /de bzhin dbyangs ni bcu gnyis ldan/ /mkha' 'gro chen mo lam rnams kyi/ /kun tu yongs su bzlog napa yin/ /nye ba'i snying po brjod pas 'grub kyi/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las rnyed dka' ba'i/ /pho nya yi ni dngos grub pa'o/ /lhan cig bskyes pa'i dngos grub ni/ /rim dang rim pa med pas skyeris)/ /khrag 'thung rgyud las gzhan du min46kyi/ /rnal 'byor phyag rgya mchog yin te/ /ye shes zla ba mchog ni btu / /kha zas mchog ni bza'am bya ste/ /'di ni bstan bcos nges pa yin/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las sngags ri btu ba'i le'u zhes bya ba 9ste drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang mdor bsdus pa/ /brda yi nyu )cho ga'i mtshan nyid dag /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag bsgrubs na/ /grol ba'i dngos grub skye bar 'gyur/ /dbang chen dang ni me tog gis/ /de bzhin bdud rtsi bskyed par 'gyur/ /zho dang 'o mar ldan pa yis/ /bcud len mchog tu phan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo zhes brjod la/ /thams cad kun gyi /1'dus pa ni/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo mchog yin te/ /thams cad mdza' bas mnyam par 'gro/ /ma dang sring mo chung ma dang / /bu mo dag ni bkug nas su/ /rnal 'byor rjes su 'jug par bya / /'di rnams longs sna ni spyad bya ste/ /chos ma yin par mi 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dag ni/ /lan gcig /lhabazlas pas bud med rnams/ /pho nya rnams ni 'gugs 14par brjod/ /o sasba badz+ra kā mi nī/ sabra mabha k+ṣa sho dha 79—12

ya gu rgya badzi tsā0)rgyu swā hā/ bud med kyis ni yongs bskor nas/ /ji ltar bde ba longs spyod cing / /sangs rgyas la 'bul rimachod par bya/ /dngos grub thob pa zhes su brjod/ /dpal ldan rdo rje bcom ldan la/ /mgo bor thalam40mo sbyar nas ni/ /gtor ma'i cho ga kun gyis mchod/ /g.yas dang g.yon pa'i lag gnyis kyis ri/ /'gying dang bcas pa'i gar bya'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yis thams cad mchod/ /bsod nams chen po sogs 5pa yin/ /de ltar mchod pa tsam gyis ni/ /yang dag dngos grub rim pas 'thob phyi/ /gang zhig phyag rgya che mi mchod / /de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa/ /ngal ba don med yongs su bsten ra / /de yis 8)'bras bu thob mi 'gyur/ /gal te bdag nyid dngos grub 'dod / /mchod pas dpa' bo mchod par bya/ /gang zhig phyag rgya che las sdang79)/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa po1 ri/ /skye ba stong phrag du ma ru/ /byol song skye gnas skye bar 'gyur/ /dpal ldan 11khrag 'thung ji lta bar/ /yul du nges par gnas pa ste/ /gtum mo sbom mo'i 12gnas dag la/ /de ni yul du gyur pa na/ /de yi yul du gyur pa ste/ /gang yang de yi 12bu dang gnyen/ /gang zhig dpa' bo rnams mchod pa/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa po/ /de ni k+ṣadagra la 'jigs pa med/ /rgyal po'i 'jigs pa la sogs med/ /dus min 'chi bar mi 'gyur ro/ /me dang ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa med/ /rtag tu phyag rgya mchod par bya/ /bsod nams las ni thob pa yin/ /dpa' bo rtag tu der gnas bdagami /gus pas mchod pa bzhes nas ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po bzhugs pa yin/ /de ni mchod cing bsnyen par bya/ / gsol bstosayi ni don ched du/ /rnal 'byor gzhan la brten 1 byas na/ /log par yongs su langs 79—13

shing za/ /des ni 'bras bu mi 'thob7bo/ /dpa' bo'i rjes su bzungakhubyas na / /rtsod pa'i dus su dngos grub thob/ /dpa' bo gang zhig phyag rgya bral/ /sgrubar po mchod par byed pa ni/ /phub ma 'bru dang mtshungs pa ste/ /sa stengs sutswani rnal 'byor pa/ /chom po ba ru gyur pa yin/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor 'dzin/ /bdag nyid mchod par byed pa la/ /grol ba'i lam nir+sā)rnam par ster/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /bdag gis bzung bar byas pa yin/ /gang zhig gnyis med mi bsten pa/ /shi nas dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de la skyob pa med pa yin/ /rnal 'byor med par rnal 'byor 'chosani/ /phyag rgya la ni bgrod 'gyur dang / /ye shes med par ye shes tshul / /dmyal bar 'gro bar the tshom med/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /de bzhin sku lus dkar po ste/ /sangs rgyas nor bu'i gtsug tor can/ /rdo rje phag mo g.yon du byas/ / de yi7phyag mtshan kha dog 'dzin/ /thod pa gcig ni gdan dag la/ /sa dang nam mkha' nyid dag dang / /gnyis pa dag dang bzhi pa ni/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung phyag na bsnams/ /rdo rje phag mo gsum pa yin//'gro ba kun ni de ltar gnas/ /lha dang lha min7) mir bcas dang / /sa ni thams cad gdan byas nas/ /de nas las ni mnyam par brtsam/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las kha zas gnyis su med par bsgrub pa nges pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bdun pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor ma sngags 'dis/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /ji ltar rigs paratshwanyerab bshad bya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor gnyis med de/ /de 79wa 14

la mi yis stimachod par bya/ /dpa' bo'i sngags kyi yid bsgrub ②pa'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti badz+ra bā rā ④nyi bobya/ ār+sā pā rā dzi ⑤te/ tre+e lokya mā te ⑥ma hā bibye ⑦sha ri/ sarba bhū ta bha yā ba 2he ma hā badz+re/ badzā sa ne dhi.a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ⑩ba sh+yi /heka ri ne nya tra bhā ma ṇi/ sho ṣa ṇi tunyero ṣa ṇiñtsa/ kro dha ni 8ka rā li ni/ tā tsos ni mā ra ṇi mapra bho da tsha/3ni a pa rā dza 0ye bi dza ye dzam bha ni/lti bha m+mu ni/ mo ha ni/ badz+ra bā rā hi/ ma hā yo gi ni kā me shwa ri 0kha ge/tad ya thā pro rta du nyegi/ pro tai gedu snye/ ha sdo sten ha na/ mā tsā ki sonyekyi ṇi khri khi ṇi/dhu na dhu na/ badz+ra 0ha ste sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la dhā tsori ṇi/ ma hā pi shi 0ta māṃ sā sha ṇi mā nu ṭ+wāṃ tra pra bṛs saṃ ni rgyun ra shi ro ku nyumā lā gro thi ta dhā zhu ri nisum/ sum̐ bha ni sum ste ha na ha na/ mā tsā sarba pā pa satā ā+oṃ sarba pa shu rmā/ ma zhugehā mi sa: da ni myur ti rda'i ka rā li du snyeni/ ma hā mu dre mashrī he ru ka de ba su/a gra ma hi ṣi byas ha sra shi re sa ha sra wā ha we pustesha ta sa ha sra ā du)na ne/ dz+wa 9mi ta te dza se dzā zhurtal mu khi dzi ga la lo tsa ne( bye/ badz+ra sha rī re 0badz+ra ā rganyas ne(ste/mi li te ni mi li te he he ha ha 4ste hūṃ kha kha dhu dhu/ ru ru/(ge sgro ru dhu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ a dz+wa (nyete/ ma hā yo gi nī pa thi ta/ sid dhi dro hre dro n+t+ra(me/gro gre/ he ho/ ha ha/ gli (3me ha sa ha sa bī re she/ hā hā/ ho ho/ hūṃ rtsu/tre+e lokya/ bi nā sha ne(2 / sha ta sa ha sra snye/ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa 0ri bā ri ④te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sing ha rū rgyastepo khaḥ5snye/ ga dza rū pe gaḥniX/ tre+e lokya u dwa ri/ sa mu dra 9me kha le nu gra sa gra sa hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ r+pā rā dwo (7te hūṃ hūṃ ha ha ma hā pa shu mo ha ni/ yo gī rdzo )shwa ri s+t+waṃ 417 ki ni/ lo kā nī bca nyurtani sa t+ya 'apra t+ya ya kā ri 99khyi rgyu phaṭa/ bhū ta tā gas ni/ ma hā bī tsore pa ra ma sid dhe/ bibye yo gī 0shwa ri 79—15

phaṭa / rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa7)phaṭa swā hā/ dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags su5shegasungs pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas rdo rje phag mo yi/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni mchog grub pa/ /he ru ka dang phag mo ni/ /ma byung 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /'di dang 'dra ba'i gsang sngags ni/ /'jig rten gsum na med pa ste/ /'bum dang 'bum phrag gsum du gsungs/ /rgyud kyi snying po mtha' dag bsdus/ /gang gis cho ga 'di rnams rigadu cin /thams cad gtong ba lo ma bzhin/ /bdag gis phyi ru ma bzlas kyang / /las rnams kun ni 'grub pa'o/ /nyon mongs kun las nges par grol/ /dngos grub 'bras bu myur du 'thob(ge/ /shes shing dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu ster/ /de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid mchog tu mi 'gyur ba/ /kun la khyab pa de nyid rnyed/ /de ni lus kun la ni gnas/ /de nyid sangs rgyas ye shes te/ /dpal ldan he ru ka yis〈/gsungs/ /sngags 'di dag ni yang dag 'byung56)/ /gang zhig la lar rab tu gnas/ /bstan bcos mtha' dag sa steng du/ /grub mtha' nges pa yang dag gnas/ /'di ni shes pas 'grub pa ste/ /sngags rnams kun ni the tshom med/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol tu/ /de med par yang dngos grub med/ /grub mtha' rig byed mtha' 3nodag ni/ /snying po gcig tu rab grags pa/ /bdag nyid kyis ni 'grub 'o par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor bdag nyid gnyis med zlosatu 3/ /dngos grub thams cad the tshom med/ /las rnams kun gyis gos med de/ /rab 'phel kun tu 79—16

gtso bor 'gyur/ /lus rnams tu)kun la rnam par gnas/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung lhar shes bya/ /rigs rnams kun la kun tu spyad/ /kha zas la ni brtag mi bya/ /'di ni don dam ye shes te/ /'di ni go 'phang mchog yin no/ /sngags rnams snying po 'di dag ni/ /'jig rten kun la ster ba yin/ /dpal khrag 'thungasamangon par 'byung ba las rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyis 50thams cad dag pa'i le'u zhes bya ba ste dgu pa'o// //de nas sngags 'di thob pa yis/ /rang 'dod dkyil 'khor byas nas ni/ /rdo rje phag mo ma de gzhagarmetsho /rab tu 'bad pas bzlas pa ri bya/ /rang 'byungalone rdul ni dmar po7yis/ /yul nas rnyed pa'i ras gtub cing / /byi la yi ni rtug pa nyid/ /dngos grub 'dod pas spos na su bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis rlob/ /spos bzang 'di ni sngags rig go/ /rdo rje phag mo'i phyag rgya yis / /thod pa kha sbyar bcing bar bya/ /skra yi sbyin sreg 3)brjod pa ste/ /de hu — ltar ma rtogs nyunyamanyam bshad pa'i/ /dam tshig rab tu bskyang bar bya/ /rtag tu phyag rgya mchod bya ste/ /rtag tu bza' btung bya ba yin/ /'di ltar sngags zhes bya ba yin/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu ster/ /chang dang ba lang sha bsgos nyinate / /lag pa g.yon pas sbyin sreg bya/ /lha rnams kun dang skar ma dang / /klu sogs sum cu rtsa gsum gnas/ /sangs rgyas kyang ni dbang 'gyuramurten/ /phra mo mi rnams smos ci dgos/ /lce yi dri ma so shing dang / /de bzhin rang lus dril phyis lke/stedang / /mi dang a lak+ta dag gige/ /sbyin sreg dag ni byas pa yis/ /'jig rten gsum ni dbang du 'gyur/ /rdul dang rang byung dmar po dang / /79—17

kha zas skyugs pa'i bza' ba dang / /mi yi skra dang yang dag ldan/ /lan ciganyegis ni 'gugs pa'i mchog /rang lugs mar ni skyugs pa dang / /rang gi skra yis7sbyin sreg bya/ /nim pa'i shing gi⑧me sbar bas/ /lan cig gis7ni snangasaba'i mchog /bya rog sgro yis sbyin sreg bya/ /smyo byed ma la mnyam gzhag pas/ /tsha ba'i mar khus yang dag ldan/ /skad cig tsam gyis gsad dang bskradag/ /stong phrag dgusaru dgang blugs dang / /sbyin sreg dag ni bya ba ste/ /dus mi ring bar rgyal po 'thob/ /gang gis sha ni blugs pa dang / /mkhas pas dgang blugs7brgya phrag gis/ /de yi zla gsum nang du ni/ /skad cig tsam gyis dbul ba zad/ /gang gis rtag tu dran pa yis/ /skye bo kun la sdug par 'gyur / /zhag ni nyi shu rtsa gcig gis/ /'grub par 'gyur te the tshom med/ /'dod pa'i lha 'dra bud med mchog /myos shing smyo ba bsten par bya/ /'dod pa shin tu rgyas pa yis/ /'jig rten rnams la brtse bar bya/ /sa stengs rnams su dngos grub thob/ /bud med bye bas yongs su bskor/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo dang / /dpal ldan khrag 'thung mnyam sbyor la/ /dpa' bo kun gyis phyag byas nas/ /'jig rten gsum du dngos grub ster/ /dam tshig spyod pa〈nyebasrung bar bya/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i las kyi (3le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu pa'o// //de nas las mchog dam pa dag /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ni/ /rtag tu 'khyud pas0gegasang mchod bya/ /rnal 'byor mas ni mchog ster 'gyur/ /73—18

sgrub7pa pos ni nub kun tu/ /de nas pho nya mchod par bya/ /sha za'i rtsa ba khar bcug ste/ /ji tsam 'dod pa de tsam du/ /rtags ni las su〈'gyur ba ste//sa7yi dbu ni snying po dag /til gyisnyimar khur btsos nas ni/ /rkang pa'i mthil la byug par bya/ /de nas rtags su gyur pa ste/ /pa ta dang ni ka ṭu dang ske/ /ro nyi ni dngasarta yi dri/ /'di rnams cha ni mnyam byas te/ /arga'i 'o mar btags nas ni/ /ling ga la ni bskus byas nas/ /ji tsam tshad du 'dod pa ru/ /de tsam tshad du 'dod pa yin/ /myur du chu ni dron mo yis/ /bskus na snga ma bzhin du 'gyur/ /pad ma dkar po ge sar dag /sbrang rtsi dag dang btags nas ni/ /lte ba la ni bskus nas ni/ /rtags ni brtan par 'gyur ba yin/ /pad+ma dmar po ge sar dang / /til ni dkar po dag dang ni/ /ma ho'i mar ni ma bskol dang / /dpa' bo gcig pa'i rtsa ba dang / /sbrang rtsi lhan cig btags nas ni/ /lte ba la ni (shebyugs byas na/ /de srid rtags ni 'gyes mi 'gyur/ /rdul dang yung ba gnyis blangs te/ /ba yi dar ba bre do ni/ /ji srid bre gang gyur tsam du/ /de srid bskol bar byas pa yin/ /de ltar btung bar byas pa ni/ /nyi ma bdun gyis rdzogs par 'gyur/ /bcud len sbyor ba yang dag pa/ /dpa' bo yis nishegasungs pa'o/ /spre'u'i〈 )mchil ma blangs byas tetunye/ /phye ma zhib mor byas pa dang / /rang gi dpa' bo'i sgo nas ni/ /byung dang yang dag ldan byas ni/ /dbang du byed pa'i mchog yin no/ /rdo rje phag mo bzlas byas te/ /yid ni gang dang gang gnas pa/ /lan cigatshwanyebazlas pa'i sdigs mdzubarwanyeni/ /lag pa g.yon pa bskor byas te/ /gang dang gang la bsams pa stobla/ /'tshomanyeb gro dang gser dang ni/ /bza' ba'i zas dang 79—19

btung ba dag /de dag thams cad blangs nas ni/ /sngags pa'i khyim ni yongs su gang / /khrag dang rang byungashegacig byas te/ /sgrubashepos rig pa lan bdun bzlas / /des ni mi la reg byas na/ /reg pas skyes bu khrag 'dzag 'gyur/ /lan cigs bzlas pa'i rig pa 'dis/ /chus ni yongs su thar bar 'gyur/ /de ltar sems can gang gang ni/ /khrag dang khrag chen po dag gis/ /skud pa sbags te bcing bar bya/ /lan bdun bzlas pa dag gis ni/ /de gzugs 'dzin par the tsom med/ /kun tu chu yis grol bar 'gyur/ /bltas pas bud med gzugs bzang dang / /rgyal po rnams dang sa bdag dag /sgrub5gepos mthong dang ma mthong ba/ /thams cad 'gugs par 'gyur bsnyiste/ /lan bdun mngon par bsngags551byas nas/ /mda' yi shugs kyis 'ong bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma bdun na the tsom med/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyi 'dod pa dang / bcud kyis len dang 'gugs pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas dngos grub rnal 'byor che/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /thang ku'i gzugs kyi ri mo ni/ /sngags pas cho ga bzhin du bri/ /rnal 'byor ma yis lus gnas pa/ /sgrubasho pa pos ni mtshan par bya/ /bcu bzhi dang ni tshes brgyad dam/ /nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcu la/ /rig pas nub mo mchod par bya / /sgrub pos dri dang me tog dang / /spos ni ji ltar gsungs pa dang / /de bzhin yang ni bza' dang btung / /mar me phreng ba dbul ba dang / /dri zhim spos kyis mchod par bya/ /stanasngo'o)gcig la ni gnas nas ni/ /lha la mngon 73—20

par kha bltas nas/ /sngags pas kha ni nub tu blta/ /sgrub pa pos ni thang ku'i gzugs / /zhal bzhi phyag ni bzhi pa dang / /thod pa dang ni kha ṭ+wāṃ stig /mdzes pa dag ni gzung zhu ribar bya/ /lag pas zhags pa lcags kyu bzung ①/ /kha dog nag po 'bar ba che/ /thod pa'i phreng ba bcings pa dang / /stag gi pags ( pas bla gos byas/ /stan la g.yas (gebarkyang ba yis gnas/ /ral pa'i cod pan zla tshes brgyan⑥/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rus (7pas brgyan(3)/ /cho gas yang dag bsgom byas nas/ /de nas phreng ba blang bar bya/ /stan gcig ⑨la ni gnas nas ni/ /dpa' bo chen po 'jigs pa yi/ /me 'dra'i ༅lus kyi rig pa bzlas//sgrub pa pos ni snying po ni/ /mtshan ni thog thag bzlas pa bya/ /dang po'i thun la ha ha rgodayi/ /spyang ki tsheyi ni sgra sgrogs pa/ /sgrub po g.yog dang bcas pa yis / /de mthong 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa yi ni thun dag la/ /nam mkha'i steng du 'bar bar mthong / /mi g.yo bas ni bzlas pa bya/ /'gro ba thams cad za 'dra yang /du / /srin po'i 'jigs pa 'gyur ba'i zhal/ /thun gsum pa la mthong ba yin/ /lhar bcas lha min mir bcas rnams/ /thun bzhi pa la 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje phag mo mchog ster lag8 /dpa' bo chen po legs so legs/ /nga 8yis mchog ni sbyin zhes smra/ /mchog tu sa 'og 'gro ba dang / /ral gri mig sman 'khor lo dang / /ngag gis thams cad 'grub pa dang ske/ /phyag rgya chen po rjes su 'grub/ /phyag rgya gang gis sgrub pa po/ /dngos grub thams cad phun sum tshogs/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung des mchod bya/ /phyag rgya'i tsoyid dang lus dag la/ /phyag rgya'i mchod 1 pas mchog ni yod/ /'di ni bstan bcos nges pa yin/ /phyag rgyas dngos grub 518shes pa ste/ /'jig rten 73—21

gsum na yang dag gnas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas bshad pa/ /ma lus lus pa med pa 'grub/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las phyag rgya chen po bsgrubatupa'i thabs kyi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya bakhuste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas dgug⑧pa bshad pararnyubya/ /skye ba bdun pas dngos grub ster/ /srid par dngos grub dpa' bo che/ /thams cad pas ni lus gnas mchog /kun tu lag pa brkyang ba'i mtha'/ /kun tu mig dang spyi bo dang / /kun tu kha dang rna ba yis/ /'jig rten pa rnams bskorasrete gnas/ /de phyir myur du bsgrub par bya/ /gnyis med ye shes sems kyis7ni/ /rang gi lus la nges phyungapo)ba/ /'og gi char ni the tshom med/ /de ru bsgrub bya la ni gzhug /rtsa ba'i lam nas rnal 'byor ma/ /phyugs kyi sa bon blangs nas ni/ /bdag gi lus la gzhug par bya/ /rlung dang me ni yang dag 'byung / /bsgrub bya'i lus ni bza' ba yin/ / mgrin pa5)zhags pas bcings nas ni/ /lha mo'i sngags kyis 32rmongs byas te/ /thams cad 'gugasatshwanyepar 'gyur ba yin/ /sgrub pa po yis0stesngags lus kyis/ /brgyal zhing dran med rmongs pa dngashe/ /rdo rje phag mos shin tu rmongs/ /de ni rtag tu dbang du 'gyur/ /'ong zhing rjes su 'ong bar 'gyur/ /de ltapha7nyid du bkod nas ni/ /bsam gtan dag dang yang dag ldan / /bdag nyid chen pos brgyal 7byin dang / /sngon du brgya byin chung ma bkug18 /denas thabs ni shes par bya/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus dang / /rgyal ba rnams kyang dgug par bya/ /kun tu thabs ni phan pa'i mchog /gang zhig rgyud rnams kun tu sbas/ /rnal 'byor sngags ni gsungs pa'o/ /brtul 79—22

zhugs dang ni bzlas pa bral/ /smyung7ba cung zad mi dgos te/ /bsam gtan 'di yis 'grub par 'gyur/ /'gro ba blta zhing rab tu sbyar/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las skye ba bdun pa la sogs pa〈gethams cad dgug pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor cho ga bshad/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /'khor lo chen po pad ma bzhin9mi/ /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma/ /dkyil 'khor rgyal po mthong ba yis/ /dngos grub ci ste skye mi 'gyur/ /ring po nas ni thos pa dang / /ring po rnams ni mig gis mthong / /rnal 'byor ma yis 'dod chags dang / /zhe sdang rnams ni spong ba yin/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /pad ma bzhi ni yang dag ldan/ /grub pa'i slob dpon mtshan nyid ldan / /dkyil 'khor thig ni gdab par bya/ /sa yi cha mnyam yid 'ong bar/ /zug rngu thams cad rnam spangs te/ /tshon sna lnga dang ldan pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor mchog ni bri ba yin/ /dngos grub 'dod pas mnyam bzhag⑧pas/ /pho nya dag ni mchod par bya/ /dpa' bo'ang mchod par 'gyur ba yin/ /des ni rdul tshonasnyibasgrub par bya/ /rdul tshon rdzogs pa nyid kyis ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun thar pa ster⑥/ /mthe chung gi ni tshad tsam du/ /rdul tshon yang dag bri bya ste / /gal te re mig 'di dag ni/ /dma' dang chad dang 'khyog por gyur47)/ /dma' ba'i re khrasashedangos grub med/ /'khyog pos nad ni byed pa ste/ /slob dpon slob ma gnyis ka ni/ /ri mo chad pas 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de ltar spuri mo'i mtshan nyid ldan/ /sa yi dbus su mtho ba bri/ /shar dang byang dag dma' 79—23

bas ni/ /sngags pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /shar dang byang dag dma' ba dang / /dbus nishimatho bas rgyal por 'gyur/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i go 'phang nges/ /byang mtho bas ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /yang na nor ni brlag par 'gyur / /ji ltar sngon gsungs shar mtho bas/ /myur du rigs ni zad par 'ong ri / /ji ltar sa yi dbus dma' bas/ /sgrub tsho zhe pa po ni gsod pa yin/ /de ltar ri mo mtshan nyid ldan/ /sa la dkyil 'khor kun tu bri/ /khru gang khru gnyis khru bzhi 'am/ /brgyad dam gebacu gnyis bcu drug nyid/ /steng dang 'og tu brtag gepa med/ /gal te rtog pa med na ni/ /slob dpon ye shes rnyed par dka'abyu ske/ /dmyal ba mi bzad par ni 'gro/ /gang zhig dman pa'i mi ru 'gyur / /de nas dgod pa'i cho ga bshad/ /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor mas / /dpal ldan rdo rje khrag 'thung lha/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i 'khor gyis bskor/ /gshin rje ma dang skrag byed ma/ / tsan+ḍi kā ⑦ni kun spyod ma/ /nor ma dpa' bo'i blo ma rin dang / /sdud ma 'jigs ma brgyad pa ste/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba'o(97/ /gzugs can ma dang 'odasngo )byed ma/ /lā mā (1dang ni rab 'phel ma/ /sā 12pa li kā //slar ldog ma/ /i nyi kā hu byedang gar dbang phyug /brgyad pa ru ni brjod pa ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni yongs su grags/ /khro gnyer ma dang mche gtsigs ma/ /sna chen ma dang ba lang gdong / /dri chen ma dang glang chen rtsenyi / /ba lang rna ba gdong bzang stetsha/ /rnal 'byor spyod par gyur pa'o/ /dmar ba'i gtum mo nyid dang ni/ /sa ni ljang gu hu 7nyid dag dang / /stobs chen dpag tshad sna gsum ma dang / /rtsub mo dang ni bden smra ma/ /zhal ni shin tu mdzes ma dang / /thod pa'i dum bu ma dag ste/ /'di rnams snying rje'i dngos 79—24

grub sterahu)/ /sngon gyi rdo rje phagashemo nyid/ /rang nyid kyi ni rig pa yin/ /rang ming brjod pa'i sngags dag la/ /dang por o gyi yi ge lomi/ /hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa kyis mtha'akhumar sbyar/ /'dod pa'i don kun〈sgrub pa pos/ /de ni rtag tu mchod par bya/ /de ltar thams cad the tsom med/ /sringa'adzi mo dang ni bu mo dang ske/ /chung ma shin tu gzugs bzang dang / /rta dang glang po ba lang dang / /zhing dang bran pho bran mo dang / /rin chen rnams ni dbul bar bya/ /deng nas brtsams te bdag nyid 'bangs/ /bdag gi lus ni phul ba lags/ /slob ma dag ni mi 'bul na/ /dngos grub ring bar the tshom med/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol name/ /des ni dngos grub mi 'thob bo/ /dkyil 'khor mthong ba nyid kyis ni/ /dngos grub ci ste skyes)mi 'gyur/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /'bad pas7slob dpon dgyes par bya/ /de yisatshwa )dngos grub myur du 'gyur / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i lha yis ni/ /ji lta bu ru gsungs pa yi/ /ji lta bzhin du rdul tshon lngas(lha/ /dkyil 'khor mnyam par 32bri bar bya/ /gdong ni gos kyis bcings tsobyas temi/ /lho phyogs sgor ni dgug par bya/ /me tog snyim pasarwanyegator bar bya/ /me tog gang du lhung ba yotshe/ /gnas la sogs pa bstan par bya/ /o shrī he ru kā0 ge ya bibyā 3)ma he bit+yā /zhe'o dzā ya snyiḥni )ma he swā hā/bdag gis dpa' bo rab tu bskul/ /bklags sa pas las ni thams cad byed/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi dngos grub ni/ /'chi ba la ni (rtebarjod par 'gyur/ /dngos grub 'di yi0nyebye brag gis/ /nyi ma gcig gis dngos grub che/ /'jig rten gsum sgrub bsgom par bya/ /sgrub pa'i dbang po cho ga shes/ /dpal ldan he ru ka yi steni/ /brtul zhugs la ni nub gsum du snyeganas/ /lha yi lus su skye bar 79—25

'gyur / /lha yi ye shes mthong 'gyur te/ /de bzhin lha yi gzugs su 'gyur/ /rtsod pa kun las rgyal ba dang / /rgas dang 'chi ba rnam par spangs/ /sangs rgyas bzhin du lha mo bsten/ /dpa' bo bzhin du sa la rtse/ /phyag rgya dang ni bcas nyid du/ /nyi ma gsum gyis 'gyur ba nyid/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las lha dgod pa dang dbang bskur ba dang / bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor bshad par bya/ /dbang bskur 'khor lo mchod pa ni/ /slob mas nyi ma bzang po 'amanyu/ /ji ltar du ni nub mo la'o/ /de nas dpa' bo mchod par bya/ /stan gcig rigel ni gnas nas kyang / /pho nya mo nini bcu drug nyid / /dpa' bo dang ni gnyis med gnas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo la/ /sum bha ni yi rig pa yis④/ /phyogs bzhi ru ni mchod par bya/ /de ltar rnal 'byor chen po mchod/ /gzugs brgyad pos ni rab tu bsrungasnyi/ /sngags dang phyag rgya yongs rdzogs nas/ /gnyis med ye shes brtsamadzanyapar bya/ / nub mo kun tu sgrub pa pos/ /de nas pho nya mchod par bya/ /dus mi ring bar rgyal po 'grub / /'khor los sgyur ba stobs kyi rgyal/ /sgrub po shin tu mnyam gzhag pas / /sngags dang phyag rgya sbyar bar bya/ /chadam tshig thams cad bskyang bya ste/ /'jig rten gsum na rnyed dka' ba/ /g.yon nas skyes pas byed pa yin/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i mtshan ༄87nyid dang / /sbyor nyid cho ga'i ye shes ni/ /da ni nga yisalobashad kyis lha nyon/ /dbugs dbyung mchog gi bar dag ni/ /dri yi chu dang bcas pa dang / /rtag tu ril bu77bza' bar bya/ /mchod pa'i dus kyi bye 73—26

brag la/ /pho nyas lhan cig skyes dngos grub/ /dman pa mchog dang 'bring rnams kyi/ /de yis sbyor bas dngos grub 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa'o① / /dpal ldan he ru ka las byung / /rang byungadza me tog nyid dag gis/ /cho ga shes pas kun tu spyod/ /bzlas dang bsam gtan mchod pa dang / /me tog gcig dang yang dag ldan/ /blo ldan gyis ni ston mo bsgrub(7/ /ma lus snod gnyis 'dus byas te/ /rtog pa med pa'i shes rab che/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi tshul gyis ni/ /gang ltar ji ltar rnyed pa la/ /yid kyis gus pas mchod par bya / /gnyis dang gnyis med rnal 'byor bdag /mkha' lding kha bzhin btung bar bya/ /rigs lnga gcig tu yang dag 'grub/ /ston mo bzang po brtsam par bya / /rtag tu nub mo rgya che ba'i/ /mchod pa bya zhing brtsam ④/par bya/ /gnas der me0yi las kyis ni/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu dkrug par bya/ /rnal 'byor gang gis me tog gnas/ /sgrub pa thams cad spangs pa dang / /byol song rnal 'byor mchog tu 'grubag/ /dman pa 'bring dang mchog rnams ni/ /ce (shesbyang gnyis skyes mig chen dang / / khrung khrung59)sa ra sa dang khra/ /pho rog 'ug pa bya rgod kyis/ /dgang blugasasngo )kun gyi bye brag gis/ /mkha' 'gro ma la gtor ma sbyin/ /mchog dang dman pa'i dngos grub sterahu1/ /de yi rdzas kyi dngos grub skye/ /de bzhin mthong dang reg pa dang / /rtag tu 'o dang 'khyud pa dang / /sbyor ba'i gnas kyi bye brag gis/ /ji srid rnal 'byor tshogs kyis ni/ /dngos grub kun gyis byed par brjod/ /sngags las 'byung ba sbyin par bya/ /gzhan du nam yang ma yin no/ /ma dang bu mo sring mo dang / /chung ma pho nya mor gnas pa/ /gang gis rtag tu sngags ster ba/ /de ni de yi cho gar brjod/ /de nas 79—27

bdag gis dam tshig bshad/ /g.yon nas 'byung ba mchog yin no/ /gang zhig mi yi bu mo thob/ /he ru ka yi7sngags kyis ni/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub 'thob ②par 'gyur/ /ring po nas kyang rnam shes bya/ /khyim mamashezhing la rnam gnas nasal/ /khrag⑧'thung rnal 'byor las gzhan min/ /slob dpon rnal 'byor ma yin te/ /yid can gyis ni rgyud 'di ru/ /rnal 'byor thams cad shes par bya//gzhan du nam yang ma yin no/ /sngon du dang bsnyel brten nas/ /gus pa yis ni mchod par bya/ /rtag tu ma mos rnam par gnas/ /gnyis su med dang ngo tsha med / /phyag rgya shin tu rnal 'byor ldan/ /tshul khrims yang dag brjod pa yin/ /skye ba'i yul las skyes pa dang / /dam tshig yang dag bsrungasheb yin/ /sems kyi bdag nyid snying rjes phan/ /dam tshig can la khro min te/ /ma gus pa la bshad mi bya/ /mtshan mo thog thag bzlas pa bya/ /rnal 'byor ma la mchod par ni bya / /bcu drug gnyis med rgyal po'i don/ /nub mo ru ni dam tshig ste/ /dpa' bo rtag tu gcer bu yin/ /sgrubashepos sngags dang phyag rgya dang / /phyag rgya lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /sgrub po las ni mnyam par brtsa4)/ /bdag nyid pho nya mchog kun dang / /rnal 'byor gnyis med gnas na 3)ni/ /de las 'byung ba'i rdzas kyis bsgrubanyarte/ /de bzhin mthong dang reg pa pos/ /nyin77mo rtag tu gsang bsaste/ /rtag tu nub mo gsal bar bya/ /srog chags pags tso pas sham thabs bya/ /bde ba'i don du bskyod par bya/ /sgrub pa po ni dngos grub nyid/ /dag pa rnam gsum gyis 'grub ste/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung gnyis med gnas/ /zhal ni dkar gnag dang smra tshodang / /mi smra'i dka' thub la sogs spangs/ /dang po yi ni dag pa yi/ /sgrub7)thabs kun gyi mtshan nyid 79—28

dang ske/ /byol song zos pas gyo)bsod nams sog(0 /gnyis pa'i dag pa brjod bya ba/ /zla ba'i chu ni 'thungs pa nyid/ /gsum pa gnyis med brjod pa'o/ /dpal5)khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor lashogemachod pa dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcwa lnga pa'o// //de nas sdom pa bshad par bya/ /rnal 'byor rgyud las rnyed dka' ba/ /ma lus lus pa med par5ge'agrub/ /kun gyi rgyal por grags ji pa ste/ /rtag tu phyag rgya bsgrub par bya/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub 'bras don du/ /spun dang slob dpon mchod par bya/ /de nyid gnyis med rnams 7)gnas so3)/ /spun dang bu dang lhan cig tu/ /bde dang sdug bsngal kun tu 'byung / /de la ye shes bstan mi bya/ /sngags rnams su ni 'byin pa yin/ /gtsang zhing dag pa bza' bya ste/ /rtag tu dam tshig yan lag gsang / /sngags ni su la'ang mi sbyin te/ /man ngag rnam par nyams mi bya/ /gang gi don du man ngag rnams/ /dam tshig srung 9)ba sbyin par bya/ /rtag tu 'jig rten g.yon la spyod/ /rkang pa g.yon pa sngon du gtang ske/ /yan lag g.yon pa hu )bsgyur bar brtson/ /g.yon pas mdzub nyurtogator byas la btung / /lag pa g.yon pas bdag nyid mchod/ /'di ru g.yon pas 'khyud pa dang / /g.yon pas gus par mchod par bya/ /g.yon nas kun tu blta5geb nyid/ /de bzhin g.yon pas 'gro byas na1lha/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu ster/ /ji ltar bdag nyid g.yon pas spyod/ /g.yon pas thar pa'i mtshan nyid de8/ /cung zad gsungs dang ma gsungs pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung g.yon la spyod/ /sgrub pos sa stengs nyinaganas nas ni/ /bzlas dang 79—29

brtul zhugs bral byas kyang / /g.yon pas dngos grub 'gyur ba yin/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las g.yon pa'i mchod pa dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu drug pa'o// //de nas rnal 'byor ma yi ni/ /lta bas rengasalgepa'i cho ga bshad/ /snying gong sna rtser byin gyis brlab/ /de ltar rlung nishegayo med par/ /snying gi gong bus ske bcings te/ /gzugs bzang ba ni myur du 'ongs/ /de nas yi dgasakyimo bsgrubalgepa/ /skye gnas la ni gi wang gzhug /sngagasalgepas pad+ma'i steng gnas57te/ /bsam gtan bzlas pa yang dag brtsam/ /skyo0zhing kun tu ngu bar 'gyur/ /thig le byas nas gnas pa dang / /rgod7cing dgyes pa nyid dag go/ /de ltar gi wang dngos grub ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las nges par 'byung ske/ /ldong ros dang ni man shing7la/ /bu mo la ni gzhug par bya/ /ser zhing zlum pa'i mig nas ni/ /mchi mar bcas shing rtag tu ngu / /'di rnams kyi ni bzlas par gnas/ /de bzhin snying po nye snying po/ /rang gi srog bzhin legs par 'dzin/ /de ltar dpa' bo dngos grub che/ /rgyud 'di ru ni the tshom med / /rtsodarwa pa chen po 'byung ba la/ /yo yig kha dog sngon po la/ /rlung gi shugs kyis bskor bar bya/ /'khrugs hunyepa chen po gzhan gyi sde8/ /thams cad rengs shing brlag par bya/ /tsheg drag yi ges mtshon cha bya/ /nyon mongs med par sbyar bya ste/ /de ma thag tu thams cad brlag /de ni mi yi sde kun te/ /gang zhig cung zad mtshan mchog gis/ /bya ba la sogs byed pa yin/ /gza'algedang dug dang me dang dag⑩/ /ser ba rlung dang mtshon cha'i char/ /dpal khrag 79—30

'thung mngon par 'byung ba las gzugs bzang rtso)ma blta ba dang gi wang dang gzhan gyi sde rengs pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /ro langs kyi ni sgrubasang pa'i thabs cho ga yongs rdzogs rnal 'byor bdag /'grub par 'gyur te the tshom med/ /sngags pas ji ltar rnyed pa yige/ /ro ni nad med gas pa med/ /de ni blangs te bsgrub par bya/ /rnal 'byor kun la dngos grub ster/ /ba nag mo yisnyi'o ma dang ske/ /sran gre'u 'bras dang ldan pa phyogayi/ /thug pa ro yi56)kha ru ni/ /'jigs pa med par blug rtso)par bya/ /ji srid ro ni langs kyi bar/ /bdag gis ci bgyi zhes ni smra/ / ril bu 59mig sman dngos grub dang / /mchilalo)lham rgyal po ral gri dang / /sbyin dang dgra bo brlag pa dang / /rkang byug7dang ni bcud kyis len/ /don mchog gcig ni byin nas ni/ /'grub 'gyur gzhan du ma yin no/ /de ltar cho ga'i rim pa ni/ /mtshan nyid kun la bral gyur na/ /sdig pa dang ni yang dag ldan/ /dngos grub rab tu brlag par 'gyur/ /rtog pa 'di yi tshad ma rnams/ /snying po ru ni rab tu sgrogs/ /khyab 'jug drag po dbang po dang / /tshangs pa la sogs pa dag dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /drang srong sna tshogs dag pa dang / /klu dang dri za lha rnams te/ /ro langs nam mkha' lding la sogs/ /drag po lha min mi 'am ci/ /sha za dang ni srin po sogs/ /nyi ma zla ba skar ma bcas/ /'jig rten skyong ba bgegs kyi rgyal/ /ma mo'i dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni sna tshogs dang / /lā hunyam dang ni dum skyes ma/ /gzugs can ma ni slar 79—31

ldog ma/ /'dod ma sangs rgyas dbang dang ni/ /grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang ske/ /gnod sbyin pho dang gnod sbyin mo/ /phyogs chen dpa' mo u mnyel/ /ji ltar bde bar〈mirtse zhing rtse/ /de nas grub pa'i dpa' bo che/ /sngags rnams kyis ni 'di dag gis/ /de ltar grub pa'i sngags chen po/ /rig pa yis ni rnal 'byor skyob/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las ro langs chen po bsgrub byapa'i thabs lha thams cad dang rtse zhing bde ba'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcwa brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /snying po'i sngags sogs bzlas pa la/ /phreng ba'i rigs dang grangasasnyidag dang / /cho gas rnal 'byor bzlas pa bya/ /shel dang nya phyis mu tig dang / /ru drwa k+ṣa rinani mdzes pa yin/ /rdo rje'i mig gis dngos grub ster/ / pu tra ṭī ba kun la bshad④/ /ni bar ta dudang lung thang dang shes/ /tshe ring nad med 'phel ba yin/ /dbang du byed dang zhi 'dod dang ske/ /nor 'phel ba ni byed pa yin/ /byi7ru yis ni 'phel ba dang / /rin chen phreng bas mdzes pa yin/ /gser gyi phreng ba dag dang ni/ /sgrub pos rin chen phreng ba bsrel31/ /rgyal po'i don du sngags pas bzlas/ /dpal ni che ba nyid du thob32/ /dngos grub thams cad yod pa dang / /sa yi dbang por the tshom med/ /'byung po'i mtshan nyid dbang du byed/ /nor rnams 'gugs par byed pa'o/lha/ /bya rog sgro yis bskrad ⑩pa nyid/ /bong bu yis ni sdang ⑫ba'o / /khyi dang rta yi74phreng ba la/ /sgrub pos me tog gis ni mchod/ /ro yi spa yi 1 skud pa dang / /bong 1 bu'i spu dang yang dag ldan/ /skud pa 'di yis snang 79—32

ba dang / /khyi yi spu dang bsres7pas ni/ /dngos grub thams cad byed pa yin//gser gyi skud pas zhi bar 'gyur/ /yang na ras kyi skud pa50ni/ /gzhon nu ma yis bkalasnyeb yin/ /gzugs mdzes yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /gtsang zhing dran ldan 'jam par smra/ /de lta'i skud pa'i phreng bas ni/ /grol ba'i dngos grub ster bar 'gyur/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thungarang)mchod par bya(5)/ /spyi bor ri bong can gyis mtshan⑥/ /zhi zhing zhal ni bzhi pa ste/ /'dod pa kun gyi5 dz+wagazugs bzang ba/ /dpa' bo thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /sangs rgyas nor bus gtsug phud byas/ /lag pas 8)kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ni bzung du9/ /mdung dang ral pa'i cod pan byas/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /brgya phyed phreng bas nya rimatshan pa ste/ /lha chen chung mar bcas pa yi/ /steng nas mnyam par gnas pa yin / /steng nas gdugs dkar pos g.yogs te/ /lha yi dri yis byugs pa dang ske/ /lha yi me tog lus la mchod/ /phyag ni 'bum phrag dang ldan pa/ /lha yi ga bur dri yis ni/ /lus la bdug cing byugs nyu1pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni sna tshogs pas/ /rnga yab kyis ni g.yob pa yin/ /rnal 'byor mas ni mnyam par bskor / /lā ma dang ni dum skyes ma/ /rdo rje phag mo g.yon la gnas/ /dpal ni skyedatshwanyetshal pad+ma ni/ /rtag tu me tog 'bras bu gnas/ /'dod pa'i shing la lcug〈nyem rgyas/ /lha dang lha min tshogs 1 ci kyi gnas/ /'dod pa'i rjes chags skye ba ste/ /skyed 3nyemos tshal na dpal samachog ste/ /sprin gyi nyu phreng ba phyed kyis bkab / /'dod pa'i ro yi nyi char pa 'bab/ /'dod pa'i gnas ni mchog yin te / /chags dang byams pas kun tu gang / /pho nya kun dang mnyam par spyod/ /dpa' bo dang ni yang dag ldan/ /nags kyi dbus na rtse 19ba ste/ /dpal ldan 79—33

rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug /glu dang gling bu gar la sogs/ /zangs dung sgra ni mnyam pa'i rigs/ /rnga ring gisheni sgra la sogs/ /cha lang sgra ni chen po dang / /rdza rngar byas pa'i sgra dag dang / /pa ṭasaha ni brdungs pa'i sgra/ /pi wang dgashepo rgyud mngasasgra/ /rol mo kun gyi sgra chen pos/ /dpal chen bcas par rtse ba ste / /kun tu yongs su khengs pa yin/ / de yis tshogesbyor ba'i dngos grub 'gyur//ji srid snying po skyes kyi bar du'o/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid dang / mchod pa dang rtse ba'i rtsed mo'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas dngos grub rnal 'byor che/ /sbyin sreg las ni rab bsgrub pa/ /dngos grub kun gyi dbang phyug rgyal/ /sbyin sreg gnyis med dgang blugs57kyis//mnyam med skal bzang de yitshan)ni/ /dngos grub kun ni skye ba ste/ /skye shi rga dang mya ngan dbul/ /myur ba nyid du brlag par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'ishedon du sgrub 3) pa pos/ /stong phrag bcu yi sngags7)ni bzlas/ /pho nya'i steng du gnas nas ni/ /sbyin sreg stong phrag lnga ru bya/ /sha chen dang ni 'o mar bsnos/ /sbyin sreg nyunyedagang blugs rim pa yis/ /dpag tshad 'bum phrag brgya yi bar/ /g.yog 'khor phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /dngos grub chen po rgyal dbang dpal / /ma nyams kun tu khyab cing 'gro/ /sngags pas dus bzhi ru ni gsonahunye / /de la susarwahekyang gnod mi nus/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor gyis / /stong phrag sumashicu rtsa gnyis bzlas/ /ba lang sha dang sha chen dang / /ces spyang sha yis dgang blugs ni/ /chang dang 'o ma mnyam par bsnos/ /sbyin 79—34

ga 'bum phrag gcig tu bya/ /gling bdun gyi ni rgyal dbang por/ /'di yis pal chen longs spyod 'gyur/ /ji srid snying ponyergyas kyi bar/ /de nas dngos ba sngags chen po/ /brgyad50lhag pa yi brgya ni bzlas/ /rdzas dang cho ga gas pa yis/ /dgang blugs stong phrag lhag par bya/ /dpa' bo rtsa ba'i gas kyis ni/ /'di nyid du ni dgang blugs brgya/ /bzlas pa rab tu sbyin bya rka/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma bzhin spun/ /de ltar sbyin sreg cho ga brjod/ / nas rab 'phel sngags7shes pas/ /sa stengs8)gang gis 'grub par 'gyur/ /skal pa chen po stong phrag gam/ /de bzhin bskal pa stong phrag tu/ /ma nyams gas pa kun khyab spyod/ /ji ltar ji bzhin 'gro ba nyid/ /sgrub pos nyi ma re ru/ /rtag tu dgang blugs lnga yis mchod/ /rgyal po yul 'khor dbang du gyur / /bcu yis mi dbang rgyal po dang / /sde ni stobs dang bcas pa kun/ / rnams myur du dbang du 'gyur/ /sna tshogs bdag nyid nor dang ni/ /sa ni ma cu thams cad dang / /gling bdun rnams kyang dbang du 'gyur/ /rgya mtsho dun ni〈)mtha' gtugs par/ /longs spyod sa ni gser rang bzhin/ /sum lnga yi sbyin sreg gis/ /sa 'og bdun gyi lha ma yin/ /sgrub pos chung mar cas pa ni/ /myur bar dbang du byed par 'gyur/ /de ltar dngos grub rnal byor cheyo/ /dpa' bo dbang phyug dag gis gsungs/ /de nas sha yi dgang gas 'bu'akho/ /yang na sha chen dag gi'o/ /chang dang bcas nas sebasres sa ni/ /pad+ma gcig tu sbyin sreg bya/ /sngags pas yul ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /ma brgya yi ni tshad kyis so/ /'bum phrag gsum gyi hu )sbyin sreg gis/ /'dzam gling ni kun tu 'thob/ /'bum phrag lnga yi dgang blugs kyis3sto/ /gling 79—35

bdun de yis longs spyod 'gyur/ /rtse zhing dngos grub rgyal dbang po/ /ji srid snying po rgyas kyi bar/ /rtag par gsung ba'i cho gar gnas/ /skal dman gyis kyang 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ltar gsungs0)pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi bdag nyid che/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las gling bdun gyi 'khor los sgyur52ba'i rgyal po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu pa'o// //de nas mngon spyod kyi ni las/ /'dod pas dpa' bo rnams ni bsten/ /dug khrag tsha ba'i mar khu dang / /mi yi rus pas sbyin sreg bya/ /tsher ma'i me ni rab tu sbar/ /de bzhin 'bras bu phub maras ldan/ /khro ba rgyas shing skra yang grol / /gcer bu kha yang lho ru bltas/ /sngags pas gos ni nag po byasang/ /nyi ma phyed na me la ni/ /drag po 5kyilas kyi sbyin sreg bya/ /gtum po'i (yeme la sems gcig gis/ /ji ltar nub mo'ang bya ba yin/ /sngags kyi mtha' ni ming dang sbyar/ /nus pa grol zhing myur bar dgugaci ci /stobs ldan sde dang bcas pa ni / /mngon spyod kyis ni gsad 8)par bya/ /pho nya de nyid rnal 'byor bdag /'grub par 'gyur bar ga9 the tshom med/ /'di ni gsad 1 dze pa'i las yin te/ /phyi nas lha la bzod 11par gsol/ /'o ma bil ba sbrang rtsi mar/ /til dang ldan pas dgang 12brugs bya/ /de ltar dpa' bo rab tu zhi/ /yang dang yang du sngags 'di bzlas/ /de nas bskrad pa rab tu bshad/ /nyi ma 1nyagazhan la las brtsams te/ /bya rog sgro yis sbyin sreg bya/ /dri chen ro ni rgya chen dang / /sha za'i shing gis me sbar te/ /rlung phyogs kha ni bltas te bskrad/ /bdag nyid du 73—36

ni gnas nas ni/ /zhag bdun gyis ni the tsom med/ /rnam par sdang ba bshad par bya/ /sngags pas nim pa'i 'dab )rim dang / /sbrul gyi pags brjes5geyang dag ldan/ /bya rog lug pa'i tshang dag dang / /smyo byed me riXni rab sbar te/ /brgyad lhag brgya ni gzhug par bya/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam par dbye/ /gnyen dang bshes rnams gtong bar 'gyur/ /dgug pa'i don du sbyin sregashogeni//mtshan gyis 'di bzhin bsam gtan bya/ /seng ldeng 5me ni rab tu sbar/ /dus gsum du ni sbyin sreg spyodañtsari/ /de yi ming ni lan cig 7 blang / /de la sngags kyis sbyor ba ste/ /rtag tu sngags pas sbyin sreg bya/ /nges par thams cad 'gugs pa yin/ /sngags pas nub mo sbyin sreg bya/ /'dod pas pho nya bcas pa ru/ /de yis thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /phyag rgya yi ni rjes 'jug (2pas / /phyag rgya yi ni sbyor bar 'grub/ /rtag tu rgyal po dbang po dang / /yang dag sangs rgyas pha rol gnon/ /ye shes gzugs ni rnal 'byor che/ /'dod gzugs mar ni gyur pa ste/ /lha mo chen mo lha ma yin/ /klu mo nyid kyi bu mor 'dod / /srin mo dang ni nye srin mo/ /dri za dang ni gnod sbyin mo/ /mi rnams nyid ni thams cad du/ /'jig rten gsum ni 9ridabang du 'gyur/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi rab sbyar bas/ /rnal 'byor phyag rgya la ni rtse1 / /bza' dang btung dang rnyed dang 'jigs/ /'di nyi rnams kun ni yongs su gtang 12/ /de nyid don dam ye shes te/ /de nyid don dam go 'phang 1lhayin/ /de nyid don dam sangs rgyas nyid/ /de nyid don dam bde ba ste1 / /gzhan du yod par mi brjod do35/ /dam tshig nye bar spyad pa yin/ /rtag tu gnyis med phyag rgyar 'bacas/ /pho nya mchod pas rab tu 'phel/ /sgrub pos mchod pa tsam gyis ni/ /dngos grub 79—37

kun ni shin tu byed/ /pho nya smad par mi bya ste/ /sgrub pos thams cad 'gugs pa yin/ /rgyabashedang smad dang bcas57pa dang / /longs spyod sdig pas gos mi 'gyur / /pho nyas lhan cig skyes dngos grub/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa rab tu 'phel / /rnal 'byor sbyor bral mi bya ste/ /'di rnams sngags ni smras pa yin/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las phrin las bzhi'i sbyin sreganyegi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba byaste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad par bya/ /ro langs chen po sgrub5nyepa'i thabs/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /'khor lo57kun la rnam par gnas/ /mi yi mar khu de yi sha /sregs blugs brgya rtsa brgyad blugs bya/ /de ru rdo rje phag mo byin/ / mkha' 'gro ma yi rin)'khor gyis bskor/ /ro langs srin pos7yang dag gang / /bsregs pa rgod hu )cing 'jigs par byed/ /ce57spyang sna tshogs nga ro che/ /yongs su bskor nas 'jigs par sgrogs(rte/ /srin pos bkram nas sdigs nya par byed/ /'jigs pa'i dbyangs kyis sdigs mipar byed/ /de mthong 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /lus kyi sngags kyi nga rgyal bya/ /dpa' bo chen po legs zhes brjod/ /bdag nyid rdo rje sems brtul zhugs/ /sgrub po yid la ci 'dod pa'o/ /de la mchog ni brgyatshamaster te/ / de yi gnas su dpa' bo 'gro//rnal 'byor ma yis yongs su bskor/ /de nas de ma thag nyid du/ /'jig rten gsum la spyod par 'gyur/ /rang nyid lha yi nyurtelus su skye/ /dpal chen skal bzang 18'dod pa'i gzugs/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /nam mkhar kun tu spyod pa nyid/ /nad dang 'chi ba rnam par spang7)/ /gnas kun 79—38

la ni spyod pa ste/ /'di rnams las ni dam pa mchog /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bos bshad/ /gnas las rnam par rgyal bar 'grub/ /de nas dpal chen las rgyas byas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang 'thob/ /de yi las ni rab tu 'grub/ /gang gis bzlas med 1)rgyud kyang med/ /spyod pa med cing smyung 5ba med/ /yid kyis ma lus par byas nas/ /sems dpa' chen po 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las ro langs chen po'i sgrub (thabs kyi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba 4)ste nyi shu rtsa spuganyis pa'o// //de nas dgug pa bshad par bya/ /mdor bsdus pa ste rgyas par min/ /bdag nyid khrag 'byung rnal 'byor gyis/ /'grub par 'gyur te the tsom med/ /thod pa dum bu gcig pa ste/ /skyon kun med cing mdzes pa la6)/ /bsgrub bya'i lus ni bri bar bya/ /de bzhin brgya phyed 'dab 7ma la/ /sngags dang ming ni lhan cigs48)tu/ /khrag chen dang ni mnyes nas su/ /gser gyi smyu 9)gus nang du bri / /sngags ni gi tshawang 11khu bas so/ /steng nas 'khor lo kha sbyor 51 yin/ /snying po bzlog ste bsgrub par bya/ /sngags ni bzlas shing gzhug 1 par bya/ /sngags pas nam phyed du gnas te/ /'dab 1 ma gcig ni yang dag blang / /lus kyi sngags kyi nga rgyal gyis/ /'dab 15ma brgya ni sbyin sreg bya/ /sems kyis tsoyid la ci 'dod pa/ /sbyin sreg pho nya'i ye shes dang / /gtor ma sbyin pa'i bye brag dang / /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor gyis/ /phyag rgya bcing ba sna tshobasam par bya/ /bsgrub bya de yis 'gugs 18par 'gyur/ /rgyal po'i bu mo bud med 79—39

mchog /'khor los sgyuratubar bcas pa dang / /gzhan du bya ba brtag mi dgos / /dngos grub 'di rnams mchog tu gsang / /rnal 'byor mchog ni mngon du bsgrubacin / /mdun du dgyes byed mchogashegis so/ /yang na las mchog dam pa dag /sgrub gepos bsgrub bya'i lus dag ni/ /tsan dan dmar po'i rang bzhin las/ /gzugs brnyan dag ni rab tu byas/ /rang gi khrag dang gi wang gis/ /mngon par bris te snying gar gzhagage) /tsha ba gsum gyis lus ni byug /zangs kyi khab kyis rinyabasgrub bya yi/ /snying dang lte ba gsang ba ru//gnas gsum dag ni phug pa ste/ /nam phyed kyi ni dus dga'agetu/ /snying po'i sngags ni go bzlog bzlas/ /gang 'dod de ni 'gugs〈8)par 'gyur/ /seng lding me la de srid gdung / /sngags ni rjes su dran pa yis/ /bsgrub bya myur du 'ong bar 'gyur/ /gnas der sangs rgyas 'jig rten sogs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dag kyang ni/ /rlung gi shugs kyis 'ong bar 'gyur/ /sngags 'di dag ni dran tsam gyis/ /'jig rten gsum ni dbang du 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i bya yang lhung 9bar 'gyur/ /shing rnams kyang ni gus par 'gyur/ /chu ni rgyun las ldog pa dze+e / /'khrul 'khor dang ni glang chen dang / /rta dang sbrul dang spre'u dag dang / /mtsho yi rlabs ni 'ching bar byed/ /ji ltar thang la 'gro ba bzhin / /de ltar chu la 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gser gyi btsag gis bha ga bri/ /de steng lag pa g.yon pa ni/ / bzhag ste 11brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas bya/ /gang gi ming ni gzung nyirten ni/ /de ni de ma thag tu 'ong / /rang gi mal stan la gnas te/ /lag pa g.yon par 1lharang rtags gzungakhe/ /gang gi ming brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ /de ni de ma thag tu ni/ /sangs rgyas dkar mo de bzhin du/ /rab tu 'dod 79—40

par 'gyur ba yin/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo ni/ /dran pas 'jigs par 'gyur ba ste/ /bzlas shing brtse bas sbyar bas ni/ /rig pa kun yang rmongs par byed/ /gang gis rig pa sbyor dran pas/ /'jig rten gsum ni dkrug par bya/ /rig pa 'di rnams zhes bya ba/ /dpal ldan phag mo zhes bya ba/ /rmongs dang dbye ba 'di rnams ni/ /khams gsum dbang du byed pa'o/ /bklags7shing bshad pas dngos grub sogs/ /dngos grub kun byed 'jigasamasapa yin/ /bshes dang bu mo rigs sogs la/ /sngags 'di brjod par mi bya'o/ /thams cad ci bgyir 'gyur ba ste/ /sgrub pos mthong bas nges par lhung / /mi mo'i mtshams las 'dzag 'gyur te/ /rtag tu ngo tsha btang 4)bar 'gyur/ /gos med skra ni grol ba dang / /nu mkhrang bdag nyid gzhan dbang 'gyur/ /lus la reg5nyapa mtha' dag dgod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dang mnyam 'gyur/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las dpal rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i sngags kyis dgug pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas kun tu 'bad pa yis/ /phyag rgya chen po rab sgrub 6pa/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sgrub pos dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /mche gtsigs ma yi phyag rgya yis / /sgrub po 'dod pa'i tshul gyis su / /sa rnams kun la nges par spyod/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams ni/ / thams cad dkrugs nas de yis ni/ /9'dod pa'i dngos grub rab tu ster/ /brtul zhugs med cing sgyung nyi chib med/ /bsam gtan dang ni ldan pa med/ /rjes su dran 11pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum ni dbang du 'gyur/ /gang gis skye ba'i go 'phang 79wa 41

mthong ske/ /lus la sa bon bkod pas ni/ /'jigs shing skrag la brgyal bar 'gyur / /rnam par rmongs shing 'dzumanyepa ste/ /'dod pas myos pa'i skye boshosarnams / /bud med nyid du gyur pa ni/ /sgrub pos mthong bas dgyes par 'gyur / /sems ni rab tu myos par song / /rig pa 'di zhes bya ba ni/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo las/ /nges pa ru ni 'byung ba ste/ /sems can thams cad dkrug pa yin/ /rang 'byung sangs rgyas kyis ni gsungs/ /sna tshogs rig pa gde yis ni/ /lan cig5gebazlas shing bsgrub par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dra bar ni/ /'jig rten pa yis mthong bar 'gyur/ /rig pas 'gugs shing de nas 'ong / /de ma thag tu brgyal 5)ba dang / / ltung zhing 'chi bar 'gyur ba yin / /rinagasungs pa'i 'dab57)ma yang dag blang ge/ /'khor lo bdag gis mngon par bri/ /bya rog sgro yi snamanyu)gus ni/ /mig gi chu yis yang dag bri/ /gang gis rlung gis 'thor 34 rib ru/ /snying po bzlog la bzlas hu1pa bya/ /steng du rlung gi nyarte'akhor ba ste/ /brgya byin yang ni skrag par 'gyur/ /dgra bo la ni mngon spyod do/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las rdo rje phag mo'i go bzlog pa'i snying po'i /snyedagug pa dang bskrad tshepa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba〈2ste nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas mkha' 'gro ma yi ni/ /mtshan ma ru ni 'gyur ba tsheste/ / pro tang 1 gi ni phyag rgya zhes/ /gnyis pa pra ti pro 18tang gi/ /bde 'am zhes ni bya ba yin/ /phyag rgyar yang ni 'gyur ba ste/ /dpa' bo chen po'i brda yin no/ / ga mi sna na zhes bya ba ni 'gro ba yin no/ /ā ga ma 3 zhes bya ba ni 'ong ba'o/ /de 31nyi zhes 79—42
