bya ba ni7chang gi btung7ba'o/ / gri rgya ri ni gnas so/ /tsalaru ka ni ston mo med ces bya'o/ /bru tsa na55)zhes bya ba ni gtor ma'o/ /tsa ru ka 56)ni khyim 'di zhes bya ba'o/ /na zhes bya ba bzang ba'o/ /pu ta ka zhes bya ba gtor ma'o/ /bun dzan+tishezhes pa kun tu mdzes pa'o/ /tsa ra ka ni mnyam par 'gro ba'o duzhes bya bar gsungs so/ /sma per na ma ni ngag gis bshig pa'o/ / ka t+ya ni bu mo'o/ /ṇiḍa ha ni 'o byed pa'o/ /gha dha ni g.yogs07pa'o/ / swa ra sha 3)ni g.yon pa'o/ /e tad tanyeni bza' ba dang bca' ba'o/ /bal ni ka 7ni dam tshig go/ /si ra ni mchod pa'o/ / ā li kai bobaden par gsungs pa'o 7zhes gsung bar〈 rme'agyur ba'otunye/ / lā la5)ni khro ba zhes gsung bar du 'gyur ro/ /samanyasra ba ṇ+ḍaṃ ( —rterna ba zhes gsungs so/ /sa ta ni srog ces su /shes par 'gyur ro/ / shā nyi steni chung ma zhes su gsungs so/ /bha ge ni bu mo dang sbyor bar 'gyur ro zhes su brjod par 'gyur ro/ /a shwa tsās lhani bud med kyi nu ma'o/ /ba laḥta zhukhuka ni skyes bu'o/ /ba la ha ka ni de dag 'khrud pa'o/ / kā na tā zhu tshoni ma'o/ /tā na/li ka ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /ka n+ya ni tsho rte'adod pa'i skyes bu'o/ /me ra ni yod pa'o/ /bā kye sa ka ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /na ra ka zhes pa dur /khrod do/ /ka khri ni〈rtesgo'o/ / sha ba5nyeni bram ze'o/ / bi ra0 tsho dhi ni rgyal rigs so/ / tsa ra dhim ni rje rigs so/ /ku ra ni dmangs rigs so/ /an ta sbri ni05gtum mo'os tsho/ /gro nyete ni phyugs so/ /hi hi zhes pa gsod pa'i stonas(mo'o/ /75 tshogi ni༄7'dus pa'o/ / u da rka5)ni zla ba'i btung ba'o/ /groṇ+ḍa nyeni phyag rgya rnams so/ / dzi hwa༄nyeni ro'o(ge/ /so la reg pa ni ltogs09pa zhes brjod pa'o/ /an traṃ zhes pa ni 'grangs5 1pa'o/ /gan+da ba si ni gnas pa'o/ /bi ma la /zhes pa ni che ge mo'i 79—43

gnas so/ / ki ra ṇa0rini me tog go/ /rgod pa du ni khro bar5kyebarjod pa'o/ /los nipo da raḥ45so zhes par gsung b.raho'u)'gyur ro/ /mu kha ni tshos mkhan du 'gyur rol/ / dzi hwa ni78)mi 'jigs par gsungs so/ / a da na nisheso'i phreng ba'o/ / dhā dza ni tshan ho 3)ha'o/ /tsa la ni rlung ngo / /pa shu ni ri dgas nyurteso/ /'i〈nyes yan ti skoni dkyil 'khor ro/ /sa me ni bzhi mdo'o/ / go ta ni 8khrag go/ /ma hā gaspyo rdzob sa ni mi 'gyur ba chen po'o/ /a nyiphanyezhes bya bas37ni dbang phyug chen po'o / /si dha ge rini rnam grangs so/ /kha la reg na zhu7ltogs pa zhes pa'o/ /so la reg pa ni tshim zhes pa'o/ / a rgya ni dbul zhu po zhes su gsungs so/ /gsang bar reg na 'khrig pa'o/ /brla la reg na gyis zhes pa'o/ /'og tu bltas na med ces 2nyepa'o/ /steng du bltas na yod cesa'astepa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi mtshan ma'o/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las gsang ba'i brda'i cho ga'i le'u zhes 25bya ba ste nyi shu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas mchod pa'i bye brag rnams/ /g.yon nas byung ri lhabs bya ba ste/ /cho ga shes nas phyag gi lan/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma las byung / /sa ni spyan mar bshad pa yin/ /chu khams mā ma tī 2 —ru brjod/ /gos dkar mo dang sgrol ma ni/ /me nisnyedang rlung du rnam par gnas/ /'o byed ma ni stong pa'o/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'o/ /mdzubalo/mo'i lcags kyu'i spyan ma ste/ /mthe bong mā ma khrib tshoru brjod/ /gung mo gos dkar mo ru brjod/ /mthe'u chung la ni sgrol mar sbyar/ /ming med la ni 1 pha rol phyin/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor dbus su mthong ske/ /gnas la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /thams cad rgyab tu gshegs 79wa 44

su gsol/ /de ltar g.yon pa khyad par can/ /slob ma rnams ni bdag nyid che//rdo rje sems dpa' thabs chen dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnam snang mdzad/ /gsum pa pad+ma gar dbang phyug /bzhi pa he ru ka ru brjod/ /lnga pa nam mkha'i snying po ste/ /drug pa la ni rta mgrin no/ /de bzhin khro bo'i rdo rje mchog /'khor lo'i gnas la blta bar bya/ /bya ba thams cad sgrub0)pa la rang ming brjod pa'i sngags dang ni/ /rtsu hūm̐ phaṭa yig sbyar ba yin/ /gshin rje'i phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /ji srid bden bral gyi ni bar/ /g.yon pa'i kun spyod 'di rnams 'dod/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni mnyam par gnas/ /'di rnams rang gi rigs dang ni/ /phyag rgya dang ni kha dog rigs/ /rigs kyi rig pa yi ge nyid/ /gang phyir de yi rigs su 'gyur/ /rang gi phyag rgya bcings pa yin/ /smra ba rang gi rigs ni brjod/ /bud med gang zhig g.yon du 'gro/ /rtag tu mkha' 'gro ma ni g.yon/ /ngag ni rab tu chen por smran/ /g.yon pa'i lta5)bas kun tu blta / /bud med rnams la dgyes par smra/ /de ni dam tshig zhes su brjod/ /bud med rnams la gsol ba gdab/ /rigs kyi sa bon rab tu brjod/ /rigs kyi bya ba gtang7mi bya/ / rang gi bstan bcos brjod mi dor/ /phyarang gi rigs kyi rig pa bzlas/ /de bzhin du ni dam tshig bstan/ /gang zhig phyag ni byed pa ni/ /rtag tu g.yon pa yis ni bya/ /bud med rnams dang mthun7par bya/ /de yis nges par bden par 'byung / /rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis / /sa la bskor)rizhing ri mo 'drin)/ /lag pa g.yon pa rang phyogs kyi/ /spyi bo la ni 'drudashepar byed/ /de yis rang gi rig pa dran/ /sgrub po'i lus la phan pa yin/ /mkhuratshwa )tshos dang ni kos ko dang / /sna la snyim pas reg pa 79—45

yin / /logs su blta tshizhing sngags bzlasashedang / /lan cigasherig pa la ni blta5ge / /rnal 'byor ma ni bde bar 'gro/ /gang gtso)dam tshig nges pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams rnyed par dka'agye/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams de bzhin no/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni bden par 'gyur(7)/ /dngos grub kun byed mdzes pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams rigs dang ni/ /'di ru dpa' bo la sogs mtshan/ /thod pa bla re mche ba dang / /'khor lo rgyal mtshan ral gri dang / /rtse gcig tu ni brgyad par brjod/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi52)rigs phyag rgya/ /dpa' bo sgrub0)pa rab tu grags/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo yi/ /rigs las yang dag byung ba yin / /rnal 'byor chen po dbang phyug gtso/ /gang zhig rtag tu sha la sred/ /mkha' 'gro thabs kyi nga rgyal gyisanyu ri/ /zad pa med cing khyadamanyapar med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su 'byung / /'jigs pa med cing ngo tsha med/ /thams cad dus su 'gyod pa med/ /mchod pa 3)byed par 'dod pa ste/ /sgrub hurtepos mtshan ni thog thag tu/ /gzhan la nam yang bshad mi bya/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung / /zhes bya gang gis bklags78pas 'grub/ /sgrub pos dka' ba med pa ru/ /sa 'og tu ni 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sems can la ni phan dang gnod/ /yul kun laphageni skyes pa la/ /ji ltar rim pa zhi dang rgyas / /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las lag pa'i brda dang rnal 'byor ma'i mtshan ma dang / phyag rgya'i mtshan ma'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /mngon sums7dngos grub ster ba dang / /79—46

gang gis bris pa tsam gyis ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'ang ༅tshobarlag par 'gyur/ /ro dang btsun mo'i 'dzag pa las/ /rab dang 'bad pas yang dag blang / /bcu bzhi dang ni nag po'i slobargyad/ /ro bsregs ri khung bu'i sol ba yis thams cad rdo rje zhal bzhi pa'i/ /sngags ni rab tu chud par bya/ /sgrub pos gang zhig gnas su ni/ /lan bdun bzlas la brkos la gzhug /nyi ma bdun gyis nges par 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i gnas su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin rig pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /lus la mngon par brgyan 4)byas pa/ /de yang yid kyi rnal 5'byor gyis/ /mngon spyod kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /de ltar cho ga yang dag ldan / /thams cad las ni bsgrub 6par 'gyur/ /rang nyid kyisam7)ni sngags gzungs2)na/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /'grub pa dag tu yang mi 'gyur/ /de kho na nyid bsdus pa dang / /dpal mchog dang po'i 9'khor lo sdom/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed la sogs par/ /man ngag nye bar 'gro ba ni/ /lus kyi pho tshodabus na yod pa ste/ /rdo rje khrag 'thung ye shes ni/ /sgrub pos gang gis 11 mi shes pa/ /gang zhig brtul zhugs yun ring 12yang / /de las dngos grub med par 'gyur/ /'di ru las mchog shes par bya/ /sngags gzhan rgyas pa ci zhig dgos/ /'di rnams kun ni yongs su btus1na/ /rab tu 'bad pas 'di ru gzung be/ /sgrub pos gang dang gang gis ni/ /bsgom 15dang bzlas pa brtsams pa yin/ /de dang de yis rnal 'byor bdag /'dod pa'i 'bras bu thob sapar 'gyur/ /ji ltar nor bu dang ba dag /rdzas la brten 1 nas gzugs ni 'dzin/ /de ltar dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal/ /bsam gtan yang dag mchog tu 'gyur/ /dngos po gang dang gang dag la/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /de dang de yi rang 73—47

bzhin 'gro/ /sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu 'dra/ /sgrub po rnal 'byor gzhonatul 'dod/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyas7mi 'grub/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyis bsgrubashepa la / /dpa' bos rab tu sbyor ba sbas/ /ji srid snying po rgyas kyi bar/ /de dang de ni nyon mongs 'gyur/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las nang gi bsam gtan dang bzlas pa7rnam par dag pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'o// //de nas sngags ⑤shes shin tu gsang / /sbyor shes de nyid rnal 'byor brtsa'adzi)ske/ /'gro ba kun ni rmongs pas khyab/ / kṛ ya'i57lam la sgrubalgepa yis/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya yis kyang / /de la 'bras bu thob pa med/ /sngags rnams 'di ni thams cad ni/ /dpa' bo dag gis sbas pa ste/ /de nas rnal 'byor shes pas sngags/ /gcig min yi ge ma lus pas/ /sbas nas yang ni thams cad la/ /brtson 'grus stobs kyis0)pha rol gnon/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung mnyam bkug ste/ /slob dpon bdag nyid chen pos ni/ /myur du dngos grub skye bar 'gyur/ /de ltar rtags ni ston pa'o/ /phyag rgya dang sbyor sgrub pa pos/ /nyon mongs med lasashi'agrub par 'gyur/ /dam tshig med pas bklags tepa dang ske/ /gang gis nam yang nyan pa dekho/nye/ /ngan pa'i bdag nyid can gyis 'jomasal/ /rnal 'byor ngan 'gro'i lam du 'gro/ /'jig rten g.yon7la spyod pas dran/ /g.yon pa'i sngags las kun tu dmigs/ /thams cad g.yon pas kun tu bya/ / dngos grub kun ni rab tu ster/ ldarnal 'byor ye shes sbas nas ni / / kṛ ya'i〈gebastan bcos la ni 'jug /rab tu 'bad pas sgrubalgepa 79—48

pos/ /de dang des ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las sbas pa'i sngags dang dam tshig srung 6)ba'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya bsho beste nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa'o// //de nas gsang ba'i gnas bzhi5snyedag /yang dag bsdus te bshad pa yin/ /ba lang lci ba skam po dang / /de bzhin lhag ma mgo skam dang / / ro bsregs bzhi yi mgo ri dang / /'byung ba chen po bzhi pa'o⑤/ /'bum la phyed dang brgya yis dman/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bzhengs pa ste/ /gsumachu)mtha'i thig le'i steng du'o/ /bzhi pa'i mtha'am ni rab tu sbyar/ /'bum mthar nyi shu ma5ge bzhi'i phyed/ /bden pa gnyis la mnyam par brten/ /rtag tu drug cu rtsa bzhi mchod / /'dod pa'i don kunalo1'grub par 'gyur/ /'jig rten dbang phyug thang shing la/ /mi gang mnyam par spyod pa'i mchog /sdig kun rnam dag bdag nyid do/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /sangs rgyas nyid mthong skad cig gis/ /ha gnyis thog mar dbang phyug dang / /ha gnyis bzhi yi 7)khro bo ste/ /sa ra sa ni nyid dag dang / /ngang pa dang ni ka ran dang / /khrung khrung dang ni chu skyar dag /sngags bya chen por brjod pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gtor ma spyod / /dkyil 'khor la ni dngos grub sgrub31/ /sngags pas lan cigatshwanyetu ni brjod / /gzugs can mi nyi ni myur du 'ong mi/ /dgug cing dbang du 'gyur ba ste/ /ji srid 'tsho bar 'gyur ba ste/ /bud med stong gis yongs bskor nas/ /sgrub pos sa yi steng du 7rtse/ /dpal ldan rdo rje phag mo ni8/ /gro gar gi wang gis bris tehurte/ /rtag tu sgrub po'i spyi bor btags/ /kun gyi nyunyekhrag 'thung 'dra 79—49

bar mthong / /gos dmar yongs su bgos nas ni/ /sgrub pos mtshan ni thog thag tu/ /chu la7yongs su bzlas nas ni/ /shing la bsnun〈gyen me tog lhung〈 )/ /skyes pa bud med phrag pa la/ /lag pa bzhag 3)ste bzlas nas ni/ /rdo rje phag mo dbang du 'gyur/ /man shing la lan 55)nyi shu bzlas/ /rkang pa la byugs mgo gnon 'gyur/ /go ro tsa na la lan nyi shur mngon par bzlas pa byas nas gang rigathig ler byas pa de thams cad skye bo kun gyis byams spepar 'gyur/ /rgyal rigs nang du 'jug na sku drin chen por 'gyur ro/ /mig sman la lan brgyad brgyar bsngags te/ mig la mig sman byugs na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ / yungs kurashon/la lan bdun mngon par bsngagasang9)te/ skyes bu la bsnun na shing du 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /chu la yongs su bzlas nas bsnun na khrag 'dzag par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa po yi hu /sngags 'di yis/ /ston mo'i bya ba bza' ston mo/ /kun nas kun tu thams cad du/ /rnal 'byor ma ni dgyes par 'gyur/ /thal ba la yongs su bzlas nas gzhan gyi rigs la bsnun na rengs par 'gyur ro/ /gos la brgyad brgyar yongs su bzlas te mdud pa bcings na 11 gos shin tu mang bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar nor dang gos dang /gzhan yang btung ba la sogs pa mang por 'gyur ro/ /chu la bzlas te chur blugs na chu skam par 'gyur ro12/ /thal ba la yongs su bzlas te zhom la bsnun na khrag tu 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis bzlas na thams cad grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi thal ba la brgyad brgyar mngon par bsngags 1 te thig le byas na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mar la yongs su bzlas te mnyes nas sgo la reg na sgo rang 'byed par 'gyur ro/ /bum pa la yongs su bzlas te chus bkang nastodami mthong 79—50

bar 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /lcags kyi phur bu la0)mngon par bsngags te/ 'o ma can gyi shing bcad nas yam shing la lan cigasabyas te/ gang gi ming dang sngags brgyad brgyar bzlas te bsregasar nanas/ de'i thal ba blangs te skyes pa la byugs na bud med du 'gyur ro/ /tsan dan la yongs su bzlas te bsnun na brlag par 'gyur ro/ /lan tshwa la yongs su bzlas te skyes pas bud med la byin na de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /me tog la yongs su bzlas te mi yi7lus po khrul bsnun na smyon par 'gyur ro/ /thal ba la yongs su bzlas te thig le byas na gos dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa'am bud med gang gi rkang pa g.yon pa'i rkang rjes kyi rdul blangs te gos la 6bcings nas gang gi ming bkod de ri sbas na bcings par 'gyur ro/ /skud pa la yongs su bzlas te mdud pa gsum byas nas lan bdun mngon par bsngags5shepa dgra bo'i dbus su bcug na 49sprul du 'gyur te/ de'i mche0 )bas btab nas71mi gsod par 'gyur ro/ /slar yang brgyad brgyar bzlas na 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /me tog la mngon par bsngags 32pa byas nas 3gespyi bor bzung na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /mi snang bar gyur kyang bud med thams cad kyis mchod par 'gyur rol/ /me tog la mngon par bzlas te mngon par gtor na de nyid du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /'jim pa'i gong bu la yongs su bzlas te spyi bor bzung 97na spyi bo bomi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis nimo grol bar 'gyur ro/ /dpa' bo'i chu la yongs su bzlas te bsnun na 'gyel bar 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag rgya yongs su brje zhing bsgos na gzugs yongs su brje nya tshobar 'gyur ro/ /dzā (1 ti dang tsam pa ma'i me 79—51

tog rnams la rtag tu mngon par bsngags ①pa byas nas gan ②ti ka dang sbyar ba'i dris 'gugs par 'gyur ro/ /chang yang dri chen du dri 'gyur bar⑩the tshom med do/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las dpal rdo rje phag mo'i snying po'i sngags kyi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste nyi shu rtsa dgu pa'o// //de nas gsang ba thams cad kyi/ /yid 'ong ston mo la 'dus pa/ /gang zhig yang dag shes pa ni/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor rnams/ /sha dang chang du ldan pa yirgya/ /ston mo sna tshogs kyis ni 'grub/ /skal ldan mdza' ba'i longs spyod kyis/ /tshe 'dikyidam par 'grub par 'gyur/ /skyes pa dang bud med kyi gan du song ste7)rin po che rnams sdud par byed do/ /de phyir bla med dkon mchog gsum/ /shes par bya ste 'grub par 'gyur/ /ka ba gcig dang sgo dgu dang / /skud pa gsum dang lha rnams ni/ /thams cad gnyis med rnal 'byor gyis/ /rab tu 'grub par the tshom med/ /chu la yongs su bzlas te zla ba'i btung ba la blugs na mer5she'agyur ro/ /yid kyis ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub pa pos/ /de nas ri yi 9chu blangs te/ /tsan dan dmar po nyid tshil zla ba drug tu nye bar longs spyad 37na nad thams cad rnam par spong zhing / lo stong phrag gcig tu gson zhing skra dkar dang gnyer 3nyam rnams spong ngo / /sa bon nag po blangs te sngags pas dngos po kun gyi snar blugs nas/rnal 'byor pas bzlas na gnyer ma dang 3)skra dkar dang mchi ma rnams kyis mi tshugs so/ /tshe nyams pa dang7skal ba ngan pa rnam par spong ngo / /nad thams cad rnam par spangs shing lo stong phrag gcig tu gson par 'gyur ro/ /don 73—52

rnams kun gyi sgrub pa pos/ /de ltar cho ga yang dag ldan/ /bcom ldan mo yishelus gzugs kyis/ /bzlas dang brtul zhugs bral bas kyang / /mchog tu 'grub par 'gyur ba yin/ /bla ma'i spyod pa sangs rgyas mnyam/ /brtson 'grus ldan zhing pha rol gnon/ /gru gsum gyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /gal te rgyal po de mchod byed/ /sems can rjes su gzung0)ba'i phyir/ /de ru rtag tu nga 'dug ste / /rang byung me tog la sogs pas/ /rtag tu bdag nyid mchod par bya/ /dpa' bos7zla ba gcig gis 'grub/ /ji ltar rang bzhin de bzhin 'gyur/ / de yi sku drin mchog de nyid/ /④rdo rje phag mo'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i dbang phyug ste/ /chung ma dga' ba med par 'gyur/ /yid kyis sngags ni yongs bzlas na/ /gnyis med ye shes rnal 'byor gyis/ /sems can thams cad dbang 'gyur zhing / /dngos grub thams cad the tshom med/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi tshe 'phel bsnyedang /mchod pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste sum cu pa'o// //de nas gser la sogs pa ni/ /thams cad dgug pa'i mchog yin no/ /sngags rnams kun nasasngonasbas pa ste/ /rnal 'byor rgyud gcig rnal 'byor ldan/ /nor gyi bdag po'i khyim song ste/ /gser gyi chu la lan bdun du/ /mngon par bsngags ⑦pa byas nas ni/ /gang gi khyim du gtor byas te/ /lhag mas bdag nyid dbang bskur na/ /nyin zhag bdun na gser rnams 'gugs/ /dpag tshad stong phrag gcig gi sa(2)/ /thig le byas na bsgrub bya 'gugs/ / chu yis slar yang grol ba'o/ /khakha ṭī ga la lan bdun mngon par bsngags nyunyepa byas 79—53

nas de la 'dug na dpag tshad brgyar 'gro ba dang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi thal ba la lan bdun mngon par bsngags7pa byas nas gang blugs pa deshedabang du 'gyur ro/ /phaṭa yig dang bcas pasar rgyas btab par 'gyur zhing rengs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma dpal rdo rje phag mo'i yid kyis 'dod pa bzhin bzlas na/ 'dod pa thams cad ji ltar bsamashepa bzhin 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin zhag bdun la 'bum phrag stong gi sbyin sreg gis dpal 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs can rnams la sbyin pa ster bar 'gyur ro/ /man shing srang gcig blangs te/ nag po'i7phyogs kyi bcu bzhi'i nam phyed na mchod pa byas te/ mar me chen porar+sā)sbar zhing gtor ma dang lha bshos phul te/ /brgyad brgyar gemangon par bsngags ⑧nas añdza na7bskus na mi snang bar 'gyur ro / /dpag tshad stong phrag gcig tu 'gro zhing 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ka ra bī0 )ra'i me tog stong phrag gcig 17tu sbyin sreg byas na nam mkhar lha mo gnas shing bud med thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /chu'i nang du zhugs te mar dang sbrang rtsi la stong phrag brgyad du bzlas nas ji srid 'dod pa de srid du sbyin sreg byas na nya de nas 'dod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rkun mo dang rgyal rigs kyis nges par 'tsherwa ba dang / rdo rje sems dpa' yang7yid kyis bzlas nas rdo rjes nges par 'gyur ro/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las rdo rje phag mo'i yi ge drug gi5gesngags kyi las thams cad kyi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba78ste sum cu 1rtogacig pa'o// //de nas gsang chen thams cad ni/ /gzugs ni yongs su brje ba ste/ /79—54

rgyud rnams kun la gsang ba ni/ /'di ru gsang ba'i bya ba gsungs17/ /ba lang gi spu las thag pa byas te lan bdun mngon par bsngagasatshananonas/ gang gi ske57la bcings pa de yang 4)ba lang du 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sems can gyi skopo)la bcings par gyur pa 6de ni de dang 'dra bar 'gyur ro/ /so ba la mngon par bsngagasadza skate so ba'i bdag po'i khyim du gtor nas lhag mas bdag nyid dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro/ /nyin zhag bdun gyi nagaso ba thams cad dang nor gzhan kun 'gugs riḍa par 'gyur ro/ /dur khrod kyi shing la mchil nyu )lham byas te mngon par bsngags77nas/ de la mngon par gnas na gang du 'dod pa der 'gro zhing slar yang 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i snying po'i yi ge drug pa zlos shing rkang hu rjes kyi rdul dang thal bar 12bcas pa la/ lan bdun mngon par bsngags 7pa byas nas gang la byugs pa de rgyas btab 8par 'gyur ro/ /yid kyis ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /sngags bzlas shing spyi bor bcings na gang gis kyang mi mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gang du 'dod pa der 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma la mngon par bltas te ming dang sngags bzlas na 7de 'gugs par 'gyur rol/ /zhag gcig gis nya dpag tshad gcig tshun chad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /zhag gsum gyis dpag tshad bcu tshun chad do/ /zhag bdun gyis dpag tshad nyi khri tshun chad 'gugs par 'gyur ronyushe/ /byi la'i spu dang gang gi ming dang lhan cig sbyin sreg 19byed na de gza' chen pos gzung chibar 'gyur ro/ /gang la des bcings pa de byi lar 'gyur ro 1/ /de ltar khyi dang bya rog gi rgyus pas srad bu byas te mngon par bsngags ni na de bya rog tu 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sems can gang gi na srad bu blangs te mngon par bsngags 2 nas mgrin 25pa bcings na de ni 79—55

de dang 'dra bar 'gyur bar the tshom med do/ /bkrol bas ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /skyes pa'i skra'i srad bu la lan bdun mngon par bsngags7pa byas nas bud med gang gi⑧mgrin pa la bcings na de ni skyes par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar bud med kyi spa la srad bu bsgril te lan bdun mngon par bsngagasalgenas skyes pa gang gi mgrin par bcings pa de ni bud med du 'gyur ro/ /lag pa la lan bdun mngon par bsngagasalgepa byas nas reg na mngal 'pho bar 'gyur ro/ /bgrol nyabs ni grol bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma yid kyisalgebazlas na rigs thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rtagasatu bzlas na dpal mo skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las de nyid sngags kyis gzugs thams cad yongs su brje ba dang / dbang du byed pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas phur bu'i cho ga bshad/ /bram ze'i dmod7pa 'dra ba yi/ /rnal 'byor yan lag yang dag blangs(3 / /gsang ba'i las ni skye bar 'gyur/ /spre'u'i 11rus pa'i rang bzhin las(nye/ /phur bu sor ni drug par bya/ /lan bdun du ni mngon bsngags hunyete/ /gang gi sgo ru sbas pa ni/ /de yi rigs ni 'chad 〉par 'gyur/ /ba lang glang chen rta dang ni/ /bong bu rnga mo ma te sha /gnas pa'i sa der sbas na ni/ /de rnams brlag par 'gyur ba yin/ /mdor bsdus nas ni gsungs pa yin/ /gang zhig rtag tu 'di bsgom7pa/ /rtag tu mig mi 'dzums 8par blta/ /gang la bzlas par gyur pa yis/ /de yi5nyemig ni ltung bar 'gyur/ /gang gi ming dang sngags su bzlas/ /de yi khrag ni 79—56

'gugs par 'gyur/ /thams cad bdag nyid bcom ldan motsho/ /rig pa'i mchog ni nyer spyod kyisal/ /las ni kun tu bya ba yin/ /ji ltar 'dod pa dpal skreg 'thung / /rdo rje phag mo'i snying po dang / /de bzhin nye ba'i snying po'o / /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las lasashekyi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams mchog tu mdzes/ /gsang ba'i bla ma bla med sngagasaphyi/ /lha rnams kyis kyang rnyed par dka'/ /lha mo kun gyi snying po ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub par byed/ /bha yig bdag gis rab tu gsungs/ /ma7yig sa bon zhes su brjod/ /ji ltar e yig sa bon la/ /me yi bu ni gsum pas dbye/ /hūm̐ phaṭa yi ge mtha' ru sbyar/ /'di rnams yi ge drug pa'i sngags/ /mdor bsdus nas ni gsungs pa yin/ /gang zhig rtag tu 'di bsgomasalgepa/ /rnal 'byor dngos grub 'bras skal ldan/ /rtag tu de la bud med bzang / /sgrub po la ni 'ong bar 'gyur/ /'dod pas brgyal bar gyurasnyen ni/ /sna tshogs kun tu 'dzag pa ste/ /sems ni 'dod pas dgyes nas su/ /de rnams kun ni 'ong bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu bzlas na bud med rnams/ /rgan dang gzhon pa dbang du 'gyur/ /byin gyis rlobalgepa byed par 'gyur/ /rang gi khyim du zhugs nas ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin brtag pa'i las 'di nye bar spyad pa ni/ las kun byed par 'gyur ro/ /mtshan thog thag tu bzlas pa byas te/ sgrub pa po hunyeshin tu mnyam par gzhaganyepas pho nya sgrubasngonapo/ /de'i lag mthil du song ba'i dpal sus kyang 'phrog par 79—57

mi nus so/ /khang stong du zhugs nas nub tu kha bltas te/ stan la 'dug0)nas gos kyis yol gebar byas te/ de la bza' ba dang btung ba'i ston mo byin te / sman rnam pa lngas spos byas te mar khu chen pos me mar rab tu sbar la stong phrag gcig tu bzlas pa byas te/ de nas rnal 'byor ma thams cad 'ongasamasanas dkyil 'khor la zhugs te sgrub pa po la 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba thams cad ston par 'gyur ro/ /sha dang kha zas kyi lhag mas rnal 'byor ma rnams la gtor ma byin te/ gi'u'agewang la brgyad brgyar mngon par bsngags 5rinas mig la añdza 46)byugs na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gis nam yang 'di dam tshig med pa la brjod par mi bya ste/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kun nas 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar dpal he ru ka la mchod pa bzhin/ de ltar slob dpon rab tu 'bad pas mchod do/ /cho ga bzhin du dgyes par byas te dpal he ru shwaka dgyes 8par byas nas rnal 'byor ma 9rnams 'dis dgyes nas mchog ster zhing / slob dpon dgyes nas thams cad dgyes par 1 mthe tshom med do/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las/ dpal rdo rje phag mo'i nye ba'i 11nying po'i sngags btu ba'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste sum cu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /phyag rgya chen po rab bsgrub pa/ /sngon bzhin thang ku'i 12mdun du ni/ /gang gis myur du de 'grub 'gyur/ /yid kyis dbang bskur thob pa ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po la gnas te/ /dngos grub kun kyang phyag rgya 1 ste/ /sgrub pos yang dag mchod par bya'o/ /dpal he ru ka dang 79—58

rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'ongs nas mchog ster bar byed do/ /de la ar+gha nyu1phul te pus mo sa la btsugasalgenas lag pa thal mo sbyar te/ sgrubs pa'i mchog gis mchod par bya'o/ /sgrub pa byapo'i lus la 'jug par the tshom med do/ /dpa' bo'i mig ni rab tu gdangs pa dang / thams cad shes shing gtso bo thams cad byed pa dang / de nas sgrub pa po mchog 'jig rten gsum du thams cad dusnyi'agro ba'o/ /dpa' bo 'di rnams ye shes che/ /gnyis pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /gang gis rnam par shes tsam gyis/ /sa dang rgya mtsho ska rags7te/ /lha dang lha min mir bcas pa/ /myur du dbang du byed par 'gyur / /oṃ shrī he ru kā0)ya bid ma he bibyā narā dzā ya dhi 59 ma he nyu )swā hā/ bsgrub nyu1bya'i spyi bo la sngags kyi rgyal po 'di bkod pas rengs par 'gyur ro/ /sngags 'di rnams7)rnam par shes nas stengs su 32stobs 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs dang / glang po che dang / spre'u dang / 'khrul 'khor dang / rta dang ske/ de bzhin du dmag mi rnams 'dir lus la bkod na rengs par 'gyur ro / /de ltar yongs su bkod pa yis/ /gru gsum dkyil 'khor yang dag ldan/ /dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yang / /skad cig tsam gyis 'ong bar 16'gyur/ /kha yi dbus su rnam par bkod/ /de bzhin lce dang rkan la'o/ /de ni myur du dge bar 'gro/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam pa yang 15/ /skad cig gisam ni mi smra 'gyur / /lce yi rtse nas rig pa 'phrog /'di ru bkod pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngags kyi rgyal po snying gar 1rtedagod/ /sems ni 'phrog par byed pa yin/ /rkang pa'i hu mthil nas mgo yi 19bar/ /nag po'i gzugs ni rnam par dgod/ /dbang po thams cad 'phrog pa ru/ /byed pa ru ni the tshom med/ /las 'di 79wa 59

thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub rab tu ster/ /'di rnams de yi dpa' bos gsungs/ /'dod pas sa stengasaturnyed parashedaka'/ /bdag nyid yid bzhin nor bu nyid/ /de nyid bsdus par rnam bshad pa/ /'di yi sngags dang 'dra ba med/ /'di yi las dang mnyam pa med/ /rnam par mi shes pa yis ni/ /cung zad las ni〈'grub pa med/ /sngags kyi rgyal po rnam par shes/ /dngos grub thams cad mdzes par byed/ /rang gi lus la rnam par dgod/ /sgrub po shin tu mnyam gzhag⑧pas/ /des ni bltas pas dbang du 'gyur/ /thams cad sgrub po'i gtso bo yis/ /rab tu khrosalgepas gsod par 'gyur / / brtul bzhin rnam par khros pa yis/ /chu bo dang ni rgya mtsho dang / /'khrugar pa dang ni rgyal rigs dang / /rkun po me yi0'jigs pa las/ /de yis rdo rje thog tu 'gyur/ /gang der yang dag bris pa yis/ /'jig rten gsum yang g.yo ba dang / /dngos grub thams cad thob par 'gyur/ /sgrub poshemachog tu gyur pa yis/ /dbang dang dgugayodang rengs pa yis(nya/ /rnam par snang tsho/rnyeb bskrad dang gsad(nye/ /gang du ming gis bris te gzung7/ /thams cad du ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs lha/ /mkhas pa yis ni myur ba ru/ /skal med kyis kyang 'grub pa yin/ /sgrub pos rab tu 'bad pa yis/ /'di ni rtag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /'khrug pa dgra dang g.yang sa dang ske/ /rkun po stag dang glang chen dang / /seng sbrul rta dang mtshonatshwanyecha'i bar//gza' tsheni sna tshogs 'jigs pa las/ /thams cad du ni rgyal bar 'gyur/ /de ni rtsod pa med 'dod na/ /sngags pas bri bar bya ba yin/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las phyag rgya chen po sgrub 3 7pa'i klu'i las kyi cho ga'i le'u zhes 79—60

bya ba ste sum cu rtsa lnga pa'o// //de nas bskrad pa yang dag bshad/ /dgra bo stobs kyis dregs pas na/ /steng du 'khor ba'i 'dab ma la/ /mkhas pas bya rog sgro yis bri/ /snying po go bzlog yang dag ldan/ /'byung po'i zhag7)la brgya ru bzlas/ /steng du 'khor zhing lding ba yi/ /'dabastogem phyed dang gnyis las ni/ /bsgrub7bya myur du skyod par 'gyur/ /gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' skyod(5)/ /nim ba pa tra'i khu bar ldan / /bsgrub bya'i ming dang dam tshig dang / /snying du sngags kyis chud par bya//me la sbyin sreg bya ba ste/ /brgyad lhag brgya〈6)ni yongs su bzlas/ /go bzlog pa yi7snying po yis/ /nyi ma phyed dam nam phyed na/ /pho nya 'khor zhing sngags ni bzlas / /snying po gnyis brgyad sa)lhag pa'i brgyas/ /'di rnams 'khor bar bya ba yin/ /yid kyis brgyad brgyas dgra rnams ni/ /'khrul 'khor dag ni gzhug par bya/ /sngags kyi zhags pas bcings pa dang / /spyi bor dbyug pa yis ni brdung ske/ /tshangs pa dbang po drag po dang / /ming dang dgra rnams gsod pa yin / /zla ba dag ni phyed pa tho la/ /bsgrub bya'i spyi boratshwa yang dag bris(1/ /thod pa khrag gis bkang ba ni/ge/ /gang gi 1snyeganas su de nyid sbas(ge/ /de ma thag tu khrag nitshama'adzag /sngags la sun ni 'byin pa de/ /de nyid kyis ni 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i 'khrul 'khor dang po'i dgra/ /'di nyid stong pa chen po ste/ /dngos grub kun byed mdzes pa yin/ /'di ni khrag 'thung gis ni brjodam/ /sngon dang phyi ma dbus dag tu/ /mkhas pas 'jig rten spyod par shes / /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las gdug pa thams cad kyi 73—61

bsam gtan gyi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste sum cu rtsa drug pa'o// //de nas char pa dbab pa7bshad/ /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor pas/ /gang gis myur du char 'bebasnyopa/ /klu brgyad pos ni the tshom med/ /mtha' yas dang ni nor rgyas dang / /de bzhin 'jog po stobs kyisakhurgyu/ /pad+ma dang ni pad chen dang / ri /dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan brjod/ /so so zhing ni re re yi / /sngags dang rang ming brjod par bya/ /sde tshan drug pa'i gnyis pa la/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pas dbye ba bya/ /bcu drug pas ni mnyam par brten/ /thog ma tha ma mnyam ldan brtag /sngags 'di dag ni mnyam par sbyor/ /mtha' yas la sogs brgyad po ni/ /rgya mtshorasnyi'abab pa'i chu bo yi/ /'jigs pas gzugs brnyan bya ba yin/ /phyogs kyi mdog tu gdengs ga bdun/ /sngags kyisalgebaskul bas yang dag ldan/ /de yi snying garaphugazhug par bya/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad dgod byas la/ /gzhag〈kyeste nyin bdun mchod par bya/ /mtha' dag chu yis rgyas par bya/ /myur du char ni mi 'beb 7na/ /las gzhan dag ni sbyararnyubar bya/ /dur khrod kyi ni ras dag la/ /dug dang ske tshe0dag dang ni/ /nim pa'i 'dab snyema'i khu ba yisadhi/ /sngags 'di dag ni yang dag bri/ /spu gu la sogs par ni gzhug /'bras phub me la gdung bar bya/ /char ni 'bab par 'gyur ba'o/ /yang na klu nor rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan mgo dgu pa byas la de'i snying garalabacug la gdung bar bya'o⑩/ /char pa'i rgyun chen po 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling kun tu rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /dpal he ru ku'i bka' nyan par byed pa dang / klu la klus zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dpal 79—62

ldan sbyin sreg gis/ /gza'7)dgu po ni〈bzhi ba yin/ /mig dmar mjug rings5)la sogs par/ /sngags kyi cho ga bzhin du sbyar/ /nyi ma dang ni zla ba 'dzin / /mig dmar dang ni gza'5gelhag dang / /de bzhin phur bu pa ba sangs / /de bzhin du ni spen pa mchog /sgra gcan mjug ringasapo)mnyam par bshad / /rang ming brjod pa yi ni sngags/ /dang po oṃ gyi yi ge dang / /tha mar swā hā sbyar ba yin/ /dbang po me dang gshin rje dang / /de bzhin bden bral chu bdag dang / /rlung lha dang ni gnod sbyin dang / /dbang ldan du ni rab tu grags/ /de bzhin 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /sbyor ba'i lam la rab tu 'jug /rang mtshan bzhon pa kha dog dang / /'jig rten skyong ba bdag nyid che / /khro bo gnyis dang yang dag ldan/ /bsgrub bya la ni sbyor ba yin/ /nyin zhag bdun gyi sbyin sreg gis/ /sgrub po ci bgyi 'gyur ba yin/ /zhal bzhi pa yi sngags kyis ni/ /phyogs dang mtshams su gsungs pa ste/ /'bru rnams thams cad bsres nas ni/ /nyi khri ru ni bsngagasamanyanas kyang / /grangs ni brgyad dang dgu po bsgrubame/ /'di rnams 'jig rten pa yin te/ /rnal 'byor pas ni sgrub pa po/ /sa yi steng du rnam par spyod/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung 'jig rten 'gyur/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mchog /sems can rang bzhin sangs rgyas kun/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /sngags dang phyag rgya mnyam par bya/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung mchod pa dang / /mtho ris kyi ni don ched du / /zhi ba'i dngos grub 'ong ba ste/ /rtag tu drug cu rtsa bzhi mchod/ /dbang po gnyis kyi rab sbyor bas/ /rang byung ni/ye shes kyis1)ni gzhi/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mchog /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las char 79—63

dbab pa dang / gza' rgyu ba dang /spyi 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad kyi sgrubasnyethabs kyi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste sum cu rtsar bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan na med pa yis/ /pho nya kun gyi dbang phyug mchog /zhal bzhi yi ni hūṃ yig dang / /ji ltar 'dod par las kyis dbye/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba ni/ /gcig tu bsdus nas bltasalgepa yis/ /khrag 'thung gnyis med bde ba la/ /bcu drug char yang mi phod do/ /gos chen dang ni sha chen dang / /dbang chen dang ni sbrang rtsi che/ /thams cad dur khrod nas byung bsti/ /phyag rgya 'di yis nodabang phyug mchog⑧ /bya ba kun lamatho)dngos grub ster/ /ji srid mdun du dgra bo bsgomadzo/ /zhags pa nag pos mgrin pa bcings/ /'dod pas dbyug pa'i brdung bar bya/ /cho ga bzhin du sngags pas bsam lho phyogs su 17ni bsgyel0sgrubar bya/ /dgar hunyeb yid dang ltung ba dang / /yang dang yang du bskrad pa dang / /lte ba ru ni bkag pa nyid/ /yang dang yang du brgyal bar 'gyur/ /nyi ma phyed dang nam phyed na/ /gzugs brnyan gyi ni sbyin sreg bya//nyi ma gsum pa kun tu bri/ /'chi bar 'gyur zhing mgo bo lhung78/ /sngags kyi cho gas 'chi bstomani/ /sa stengs 3lhamache bas btab pa ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sngags kyis ni/ /rnal 'byor pa la dngos grub ster/ /snying pos mi la bsdus nas su/ /phyi nas yang ni lhung ba yin/ /phyag rgya chen po'i snying po ru/ /yon po zhes byar rab tu grags/ /sgrub pos 'jig rten gsum po yang / /'di yis thams cad bsdus pa yin/ /de nas bskrad〈nyepa bshad par bya/ /dgra bo rnams kyis stobs dregs dang / /sngags pas sngon gsungs cho ga bzhin/ /nim pa'i 'dabarwa ma'i 79wa 64

khu ba dang / /bya rog sgro yi bye brag gis/ /sgrub posasherab tu 'bad pa mchog /blo ldan rang gi gnas la spyod②/ /de ni sa stengasa'akhor los sgyur④/ /nyi ma bdun gyis lha nyid dang / /zla ba yis ni 'jig rten pa/ /lo yis sangs rgyas byang chub sems/ /dran pas phal che'i mi rnams so/ /zla ba phyed kyis lha ma yin / /srin po dang ni gnod sbyin mo/ /klu dang dri za dag dang ni/ /mi 'am ci la sogs skad du/ /sngags dang phyag rgya 'di rnams kyis/ /sgrub pos sa stengashernyed par dka'/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni dngos grub che/ /rnal 'byor kun la 'di mchog yin/ /rnal 'byor 'di ni dpal chen po/ /sum cu pas ni mchod pa yin/ /'di dang 'dra ba gzhan na med/ /cung zad mdzes〈9)pa gsang ba rgyasal / /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal/ /gsang ba'i ming dang mkha' 'gro ma/ /gang zhig cung zad pas rab skye/ / mi yi 'jig rten na ni yod/ /rinyede kun lho ru kha bltas pa'o/ /dpal59)khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las bskrad pa dang gsad tshipa'i sngags kyi las kyi cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste sum cu rtsa te brgyad pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /'khor los sgyur 32ba drug gi sngags/ /cho ga shes pas sngags ni gsang / /'dod pa'i dngos grub 'ong bar 'gyur/ /sems ni shin tu rnam dag byas/ /de nas rdza rnga bcing bar bya/ /shin tu mnyam par gzhag〈nyepa yis/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge dgod par bya/ /re'us1stemig dgu ni bcing bya ste/ /mnyam par yi ge bzhi bcu dgu/ /gnas der blo ldan gyis ni btu / /dang po rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /rdza rnga'i rnam pa dpa' bo che/ /79—65

dpa' bo chen po'i zhal ni bsgyur/ /ji ltar rigs pa de ltar byas/ /mtha' dag rab tu zhi ba yin/ /sde tshan dbye ba shes byas nas/ /mkhas pas phyi mo las ni btu/ /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa blangs te/ / dbyangs kyi lnga pas yang dag ldan / /dang po yi ger gyur pa yin/ /de nas bzhi bcu rtsa gcig blang / /bzhi bcu pa yis sbyar ba yin/ /gnyis par yongs su grags pa'o/ /de nas sum cu so drug blang / /dbyangs kyi gsum pa sbyar ba yin/ /①gsum pa'i yi ger gyur pa'o / /drod kyi yi ge gsum pa la/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pa yang dag ldan/ /bzhi pa'i yi ger gyur pa'o/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /de nyid kyi ni bzhi par7ldan/ /lnga pa'i da )yi ger gyur pa ste/ /rdo rje sems bdag nyid chen po/ /de bzhin bzhi bcu rtsa dgu blang / /dbyangs kyi lnga pas7sbyar ba ste/ /steng du nā༄das sbyar ba yin / /yi ge drug pa ru ni brjod/ /oṃ gyi yi ge dang po ste/ /phaṭa kyirtso6)yi ge tha mar rormu/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab tu grags/ /de bzhin gcig dman lnga bcu la / /dbyangs kyi gnyis pa sbyar ba yin/ / ya yi nisde tshan brgyad pa la/ / me yi bus7)ni sbyar ba yin/ /dbyangs kyi bzhi pas sbyar ba ste/ /gnyis pa'i yi ge mchog yin no/ /steng du nā 3 nodas sbyar ba'o/ /yi ge gcig dman nyi shu la/ /skye bar byed pas yang dag gnas/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas sbyar ba yisahunye yi ge gsum par gyur pa yin/ /gcig gis dman pa'i lnga bcu blang / / sum cu rtsa drug yang dag blang / /7yi ge bzhirwanyepa brjod pa'o/ /lan gnyis su ni brjod par bya/ /de bzhin bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa/ /gzugs kyis rab tu dbye ba yin/ /bcwa lnga pa ni yang dag blang / /yi ge bdun pa ru ni brjod/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa pos/ /oṃ gyi yi ge dang po ste/ /hūm̐ phaṭa yi ge 79wa 66

mtha' ru sbyar/ /rnam snang mdzad du gyur pa'o/ /'dis ninyedangos grub thams cad ster②/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pa nyid dag dang / / an+ta sba yisheganyis pa la//dbyangs kyi bcu gsum pa yis sbyar/ /gnyis pa'i yi ger gyur pa'o/ /bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi yang dag ldan/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas sbyar ba ste/ /yi ge gsum par gyur pa'o/ /oṃ yig dang por swā hā mthar/ /pad ma gar gyicadabang phyug go/ /'di rnams rang gi sngags bshad pa'o/ /de bzhin gcig dman lnga bcu blang / /dbyangs yig bcu gcigashepa yis sbyar/ /dang po'i yi ge brjod par bya / /drod kyi yi ge bzhi pa la/ /dbyangs kyi bcu gcig gis ni sbyar/ /gnyis pa'i yi ge brjod par bya/ / an+ta sba yisheganyis pa la/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pas sbyar ba yin/ /ra yig dag dang bcu bdun pa/ /lnga pa yis ni mnyam par ldan/ /bcwa lnga pa yis mchod par bya/ /oṃ gyi yi ge dang po ste/ /rtsu rtsu phaṭa ni mtha' mar yin/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa'o/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo che/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug kun gyi dbang / /de nas bcwa brgyad pa ni blang / /drod kyi yi ge dang po la/ /dbyangs yig bcu gsum pa yis sbyar/ /gnyis pa ru ni rab tu grags/ /an tasba yi pegasum pa la/ /bcu gsum pa yis sbyar ba yin/ /dbyangs kyi gnyis pa nyid dag dang / /mkhas pas gsum pa ru ni brjod/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis yang dag blang77/ /gcig gis ma tshang lnga bcu la/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pas sbyar ba yin/ /steng du nārwarnyedas sbyar bar bya/ /oṃ gyi yi ge dang po ste/ /phaṭa kyi yi ge tha mar yin/ /de lta hunyenyid du the tshom med/ /'di ni rdo rje nyi mar gyur/ /dngos grub ster zhing thar ba ste/ /yi ge bzhi bcu pa nyid dang / /de nyid la ni dbyangs yig dang / /bcu gsum pa 79—67

yisamagyo)sbyar ba yin( )/ /de ni gnyis ldan du ni bri/ /'on kyang rig pa cungashezad med/ /gcig gis ma tshang nyi shu dang / /an tas+tha yisnyibazhi pa dang / /dbyangs yig gnyis pas yang dag ldan/ /de bzhin bcwa lnga pa yis sbyor⑤/ /bzhi pa'i yi ger brjod pa'o/ /dbyangs yig gi ni gnyis pa dang / /de bzhin bcu drug pa nyid dang / /dpa' bo nyi shu drug pa btu/ /yi ge bdun pas brjod pa'o/ / oṃ gyi yi ge dang po ste/ /yis phaṭa thamanyamar sbyar ba yin/ /dpa' bo chen po rta mgrin te/ /dngos grub kun gyi gtso bo yin/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las 'khor lo sgyur53)ba drug gi7)bsam gtan dang sngags btu ba'i cho ga'itshwa )le'u zhes bya ba ste so dgu pa'o// //de nas yang dag gnas pa'i sngags/ /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma/ /snying ga 31mgo bo spyi gtsug dang / /go cha mig la sogs pa ru/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs sbyar/ /cho ga byas shing rab tu bsrung (rte/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying la sbyar/ /dngos grub thams cad rab tu ster/ /rnam par snang mdzad mgo bor dgod/ /de ltar yon tan khyad par can/ /spyi gtsug pad ma gar dbang phyug /phrag par hunyekhrag 'thung dgod pa ste/ /mig gnyis rdo rje nyi ma yin / /yan lag kun la rta mgrin te/ /de ltar go cha bgos pa yin/ /thams cad las ni sgrub par byed/ /lag par dgod pa yang ni bya/ /lag pa'i brda ni bstan bya ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mthe bor gnas/ /de bzhin rnam snang mdzub 14mo ste/ /gung mo pad ma gar dbang phyug /ming med dpal ldan khrag 'thung ste/ /mthe'u michung rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /sen mo'i ngos la rta tsomachog yin/ /79—68

lag pa'i mthil du dpa'atsho)bo che/ /gnyis med rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyab tu rnal 'byor ma rnamasabakun/ /'di rnams lag pa la ni dgod/ /kun gyisalgestug par mnyam pa ni/ /de ltar cho ga bzhin du ni/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mchod bya/ /gshin rje'i phyogs nas 3)brtsams nas ni/ /ji srid bden bral gyi ni bar/ /dus drug nyisasnyi'agyur du ni byas/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sdom pa mchodayi / /tshes dang dbyangs dang dus shes bya/ /dus bzhi sum 'gyur shes par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su he ru ka /spyan drangs nas ni mchod pa 'phel / /rtag tu rnal 'byor dbang phyug la/ /mchod pas dbul b.ralo7mi 'gyur ro/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / /dum skyes ma dang gzugs can ma/ /'di rnams dpa' bo'i sring mo yin/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa yin/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las dpa' bo drug gi go cha dang / lha'i grangs dang lag pa'i mchod pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bzhi bcu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dus bzhi mtha' yitshananornal 'byor la/ /gsang ba'i mchod pa'i gsang ba ni/ /dpa' bo gnyis med bstan par bya/ /rdzogs ldan 'di ru ma yin te/ /gsum ldan la ni sring mor brjod/ /gnyis ldan la ni 3)bu mor shes/ /rtsod 3 )ldan chung ma'i pho nyar gnas/ /de ltar cho ga shes byas nas/ /dngos grub 'bras bu skal ldan 'gyur/ /dpa' bo kun gyi rjes bsgoms nas/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub yod pa yin/ /phyag rgya chen po'i theg pa che/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams dngos grub ster/ /phyag rgya chen po gzhan na med / /rnal 'byor kun la sgrub pa pos3gle/ /'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten 79—69

'das / /gzhan yang rig byed smra ba dang / /dpyod pa pa dang grangs can dang ske/ /gzhan yang bye braganyesmra ba ltar/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug lha chen gyi/ /kun tu dngos grub mchod pa ste/ /dngos grub yang dag ye shes nyid/ /thams cad pas ni mchog yin no/ /sa las rin chen bzhi7yin te/ /deshebazhin mchog gi mchog nyid do/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang rig pa che/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po dang / /sdom pa'i bdag nyid chen po dang / /rnal 'byor 'di rnams shes pa mchog /rig byed bzhi la nga mi byams/ /nga la gus pas nga byams so/ /de la nga ster de merjes gzungasnyi/ /ji ltar bdag nyid kun tu mchod / /thams cad gnyis su med pa ste/ /kun nas kun tu rnal 'byor bsgrubalte ske/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung dpa' bo mchog /mdza' ba thams cad 'dus pa yin/ /zla ba'i btung bas dngos grub 'gyur/ /rtag pa yi ni go 'phang mchog /mkha' 'gro ma yi7dra ba sdom/ /mkha' dang mnyam las btus pa yin/ /kun mkhyen ye shes de rang bzhin/ /khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung zhes pa/ /thar pa'i dngos grub mchog tu ster/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung ji ltar 'thob/ /yon tan gzhan ni rtswasngogebazhin btang / /spyan ma mthe bong la ni gnas / /mdzubashemo mā ma khri〈 )ru brjod/ /gung mo'i rtse mor sgrol ma yin/ /ming med la ni 'od byed ma/ /mthe chung pha rol phyin ma dgod/ /lag pa'i mthil du mnyam par sbyor/ /rgyab tu gshegs su gsol ba ste/ /de ltar nyid du the tshom med/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las dus bzhi'i mtha'i rnal 'byor ma dngarwanyalag pa'i brda'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bzhi bcu rtsa gcig pa'o // //79—70

pas myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /sngags dang rnal 'byor rab 'bad pas/ /'bras dkar btags pa'i rang bzhin las/ /sngags pas byol song gzugs dang ni/ /gro ga la sogs yang dag blang / /sgrub pos gang lta 5)ji lta bar/ / de yishegazugs la gzhag ④bya ba/ /ming ni sngags kyi nang chud bya/ /lus ni tsan dan dmar pos byug /shin tu mnyam par bzhag sa)pas bsgoma'u)/ /gang gis nub mo ci nus bzlas/ /byug ri pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag dang / /de ni zos pa tsam gyis ni/ /mi rnams dam tshig can du 'gyur/ /ces)spyang sha dang chang gis ni/ /phyi nang bdag nyid mchod par bya/ /ce 3 1spyang sbyin sreg byas pa las/ /de la dngos grub thams cad gnas/ /'di ru ces31)spyang sbyin sreg bya/ /nor gyi lha dang 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de nas gtor ma sbyin par bya/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun dgyesalgepar 'gyur/ /ji srid yongs su rgyas pa ru/ /de yi sngags kyis 'grub par 'gyur/ /yang dag brtag pa'i tshogs kyis gang / /rnal 'byor bzhi sogs phyag rgya dang / /rang gi mdog dang phyag mtshan dbyibs/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /thig le dang ni nā 1rtadas sbyar/ /rnal 'byor che la rnam par gnas/ /las kyi dbye bas hūṃ yin no/ /'bad pas thar pasnyibasgom par bya/ /lte snying mgrin pa sna yi partser/ /hūm̐ gi yi ge rnam pa bzhi/ /'phar ba dang ni ring thung dang / /rnam bcad las ni dbye ba ste/ /'phar ba yis ni thar bar 'gyur/ /ring bas rgyas pa rab tu brjod/ /thung bas mi mthong ba tsharu 'gyur/ /rnam par bcing bas nyu gsod par byed/ /lte ba dril bu'i sgra dang 79—71

mnyam / /snying garatu'abrug gi sgra 'dra ste/ /mgrin par ba lang gi ni sgra/ /sna rtser yungs kur〈'phar ba 'dra/ /hūṃ yig bzhi po rgyal po che/ /'jig rten gsum yang sgrub pa po/ /pu dzā o a go rā de mā kā ni.o tri ko ka la kā rjogyi pre gri sau su nā gesi ma ku/ phyi nang bdag nyid rnal 'byor pas/ /mā0yig la sogs rnam par gnas/ /rnam shes ye shes gzungakhubar bya/ /rab tu 'bad pas bla ma bstod/ / phyi yisnyilam nas bsten pa ste/ /bstan bcos rnams kyang ring ba yin(77/ /thabs kyi rnal 'byor ma ni rnams/ /'bad pas bla ma'i bsnyen bkur bya/ /bstan bcos mtshan nyid mdor bsdus pa'o/ /de nyid ston pa'i dpa' bo yin/ /skad cig gis ni rnal 'byor bdag /skad cig gis ni phyag rgya sbyin31/ /kun nas kun tu skad cig ste/ /skad cig sngags7dang rnal 'byor rig /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las skye ba bdun pa'i bsgrub bya dang ske/ hūm̐ yig bzhi rnam par dag pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba〈nyeste bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis pa'o// //de nas dpal ldan rgyal chen dang / /dpa' bo phan par 'dod pa yis/ /pus 0mo sa la btsugasamatshanas ni/ /yid kyis kun nas phyag 'tshal te/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pa/ /gsang ba chen po dag ni zhus/ /kun gyi rnam pa rgyas pa ru/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /gang ni gnas su gnas pa yin/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu rnams la brtse'i/ /nyon cig man ngag ji bzhin bshad / /rtag pa bsam gyisal mi khyab gzungarwanye/ /gang gis ji ltar sngon du gsung ske/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu gnas/ /lus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes 79—72

su brjod/ /sgo dgu ru ni gyur pa ste/ /lte ba'i dbus na7pad+ma che/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes grags/ /de yi gnas na dpa' bo bzhugs/ /cha med cha ni rnam par spangs/ /lus rnams kun gyis rnam par brtsomi/ /lus bral dri ma med pa ste/ /la lar gzugs kyisheganas na bzhugs/ /la lar sna yisnyiganas na bzhugs/ /la lar mig gi sgo na gnas/ /la lar sgra yi sgo na bzhugs / /la lar bshang5nyagaci'i sgo na gnas/ /la lar sems dang rnam shes bcas / /la lar sredakyidang ltogs sa)dang skom/ /la lar khro dang la lar zhi/ /la lar ltogs7dang bcas pa'i gdong / /la lar bud med mchog gi lus/ /la lar gsod cing brdeg pa dngarwa )/ /la lar smra ba bzhin du gnas/ /la lar me tog 'bras la gnas/ /la lar rtse zhing longs spyod gnas/ /la lar dri la rnam par gnas/ /la lar 'byung ba chen po lnga/ /sa dang chu dang me dag dang / /la lar rigs kyi dbye ba yis/ (1gtum mo dang ni 3)sbom po dang / /la lar ma dang sring mo yin/ /la lar chung ma bu mo dang / /la lar tshangs pa dbang phyug dang ske/ /nyi ma dang ni 'phrog ma dang / /la lar zla ba skar ma dang / /la lar nub mo nyin mo dang / /la lar khams gsum pa yin te/ /la lar thams cad med zad rgyal/ /la lar ro dang bag chags nub/ /cha med stong pa kun mi gsal/ /la lar byang chub gzigs mo che/ /la lar bdud las rgyal ba yin/ /la lar chos kyi 'khor lo che/ /de bzhin la lar 'chi 'pho ste/ /la lar dka' ba spyod pa yin/ /la lar dge slong tshul du gnas/ /la lar byis pa yirwanyeni gzugs / /la lar rgas shing 'khogs pa dang / /la lar na bas zos pa dang / /la lar snod dang bcud dag dang / /la lar sngo zhing dmar ba dang / /la lar 79—73

dkar zhing ser ba dang / /la lar sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /la lar sgronanyem gos dkar mo/ /la lar spyan ma mā ma khril/ /la lar kun tu zhi bar 'gyur/ /la lar bya yishemangal du 'gro/ /nam mkha' ru ni 'gro ba nyid/ /la lar glang chen nga rgyal te/ /la lar smad 'tshong mar ni 'gyur④/ /la lar rmi lam mthong〈bar 'gyur/ /la lar gnyid ni log par gnas/ /la lar rlung dang mkhris9)pa dang ske/ /la lar khrag dang pagasalgepa dri/ /la lar ngu zhing mya ngan byed/ /la lar mi rnams za ba dang / /la lar bskal par gsung ba dang / /ji ltar kun tu rnam par dbye/ /lha yisasnyiji srid gsungs pa kun/ /gang de thams cad bdag nyid gnas/ /dpa' bo 'di rnams gsang chen po/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ /kun la khyab cing rtag tu stong / /srid pa gzung zhing dri ma med / /rnal 'byor pas ni 'di ltar bsgom/ /gnyis med ye shes nyid dang yang ske/ /de dang 'dra bar stong par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid la ni rnam par bsgomatho la/ /de la brtul hu )zhugs bshad pa med/ /phreng ba dang ni sngags kyang med / /gzungs dang sbyin sreg las med de/ /mi g.yo go cha'i bya ba med/ /lag pa phyag nyurtargya'i sbyor ba dang / /g.yon brkyang rkang stabs la sogs med/ /dpa' bo chen pos srid pa gzung nyuge/ /rang byung mchog ni byed pa'o/ /dgag pa ru ni mi bya ste/ /bdag nyid nges par mchod par bya/ /zla ba'i dbus su thig le bsgomatha/ /brgya yi phyed kyis rnam par brgyanasnyi/ / de yi lidabus su rab bsams te/ /gzhonamasamed thig ler bcas pa yin/ /de yi lus ni 'bralama'i 'gyur te/ /bsgom 12du med cing bsam du med/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las kun gyi rnam pa'i sgyu ma ltar bstanardza/7pa'i le'u zhes bya ba nu )ste 79—74

de ltar sgyu ma'i cho ga dang / /gong gi cha ni rnam par spangs/ /rtag tu snying ga'i⑧dbus na gnas/ /'di ltar gsang ba chen po'o/ /lte ba'i rtsa bar pad+ma gnas / /ge sar bcas shing 'od dang ldan/ /rang bzhin kun ni shel dag ltar / /bcu drug la sogs kyis ni bskor/ /yi ge mnyam par sbyor ba ste/ /nam mkha' sbyar ②ba'i bdag nyid do/ /de nyid dbus su stong pa che/ /spro dang sdud par byed pa yin/ /gang gis ming ni kun rang bzhin/ /gang gis yongs su grags pa'o⑤/ /nyi ma zla ba rnam dag stegazhu / /'char dang nub parashebastan pa yin/ /sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ /bsod nams thams cad rnam par 'phel/ /pad+ma'i sna rtser yungs kur tsam/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu'i rang bzhin kun/ /yid kyis bzlas par yang dag ldan/ /phyi yi dbyangs ni rnam par spangs/ /de yi ye shes sangs rgyas te/ /gzhan gyis sangs rgyas mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu sems dpa' dngos po shes/ /khrus med dri ma med pa ste/ /bde ba'i chos ni de bzhin gshegasal/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin/ /thams cad me yi rnam pa ru/ /mthong ba mtshan ma dang po'o/ /srin bu me khyer rnam pa yi/ /mtshan ma gnyis par mtshon pa ni/ /rdul phran dkar po'i rnam pa ru / /phyogs bcur 'jig rten mthong ba yin/ /nyon mongs 'don pa'i las rnams ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yi mtshan nyid dang / /'dod pa lha yi7longs spyod myang / /bzhi pa mthong bar bstan pa'o/ /lha gzugs mtho ris lha rnams ni/ /gang la mthong bar sems pa'o/ /drug pa 'jigs nyu1pa longs spyod do/ /bdun 79—75

pa chos kyi dbyings nyid de①/ /brgyad par 'dod pa'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /rnal 'byor rnams kyis 'bras bu 'thob/ /skra yi rtse mo mibargyar gshags7cha/ /rdul phran shin tu bsam par bya/ /stong pa la sogs dmigs mi bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa mi blta ste/ /rdul med sa bon med pa bzhin/ /gzugs med mtshan nyid med pa'o/ /rnam shes ye shes gzungasem yin/ /rnam shes de yi rang bzhin te/ /mngon shes brgyad po yang dag 'thob/ /kun mkhyen kun byed gtso bo ste/ /ye shes sku ni dri ma med/ /skye ba 'di la thob par 'gyur/ /gzi brjid stobs dang ldan pa yin/ /sdug cing skal ba bzang por ston/ /dpag bsam shing ni yang dag byung / /rtag tu bsgom zhing5gebazlas pas ni/ /ji srid lus7ni bsgul bskyodashedang / /ngag gi smra ba thams cad ni/ /de snyed sngags dang phyag rgya ste/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung go 'phangasheganas/ /pad+ma bzhi dang 'khor lo che/ /de bzhin dngos grub kun gyi gzhisti/ /dpa' bo bye ba rnams dang ni/ /sangs rgyas bye bas legs par gsungs/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las thams cad so sor gsal ba'i mngon par shes pa brgyad nges par bstan pa'i cho ga'i le'u zhes bya ba ste bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzugs brnyan gyis nyul )zhi ba/ /'di ru yid ldan don du gsungs(1/ /gang gis myur dul de 'grub pa/ /nad pa zhi bar byed pa ni/ /pho mo rgyal po byis pa rnams/ /sus kyang cho ga shes bya ba/ /spang lebatshwanyekhri sogs stan rnams ni / /'bras dang sran chung yang dag bsres/ /shin tu btsos nas bsnos byas te / /nya dang sha dang khrag gis ni/ /gzugs brnyan dag ni bca'achab ste/ /79—76

bu mos bkal0)ba'i skud pa ni/ /skra yi tshad du bya ba yin/ /sngags kyi yi ges bskul bar bya/ /drug dang bcu gnyis yi ges so/ /bla re dag ni bresab dang / /sna tshogs gos dang rgyal mtshan mchog /dri dang spos dang me tog sogs/ /gsang sngags kyis ni bskul bar bya/ /srungs ba chen po'im )gos kyis52ni/ /smad g.yogs dang ni stod g.yogs 46)byas/ /gang gis cung zad nad pa yi/ /spyod lugs ji ltar yin pa bzhin/ /ro ru song nas bskyal bar bya/ /rol mo sna tshogs glu dbyangs dang / /de bzhin gzhugatso)pa bya ba ste/ /gzugs brnyan la ni gdags par bya/ /dpung rgyan lag gdub mgul rgyan dang / /gos la sogs pa rnams kyis brgyan3)/ /rked pa la ni mtshon chas bcings/ /lag paraloraral gri 'dzin pa ste/ /spyi bor bcing tshizhing go cha bgos/ /snying rje la sogs phan pa'i sems/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rnal 'byor che/ /go cha gsum gyis rnam par brgyan31ri/ /dur khrod du ni 'gro ba ste/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bos bskor/ /'du byed rnams ni dang por byas/ /dkyil 'khor mdzes par bri ba ste/ /ma mo 3 rnams dang rnal 'byor ma/ /bsgom 1lhazhing phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dgod/ /de ru lha rnams yang dag gzhaganyibyu /gzugs brnyan lus ni lho phyogs su/ /sngags pas mgo bo bstan par bya15/ /ji ltar mdzes pas bsgrub bya bsgom / /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /g.yas brkyang gis ni yang dag gnas/ /rtsa ba'i sngags sogs kyis ni bsrung 3 / /sngags pas kha ni shar du bltas/ /lag pas shes rab kha nya ṭī ga /grib ma bgom par byas nas ni/ /lte ba'i phyogs su brdeg par bya/ /ji ltar sdug bsngal bar ni gtub3tshe/ /lha sbyin nad ni zhi bar 'gyur/ / dbang po 2 la sogs shar phyogs gzhag nya /79—77

sngags kyis7bskul bar bya ba ste/ /ji ltar cung zad gzhug par bya/ /slob dpon gyis ni mdzes par brtag /khye'us khye'u grol ba ste/ /bu mos bu mo grol ba yin/ /thams cad khrus dang gtsangasasbra dang / /mdzes shing zhi bar bya ba ste//phyi nas7slob dpon dgyes par bya/ /gos dang rgyan la sogs pa yiX/ /gzhan kun la yang mchod par bya/ /bza' ba btung sogs gos kyis so/ /gsang ba chen pos zhi bar bya/ /dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba las 'bum phrag gsum las btus pa/ bstan bcos thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal khrag 'thung chen po bklagasalgepas 'grub pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gzhan las rgyal ba dang po'i sgrubalgepa'i rgyud kyi7phyi ma/ dpal khrag 'thung mngon par 'byung ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs sonya// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a dwa ya badz+ra dang bod kyi lots+tsha ba chingasalgeyon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan〈nyel phab pa(nye// //
