༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ yo gi nī salnga jus / bod skad du/ rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal tshon1rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas/ /skad cig gis ni 'thob 'gyur brlom/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu yi/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /kun tu spyod pa'i cho ga mchog /'khor lo gsum bdag 'di sgom pa/ /rnal 'byor lam la gnas pa yin/ /lugs 'byung lugs las ⑤bzlog par ni/ /rgyud du sbas par 67gnas gang de/ /bstan pa ru ni ⑦ji skad gsungs/ /bshad pa yang ni de bzhin no/ /so sor bstan pa ma lus nyid / /brda yi cho ga rgyas pa yin/ /gang gis shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /sgrub pa po yis grub thob pa/ /sum cu 2rtsa bdun tshul gyis ni/ /byang chub phyogs la gnas pa yin/ /'jig rten du ni bsgom byar bshad/ /he ru ka dpal 'gro 79—95

ba'i mchog /de la thog mar rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug gis phung po lnga la lha'i nga rgyal bskyed par bya 1ste/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po la ni rdo rje nyi ma 'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po la ni〈(pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /'du byed kyi phung po la ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la ni rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna dag la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /lce la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'i dbyings so/ /sa'i khams la ni ltung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ri ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni gar dbang ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma'i dra ba mo ste/ de ltar ri kyiphung po dang / khams dang skye mched rnams la lha'i ⑤nga rgyal bskyed par bya'ol/ /rnal 'byor ma'i 6kun tu spyod pa las lha rnams kyi gnas kyi tso)rnam par dag pa gnas pa ste dang po'o// //de nas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun lha'i sbyor bas sbyar bar72)bya ste/ de thams cad kyang gang zhe na/ lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang /tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang /sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / 'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dad pa'i dbang po dang / brtson 'grus 79—96

kyi ①dbang po dang / dran pa'i dbang po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po dang ske/ shes rab kyi dbang po dang / dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / dran pa'i stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / shin tu sbyangs pa (geyang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang /yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / yang dag pa'i rtog pa dang / yang dag pa'i ngag dang ske/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' dang / yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa dang / dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par srung ba po dang / mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong ba dang / mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed ④pa'o/ /de ltar na dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dang / yang dag par spong pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / dbang po dang /ci stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i 55nomathar thug pa rnams ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yin no/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las byang chub kyi phyogs (7kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun bstan pa ste gnyis pa'o// //de la de rnams kyi lha'i sbyor ba'i 7grangs ji lta bar mdor bsdus nas bshad 73—97

par bya ①ste/ lus dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni lā mā'o②/ /chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni khaṇ+ḍa ro hā'oge / /sems dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni gzugs can mtho/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab tu stigatum mo'o⑤/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'ol/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o/ /dad pa'i dbang po ni dpa' bo'i ༅blo gros ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi'u methung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po ni lang ku'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o/ /shes rab kyi dbang po ni sa srung tshonasama'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs byed chen mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /dran pa'i stobs ni chang 'thung ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo bsangs ma'o(ge / /shes rab kyi stobs ni shin tu bzang mo'o'i/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta rna ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni bya 7gdong ma'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ /shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni khaṇ+ḍa ro hā'o/2/ /chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni chang 'tshong tsoma'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni tsakra war ti nī'obo / /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni shin tu dpa' mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog 8pa ni 'khor los sgyur skimathol/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khu gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug gdong ma'o/ /yang 73—98

dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ku'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams7yang dag par srungaglegeb ni gshin rje pho nya ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spong ba ni gshin rje mche ba ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyed pa ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun lha rnams kyi rnam par dag pa bstan pa ste gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /dpa' bo gnyis med dam pa ste/ /he ru gasnyedapal sku'i yan lag /yan lag kun ni cha shas gnas/ /sen mo dang so la ni thod pa phyed pa'o/ / sku dang la/spu la ni keng rus chen po'o/ /pags ri pa dang dri ma la ni keng rus so/ /sha la yini mche ba rnam me)par gtsigs pa'o/ /rgyus pa la ni lhabadagra'o/ /rus pa la ni 'od 9)dpag med do/ /mkhal ma la ni rdo rje'i0'od do/ /snying la ni rdo rje'i tsho11sku'o/ /mig gnyis la ni 12myu gu can no//mkhris pa la ni rdo rje'i ral 32pa can no/ /glo ba la ni dpa' bo chen po'o/ /rgyu ma la ni༄rdo rje hūṃ mdzad do/ /gnye 'am la ni rab bzang ngo / /lto ba la ni rdo rje bzang po'o/ /bshang ba la ni 'jigs byed chen po'o/ / mtshog ma'i sbubs 8la ni mig mi bzangatshwa rmengo / /bad kun nyusnyel ni stobs po che'o/ /rnag la ni rin chen rdo rje'o/ /khrag la ni rta mgrin rna37/ /rdul la ni nam mkha'i snying po'o/ /tshil la ni dpal he ru ku'o/ /mchi ma la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go/ /73—99

mchil ma la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /snabs la ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las dpa' bo'i ①rnam par dag pa bstan pa ste bzhi pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub byed pa/ /gang zhig shes pa tsam gyis ni/ /sgrub pos dngos grub thob 'gyur ba'o/ /ji ltar nang gi bdag nyid shes/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor dam pa yin/ /rnam dgod ji ltar sbyar ba ni/ /snying po thams cad bsdus pa ste/ /rten dang brten ②pa'i tshul gyis ni/ / hai raṃ bha ris sogs yang dag gnas/ /bla ma las brgyud gerim bzhin du/ /gang zhig cho ga 'di shes pas/ /ri steng (5)pad+ma ge sar gyi/ /sna tshogs 'dab stim 'jam pa la/ /de yi 97)dbus bzhugs dpa' bo ni/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub mdzad pa/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang lā ma dang / / khaṇ+ḍa ro hā (shegazugs can ma/ /pad+ma'i phyogs kyi gnas la dgod/ /dngos grub thams cad sgrub byed yin/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang rnam rol ma'o/ /mtshams kyi bzhi po dag la ni/ /lnga pas gang ba'i thod pa gzhag /phul+la 6)sogs dang yang dag sbyar/ /yul dang 7yul du gnas pa yin//spyan drang rtsona'akhor lo'i dbus gnas la/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /pu zhes bya ba ni pul+lī hunyer ma la ya na khaṇ+ḍa ka pā hunyel dang pra tsaṇ+ḍa'o/ /dzā ④zhes bya ba ni dzā lan bodha ra na ma hā kung kā tshel dang tsaṇ+ḍa gyi'o/ /o nyu 1zhes bya ba ni au rmin na rkang kā la dang pra bhā ba tī'om/ /a zhes bya ba ni ar hunyebu da hūṃ rten bi ka ṭa sbyo :rda ṣ+ṭa ni dang ma hā na sī ༷ rteste gnas so/ /go zhes bya ba ni go dā ba rī na su rā bai 79wa 100

ri ṇa dang bī ra ma tī'o/ /rā (1)zhes bya ba ni rā me shwa ri (kyen a mi tā bha (kyedang khar wa rī'o④/ /de zhes bya ba ni de wi ko ṭa (snyen badz+ra pra bha dang lang ke shā rī'o/ /mā ⑥zhes bya ba ni mā la ba na badz+ra de ha dang dru mats+tsha lnga'ongs/ /nye ba'i gnas so/ /thugs kyi 'khor lo ste nam mkha' la rgyu ba'o/ /kā (8)zhes bya ba ni kā ma rū 99)pan ang gu 7ri dang i rā ba tī'o3che/ /o zhes bya ba ni o ḍi 512na badz+ra dza ṭi lha la dang ma hā lha ra bā'o④/ /zhing ngo / /tri zhes bya ba ni tri sha ku ni (snyen ma hā r+bha ra ba nyu9dang bā yu be gā'o(8/ /ko zhes bya ba ni ko sa la na badz+ra rtsu kā tunyer dang / su rā bha gyi'o yinye ba'i zhing ngo / /ka zhes bya ba ni ka ling ga tsho stan su bha dra dang sgyum de bī'o me / /la zhes bya ba ni lam bā 2ka na badz+ra 52bha dra glogedang / su bha dā'o tshan do 25ha'ol/ /kā skyezhes bya ba ni kārtsi tsho snan ma hā lha smyo sher ba dang ha ya /sgro'ori rte/ /nyi zhes bya ba ni hi mā (2 la ya na bi rū pā gihak+ṣa dang kha gā na nī'os / /nye ba'i tshan do zhunyeha'o / /gsung gi ④'khor lo ste sa la rgyu ba'o tshog/ /pre zhes bya ba ni bre ta pu ri na ma hā ba la dang tsakra be gā'o/ /gro gi5zhes bya ba ni kṛ ri tshoha de ba tā 32na rat+na badz+ra dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hā'o0/ /'du ba can no/ /sau zhes bya ba ni sau rāṣ+ṭa 8 snan ha ya spyi 47ba dang / shoṇ+ḍi nī'os / /su zhes bya ba ni su baṇ+ḍa dī 48pa na ā 44kā sha (snyegar bha dang tsa kra bar sī tsā'o45/ /nye bar 'du ba can no/ / nā zhes bya ba ni 4 tshonā ga ra na shrī ho ru ka dang su bī rā'o dz+wa/ /si zhes bya ba ni si na dhu 49de sha na/ pad+ma nasto shwa ra sro )dang / ma hā ba lnga'o(spe/ /dur khrod do/ /ma zhes bya ba ni ma ru de sha na bai ro tsa na dang tsakra bar ti nī'o52/ /ku zhes bya ba ni ku lu tā 5nyen badz+ra sa twa dang ma hā bī r+sā'o5nye/ /nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /sku'i 'khor lo ste sa 'og na spyod pa'o/ /kā kā kyā nisnyedang u lū kā kyā ni5dang shwa nā myu ga dang sru ka rā kyā 58ni 73—101

phyogs su'o/ /ya ma dā snyitudang ya ma dra ཿshedang ya ma rda: rjisridang / ya ma ma tha gli⑧ni mtshams su'o/ /de ltar phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid ji srid nges par rtogatsonopa'i spyod yul du gyur gyi bar du dmigs par bya'o/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las lha'i gnas kyi sa bstan pa ste lnga pa'o// //de nas bdag po sogs kun gyi/ /mtshan ma phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams dang / /rang mdog phyag mtshan bzhugs tshul rnams/ /rgyud du sbas pa nges par bya/ /rgyal chen shrī he ru ka ni/ /gdug pa thams cad rab 'joms pa/ /phyag gnyis yang dag 'khyud pa dang / /gnyis kyis glang po'i pagasalgepa 'dzin/ /g.yas pa'i lhag mar dgra sta mdung / /rtse gsum gri gug 7lom ru/ /g.yon gyi lhag mar kha ṭ+wāṃ bsgrengashe/ /thod pa dmar chen zhags pa dang / /tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams bshad do0/ /bcu gnyis kyis ni brgyanatshwanyepa yin/ /thod pa'i phreng nyarteba'i mchod phyir thogs/ /brgya phyed par ni shes par bya/ /bcom ldan yum ni mdun du bzhugs/ /zhal gcig 'bar ba chen po ste/ / 'khyud patshwanyeyis ni thod pa dag /gdug pa'i bdud kyi khrag bkang bsnams8/ /g.yas pas rtag tu sdigs mdzubastomadang / /ma rungs pa yi gri gug bsnamasatso/ /sku mdog dmar zhing cher 'bararwa ba/ /thod dum brgyan pa'i sku ragasal can/ /dbu skra grol zhing spyan gsum sku/ /mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs su rung / /byin pa zhabs kyis legs par 'khyud/ / gnyis kumurtekhu sbyar tshul gyis bzhugs( kye / /mkha' 'gro ma sogs bzhi po ni/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga snod gri gug bsnams/ /sku la spyan gsum rgya 37lnga sogs/ /skra grol bas ni rnam par brgyan/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa 73—102

bzhi ni/ /phyag rgya lnga la sogs pas brgyan/ /phyag gnyis zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ /ral pa'i cod pan dar gyis bcings/ /rdo rje dril bus7legs 'khyud cing / /chags pa chen po rjes chags mdzad/ /rnal 'byor ma ni nyi shu bzhi / /dbu skra grol bas rnam par brgyan/ /phyag rgya lnga lam pasogs pa dang / /spyi bor nor bus rnam par brgyan/ /rnal 'byor snod dang bcas pas 'khyud/ / sdigs mdzuba'i0kyis ni gri gug bsnams/ /he ru ka dpal la sogs kun/ /g.yas brkyang7pa yi gnas pas bzhugs/ /mgur chu dpung rgyan rna cha dang / /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /mchod phyir thogs dang thal ba ni/ /phyag rgya drug par rab tu bshad/ /pha rol phyin drug rnam dag pas/ /phyag rgya drug gis slobargyan pa yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /spyan gsum 'og pagatso)dag gis brgyan/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /yi ge gsum gyi dngos grub kyi/ /ngo bor bdag nyid bsgom bya zhing / /dngos grub 'dod pas gzhan mi bya/ /de yi bsod nams gang 'gyur ba/ /sgrub pa'i yon tan rgya chen po / /lce ni brgyas stong du ma yis/ /bsod nams brjod par nus ma yin/ /khwa gdong la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ /thams cad kyang ni sgo skyong ste/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa thogs/ /sku la phyag rgya lnga sogs ldan/ /gshin rje brtan sogs mtshams bzhir te/ /de dag zhabs gnyis brkyang pa dang / /gzugs gnyis ldan zhing yid 'phrog ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma skyed 8ji bzhin du/ /khwa gdong la sogs dbye ba nyid/ /de ltar ma lus 'khor lor 9riganas/ /mdog dbye'i nya )cho ga'i rim bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las rang gi mtshan ma dang /zhal dang phyag rgyarwanyadang / sku mdog dang mtshon cha bstan pa ste drug pa'o// //73—103

de nas go chasheganyis po ni/ /gang shes pas ni myur ba ru/ /sgrub pa po yis grub thob pa/ /rgyud du sbas pa nges bshad bya/ /oṃ ha/ na ma nyi/ swā hā dun hu/ bo gsheṭa he/ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho/ phaṭa haṃ/ snying ga spyi bo spyi gtsug dang / /dpung pa mig gnyis go cha sbyar/ /dang po rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /gnyis pa rnam par snang mdzad gnas/ /gsum pa pad+ma gar dbang rgyal/ /bzhi pa he ru ka dpal bshad/ /lnga pa rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /drug pa la ni rta mchog yin/ /de ni go cha rnam drug gis/ /shin tu bsrungs pa nyid yin no/ /oṃ baṃ/ haṃ oṃ/ hri mo'i/ hri hri/ hūm̐ rtsu/ phaṭa phaṭa/ lte ba snying ga mede bzhin kha/ /spyi bo spyi gtsug go cha nyid/ /dang po rdo rje phag mo'o/ /gnyis pa yasami nī ⑦ru brjod/ /gsum pa rmongs byed ma nyid de/ /bzhi pa sbyin ma yin par bshad/ /lnga pa kun tu skrag par grags/ /drug pa gtum mo yin par bshad/ /go cha drug nyid phag mo dang / /dpa' bo gnyis med rnal 'byor ma'o/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las go cha gnyis bstan pa ste bdun pa'o// //de nas go cha gnyis shes nas/ /ye shes 'khor lo rnam bsgoms nas/ /sngags dang phyag rgya'i sbyor ba yis/ /dam tshig 'khor lor myur gzhug nabya/ /rkang pa mnan la steng du blta/ /steng du dze gyi sgra bsgrags she)la/ /phyogs bcu'i〈 )'jig rten khams gnas pa'i/nya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgug /sngags kyis yang dag bskul ba dang / /skad cig de la spyan drang ‘/gebya/ /mdzub〈nyemo dgug byas gung mo nges par sbyar/ /mthe bong rdo rje brtan por yang dag sbyar//79—104

de ni dpral ba'i phyogs kyi dbus gzhag la/ /gcu 3)zhing gcu'agazhing bskor ba byas pa yis/ /sngags pas dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma byin brlab/ /yi ge 35)ni sna rtser yang dag sbyar/ /byā ni mtshan gyi lte bar yang dag dgod/ /lte ba snying ga kha dang dpral ba ru/ /sngags kyi tshogs dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ /lte ba snying gshedag tu rnal 'byor ma/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma yi sngags(byekyis ni/ /a ba dhū tī gnyis kyis dpa'apha)byin brlabatu )/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo gnyis med yin/ /dang por 31dga' ba dpa' bo ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnal 'byor ma/ /rab tu dga' ba ma lus nyid/ /bde ba'i thabs desngo kun rig pa'o/ /lha yul sa steng sa 'og tu/ /skad cig gis ni gzugs gcig 'gyur / /sgomanepa bdag gis bshad pa yi/ /bsdu ba de nyid bshad pa ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi lag gnyis kyis/ /bskor ba mkha' 'gro'i bde de yin/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drang ba tshadang bsdu ba bstan pa ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas sprul par shes bya dang / /longs spyod rdzogs par 'dod pa nyon/ /theg pa chen po phyag rgya che/ /rnal 'byor ma yi mgrub ster bshad/ /phyag rgya chen po skyelas lhag pa'i/ /rnal 'byor kun las mchog gzhan med/ /he ru ka dpal rgyal po che/ /rnal 'byor kun dbang dbang phyug yin/ /mkha' 'gro nyu snam yi dra ba sdom/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam las blangs pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shes de'i rang bzhin/ /te ru ka dpal nya dpa' bo mchog /skye bo dam pa kun 'dus pa/ /zhi ba'i btung bas grub 'gyur ba/ /rtag pa'i go 'phang mchog yin te/ /skyon 79—105

med pa ni rtagashepa'i gnas/ /pu la sogs pa50yang dag sbyar/ /yul dang yul du rnam par gnas/ /he ru ka dpal bdag nyid dgod/ /yi ge nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni / /longs spyod rdzogs par shes bya ste/ /rnal 'byor che la gnas pa yin/ /mdor bsdus nas ni rab 'jug pa/ /blo gros brtson pas shes par bya/ /ldog pa'ang ji ltar bstan pa ni/ /bshad bya sgrub pa po rnams nyon/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni bkod dang bral ba sterikyi / /ka ni gang du'angs④mi gnas pa'o⑤/ /de ni rang bzhin stong pa ste/ /kun tu 'gro zhing mi shigasamagyepar/ /mdor bsdus nas ni sgom byed pa/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa yi/ /sku /rmugasum dag ni rnam sgom nyepa/ /byang chub phyogs ni sum cu bdun/ /der ni nges par bsgom par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las 'jug pa bstan pa ste dgu pa'o// //de nas bsgoms pas dub gyur na(9)/ /bsdus pa 7spyod tshul khyad par gyis/ /sbyor dang bral bar mi bya ste/ /spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa 'di yin/ /sngar ni ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ /bsam gtan cho ga rgyas byas la/ /rang 'dod las 11/la gtor ma ni/ /khyad par du yang sbyin par bya/ /zla ba mar ngo'i tshes bcu dang / /zla ba yar ngo'i de nyid la/ /'bad pas dpa' bo chang sogs dang / /rdo rje lha mo rab mchod cing / /sngar bshad sngags dang rgya sbyar ba/ /cho ga bzhin du yang dag bsrung thege/ /o ā ra l+le hoḥhunyedzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥyi/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī mas ma ya s+t+waṃ dz+ra tshash+ya hoḥ1 ci / de ltar lan /shegasum bzhi lngar brjod/ /dam tshig sogs rdzas legs 79wa 106

gnas par①/ /rdo rje thal mo kha gyen phyebya/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor mas mngon bzla / /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba rigeyak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa/ bhū ta bsre ta pi shā tso dā/pa smra ⑤ra badz+ra ḍā ka ḍā ki kyā 67da ya i me ba li kṛ hār+sha 7)sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma ⑧sarba sirnyi mashepra yal) ts+tshan+tu ya the hu1/baṃ/ ya the/ bhuñdza tha dzi gh+ra 12tha/ pi ba tha/mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kān+ta yā/ /sacu khaṃ bi shud dha ye/ sa hā yi kā bha bsalge/ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ dpa' 8bo'i 'khor lo la sogs sngags/ /dur khrod la sogs kyis kyang brgyan/ /lho phyogs kha bltas tshernal 'byor pas/ /gnas ni mthon por rab tu mchod/ /nye bar mtshon pa ji lta bar/ /bdag gis nus pas dbul bar bya/ /dgun zla 'bring po la sogs pa'i/ /tshes bcu la ni dad pas mchod/ /skye hunyebo dam pa kun 'dul 3)la/ /bde ba thams cad dbul bar bya/ /der ni bshos rnams bza' bya ste/ /lhag ma snod du gzhag )par bya/ /de yi lag tu 'ongs pa'i dpal31/ /gang gis kyang ni gzhom mi nus//de ni skye bo dad ldan rnams kyis mchod/ /he ru ka dpal mngon par dgyes gyur nas / /kun tu dgyes pa'i zhu mchog ni stsol 'gyur te/ /gang phyir mchog ni de yi lag na gnas/ /mtshan mo skra ni grol gyur pas rte/ /brtul zhugs gos med gtor sbyin na/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor bdag /des ni ma mo dga' bar 'gyur / /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las gtor ma dang / mchod pa tshes bcur bya ba srungs steb bstan pa ste bcu pa'o// //de nas pha rol phyin drug dang / /byang chub phyogs ni sum cu bdun/ /gnas sogs sa ni bcu po rnams/ /che mchog lha yi ni'ubadag nyid can/ /73—107

dngos po gang dang gang gis ni/ /mi rnams yid ni yang dag sbyor/ /de yis de yi dngos 'gyur te/ /sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu 'dra/ /de bzhin 'jigs dang bcas 3)pa'am/ /'jigs med ji lta ji ltar gnas/ /bsam gtan dag gam sgom pa yisal/ /las rnams thams cad rab sgrub byed/ /spyod dang grol ba'i 'bras rab stsalakye/ /tshe 'di nyid la thob 'gyur ba/ /bsgomasapa bdag gis bshad par bgyi/ / snying po52kun las btus pa yin/ /log pa'i shes pa'i 6shes pa can/ /gang yang khyod kyis bshad mi bya/ /bla ma'i rim las ji ltar bstan/ /gang gis myur du shes 'gyur ba/ /skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu/ /sgyu 'phrul ye shes kyis bskul ba/ /dad pa yang dag bskyedashepa dang / /rnal 'byor spyod tshul gnas pa yin/ / lkugs shing glen52)la thabs ngan ldan/ /byis spupa'i shes pa'i shes pa can/ /sems can yongs su ma smin dang / /phyi rol bstan bcos kyis 'chal sna ripa/ /de dag kun gyis 37mi shes te/ /mi shes mun pas khebs pa dang / /khengs pa la ni rten par dga'/ /nga rgyal la sogs bdun sems ldan/ /de kun gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi3)/ /spyod yul gsang ba mi shes so/ /he ru ka dpal yang dag 'jug /slob dpon bdag nyid chen po yis/ la/ /myur du dngos grub skyed mibyed de/ /'phral du yid ches byed pa yin/ /kun spyod cho ga'i rnal 'byor shes/ /cho ga'i bya ba bstanamatshapar bya/ /srid pa gsum po ma lus na/ /de ni kun mkhyen bstan pa shes/ /mthong ba dang ni reg pa dang / /thos pa dang ni dran pa yis/ /sdig pa kun las grol 'gyur ba/ /de ltar de ni the tshom med/ /lha rnams bzlog75ste dgod pa dang / /sngags kyi dbye ba bzlog pa dang / /bsgom nyurtepa gsang ba bzlog pa ni/ /snying po thams 79—108

cad bsgrubatupa yin/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi spyi yis ni/ /sems ni yongs su smin pa dag /'dir ni sbyor sogs sngags rnams kyi( gon/ /dam tshig de ltar bstan pa yin / /bde gshegs dbugs 'byin gsungs pa ni/ /dag pa'i lus ni skyon med pa / /bsod byanams chung ba'i sngags pas kyang / /ngas3)dga' bas ni rnyed par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las thams cad rnam par dag pa bstan pa ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas bsrungs46)min bza' min dang / /dkyil 'khor pa min dkyil 'khor min / /bzlas brtul sbyin sreg med mod kyi tsho/ /mdor na sems 'dus5kyitshul can yin/ /gzung57bya rnam shes ye shes ni/ /bla mas bstan las rtsol 7bya ste/ /phyi rol gyi ni bstan bcos pa/ /lam de shin tu ring ba yin/ /rnal 'byor pa rnams thabs kyis ni/ /bla ma'i bsnyen bkur la brtson pa/ /ston pa'i mtshan nyid bstan pa dang / /dpa' bos de nyid bstan pa yin/ /skad cig rnam pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /skad cig rnam pa'i phyag rgyar ldan/ /kun nas thams cad skad cig ste/ /skad cig gis ni gsang sngags brjod/ / sbas dang71lta dang lag bcangs dang / /'khyud dang gnyis gnyis la sogs pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pas dbugs 'byin gsungs/ /gong nas gong du bsten par bya/ /thams cad 'dir ni bstan pa yin/ /rnam pa gzhan dag rtswa dang 'dra1snye/ /de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid mi 'gyur dam pa yin/ /de nyid thams cad khyab byed de/ /lus kun la ni rnam par gnas/ /de nyid sangs rgyas ye shes te/ /he ru ka dpal yin par bshad / /skyes pa ma ning la nyanyesogs 73—109

nyid / /phra ba'i snying po'ang 'dzin pa yin/ /ye shes bdagashetu byung de la/ /gang zhig sa5gel gnas rnams dang / /bstan bcos dag ni ma lus dang / /rig byed grub mthar gnas pa rnams/ /'jig rten 'di dang gzhan dag tu/ /de med par ni grub mi 'gyur/ /rig byed grub pa'i mtha' rnams las/ /'di ni snying por rab tu bshad/ /'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas lnga'i bdag nyid/ /gar mkhan dag dang rilamo bzang ltar snang / /gang du bde chen zhes bya gcig pu nyid/ /gcig pu'i nga)nyams ni du mas gar mdzad do/ /'dug dang ldang bsnyenyid dag dang / /'jug dang rdzogs pa nyid dag dang / /byin gyis brlabalgedang dbang bskur dang / /ting pe'adzin mchod pashebasdus pa yin/ /de nas cho ga'i ming gzhan pa/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ /de nyid du ni kun skyes pa/ /'byin dang sdud par byed pa yin/ /a ā/ i khri/ utu.u/ ṛ dzāl/ bla lī/ e )e/ o au/ e aḥ/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ṭa ṭha ḍa nye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha/k+ṣaḥhu7ske/ 'di ni bcom ldan lha de yin/ /mchog nyid lhag par gnas pa yin/ /lha kun gyi ni skyedarwartepa dang / /sngags rnams kyi ni rgyud nyid yin/ /gang zhig 'di rtag sgom pa dang / /rtag tu klog cingatshwanyesems patshwastedang / /rnal 'byor pa yis dang por brjod/ /te ru ka dpal gnyis med 'gyur/ /der ni lagasnyisogs rgyan yin te/ /ska rags gnas rnams thams cad yin/ /'di ni rtag tu 'dzin byed pa/ /chos kun rtogs par byed pa yin/ /ā li kā li mdun bsams te/ /rnal 'byor chen pos rnamatshwa gnas la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor legs rdzogs pa/ /lte ba'i rtsa bar gnas par bsgogonye/ /de yi dbus gnas 79—110

bsam pa ni/ /dam pa'i gnas mchog yi ge ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can① / /lha yi sku ni bsgom par bya/ /de ni gzugs las 'das pa ste/ /dngos po med pa'i sems nyid yin/ /bsam mi khyab pa nyid bsams rin)te/ /bsam de mtshan mar brtag mi bya/ /yang na bdag nyid sems bsam pa de las gzungs ni 'thob ri par 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las rgyud thams cad lasaras)nges par byas pa'i de kho na nyid kyi gnas gcig pu bstan pa ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma gnyis med/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che'i/ /gnas ni yi ge'i sa pa yin/ /pul+līrabar ma ya mgo bokyil/ / dzā lan medha ra spyi gtsug nyid/ / au rgyan58)rna ba g.yas pa ste/ /mar〈nyebu da tshini rgyab phyogs 31la'o/ /gnas so/ / go dā ba 'i02rna ba g.yon / / rā me shwa ra 3)smin ma'i 7mtshams/ / de bī ko ṭa 7mig gnyis te/ / mā la ya 7ni dpung mgor ro/ /nye ba'i gnas so/ /kā ma rū pa mchan khung dgod / /o ṭi 3 nu ma gnyis la'o/ /zhing ngo / /tri sha ku ni 12lte ba'i dbus/ /ko sa la ni sna rtser ro/ /nye ba'i zhing ngo / / ka ling ka 39ni kha la dgod/ /lo ba5) ka ni mgrin dbus nyid/ /tshan do ༷ 1ha'o/ /kā: sa snying la dgod par bya/ /hi mā (nyel ya mchan du 0rtsar ro/ /u pa tshan do ha'o/ /bre ta pu ri mtshan la ste/ /gromanyeta de ba bshang lam shrī 9la'o/ /'du ba can no/ / sau rā dzo rtes brla gnyis bsagonye / /gser gling rje ngar gnyis la'o/ /nye bar 'du ba can no/ /nār(ga ra ni sor mor ro/ /sin dhu du )rkang pa'i bol gnyis la'o/ /dur khrod do/ /ma 73—111

ru mthe bongasheganyis la dgod/ /ku lu tākhuni pus morasheganas/ /nye ba'i dur khrod do/ / pu dzā( )o a go rā de mā/ /kā o tri ko ka la kā nyi/ /pre gro7so su nādzesasi ma ku/ /gnyid log ma log ldang ba dang / /bza' 'am 'gro ba'i chos spyod pa'am/ /gang yin der ni rnam bkod na/ /'jig rten gsum gyis mi g.yo'o / /ming gi rgyud ni 'bum sde las/ /snying po bsdus par gyur pa yin/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa'i rgyud/ /'bum gcig nangashenas de bzhin bshad//shes rab rgyud ni gsang ba ste/ /ming 'byung ba las5) gnas pa yin/ /bstan pa yis ni sprul pa yin/ /bshad pas longs spyod rdzogs par 'dod/ /so sor bstan pa ma lus nyid/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i de nyid bstan/ /sku gsum 'khor lo gsum du bshad/ /chos sogs longs spyod rdzogs pa nyid/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs dag ni/ /bden pa gnyis la gnas pa yin/ /blo ngan glen zhing lkugs pa dang / /shes rab dman zhing log lta can/ /phyi rol bstan bcos kyis 'chal 37pa/ /bla ma la ni sun 'byin yin/ /de dag kun kyang rnam spangs te / /gus kyang bshad par mi bya'o/ /cha dang cha yi7)khyad par la/ /der ni gnyis su med par bshad/ /dgatshwanyebyed dbang gi lha mo dang / /bka' bsgo'i lha mo dpa' bo skyes/ /de 'og ma lus kun spyod pa/ /'khor ba las grol gtso bo yin/ /ma lus rig byed las sprul pa/ /grub pa'i mthar ni de rab bsgrags//dpa' bo khyod kyis nga la bshad/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs can la sba/ /sgra dang sgra nyams brda rnams kyi/ /lam 'di nyid kyi rjes su 'brang / /bsdus don yang dag blangs pa dang / / brda yi/tshig ni rgyas pa yin/ /gang gis kun spyod mi shes par/ /rnal 'byor pa ni rnal 'byor ston/ /de yi ngal ba don med de/ /79—112

'bras bu de ni thob mi 'gyur/ /'gro la 'phags0)pas sngon gsungs pa/ /sbas teshegazhan du gsungs pa yin/ /kun spyodasa'adir ni bshad pa las/ /sgrub pa pos ni rab mnyam gzhagabu /rgyal bas sngon ni rgyud chen po'i/ /sngags kyi yi ge sgrub mdzad pa/ /las kyi bya ba gang yang rung55)/ /dge dang mi dge brtags te bya / /yi ge mtha' dang dbus dag tu/ /der ni thams cad rab tu grub/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las ā li kā li yedang / las thams cad kyi nges pa gnyis su med par bstanashepa ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas rgyud rnams thams cad du/ /sbas gsang cho ga bshadas bya ste/ /sangs rgyas bzhi yi gdan bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje la sogs dpa' rnal 'byor/ /mkha' 'gro la sogs rdo rje yi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor dbang phyug gtso/ /me long5nyal sogs rnam pa bzhi/ /gnyis med gnyis su med sbyor hu )nyid/ /gnyis med rdzas ni me tog sogs/ /re re nas07ni dbul bar bya/ /phyag rgya lnga sogs mchog lus kyi/ /pha rol son pas phar phyin drug /lag pa'i mchod sogs ye shes can/ /blo ldan dpa' bos shes par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma drug go rims 32bzhin / /rdo rje sems sogs bcu gnyis dang / /dpa' bo chen por sbyar bya gonye / /lag pa'i mchod la sogs pas bstod/ /lnga po lnga dang yang dag bsroste/ /'o ma dang yangatsobasre bar bya/ /mchod pa des ni legs gnas la/ /spyod dang grol ba'i 'dod dang ldan/ /lag pa'i mchod pas rnal 'byor pa/ /dbul ba'i 'dod don 'grub 8par 'gyur/ /sems ni gzhan du gyur pa dang / /bza' btung gos sogs thob par 'gyur/ /lha yi mchod pa byas na ni/ /de la bsam 73—113

pa yin/ /rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags gang / /ska0)rags byas pa brgyan pa yin/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i(gyi/ /sngags ni lag pa'i' thod pa yin / /rnam par snang mdzad yum sngags dang / /thod pas mgo bo brgyan pa yin / /de ltar bdag nyid rnam bsams nas/ /tsham ngam sngags kyis legs par bsrungasnyi/ /rtag tu tshangs par spyod 'gyur ba/ /gsang sngags rkang pa brgyad mchod pa'o/ /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo steg/ /mtshan mo bcom ldan ma brtag bya/ /mi bya ci yang yod min te/ /rtag tu mi bsam yod ma57yin/ /mi bza' ci yang yod 3 min la/ /dge dang mi dge mi smra med/ /bdag nyid ji bzhin 'gro de bzhin/ /bdag ci 'dra b.raman gzhan de bzhin/ /de ltar rnam bsam rnal 'byor bdag /'jigs pa thams cad yongs spangs te/ /dpa' bo seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs byed yin/ /he ru ka dpal gzhir gnas pa'i/ /yan lag bskyod pa ji snyed dang / /tshig tu brjod pa ji snyed pa/ /de snyed phyag rgya gsang sngags yin/ /rigs lnga'i kun tu spyod pa ni / /rigs gcig nyid du spyad 49)par bya/ /de ltar shes pa'i bdag nyid can/ /go 'phang mchog tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gnyis med ye shes sems ldan la/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /mi rtog bdag nyid sems kyis ni/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams spyad/ /rnal 'byor ma'i kun tu spyod pa las gnyis su med pa'i brtul zhugs dang gsang sngags bstan pa ste bcwa nyu snalnga pa'o// //gzhan yang phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe/ /dus mthar dngos grub mi thob ste/ /blo ni gzhan du rnam 'khrugs pas/ /phyag rgya dkyil 'khor bzlas pa yis/ /bde bar 79—115

༄ga /rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha smyor gyi rgyud ces bya ba/①༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ tsa tur yo gi nī serma pu ṭa tan+t+ra nā ma/ bod skad du/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor gyi rgyud ces bya ba/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /rnal 'byor bzhi yi kha sbyor te / /zhal bzhi zhes ni rnam par bshad/ /rgyud rnams kun tu sbas pa laste/ /zhal rnams kyang ni kha sbyor ma/ /'di ru rgyas par brjod pa yin/ /'og dang steng du rnam bshad dang / /de bzhin g.yon dang g.yas pa'o/ /ā li kā li'i bye brag dugis/ /lte ba'i dbus su rnam par gnas/ /zla ba nyi mar rnam par bshad / /sa dang rlung gi nyid dag dang / /chu me de bzhin nam mkha' dang / /khams lnga ⑤dag dang yang dag ldan/ /gzugs dang reg pa de bzhin sgra/ /mig gnyis dang ni sna dag dang / /lus kyi steng 'og tu yang gsal/ /rtag tu rdor can rnam par gnas/ /cha dang cha min rnam par grol/ /stong pa'i ngang las 79—129

yang dag gnas/ /ya yi sde mtha' yang dag rdzogs/ /u yig dag ni thig ler bcas / /'byar mo)zhing gsal bar 'gyur ba ste/ /kha sbyor rnam pa rnal 'byor gyi / /rdor can jir ltar chang gis myos/ /'khor nas sems ni rnam par grol/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus pa/ /rdo rje'i⑧mig gis mthong bar 'gyur/ /bdun gyi rgyal po'i dngos grub kyis/ /ma lus lus pa med pa mthong / /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang ldan dang / /dbang po de bzhin 'dod dbang phyug /pha rol stobs kyis mnan nas 5)ni/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug gis ni mchod3)/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams kyis/ /dam tshig sgra yis bshad pa ste/ /srog dang rtsol 6ba kun tu bya/ /de yis 'di ni dam tshig sdom/ /de la kha sbyor rnam pa bshad / /zhal bzhi ru ni rab tu gnas/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi sde zhes ri bya/ /sbyor ba bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /gang gang dbang po'i lam nas byung / /de dang de yi rang bzhin nyid/ /'dod pa kun las7longs spyod pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /gzugs ni ji ltar rdzogs pa las/ /de la sgom pa ci shesalta bu/ /sngags rnams ji ltar bskyed par bgyimi/ /rdzogs par yang ni ci51ltar 'gyur/ /de dag thams cad tha snyad tsam/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams yang dag 'byung / /byang chub sems ni 'di ru bsngagasanyuge/ /'dod pa lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /mtshon bya 1snyematshan nyid kyis ni mtshon/ /mtshon bobya du ma'ang mtshon mi bya/ /sngags rnams rgyas par bshad nas ni/ /lha rnams kyi ni bsgom pa genyon/ /steng gi sgo ni gsum yin te/ /lte bar larlung gi gzugs can ma/ /de la / snadabus su rtag tu stong / /dag pa yi ni shel lta bur(she/ /longs spyod chen po nges par 'byung / /dgu pa bcu yis ldan pa ste/ /cha brgyad nyu)de yi yan lag 73—130

gis / /sgo dgu'i sa bon yin pa ste7/ /lus la sa bonadza rjes su brjod/ /ye shes mkha' 'grosabadag nyid kyis/ /steng gi char ni shes rab ste/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang bcas par 'byung / /sems kyi rdo rje zhes ni bshad/ /'dir ni steng gi pad+mar bshad/ /de la gnas ni bha gar bshad/ /shes rab de nyid rdor can bcas/ /rten dang brten par du )'byung ba yis/ /rtsa rnams kun la rnam par gnas/ /khu ba'i gzugs su gyur pa yis/ /spro dang sdud pa)par byed pas so/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsgom 6)pa'i rim pa phyed pas53)so/ /gdams ngag rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /lha rnams bsgomasko par brjod pa ste/ /de rnams sna tshogs rnal 'byor gyis9)/ /zla ba nyi mar bshad 7pa yin/ /gzhan yang gzhan min rnam par grol/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni g.yo ba med/ /der ni gzung bar bya ba ste/ /gang zhig de ru ji ltar gnas/ /nyin mo bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mtshan mo shes rab tu ni brjod/ /nam mkha'i nang song mchog tu zhi(me/ /dag cing dge ba 32yid du 'ong / /sangs rgyas la sogs mu stegs kun/ /lha min gnod sbyin srin po dang / /de nyid 'dod chags chags bral dang / /'dod pas thar bar gyur pa nyid1lha/ /de nyid bud med rnams la chags/ /de nyid mngal ni rab tu len/ /de nyid 'chi ste ril po'i miganas/ /de nyid bskamasalgepas mthong ba yin/ /de nyid gong du gyur pa ste/ /de nyid dri ru rnam par gnas/ /de nyid sdug bsngal rig tshapa ste/ /rig pas bde ba nyid dgasngortel/ /de nyid gcig pus khyab pa yin/ /bdud rtsi thigs pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /gzugs bzang gzugs dang ldan pa'i mchog /sna tshogs gzugs rnams yid du 'ong / /gzugs kun gsal bar byed pa'i dpal/ /gzugs 79—131

brnyan ma lus 'chang ba'o/ /bcu drug phyed phyed de yi0)phyed/ /rtag tu de nyid rig pa po/ /sna tshogs rtag tu zhi ba'i gzugs/ /nam mkha' lnga dang yang dag ldan / /de nyid rab tu zhugasalgepar brjod(kye/ /'gro la gsal bsnyemar me bzhin / /sna yi rtse mor rnam par 'byung / /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i 'od zer te/ /'di rnams kun ni bdag gis brjod/ / rten dang brten52pa'i mtshan nyid du/ /gang gis shes pas cho ga shes/ / de yi7dpal ni rgyas par 'grub/ /gzhan yang sngags kyi tshogs bshad de/ /gsang ba'i sbyor ba sbas pa ste/ /sde tshan brgyad kyi5kyematha' ma gzung / /sa bon lnga dang yang dag ldan/ /de bas byu yig7)sbyin par bya/ /dang por mtshamayig yang dag ldan/ /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /thig le chen po yi ge med/ /nam mkha' nam mkha'i dbus gnas par / /sngags dang rgyud 17ni yang dag 'byung / /ci7)ltar de ltar sngags kyang ni / /de bzhin nyid kyi tshul lta bur/ /yi ge tsam dang yang dag ldan/ /de la dbus su rab tu grags/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /gang yang gzhan gyi7)lha tshogs dang / /'byung po ma lus thams cad dang / /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /de yi dbus su yang dag rdzogs/ /yi ge la sogs gzugs can gyis/ /gzugs can rnal 'byor lā tham dang / /dum skyes ma yi bye brag gis/ /zhal bzhi zhes ni rnam par bshad/ /rnal 'byor bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /lte ba dang ni ge sar ldan/ /'dab ma bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /de la dbus su dpa' bo che/ /phyag brgyad kyis ni rnam par brgyanami/ /dang po la ni sha yis gang skye/ /gnyis pa khrag gis7 tshobakang ba nyid she/ /gsum pa bzhi pa lus phyag rgya/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍā /7ma ru/ /de bzhin kha dog dkar po 'phro /79—132

dri med ston ku'i nam mkha' bzhin/ /dkar dang dmar dang de bzhin gnag①ljang gu'i〈zhal te gtsigs pa'o/ /phyag rgyal)brgyad ni mdo ru bshad/ /phyag gis mtshon char rab tu grags/ /dang por 'jug pa'i phyag rgya ste/ /gnyis pa snying ni 'byinalapa'o/ /gsum pa rmongs byed phyag rgya yin/ /bzhi par ltung byed de bzhin no/ /lnga par gar ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /drug par gsodam gebyed mar ni brjod / /bdun par za76)byed ma'i phyag rgya/ /brgyad par steng du len57par nges / /gshinas rje mo dang skrag57byed drag /gtum mo dang ni bzang za dang / /bha su ma dang 'dod pa nyid/ /de nyid brgyad po phag mo nyid/ /mi bzadakyirnam par 'gyur ba'i gzugs/ /khrag dang khu ba za ba mo/ /'od zer 'bar ba sna tshogs 'bar/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsgom bya/ /mang por rnam bshad ye shes ni / /de la dbus su rnam par 'byung / /dpag tshad 'bum 31gyi rgya khyon du/ /de yisatshwanyegasal bar byed pa yin/ /sems can thog ma tha ma med/ /rdo rje sems dpa' chags pa che/ /thig le rdo rje can du 'gyur/ /zla ba phyed pa lta bur gsal/ /gdan ni pad+ma 'os1snyeg ste/ /rgyal po'i gzugs ni gsal ba yin/ /rgyal po nyid ces yirnam par bshad/ /steng du 'byung bar rab tu grags/ /yang ni dgod par bya ba ste/ /rigs kyi dbye bas brjod pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje sems dpar gyuratso/ /lho ru rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /nub tu rta yi rgyal po'o/ /byang du pad+ma gar dbang ste/ /'khor lo'i dbus su ho ru ka /steng gi sgra ni rta gdong yin/ /'di rnams 'di ru dgod par gsungs/me/ /rigs kyis dbye bas 12rnam pa lnga/ /de ru bsgom par bya ba yin/ /gzhom med gzhig tu med pa nyugeste/ /de yi dbus su yang dag rdzogs/ /mgon po rnam par 79wa 133

snang mdzad sogs/ /rnalatu'abyor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor lasashetshogs kyis bsgyings pa'i〈rgyud chen po zhes bya ba ste brtag pa dang po'o// //de nas rdo rje phag mo de/ /rkang rgyan dang ni do shal rgyan⑥/ /de yi dkyil 'khor la gar byed/ /dbang bskur ba ni ster ba yin/ /dam tshig la ni legs gzhag57phyir/ /phag mosasnyede bzhin rdo rje can/ /ci 'dod de bzhin rdo rje can / /dri chen dri chu za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /rtag tu bud med dang nus sam/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed dam/ / smros shig rdor can bde ba che/ /de nas bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /bzhadarwa1par gyur nas 'di dag smras / /lha mo ci ste bdag mi spro/ /khrag dang khu ba la sogs bza'/ /rtag tu bud med gus par bgyi/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o5nyebagyid do/ /yang ni legs so legs so byin/ /sgo skyong de bzhin rdo rje can/ /thod pa yang dag blangs nas ni / /rdo rje can la bza' ba dbul/ /zhi hunyezhing gcer bur7'dug pa dang / /rdo rje can ni skra grol bas/ /legs par dbang bskur 8ster bar byed/ /bha gar 'o byed rdo rje can/ /8de nas brtsams te rdo rje khyod/ /sems can don gyis brtul zhugs bzang / /bza'arwa)ba dri chen dri chu dang / /khrag dang khu ba sha dag go/ /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o bya ste/ /bdud rtsi rnams ni bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor pho nya mos/ /de nas rtag tu dbang bskur ro/ / rtsu rtsu haḥhaḥ.aḥ.aḥtrīḥtrīḥhunyes hā/ de nas de ma thag tu kun/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma nyid kyis/ /sgra chen po ni rab tu bsgrags/ /rdo rje can de dbang bskur ro/ /sna tshogs gzugs can drag po che/ /thod pa'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /sha dang 79—134

khrag dag 'thung ba ste/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni sbyor/ /la la rol mo'i cha byad brdungatu/ /pa ṭa'i ha sogs mu kuṇa ḍazhu/ /la la rab tu glu len cing / /la la pi wang bsgreng58)ba ste/ /la la rdoras55)can gar byed do/ / la la dril bu'i sgra sgrogs byed/ /(6)la la sgra dag rab tu sgrogs71/ /phyogs bcur dze gyi50sgra dag go / /la la gar dag rab tu byed/ /la lar dkyil 'khor du glu len5)/ /la la me tog rab tu 'grems/ /de yis rdor can la dbang bskur/ /la la spos kyis7 rab sbyin51byed/ /la la dri yis de bzhin no/ /'di ltar gyur pa'i mchod pa yis/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la ni bya/ /de nas rdor can lha mo de/ /tshig 'di dag ni brjod pa ste/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor nyid dag dang / /dbang dag legs par brjod nas ni/ /nga hu yis gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /lha rnams dgod pa mchog dag go/ /rgya ru kun tu khru brgyad de32/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa / /sngags pas de yi nyunyenyis 'gyur dpyad/ /gang du mkha' 'gro'i tshogs 'gying btso/ /nam mkha' 'od kyis 8rgya khyab par/ /gang de dkyil 'khor mchog yin no/ /dbus su 'khor lo yang dag bri/ /lte ba dag ni ge sar ldan/ /'dab ma bzhi dang yang dag bcas/ /kha dog dkar por yang dag ldan/ /de la dbus su dpa' bo dgod/ /dag pa'i shel bzhin dri ma med / /dang po'i zhal ni rnam par bzhad/ /dang po'i 1nyespyan gyis rnam par gzigs/ /smin ma khro gnyer rab tu gsal/ /mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa ni/ /lho ru bltas pa'i zhal dag go/ /g.yon pa rmad nyurtedu byung ba ste/ /rgyab ni 'jigs pa chen po yin / /mdun rgyab rta yi na ༷zhal gyis brgyan( lha/ /dkar po dmar po de bzhin gnag(nye / /ljang gu yis geni kha dog go/ /phyag brgyad kyang ni bri gi bar bya/ /73—135

thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan①/ /dpal ldan mgo bo'i phreng ba 'dzin/ /'jigs byed ljags ni 'dril ②ba ste/ /'jig dus chen po'i me ③dang mtshungs / /dur khrod lta bur 'jigs su rung / /brtsegs par rgodarnyucing bzhad pa che/ / dze gyi〈nyesgra ni sgrogs pa'o/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa ru/ /lha bzhi rnams ni brjod par bya/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa'i lag /khrag dang khu ba dag 'thung ngo / /'khor lo gnyis pa yang dag bshad/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zlum po la/ /'khor lo chen po yi ge brgyad/ /'od zer dmar po 'bar ba ste/ /gzugs can ma dang 'o57byed ma/ /lamasnyemachog 'phelashedang sa ma li / /phyir mi ldog dang e nyi ki/ /rdor can brgyad par brjod pa yin/ /lha mo brgyad po 'di ru dgod/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu 'bar/ /lag pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gzung71zhing / /thod pa5)khrag gis bkang ba'o/ /phyi rol 'khor lo yang dag brjod / /lha rnams bkod pa mchodasngo dang ni/ / saṃ khi nī dang puk+ka si/ /gsodasnyim dkar mo sgrog ma dang / /gtum mo ri khrod ma nyid dang / /sgrol ma de bzhin khro gnyer ma/ /khams gsum rnamatshwanyergyal glang chen mo/ /de bzhin ghasma rī dag dang / /durga tsa muṇ+ḍa skyedag dang / /de bzhin tshangs ma khyab 'jug ma/ /sgo skyong yang dag bshad pa ni/ /sgo bzhi dgatshwanyetu sbyar bar bya/ /'khor lo chen po kha dog dzishe/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba'i〈)tshogs kyi 'od/ /lha mo chen mosko 3 kha dog dkar/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang nya phyis 'dzin/ /dkyil 'khor 'di ni rgyal po ste/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sdom pa ni/ /rang gi rgyud du thun mong ste/ /dkyil 'khor bla ma'i bla ma yin/ / srub pa5)chen po'i sdom pa ni/ /de yi bla ma zhes su gsungs / /rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor las dkyil 'khor gyi brtag pa zhes bya 79—136

bsheste gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dam tshig chen po'i sgrub ③thabs so /glang po rta dang bong bu dang / /ba lang garnga mo dag dang ni/ /khyi yi sgron ma rab tu 'byung / /sgron ma chen mo rab tu bshad/ /'gro ba dga' bas gsalasnyibar byed/ /bya rog 'ug pa khra dang ni/ /chu skyar bya rgod lnga po yige/ /spos chen po ni rab tu bshad/ /spos su 'bul bar byed pa'o/ /'di rnams dbang du byed par 'gyur/ /sa gsum po ru rnam par spyod/ /cipo)srid sbyor ba tshogs pa yis/ /dngos grub thams cad byed pa'i mchog /bdud rtsi lnga ni rnam brjod pa/ /'chi med dngos po med pa'o/ /rtog pa med par bza' bar bya/ /blo ldan rang bzhin med pas so/ /sde tshan tha ma'i sngags btus te/ /bcu drug cha yis yang dag ldan/ / pra ṇasheb sbyor steng du steni/ /thig les gnonapo)cing brgyan 0pa yin / /dri zhes kun tu brjod pa yin/ /kun nas thugs kyi dkyilas/nya'akhor tshoge//nyi shu bdun pa 'og tu sbyin/ /sngags la sogs pas phye ba yin/ /spyi bo de ru yang dag sbyar/ /yi ge lha yi gzugs kyis lha ni/ /nyi shu rtsa drug yang ni sbyar/ /dbyangs yig gnyis pas brgyan 3nyepa yinas/ /nyi shu rtsa gsum yang ni blang / /'og gi char7ni sbyar bar bya/ /dbyangs kyi / tshogasum pa yang dag ldan/ /bzhi pas sbyar bar bya ba yin/ /de yi dbus su yang dag gsungs/ /yi ge dbang phyug gis ni brgyan(nye/ /bcu drug mtha' ni yang dag bshad/ /steng dang 'og tu khyab pa yin/ /de la dbus su yang dag gsungs/ /stong pa chen po'i yi ge ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' gzhig tu med/ /dag pa yi ni shel lta bur3rje/ /rdzas 'di 79—137

rnams ni bza' ba yin/ /rnal 'byor 'di rnams mchog yin te/ /rnal 'byor kun las mchog tu 'phags/ /khyod la mdo ru bsdus par bshad/ /bza' ba rnams ni yang dag brjod/ /gang gi rigs pas thams cad bza'/ /dngos po ro mnyam bsres nas ni/ /dag dang ma dag mi byed par/ /de bzhin nyid rnams thams cad dang / /bza' ba thams cad bza' bar bya/ /de nyid bcu yis rab dbye bas/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par grol/ /sbyin pa'i snying po sbyin par bya/ /sems kyis rnal 'byor rdzogs nas ni/ /thams cad rtswa sogs bzhin du btang ①/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi tshul khrims gyur/ /de nyid kun gyis mi 'jigs pa/ /skye bo thams cad 'tshe mi byed/ /dang por snying rje bla na med / /bzod pa tshul khrims bgegs med dang / /gzhan gyi gnod pa 'gegs mepa ste/ /gur dang phur bu dra ba dag /gdug pa'i bdud ni 'joms pa ste/ /bdud med 'chi ba med pa yin/ /bdag gi sems ni bcing bar bya/ /gang gis rang sems gdul5)ba yis/ /bdud kyis gnod〈pepa smos ci dgos/ /mnyam pa'i sems kyisadri yis ni/ zhagru bzhi pa ru yang dag bri/ /lus la ste'u dang tsan dan dang / /sems kyis mnyam par gnas ⑦pa na/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes brjod/ /dngos po bdag med bsresapo)pa ste/ /gang zhig rnal 'byor rgyal bar 'gyur/ /gang dag rnal 'byor ma yi ni/ /zhu ba rnams la za ba dag /de yis sa stengs (9)mtha' dag tu/ /rga dang na ba rnam par 'joms/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i〈 )kha sbyor las dam tshig chen po'i bdud rtsi lnga zhes bya ba'i brtag pa ste gsum pa'o// //79—138

de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sbyor ba dang po'i sgrub ༅thabs te / /sbyor ba rnam bzhir shes par bya/ /dam tshig bzhi ni bsgrubasrepa ste/ /dang po khu ba rnamasasheshes bya/ /gnyis pa de bzhin khrag nyid do/ /rdo rje chu dang dri chen niphyi//dam tshig bzhi ni bsten pa ste/ /'dod chags khu bar rnam par bshad/ /phrag dog khrag ni nyid dag go/ /gti mug rnam snang rgyal po ste/ /zhe sdang dri chur bcas pa yin/ /dam tshig bzhi yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /dam tshig bzhi la spyod pa posadu / /dang po7sbyor ba 'grub 'gyur zhing / /rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam 'gyur/ /bris sku gzhug pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dam tshig de nyidasnyebasgrub bya ste / /stongashepa'i rdo rje brjod bya ste/ /ye shes sems dpa' rnam par bsam/ /mdor bsdus pa ni sngags bzlas bya/ /hūm̐ dag 3 )sngags ni brjod par bya/ /dngos pos bsgom pas bsgomarwanyepar bya/ /spro dang sdud par byed pa'o /ge/ /bdud bzhi gzhan las rgyal ba hu yi/ /go cha mtshon cha 'di yis bcing ra ba phur bu gur sogs kyis/ /phyogs bzhi la sogs bcing bar bya/ /khams bzhi por ni yang dag 'byung / /bdud bzhi po ni rnam par brjod/ /bad kun sha dang rkang dag dang / /rus pa'i khams la yang dag 'byung / /spyanasadang bdag ma sgrol ma dang / /gos dkar la sogs bzhi pa'osko/ /khams bzhi dag ni rnam dgatshwanyepa/ /sbyor ba dang por brjod pa'o/ /brtson chen zhes su rnam bshad pa/ /rlung dang me ni mchog yin te/ /de la dbus su yang dag gnas/ / dzā ta ri yi hunyerang bzhin mings/she/ /dbyibs dang kha dog sna tshogs pa/ /kha dog med par rab tu grags/ /dbyangs dang yi ge'i tshul dag tu/ /dbyangs med yi ge med pa'o/ /tshangs min khyab 'jug drag po min/ /nam mkha' min zhing 79wa 139

'dod pa min①/ /zla ba min zhing skar ma min/ /nyi ma min zhing rlung yang min//gnod sbyin srin po lha min min②/ /'byung po yi dgas7nyid min cing / /snod dang bcud ni sna tshogs dang / /khams gsum po ni ma lus la/ /bdag nyid chen po de yis khyab/ /bems po nyid la yid kyis rtogs/ /de nyid 'jig rten pa ru 'gyur/ /tshangs pa khyabasre'ajug dbang phyug che/ /zla ba gza'aphurin skar ma lha/ /de nyid thams cad bde ba che/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa rnam snang mdzad/ /pad+ma nyi ma khrag 'thung rtasti/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor pho nya mo/ /de nyid rdo rje bde chen pome/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /de bzhin pad+ma pad+ma 'dzin/ /nor bu nor bu 'dzin pa nyid/ /rigs 'di rnams su bsgyur ba'o/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor bri ba nyid/ /rdul tshon7kha dog lnga pa'o/ /de nyid sngags su rab tu bya/ /hūṃ r+ghaṃ phaṭa kyi yi ge nyid/ /dmyal ba dud7'gro yi dgas dang / /lha dang mi dang lha min dang / /rmongs 31pa'i sems su gyur pa yis/ /'khor ba 'di ru 'khor bar nyunya'agyur/ /rnal 'byor chen po mdor bsdus pa/ /rdo rje can la gnas pa'o/ /lha mo chen mo slar yang dritu / /'gro dang 'ong ba ji ltar 'gyur/ /gnas nas 'di yi sems dag ni/ /skye ba ji ltar brjod pa yin/ /khu ba ji ltar gzugs su 'gyur/ /skye bo'i skye ba ji ltar yin/ /de yi gzugs kyi skye mal ni / /khrag las 7ji ltar 'byung ba lags/ /'byung ba rnams kyi 'byung ba ci/ /de yi skye ba ji ltar lags/ /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' nyid dang ni/ /skye gnas kun la chags pa ni/ /dngos po rnam pa ji ltar khyab / /zhi ba'i gzugs ni ji ltar yin/ /thams cad du ni ji ltar skye/ /'di rnams yang dag bshad pa ni/ /lha mo bden par bdag la gsungs/ /ji ltar 79—140

de bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /sems can kun gyi skyed7pa dag /'khor bar yang dag bsrubs pa las/ / ding 'dir gethabs kyis 'di 'gyur ro/ /thog ma tha ma med dus su/ /sems can thams cad yang dag 'byung / /rgya mtsho 'khrugs sogs gting gi bar/ /blo gros chen po bsrubs rapa yin/ /de las de dag skye bar 'gyur/ /sa yi khams dang yang dag ldan/ /me yis mnyam par nges par bsrubs / /chu dang rlung gisabye brag dud go/ /yid kyis 6de ru rab zhen pa/ /mngal ni bzung ④zhing blangs pa ste/ /de ni 'khor bar 'khor bar 'gyur/ / dga' bsamya ngan ldan pa ste/ /de las 'byung bar 'gyur ba ni/ /so sor skye ba smra ba ste/ /de bzhin chos dag zab mo nyid/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis sangs rgyas brjod/ /de nyid 'di rnams mnyam bshad pa/ /sum cu ri9)pa ste rnyed par dka' / /rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i 7kha sbyor las de kho na nyid kyi 31man ngag sbyor ba bzhi'i cha zhes bya ba ste brtag pa bzhi pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /sbyin sreg 32las ni rab tu bsgrub32/ /sbyin sregatsornam pa gnyis su gsungs/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ /phyi ru ji ltar gsungs pa lags/ /nang du yang ni ji kyi ltar 'gyur/ /nyon cig rdo rje nang gi ni/ /ji bzhin sbyin sreg mirab bsgrub nyi bya/ /me chen po dag rab tu sbaratso / /rnam rtog med pa'i sbyin sreg 37bya/ /bza' ba ri )btung ba gang yang rung ske/ /de ru thams cad sbyin sreg tsho 1bya/ /sreg ni rdzas rang bzhin gsungs pa dag /gzugs phung la sogs lnga po dag /rnam rtog med pa'i sbyin sreg (nyebya/ /de dag thams cad sems las byung / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /dri chen dri 79—141

chu lnga po dag /rnam rtog med par bza' bar bya/ /blo ldan rang bzhin med pas so/ /gti mug nga rgyal de bzhin chags/ /zhe snang de bzhin 'dod chags nyid / /phrag dog ser sna phra 0)ma dag /dam tshig de nyid dri ma med/ /ji ltar nyi ma 'bar ba bzhin/ /de ltar dri ma med par 'gyur/ /ji ltar ston gyi zla gsal ba/ /de ltar 'di yi dbus gsal yin/ /'dod chags chen por 'gyur ba yin/ /rdo rje snang byed (misgron ma bzhin②/ /de nyid thar par gsungs pa ste/ /bla med go 'phang ④thob par 'gyur/ /sbyin sreg ⑤'di la rab gnas na/ /lha rnams dga' bas tshim pa yin/ /sbyin sreg 0las ni rab gsungs nas/ /rab gnas dag ni brjod par bya/ /sngon gyi rnal 'byor la gnas nas/ /de nas rab gnas bya ba ste/ /rab gnas sku sogs thang ka dang / /rnal 'byor can gyis cigeglegs bam ste/ /dpal ldan g.yon gyis ⑧dril bu 'dzin/ /g.yas kyis ⑨rdo rje yongs su gzung ⑩/ /don kun rnal 'byor kun gyis ni/ /mdzes par sku gzugs mchod par bya/ /sha hu)dang chang dag rab tu bkang / /ro yi steng du yang dag gnas/ /par pa ṭi kā shaṃ ku 8mi/ /mchod pa kun gyis dgyes par bya / /me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri nyid dang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /glu dbyangs de bzhin gar dag dang / /sgrub pos pa ṭa rtso)ha sogs te/ /sku la sogs pa 'di rnams la/ /rab gnas chen po bya ba yin/ / ya dzi yaṃ ho ya i e / /dze idz+dza i mā a sum̐/ /mā a zhi mā a dha m+mu pā/ /pidz+dza i tsit+ta yaṃ mu/ /tsisnyi dz+dza i sa e la/ /sa:zu ki ri mdza i/ /glu 'di dag 7ni blangs pa yis/ /dbang rnams kun kyang blang ba ste/ /chos rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gzhi/ /mchod pa kun gyi sprin chen mo0/ /spro zhing 79—142

bsdu bar brjod pa'o/ /nga yis rab gnas bshad pa ni/ /rgyud gzhan las ni7)rnyed par dka'/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i nakha sbyor las sbyin sreg rab gnas kyi brtag pa ste lnga pa'o// //de nas mdor bsdus rab bshad pa/ /de nyid gtan la dbab pa'i mchog /rtag tu sems ni rnam rtog med/ /rnam rtog bcas pas ci ltar 'gyur/ /ciskogiriltar me dag rab 'bar ba/ /rtag tu shing rnams tshig par brjod/ /de la tshig pa shing rnams te/ /'di yis tshig par mthong ba yin / /de yis tshig pa ji bzhin du/ /blo ldan rnam rtog med pa yis/ /phung po lnga yi shing rnams te/ /de bzhin gzugs kyi phung po nyid/ /rus pa rkang dang bad kun dang / /khrag dang khu ba dri chen dag /mig gnyis de bzhin rna ba dang / /de bzhin du ni sna nyid dang ske/ /sa dang chu dang de bzhin me/ /rlung dang nam mkha' nyid dag dang / /'byung ba lnga po thams cad la/ /de nyid nyi shu rtsa lnga dag /de yi gnas ni bye brag tu/ /nga ⑥yis bye brag brjod pa ste/ /lte bar gnas pa'i 'khor lo chos/ /'dabamadzom drug cu gsabazhi dang ldan/ /shes rab gnas su rab tu gsungasashi / /zla ba'i gzugs bzhin gsal ba ste/ /de yi 1 dbus su gnas pa dganyu1 /me lta nyu2bur ni 'bar ba yin/ /me chen de 1lhani 'bar ba ste/ /de yi rtse mo mthong ba ni/ /de yis 8de ni gzugs mthong yin/ /dngos po thams cad gzugs 'dzin pa/ / blo yi 8gnas su gsungs shing brjod/ /rtsu yig nga ro tshul 'dzin pa/ /rdo rje can ni rtag tu 'byung / /rdo rje 'dzin chen gzugs bzhin nos/ /rlung gis bskyod pa me7)yin te/ /de yi dbus su rab tu grags/ /gang zhig ri bong 3879—143

can gzugs gsungs/ /shes rab de nyidatumador bsdus so/ /ji ltar nyi mar rab tu brjod/ /rdo rje 'dzin dang bcas par 'gyur/ /sde tshan brgyad kyi7tha ma gzugs / /thig le dang ni zhabs kyur gebacas/ /de nyid nyi ma zhes su gsungs / /'od zer 'bar ba'i phreng ba can/ /de yi dbus su yang dag 'byung ske/ /rdo rje can gnas mnyam par 'gyur/ /ji ltar gnyid kyis gzung ba ni3)ske/ /cung zad kyang ni mthong ba med/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i gzung7ba dag /langs na rtag tu mthong ba yin/ /de ru thabs ni bsgom pa yin⑦/ /de yi rang bzhin mchog tu grags/ /sems can thogs med bde chen brjod/ /de ru der gnas dngos po yis/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa gsal/ /de phyir de nyid dngos po yis/ /blo ldan sems kyisasnyide nyid gsungasaskyu/ /sems ni rnam par dag pa ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyam par 'gyur/ /sngags pa gar 'dod 'gro ba yin/ /skad cig gis ni gnas par 'gro/ /'dod chen rnams ni chags par 'gyur/ /drag po rnams la drag po mtshon/ /zhi ba rnams la zhi ba ste / /'di ni mdun rgyab rgyal ba ri4sto/ /ji ltar 'di ru pad+ma rim/ /'dod chags skyon gyis gos mi 'gyur/ /sna tshogs bag chagasaspyo skyon mi chags/ /khams gsum po ni de bzhin dag /stong pa ma yin mi stong min/ /dbu ma nye bar thob pa'o/ /shes rab pha rol phyin rnal 'byor/ /thabs ni snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ /'di ni byang chub sems rdo rje/ /sems dang sems byung rang bzhin gyis/ /dngos po med par sgomamugepa'i dngos/ /de la bsgom7par brjod pa min8/ /phreng ba med cing bya ba med/ / spungs pa7med par brjod pa ste/ /rnal 'byor 'di la gnas pa ni/ /dbu ma'i mchog gi go 'phang ngo / /79—144

bla na med pa'i ye shes ni/ /bla med zhes7ni rim pa med/ /'dis ni 'khor ba rnam par grol/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i go 'phang mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes su gsungs/ /de yis rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub/ /skye ba 'di la grub50pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam 'gyur/ /khrag dang khu ba bza' ba ste/ /dri chen dri chu sha dang lnga/ /de yi tshe ni rgyas par 'gro/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam 'gyur/ /ba jukhubi ha rtsu kā ra ga ti ba hūṃ bi ha/ rū pa dhā ri ṇi ba rtsu bi dha nā nā rardzi ha/ ba hū bi ha bṛ t+ya gī tar+ya/ ba hu bi ha dzi ba san+ta t+ya she/ ṣaḥni she ṣa sa twa bi na ya bi distan sa ma ra stu bi shurnye haḥhaḥhaḥhaḥhoḥ/ a hai sasba re sidzha ma hūm̐ a ho/ sum̐ ha hūm̐ re u pa rū a la la la la hoḥ(33/ glu 'di dag ni blangs pa ste/ /brtag pa kun gyi bla na med/ /de yi tshe ni pa rgyas par 'gro/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang mnyam 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i56)kha sbyor las de kho na nyid gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba ste 7 brtag pa rin)drug pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /de nyid rnal 'byor thams cad ni/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims brtson de bzhinaspyo / /bsam gtan bzod pa shes rab dang / /stobs dang de bzhin thabs dang ni/ /smon lam ye shes yang dag 'byung / /pha rol phyin pa bcu rdzogs pa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yinya sna/ /sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi ru gsungs/ /tshul khrims gsum gyi ngo bo nyid/ /bsam gtan rnam bzhir gsungs pa ste/ /brtson 'grus rnam pa lnga ru 'gyur/ /bzod pa rnam pa bcur shes bya/ /shes rab rnam pa drug tu 'gyur/ /stobs ni rnam bcu rab tu gsungs/ /thabs ni rnam pa lngar 'gyur te/ /smon lam gnyis su shes 79—145

bya ste/ /ye shes rnam lngar gnas pa'o/ /chos dang mi 'jigs rdzas dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam pa bzhi po ni/ /sbyin pa'i pha rolatuphyin pa'o/ /ngar7'dzin med cing khengs pa bral/ /bden pa gnyis med gnas pa ni/ /tshul khrims rnamakhugasum brjodaspogepa ni/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin par gsungs/ /gang gis rnal 'byor ma gnyis dang / /phyi yi rnam pa gnyis su gsungs/ /bsam gtan pha rol phyin pa ni/ /dri chen dri chu de bzhin sha /khrag⑧dang khu bar yangasnyedag 'byung ske/ /'di rnams brtson 'grus lnga po ni/ /dam tshig sgra yis brjod pa'o/ /tshig rtsub brdzun medang ngag 'khyal dang / /chags sdang zhe sdang phrag dog dang / /nga rgyal khro dang de bzhin dbyen/ /'di bcu5kyernam par bshad pa ni/ /rdo rje can ni bzod bcas 'gyur/ /yang dag lta ba yang dag rtog /yang dag ngag dang yang dag las/ /yang dgayo)'tshomatshadang yang dag rtsol/ /bdag gis mdo ru bsdus nas ni/ /shes rab rnam pa drug tu brjod/ /dadamo/spepa'i stobs dang dran pa'i stobs/ /ting 'dzin stobs dang shes rab stobs/ /lus kyi stobs dang ngag gi stobs/ /ye shes stobs dang smon lam stobs/ /brtson 'grus kyi 8ni stobs rnams te/ /'di rnams stobs ni bcu pa'o/ /ma skyes pa yi hustedage ba bskyedanya ri / /skyes pa'i mi dge yang dag spong / /mi dge ma skyes mi skyedamugedang / /dge ba skyes pa mi'aphel ba ste/ / bzhi po hu rmethams cad chos rnams kyi/ /dge ba'i chos rnams gsungs pa ni/ /rdzogs par byed pa nyid dag go/ /smon lam rnam pa gnyis su gnas/ /me long mnyam nyid so sor 32rtog /bya grub chos dbyings rnam par dag /ye shes rnam pa lnga ru 'gyur/ /'di rnams bcu bzhi po dag ni/ /pha rol phyin pa mdor bsdus pa/ /bdag gis de nyid brjod pa 79—146

ste / /rdor can nyon cig gtan la dbab/ /bcu gnyis mtha' dang dgu ①yi mtha' / /mgo nas rkang pa'i mthil bar du/ /de yi dbus su nges (kye'agyur ba/ /lte ba'i dbus su rnam par gnas/ /rtag tu shar bar (5)'gyur ba ste / /'di ru rdo rje can gyis mthong / /lus ngag sems kyi 94nadabus dag tu/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'bar ba'o/ /steng gi sgo ru rtag gnas pa'o/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer ⑤phreng ba can/ /cung zad lus las mthong ba med/ /mgal ⑥me'i 'khor lo'i gzugs can te/ /de nyid rnal 'byor lam gyis ni/ /rtag pa'i dus su rnam par gnas/ /de la rdzidabyar gyi dus med cing / /dpyid med ston yang yod ma yin/ /dgun med sos kyang med pa ru/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rtag tu bsgomadu / /sngags pas seng ge bzhin du spyod/ /sngags dang rgyud la ji ltar gnas / /nya dang sha ni bza' spubar bya/ /chang gi btung ba mchog yin no/ /bcud kyis ⑩len gyi cho ga yis/ /sngags ni brjod par kyilhami bya'o/ /mtshon cha'i gnas la dus rtag tu/ /mtshon bya'i mtshan nyid mtshon par bya/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces gsungs pa la 'khor lha dang mi dang lha ma yin r+sha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi 3nyerangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i kha sbyor zhes bya ba rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po rdzogs sobu // //dpal ornan nas 3lhanges par 'byung ba'i rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud chen po stong phrag bcu gnyis pa las tso'ajig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgyal po chen po ⑩dpal in+d+ra khyu hu ti'i zhabs kyis bkol pocing gsal bar mdzad pa'o/ /79—147

bod kyi lots+tsha ①ba la chings yon tan 'bar gyis bsgyur te/ slad kyis de nyid kyi ②ce5 paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis 'o/ pa5nga ②ga/sprugs te gtan 95 phab paX//bsdur ma na/129 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i
