phyinyenang gnyis ku'i sems la sems kyisarjes su lta7zhing gnas pa'i phyir yang dag par rab tu shes te/ ma rig pa la sogs pas yid gnyis su gyur pa'i 'dul ba'i 'jig rtenasnyil dran pa dang ldan pa'o/ /'di rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'o/ /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi skyedam3)pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyed7do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'jogashego/ /smon lam yang dag par 'debs so/ /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spang ba'i phyir 'dun pa skyed do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'jogashego/ /smon lam yang dag par 'debs so/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyedapo)do/ / 'bad do / /⑩brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'jog 31go/ /smon lam yang dag par 'debs so/ /de ltar dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams gnas par bya ba'i phyir thabs tshad med pa 8bsgoms pas yongs su gang ba'i phyir yongs su gang bar gyur pas bsgom pa dam pa 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir 'dun pa skyedatsha/nyedo/ /'bad do / /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'jogatsogo/ /smon lam yang dag par 'debs so/ /'di rnams ni yang dag par spong ba bzhi'o/ /'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom par bya ste/ bye brag phyed pas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / rnam par byang bar gyur pas bdag gi 'dun pa nub par 'gyur zhing shin tu rab tu 'jog pa ma yin pa'o8/ /brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom par bya ste/ bye brag phyed pas nges par 'byung ba 79—223

dang ske/ 'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / rnam par byang bar ti)gyur pas bdag gi brtson 'grus nub par 'gyur zhing shin tu rab tu rina'ajog pa ma yin pa'o/ /dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom par bya ste/bye brag phyed pas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / rnam par byang bar ri gyur pas bdag gi dpyod pa nub par 'gyur ④zhing shin tu rab tu 'jog pa ma yin pa'o/ /sems kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom par bya ste/ bye brag phyed pas nges par 'byung ba dang /'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / rnam par byang bas snyebadag gi sems nub par 'gyur zhing shin tu rab tu 'jog pa ma yin pa'o/ /'di rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ste/'dod par spyod nepa dang bcas pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba la dad par byed de/ rang gi las kyi rnam par smin pa la so sor yid ches par gyur pa 7gang zhig de ltar las byed par 'gyur ba dge ba'am sdig pa de dang de'i las kyi rnam par smin pa so sor nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir de ni 'tsho ba'i rgyur yang sdig pa'i las mngon par ci 'du mi byed pa'o/ /'di ni dad pa'i dbang por gsungs so/ /gang zhig chos rnams la dad pa'i dbang pos dad she par byed pa'i chos rnams la brtson 'grus kyi dbang pos shes par byed do/ /'di ni brtson 'grus kyi dbang por gsungs so/ /gang zhig chos rnams la brtson 'grus kyi dbang pos shes pa de'i nyu chos rnams ni dran pa'i dbang pos rab tu 79wa 224

'jog par mi byed pa'o17/ /'di ni dran pa'i dbang por 5)gsungs so/ /gang zhig chos rnams la dran pa'i dbang pos /norab tu 'jig par mi byed pa de'i chos rnams ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang pos rtse gcig tu byed pa'o/ /'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang por gsungs so/ /gang zhig chos rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang pos rtse gcig tu byed pa de'i chos rnams ni shes rab kyi dbang pos so sor rig pa ste/ de ni chos de dang de rnams la so sor rtog pa skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'di ni shes rab kyi dbang por gsungs so/ /dbang po lnga po 'di rnams 'phel ba ni stobs lnga ru 'gyur te/ dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang ske/ dran pa'i stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs te/ 'di rnams ni stobs lnga'o/ /de la byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang ske/ shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ste/ bye braga' phyed pas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang bral ba'i 5 kun nas rnam par byang bar gyur pa dang 96ci/chos rab tu 'byed pa ni byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la sogs pa bsgom pa'o/ /de la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ni gang zhig 'jig rten las 'das pa ste/ bdag tu lta bas kun nas bslang ba ma 79—225

yin pa dang / sems can med pa dang / 'tsho ba med pa dang / gso ba med pa dang / skyes bu med pa dang / gang zag med pa dang / shed las skyes med pa dang / shed bu med pa dang / byed pa po med pa dang / tshor ba po med pa'i lta bas kun nas bslang ba chad pa ma yin pa dang / rtag par lta bas kun nas ①bslang ba ma yin pa dang / srid pa dngakhubral ba'i lta bas kun nas bslang ba dang / rigs su lung bstan pa'i lta bas7kun nas bslang ba dang /ji srid 'khor ba ma yin zhing mya ngan las 'das pa'i yang masayin pa'i lta bas kun nas sa)bslang ba ste/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i lta bar gsungs so/ /gang zhig yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug dang /nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ba'i rtog pa de ni yang dag pa'i rtog par mi 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa gang zhig tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grolatsha༅ba dang / rnam par grolasheba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung pos kun nasalosaslong ba de'i yang dag pa'i rtog pa de ni yang dag pa'i rtog par 'gyur te/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i rtog par gsungs so/ /gang zhig tshig gis bdag la gdung bar mi bya zhing gzhan la gdung bar mi bya ba dang ske/ bdag la nyon mongs par 59)mi bya zhing gzhan dag la nyon mongs par mi bya ba dang / bdag la mi dpya /7zhing gzhan dag la yang dpya〈rnyebar mi bya ba ste / de mnyam par gzhag /nyepa dang ldan pas tshig dang ldan par 'gyur zhing /gang gis tshig gis yang dag pa'i 'phags par 'jug par 'gyur ba 'di ni yang dag pa'i ngag ces gsungs so/ /gang zhig las nag po dang nag po'i rnam par smin pa de'i las mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang / gang zhig las dkar ba dang 79wa 226

dkar po'i rnam par smin pa de'i las mngon par 'du nya)byed pa dang / gang zhig las dkar po dang / nag po'i rnam par smin pa de'i las mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang / gang zhig las dkar po dang / nag po dang / dkar po'i rnam par smin pa dang / nag po zad pa'i bsam pas gnas pa de'i las mngon par 'du byed de/ dam pa'i las lta bur 'gyur ba ni yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' stekhya/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i las kyi mthar gsungs so/ /(shegang gi tshe 'phags pa lta bur dul ba dang / yon tan yang dag pa'i chas ca)zhum zhing dul ba dang / kha gsag med pa dang / mang du smra ba ma yin pa dang / gtam la mi dga' ba dang / rang gi spyod pa'i tshul 5)khrims dang / 'jig rten pha rol gyi dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang / bdag gi rnyed pa kha na ma tho ba med pas bdag chog par 'dzin pa dang / 'phags pa'i bka'i 7gnang bas 'tsho ba ste/'di ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho bar gsungs so/ /rtsol ba ni gang zhig brdzun57tshodang /'phags pas ma gnang ba dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nyon mongs pa rjes su bsten 87par mi 'dod pa ni rtsol ba ste/rtsol ba gang zhig yang dag pa'i 'phags pa'i lam gyi bden par 'jug cing mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba dang / so so'i gnas su skyed par byed pa de ni rtsol bar ⑨yang dag par rjes su 'brang ba ste/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i rtsol bar gsungs so/ /gang la nye bar gnas pa de ni rab tu mi g.yo ba dang / lus drang pos kyog po ma yin pa dang / 'khor ba'i skyon sna tshogs la sogs pa dbang du byed pa ston cing / mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas 'dod pa'i dran pa ni mi brjedarwa1pa ste/rte/ 'di ni 'phags pa'i yang dag pa'i lam la sbyor 32ba'o /79wa 227

'di ni yang dag pa'i dran par gsungs so/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni ting nge 'dzin gang la gnas nas sems can thams cad rnam par thar bar bya ba'i phyir yang dag par gnas te/ mya ngan las 'das pa mnan pa'o/ /'dis ni yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes7gsungs so/ /de nyid yang dag bshad pa ni / /dga' ba la sogs sa tshos)rnams te/ /dbang po la sogs rang bzhin gyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas/ /phung po la sogs khyad par gyi②/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni mchog tu 'bab/ /byang sems sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /gang tshe 'dir ni gang gyur pa/ /dbang po phung po 'byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas de yi de ma thag /rang lus nyid la sangs rgyas nyid/ /gzhan ni5gegang du'ang mi gnas so/ /lus las gzhan du sangs rgyas nyid/ /mi shes pa yis bsgribs par brjod/ /ye shes chen po rang lus gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs / /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus la ma skyes pa'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ lus la rtsa du lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'khor lo bzhi yi rab dbye bas/ /brgya phrag gcig dang nyi shu lhag /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /rtsa rnams sum cu rtsa gnyis mchog /gsungs pa/ 'di lta ste/ mi phyed ri ma zhes brjod pa dang / phra gzugs ma dang /rtse neb ma dang / g.yon pa ma dang / thung ngu ma dang / rus 50sbal skyes ma dang ske/ sgom pa ma dang / dbang ma dang / skyon ma dang / 'jug ma dang /ma mo dang / mtshan mo dang / bsil57sbyin ma dang / tsha ba ma dang / brkyang rigem dang / ro ma dang / kun 'dar kyi rim dang / 'bab ma dang / rangs ma 79wa 228

dang ske/ mdog ma dang / gzugs can ma dang / spyi ma dang / rgyuphakye7sbyin ma dang ske/ sbyor bral ma dang / sdug migu ma dang / grub ma dang / 'tshed mar+sā dang ske/ de bzhin du yid bzang ma dang / sum 9)skor ma dang / 'dod ma dang /khyim ma dang / gtum mo dang / bdud 'dral zhesima'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rtsa 'di dag ji lta bu lags/ srid gsum yongs su gyur pa ste/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa thams cad yongs su spangs pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang /yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ba'i dang / dbang po lnga dang ske/ stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i mthar thug pa la sogs pa'i rnam par 'grel765pa byang chub kyi sems 'jug pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas bcom ldan 'das la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bla med pa⑦ / /snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab par mkhyen nas/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po ye shes mar me rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugasashete/ rgyud thams cad kyi gsang ba 'di bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba mchog gitsodagyes pa nanya / /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /'di ni bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /brtan 37pa rtag pa 12mchog tu yang / /yid srub nyurnyeso sor skyes pa nyid/ /rtag tu rang bzhin mnan 1 dka' ba/ /sna tshogs las 79wa 229

kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /sna tshogs cho ga 'dod pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin sogs rnams/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs brtan dang g.yo/ /thams cad dngos po srid pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi0)dra bskrubasdom/ /'dis ni sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /thams cad las ni sna tshogs mchog /sangs rgyas sogs pas 'dul ba'i phyir/ /dngos grub sems can⑧kun don mchog /rang gi ngo bos yongasalasabasgyur bas/ /bud med sgyu ma thams cad 'grub/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes kla klo'i skad/ /ḍi be+e hā ya sar 'gro bar/ /skad dbyings 'di ni rnam par brtag /nam mkha' kun tu spyod 'grub pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /kun nas sna tshogs phyag rgya ste/ /kun las sna tshogs sdom pa'o/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /pad+ma de bzhin pad+ma 'dzin/ /nor bu nor bu 'dzin pa nyid/ /'di rnams kyi ni rigs rnams yin/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa rdul dang bral ba'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di bka' stsal pa/ stong min stong pa min pa'ang min/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /thabs ni snying rje'i bdag nyid de//de nas mdzes pa'i snying rje thabs/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gsal ba/ /rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams la/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa'ang med/ /rnam rtog med pas rtag mos pas/ /brtag pa kun gyis brtag par bya/ /rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams la/ /sems can don ni yongs su brtag /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag chos/ /chos can med cing chos nyid med/ /sgra brnyan 79—230

lta bur mnyam pa nyid/ /de nas 'di ni chos dag 'byung / /de nas theg pa chen po las byung ba'i bsgom pas yon tan rgyas pa rnams kyis dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis yang dag par bstod pa / rnal 'byor gyi bdag po sems can grol bar mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can bdag nyid skyes pa gcig par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i gti mug gcod par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /de kho na nyid0)thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu ston par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal te/ bdag rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo yang mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /chos rnams thams cad gcig pa'i sku'i/ /snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / dbang po rigang dang gang lam nyid/ /de dang de yi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtag par shin tu mnyam gzhag nyid/ /gang phyir thams cad bdag nyid kyi/ /rnam shes phung por gnas pa ni/ /skyes bu tha mal sems rmongs pa/ /la las so sor rtog mi nus/ /sems dang sems byung sems kyi 'dangos/ /ye shes shes bya rang bzhin can/ /'bras bu rnams la byed pa nyid/ /chos dang chos can sgom pa nyid / /gang phyir chos ni du mas ni/ /chu bo'i rgyun ni rgya mtsho ltar/ /thar pa nyid ni gcig pu yin/ /mang po dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar nang du rnamakhuganas pa/ /bla ma'i zhal lasamanyarnyed par 'gyur/ /de kho na nyid mdor bstan pa ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //79—231

de nas rgyud rnams thams cad du/ /gtan la phab pa rab bshad bya/ /sems can kun la mnyam pa'i phyir/ /grusanyu1gsum rgya che'i gzugs can nyid/ /tshangs sogs lha dang lha min bcas/ /de rnams kyi ni gnas su 'gyur/ /de nyid shes rab pha rol phyin/ /kun rdzob rnam pa'i gzugs can ma/ /de nyid yul las rnam par 'das/ /srog chags kun gyi snying la gnas/ /de phyir de rgyasam ci zhig bya/ /mdor bsdus pas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med pas/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas gang thob pa/ /gang gis dam pa'i bde bas khyod/ /skye ba 'dir ni thob par 'gyur/ /yang na rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /yang na riga'akhor los sgyur nga ba 'am/ /'dis ni dngos grub chen po brgyad/ /gzhan yang yid zil 'dod pa yang zhi / /gti mug chags dang nga rgyal dang / /phrag dog dang ni nyon mongs lngas/ /sems can so sor bcings pa gang / /rang gi yan lag nyid kyis 'joms༄8)/ /'dis ni 'gro drug sems can bcings//'khor bar 'khor zhing skye ba nyid/ /nyon mongs pas ni rmongasamanyu)gyur pas/ /sdig pa du ma byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di bcom cang 3 )mkhyen nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis sprul rigs pas ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung 11ba yi/ /sbyor bral sdug bsngal mthong nas ni/ /thabs dang shes rab sprul pa'i rgyus/ /nyon mongs rnams ni yid ches 32'gyur/ /mtshon pa 'di ni 'bras bur gyur/ /khams gsum du ni dri med snang / /gang dang gang gis gnas gyur pa/ /de ni de yi ngo bo can/ /bud shing bsregs pa'i rigs /lhags ni/ /dgyes pa'i rgyal ba gar mkhan mchog /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /'di nyid rnam dag mtshon pa 'dimi/ /ji ltar dgra bo nus pa la/ /dgra bo nus pas de bsnun pa/ /79wa 232

gti mug dag pas gti mug ste/ /zhe sdang dag pas zhe snang nyid/ /'dod chags dag pas 'dod chags te/ /nga rgyal rnam dag nga rgyal che/ /phrag dog dag pas phrag dog nyid1)/ /thams cad rnam dag rdor 'dzin mgon/ /de yi ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /nyon mongs lnga ni mnyam tshon)par 'gyur/ /de ltar rigs ni lnga rnams dang / /ye shes lnga dang sangs rgyas lnga/ /'di las rdo rje snying po dang / /khro bo khams gsum sems can skye/ /nang gi dbye ba 'di nyid ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las rnyed par 'gyur/ /bla ma dman pa'i sems can rnams/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rnyed mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig shin tu gsal bsalani/ /'dzam gling de 'dir sangs rgyas bsngags/ /gru gsum dag pa e yi dbyibs/ /dbus su dgyes pa'i e baṃ yin/ /gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar/ /rdo rje ra li rnam par byung ske/ /btsun mo'i bha ga zhes kyang bya/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes byar bshad//de yi nang song padra༄ni/ /'dab snim brgyad pa snying por bcas/ /de la ā li kā li 'dres/ /sde tshan brgyad ni rnam par gnas/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyis ⑥lus can gyi/ /las kyi tshogs ni byed par 'gyur/ /yi ge rnams ni lnga bcu nyid / /rig byed rnams la nye bar gnas/ /sngags rnams nyid dang rgyud rnams dang ske/ /phyi rol tshul gyi ri bstan bcos kyi/ /rdo rje snying po'i rang bzhin 'di/ /gzhan du 'di ⑧las cung zad med/ /a ka tsa ṭa ta she)pa ya sha /sde tshan dga' ba lnga bcu yang / /mnyam pa dag tu sprul pa rnams/ /rdo rje ra li pad+mar nyi rison/ /'dab 37ma brgyad po phyogs rnams dang / /mtshams rnams su ni 'di rnams rigs / /de rnams dbus su ze 'bru la/ /dam pa'i dbang phyug ma yod do32/ /sde tshan brgyad po rnams kyis ni/ /yi ge dam pa yongs su bskor/ /a 1 ni yig 79wa 233

'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen sde tshan gtso bo ni/ /lus can rnams kyi sngags kun ni/ /'di0)nyid las ni yang dag byungashe/ /gang zhig ral gli⑧mig sman dang / /rkang byug ril bu rkang 'og dang / /gnod sbyin mo yisnyiyan lag ma/ /'jig rten gsum gyi khongs su rgyu⑥/ /dngul chu'i 'gro bas rjes su 'brangashe/ /gang zhig thams cadasnyemathu che ba/ /rang gi khyim du lnga bcu 'dod pa dang ldan par 'grub bo/ /de ni sde tshan brgyad nang son/ /dbyangs mchog sde tshan bdag nyid 'byin/ /skye bo rnams kyi tshig rgyas pa/ /gang zhig cung zad rtogs bya ba/ /de kun sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni/ /de phyir rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /lus can rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sgra ni sngags zhes brjod par bya/ /sna tshogs mdud pa'i gnas chen las/ /chos kyi ra li rnam par 'byung / /dngos grub rdzu 'phrul rnam gnas pa'i/ /sngags dang nges pa gang yang med/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma skyes pa'i/ /sngags kyi yig 'bru dbang phyug mchog /yang dag sbyor byung hunyematshan nyid ni/ /de nas mchog tu rab bshad bya/ /e ni sa ru shes par bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya spyan ma nyid/ /snying rje chen mo thabs chen mo/ /rang bzhin sna tshogs spyod yul ma/ /lte bar sna tshogs 'dam skyes la/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor rnam par gnas/ /rba ni chu ru shes par bya/ /chos kyi phyag rgya mā ma tī/ /byams pa dang ni smon lam tshul/ /lha mo rdo rje'i rigs gtso mnya/ /snying gar0)chu skyes 'dabasto9brgyad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lor7yang dag gnas/ /ma ni me tsoru brjod pa ste/ /phyag rgya chen mo gos dkar mo/ /dga' dang stobs kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /lha mo pad+ma'i rigs byung ma/ /lkog mar tunyechu skyes 'dabatsobargyad gnyis/ /longs spyod 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /yā 3ceni rlung gi rang 79—234

bzhin te/ /nyon mongs thams cad rab 'joms byed/ /dam tshig phyag rgya chen mor nges①/ /lha mo las kyi rigs gtso ma/ /btang snyoms ye shes rnal 'byor gyis/ /sgrol ma 'khor ba sgrol ba mo/ /'dam7skyes 'dabalam sum cu gnyis/ /bde chen 'khor lo chen por gnas/ /ye〈peni shes rab brjod par bya/ /baṃ ni thabs dang ldan pa nyid/ /baṃ gisar rnam par brgyanar+sā)pa57nyid/ /e ni nges par mdzes par 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyis/ /steng dang 'og tu snyoms par 'jug /e nyid dngatshasheni baṃ nyid dag /gnyis gnyis su ni brjod pa nyid/ /'di skad ces bya ba'i tshig gi phrad ni de skad ces gsungs nas zhes bya ba'i mthar thug pa'i rgyud kyi tshogs la bsnyegs so zhes brjod do/ /bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba ni de skad du 'dod chags chen po 'di la rtag tu gnas pa'o/ /shu zhes bya bas7ni 'dzag par gsungs so/ /ta zhes bya ba ni gang yang bde ba chen po'i mgon po'o/ /bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyis thos pa'i phyir rna ba'i ye shes kyis thos pa yin gyi/ rtogs5nyepa ni ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das mitsha/)rtogs pa'i skyon gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis7bka' stsal pa/ /sdud par byed pa dang 'chad pa po midag dbyer med par 'gyur ro/ /yang na rtogs pa nyid ni gdul bya'i skye bo'i dbang du byas nas 'chad pa po nyid sdud par byed pa yin te/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa ngatso/ /de dag ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ /gang du bde ba chen po'i mgon po gar mdzad pa'i tshe/ gcig nyid nya mogacig dang du ma'i ro zhes bya ba'i tshig gis rol par mdzad pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das kyis gang cung zad gsungs pa de bdag gis gcig na zhes bya ba ni dus gcig 79—235

nyid la'o/ /gcig na zhes bya ba ni skad cig nyid7)la'o/ /thos pa zhes bya ba ni lhag par son pa ste/ 'dis bsam gyis mi khyab pa la lhag par mosalgepa'i ting nge 'dzin rnyed do zhes bya bar bsnyegs so/ /dus zhes bya ba ni dus tshod ces gsungs so/ /dus ni rnam pa gsum du brjod/ /bde ba'i dus dang sdug bsngal dus/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dus nyid do/ /'o ma'i rgyun ltar sna bug tu/ /'ong ba bde ba'i dus su gsungs/ / me yi shrī sdugazugs kyis 'gro ba nyid/ /sdug bsngal dus dang de gcig grags/ /gcig ni lhan cig med pa yin/ /dus ni bsam gyis mi khyab 'gyur/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /de la 'dod chags nus mtshan nyid/ /'dod chags bral ba 'gog par gsungs/ /'di bral dbu mar mi rtog pas/ /'di gsum dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags nyid dang chags bral nyid/ /'dres par gyur pas④rtog pa med/ /de bzhin 'dod chags chags bral las/ /ro mnyam gcig pu'i skad cig ma/ /dngos po kun gyi ro mnyam pa/ /bsgom pa'i dus ni gcig tu gsungs/ /'di lta ste/ dbang phyug dang / gzugs dang ske/ grags pa dang / dpal dang / ye shes dang / brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ bha ga drug ces gsungs so/ /de 'di la mnga' ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das so/ /yang na gang zhig mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi gechos de rnams bcom pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rnams dang / de rnams nyid kyi snying po dang ske/ de nyid kyi rdo rje dang / de nyid kyi btsun mo dang / de'i bha ga de la bzhugs so/ /kye bcom ldan 'das bzhugs so zhes bya bas ci gsungs pa 'u79—236

lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis7bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ro gcig (9pa thabs sna tshogs kyis 'dul ba'i skye bo'i geyid 'phrog pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi risku dang /gsung dang / thugs kyi snying po rdo rje'i rang bzhin gang gi pa chos kyi 'byung gnas la/ gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa de'i tshe bdag gis thos pa'o / /'di lta ste/ shes rab gang gis nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa de'i phyir shes rab bha gar gsungs te/ bha ga der de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang btsun 6)mo lhan cig tu bzhugs so/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /kun mkhyen ye shes bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bde don gang / /btsun mo nye bar mdzad pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di skad bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba'i yig 'bru ni/ chos kyi thog mar rtag tu yang dag par gnas pa ste/ dag pa dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dngos grub skyed par byed pa'o/ /lag na rdo rjes lam bshad pa de ngas khyod la bshad do/ /tshigalo8)'bru 'di rnams kyis sems can rnams 'khor ba las pha rol tu shin tu ring bar 'gro ba mngon du mtshon par mdzad pa dang / mngon du ma 9mdzad pa de nub pa'i sems kyis 1 tshoskye ba 'dir sangs rgyas nyid dam/ rdo rje sems dpa' 'thobartso11par 'gyur te/ gang dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas ma thob pa de ni bde bar gshegs pa ste sangs rgyas yin no/ /mtshan gzhi 1nyamatshon par byed pa ni sems dpar yang dag par gsungs te/ sdang bas bsten pa tsamatshwa gyis mnar med par rab tu ltung bar 'gyur bas na/ kun nas nyon mongs pa can gyi sems kyi miro spang bar bya'o/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa can gyi bo79wa 237

srid pa'i 'jigs pa las 'das pa'i sgrub pa po dpal dang ldan pas dag pa'i sems sgom par byed de0)/ thabs dang shes rab kyi sbyor ba 'dis ji ltar yang dag par (0thob pa dag pa'i yang dag par rig pa'i bdag nyid can gyi mtshan gzhi (mithabs dang shes rab kyi ④nus pas nam mkha' dang mnyam zhing gnas gsum du snang ba ste/ de'i mtshan gzhi ⑤ni mtshon rjopar dka' ⑦ba dang /thams cad du son zhing rgyu dang rkyen spangs pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur 'jig rten gyi rang dang gzhan gyi don byed de dngos grub thams cad kyi mchog go//rgyud thams cad7kyi gleng spugazhi gsang ba dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po ste dang po rdzogs jo9// //de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /sgrub pa po la phan don du/ /gang gis slob ma dbang bskur ba'i/ /cho ga yang ni bshad par bya/ /dang por lha yi bdag nyid kyi/ /rnal 'byor pas ni nor 'dzin sbyangarwate/ /'bad pas rtsu las rdo rje can/ /byas te phyi nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang ske/ /byang chub sems dpa'i khyim dang yang / /khang stong dang ni khyim nang du / /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs par 8bya/ /rdul tshon dam pa nyid dang ni/ /yang na 'bring po nyid kyis te/ /rin chen lnga yi bdag nyid phyes(nye/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pas bri/ /dkyil 'khor khru gsum bya ba dang / /mthe bong gsum ni r+shalhag par bya/ /der ni rigs /lhalnga las byung ba'i/ /rigatshaskyem bzang po gzhug par bya/ /sngags kyi lam gyi rjes btsal bas/ /gang tshe mkhas pas dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mngon sum du/ /dkyil 'khor bde bar 73wa 238

gshegs gnas su/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas bdag /blo dang ldan pas de bzhin blang / /rang byin brlabatupa'i gnas thob pas/ /dam tshig nyams pas 'jigs pa yis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis don dam las/ /sngags kyi lam ni de bzhin gsungs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs lha'i/ /dam tshig rim pa shin tu ring / /de phyir don kun la 'bad pas/ /dbang don rgyal ba'i bdag nyid skyes/ /rdo rje slob dpon yon tan mtsho/ /ji bzhin sbyor bas gsol ba gdab/ /yang na ma dang sring bu ②mo/ /bu sring mo yi bu mosanyid/ /'di nang gang de ji lta bar/ /rnyed nas bsgrubalgepa nyid du gyis/ /yang na mngon du 'di med na/ /kun mkhyenasnyigyis bsngags7rig ma ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis khyabalgemadzad pa/ /de ni de phyir gzung〈bar bya/ /skye ba gnyis kyi bu mo dang / /yang na btso blag7ma dang / yang na gdol pa mo dang / g.yung mo dang / rigs las skyes ma dang / yang na rgyal mo dang / gar mkhan gyi bu mo dang / bzo mo dang / yang na ri dgas51kyi mig ma dang / rked pa phra ba dang / ro smad rgyas pa dang / nu ma mtho ba dang / bha ga bzang ba dang /dam tshig gi spyod pa la shin tu dam pa dang / de kho na la gnas pa dang /sngags dang rgyud shes pa ste/ sgrub pa po'i dbang po la gnas gsum du che ba'i bu mo 'di dag bshad do/ /rigs kyi rim pa nyid kyis 'di rnams kyis thams cad 'grub par7'gyur ro/ /ma rnyed ji ltar gang rnyed de/ /de bzhin bcu drug lon pa nyid/ /dang po'i lang tsho phun sum tshogs/ /mig mdzes phyag rgyamathurnyed nas ni/ /rig ma de nyid blangs nas ni/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pas ni/ /sbyangs nas de nyid gsang ba dang / /sngags dang rgyud kyi rim kun 79—239

bsgrags / /sgra 'am 'og gi lam du lces/ /de nyid de bzhin steng du gzhug /kun gyi cha rigasamanyu)sna tshogs byed/ /rim pa nyid kyis rna cha〈pedang / /ska rags che dang se mo do/ /lag gdub dang ni rkang gdub ldan/ /de ltar dngos grub dam pa ster/ /gang zhig sbyangs pa'i rig ma kun/ /nye bar 'tshe ba med gnas su / /rig pa 'dzin pa 'khor mang po/ /de nas tsan dan gos phreng sogs/ /rnam par brgyan nas dbul bar bya/ /dri dang phreng sogs5)rim gro yibya/ /'o ma'i mchog gesogs rgyas pas ni/ /phyag rgya thabs cigakyisgrub pa pos/ /gus par 'bad pas yang dag mchod/ /slob mas pus mo'i lha nga ni/ /sa la dad pas btsugs parinas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas bstod pa 'dis/ /ston pa la ni zhu ba bya/ /stong pa'i snying po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshogs/ /ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod / /'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa rinacan/ / dag pa'i ⑨de nyid don ston mdzad / /bdag med chos las byung ba yi/ ri/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstodarka/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan rnams / /mgon po las ni rtag tu byung / /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod / /dkon mchog gsum dang theg chen dang / /de bzhin bstan 1medang 'gro ba dang / /khams gsum po nyu ni 'di dag kun/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yid bzhin nor bu ltar gyur pa'i/ /'gro ba'i 'dod pa'i don grub phyir/ /dpal ldan bde gshegs bka' bzhin mdzad/ /sangs rgyas sras po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nyid bla med bdag 'tshal bas/ /yon tan mtsho hunyekhyod bka' drin las/ /kun mkhyen rdo rje dbang gis ni/ /da lta 14nyid du 73—240

bka' drin skyobs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /ji ltar dpal thugs rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje chos can la gsungs ltar1/ /de bzhin mgon pos bdag la skyobasal/ /bcom ldan zhabs pad spangs nas ni/ /gzhan du bdag la 'gro ma mchis/ /'khor ba'i 'gro las nges rgyal bar/ /de phyir mgon posamachosathugs rje mdzod/ /de nas rdo rje slob dpon dpal/ /rjes su brtse bcas phan sems kyis/ /slob la snying rje bskyed nas ni/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dgug pa dang / /'dod yon lnga yis gang ba dang / /bla res byes pas nye bar 'bar/ /rnal 'byor ma dang sbyor ldan zhing / /dril bu sil sil sgra dang ni/ /me tog bdug 'khyil 3)nyams dga' ba/ /lha yi dri phreng bde ba'i mchog /dpal ldan rdo rje sems sogs lha'i/ /dkyil 'khor mchog tu ngo mtshar bar/ /slob dpon skal 45)ba bzang po mchog /de nas phyag rgya sbyor byas nas/ /rgyal ba'i bdags skyes byang chub sems/ /pad+ma'i snod du gzhug 8par bya/ /rnga yab g.yob cing gdugs dang ni/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad glu rnams kyis/ /phyag rgya ldan pas slob ma de/ /'gro ba'i gtso bos dbang bskur bya/ /slob dpon mchog gi dbang phyug gis/ /dbang ni rin chen mchog byin nas/ /bzang po'i rang bzhin legs sbyangs pa'i/ /dam tshig yid 'ong nges par sbyin/ /khrag chen dang ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan dan dmar po 9sbyar ba dang / /rigs kyi bdag po'i chu ldan zhing / /lnga pa sems las yang dag byung / /'di rnams dam tshig yang dag par/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis nye bar gsungs/ /bzang po rtag tu bskyang bar nyu )gyis/ /sdom pa yang ni da ltar nyon/ /srog chags gsad 11par mi bya zhing ske/ /bud med rin chen yongs mi spang 12/ /des na 1 slob dpon spang mi bya//79—241

sdom pa shin tu 'da' b.rashedaka'/ /gangakhudu gsungs pa'i rig ma 'a4/ /yang na bdag gi rnal 'byor ma/ /dag cing sprul pa'i rig ma ni/ /si h+la ga bur bsgos pa ni/ /ji srid khu ba ldan gyur pa/ /de srid phyag rgya bsten par bya/ /phyag rgya'i gdong yang bcing ba dang / /thabs kyi gdong yang de bzhin te/ /bstan pas yangatso/dag gang byung ba/ /slob ma'i kha ru ltung0bar bya/ /ro mnyam slob ma'i spyod yul nyid/ /de nyid la ni bya bar bshadame/ /rang rig ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ /rang gzhan yang dag rig pa spangs/ /mkha' mnyam rdul bral stong pa nyid/ /dngos dang dngos min bdag nyid mchog /thabs dang shes rab rnam par 'dres/ /'dod chags 'dod chags bral bas 'dres/ /de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid yi ge dam pa nyid/ /de nyid 'di ni kun khyab byed/ /de nyid sangs rgyas ye shes can/ /he ru ka dpal zhes byar brjod / /gzhan rnams gang rnams de rnams dang / /dngos dang dngos med de las byung / /dga' ba dang po dpa' bo ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnal 'byor ma / /shin tu bde dga' thams cad nges/ /de'ubade thabs las thams cad rig /dang po dga' ba tsam nyid de/ /mchog tu dga' ba gnyis pa'i grangs/ /gsum pa dga' bral dga' bar bshad/ /bzhi pa lhan cig skyes par brjod/ /de yang dbang ni rnam pa7bzhi/ /dang po la ni bum pa'i dbang / /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /byang chub sems kyi dbang gis ni/ /slob ma sdig pa bral ba yin/ /sangs rgyas grong khyer mchog sngon du/ /de nas de la gnang ba sbyin/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /phyogs kun du ni 'khor lo ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 79—242

bla na med/ /kun tu mchog tu rab tu bskor/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin bdag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong nas6)/ /sbyor med bral zhing ma zhum pas/ /sems can don ni da〈peltar gyis/ /dbang dang bka'57gnang thob nas ni/ /bya ba byas pas rab 'dzum zhing / /'gro ba dga' bar byed pa yi/ /shin tu snyan pa'i tshig 'di brjod/ /deng57bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi 'tsho ba 'bras bur bcas/ /de57ring sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /dkyini sangs rgyas rigs su 'gyur/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor 'jigs chen por/ /mnar med skye ba yang dag 'khrugasatho/ /nyon mongs 'dam ni brgala'udaka' lasal/ /bdag ni mgon po khyed ⑩kyis bsgral/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin las/ /theg pa rdzogs pa lta bur bdag /bag chags thams cad bral bas na/ /bdag la byang chub 'tshal ma mchis/ /rangs shing mig ni phye brkanyayis / /zhabs la 'jus nas gus par bya/ /gang dang gang zhig sdug pa'i rdzas/ /re ba med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /de dang de nyid dbul bar bya/ /bla ma'ang snying rje ldan pas ni/ / slob ma bsdu ba'i bsam pa'i phyir/ /de la phan pa'i bsam pas bzung 8/ /de nas phyag 'tshal mchod nas ni/ /bla ma la ni yon rnams dbul/ /gser ni stong phrag brgya dang ni/ /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /gos ni zung 'gyur brgya nyid dang / /glang po rta dang yul 'khor nyid/ /rna cha dang ni rkang gdub dang / /nor bu dang ni sor gdub sogs / /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ /rang gi chung ma bu mo dang / /bran phos8bran mo sring mo nyid/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni dbul bar bya/ /bdag gi dngos po thams cad kyis/ /blo dang ldan pas bla mar tshadabul/ /de nyu tshoring tshun chad bdag bran 79—243

du / /khyod la bdag ni dbul hu)lags zhes/ /de ltar zhu ba byas gyur pas/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas thob nas/ /da ②ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /bdag la bka' drin legs par skyobs/ /ji ltar bla med byang chub de/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag gis bsgrubs/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub gnas/ /kun mchog mchod pa bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can gnas gsum 'khor ba zhurnams / /de nyid la ni gzhag cadapar bgyi/ /dbang chog ⑤'dis sbyin par bya zhing slob ma'i lhag par mos pa dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba'i ⑥rig pas lhag par mos pa'i yid kyis shes par byas nas tshig nyid kyis dbang rin po che sbyin par bya'o/ /gang thob dbang rab mchog ni rigs kyi bdag por gzung ⑦ba rnyed par dka' zhing mtshungs pa med par gdams/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing gi dpal dag blang bar byas pas byang chub sems dpa' tsochen po'i dbang bskur ba / /bka' yi gnang ba rnyed nas 'jig rten khagasum gyi dgra bo las rgyal 7rtsom pa'i go bgos pa yi blos/ /byang chub dag la dgod pa'i sangs rgyas 'dir ni de nyid rnal 'byor pas ni dri ma med par spyod/ /byang chub kyi ⑩sems kyis bidabang gnyis pa las nyugerab tu byed pa dang po'o// //de nas thabs dang shes rab don/ /bsgom pa yang dag rab bshad bya/ /pha rol don brtson brtson 'grus kyi/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i cha'ajigs pa las/ /bsgral dka' gang zhig rnam bsgoms pas/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rang don du/ /mya ngan 'das par gnas mi 'gyur/ /gang gis khyad 'phags mthar thug par/ /sangs rgyas dri med ngo mtshar rmad/ /79—244

'grib dang 'phel las rnam par grol/ /byang chub bla med thob par 3)'gyur/ /phung po lnga sogs chos rnams dang / /theg gsum shin tu spang mi bya/ /chos dbyings shin tu (mimanyam pa nyid/ /chu shing lta bur yongs su gzung (kye/ /stong pa bsgom par mi bya ste/ /stong min bsgom par mi bya'o/ /stong pa mi spang rnal 'byor pas/ /stong min yongs su mi spang (pengo / /stong dang stong min gzung (snyeb las / /rtog pa nyung min skye bar 'gyur/ /yongs su spangs (6nyen kun rtog ste9) pe/ /de phyir de gnyis yongs su spang (8da/ /gnyis kyis gzung ba yongs spangs pa/ /rnam grol gnas dang bral ba ste/ /nga zhes bya ba'i kun rtog 'di/ /de phyir de ni yang dag spang po)/ /rnam pa med cing dogs bopa med/ /'dod pa med cing sdig pa bral/ /thog ma tha ma'i rtog las grol/ /nam mkha' lta bur mkhas pas bsgom / /snying rje ldan pas sems can la/ /rgyab kyis phyogs par mi bya zhing / /sems can yod dang yod min zhes/ /de ltar yongs su brtag mi bya/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /shes rab ces chirtortani rab tu grags/ /yid bzhin nor ltar ma lus pa'i/ /thams cad don byed snying rje nyid/ /dmigs med gnas su shes rab dang / /dmigs med snying rje chen po nyid/ /blo dang lhan cig gcig gyur pa8/ /nam mkhar nyi nam mkha' ji lta ba'o/ /gang la sgom pa po yang med/ /gang yang rnam par sgom pa'ang cimed/ /bsgom bya nyid kyang yod min pa/ /de tsoyi de nyid sgom par 8brjod/ /gang yang bya ba yod min 'dir/ /bza' bya nyid kyang yod ma yin/ /byed po bza' las rnam par grol/ /don dam rnam par bsgoms pas narmo tsho/ /'di la sgrub po gang yang med/ /gang yang stong /93par byed pa med/ /dor ba cung zad med par brjod/ /blang ba'ang slo79wa 245

cung zad yod ma yin/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang / /sgyu ma smig rgyu 'dra ba dang ske/ /'phrog pa zla ba'i grong khyer mtshungs/ /rmi lam rtse0ba lta bur blta/ /sgyu ma ji bzhin thams cad du/ /blta ba nyid dang reg par bya/ /'gro ba thams cad gnas pa ni/ /gang yang rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ / sbyor bsnye'adus pasashebasam mi khyab/ /rmi lam sad pa lta bu ni/ /ji ltar gzhon nu'i gzugs kyis ni / /dbang po gnyis ni 'dus pa yis/ /bha gar ling ga bzhagatunas ni/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /ye shes ci zhig skye zhe na/ /thog ma dbus mtha' dri ma med/ /rang gis rig pa'i ye shes de0/ /gzhan du smra bar mi nus so/ /gzugs rnams thams cad lta ⑥ba dang / /sgra rnams nyid kyang nyan pa dang | /smra ba dang ni rgod pa dang / /sna tshogs ro ni za ba dang / /las rnams thams cad byed pa nim/ /gzhan du sems ni mi 'gro bas/ /de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /'di ni gnyis su med par brjod/ /'di ni byang chub sems mchog nyid/ /rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dpal / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub nyid/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin / /pha rol phyin pa kun gyi chadangos/ /mnyam nyid bsam bya nyid du gsungs / /sangs rgyas kun mchog bsgom bya nyid/ /'gro ba brtan dang g.yo ba'i bdag /byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos sogs7/ /de nyid las ni thams cad skyes/ /dngos dang dngos med sbyor bralalteb/ /rnal 'byor pas ni de nyid bsgom/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam grol ba/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /ma lus skyon la sdang ba dang / /kun nas nyon mongs rgyab phyogs des/ /dpal ldan bderwalha79—246

gshegs yon tan rnams/ /mtha' yas de las skye bar 'gyur/ /kun rtog mang po'i mun pas khyab gyur pa'i/ /rab tu 'joms pas sto0)zhing blo 'gyur ba/ /chags sogs dgag dka'i dri masar gos gyur pa'i/ /sems ni rdo rje can gyis 'khor bar gsungs/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rtog las rnam par grol/ /'dod chags las sogs dri mas gos bral ba'i/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin med sems dpa' mchog /de nyid mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu gsungs/ /sdug bsngal phung po du ma'i mtshan gyur pa/ /'di las gzhan du cung zad yod ma yin//bde ba mtha' yas 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur pa/ /de las gzhan du grol ba'ang yod ma yin/ /sdug bsngal ma lus zad par 'dod pa dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bde mchog thob 'dod pas/ /sems ni brtan par byas nas 'bad pas dpyad//de yi rang bzhin dngos po med par byed/ /ji srid rtog pa'i mun pa'i yolasaslostug po/ /skye dgu'i yid bsgribs56sdug bsngal mtha' yas la / /ji srid de nas desnyeni bral yin te⑨/ /de srid bde ba rgya chen tha dad min/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi mthar thug 'phags dgyes pa'i/ /de yi zad phyir rang gi71bya ba yang / /rgyas pa de yi yan lag 'gro ba blta/ /de ltar de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor pas rnal 'byor gyi nges pa byas nas bka'i gnang ba dang / rang gi dam tshig la gnas pas sgom par〈nyebyed na lag pa'i phyag rgya dang / sngags dang sku gzugs kyi nga rgyal bsgom pa dang / dam tshig gi77thun mong gi dngos grub sgrubalgepar byed pa yin no zhes pas7ci zhig bya/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs〈 phopa'i mtshon pa mngon du rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor yin te bskyed pa dang / de mtshon pa na gnas gsum po nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur ro/ /gzhung thams cad 79—247

spangs nas thob pa'i gnas kyi bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor de la brtson pas rang rig pa tsam la spro bas nyin dang mtshan du goms par bya'o/ /ri'i rtse mo dang /zhi ba'i gnas dang / pad+ma'i tshal dang / rgyal po'i tshal dang / dben pa dang ske/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas dang / rang gi khyim mamanya/ sems la mngon par 'dod pa〈thams cad mkhyen pas sngags51pa 'di'i nang du gang dang gang gi gnas der gnas shing sngags shes pashespro ba dang ldan pa desashesgom par byed de/ thabs dang shes rab ma rtogasalgepar sangs rgyas nyid mngon du thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir shes rab ma dngos sum yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub sbyin par byed pa bzang mo spang bar mi bya ste/ phyag rgya re re dang ldan pa 'di ma gtogs rin par dngos grub 59)ster bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir ye shes skyed pa yi1 dzo/ /phyag rgya bzhi ni sbyar bar /nyabya/ /gti mug dam tshig phyag rgya ste/ /zhe sdang phyag rgya chen por brjod/ /phrag dog las kyi phyag rgya ste/ /'dod chags chos kyi phyag rgya bdag /yo gis phyag rgya sna tshogs 'di/ /bskyed nas rig ma bza' bar bya/ /de la gnyis ka yang hu lha'i gzugs su mngon du bsams nas gti mug las zhi ba dang / khro ba las /snyem rungs pa dang / 'dod chags las chags pas las rnams byed dos/ /de'i don du rab tu byed pa lnga po 'di rnams kyis rgyal ba rnams 8yin no/ /snga dro dang / nyi ma'i mtha' dang / nyi ma phyed dang ske/ /nam phyed kyi dus su yang 7phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bya'o/ /mnyam par sbyor ba las gzhan du ni 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /bstan pa la smod pa'i 'jigs pa dang / skye bo gdug pa'i nang du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas rang gi sems 'ba' zhig de bsams pas sems la lhag par mos pa mngon du bya'o/ /79—248

gang zhig yang rnal 'byor pa brtson 'grus kyi 'bad pas rnal 'byor 'di bsgrub par bya'o/ /shes rab mngon du ma rnyed na byol song dag la'ang rtag tu goms par bya'o/ /de ltar gang zhig rnal 'byor pas gal te pad+ma 'dzin pa la mngon du nyi ma re re'am/ zla ba so so'am/ lo la reg par mi byed na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ro/ /dam tshig nyams pas rnal 'byor pa bag med pa7)skye bar 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i dam tshig blang bar byas na 5yang mi byed par sdom pa gzung bar bya57ste/ de'i phyir kun gyis sdom pa dang ldan zhing de kho na la gnas pas phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bya'o/ /gsang ba'i nye ba'i rdzas dang sngags dang rgyud kyis 'di skad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yang dag par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor gyisate④rtag tu nye bar 'dug ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas su gnas gsum po rtse gcig pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya'o/ /thabs dang shes rab kyi don bsgom pa zhes bya ba gnyis pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas 'khor lo thams cad kyi5/ /rnam par 'phrul pa 6yang dag bshad/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems sogs lha'i/ /thams cad las ni sna tshogs byed / /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid 'di la bsgrub rdzo/ /rnam par bral dang gnas su yang / /rang gi tshal sogs rnams su yang / /kun las sna tshogs phyag rgya ste/ /kun las sna tshogs sdom pas ni/ /kun las sna tshogs bya ba rnams/ /ji ltar bde bar bsgrub par bya/ /bde gshegs kun gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes nyid/ /khro bo'i sgrub thabs thams cad dang / /zhi ba rnams kyi lha rnams la/ /ci zhig nga yis bshad par bya/ /79—249

bsam gyis7mi khyab sangs rgyas gar/ /bsgom pa lha yi7rnal 'byor dngashe/ /sngags kyisnyibazlas pa'i chog rim dang / /bris sku 'am ni sku gzugs kyangakhu/ /sems kyis7thams cad sprul pa ste/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod phyir/ /nga yis rgyud du bsgrags pa yin/ /stong nyid gcig las rdo rje can/ /rigs ni rnam pa lnga ru gsungs/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bskyed pa'i yig 'bru gzugs dang ni/ /phyag rgya dbyibs kyi chogasherim dang / /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i cho ga yang / /gang gis sgrub posa'u'agrub 'gyur ba/ /gtso bo shin tu dga' chen pos/ /bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang por byams pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis par7snying rje rnam par bsgom/ /gsum par dga' ba bsgom pa dang / /kun gyi7tha mar btang snyoms so/ /yang ni stong pa'i5)byang chub sems/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru dgod/ /re phas 8nyi ma sngon du rnam bsgoms nas/ / nyi deratso byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis ni ra ba dang / /gur yang cho ga bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /dang por ro ni bsgom par bya/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid brjod/ /de steng rnal 'byor pa gnas nas/ /ho ru ka nyid rnam par bsgom / /rang gi snying gar re pha hunyebasgom/ /de las byung ba'i nyi dkyil 'khor/ /der ni rtsu gi dbyibs nyid ni/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po/ /hūṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje nyid/ /rdo rje lte ba'i dbus〈leganas par/ /yang ni0bye hūm̐ gi de nyid bsgom/ /de nyid yongs51su gyur bltas nas/ /zhe snang bdag nyid rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje skye ba dpa' bo che/ /79—250

'damanyeskyes sngon po 'dra ba 'am/ /yang na sngo dang nyi ma ltar/ /dad pas nges par bsgom par bya/ /nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje che/ /rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi/ /lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bya/ /dkar mo ri dgas mtshan pa 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma 'i⑧ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje lagadu /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u rdung / /g.yung mo sku la 'khyud pa ste/ /mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa yisaX/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /de nas gnas las0rnam grol ba'i/ /chos rnams kun gyi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /ā li zla ba kā li nyi/ /sa bon nang du son rig pa/ /de nyid sems dpa' zhes byar brjod/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab pa yi/ /rang gi lus mtshungs rnam par spro/ /bsdus nas snying gar dgug pa na/ /yo gi zhe sdang bdag nyid 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi nang son par/ /de nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /rtsu skyes sngo dang nyi ma ltar/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du ser/ /snang mig brgyad gnyis lo yishedabyibs/ /'jigs byed mnan cing g.yon pa na/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nyid dang ske/ /thod pa yang ni g.yon pa na/ /g.yas na rdo rje nag po nyid/ /hūṃ ni 'don par byed pa'i bdag /lha mo brgyad kyis bskor nas ni/ /dur khrod du ni mgon po rol/ /de ltar gernal 'byor pas ni bsgom/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi sdomashepa kun/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /khro bo'i gzugs ni 'dzin gyur pa/ /phyag bzhi yis ni rnam 79—251

par brgyan/ /bdud bzhi rnam par dag pa ni/ /dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin rnam/ /sngar gsungs medakyil 'khor 'khor lor gnas/ /hūm̐ gi ges bon las byung ba'i/ /g.yon na thod pa lha dang ni/ /lha min khrag gis bkang ba dang / /g.yas na rdo rje me lta bus/ /'jigs pa yangasani 'jigs par mdzad/ /gzhan pa yi ni phyag dag gis/ /lus la yang dag 'khyud pa nyid/ /shes rab rdo rje phag mo ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi5gegazugs brnyan〈gabasgom/ /dang por stong pa bsgom bya 46 zhing / / gnyis pa tshil ni cha bral nyid/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /hūm̐ ni der ni bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin zhal gsum phyag drug par/ /lha yi gzugs su bsgom par bya/ /dang po'i zhal ni dkar min zhing / /g.yas pa dkar zhing zhi ba nyid/ /g.yon pa dmar po lta bu ste / /spyan gsum bzang po'i gzugs can nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag gang / /thod pa'i gdan la yang dag gnas/ /bshang gci khu ba khrag rnams kyi ri/ /thod pa phyag gis bzung ba dang / /gzhu dang mda' ni 'dzin pa nyid / /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /dang po rdo rje 'bar ba nyid/ /gsum par de bzhin rtse gsum pa/ /dpal ldan shes rab 'khyud pa dang / /ral pa'i cod pan brgyan pa ste/ /sprin gyi 'od 'bar du ma ni/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig spro bar bya/ /bha ga'i dbus su sgrub 59pa pos/ /der ni bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /lha mo lhan cig ldan par ni/ /de nas phyag rgya bsgom par bya/ /thod pa'i stan la gnas par ni/ /'dab mar lha mo bri bar bya/ /sna tshogs gzugs ma yid 'ong ma/ /zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /dang por rig ma 1 mobri bar bya/ /gzhu dang mda' ni 'dzin ma mdzes/ /thod pa khu bas gang ba dang / /lcags kyu 79—252

lag pas 'dzin pa mo'o0)/ /gnyis pa rtse gsum lag pa dang / /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /rdo rje de bzhin zhags pa nyid/ /gsum pa lag par ral gri dang / /thod pa chu yis gang ba dang / /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /bzhi pa kha 〈〈ga lag ma/ /g.yon pa'i lag pas thod pa nyid/ /mu susnri dang ba dan gsum/ /lnga pa zhags pa'i lag pa dang / /thod pa lag pas bzung ba dang ske/ /de bzhin ut+pal cang te'u nyid/ /drug pa'i lag pas pad+ma dang / /thod pa tshil5gegyis gang ba dang / /de bzhin me long dgra sta nyid/ /bdun pa 'phang mdung lag pa dang / /dung dang 'khor lo'i mtshon cha 'dzin/ /thod pa khrag gis rgyagang bar ni/ /khru gang tsam du yang dag bri/ /brgyad pa bum pa'i lag pa dang / /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /thod pa skyes pa'i pags 6pa yis / / bkab padza rdzas kyis gang ba 27ni/ /ze 'brur bde ba chen po dang / /'dabate⑨mar lha mo bri bar bya/ /rol mo rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /rdo rje zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /sgo yi skyong ba yang dag bri/ /bha ga'i dbus su bsgom bya zhing / /phyis ni bzlas pa yang dag brtsams1 / /hūm̐ ni rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /oṃ ni dbyangs kyi dbye ba nyid/ /ā 17ni ngag dang yang dag ldan/ /shel ni dag pa lta bu nyid/ /hrīḥtshani de la yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin dul yang swā hā nyid/ /sngags kyis 〉bzlas par yang dag gsungs/ /bsam gtan yi ge gcig po nyid/ /lha mo rnams kyi hrīḥlhaganyid ni/ /'dab tsham rnams la de nas dgod/ /mchod pa bzhi yi rang bzhin gyis/ /sa bon bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /sgo yi skyong ba thams cad du/ /dang po dbyangs yig la 79—253

sogs ldan/ /bha ga nyid du sgrub pa pos/ /de nas rdo rje gzhug par bya/ /hrīḥlayi rnam pa nyid dang yang / /de la rtsu ni brjod par bya/ /zla mtshan dus su khrag bcas pa'i/ /khu ba kha yis bza' bar bya/ /bdag nyid dang ni bha ga la/ /me tog dri yis mchod par bya/ /gal te sgrub po grub ②'dod na/ /de nyid la ni bzlas par bya/ /rdo rje drag mo de bzhin gcig /de bzhin rdo rje gzugs brnyan gnyisal/ /gsum pa rdo rje 'dod chags ma/ /bzhi pa rdo rje zhi ba ma/ /lnga pa rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/ /drug pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /bdun pa sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /de bzhin brgyad pa rdo rje sa/ /gnyis pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //'khor lo sgrub pa'i khyad par gyi/ /rim pa ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /srung ④dang de bzhin mngon spyod nyidañtsa/ /re'u mig dgu sogs 'khor lo yi/ /phyi rol mu khyud nyid du bya/ /'khor lo las kyi kha dog sogs/ /mkhas pas rnam par bsgom par bya/ /oṃ tā re tut+tha re tu re swā hā / 'di yis (zhes bon thams cad kyis na/ /phyag 'tshal sreg ②blugs tha ma ni/ /dbus su ming ni sbyar bar bya/ /srung khaba'i tshig kyang rnam par bya/ /mnyam nyid ye shes stong pas ni/ /bdag nyid kyi ni gzugs su ⑩bya/ /mnyam nyid kun rig gnas su ni/ /srung /leba'i 'khor lo sbyar bya ba/ /srung 8ba ye shes can gyis bsgom/ /'jigs pa thams cad ring 8du byed/ /sems can dngos po med na ni/ /rnal 'byor dngos po bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas parabu/ /pad+ma'i gdan ni bsam par bya/ /dngos grub thams 79—254

cad rab ster mar/ /bdag gi lus ni bsgom par bya/ /oṃ tā re swā hā/ mgo bo la'o/ /oṃ tu re swā hā/ mig dag ①la'o/ /oṃ tā re swā hā/ sna dag (kyela'o/ /oṃ tu swā hā/ rna ba dag ①la'o/ /oṃ re swā hā/ lce la'o/ /oṃ tā ri ④ni swā hā/snying gar ⑧ro/ /yan lag drug ni rnam par gzung (6)/ /'phags ma sgrol ma bsam par bya/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung ⑦/ /rgyan rnams kun nigyis rnam par brgyan/ /kun la skyabs sbyin lag pa dang / /g.yon pa ut+pal lta bu mchog /sngags kyi rgyal pos bskul ba yis/ /lha rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥshig hā/ las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /dgra dang rgyal pos bcings pa dang / /'gro ba'i shin tu 'jigs pa'i dug /yan lag rims ni sna tshogs dang / /dug 7sogs dus min 'chi ba yi/ /'jigs pa'i gnas ni gang gang la/ /de dang de la rab sbyar bya/ /shes rab chub pa (/steblo ldan par/ /srung 42ba bris nas gzung (/nyebar bya/ /srung mib bzang po 'di nyid ni/ /'jigs pa thams cad du ni spangs/ /srung 8ba 'di ni thams cad las / /rnal 'byor de nyid gong na med/ /'bar 7ba'i 'od zer lta bu yi/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams zhu tshonas ni/ /de yi dbus su hrīḥ18nyid ni/ /kha dog dmar po lta bu'i 'od/ /de nas bdag nyid bsgom mi par bya/ /zhal gcig ( — )ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /mda' dang gzhu yi lag pa ma/ /ut+pa la dang lcags kyu 'dzin / /'di ni bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed / /'bum phrag gcig gis rgyal po rnams/ /khri yis 'jig rten phal pa nyid / /bye bas phyugs dang gnod sbyin sogs/ /'bum phrag bdun gyis lha ma yin / /'bum phrag gnyis kyis lha rnams nyid/ /brgya phrag gcig gis sngags pa 79—255

nyid / /'khor lo 'dab 1)ma brgyad pa 'di/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /mnyam nyid gzugs su bsams nas ni/ /khams gsum gyi ni rang bzhin gyis②//sngar gsungs mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ /gong du gsungs pas bsgrub par bya/ /shes rab 'bar ba'i las rnams ni/ /'di yi 'khor lo bsgom par bya ma pralha ma hā pralha hūm̐ swā hā/ dngos po'i ngo bos bsgom par bya/ /'od zer 'bar ba du ma yi/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /shes rab bdag nyid rnam par sprul/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung /kye/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /kha dog dkar po rige'od gsal ma/ /shes rab bdag nyid gzung skurabar bya/ /'di yi sa bon bzlas nas ni/ /shes rab 'dab ma lta bur 'phel/ / gu ba'am bla blo ni dman pa yi/ /shes rab 'phel ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yi ge de la dgod par bya / /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus gnas par/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhi ba'i 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin/ /thod pa dang ni zhags pa nyid/ /de bzhin 'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs par/ /kun tu rnam par spro bar bya/ /'dir (7)ni rnal 'byor rim pas ni/ /rin chen 'byung gnas bsgom par bya/ /btso (shem gser gyi mdog lta bu/ /sku mdog ser po gzi brjid che/ /thod pa'i shigadan gyi dbus bzhugs pa57/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /dpa' bo rin chen lcags kyu 'dzin/ /thod pa de bzhin zhags pa nyid/ /'dir ni rnal 'byor rim pas ni/ /pad+ma rdo rje 'chang ba bsgom/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /pad+ma rā ga lta bu'i 'od/ /dpa' bo mda' ri(lhadang gzhu 'dzin cing / /thod pa'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /pad+ma zhags pa 'dzin pa nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun 79—256

gyis rnam par brgyan/ /'dis ni rimatsha3)pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /don yod phyag na ral gri 'dzin/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi72)dbus bzhugs par ri/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /thod pa rdo rje dril bu dang / /lcags kyu dag ri4)ni g.yas pas55)'phyar/ /be+e ḍūr+ya〈6)ltar ljang 7)gu 8)ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis49 rnam par brgyan / /nam mkha'i khams kyi lha )dbus son pa31/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /de yi nang son sa bon ni/ /r+bha las spyan gyi dbyibs su ni/ /thod pa'i gdan gyilo dbus gnas par/ /phyag ni brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /'khor lo'i lag pa mda' dang gzhu/ /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /zhags pa ral gri thod pa nyid/ /spyan gsum pa la zhal gcig ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag gang / /do shal dang ni rkang gdub brgyan/ /kha dog dkar mo shin tu mdzes / /de bzhin thod pa'i dbu rgyan nyid/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus son pa / /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs gang ba/ /de yi nang son bsam par bya/ /rtsu las mā ma tī yi72dbyibs/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus gnas par/ /kha dog sngon mo 'bar chen mos/ /spyan gsum ma bol zhal gcig ma/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /mda' dang gzhu ni 'dzin pa nyid/ /lcags kyu dang ni ral gri nyid/ /zhags pa rdo rje de bzhin du/ /dril bu dang ni thod pa'o/ /'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang / /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang tshabacu gnyis ni/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /bha ga'i dbus su yongs gang ba'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /der ni trīḥnyi snani bsam bya zhing / /gos dkar zhes bya rnam par bsgom/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus gnas par/ /kha dog dmar mo 'bar chen mo/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis 79wa 257

yongs gang ba3)/ /phyag brgyadasakyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /gzhu dang mda' ni 'dzin pa dang / /pad+ma'i lag par ral gri dang / /thod pa rdo rje dril bu dang / /zhags pa de bzhinas rin chen nyid/ /do shal dang ni rkang gdub sgra/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'di bsgoms na④/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i dbus su yongs gang ba'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de yi nang song rta nyid ni/ /sgrol ma'i dbyibs su bsam par bya/ / thod pa'i⑧gdan gyi dbus gnas par/ /phyag ni brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ral gri phyag na chags bcas ma/ /ut+pal7de bzhin lcags kyu dang / /thod pa khrag gis shegang ba dang / /zhags pa de bzhin 'khor lo dang / /gzhu dang mda' ni 'dzin pa nyid/ /zhal gcig ma ni yang dag bri/ /kha dog ljang gu nyu spyan gsum ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyanam/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pas bsgoms pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam par 'gyur/ /rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi'i gsang ba dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba las skyabartag /19pa'i rgyal po gnyis pa'o// //he ru ka dang bdag med ma'i/ /skyed〈nyepa'i sgrub dang de nyid nyon/ /gang gis gdug pa drag po yis/rnye/ /sems can 'dulasabar 'gyur ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro mas mdzad pa'i/ /de dag thams cad khyod la bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur nas kyangs/ /rdo rje can nyid rdo rjer dbab⑩/ /'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs drag po ni/ /kun tu rnam par spro bar bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sa bon phreng ba de nas dgod/ /de nas rdo rje 73—258

chags chen las/ /rig mar bcas pa khu bar gyur/ /sna tshogs glu yi mchod pa las / /de nas rig mas hu)bskul bar bya/ /rje btsun snying rje'i yid bzhengs shig /puk+ka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs 5kyil/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhed du mdzod/ /khyod med na ni bdag 'gum ( 1pas/ / kye yi ②rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgon 96)gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs tho)sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/ /bdag gis khyod kyi (8)thugs 'tshal gyis59/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag yid dran nyams pas/ /snying rje rgyun chad ma mdzad 7cig / e dang hūṃ 37las rdo rje che/ /khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhabs rnams sa la rdegs 32pa dang / /lha dang lha min sdigs bu/par mdzad/ /gi rtsa bam̐ r+ghaṃ paṃ sho lo ḍi/ 'di yis mas bon dbyung bar bya/ /bdag po dga' ma'i sa bon la/ /oṃ lorgyu sngon po 'bar gtsigs 8pas/ /ma mo'i 'khor lo grong nyams dgar/ /gtso bo 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /phyag ni bcu drug dag gis brgyan / /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa nyid/ /'jigs pa yang 7ni 'jigs pa po/ /sgeg cing dpa' bo mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /mgo yi phreng bas do shal mdzad/ /nyi mar bzhugs shing rol mor bcas kha dog nag po tso'ajigs pa po(6/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /nyid kyi zhal nas hūṃ spro zhing / /thal bas sku la byugs pa nyid/ /bdag med lhan cig mnyam 79—259

sbyor zhing / /dga' ba gnyis gnyis snyoms 'jug pas/ /dba'aphurlabs med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni bzhad cing nag⑧ /g.yas pa'i zhal ni kun da mtshungs/ /g.yon pa dmar zhinga' cher 'jigs pa/ /steng ma'i zhal ni rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi che/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs / /rdo rje ral〈bgri 'dzin pa dang / /mda' dang de bzhin 'khor lo nyid / /de bzhin gshor dang dbyig pa dang / /rtse gsum pa dang lcags kyu nyid//g.yon par dril bu pad+mar bcas/ /gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyar zhing / /thod pa dang ni rin chen nyid/ / sdigs mdzubane gezhags pa de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyi 'od zer ldan/ /kun tu rnam par spro bar bya/ /de ltar cho ga sna tshogs kyis / /dkar mo la sogs de nas rigadagod/ /dkar mo kha dog dkar mo ste/ /gzhu dang mda' ni 'gengs pa dzo)mchog /thod pa khrag gis bkang ba dang / /de bzhin rdo rje gri gug nyid/ /chom rkun ma ni kha dog dmar/ /'khor lo lcags kyu 'dzin mar risresabarjod/ /thod pa dang ni cang te'u nyid/ /gsal ba'i gzugs can dgod par bya/ /rmongs byed ma ni sku mdog nag⑨ /de bzhin thod pa dang ni gshor/ /sa la zlog mapa nyid dang ni/ /g.yas pa rtse gsum 'phyar 3gleba'o /ro langs ma ni dkar ser mtshungs/ /phyag dag na ni chang dang chu/ /ral gri dang ni thod pa nyid/ /mdzes ma'i gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /puk+ka sī ni kha dog ser/ /dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang / /sha yis〈gegang ba'i thod pa dang ske/ /rin chen dang ni mchog 1 sbyin nyid/ /gdol pa mo ni sngo mdog mtshungs / /de bzhin rlung gi gos 'dzin ma/ /gzhan 8pa dag gis 8thod pa dang ske/ /de bzhin pad+ma dkar po nyid/ /g.yung mo sngo dang dkar ba'i mdog /79wa 260

rdo rje dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin pa ste/ /gzhan pas rlung gi gos 'dzin ma/ /ghasma rī ni gyo)ljang ser mtshungs/ /rdo rje me thab dgra sta'i lag /thod pa〈tshil bus yongs gang bcu ri/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs sbyin byed ma/ /ri khrod ma ni dkar mdog mtshungs/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa'i lag /rdo rje de bzhin zhags pa nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /ro hi ta dang phag nyid dang / /rus sbal de bzhin lto 'phye nyid/ /seng ge de bzhin stag nyid dang / /wa dang dge slong nyid rnams ni ri/ /de ltar dkar mo la sogs pa'i/ /thod pa brgyad du cho ga bzhin/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan / /sgeg pa la sogs ro dang ldan/ /rta yi gzugs dang phag gi gdong / /khyi gdong de bzhin seng ge ma/ /zhal bzhi ma 5la phyag bzhi ma/ / sbrul gyi rgyan yegyis rnam par brgyan/ /gling bu dang ni pi wang dang / /mu kun+da 7dang rdza rnga ste/ /phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /nag mo dkar ser lta bu dang / /de bzhin steng du rta gdong ljang / /ser mo nag mo dkar mtshungs dang / /de bzhin steng dus phag gdong dmar/ /dmar zhing nagatso)dang dkar mtshungs shing 1 / /de bzhin steng du khyi gdong ser/ /ljang dang nagarwartedang dkar ba'i gdong / /steng du 'bar ba'i seng ge gdong / /thams cad skra ni steng du 'bar/ /g.yon brkyang ba yis ro mnan cing / /spyan gsum khro zhing sgeg pa dang / /rgod pa'i bzhin ni bsgom par bya/ /he ru ka bskyed〈rtepa gsum pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //ye shes mkha' 'gro'i /2sgrub thabs 〉ni/ /rdo rje gtso bo rgyal po nyon/ /79wa 261

gnyis med ye shes chos ldan pa'i/ /gnyis kyishedangos po spangs pa yis/ /rnal 'byor kun sogs dang por ni/ /dag pa gsum ni gdon par bya/ /swa bhā ba shud r+sātsho/ sarba dharmākhuswa bhā ba shud ho3nyame/ badz+ra shud d+mas/ sarba dharmā badz+ra shud rnyo3rta'u/ yo ga shud ṅgāḥme/ sarba dharmā0yo ga shud rnyo3rtakhya/ de ltar byas nas rnal 'byor pas/ /yang ni bsam gtan de nyid bya/ /yid dang7rjes mthunasheganas rnams su/ /de nas bsam gtan brtsam par bya/ /bla re yang ni thetsob nyid/ /sna tshogs gos ni 'phyang ba dang / /'phan dang rgyal mtshan bsgreng tsheb dang / /phyogs bcu'i gnas ni thams cad du/ /dri zhim me tog sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin dri yi dkyil 'khor du/ /skad cig gcig pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag gi 8lus ni bsam par bya/ /blo gros ldan pas sngar mchod nas/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma ni gzung / /de ltar cho ga sna tshogs ni/ /nges par bsgom pa nyid du bya/ /ye shes rgya mtsho ri bo'i mgor/ /phyogs sogs kha dog bzhi ni bsam/ /de bzhin gser gyi rgyan byung dang / /rin chen bdun gyis rnam par spras/ /g.yer ka 'bar ba'i phreng ba ni/ /'dod pas kun tu rgyas par ni/ /gnas ni lnga ru seng ge yi/ /gdan ni bsgom pa nyid du bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsamasalgenas ni/ /gdugs ni dkar pos rnam par spras//bdag gis dbugs kyis phyung nas ni/ /dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug nyid/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis /7)gnas/ /ma bcings skra yis thamadzes pa dang / /sangs rgyas lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /kha dog sngon mo 'jigs chen mo/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rgod dang khro ba sgeg pa dang / /spyan gsum gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ /sgra cher 79—262

rgod dang gtsigs7pa mo/ /gos ni dmar pos shin tu mdzes/ /steng du khadza shesaṭ+wāṃ ga nyid dang / /gnyis pa la ni dgra sta nyid/ /gsum pa la ni rdo rje nyid/ /g.yon na de bzhin dril bu'i sgra/ /gnyis pa la ni lhung bzed nyid/ /gsum par de bzhin ral gri 'dzin/ /'od zer 'bar ba du ma dang / /dbus su mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mdun du ni/ /bdag gis gudabugs kyis phyung nas ni/ /kha dog dkar mo shin tu mdzes/ /ma bcings pa yi spa yis brgyan/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /sgeg pa'i ro dang ldan pa dang / /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni rnam par spras / /rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsgom bya/ /ye shes byangasregi cha la ni/ /bdag gis sridabugs las phyung nas ni/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /btso ma nerigaser gyi mdog lta bu/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ma mubacings skra yis rnam par brgyan/ /yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan⑧dang ni/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /'jigs pa'i mkha' 'gro zhes bya bsgom/ /ye shes nub kyi cha la ni/ /yang ni ro langs ma phyung nas/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung 9mo/ /kha dog sngon mo shin tu mdzes / /rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ma bcings pa yi skra yis brgyan/ /lus la sbrul gyis brgyan pa dang 31/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /ye shes lho yi cha la ni/ /gdol pa mo ni dmar mo ltar/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /ma bcings pa yi spa yis brgyan/ /phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /yongs gang gzugs dang gzi brjid ldan/ /'di ni rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom/ /dbang ldan lha mo seng 79—263

ge ma/ /gdong ni seng ger bsam par bya/ /dkar dang ser ba lta bur7ni/ /klu dbang stan la g.yas brkyangs geganas/ /rdo rje lcags kyu sdigs mdzubashezhags//shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /'od zer 'bar ba du mas ni/ /lus ni 'bar bar bsgom par bya/ /mer ni stag mo zhes bya ba/ /rin chen bdun po mchog gi gdan/ /phyag gnyis sngo dang dkar ba mtshungs/ /gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /'bar ba'i rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /de bzhin sdigs mdzubasrezhags pa nyid/ /'od zer 'bar ba du mas ni/ /lus ni 'bar bar bsgom par bya/ /bden bral lha mo wa gdong ma/ /sgra cher rgodakedang 'jigs pa mo/ /ma he'i gdan dang yang dag ldan/ /dmar zhing nag57pa'i kha dog ma/ /lus la shin tu mdzes gos dang / /phyag gnyis kyis ni rnam par spras/ /lcags kyu zhags pa sdigs mdzub 7)ma/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /rlung du lha mo 'ug pa ma/ /ser dang dmar ba'i kha dog ma/ /klu'uyi gdan la gnas pa dang ske/ /de nyid rgyan ni rab tu brtag /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung zlo gnas / /lcags kyu zhags pa sdigs mdzub 1 ma/ /'od zer 'bar ba du ma yis / /thams cad kyi ni thams cad 'bar/ /mkha' 'gro ma brgyad dbus su ste / /phyi rol du ni bzhi po rnams/ /de ltar dgod pa'i rim bltas nas/ /phyi nas gnas ni rab tu brtag /shar du mkha' 'gro7)rgyal dbang rdzorte/ /phyag gnyis dang ni mdog dkar mo/ /yi dgas gdan la gnas pa dang / /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /spa ni grol zhing drag mo dang / /me ni 'bar ba'i 'od lta bu/ /khar nyi ni lag pa bcug nas ni/ /sgra cher rgod budang de bzhin 'bar / /byang du mar me rgyal mo dbang / /kha dog gser mdog78drag shul ma/ /79wa 264

'jigs pa'i gzugs can gtsigs pa can/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan / /rab tu song ba'i stan 3)la gnas/ /'bar ba'i me ni lta bu'i 'od/ /thal mophuganyis kyis5kyelag pa ni/ /mgo bo'i steng du mar me bzhin/ /nub tu lha mo 'jibane0byed ma/ /kha dog sridamar mo 'jigs pa mo/ /rab tu song ba'i stan56)la gnas/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /khrag gi srad bu lag pa yi/ /snyim par khrag ni 'thung bar byed/ /me ni 'bar ba'i 'od drag mo/ /lha mo gtso mo 'jibatso)byed ma/ /lho ru g.yo ldan ma zhes pa / /kha dog nag po'i 'od lta bu7/ /rab tu song ba'i stan la gnas/ /ma bcings pa yi spa yis brgyan / /gos ni dmar po shin tu mdzes/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / / sdigs mdzub spudang ni gtun shing lag11 /thams cad sems ni rmongs par byed / /'bar ba'i me yi 'od drag mo/ /thams cad rig 12pas thams cad bsgom / /'di rnams gzugs sogs mdun du ni/ /dam tshig de bzhin bstan par bya/ /rlung dang me yis bdun pa'i nyi don/ /rdo rje'i sa bon gyis ni bskul/ /thig le sgras ni mnan pas ni/ /rgyun gyi char ni zhes byar gsungs/ /gsum pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas bdag med sgrub pa ni/ /ci gsungs mdo ru bsdus 1 nas bshad/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus son par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /'khor lo sngon du ci rigs paras/ /lha rnams ji ltar 'byung ba nyid/ /'khor lo sa dang chu ni sngon/ /go rims tshabazhin du byin za dang / /lha rnams kyi ni rlung chen dang / /ji ltar sgom pa po 'byung ba'i1 / /chos 'byung las skyes 79—265

'khor lo ni/ /'phar ma gnyis dag skyon med pa/ /ze 'bru las ni gcig yin te / /rdo rje can gyi sku gsum mchog /bananyelnga'i gdan dang ldan pa yisal/ /ro ni nges par bsamanyepar bya/ /de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zla ba'i stong du sa bon nyid/ /phyi nas bdud las rgyal bas mnan/ /gnyis 'dus pa las bde chen po/ /ā li zla ba'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /kā li'i gzugs kyis snang byed do / /zla ba nyi ma gnyis 'dus pas/ /dkar mo la sogs rab tu grags/ /zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ /de bzhin mnyam nyid ye shes nyid/ /rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni④/ /so sor rtog par brjod par bya/ /thams cad gcig gyur nan tan nyid/ /gzugs brnyan rdzogs parasnyedag pa'o/ /mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa7ni/ /rnam pa lnga po bsgom par bya/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi gdan/ /yi ge las byung gong bu la/ /r+ghaṃ phaṭa rnam pa〈pe'adod mi bya/ /sems pa'isnyigazugs brnyan las byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po bsgom par bya/ /phyag mtshan zhal sogs gong ma bzhin/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las/ /de ltar thams cad rdzogs pa nyid/ /ā li shes rab kā li thabs/ /zla ba nyi ma'i rab dbye ba'i / /gang phyir dkar mo la sogs pa/ /kha dog dbye bsngo)so so yin/ /de phyir kun tu rab 'bad pas/ /dkyil 'khor pa yang rab tu brtag /rnal 'byor ma lnga 'di dag ni/ /nang gi 'phar ma yang dag gnas/ /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bsgom/ /dbang por rdo rje gshin rjer dkar/ /chu bdag chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /lus nganatshwanyerdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /dbus su bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /byi7rol 'phar marachadakar 79—266

mo dang / /chom rkun de bzhin ro langs ma/ /ghasma rī dang puk+ka sī/ /ri khrod ma dang gdol pa mo/ /brgyad pa g.yung mos gang ba'o/ /'og ldan ma dang steng ldan nyid/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod ma zhes brjod/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /ngos su gyuratum yang dag gnas/ /lha mo thams cad sna tshogs mdog /dragashechen phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /spyan gsum gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ /'khor lo rna cha mgul rgyan dang / /lag parashegadu bu skabarags nyid/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag pasame/ /'di lnga phyag rgya dag par gsungs⑥/ /ji ltar bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /de ltar thams cad rnam par bshad/ /g.yon pas rnal 'byor lhung bzed dang / /de bzhin steng du kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /g.yas na rdo rje sngon po dang / /de bzhin du yangaralpigri gug nyid/ /ro la zhon zhing gzi brjid 'bar/ /spyan dmar de bzhin steng skyes ser/ /kha dog sngon mo ches gsal ma/ /stag gi pags pas rnamasnyidakris shing ske/ /'jigasalgepa'i me ni lta bur ni/ /gsal ba'i gzugs can ma de gnas / /g.yas na dkar dang sngo ba ste/ /g.yon na margad sngo dang mtshungs/ /phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /lag pa gcig ni thod pasaphamathel/ /g.yas na gri gug 'dzin pa ma/ /rgod dang khro dang sgeg pa dang / /de ni mchod pa'i gzugs gnas pas/ /sangs rgyas sprin dang mnyam pa yi/ /'od zer sna tshogs kun tu spro/ /de nyid gsum gyi rang bzhin bdag /mkhas pas dbus su bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //79—267

de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /rdo rje dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbyibs①/ /rdo rje dbyings zhes bya bar gsungs//dkyil 'khor gnas ni sbyangs nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen por yongs su gzung / /thams cad rnam par bltas nas ni/ /sngags pas 'di ni bsgrub par bya/ /sar pa legs par bkal ba dang / /shin tu tshad ma mdzes pas ni/ /srad bus thig gdab shes rab can/ /ji ltar nus (5)par dkyil 'khor nyid/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs rnams kyis shin tu mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /gos dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /mtshams kyi cha rnams thams cad dang / /sgo yi khyud kyi grwa rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ / phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /snode yi 'khor lo so so'i skabs/ /nang du yang ni zhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje thig ni yongs bcug cing / /pyaka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /rdo rje ka ba'i rtser gnas pa(ge/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nang du ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rnam par dgod/ /gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga yang7/ /sgrub pa'ang khyod la bshad par bya/ /de la dang por lha nyid kyi/ /khyim du sngags pa zhugs nas ni/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bsams nas de steng rdo rje ni / /dkar po rtse mo lnga pa nyid/ /cho gas bsam par byas nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun sogs la/ /mchod nas phyag 'tshal 'di skad gsol/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs pa7mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ni che ge mo zhes bgyi/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung rin/nas ni/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni 79—268

nges mdzad pa'i①/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims dang / /tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /so sor bdag gis brtan parashegazung / /sangs rgyasasko chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa dengaspo dzhanas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /de nyid las ni so sor gzung / /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi / /rin chen rigs kyi rigernal 'byor gyisaye/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyi ma re re drug byas nas/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum / /dam pa'i chos kyang so sor gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la//sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /thams cad so sor gzung tshome bar byame/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med po9)/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can kun gyi 3 )don gyi phyir/ /sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bgyi/ /ma bsgral 31ba dag bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba dag sgrol〈gebar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa nyusnyedabugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la gzhag /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi rtse mo las byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te tshig 'di dgakhebaka' stsal pa/ de nas bsam gtan gnas 'dug nas/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med par/ /yang dag rjes su blta bar bya/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can/ /'di dag thams cad sems kyis brtags/ /sems las ma 79wa 269

gtogs pa nyid ni/ /gzhan du yod pa ma yin no/ /chos kun rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /chos kun dang por ma skyes phyir/ /yid kyis a nut+pan+da0brjod/ /de nas rang sems de nyid 'dis②/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba/ /'dod pa'i sngags kyis7bzlas pas ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par blta/ /oṃ tsit+ta pra ti be dhe ku bya'o mi/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor che dag pa/ /nam mkha' lta bu4)dri ma med/ /yid gnyis kun las rnam par grol/ /mchog tu rnam par rtog pa 'joms/ /nyon mongs dri ma thams cad dgadu/ /dang po zla ba ltar bltasalgenas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan 'dir/ /a sogasasnyigazugs kyis 'jug par 'gyur/ /a ā i khri u she)u ṛ rī lī 17ye i o au oṃ aḥ bcom ldan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /yon tan khyad par ji ltar lags/ /bcom〈lhaldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gru gsum rgya chenasngogerang bzhin can/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gnas/ /'di ni a sogs gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas yon tan 'jug par 'gyur(rte/ /shel dang zla ba lta bur ni/ /de yi steng du 'jug par 'gyur/ /sems ni rang bzhin 'odamugasal bas/ /de nyid dga' bar byed pa'i rgyu/ /sngags pas 'di yi sngags kyis ni/ /byang chub sems ni skyed 8par byed/ /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta uṅgā da yā mi/ byas 8pa'i rjes su rim 'byung ba / /sems can rjes su 'dzin pa pohu tsho/ /dge ba'i chos kyis yang dag gang〈nye/ /nyon mongs thams cad nges par gnon/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /byang chub zla ba gnyis pa can/ /'dir yang skar ma'i rnam pas ni/ /sangs rgyas yon tan ka sogs kyi/ /gzugs kyis /6gzugs brnyan lta bu yidu 3/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa bras(1ḍa 79wa 270

nye ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥhunye/'di yi dkyil 'khor cho ga kun/ /rgyud ni gzhan du ma gsungs so/ /de la dbus su rtse lnga pa/ /'od zer dkar po bcas pa nyid/ /kun tu bzang po'i sems bskyed pas②/ /brtan par byed pa'i rgyu yis phyir/ /bdag nyid rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan du/ /'di yi sngags kyis bsgom par bya/ /oṃ tiṣ+ṭhar+sā)badz+ra/byang chub spyod pa bla na med/ /de yi sa ni rtogs pa 'di/ /ye shes dag pa zag pa med/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje nges par brtag par bya/ /nam mkha'i khams ni thams cad kyis)/ /tshad du yang dag gang ba yi/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi bdag nyid du/ /sngags pas bsgom par bya ba'o/ /'disapo)ni sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu bar bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ād+ma ko3rtarin/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang ni/ /snang ba med cing gnas pa med/ /ma skyes ma byas dag pa nyid/ /dngos po med pa la sogs spangs/ /gcadam3med dbyer med gzung7du med/ /chos kyi sku ni gzugs med pa/ /rdo rje bdag med yang dag gyur / /rdo rje'i sku ni gong na med/ /de ltar yang de rdo rjes mtshan pa bsgom par bya ba bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyon cig /yang ni rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs brnyan ni/ /'di yi sngags kyis bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ya tha 3mesarba ta thā gā tā sta thā rta(nye/ sku dang gsang ba de bzhin spyod/ /spyod yul de nyid rtogs pa ni/ /mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 3)bdag nyid dge/ / de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang 79—271

ba'i rdo rje dang / pad+ma'i rigs kyi ming ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun la gnas/ /pad+ma'i rigs ni lha mo chen mo0)ldan/ /de yi rdo rje pad+ma'i steng du gnas/ /de las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don/ /de nas de ltar ga bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed nas steng dang 'og tu sngags kyi yi ge bkod des/ cho ga bzhin du ri rab dang / gru gsum rgya chen po bskyed par bya ste/ 'od zer sna tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa las yang dag par byung ba'i mdzes pa'i gnas bsgoms nas/ der baṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs pad+mar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa ya ra la was brgyan pa'o/ /de nas de'i⑧steng du sngags kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab cing bstod pa/ rab tu bsngags pa/ nor bu rin po che chen posnyi'od gsal ba dang ske/ kha dog sna tshogs shing dril bu dpyangs pa dang / rlung gis bskyod pa'i gos dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / do shal dang / do shal phyed pa dang / zla bas nye bar mdzes par rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor gzhal med khang bsam par bya'o/ /hūm̐ gi sngags 'dis rang gi snying khar 65zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du sngags 'di bkod de gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsgom par bya'o/ /yang sangs rgyas thams cad spro ba dang bsdu bar bya zhing rdo rje de nyid yang yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa zla ba'i kha dog gi pe'od lta bu ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na bzhugs shing rgyan (8)thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dpa' bo shes rab dang dga' ba gcig pus mdzes pas rdo rje dang /dril bu dang / ral gri dang / lcags kyu nyid dang / thod pa dang / zhags 73—272
