pa 'dzin pa nyid do/ /g.yas pa ni kha dog nag po'o/ /g.yon pa ni pad+ma rā 37ga'i 'od do/ /zhal gsum pa dang / phyag drug pa nyid dang / spyan gsum pa nyid dusadang / bzang po'i gzugs can te/ rang gi rig ma'i pad+ma la bzhugs pa / /dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan par dkyil 'khor pa'ang rab tu brtag par bya'o/ /shar du ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /lhor ni rin chenas 'byung gnas so/ /nub tu ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /byang du ni gdon mi za bar grub pa'o/ /dbang ldan du ni spyan no/ /mer ni mā ma tī'o/ /bden bral cadu ni gos dkar mo'o/ /rlung du ni sgrol ma'o5/ /phyi rol gyi 'phar ma la drag shul ma ni kha dog dkar mo'o/ /lho ru ni rdo rje gzugs brnyan ma ni kha dog ser mo'o/ /nub tu ni 'dod chags rdo rje ma kha dog dmar mo'o/ /byang du ni rdo rje zhi ba mo kha dog ljang gu 'ama'o/ /dbang ldan du ni rdo rje gnod sbyin mo kha dog dkar ser lta bu'o7/ /me ru ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser lta bu'o/ /bden bral du ni na sgra'i rdo rje ma ni sngon dmar lta bu'o/ /rlung dang 〈snasa'i rdo rje ma ni kha dog ljang skya ma lta bu'o1 )/ /phyi rol gyi 'phar ma la dbang ldan du ni gling bu ma'o/ /me ru ni bi baṃ ma'o/ /bden bral du ni mu kun da ma'o/ / rlung du ni rdza rnga ma'o/ /11gling bu ma la sogs pa ni phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma'o/ /phyi rol gyi snam bu la me tog ma 12la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ma de gzhag nyi par bya ste/ de bzhin du phyag gnyis ma'o/ /shar gyi sgo la lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu ma nam mkha' sngo bsangs ma'i mdog bri bar bya ste/ zhal g.yas pa dang / gzhan pa ni gnag pa tsodang dkar po'oge/ /phyag g.yas pa'i dang po 7ni lcags kyu'o/ /gnyis pa 79wa 273

la7ni ral gri 'phyar ba'o/ /gsum pa la ni 'khor lo'o/ /g.yon pa na ni zhags pa dang / sdigs mdzubasnyedang / dril bu 'dzin pa ste phyag drug pa bri bar bya'o/ /lho'i sgor lha mo rdo rje zhags pa ma kha dog dkar ser te/ zhal g.yas pa dang / gzhan pa ni gnag pa dang dmar ba'o/ /g.yas pa na ni zhags pa dang / rdo rje dang / ral gri 'phyar ba'o/ /'khor lo dang / dril bu dang / sdigs mdzubasazhags pa can te phyag drug gol/ /nub kyi sgo la ni rdo rje lcags sgrog ma ste/ de bzhin du yang5gekha dog dmar zhing gzi brjid che ba ste / zhal g.yas pa dang gzhan pa ni gnag pa dang dkar ba'o/ /phyag drug na lcags sgrog dang / rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / dril bu dang glu/ lcags kyu'o/ /byang gi sgo la ni rdo rje dril bu ma 'jigs par byed ma7ste / zhal gsum ni ljang gu mdang / nag mo dang / dkar mo'o/ /phyag drug na ni dril bu dang / rdo rje dang / lcags kyu medang / 'khor lo dang / ral gritswadang / zhags pa'o/ /thams cad kyang skra steng du 'bar ba ste/ sna tshogs pad+mar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gzhagatshwanye par bya'o/ /me'i phyogs nas brtsams te me tog la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ma de gzhag par bya ste phyag gnyis mar gsungs so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su ni rnal 'byor ma lcags kyu ma dang / zhags pa ma dang / lcags sgrog ma dang / dril bu'i lag pa ma〈rteste/ sgo srungs hu ma dang yang dag par ldan pa'o/ /dzaḥrgyu baṃ hoḥzhes bya ba 'di rnams kyi snying po bstan pa ste the tshom mi za'o/ /de ltar bkod pa dang byas pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis kyang mtshan ma dang phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i〈nyephyi'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /gong ma lta bulade'i phyed kyis 79—274

de'i nang du zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs lta bu'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang hu)ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa dang / phyi rol du ri mo bzhis yongs su bskor ba'o//lha mo thams cad kyi gnas su ji skad gsungs pa'i gdan rnams ni dkar mo la sogs pasherab tu brtag par bya'o/ /de la dbus su hrīḥ'i⑧yi ge rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i shar gyi re'u mig la ni hrīḥ'o9)/ /lho ru ni ho'o/ / nub tu ni gri'o/ /⑤byang du ni dzi'o/ /me ru ni haṃ ngo / /bden bral du ni rdza ngo / /rlung du⑥mi ngo / /dbang ldan du haṃ ngo / /dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du dgod pa ni me'i mtshams su nisnyi.o ngo / /bden bral du ni u'o/ /rlung du ni e'o / /dbang ldan du ni i dgod ri9)par bya'o/ /shar gyi sgo la dzaḥ'o/ /lho ru ni hūm̐ ngo / /nub tu ni bam̐ rdzoX/ /byang du ni hoḥdagod par bya'o/ /phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams te/ der dbang po (7la sogs pa'i 'byung po chen po brgyad po 'jigs par byed par tsho/g+nedagod par bya'o/ /shar du ha ri 'itshwanyes la/ /lha yi tshogs ni yang dag bri/ /lho ru r+sā7ta'i shing la ni/ /gshin rje'i gtso bo'ichadabang phyug bri/ /nub tu a sho gtsoganas su/ /sprin gyi rgyal po der ni dgod/ /de bzhin byang du byang chub shing rka/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon mnyam par gzhag /de bzhin mer ni ka rañdzar/ /drang srong tshogs kyis yang dag khyab/ /bden bral la tā dz+dza ṭiratshwa tshoni/ /srin po la sogs de nas dgod/ /rlung du pā ba larwarteni/ /rlung gi bdag po yang dag bri / /dbangatshwa)ldan pa ṭa du — )sba lar ni/ /yi dgas tshogs ni yang dag bri/ /drag bcas dbang bcas nye dbang bcas/ /zla bcas nyi ma gshin rje'i myosanya/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas zos nyebyas shing / /thal ba'i dngos bcas 'tsho zhu bar 79—275

byed / /thabs dang shes rab rnal 'byor gyis/ /g.yon par kha ṭ+wāṃ brten nas su / /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing / /khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams / /g.yas su rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad / / skyil krung 0)phyed pa byas nas ni/ /nyid kyi brla steng ②g.yon pa mnan / /tshangs pa la tshisogs mnan pa de/ /grags pa nye bar mi za ste/ /kun du 'od zer sna tshogs kyi/ /sangs rgyas sprin dang mnyam pa 'dis/ /spro ba yang ni sbyin par bya/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pas bsgoms na④/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las 2byung ba ste brtag pa'i rgyal po gsum pa'o// //bcom ldan rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'i/ /ngag gi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ci/ /gsang ba nyan par 'tshal lags na/ /thub pa chen pos bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs zhes (pebya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas mkha' 'gro ma'i dam tshig gi (3)phyag rgya bka' stsal pa/ kol+la i risbyi 87a bol+la 9ci/ musmu ṇi bore rkak+ko lnga'o/rnye/ gha ṇa ki snis 512ho bādz+dza i/ kā ru ṇi ki nyunyes i na rik+ṣar lā/ ta lha ba lā khādz+dza 8yi/ gha ḍi cham a hurteṇa pidz+dza minyushe/ ha le kā lidzi ra pa ṇi 1shes i/ du dhu ra badz+dza 3 )a i/ tsa u sa ma māsgru 37ri si 'ishurnye/ gas ( deru lā i a i/ ma la in+ta ṇi shā li dzang ste/ ta dzi abha ru khā smyo 9yi a i/ phro kha ṇa khes ( ka radheX snye/ shud+dha a shud+dha na 4tesu ṇi a i/ ṇi 8 byeraṃ shu ang ga tsa ḍā bi a/ ta sa/dzi dza sa rā ba pa du ṇi a i/ ma la a rdza zhunyekun du ru bāsta dugeyi/ ḍo ḍi sa ma ta hiṇ+ḍa badz+ra 35a i/ mu khe so tshosto ghu gu 'us/ mu ghu 79—276

dan+ta spar+sha deshedang / mu kha spar+sha nesadang / ho dang / trī kā dang / shukhurgya spar+sha ne dang / u ru ④spar+sha ne medang / steng dang / 'og tu yod pa ni phyag rgya dang57phyag rgya'i lan du gsungs so/ /yi ge dang ngag gi smo masheste bzhi pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //rdo rje snying po snying rje che/ /yid ni gcig tu gyur pas nyon/ /gzugs can ma dang 'o byed ma/ /lā mā0yongs gyur byis bcas mo/ /mi ldog mo dang 'dod pa mo/ /'di dag mkha' 'gro bdunaphonyedu gsungs/ /mngon par zhen pas lta nyugeb dang / /smin ma yon por gang byed cing / /sngon gyi gzugs ni sdud pa dang / /phyis ni hunye'ajigs par byed pa yang5ste/ /de ni gzugs can mar shes 8bya/ /dpa' bos gnyis med bstan pa'o/ /sdug pa'am gal te mi sdug pa'i / /byis pa lta zhing 'o byed gorte/ /de ni 'o byed mar shesatsobya/ /mkha' 'gro mchog kyang de nyid yin/ /byol song ltalostangs khro gnyer gdong / /'di ni sminatshwakye sgyur sdigs57par byed/ /gzhan du dbugs kyisalge 'jigs byed ma/ /de ni lā mār〈 nyernam par bstan/ /phag dang ce spyang byi la dang / /rta rnams thams cad 'jigs byed 7nye/ /de ni yongs gyur ma ru gsungs/ /rab tu dga' zhing gsal bar dgod/ /song bar gyur nas7mi ldog mtsho/ /de ni byis bcas mo ru gsungs/ /gang zhig skyo bas 3lag pa 'am/ /bong ba 'am ni rkang pas sam/ /gos mtha'amarmānyeyang na shing gis ni/ /des reg pa ni 'tsho mi 'gyur / /de ni mi ldog mar shes bya/ /rgodamanyadang smra dang ngu ba dang / /glo bur du ni khro 'gyur ba/ /de ni 'dod pa mar shes bya/ /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor 79wa 278

maratugasungs sonya/ /thod pa dgra sta mche ba dang / /chu srin rgyal mtshan ral gri dang / /'phang mdung dngasheni bdun du gsungs/ /yang dag sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchodabya/ /lus srul57mo'i mtshan ma dang phyag rgya ste bzhi pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas lā mā'i7mtshan nyid ni/ /yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /dmar zhing dkar ba'i bud med gang / /pad+ma'i 'dabastim lta bu'i 'od/ /dkar po'i gos la rtag dga' zhing / /tsan dan sar pa'i⑧dri dang ldan/ /bde gshegs 'dus pa nyid la dga'/ /chags shing mthong na rjes 'gro ma/ /khyim du pad+ma 'drishebyed pa/ /pad+ma gar dbang tsorigs las byung / /smin ma'i dbus su rtse gsum son/ /lus ni sngo sangs77skya ba dang / /ut+pal sngon po'itshwanyedri dang mtshungs/ /khyim du rdo rje bris nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod pa nyugebyed pa ni/ /ho ru ka dpal rigs byung ba/ /de ni mkha' 'gro mar shes bya/ /mig dmar dkar dang dmar ba dang / /de bzhin rkang pa lag pa dmar/ /ra skyes khyim bya dag gis kyang / /rtag tu dga' bar gyur pa dang / /de yi khyim du rdo rje ni/ /bris nas rtag tu mchod byed pa/ /he ru ka dpal rigs byung ba/ /mkha' 'gror 'di la the tshom med/ /'khor lo gang gi dpral ba 'am/ /lag par yang ni mthong gyur pa'i/ /ser zhing sngo sangs7bud med gang / /rtag tu gos ser dga' ba nyid/ /me tog dkar po'i hunyedri chen dang / /skal bzang phun sum tshogs ma de/ /khyim du 'khor lo 'drispyibar byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rjes 'gro/ /gnaganyecing sngo sangs〈nyebud med gang / /so ni dkar zhing 79—279

mtho ba dang / /rtag tu gdug pa'i g.yon pa ni/ /skra ni rtag tu grol ba yin/ /rtag tu khrus la dga' ba dang / /spyod cing mang du smra ba dang / /rdo rje khyim du bris nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung / /dkar zhing gser dang mtshungs pa dang / /'bar ba'i mig dang ba spu gang / /rdo rje gang gi dpral ba 'am/ /lag par yang ni mthong gyur pa/ /rtag tu rgyal srid dga' ba dang / /snyems shing bden par smra ba dang / /ma li ka yi dri dang ldan / /khyim du rdo rje bris nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /dum skyes ma yi rigs las byung / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug (1chen mo gemachog /sha la dga' ba'i bud med gang / /mig sman nag po lta bu'i 'od/ /dpral bar mdung rtse'i rnam pa nyid/ /drag shul las la dga' ba gang / /rtag tu dur khrod 'gro gang dang / /'jigs med skyugs byor med pa dang / /gang gi dpral bar bsdus nas ni/ /khyim du thod pa 'dri byed cing / /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /he ru ka yi rigs las byung / /char sprin mdog 'dra'i bud med gang / /so ni mi mnyam choge par gnas shing / /rtag tu drag shul las rnams dang / /g.yon pa'i mche ba byung ba ni/ /khyim du dgra sta 'dri dbyed cing / /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni༄6)/ /rnam par 'dren pa'i rigs byung ba/ /de ni mkha' 'gror the tshom med/ /gang gi skra ni li ba dang / /bzhin ni yongs su zlum pa dang / /rtag tu kha la sma ra dang / /smin ma ring zhing ba spu dang / /gos dkar gtsang zhing zhi ba dang / /mi bskyod bden par smra ba dang / /rtag tu dam pa'i chos dga' ba/ /dpa' bo'i sring mor de shes bya/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /yang na ru 57sbal phyag rgya bya/ /ril ba spyi blugs mchod byed pa/ /phyag rgya'ishe79—280

lan du brjod par bya/ /de ni tshes bcu'i res dag la/ /khyim du pad+ma 'dri bar byed / /ma mchu 'phyang zhing mig yangs ma/ /mig ni dmar zhing ser ba dang / /che zhing skal bzang nor dang ldan/ /ser zhing tsam7)pa lta bu nyid/ /ring zhing lag pa ring ba dang / /sna tshogs gos la dga' ba dang / /ri mo gsum ni dpral ba 'am/ /steng gi mtshams su nges par gnas/ /rgod( ripa dang ni dga' ba nyid/ /lam gyi rnam pa gnon cing gnas / /g.yul du shi ba rnams kyi ni/ /gtam la rtag tu dga' ba nyid/ /de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /mdung rtse'i phyag rgya rab bstan bya/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bskums pa yi/ /gar nyid kyang ni rab bstan bya/ /g.yon gyis thuyongs su bskor ba ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan du brjod par bya/ / bcu bzhi pa dang ༷gebargyad pa la/ / khyim du 4yemadung rtse bris shing mchod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mtshan nyid yin/ /dmar zhing dkar ba'i bud med gang / /mig ni ljang zhing ser ba dang / /de bzhin skra ni 'khyil ba dang / /dar dpyangs bcings par snang ba nyid/ /ri mo gcig par rab tu gnas / /de bzhin steng du ring ba dang / /rtag tu gos dmar la dga' zhing / /rtag tu rgodamagacing glu len dang / /glo 3)bur du ni khro ba dang / /khyad par du ni sems g.yo dang / /rtsod pa rtag tu dga' ba nyid/ /de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /'phang mdung phyag rgyasherab bstan bya/ /gnyis pa yis kyang 'bad pa yis / /dril bu'i phyag rgya rab tu sbyin/ /g.yon gyis nya )yongs su bskor ba ni3te/ /phyag rgya'i lan du brjod par bya/ /thung zhing byin pa sbom pa dang / /rtag tu gos ser dga' ba dang / /mgrin pa nas ni gos 'phyang ba/ /de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya rab bstan bya/ /gnyis pa'ang rab 79—281

tu 'bad pas ni/ /dung gi phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /de bzhin yongs su bskor ba nyid / /de yi dus ni bcu bzhi la/ /khyim du rdo rje 'dri bar byed/ /yan lag kun la7ba spur bcas/ /mig ni nagashecing ser ba dang / /gtsigs shing rnam 'gyur 'jigs pa dang / /bzhin sbom kha ni sbom pa dang / /ma mchu 'phyang zhing khung mig dang / /sna ni nyams par gyur pa dang / /rtag tu dri zakhu'adod pa dang | /sprin gyi kha dog lto che ba/ /de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /klu yi phyag rgya rab sbyin bya/ /gnyis pa yang ni 'bad pa yis/ /'phang mdung phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /yongs su bskor ba gong ma bzhin/ /de ni bcu gcig tshes la ni / /mche ba 'dritshugazhing rtag tu mchod/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya ste bzhi pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //de nas yan lag phyag rgya yi/ /mtshan nyid yang dag rab bshad bya/ /bud med gang zhig spyi gtsug reg /spyi bo de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig dpral ba ston pa la/ /mkhur tshos de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig so ni ston pa la/ /lce ni de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig ma mchu ston pa la/ / kos ko de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig mgrin pa reg pa la/ /lto ba de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig lto ba ston pa la/ /lterastso ba de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig mjug ma ston pa la/ /sa ni de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig gsang〈peb ston pa la/ /ling ga de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig pusam42)mo ston pa la/ / byin pa de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig lag pa ston pa la/ /skyodapung pa de la rab bstan bya / /gang zhig rkang pa ston pa la/ /rkang mthil de la rab bstan bya/ /gang 79—282

zhig sor mo ston pa la/ /sen mo de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig sa ni ston pa la/ /nam mkha' de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig nam mkha' ston pa la/ /nyi ma de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig chu bo ston pa la/ /rgya mtsho de la rab bstan bya / /gang zhig sor mo gcig ston pa/ /legs par 'ongs zhesatubarjod pa yin/ /gang zhig sor mo gnyis ston pa/ /shin tu legs 'ongs7brjod pa yin / /g.yas pa'i smin ma sgyur tshul dang / /g.yon pa'i sminasasgyur tshul ston pa/ /slob dpon gnyis dang 'du ba ston/ /rgyud thams cad kyi gsang ba yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i brda ste brtag pa'i rgyal po bzhi pa'o// //de nas skye bosredam pa kun/ /'du ba yang dag rab bshad bya/ /de la zas gcig bza' bar bya/ / snod gnyis ⑤su yang ma lus brtson/ /kye bcom ldan 'das 'du ba'i gnas gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /zhing dang de bzhin nye ba'i zhing / / ts+tshan do nye ba'i ts+tshan do hal/ /'du ba de bzhin nye 'du ba/ /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod dang / /'thung gcod7nye ba'i 'thung gcod nyid/ /'di rnams sa ni bcu gnyis te/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon po nyid⑩/ /'di ni gzhan gyis brjod mi bya/ /kye7bcom ldan 'das gnas la sogs pa gang lags/ de bzhin du sa bcu gnyis po rnams rgya chen po las byung ()ba bka' drin gyis bskyab tu gsol/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gnas ni dz+dza lan dha rar gsungs/ /de bzhin du ni ocan〈nyenyid/ /gnas ni kol+la gi ri dang / /de bzhin ar bu 79—283

da7)nyid do/ /nye gnas go dā ba rishogenyid/ /de bzhin dga'akhuba'i dbang phyug dang ske/ /de bzhin de bī0)ko ṭar bshad/ /de bzhin mā la wasnyinyid dang / /de bzhin kā ma 67par gsungs/ /o drashezhing ni nyid du gsungs/ /nye zhing tri sha ku ni dang / /de bzhin ko sha la nyid dang / /ka dzi7kar ni ci gsungs pa'o//de bzhin lam hā59)ka nyid dang / /kārtsi 7kha ba'i gnas nyid ni9/nyu/ /ts+tshan dor yang dag gsungs pa dang / /nye ba yi yang ts+tshan do'o/ /pre ta a nyi bā si gsungs(rte / /de bzhin khyim gyi lha nyid dang / /sau rāṣ+ṭa nyusnyedang gser gling nyid/ /'du ba de bzhin nye 'du ba/ /nā ga ra dang sin 677ni/ /dur khrod nyid du brjod pa dang / /ma ru dang ni ku lu tās/ /nye ba yi ni dur khrod nyid/ /snying rje de bzhin las kyi brang / /ha ri ke la nyid dang ni/ /lan tshwa'i hu)rgya mtsho'i0shenang song dang / /biḥpha1)gzhon nu'i grong khyer nyid/ /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod do/ /de dang nye ba dur khrod nyid/ /rab song dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'gram/ /skyed du nomos tshal dngas1rdzing bu'i 'gram/ /nye ba'i dur khrod brjod par bya/ /de nas gnas la lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/rdul bral gnas su tsū sa ta gnas/ /kong ka nar ni zla ba'i gling ༷ / /ka rar+sār steganas tsā 3geri tra/ /aṣ+ṭa ha sar ka daspa/ /lha mo'i mkhar du ba ṭa gnas/ /ha ri ke lar hi ra ri 9gnas/ /osgyun sa a sho ka ni gnas/ /dzā larnyarmānyerar gser shing gnasaX 6/ /gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med / /zhing ni 'od ri )byed shes par ri1bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro can/ /ts+tshan do mngon du gyur par nges/ /nye ba'i tsun do sbyang dka' ba/ /'du ba ringam du song ba ste/ /nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros 79wa 284

nyid①ma/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi kla klo'i skad/ /55gel sogs pa ci gsungs pa/ /phyi dang nang du bsam par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams legs 'du ba'i/ /nyin par nyid kyang legs bshad bya/ /yi dgas zla phyed bcu bzhi dang / /brgyad pa la yang khyad par du/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni mtshon bsnun nyid/ /skye ba bdun pa khyad par du/ /'bad pas snying rje bskyed nas ni/ /mkhas pas gsad57par bya ba nyid / /snying rje med na mi 'grub pas/ /de phyir snying rje yang dag bshad/ /ji ltar bdag bzhin sems can nyid/ /ji ltar sems can de bzhin bdag /'di ltar sems pa'i⑧rnal 'byor bdag /dngos grub myur du 'thobalgepar 'gyur / /'du ba'i gnas te'ulnga pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //gsang ba'i pad+ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /ye shes dbang po nyan par 'tshal /ye shes sems dang 'dres pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim pa citsu) bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gnas bzhi mnyam par gnas nas ni/ /rdzogs byang7rim pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /mnyam nyid sems ni bskyed nas ni/ /'dod chags la sogs ring du spangs1)/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su ni/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po kun/ /snying rje hu)phan pa'i sems kyis ni(rte/ /spyi bo med pa'i spyi bo dang / /sgra mtha'i hunyede bzhin gsang pad+ma/ /cha ni sna tshogs yig 'bru rnams/ /de bzhin du yang stan mi rnams nyid/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rnam par byed//bsdus nas gong bu'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpar rang nyid 'gyur/ /73—285

chu yi khams dang me yi khams/ /ro gcig mchog gi gnas su ni/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid sbyar6)/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan dbang po drug /bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon dang / /lung gi rjes 'brangs de nyid shes/ /gsang don de nyid dngos po yang / /de nyid las ni gcig⑧las gcig /sngar gyi mtshan nyid thams cad kyis5mi/ /stong sogs de nyid mtshan nyid kyis/ /lus kyi dri ma bkrusalgenas ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim par sbyar⑤/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes sems dpa' bsam par bya /mdog dkar kun da zla ba yi/ /'od zer rnam par spro ba ni/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung rig/ /pad+ma'i gnas la yang dag bzhugs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /phyag rgya chen po phyag gnyis kyis/ /snying gi gnas su gzir bar mdzad/ /gzugs dang gzi brjid yongs gang ba/ /ye shes sems dpar bsgom pa nyid/ /chu shing me tog lta bur ni/ /lte ba ru ni yang dag gnas/ /langs nas snying garashekun tu gnas/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid yongs gang ba/ /bton7nas dang po'i pad+ma ni/ /'dab 7ma brgyad pa nyurteshin tu mdzes/ /ze ba dngacani ze 'brur bcas / /yi ge rnam dgod dgod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gnas pa yi/ /phyag gnyis zhal gcig dkar po ni/ /bzang po dri med dbus su bsam/ /de yi dbus su rnam shes dang / /ye shes de nyid sbyar bar bya/ /dang po shar gyi 'dab sam la/ /byams par ldan pa'i mi bskyod pa/ /lho yi sgor ni snying rje nyid//rin chen de nyid sa bon las/ /nub kyi sgo yi 'dabasngonam la/ /'od dpag med pa'i sa bon dgod/ /byang gi sgo yi gnas su ni/ /sems kyi don yod gtso bo 73—286

nyid/ /dang po'i dbyangs sogs sa bon gyi/ /zla ba'i thig le ji bzhin rim/ /zla ba'i 'od zer dkar brgyan pa'i/ /yi ge bzhi ni dgod par bya/ /mtshams rnams su ni ma ning nyid/ /rnam pa bzhi po sngar0)gsungs pa/ /de yi dbus su de yi sems/ /yi ge yis ni sbyar bar bya/ / rdo rje snying pos gsol pa②/sems la the tshom 'khrungs lags pal/ /bcom ldan bdag la bshad du gsol/ /stong pa mtshon du med pa la/ /yi ge'i rnal 'byor la sogs ci/ /bcom ldan⑧'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /de nyid ji ltar rdo rje nyon/ /mtshan gzhi skyematshan nyid stong pa nyid/ /snying po med pa'i chu shing las/ /snying po bdud rtsi 'bras 'byung ltar/ /'bras bu rnam shes ye shes yini/ /gzugs med pa la ye shes gzugs / /ye shes sku ni skyon med pa/ /mtshan nyid mtshon du med pa nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol/ /yig 'bru medakyilas yig 'bru'i gzugs / /de dbus ngo bo stong pa nyid/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pa yis gzung / /ji ltar mtshan nyid shes kyang ni/ /mnyam nyid ye shes sems kyis ni/ /de yi rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam/ /myur ba nyid du mthong bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /ye shes rnam shes ngo bo las/ /mtshan nyid bstan bcos mdor bsdus pa/ /de nyid dpa' bo ston pa po/ /'di yi bsgom pa thams cad kyi/ /'od zer dkar pos rnam par brgyan/ /lcags sgrog lnga po mchod rten gyi/ /bdud rtsi'i sa bon bsams nas ni/ /kha dog dkar po 'od gsal ba/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni 'dzag par 'gyur/ /snying gi sa bon pad dbus su/ /mthe bong yongs kyishedakyil 'khor 'dil/ /de yi dbus su sa bon ni/ /ā li kā li yongs btus pa/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /zla ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba 79—287

ni / /de yi dbus su sgo rnams kyi/ /thig le bsam par rab tu grags/ /skra yi rtse mo brgya char ni①/ /phra rab gzugs su yang dag gnas/ /rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ye shes can gyi mtshan nyid mtshon/ / go 'phangasheganas kyi thig le ltos/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid thams cad shes/ /snying la tshangs pa'i sgo yi ni/ /thig le sgo yi lam las ni/ /bla ma'i man ngag brtson pa yis / /rnam shes ye shes kyi yang50blang / /lam gyi byi7rol bstan bcos kyang //ma yin ring bar 'gyur ba yin(5/ /bstan bcos rnams ni rnyed sla yang / /sbyor ba de la rnyed par dka'/ /rnal 'byor pa yi thabs kyis ni/ /bla ma gsol ba 'debs la brtson/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /rnam par mkhas pas mthong bar 'gyur/ /mnyam gzhag57dngos po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /g.yo ba med cing 'tshe ba med/ /yid ni chos rnams sngon du 'gro/ /yid ni dag cing yid ltar mgyogs/ /yid kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin gyis/ /smra ba dang ni byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir yid kyi tsu)bdag nyid kun/ /yid la byung bar blo ldan pas / /snying gar57sems bsgom sdom pa ni/ /gal te 'dod na yo gis bzlas/ /rgyu ru gyur pa'i sa bon te/ /de nyid dpyad pas ma yin no/ /'bras bu rgyu yi sa bon te/ /de nyid mthong ba ma yin no/ /gzugs sogs srid pa'i longs spyod kyisam)ske/ /dmigs pa'i sa bon rnam pa lnga/ /spyi bo spyi med yang dag gnas/ /kun nas kun du 'bab par pho )'gyur/ /rtag tu rtsam/nyeba'i sa bon gyitunye/ /ye shes rnam shes sa bon las/ /thig le sgra dang yang dag ldan/ /'khor ba'i longs spyod 'dod pa yis/ /yid kyi bzlas pa yang dag ldan/ /yi ge ngag ni rnam par spangs / /nges par rtag tu go 'phang gnas/ /rtag pa dang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /73—288

rtag tu phra zhing skyon med pa/ /ye shes la ni rnam shes nub/ /ye shes dngos pos rnam shes kyi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim mthong 'gyur/ /dang por mtshan ma thams cad kyi/ /mar me'i rnam pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa mtshan mo7)me khyer gyi/ /rnam pa'i rdul ni gematshon par byed/ /rdul dkar tsa nas ka dbyibs su/ /phyogs bcur de bzhin mthong bar 'gyur/ /gsum par nyon mongs bcom pa ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis rnam par brtags(ge/ / lha yi57longs spyod 'dod pa yang / /bzhi par yang ni bstan pa'o/ /lha yi gzugs ni thamasaponicad kyang / /lnga par sems kyis brtag par bya/ /drug pa gzugs ni med pa'i chame / /bdun pa chos kyi dbyings nyid de/ /brgyad par rang 'dod rnal 'byor pa'i / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'bras bu'i don/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying rje che/ /yid ni gcig tu gyur pas nyon/ /nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /dag pa de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /phyis ni re rer dbye ba yis/ /lha rnams kyi ni brjod par bya/ /lus can rnams kyi phung po dang / /khams rnams dang ni skye mched rnams / /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par dag /nyon mongs mi shes sgrib sbyang bya/ /rang rig bdag nyid dag pa nyid/ /dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min/ /yul gyi dngos po dag pa'i phyir/ /rang gis rig pa'i bde ba mchog /gzugs la sogs pa'i yul gang dang / /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa snang ba/ /de kun rang bzhin dag pa ste/ /de phyir sangs rgyas sna tshogs dngos/ /kye bcom ldan 'das rnam par ma dag pa gang lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/gzugs la sogs pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol pa/ gzung rin ba dang 'dzin pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 79—289

'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mig gis gzugs ni gzunganyebar bya/ /sgra ni rna bas mnyan par bya/ /dri ni sna yis tshor bar bya/ /lce yis ro ni rig par bya/ /lus kyis dngos po rig tsho par bya/ /yid kyis bde sogs thob pa ni/ /dag pas dug med byas nas ni/ /bstenasabya 'di dag bsten par bya/ /gzugs ni sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug /de bzhin 'du byed rdo rje rgyal/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' nyid / /kun gyi ngo bo he ru ka /mig la gti mug rdo rje bshad/ /zhe snang rdo rje mngon thos pa/ /phrag dog rdo rje de bzhin sna/ /kha ni 'dod chags rdo rjer bshad / /reg la rigeser sna rdo rje ma/ /khams dang skye mched thams cad ni/ /dam pa'i dbang phyug he ru ka /sa yi khams ni ltung byed ma/ /chu khams gsod par byed mar brjod/ /me yi khams ni 'gugs byed ma/ /de bzhin rlung ni gar dbang phyug /nam mkha'i khams su brjod pa ni/ /pad+ma 'bar ba 'khyil pa nyid/ /'di ltar lus can rnams kyi lus/ /phung po la sogs lha bdag nyid/ /bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin las/ /nyon mongs la sogs desasrogabaskyed pa'i/ /bskyed pa'i cha la legs gnas pas/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /phung po dang skye mched rnam par dag pa ste lnga pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas spyod pas tsunirtog pa rnams/ /'jig par byed pa bshad par byes/ /chos rnams kun la mnyam byung ba/ /de nyid spyod pa gong na med/ /sangs rgyas sras la phan pa'i phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnamatsha1)gnas pa/ /gang zhig yang 79—290

ni de nyid las/ /rdo rje yan lag med pa yi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog /skye ba'i rgya mtsho 'jigs chen por/ /rga ba'i rlabs kyis 'khrugs pa las/ /sems can thams cad sgrol bar byed/ /tshong pa dge bar 'gro ba dang / /myur du dngos grub gsal byed cing / /snying po'i yon tan kun gyi gnas/ /sems kyi rin chen las byung ba/ /'dod donaturab tu sgrub par byed/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas rab bsngags pa'i/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'idza yon tan kun/ /lus byungashe'adi las ma gtogs par/ /dga' ba'i dngos grub 'byung mi 'gyur/ /mkhas mchog spyod pa mtshungs med 'di/ /grol bar 'dod pas spyad par gyis/ / lha yicadagra dang brgya byin dang / /grong khyer sum brtsegs chodagra bo dang / /nor sbyin tshangs pa la sogs pas/ /zhabs kyi 'dam skyes mchod pa yisagaye/ /sdig pa 'jig byed 'di la spyod/ /myur du de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /gnas kyi mchogatsorini thob par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpas ni/ /gang zhig 'gro la phan par ni/ /kun 'dar0)gyi ni spyod pa gsungasaspu/ /de ltar mchog tu bsam yas gnas/ /shin tu gsang hunyeb yo gis bsgom/ /rtog pa thams cad bral bar7ni/ /dam tshig la ni spyad nyugepar bya/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu rang bzhin las / /dang po'i rtsom par7yo gi gnas/ /de nas bsgoms pas dub pa na/ /bsdusalgenas byis pa'i rtse bar bya/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i 'jig rten la/ /'jam pa'i gzugs can rang nyid bsgom/ /grub par grags pa ma lus pa /ci gsungs rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /spyod pasam bla na med pa yi/rte/ /kun bzang mtshungs pa med 'grub pas/ /spyod pa nges rig rdo rje can/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to/ /dpal ldan slob dpon rdo rje can/ /kun gyi 73—291

mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba'i spyod pas gnas nas ni/ /blo gros chen po bya ba byas/ /de nas rang gi 'dod sgyur bas/ /sbyor ba kun la kha phyir bltasal/ /kun tu seng ge lta bur ni/ /de nyid ldan pas bdag gis spyad/ /ji ltar byung don yang dag rig /'gro ba 'don pa'i bsam pa yis/ /yang dag lta ba rab sgyur bdag /brtan pa'i sems ni gnas med7pas/ /phung po khams sogs mtshan nyid ni/ /thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ /khams gsum 'di dag thams cad ni/ /mdor bsdus nas ni 'dir shes bya/ /sgrib pa kun las rnam par grol/ /'tsho bar dbang phyug 'du ba dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten chos brgyad ni/ /thams cad shin tu ring du spangs/ /rtag tu rtog pa med gyur pas/ /gnyis su med par nges byas nas/ /pha rol phyin drug rnal 'byor gyis / /sangs rgyas dngos grub rab grub phyir/ /sems can don la legs nus kyang —/ /sems can yongs su brtag mi bya/ /byang chub la ni sems bzhag nas//phyogs las rgyal ba'i spyod pa brtsamadu / /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa'i bdag /sbyor ba kun la rgyab (kyis phyogs/ /de nyid goms par rab byas pas/ /skye ba 'dir ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtog pa kun las rnam par grol/ /sems can bsam pa'i khyad par las/ /sgyu byam ltar sogs rnal 'byor gyis/ /thams cad nyid ni bza' bar bya/ /chos kyi 55)dbyings las yang dag byung / /⑥gang yang kun tu lam grogs gemed/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod par ris rab tu bza'/ /longs spyod rdzogs don 'di dag kun/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpas7rnam par sprul/ /ye shes mtha' yas thob pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs phyag mi bya na//79—292

rtag tu sgom pa ldan pa yis/ /dbang bskur med sogs7smos ci dgos/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'di/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /de phyir de nyid lha rnams nyid/ /dkyil 'khor smyung bshogemi bya zhing / /phyag rgya mchod rten las mi bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mgon pos ni/ /gang yang gzhan du bstan pa rnams/ /lhag par mos pas gnas gang yang / /de rnams kyis kyang de nyid rig /ji ltar bdud rtsi'i kyedon gnyer bas/ /snying posablangs nas dor ba spongasnyi/ /de ltar chos kyi snying po ni/ /thob nas rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /rtog med gang tshe blo ldan pas/ /dogs pa spangs shing gnas med pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje ci gsungs bzhin/ /de tshe 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /rtog pas dmyal bar 'gro 'gyur te/ /'gro ba drug gi 'khor ba yi/rgya mtsho7ru ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ /rtog pa med na grol 'gyur zhing / /gnas ni dri med zhi ba nyid/ /de phyir rtog pa'i dgra gegazhom phyir/ /dam tshig sangs rgyas mdzad pa gang / /de ni rtag tu goms par bya/ /gang gis dam tshig gnas gyur pa/ /sngags shes bsam pa'i nus pas bya/ /dngos po kun la blta bar bya//nges par thams cad ma skyes pa'i/ /rnam pa yi ni rnal 'byor gyis12)/ /khyi dang bong bu rnga mo dang / /glang po la sogs khrag 'thungs nas/ /sha yang rtag tu bza' ba nyid/ /sha chen khrag gis bsgos7pa ni/ /thams cad khyad par du ni blta / /dman pa'i sha ni thams cad dang / /srog chags 'bum phrag brgya ldan bza' / /rnam snang shin 8tu rul ba yi/ /srin bu brgya phrag zi zir ldan/ /khyi dang mi skyugs bsres nas ni/ /sha ni rdo rje'i chus77gos ldan/ /rnal 'byor pas ni spro ba yis/ /rnam snang bsres nas bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje'i chu ni btung 79—293

bar bya/ /gang gi tshe 'ga' zhig tu sha'i bza' ba ma rnyed na bza' ba'i don du sha'i gzugs su rnam par brtags te bza'o/ ljagang zhig gzhan pa'i 'jig rten za ba de bza' bar bya'o/ /de kho na'i〈sgrub pa po'i dbang po gang zhig bgrod par bya ba ma yin pa de la bgrod par bya ba dang / gang zhig bya ba ma yin pa de ni de'i bya ba dang / bgrod pa dang bgrod par bya ba ma yin par rnam par rtog pa dang / bza' ba dang bza' bar bya ba ma yin pa dang / sdug pa dang mi sdug pa dang / btung ba dang btung ba ma yin par sngags pas mi bya ste/ sku dang ske/ gsung dang / thugs mnyam par gzhag par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar yang sems 'khrul pa ma yin pa de ltar chang rnal 'byor pas7rtag tu btung bar bya ba dang ske/ dman pas shin tu sgeg pas④dang / rigs dang bcas pa dang /rigs med pa dang / sdug cing7phongs pa'i sems can thams cad laphugacig pa'i tshul gyis rgyal ba lta bur blta 3)ba dang / glegs bam bklag⑧par gsungs pa mi bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor dang me tog bsdu bar mi bya ba dang / sngags kyi bzlas pa mi bya ba dang / lha dang dbang bskur ba la sogs pa la phyag mi bya ba dang ske/ brdzun du smra ba dang / pha rol gyi bud med skal ba bzang mo7bsten par bya ba dang / gdug pa can la byams pa mi bya bar gsungs pa dang /sangs rgyas dang srog chags gsad〈 nopa dang / rgyal bas mchod pa'i slob dpon dang ske/ ye shes kyi dam tshig ni /1sems can decadam tshig gis rtag tumathenadangos grub sna tshogs sbyin par byed de/ blo dang ldan pa la phyogs bcur rnam par bzhugs pa skomachod par byed do8/ /gang gi phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams gang zhig slob dpon gyi ba spu'i khung bu'i rtse 79—294

mo la mthong ba de'i phyir byang chub sems dpas7slob dpon la sangs rgyas kyis mchod pa byed pa mthong ngo / /nges par rang gi dam tshig sangs rgyas 'dod pas dngos grub sbyin par byed pas bla ma dam pa la smad par mi bya ba dang / rdo rje spun la mi gus par mi bya ba dang / gang zhig byin pa de bzung nas mchod rten la phyag mi bya bsnyedang / spun dang / bu dang / pha dang / rgyal srid kyi longs spyod dang / gter dang / norakhudang / 'bru thams cad la rtswa lta bur mthong nas khams gsum gyi rgyal po bsgrubasrepar bya'o/ /'khyud pa'i⑧spyod pa ste lnga pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /spyod pa pha rol phyin mtshan nyid/ /gang gi ring nas shes pa deX/ /rdo rje yo gir the tshom med/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs gtor ma ni/ /ji ltar rnyed〈kyedang bza' btung ni/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor pa yis bza'/ /ro yi dkrisalgema'i gos bzang dang / /ro bsregs thal bas rnam par brgyan/ /phru chag shin tu gsang bar ni/ /mtshan mo'i dus su rgyu bar bya/ /bzhi mdo dang ni ri bo dang / /shing gcig gam ni dur khrod dang / /bzhir ni de nas sngags pa yis/ /bsgom pa bzang po bya bar brjod/ /ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo dang / /yang na dben pa'am bas mthar ni/ /cung zad drod ni thob pa yis/ /gal te spyod pa byed 'dod na/ /bdag nyid gal te 'grub 'dod pas / /byis pa bzhin du spyad nas ni/ /sems can rjes su gzung 3gleba'i rgyur/ /blo ldan chen pos rgyu bar bya/ /zhen pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /kha dog can gyi 8rtag sgrib pa/ /ba spu'i khung bu'i7bu ga nas/ /phyogs bcu rnams su dbyung 79—295

bar bya/ /'jam pa'i rdo rjer rang gyur nas/ /dkyil 'khor par ni rab tu brtag /pad+ma'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar5)/ /chu bo 'dus pa rnams su yang / /der gnas rnal 'byor pas bsgoms na②/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur//phug gam ri yi rtse mor ni/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag ②pas gnas/ /ji ltar rnyed pa bzhin du bza'/ /zos shing zos nas gtor ma sbyin/ /'bras bu sna tshogs do shal sogs/ /'ol ma zi sogs de bzhin sprasabu/ /srog chags yan lag gos gyon55)zhing / /bde don gnyer la bde ba sbyin/ /res 'ga' legs sbyar zur chag 6 ni/ /bzlog pa yis ni 'don par byed/ /bza' dang bza' min ci snyed 7pa/ /smyon pa'i sbyor bas bza' bar bya/ /gzhan pa'i yul 'khor grub pa dang / /ri yis phug dang tshang tshing dang / /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod che/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du yang / /der gnas shes rab can gyis bsgom / /skrag pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /de ltar byas nas rnal 'byor pas / /yang ni phyogs las rnam rgyal brtsam/ /sgrib pa kun las rnam par grol/ /phyogs bcur rnam par gnas pa yi/ /skye ba'i sgrib pas bsgribasalgepa yi/ /kun gyi bsam pa 'gengs par byedabo/ /gzung 11ba dang ni 'dzin pa kun/ /bsgom pas spangs 3)shing rnam par spangs/ /'dis ni bsgoms pa thams cad kyis/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal mngon par brjod/ /de ltar re zhigatshwanyeganas byas nas/ /de nyid mi /4shigs rnal 'byor pas/ /rig ma'i lha mo 'dod pa yi/ /shin tu gzugs can bsdus nas bya/ /chus byung yid 'ong rin chen dang / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i nyams dga' 'gage/ / lha yi 8bu mo gnod sbyin lko 7/ /yang na klu mo rkang 'og tu/ /gnas pa dang ni lha min mo/ /'di nang yo gis7)rig ma 79wa 296

gcig /rang gi sems la mngon 'dod pa/ /lcags kyu zhags pa'i rab sbyor bas / /rnal 'byor pa yis bkug nas bsgrub①/ /nye bar dgos pa rgyas pa kun / /ma bslangs par ni lha yis ster/ /rga dang nad las rnam par grol/ /gnyis med gnas gsum sdig pa med/ /lus kyis〈sbyin pa byin nas ni/ /phyis ni spyod pa yang dag brtsam/ /skal dang skal medar rnam dpyad pas/ /de phyir sbyin pa sbyin mi⑧bya/ /bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba nyid/ /ji ltar rnyed pa bza' bar bya/ /yid 'ong mi 'ong rnam rtog phyir/ /zhen⑧pa tsam du mi bya'o/ /bslab dang dbang las rnam par grol/ /de bzhin ngo tsha'i bya ba nyid/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /yo gis rnam dpyad snying rje che/ /mchod sbyin sbyin sreg dka' thub 'das/ /sngags dang bsam gtan rnam par spangs/ /dam tshig sdomashelas rnam par grol/ /shin tu rnal 'byor ldan spyod kyis/ /nges par sngon du lha min gang / /brgya byin lta bu yin na yang / /de la 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /seng ge'i gzugs kyis7rnam par rgyu/ /sems can kun gyi7don gyi tshi phyir / /rtag tu snying rjes btung bar bya/ /rnal 'byor btung dga' rnal 'byor pa / /gzhan gyi〈nyebatung bas bzi ba med/ /yang na dpal ldan rgyal tshab che'i(rte /brtul zhugs7spyod pa bsgrag par bya8/ /gang gis dngos grub mthar 'gro ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sgom pa po yis rnam gzung 8ba/ /rna ba dag la rna cha bzang / /spyi bor 'khor lo rnam par 'dzin/ /lag pa dag la lag gdub nyid/ /rked pa la ni ska rags nyid/ /rkang par hu9de bzhin rkang gdub bo / /dpung pa'i rtsa bar dpung rgyan nyid/ /mgrin pa la ni nor bu ste/ /bgo ba stag gi pags〈nyepa nyid/ /bza' ba mi 'chi bcu phyed de/ /he ru ka sbyor skyes 79—297

bu nyid/ /mnyam par gzhaganyepas gnas par bya/ /shin tu bzhin bzang mig yangs ma/ /rang gis dbang bskur snying rje can/ /rdo rje'ikhubu mo 'di khyer nas / /spyod pa brtul zhugs rtogs par bya/ /rdo rje'ikhurigs kyi dngos med na/ /gang zhig rang gi 'dod pa'i50lha'i/ /rigs kyis kyang ni bya ba'o/ /yang na gzhan gyi rigs byung ba/ /byang chub sa bon bcug pa yis/ / sbyang bsnyebyas te khyer nas ni/ /gang tshe rdo rje mchog ldan par/ /de tshe glu ni blang bar bya/ /gang tshe dga' ba skyes pa na⑥/ /thar pa'i rgyur ni gar bya ste/ /de tshe rdo rje rkang pas gar/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pa yis bya/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyis7mi bskyod pal/ /rna rin)cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng bar7rin chen bdag /lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas / /shes rab kha ṭī ga gzugs can/ /thabs kyi gzugs kyis cang te'u//sman ni rnam par bza' bar bya/ /chu ni rtag tu btung bya ste/ /rga7shis zil gyis mi non cing / /kun tu bsrung 3)bar gyur pa de'itso/ /rkun ma'i spas kyangachacod pan bya8/ /de la hūm̐ byung sbyar bar bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi thod pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor spyod pas rnam par 'dzin/ /sor lnga'i dum bur byas nas ni/ /cod pan la ni rnam par 'dzin/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las/ /skra yi ska rags nyis skor nyid/ /thal ba spa yi mchod phyir thogs/ /rnal 'byor pa yi5)spyod pas 'dzin/ /cang te'u'i nyunyesgra ni bzlas pa ste/ /sems can thams cad mgronarwarteganyer ba'o/ /kha ṭī ga ni shes rab ste/ /rdo rje bzlas dang bsgom pa yin/ /thod pa can du rang gyur pa/ /brkam5nye dang rmongs dang de bzhin 'jigs(1)ske/ /khro dang ngo tsha'i bya ba ni/ /rtag tu rnam par spang bar bya/ /he ru 79wa 298

ka bdag rnal 'byor pa/ /rigs0)lnga la ni gnas par bya/ /rigs lnga dag dang mnyam par ldan②/ /rigs ni gcig tu rnam par brtag /rigs gcig du ma nyid kyis ni/ /gang phyir dbye bsaphubaskyed mi bya/ /bdag nyid kyis ni gnyid spangs nas/ /the tshom med par spyod pa0bya/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba las/ spyod pa'i brtag pa ste lnga pa'o// //lha lags nyan0par 'tshal lags na/ /rang byin brlab ⑦pa'i rim ci lags/ /gsang ba la sogs dgongs pa ci/ /rdo rje sems dpa'7snying rje che/ /yid ni gcig tu gyur pas7nyon/ /thams cad rgyud kyi gtan phab pa/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bsgrag par bya/ /e yi rnam pa gang gsungs pa/ /gnas kyi mtshan nyid mi gsal bar/ /'gro dang rjes su 'ong ba nyid/ /khams dang sems kyi rtag 'gro ba'o/ /khams zhes7bya ba'i sgra dutsolags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'di ltar gsang ba'i yi ge bcu drug brjod par bya ste/ ra yi rnam pa khrag gi khams/ /ha ni de bzhin reg bya nyid/ / phye ni bdahūkun zhes byar gsungs/ /pa yi rnam pa sems nyid dang / /ra yi rnam patsha8ro nyid de/ /me ni de bzhin lto tshil dag /ra ni me nyid du ni gsungs/ /me yi rnam pa sha ru gsungs/ /sa yi rnam pa bshang b.ratsogasungs/ /blo yi rnam pas de bzhin tshil/ /t+ma na pagasalge pa nyid du gsungs/ /ni yi rnam pas rus pa nyid/ /sa ni gci ba nyid du gsungs/ /dā du )yi rnam pas glo ba nyid/ /sbri ni pad+ma nyid du gsungs/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rdzas dang ldan/ /ta〈nyeyi rnam pas khu ba ni/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yin/ /rtsa yi sgra yi rang bzhin las/ /79—299

de ltar lha mo bsgrags pa yin/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las/ /cha yi bdag nyid 'gyur ba nyid/ /ra ni me zhes bya bar gsungs/ /khrag las mkhrisatupa yang dag langasal/ /mtshan nyid gcigashe'adod bad kun las/ /rdul dang chu rgyus yang dag byung / /de yi mgon por brjod pa'i rlung / /ha ni kun du 'gro bar gsungs/ /rus pa'i mtshams ni 'di rnams su/ /sa bon lnga ni yang dag btab/ /rkan du rasredang thams cad du/ /sa bon bzhi ni dam pa nyid/ /dang po'i re'u7mig gnas der ni/ /sa bon lnga ni mdzes pa nyid/ /ha ni dbyangs kyi drug ldan pa/ /rnam par shes par yongs su grags/ /ha yi rnam pas thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor/ /sgra yi tshul las byung bton zhing / /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul nyid/ /'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba/ /thog⑧ma dbus mtha' yang dag gnas/ /bsrubashedang srub byed sbyor ba lasal/ /ji lta ba ni de bzhin no/ /sngags bzlas bsam gtan la sogs ldan/ /rgyudakyilas gsungs pa mnyan par gyis/ /rtsa gnyis skye gnas dbus su ni/ /g.yon dang g.yas su de bzhin du/ /g.yon du khu ba rnam shes byam/ /g.yas pa la ni khrag nyid de/ /de yi phan tshun bsdu ba yang / /chos kyi dbyings ni sdud 37pa yin/ /snying stobs sku dang rdul dag bcas/ /mun pa sems kyi rang bzhin las/ /snying stobs khu ba rin chen rdul/ /mun pa skyed par byed pa nyid/ /rdo rje pad mo mnyam sbyor bas/ /dngos dang dngos med ro gcig 'gyur/ /bshang hurteb gci ba bad〈nyekan dang / /khrag dang lnga pa khu ba nyid / /bdud rtsi lnga yi gong bu'i yidangos/ /de phyir rdo rje can du brjod/ /rus pa rkang dang khu ba ni/ /pha las skyes par de bzhin gsungs/ /pags 8pa 79—300

dang ni sha dang khrag /ma las skyes pa zhes byaratubasgrags/ /gong bu'i bsdu ba rnams kyi yang / /tshad ni 'di dag gsungs pa ste/ /gong bu gcig pu gnyis su 'gyur/ /gnyis su gyur pa du ma rnams/ /gcig pu du ma'i rang bzhin gyis/ /de phyir rdo rje can 'dir gsungs/ /rtsa yi kun spyod minyid gsungs pa/ /de yi sgo yang de gnyis la/ /de rnams 'du ba'i dus su ni/ /lha ni dmigs par 'gyur ba yin/ /steng gi sgo dang 'og nyid de/ /'og gi sgo ni rnam par shes/ /steng gi sgo ni dbyings nyid do/ /rtsa ni thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'jug par bsam/ /de yi lus kyishesteng sgo la'ang / /rdo rje can gyi rtag rgyun bzhugs/ /steng gi sgor ni sbyor ba gsum/ /sgo dgu rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /kye bcom ldan 'das sbyor ba gsum ni ci zhes bshad/ /ji ltar gang gi rnam pa yis⑤/ /sems kyi rtag tu 'gro ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gsum nyid sbyor ba sbyor ba gsum/ /rnam gsum dbye bas rnam par gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /tha ma 'bring po dam pa nyid/ /ka ba gcig dang sgo dgu pa/ /sbom po lnga ni lhag pa'i lha/ /bug ⑥pa dgur ni son pa'i sgo/ /dgu yi rnam par yongs su grags/ /tha ma'i sgo ni skur ldan pa/ /sbom pos3)lha yi sprul pa'o/ /sems dang skyes bu skyes bu can/ /khyad par rnal 'byor pa yi don/ /rtag par kun du dus su ni/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i khyad par las/ /rkang med rkang gcig 7rkang gnyis dang / /rkang bzhi la ni sogs pa yi/ /rlung la sogs pas rab dbye bas/ /rtag tu 'gro ba rlung rnamatshwanyebazhi/ /sems kyi gnas pa rnam pa gnyis/ /nub dang rab rgyu'i cho ga yis/ /rtag tu nub dang rab rgyu ba/ /sems can kun la 'gro ba'o/ /79—301

de ltar gang zhig mi rig pa/ /sems med skyed bu med7pa dang / /yid dang ldan pa med pa dang / /rnal 'byor pa yi don med pa/ /me7nyid gang dang rlung dang ni/ /dbang chen dang ni de bzhin chu/ /'khor lorashesems kyi kun spyod pa / /steng dang ngos dang brangasnyi'og 'gro/ /zla ba nyi ma'i rab dbye bas/ /gsum pa'i sgo ni yid dang bcas/ /rngub dang dbyung ba gnyis ka yang / /sgo yi dam pa nyid yin te/ /gtso bo dam pa yi ni sgo/ /steng dang 'og tu rab tu grags / /'og gi sgos ni rnam par shes/ /steng gi sgos ni dbyings nyid de/ /rnam snang la sogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /steng gi sgor ni g.yo zhing gnas/ /de rnams 'og tu rnam par gnas/ /steng gis gshegs su gsol ba nyid/ / spyan drangasalgegashegs su gsol ba yi/ /tshul gyi sems kyis rtag tu 'gro/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma mo rnams/ /'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la/ /yon tan skyon ni rab brjodakyipas/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rang bzhin gyis/ /lhan cig skyes pa grub pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan lha mos ni/ / bol+la kukusko lar bcug nas/ /sems dpa' chen po mnyes byas te/ /tshig ni 'di dag yang dag gsol/ /dpyid ces bgyi ba ji ltar lags/ /thig le bgyi ba ji ltar lags/ /mi phyed lashesogs ji ltar gnas / /de yi gnas ni ji ltar lags/ /pul+lī ra sogs ci gsungs dang / /'khor lo dgodarwa1)pa de bzhin gzhan/ /ji ltar rtsa yi rdzogs pa yi/ /de yi dbye ba bdag la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /lha mo bshad par bya yisatshwa nyon/ /gsang ba las ni ches7shegasang mchog /rtsa'i 8rang bzhin 79—302

dang / gnas la sogs pa dang / sa bcu dang / pha rol tunyephyin pa'i sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi 'khor lor son pa gnas kyi nang gi rab tu dbye bas nyi shu rtsa bzhir gsungs pa/ /spyi bo mādzabal ya yi yul/ /de bzhin spyi gtsug 'bar ba 'dzin/ /de bzhin du ni o sgyun⑧nyid/ /rna ba g.yas pa nyid du brjod/ /rtsib ma'i rgyab ni arbu da④/ /bzhi ni gnas shes bya ba'o⑤/ /rna ba g.yon pa'i rang bzhin niyi/ /de bzhin go 'o⑩ba rir shes/ /dga' ba'i dbang phyug bshad pa ni/ /smin ma'i dbus gnasapo rab tu bskulaX/ /de bzhin mig dag lha mo'ikhemakhar/ /lag pa'i rtsa bar mā la ba/ /de ltar nye bar〈nyeganas nyid de/ /thugs kyi 'khor lor rnam par gnas/ /gnas kyi khyad par rang bzhin gyi/ /mkha' spyod rnams kyi5)yang dag bshad/ /mchan khung kā ma r+sha〈nyepa nyid/ /nu ma o draracharab tu grags/ /'di dag zhing du yang dag brjod/ /lte ba tri sha ku nir brjod/ /sna yi rtse mor ko shasnyi'/ /nye ba'i zhing du brjod pa'o/ /kha ni ka ling ku ru brjod/ /mgrin pa lam pa ka ru gsungs/ / tshan do ha zhes rnam par bshad/ /snying ni kāñtsir nyunyebarjod pa ste/ /dbang po hi ma la ya nyid/ /nye ba yi ni tshan dorarwacebarjod/ /de ltar yul rnams thams cad du/ /gsung gi 'khor lor rnam par gnas/ /gnas kyi khyad par yul gyi ni/ /sa spyod rnams kyi yang dag bshad/ /rtags sno )la yi dgas lhag par gnas/ /gsang ba la ni khyim gyi lha/ /'di dag 'du bar brjod pa'o/ /brla ni sau rāṣ+ṭa ru spebarjod/ /rje ngar gnyis ni gser gling gi/ /rang gi ngo boramanyarnam par bshad/ /nye ba yi ni 'du ba nyid/ /sor mo nāmanyag ra ru brjod/ /rkang pa'i rgyab ni sin dhur〈henges/ /dur khrod du ni yang dag brjod/ /mthe bong la ni ma 79wa 303

ru zer/ /pus7mo ku la rākhuru brjod/ /'di dag nye ba'i dur khrod nyid/ /mkha' 'gro mar ni gsungs pa'o/ /'di dag yul dang rang lus skyes/ /rang gi nang dang phyi rol gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir phye ba yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni〈bkun gyi gnas/ /thams cad du ni yang dag bshadarka/ /'di rnams gnas su mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtsa yi gzugs7kyis yang dag gnas/ /drug pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //de nas gzhan yang dam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ji ltar gnas su son pa'i rtsa'i 'khor lo bshad par bya'o/ /snying gi nang song pad+ma ni/ /'dabasnyem brgyad pa snying por bcas/ /de yi nang du son pa'i rtsa/ /mar me'i rang gi ngo bo can/ /chu shing gi ni me tog ltar/ /brkyang zhing kha ni 'og tu'o / /de yi nang gnas dpa' bo ni/ /yungs kur7gyi ni sbom phra tsam mi shigs hūm̐ gi77sa bon ni/ /kha ba lta bur 31'dzag pa nyid/ /lus can rnams kyi snying dga' ba/ /dpyid ces bya bar rnam par bshad/ /rgod ma'i me yinyegazugs kyis ni/ /bdag med ma ni thig ler brjod/ /las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni 'bar/ /dpyid thob pa yi chog shes pas/ /snyoms par 'jug pas rnam par gnas/ /dpa' bo shrī ni he ru ka /'di ni dpyid kyi thig ler brjod/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gzugs 'dzin ma/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu bcas par gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye bas ni/ /sgo ni rnam gsum 'byung ba las/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong bar byed/ /'di ni kun gyi lus la gnas / /lte bar a yi gzugs kyis ni/ /thung ngu ru ni rab tu grags/ /snying 79wa 304

la yang ni hūṃ nyid ni①/ /ring po ma mo gnyis dang gnas/ /mgrin pa50o gyi gzugs kyis ni/ /ma mo gsum brjod pasalu ta/ /dpral bar haṃ gisarnam pa 'di / /sgra dang thig le mi shigs pa/ /'khor lo bzhi yi55)rab dbye bas/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /thun bzhir byin gyis brlabs ni)pa dang / /pad+ma bzhi las byung ba dang / /dga' ba bzhi yi ngo bo yis/ /rnal 'byor bzhi ni mngon du'o/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i ngo bo yis/ /bya dang byed pa'i dngos po las/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /'di ni ji ltar bde bar rol//'dabasnyem rnams kyi bzhi shel yang / /'byung ba bzhi yi rtsa rnams ni/ /mar me'i rang bzhin lta bur ni/ /phyogs bzhi la ni rnam par gnas/ /rtsa rnams bzhi yang7mtshams rnams su/ /rnam par gnas shing der son pa'ang / /bdud rtsi lnga ni 'bab pa ste/ /de mchod rang gi gzugs gnas pas/ /de yi dngos po'i ngo bo las/ /mchod pa bzhi ni rnam par bshad/ /lus kyi snying gi nang du ni/ /rtsa lnga rnams ni rnam par gnas/ /sku gsung 37thugs kyi dbye ba yis / /nyi5)shu rtsa bzhi nye bar brjod/ /gnas sogs dbye ba la gnas nas/ /gnas dang gnas la rnam par gnas/ /spyi bor yang dag byung ba yi/ /rtsa ni spyi bo skyes zhes brjod/ /rdul dang snying stobs mun pa'i tshul/ /de yi nang nas gtso mo ni/ /pusgrisarar ni mi phyed ma/ /so dang sen mo 'bab par brjod/ /'bar ba 'dzin pa phra gzugs ma/ /de bzhin skra dang ba spu 'bab/ / o sgyunam8gnas ni chen po la/ /rtse ba ma ni rnam par gnas/ /rna ba g.yas par gnas nas ni/ /pagasam pa dri ma 'bab ma gnas/ /arbu dar ni g.yon pa ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni sha 'bab ma/ /gang zhig chu rgyus 'bab pa'i rtsa /ba yi mchog 79—305

sbyin rnam par gnas/ /de ni sra ba'i tshul gyis gnas/ /thung ngu mar ni rnam par bshad/ /gang zhig dga' ba'itudabang phyug tsotsho/ /de bzhin rus sbal skyes mar grags/ /sra ba'i dngos posalgeganas pa'i phyir/ /rus pa'i phreng ba 'khrugs par gnas/ /lha mo'i mkhar du gang zhig rtsa/ /'jam pa sgom pa ma ru brjod / /de ni rtag tu mchin pa 'bab/ /thams cad lus la rtag par gnas/ / mā la byabar ni dbang ma ni/ /rgyal ba'i dbang phyug snying la gnas/ /rtsa ni gang zhig mig 'bab ma/ /'dod pa'i gzugs su rnam par gnas/ /gzugs ni mthong bar 'dod pa ste/ /skyon bral ma zhes rnam par bshad/ o ḍirakyimakhris pa 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /gang zhig 'jug ma chen mor brjod/ /tro⑩sha ku nor byung ba ni/ /ma mo nges par glo bar bcas/ /ko sha lar ni mtshan mo nyid/ /rgyushema'i phreng bzang khyab cing 'bab/ /ka ling kur ni bsil sbyin ma/ /ngos kyi chu rgyus yang dag bshad/ /tsha ba ma ni lto gnas ngesal/ /lam pā kar ni rab tu grags/ /'bab5nyam nyid ni kāñtsir〈nyeganas/ /thams cad du ni bshang ba 'bab/ /mtshams kyi mtha' yi nang du yang / /kha ba'i〈nyeganas su rangs ma'ichagadong / /shin tu gzugs can bad kun ldan/ /yi dgas lha gnas yang dag gnas/ /gang zhig rtag tu rnag 'bab pa/ /khyim gyi lhar ni yang dag gnas / /mkha' 'gro dam pa'i dbang phyug gisatso/ /spyi ma nyid du rnam par bshad / / sau rāṣ+ṭar ni7gang zhig rtsa/ /rgyu0)sbyin ma ni dmar po 'bab/ /rdul ni 'bab par gyur pa ninyushe/ /gser gling du ni yang dag bshad/ /yan lag gzi brjid kun khyab ma/ /sbyor bral mar5)ni rab tu grags/ /nā ga rar ni sdu gu ma/ /tshil can sbom zhing myos byed 'bab/ /sin dhurarwa )shin tu grub padza te79—306

nyid/ /mya ngan mchispyim 'bab mar brjod/ /ma rur5miganas ma lud skam 'bab/ /'tshed pasam zhes rnam par bstan/ / gu lu tār5geni yid bzangasam/ /sha dang snabs ni 'bab ma'o6/ /drug pa las yul gyi dgod pa ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //lha lags mnyanate⑦par 'tshal lags na/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor mchod pa 'khaske/ /sogs pa'i las ni ji ltar lags/ /sbyin sreg las ni mi 'tshal bas6) /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /he ru ka la sogs pa'i lha/ /rtsa gzugs mdzes par yang dag byung / /lus kyi dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar/ /sgo bzhir nya tshoji skad gsungs pa'o/ /rang gi yan lag brgyad byung bas/ /ka ba de yis bskor nas gnas/ /dngos po kun gyis mnyam pa'i phyir/ /gru bzhi par ni rab tu grags/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bos ni(nya/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gcig tu gsungs/ /ri 7ni mgo bo'i ze 'bru la/ /ji ltar rtsom chen la sogs rim/ /bla ma'i dus thabs rim nyid〈nyekyis/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gnas/ /rkang pa'i mthil midu rtsom chen rlung | /gzhu yi dbyibs su rnam par gnas/ /sum mdo yi ni gnas su ni/ /de bzhin gru gsum 'bar ba nyid/ /zlum po'i rnam pa'i dbyibasam kyis ni/ /chu ni lte bar rnam par gnas/ /snying gar7yang ni sa nyid de/ /kun nas gru bzhi pa nyid do/ /sgal〈nyetshigs dbyug gu'itshwa gzugs kyis ni/ /ri rab ri rgyal de bzhin no/ /derarwateni spyi bo'i char gnas pa/ /'dam skyes 'dabasngo dzom sum bcu gnyis / /dbyangs dang gsal byed mdzes par gnas/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis byang 79—307

chub 'dod/ /pad+ma'i nang du son pa gang / /de ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor brjod//spyi bo'i nang du klad pa ni/ /gang zhig gnas pa de ru gsungs/ /de nang haṃ giturnam pa nyid/ /thig le'i gzugs can mi shigs pa/ /'jig rten kun gyi rtsa ba de / /brtan pa'i bdag nyid g.yo ba'i bdag /gsal dang mi gsal gzugs las ni/ /sa bon gzugs kyi〈rnam par gnas/ /lus can rnams ni kun gyi gzugs / /de phyir gdod nas rdzogs pa nyid/ /bdud rtsi'i gzugs kyis 'dzag par ni/ /nyin dang mtshan du rnam par gnas/ /de nyid kyis ni sgra 'byed cing / /me ni dga' bar byed pa ste/ /des ni gang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni / /yin pa nyid du the tshom med/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor zhes byar gsungs/ /dngos po rnams kyi snying po mchog /de ni len cing gcod pa'i phyir/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod/ /rtsa chen sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi / /'khor lorasheyang ni dkyil 'khor brjod/ /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /phyi rol bcas pa'i nang gzugs kyis⑤/ /sna tshogs khyab cing rnam par gnas/ /phyi rol gzugs dang sgra la sogs/ /dbang po thams cad 'jug pa'o/ /nang gi 0khu ba la sogs pa/ /grub pa'i rdzas ni rnam par gnas/ /phyi rol bcas pa'i nang nyid kyis/ /rdo rje can gyi byang chub sems / /sbom dang phra ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyisherang bzhin can / /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dam tshig don du gsungs pas ni / /dkyil 'khor goms pas skye ba 'dir/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni thob par 'gyur / /nyan thos rnams kyi chos)sangs rgyas dang / /de bzhin rang rgyal rnams kyi dang ske/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor goms pas rdzogs pa 79—308

nyid / /shes rab me ni cher 'bar bar/sna/ /nang gi khu ba la sogs dang / /de bzhin phyi rol gzugs sogs kyil/ /bsreg rdzas kyis ni sbyin sreg bya/ /skye mched drug dang khams rnams dang / /phung po la sogs khyad par las de rnams kyi ni gzugs can lha/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro ma nyid ni/ /des ni de mchod gang gisaphyir/ /rnal 'byor mchod par yang dag bshad/ /thod pa 'di ni mgo bo nyid/ /bsregasardzas kyi ni snod du gsungs/ /blugs gzar⑥ro mar bshad pa ste/ /snying gi 'khor lo brkyangasañtsa)ma dag /dgang gzar zhes byar57yang dag brjod/ /thab khung lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa yi/ /tshangs pa'i me ni sum mdor gnas/ /sgra ni sngags zhes 3)brjod pa ste/ /bzlas pa 'khor bar byed pa yin/ /bsgom pa mtshungs par snang ba nyid / /dkyil 'khor gnyis med rnal 'byor phyir/ /lhan cig skyes pa zhon pa 'di / /'disheni rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po'i gzugs kyi phyir/ /slob dpon sems kyi rgyal po nyid/ /de skad la sogs ci gsungs pa/ /rgyud ni thams cad rtogs par bya/ /da dung bdag la the tshom mchis / /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang / /bde ba chen po'i gzugs kyis ni / /mgon po ji ltar rol bar 'gyur/ /de rnams dbye ba mi 'tshal bas /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /spyi bo lterarwaskreson 'khor lo ni/ /e yi dbyibs su yang dag gnas/ /snying dang mgrin par yang dag gnas/ /bam̐ gi nyu2rnam pa lta bur brjod/ /lte ba'i nang gnas pad+ma ni/ /'dab tsho/—snyem drug cu rtsa bzhir ldan/ /'dam skyes 'dabatsom sum cu gnyis/ /spyi bo'i nang du rnam par gnas/ /mgrin pa'i nang du son pa 79wa 309

yang ske/ /pad+ma lo ma bcu drug nyid/ /de yi snying ga'isheganas su ni/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad du brjod/ /'dabasnyem drug cu rtsa bzhi nyid/ /sprul pa la ni rab tu grags/ /pad+ma chen po 'dabashebargyad par/ /chos kyi sku0ni rab tu bskor / /longs spyod rdzogs pa bcu drug rtsibs/ /de bzhin 'dab ma sum cu gnyis / /bde chen ye shes chen po la/ /kun tu yang dag rnam par gnas/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /sde tshan brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ /yig 'bru dang po'i ngo bo yis/ /'di ni a ste yi ge mchog /chos kyi 'khor lor rnam bshad pa/ /r+ghaṃ ni mi shigs pa ru brjod/ /dbyangs lnga dang0ni yang dag ldan / /ya ra la was rnam par brgyan/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i nang gnas pa/ /oṃ ni yig 'bru gsal bar byed/ /cha ni rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /kun tu yongs su bskor ba'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo chen po la/ /rtasani thig le'i gzugs can no/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i ngos dag la/ /zla ba nyi ma rnam par bshad / /mgrin pashenas brtsams g.yon pa'i rtsa/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku can ma/ /lte ba'i nang du ngal sos shing / /kha ni 'og tu myos byed 'bab/ /gang zhig lte ba las stengs7) rtsa/ /de bzhin kha ni steng du 'bab/ /mgrin pa'i nang du ngal sos shing / /khrag 'bab par ni rab tu grags/ /myos byed zla ba zhes byar bshad/ /khrag ni nyi ma zhes byar gsungs/ /sgo gnyis mnyam par zhon〈spenas ni/ /steng dang 'og tu mnyam gnas pa/ /'di dag zla ba nyi ma gnyis / /rtsa ni gnyis su rab tu grags/ /dpa' bo rnams dang mkha' 'gro ma'i / /'gro ba dang ni 'ong ba'i rgyur(nye/ /nub pa dang ni 'char don dang7/ /log dang sad pa lta bur gsungs/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i ngos la ni/ /79—310

dbyangs ni bcu gnyis yang dag gnas/ /kha ni steng du yang dag bshad/ /ka la sogs pa rnams kyis bskor/ /kha ni 'og gi gnas su gnas/ /lhag par byas nas sbyar ba nyid/ /k+ṣa ni srin po nyid gsungs pa/ /'og gi char ni rnam par gnas/ /gang tshe mgrin par chags chen gyi/ /gzugs kyi zla ba gnas pa na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dam pa'i sku/ /de tshe longs spyod rdzogs par bshad/ /gang tshe rdo rje'i rtser gnas pa①/ /de tshe de na ni sna rtser ro/ /gang tshe longs spyod rdzogs sku yang / /nub par gnas par gyur pas min/ /bha ga'i⑧nang du son de yang / /yungs kurasnyitsam du rnam par gnas/ /nyi ma'i gzugs su yang dag bshad/ /sprul pa'i skur ni brjod pa ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /spros pa de yis bskyed pa 'o/ /pad+ma gar dbang rgyal po ni/ /'dabalgem 'byed7pa'i sbyor ba can/ /sprul pa'isngo'isku yi gzugs su ni/ /der ni nyi ma nub pa na/ /gang tshe rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /gong bur gyur pa rtog pa med/ /'khor ba'i lam ni rnam bcad cing / /spros pa nyer zhicadage ba ste/ /gnyis med mchog tu dag pa nyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs/ /shrī ni he ru ka zhes brjod(rte/ /rgyud ni srin bu'i gzugs can nyid / /rgodachadang lta dang lag bcangs nyid/ /rgyud durwanyede nyid rnam par gnas / /'dod chags nyid dang chags bral yang / /zos nas srin bu gnas pa nyid/ /rtsa thams cad kyi mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba'i sdom pa ste drug pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po rdzo/stel sogs pa dang /79—311

rnal 'byor ma bdag med ma la sogs pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'khor lo'i bsgomatsho)pa'i lam dang ni/ /lha rnams ji ltar 'byung ba dang / /mkha' 'gro'i 'khor lo'i khyad par②dang / /dgongs pa'i skad kyisakhyad par ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sngar gsungs na/ /sdom pa'ang bdag la bshad du gsol//bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rnal 'byor ma lus dbus gnas par/ / a yi7rnam par sdom pa'i gnas/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /sdom pa de nyid rab tu phye/ /bo la'i bde ba phyag rgya che/ /rdo rje skye mched thams cad nyid / /'dis ni gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug pas/ /phyi rol gnyis gnyis bstan pa med/ /sku gsum lus kyi nang du ni/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyis brjod par bya / /sku gsum yongs su shes pa las/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor brjod/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang / /de bzhin bde ba chen po nyid/ /skye gnas mgrin snying dbus su ni/ /sku gsum po ni rnam par gnas/ /ma lus pa yi sems can gyi/ /skye ba gang la brjod bya ba/ /gang zhig sprul pa gnas brtan phyir / /de la sprul pa'i sku nyid yin/ / sems ni chosalakyi rang bzhin te/ /chos kyi sku yang snying gar ni yin/ /ro rnams drugashegi gzugs can gyi/ /bza' ba nges par longs spyod brjod/ /chos rnams kun la gnas brtan phyir//thams cad yod pa'i rang bzhin can/ /mgrin par longs spyod 'khor lo dang / /bde ba chen po spyi bor gnas/ /e bo rnam pa rgyu mthun nyid/ /rnam smin chos kyi 'khor lo las/ /skyes bu byed pa longs spyod la/ /bde chen 'khor lor dri med nyid/ /rgyu mthun la sogs rab dbye bas/ /'bras bu rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod / /las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis/ /lasarwasnro la bcom ldan shes rab 79—312

brjodam/ /gang zhig sprul pa gnas brtan phyir/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo gnas brtan brjod/ /chos ni ngag las byung ba'i phyir/ /'khor lo thams cad yod par smra/ /gang zhig mgrin par7kun bkur phyir/ /longs spyod 'khor lorakhukun bkur nyidani/ /gang zhig bde chen mgor rigeganas phyir/ /bde chen 'khor lor dge 'dun che/ /sde pa sku zhes brjod pa ste/ /lto ba gnas su brjod par56ribya / /skye gnas 'dod chags bral ba nyid/ /mngal gyi phru mem chos gos te/ /de bzhin ma ni mkhan po nyid/ /mgo bor thal mo sbyar ba phyag /'gro ba'i bya ba khrims kyis gnas/ /de bzhin sngags bzlas a dang haṃ/ /sngags 'don skyes pa dege slong nyid/ /gcer7bu skra dang kha spu bregs/ /'di rnams rkyen gyis sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /zla ba bcu yang sa rnams te/ /sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug go/ /btsun mo'i bha7)ga bde can du/ /khu ba zhes bya rnam par gnas/ /de med pas na bde med 'gyur/ /bde ba spangs na de med 'gyur/ /nus pa med phyir ltos dang bcas/ /lha yi rnal 'byor las bde ba/ /de phyir sangs rgyas dngos po min/ /de nyid dngos med tshul yang77min / /zhal phyag rnam parwaskyegazugs can nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba 3gegazugs med pa/ /de phyir 'gro kun lhan cig skyes/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin brjod / /rnam dag rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni mya ngan 'das / /zhal phyag kha dog dbyibs las ni/ /lha yi gzugs kyi nyu rnal 'byor ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas/ /'on kyang bag chags phal78pas so/ / lha mos de skadasnyibashad pa ni/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi gong na med/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma bdag med ma la sogs 8lha mo thams cad la 'di lta ste/ spyan ma hu shwe73—313

dang / mā ma tī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma dang / khro gnyer can dang ske/ skul7byed ma dang / ri khrod ma shing lo can dang / 'og zhal ma dang /sdom pa ma dang / de dag la sogs pa ri rab kyi rdul phra rabasredang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams mchog tu ngo mtshar bar gyur cing brgyal ba dang / skrag par gyur to/ /de nas mi bskyodashepa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi7tshogs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bslang du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/rnal 'byor ma thams cad bslang ba'i phyir 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang blo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de bsal nas ⑦ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das de de bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu/ gang zhig mi shes 'jig rten pa/ /btsan dug zos pas brgyal bar 'gyur/ /rmongs spangs de nyid yid kyis ni/ /de yi de nyid yongs su gcod / /dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis/ /skye bo thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dug gi de nyid shes pa des/ /dug gis dug ni 'bigs par byed/ /ji ltar rlung gis zin de la/ /ma sha'i5sebaza' ba sbyin par bya/ /ldog0)pa'i sman ni brtagasasngo )pa las/ /rlung gis rlung lam/nyasnun par byed/ /so sor rtog las rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyisatshwa srid dag byed/ /ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa/ /chu gzhan gyis ni dgug par bya/ /de bzhin dngos po'i rnam rtog kyang / /rnam par nges pas〈rtesbyang bar bya/ /ji ltar 'tshed gepas tshig pa la/ /yang ni me yis gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig pa/ /'dod chags meshe73—314

yis gdung bar bya/ /skye bo mi bzad7pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol 'gyur/ /'dod chags kyis ni 'jig rten 'ching / /'dod chags nyid kyis rnam par gro'akho/ /bzlog pa'i sgom pa 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes/ /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin las/ /kun du ru las7lnga ru 'gyur/ /dga' ba chen po gcig nyid lasadu/ /dbye bas lnga ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bol+la0rkak+ko la sbyor bas/ /reg pa sra ba'i bag chags kyis/ /sra ba gti mug chos yin phyir / /gti mug rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /gang phyir byang sems gsher ba nyid / /gsher ba chu yi khams su brjod/ /chu ni mi bskyod ngo bo'i phyir/ /zhe snang 'dren pa mi bskyod pa/ /gnyis kyi bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /rtag tu drod ni skye bar 'gyur/ /'dod chags dpag med rdo rje yin/ /'dod chags drod las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /kuskokhular ni gang zhig sems/ /de ni rlung gi rang bzhin can/ /don yod rlung las 'byungaphuba'i phyir/ /phrag dog don yod grub pa yin/ /bde ba 'dod chags sems yin te/ /rin chen khrag dang 'dod chags nyid/ /ser sna nam mkha' las byung ba/ /nam mkha'aphroser sna rdo rje yin/ /sems ni chen po gcig nyid la/ /lnga yi gzugs kyis mtshon pa nyid//rigs ni lnga po skyes pa lngayi/ /de la stong phrag du ma nyid/ /de phyir 'di dag rang bzhin gcig /bde chen mchog tu phan pa nyid/ /'dod chags la sogs sems lnga yis/ /dbye bsarwatelnga ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang gā'i klung ni bcu yi5nyebye ma snyed/ /rigs gcig la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /rigs chen lnga5nyeni rigs ni du ma rnams/ /de rnams rigs las brgya phrag du ma rnams/ /79—315

de rnams la yang 'bum phraganyerigs chen rnams/ /byesheba'i rigs la grangs ni med par 'gyur/ /de la rigs la grangs med rigs rnamasashenyid/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rigs las byung ba rnams/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /'dir gsol pa/ci gong bu'i gzugs can 'di tsam du'ang chung ba de snyed kyi rang bzhin du 'gyur ba cikyilags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ / skra yi khyon tsam phra ba la / /sangs rgyas zhing khams du ma ni/ /gnas dang dog dang 'dzer min pa/ /de bzhin 'dir yang blta bya ste/ /stobs bcu dag dang ldan pa'i⑧lha/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bdag gi ni/ /sdum par ston mo bzhes par 'tshal//rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis rigs kyi bu/ /yang dag byung ba bka' stsal pa⑦/ /yang dag sbyor byung sematshan nyid ni/ /bshad par7bya yis lha mo nyon/ /gsang ba la ni sa yi khams/ /mchog la de bzhin du ni chu/ /dgyes pa la ni me ru bshad//thams cad bdag nyid rlung la gnas/ /rtag tu bzhugs par brjodarwa)pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa bdag /yang na me long lta bu'i tshul/ /de bzhin du yang mnyam pa nyid/ /so sor 32rtog pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /de bzhin bya ba nan tan la/ /rtag tu bzhugs par brjod pa 'di/ /shin tu rnam dag rang bzhin can / /de bzhin rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ /gzhan yang mi bskyod pa nyid dang ske/ /yang na rin chen 'byung gnas dang hunye/ /yang na 'od dpag med pa yis / /gang tshe rtag bzhugs don yodamatshel/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi gong bu'isko7dngos//thig le'i77gzugs te yid lta bu/ /shin tu yang 3 tshodag ye shes zanye/ /lha mo kun gyi rang bzhin can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byar bshad/ /bde ba dam pa ru ni brjod/ /rang byung ngo bo 'di nyid ni/ /chos kyi skur ni rab tu grags/ /73—316

de yi7shes rab lhan cig skyes/ /de phyira'i gnas5kyepa'i gzugs can ma/ /las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis④/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni 'bar/ /bdag med ma0zhes rnam par bshad/ /dpyid kyi thig le nyid du brjod/ /spa yi rtse mo brgya stong lus/ /glog7gi zer ma mnyam pa'i 'od/ /lha yi rnal 'byor dus su ni / /ba spu'i khung bu'i rtse bug〈penas/ /phyogs bcur rnam par phyung nas ni/ /kun tu lha dang lha min bsdigs/ /snying la〈8)chos kyi 'khor lor ni/ /bsregs nas longs spyod 'khor lor songalonye/ /sna yi bu ga g.yas pa nas/ /thams cad du ni phyung nas ni/ /mdzod spur song ba dag gis kyang / /bug pa nges par phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /shangs kyi bu ga g.yon par ni/ /zhugs nas spyi gtsug 'khor lor ni/ /kun bsregs rnam par phyung nas ni/ /sngar gsungs nyid kyi bug pa nas/ /yang ni spyi gtsug zhugs par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bsregs pa yis(te/ /dga' ba de nas bskyed par bya/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor phyin nas ni/ /snga ma bzhin du gnas par 'gyur/ /yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rgyud chen po las dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po ste drug pa'o// //ngag gi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ni/ /bcom ldan bdag ni nyan par 'tshal/ /dgongs pa'i skad ni ci zhes bgyi/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rtag dam tshig /nyan thos la sogs mi shes pa/ /rgod sna dang lta ba dag gis kyang / /'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis rtsegs/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /dgongs pa'i skad ni ma bsgrags pa/ /bcom ldan nges par gsung nya du gsol/ /73—317

dgongs pa'i skad ni skad chen posti/ /dam tshig brda ni rgyas pa ru/ /rdo rje snying po ngas bshad kyis(ge/ /de nyid rtse gcig sems kyis nyon/ /ma da na chang ba la sha /'du ba mā (kyil ya dza nyid/ /'gro ba khes ④ro ni shra ba/ /rus pa'i rgyan ni ni phyir shu(ye/ /'ong ba phro ka ṇa meru brjod/ /cang te kri pri ta meru brjod/ /skal med du du ra zhes bshad/ /skal ldan kā lidzi ro ⑨brjod/ /reg min ḍo ⑩ ḍi ma zhes brjod/ /thod pa pad+ma bha dza rna/ /bza' ba ti pri tar ⑩shes bya/ /tshod ma mā la tin dha phonyerna/ /bshang ba tsa tum mi hunyebarjod/ /gci ba /sna 8ri zhes brjod/ /rang byung sih+lar shes par bya/ /khu ba ga bur brjod par bya/ /sha chen shā mali dza zhes brjod/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor kun du ru/ /rdo rje bol+la ⑩zhes brjod de/ /pad+ma 8kak+ko la zhes zer/ /mu khi/ sor mo kha ru bcug pa ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi (1snyematshan ma'o/ /gho 376/ thal mo spyi bor 0 yang dag gzhag⑥/ /mar me ma yi sa mtshan ma'o/ /ghu ghu/ mthe bong hu nyergan po bcangs ④pa ni/ /'jib bubyed ma yi du sematshan ma'o/ /mu rngo 7ku/ lag pas rna ba ( nyebadebs pa ni/ /g.yo ldan ma yi mtshan ma nyid/ /lu 62rte/ sna rtser thal mo brdebs sgo )pa ni/ /dge ba'i da1gtam ni 'dri ba'o/ /draṣ+ṭa ri dgas mgo zhu ston pa/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dgematshan mar mtshon/ /ḍa zhes bya ba skyes bur nges/ /ḍi 0ni bud med de nas brjod/ /bu zhes bya bar sa rengs pa nyid/ /su ni de bzhin za ba nyid/ /ma zhes bya ba ma ru brjod/ /yo ni de bzhin chung mar nges/ /bhi zhes bya ba sring mo nyid/ /dhi zhes bya ba mdza' mor brjod/ /lu zhes bya ba bu mor nges/ /s+t+ri ni khrag tu shes par bya/ /sa da tshoni zhi ba'i btung ba nyid/ /pe du zhes bya ba btung ba da ste/ /bi 8 )zhes bya ba nges par sha 1 /bha zhes bya ba bza' bar brjod/ /bhu 79wa 318

zhes bya ba 'du ba nyid/ /bi zhes bya ba dur khrod nyid①/ /bhu zhes bya ba ro ru ②brjod/ /ḍi ③zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma/ /ga ni de bzhin lā mā ④nyid/ /s+t+ri ⑤zhes bya ba gzugs can ma/ /ku ⑥zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma/ /kha zhes bya ba dum skyes ma/ /dza zhes bya ba byin pa zung / /ke ⑦zhes bya ba lag pa gnyis/ /bha zhes bya ba phyag 'tshal ba/ /swā lani legs 'ongs ⑨bya ba yin/ /'di rnams ni yi ge re re zhing yang brda ⑩ste/ dpa' bo dang sring mor des shes par bya'o/ /yi ge'i ⑩dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i ye shes so/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ ngag gi brda 0ni mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos hu bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bshad bya ba/ /de ni nga yis ④bshad kyis ⑩nyon/ /po rta gi zhes bya ba ni ⑩phyag go/ /pra ti po rta gi zhes bya ba ni phyag gi lan no/ /ga mu zhes bya ba ni 'gro ba zhes brjod par 'gyur ro/ /lum pa ⑩zhes bya ba ni 'ong ba nyid do/ /ni ga raṃ zhes bya ba ni byin cig ces brjod par 'gyur ro/ / tsartsa ka nyunyezhes bya ba ni khyer cig ces brjod pa yin no/ /hri da ya zhes bya ba ni dpa' bo zhes bya ba (rteyin no/ /kau ra ba zhes bya ba ni gsod rdu )pa zhes brjod pa yin no/ /kurnyi maka zhes bya ba ni dril bu zhes brjod pa yin no/ /a li ka ra ngaṇa zhes bya ba ni spyi bo 2rtezhes brjod pa yin no/ /ba ra ha zhes bya ba ni skra snyizhes brjod pa yin no/ / shra ba ṇa 9zhes bya ba ni rna ba'o/ /mjo 0zhes bya ba ni bdud rtsi'o/ /na ra zhes bya ba ni mnyam par sbyor ḍa snab zhes brjod pa yin no/ /tā tsha nyeli kā ‘ )zhes bya ba ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /nā snye byer ka zhes bya ba ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /a mu kai shenyazhes bya ba ni dur khrod do/ /kā khi la zhes bya ba ni sgo'o/ /swa sa ṇi 6zhes bya ba ni bram ze'o/ /pa ri dhi ni rgyal rigs so/ /73—319

bi ra ti ri ①ni rje'u rigs so/ /kru ra zhes bya ba ni dmangs rigs so/ /an+ta7ni gdol pa'i rigs so mi/ /a li ka nisaphyugs so/ /bha gi nisheni mkha' 'gro ma'o / /mu da rka ni tshil bu'o/ /grit+nal)zhes bya ba ni phyag rgya'o/ /dan+ta spar+sha ti dzi hwa gshezhes bya ba ni ⑨bkres so zhes brjod pa yin no/ /ghan+da pa nyi ni sred pa'o / / ā ga ma 3nyan zhes bya ba ni gan du'o/ /55nyen〈nyezhes bya ba ni che ge mor rol/ /ki ra ṇa skoni me tog go/ /lam po ni 'jigs pa'o/ /dan+ta ni rgod pa zhes brjod pa yin no/ /ni ro dha 32ni char pa'o/ /bi dzān+ta ni chog par 'dzin pa'o / /dhu mā ni sprin no/ /dhu mra pri ya dang / sā nu ni7ri'o/ /sa ri to ni chu bo'o/ /oṃ gu l+ya ni yan lag dang nying lag go/ /ba da rna ni〈shekha'o/ / rā dzi kā nyurteni lce'o/ / a da nā du )ni so'o/ / paṃ ka ti51ni rgyal mtshan no/ /ts+tshan doke ni phreng ba'o/ /tsa la ni rlung ngo / / mṛ ku5nyepa ti ni phyugs so/ /maṇ+ḍa du stel ni mnyam pa'o/ /swā du ges ni lam gyi 39bzhi mdo'o/ / phal gu sha ni skye bo'o( nye/ /ma hā k+ṣa ra ni phyugs chen po'o/ /ts+tsha ni ra'o/ /na zhes bya ba ni skyes pa'o/ /go zhes bya ba ni ba glang ngo / /ma zhes bya ba ni ma ho'o/ /gi )zhes bya ba ni bza' ba'o/ /has1zhes bya ba ni rnam grangs so/ /a phya ku zhes bya ba ni rgyal po'i skyes bu'o/ /s+tha ri /zhes bya ba ni gnas so/ /mu kha spar+sha5sten ni zos so zhes bya ba'o 'u/ /dan+ta spar+shabacan ni 'grangasam)so zhes bya ba'o(nya/ /ho zhes bya ba ni gang yang rnam grangs so/ / trī ka du rteni ngo tsha ba'o/ /shu morgya spar+sha ne ni mi thu na57gyis shig ces bya ba'o82/ /u ru spar+sha ne ni de lta dang ltar gyis shig ces bya ba'o (4la/ /ngag gi brda yi g.ye shes so/ /mnyam par drag shul dpral ba can/ /rtag tu ltung bar byed par brjod/ /dbang gi lta nyastangs g.yon na gnas/ /79wa 320

g.yon pa na7ni gzugs brnyan gnyis/ /g.yas pa'i cha la dgug pa nyid/ /gnyis ni steng du sbyar bar byal/ /dbu ma rengasalgepa'i ltasastangs nyid/ /sna yi rtse mo'i dbus su gnyis/ /dud 'gro'i ltadzabastangs gsad7pa la/ /sna yi rtse mor gzugs brnyan gnyis/ / 'byung ba nyid kyis lhung bar byed/ /bum pa yis ni dbang du byed/ / dgang ba yis ni 'gugs58)pa nyid/ /zhi ba nyid kyis rengs par byed/ /rlon pa'i shing la ltung byed nyid/ /me tog la ni dbang du grags / /rdo rje shing la dgugashepa nyid/ /g.yo bcas rtsa la rengs byed nyid/ /zla drug goms pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /'di la 'khrul bar mi bya ste/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab/ /slob dpon gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas317/ /shin tu phyag 'tshal dpal ldan ni/ /rdo rje sems sogs rnal 'byor gyis/ /g.yas pa'i smin ma sgyur tshul gyis/ /nam mkhar 'gro b.rarwa bsgoms pas ni/ /gang zhig gnas pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /g.yon pa'i smin sgyur pha rol gyi/ /sde las mchog tu rgyal bar 'gyur/ /bdud kyi dpung ni gzhom pa'i phyir/ /de nyid kyi ni rnal 'byor gyis/ /g.yon pa'i migatsobasgul zhes bya bas/ /dkar mo la sogs gzugs bsgoms pas/ /der ni rdzogs nas grub par 'gyur/ /g.yas pa'i mig bsgul zhes bya bas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems sogs kyis/ /skyes bu'i gzugs ni rdzogs par 'gyur/ /ngag gi tha snyad ma gtogs par/ /'jig rten rab tu grags pa yi/ /tha snyad du yang 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ltar yi ges 'jig rten dang / /'jig rten 'das par bsdus patshatshe'agrub/ /legs par bshad pa'i dngos grub po/ /lta stangs kyi phyag rgya'i ye shes so/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems sbyor zhing / /ji ltar dbyibs kyi 79—321

sku ldan pas/ /'dir ni mi7yi thod pa yikho/ /yungs kur7cho ga bzhin du gdab / /btsos pa'i mar khu bza' byas shingasre/ /mgo bo 'bras bus de bzhin byugs/ /phyogs mtshams nam mkha' sa bcings pas/ /bsrungasheb kun gyi0)gong na med/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems sbyor zhing / /tshems ni bsdams shingate⑨zhal btsums pas/ /dpal ldan g.yon pa bsgyings 'dzin cing / /g.yas par 'khor lo phyogs tshul gyis/ /gsal bar steng 'og byin gyis brlab/ /sa la rang gi phyag rgya bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos dngos grub sbyin/ /skye ba gnyis pa'i thod par 'di btab nas/ phyi nas ni mi'i 7thod par ro/ /de nas blangs nyu1 nas bud med dang / skyes pa dang / ma ning la sogs pa dang /khwa dang / bug pa dang / bya rgod dang / mchil pa'i dngos grub sna tshogs byed do/ /'ol ma zi nyurtedakar po sgrub 8pa'i cho gas kyangs/ 'dod na glang po dang ske/ rta'i gzugs 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / 'dod na ba glang dang / ma he'i gzugs 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / 'dod na khyi dang / byi la dang /ce4spyang gi gzugs 'dzin par 'gyur ba dang / 'dod na bud med dang /skyes pa'i gzugs 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /ro'i kha'i bug pa'i nang du son pa'i pu ra nag po 1 moro bsregs pa'i mesatshwa mar ngo'i 'byung po'i nyi ma la gdungs shing bdug pa byin na 'gro ba ma lus pa 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /ka na5)ka'i 'bras bu dang / a lo ka dang /nu / ma tu lung 31ga dang / tsi tramanyaka dang / ba tsa ka 2nyedang / khyim bya'i sgo tshong dang / arka'i ri la'abras bu rnams thams cad bdug 27pa las/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i 'jig rten kun 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /rta gsod pa skya 2 7bo'i rtsa ba dang / nyi ma'i ljon shing dang / phe chag〈nyepa dang /79wa 322

sdig pa'i rnga ma dang / dug tu nges pa'i brgya'i cha dang ldan pa/ 'dis de rnams cha bsnyams te lag pa la byugs na ba glang gi snar 'gyur ro/ /dinyen ka ra'ikhu'o mas bā na ri nyi ma bdun du byugs nas nags kyi mi zhag bdun sbangs te/de bzhin du kha ṭi0kas bris pa'i lag pa dag gis reg na klu'i dbang po'i dug 'byin⑧par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i phyir bzlog pa sbyin par bya ste/ mā rgyal ya las byung ba dang / nā ga ge sar dang / nad kyi dbang po dang / ma da na7pha la dang / chosagu'i yul dang / ta 157ra dang ldan par 'bras kyi chu dang ldan pas 'gro ba'i dug sna tshogs 'jig par byed do/ /de'i nyin par skyes7pa'i byis pa'i ro tsa na tamanyaka ra'i snying por gnas pa'i ril bu 12zos na lag na rdo rje lta bur ji ltar 'dod par dug btung bar bya'o/ /sbal pa dang / sbrul gdong gnyis pa'i tshil0nyebu bsdus la gle smri'i shing gi 'bras bu 'dis lag pa la thestebyugs pasal/ reg na dug zhi bar byed do/ /ba'i mar dang / badzi 3lhadang / ba nyi'i 8khrag dang / sbrul mgo gnyis pa'i sha dang / sgalam tshigs kyis lag pa la byugs na gnas gsum gyi yang 3shedug med par byed do/ /gcer bu la sogs pa'i cho gas 3)mnyam par bzhag ci — )pas/ bā la ma'i rtsa ba cha bdun du byas nas/'byung po'i nyi mdza telag pa la bcings na nyin bzhi pa 'jig par byed do/ /lto 'phye'i dbang po'i shun pa sar pa dang / lto 'phye'i dgra'i gshog du 2pa'i cha dang ldan par bdug〈 rtepa dang ldan pa tsam gyis 'jig rten gsum po sdang bar byed do//yang na kā gnyis dang nyin mo 'jigs pa'i gshog na pa dag cho ga bzhin du bdug snyepas ni 'phrog byed ma smad kyang 'byed par zhu byed do/ /gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /rta'i mig pa'i khung bur sbrul gyi mgo gzhag nu tshocing gnod sbyin smyon pa'i lce dang 79wa 323
