par byed do/ /ston ma'i dus kyis37nam mkha' lta bu'iri/ me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i /mi g.yo mgon dpral ba'i nang nas bton te/ rnam par snangs rimadzad kyi gnas 5su phyag drug 6rin ral gri dang / sdigs mdzub dang / mda' dang ske/7 zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / rdo rje ste/ char rab tu 'bebs shing khro bo grangs med pas yongs su bskor bas bdud las rnam par rgyal ba dang /bgegs thams cad bskrad pa dang / hūm̐ gi sgras gang bas 'jig rten gsumasanigang ba yang 'jig 9 par byed do/ /skyes pa'i khrag dang / rkang rjes kyi sa las 1 rimi'i gzugs byas 11nas mig la mi'i 12rus pa'i phur bu 'od zer can gyi sngags /rtelan nyi shur mngon par bsngags 1 te/ gdab par bya zhing btab tsom thag tu de tshogs kyi bdag po'i khar bcug nas rgyab tu rdo rje gtun shing gis brdung 39bar bya ste/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hūm̐ badz+ra mu ṣa le na tsū ṇ+ḍi ya bi na 1 hūm̐ phaṭa/ /de ltar bsam gtan gyi las kyis 18skyes pa'i bgegs zlog 19par byed do/ /nam mkha' lding mig 2 sman gyi kha dog lta bu klu brgya stong gis brgyan cing / lus la klu brgyad dang / brgya stong gi 21gdong dang rna / nam mkhar gnas pa'i bka' sprin de rnams kyis thos nas sprin gyi na tshogs kyis char zlog da par byed do/ /nam mkha' lding gi gshog 25pa'i mdog sngon po yang 2nemachus bsnun pas chu bo'i tshogs skems 2 par byed do/ /oṃ badz+ra nā rā ya ṇa ni ni pa ya pa snan+da pā tsa 36'isbu me lhaḥrtsu / nam mkha'i khams kyi nang son par/ /zhal gsum pa la spyan gsum pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /stag gi pags pa mnabs nu pa dang / /kha dog dmar po gzi brjid che/ /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od lta bura'atsha/ /ral grim nyid dang kha da smra ga /gzhu dang de bzhin mda' nyid dang / /sha chen gyi ni thod 79wa 372

pa dang / /de bzhin du ni cang te'u 0)nyid/ /zhags pa nyid dang lcags kyu dang ske/ /g.yon na ut+pal rnam par spras/ /g.yon brkyang 'jigs pa chen po ni/ /nyi mar gnas shing gar dang ldan/ /dmar po 'bar zhing 'khyil ba dang / /gos ni chen po bla bre sridang / /dur khrod du ni rab tu bya/ /hrīḥchalas byung ba'i lha mo ni/ /sgrol ma 'khor ba sgrol ba mo/ /de ltar bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /yo gis sangs rgyas nyid thob na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /de nas dbang du bya ④'dod pas/ /mya ngan med pa'i brgyad ⑤la mya ngan med pa'i 'og tu song ste/ gos dmar pos bgos (penas rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /zhal gsum pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas nas bdag nyid kha dog dmar por bsams te/ phyi nas rang gi sku las phyag gnyis ma dmar mo lag pas lcags kyu dang / zhags pa 'dzin ma dbyung bar bya'o/ /des bsgrub bya'i snying dang mgrin pa bcings nas dgug par bsam (7༄par bya zhing rang gi lus la lha mo de gzhug par bya'o/ /bsgrub bya myos 3)par gyur nas de'i snying gar spu sngags kyi yi 0ge bcu kha dog dmar por dgod par bya ste/ yang na bsgrub bya dang ye shes kyi gzugs kyis yi ge de rnams la de zhugs pas de rnams lhan cig tu 'dres par gyur par nyustobasam par bya'o/ /bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba 'dis nyi ma bdun gyis 'khor los sgyur ba yang tu ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dbang du byed par the tshom mi za'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i bar chad bzlog pa'i don du bka' stsal pa/dpal mchog dang po'i gzugs su bdag nyid zhal gsum pa/ zhabs bzhi dang tre//nye phyag bzhi pa0/ zhal dmar po'i 'od zer 'bar ba/ snyems tsam la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis yongs su bskor bar rnam sna par bsams nas rdo rje 73—373

mtshon cha ma dang / rdo rje tī li tī la dang / rdo rje sdug pa7dang / rdo rje snyems ma'i g.yas na rdo rje mda' 'gengs shing 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa bsgyings shing rked par gzhag 5)pa dang / gzhu 'dzin par bsams te/ de nas sems dpa' phyung ste/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i sprin rnam pa thams cad kyis rnam par spras gupa'i g.yas na mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / dbang gi thod rin po che 'dzag pa nam mkhar son pas ni rdo rje zlogasepar byed do/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra te dun)dzaḥ// de ltar shin tu dga' ba'i bcing ba byas nas rnal 'byor bla na med par bshad do/ /gang zhig rnam par phye bas gsodaskophyi par byed pa 'di bka' stsal to47/ /zhi ba la ni mtha'i ya dang ni gnyis dang / phyi nas ya dbu58)ma phyi bas yig 'bru lhag mas ji ltar bde bas so/ /lha mo de ltar bshad pas ni las thams cad rab tu sgrub par byed do/ /rab tu myos ma dbang du bya bar 'dod pas yang brgyad pa la ku ru kul+le'i rnal 'byor lama'o)gnas nas bsam gtan 'di bya'o / /myos byed kyi 'bras bu bza' zhing / de nas ka kā ma tsi ku'i khu bas thig le byas nas sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /o a mu tī me hrīḥb shī (tebha ba /sarte/ khri bzlas pas 'grub bo32/ /de nas dug gisatsha zin pa bslang ba'i phyir rang gi snying ga na 32pad+ma 'dab7nyam brgyad pa bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du dbyangs kyi gsum pa 'dabaspyonam brgyad la kha dog dkar po bsam par bya zhing / bdag nyid yang 'og gi klu'i gzugs kha dog dkar po i'i bdud rtsi 'dzag par bsam〈shepar bya'o/ /klu de'i mig las bdud rtsi byung bas der bsgrub par bya ba de'i lus la ltung bar 17bsam par bya'o/ /bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba 'dis khams gsum yongs su gang ba'i dug med par byed tri rido/ /de nas zla ba dang nyi ma rnam par 79wa 374

gzung ①bar 'dod pas sā tshulu btags pa'i bdag nyid las zla ba dang nyi ma byas te/ rdo rje'i chu la gzhug par bya zhing sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ tsan 〉ska5 mā tsa la mā tsa la tiṣ+ṭha ti khri he badzā ya swā hā/ bye ba phrag drug bzla bar bya ste/phyi nas las 'di yang dag pa brtsamam )par bya'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma dag gnas shing nyin mtshan bye brag med par gnas par5ge'agyur ro/ /pha rol gyi sde rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir bsgrub par bya ste/ kha ṭi kār+sādang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / kujo ra tshin+dadza))dang lhan cig btags la ril bu bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra kurta7ri he badzā ya swā hā/ dngos grub kyi don du bye ba bzlas shing de grub na bsgrub bya0)ril ba spyi blugs kyi mgrin pa bskor nasami/ bcag na dgra thams cad kyi mgo 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /lha dgas par 11'dod pas thig le bsgrub par bya ste/ rdo rje bcings pasatshwa rdo rje can gyi me tog bsgrubs sna te/ sta res bcad pa dang bsregs 1stenas nyi ma gzas zin pa dang mi bskyod pa dang btag tugepar bya zhing /btags nas dgra sta bya ste/ de rdog pasalgemanan nas sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /o badz+ra kujo ratsha/ sī ṭa ya sī ṭa ya phaṭa hu phaṭa swā hā/ dngos grub kyi don du bye ba bzlas la/ phyi nas thig le byas na gang la phyag byas pa de 'gas0)so/ /de nas char gyi rab tu sbyor ba bshad par5ge )bya ste/ oṃ ā phuḥ/ yi 27rnam pa'i cho ga ltar mtha' yas kyi gzugs brnyan byas la bdud rtsi lngas ni blugs par bya'o/ /me tog nag pos ni mchod par bya/ klu 'dul ba'i khu bas ni byug par bya/ glang po che'i chang gis ni mgo bo༄ byug par bya/ kham phor5 gekha sbyar du ni gzhag5gepar bya / ba nag po'i ge'o mas ni dgang bar bya/ gzhon nu ma nag mos bkal ba'i skud pas ni dkri bar bya/ rlung gi phyogs su rdzing bu byas nas der mtha' yas 73—375

gzhag hu)par bya/ de'i 'gram du cho gas dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ de'i dbus su mtha' yas gzhag rin)par bya'o/ /mtha' yas mnan pa'i kye'i rdo rje bri bar bya ste/ zhal brgyad pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag bcu drug gis brgyan pa/spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi par bsgom par bya'o/ /phyis ni slob dpon nang gis5bam rungs pa'i sems kyis cadaben pa'i gnas su sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ ghu ru ghu ru/ ghu ṭa ghu ṭa/ sha ma sha myo/5)/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ gho ṭa ya gho ṭa ya/ a nan+ta 6)khyo bha ka rā ya/ nā gā dhi pa ta ye/ he he ru ru kai/ sap+ta pā 657la/ga tan+d+ra gā nā rin kar+ṣa ya/ bar+ṣa ya/ gardza ya/ tardza ya/ phuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥrgyu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gal te char mi 'bab na de'i tshe sngags 'di bzlog nas phyi bzlas na char 3 ci'abab par 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi /lha'abab na de'i tshe mgo ardza ku'i dog pa ltar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /sprin dral nya bar 'dod pas de'i tshe dur khrod kyi ras la sngags 'di bri bar bya'o/ /oṃ tadz+dza ya tadz+dza 3nyeya/thra shā na pri yā ya phaṭa swā hā/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po las las thams cad kyi bsam gtan 'byung ba zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po ste bdun pa'o// //gzhan du mtshan nyid mtshon pa ni/ /bcom ldan bdag ni 0nyan par 'tshal / /de nyid bzhi ni mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /'khor ba sgrol ba'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /ji ltar de nyid rdo rje nyon/ /dang por rdo rje'i de nyid de8/ /dril bu yang ni gnyis pa la/ /gsum pa la ni phreng ba nyid/ /bzhi par ye shes mtshan nyid do/ / bode nyid bzhi yi rba rlabs las/ /pha rol 79wa 376

'dod pa 'dren pa'o/ /dbus su rnam par snang mdzad mgon/ /shar du mi bskyod de bzhin yang / /rin chen lho yi rwa la 'o/ /'od dpag med ni nub tu dgod / /byang du don yod0)grub pa ste/ /rwa lnga rnams kyi lha nyid do/ /pad+mar byang chub yan lag brgyad/ /sa ji lta bar gzhag par bya/ /phyag na pad+ma byams pa dang / /nam mkha' kun du bzang po bzhin/ /gnod sbyin dbang po 'jamasngonadapal dang / /rnam par sel dang sa nyid kyang / /lha rnams brgyad po 'di rnams kyis/ /sa ji lta bar gzhag par bya/ /dbus su skabs gsum sgo nga la/ /ye shes lha ni thim par bya/ /pad+mar lha mo brgyad po rnams/ /ji bzhin gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs bzhi/ /de bzhin rtse nam phyogs bral lo / /rwa la mkha' 'gro ma lnga ste/ /dbus su ye shes ming can teng pe/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /byang du drag mo'i ming can te/ /ro langs masani phyogs kyi mthar / /gtum mo lhora'uyi dbang phyug ma/ /rdo rje'i de nyid lha rnams su/ /mkhas pas shes par bya ba yin/ /gang phyir de nyid rdo rje yi/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid bdag sems la/ /rdo rje snying can rnal 'byor payi/ /rdo rje sems ni byed du gzhug /rdo rje dag pa bstan 7 par bya/ /rdo rje chos la brtson pa'i yid/ /rdo rje de nyid can kun rnams/ /rdo rje las la mngon par 'gro/ /rdo rje spro ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems can 'khor ba sgrol48)/ /rdo rje dgugalokepa'i rnal 'byor dang / /rdo rje rengs pa'i rnal 'byor rig /mun pa lta bu'i nyon mongs pa / /rnam shes mar me dang lhan cig /ye shes rdo rjes gzhom 1 ripar bya/ /snang ba'i phyogs ni 'thob pa'o/ /rdo rjes bsgrubs 11pa thams cad la/ /rdo rje'i bdag ces bstan pa yin/ /rdo rje chos kyi snying po can/ /rdo rje thar pa'i lhur 79wa 377

len pa/ /rdo rje pad+ma rnam hu)mnan te/ /bsgrub bya de nyid thams cad nas/ /rdo rje pad+ma kun zhugs pa/ /rnam par mkhas pas bsgrub par bya/ /sa②rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po nyon/ /shes rab dkrolakhuba'i de nyid ni/ /lha ni kun gyis thos par 'gyur/ /cha gsum gsal bar gzung ba la / /ska rags byas pa bzang po nyid/ /zhi ba ut+pal ku mu tan)/ /rin chen pad+ma rnam par gnas/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad pa'i dbus su ni/ /dgu pa la ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /lha dgu la sogs rtse mo ni/ /lha rnams dgu yis byin gyis brlabs/ /chu srin kha nelas byung ba yi/ /rtse mo 'od zer zla bar gnas / /rtse mo dgu pa rnam par bshad/ /ye shes rdo rje 'gro ba 'don/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug par/ /byang chub snying por rnam par gnas/ /phyogs bcu thams cad rig pa'i gnas/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas pa/ /phyogs ni brgyad ces bya bar ni/ /lha mo brgyad du rab tu grags/ /yi ge brgyad kyi sa bon ni/ /phyogs ni brgyad du rnam par dgod/ /shar du lha mo sgrol ma ste/ /byang du yang ni gos dkar mo7/ /nub kyi phyogs su mā ma kāgu/ /lho ru yang ni sangs rgyas spyan/ /gser dang sbrang rtsi gzi brjid ma/ /rdo rje phreng ba bzhi pa'o//nang gi 9)gzugs ni nam mkha' ste/ /gzugs kyis 1 rdzogang ba gzi brjid can/ /pad+ma kha phye las byung ba/ /gzugs med srid pa'i gnas su ni/ /shes rab bdud rtsi bum pa ltar/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i gnas su ni/ /de yi yang nis 7dbus su yid/2/ /lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gzugs ni mdzes steshing yon tan gnas/ /steng gi pad+ma 1 rdo rje rnams/ /ji ltar gong mas tshobasam par bya/ /nang gi ye shes dbyug gu ni/ /thams cad sdud cing 'byin par byedas/ /ā li 79wa 378

kā li sgomanyepa ni/ /gnas ni brgyad du bskyodashepar bya/ /ā li kā li rab sbyorasho kibs / /'khor ba thams cad gcod par byed/ /rdo rje dril bu'i thabs nyid de8rka/ /thabs ni yang ni nang du nyid/ /de la lag gnyis rab tu brkyang / /rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor bam bya/ /g.yas par nyi ma yang dag bsam/ /g.yon par zla bsam g.yon pa56)nyid/ /lus can rnams kyi thabs nyid deX/ /rangashe'adod lhar 9)ni bsam par bya/ /byang du rdo rje gsor nas ni/ /phyi nas blo ldan yang dag gdab/ /r+ghaṃ gi glu yi rnam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par byed/ /rdo rje gsor bas mdzes pa yis/ /rmongs pa'i sems can rnam par sgrol/ /chos kyi rnam thar 'bras bu nyid/ /rdo rje dgyes pa 'dzin pa ste/ /rgyu r+ghaṃ hūṃ ho ho ho/ /thabs dang shes rab rab dkrol 31zhing / /thabs dang shes rab lag pa'i dngos/ /oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saṃ pra ra ṇi tu ta sab budhatshwa k+ṣe tra pra tsā li ne/ pradzñā 8snga ra mi tā nā da susabhā be tsas badz+ra sa twa bla da ya si to ṣa ni hu3 r+ghaṃ rtsu ho ho ho swā hāḥkhe/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ( bye ga ta sid dhi badz+ra sa ma ye tiṣ+ṭha (1e ṣa tā ra yā (rtemi hi zhu)gyi hi hi hi hūṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhustephaṭa swā hā/thabs dang shes rab chos kyis ni/ /'gro ba thams cad zhugasad par byed/ /mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi/ /sems can sangs rgyas don du dkrol/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis ni gzung / /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /thabs dang shes rab cho ga yis/ /sems can don ni yo gis byed/ /de nyid med sems rnal 'byor pa//glang po dril bu dkrolas ba nyid/ /rnal 'byor de nyid dmanam pa yi/ /rang gi dngos grub ring zhugedu brtag /brgyad pa las dril bu'i de /kho na ste rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //79wa 379

yang dag cho ga yis ri/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /shel dang nya phyis mu tig dang / /khams ni dkar po la sogs gzhan/ /zhi ba'i las la khyad par dul/ /phreng ba yi ni mtshan nyid do/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs ma pa( ni/ /pad+ma'i sa bon khyad par du/ /rgyas pa la ni phreng ba nyid/ /rnam par mkhas pas bgrang bar bya/ /gur gum 4la sogs dri sogs kyis/ /dri ni thams cad khyad par du/ /bsgrubs 5shing ril bu byas nas ni/ /dbang la yongs su rab tu grags / /ru dāk+ṣa 6dang lung tang dang / /de bzhin skyes pa'i rus pa nyid/ /drag po'i me las la sbyar bar bya/ /mngon spyod la ni yongs su grags/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la/ / phu tra ṭī wa naskulas kun byed/ /sngags kyi bsgrub pas9kyilnga bcu ste/ /dbang la de yi 1 phyed nyid do/ /brgya 31phrag gcig 3 ni zhi ba la/ /de bzhin rgyas la lhag par brgyad/ /mngon spyod la ni drug cu nyid/ /khyad par du ni las la sbyar/ /ji ltar las kyi 1 bye brag gis/ / phreng ba skol sogs bya ba'ol/ /phyogs dang mtshams ni 15brgyad rnams kyi/ /dbus su dgug pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /lha ni dgu sogs srad bu la/ /lha dgus byin gyis brlab par bya/ /phreng ba kun ni dgra bcom pa/ /mchod rten steng du rab tu brtag /mchod rten chos kyi dbang po'i phyir/ /steng du yang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /lag mthilas nyi ma bsams nas ni/ /dbyangs yig dang po la sogs pa/ /lag pa'i dbus su rnal 'byor pas/ /bsgom zhing bdud rtsi yi ge nangs1 rme/ /'od zer 'phro ba du ma dang / /kha dog dkar po bsams nas ni/ /sor mo rdo rje rtse mo ste/ /79wa 380

g.yon pa pad+ma 'dab0)mar bsgom/ /pad+ma rdo rje snyoms 'jug pa'i/ /kha sbyar dunadabus su phreng gzhag5gel/ /kun gyi de nyid bsgom bya zhing / /phreng ba byinam canagyis brlab par bya/ /sor mo la sogs bye brag las/ /phyis ni sngags pas bzlas pa bya⑤/ /rdo rje gnyis med dngos po las/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje can gyi dngos / /zhi la4)khro bor dgod par bya/ /rgyas la dbu ma'i de nyid la/ /srin lag la ni dbang du gsungs/ /kun gyi mtha' mar 7)mngon spyod la/ /mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyu lha / /dngos po las ni dgug par bya/ /mnyam gzhagam1)bzlas dang sgom pa yisathe )/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nyid med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de nyid med pa'i sngags zlos dang / /rdo rje dril bu de nyid med / /phyag rgya'i de nyid skye mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pa yis de nyid dmigs/ /de nyid thams cad byed pa nyid/ /yi ge rnams kyi rgyu nyu1las ni/ /gzugs kyi snying po mdzes pa ste/ /sngags kyi snying po bgrang ba'i grangs/ /rdzun 32pas rnal 'byor ma snying 'grub/ /oṃ pa de pa de/ ma hā dzñā rna/ sab 12bud dha ma haṃ bha be ta 0rgyu hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ sngags kyi phreng ba sbyangs nas ni/ /gang 'dod de nyid bsgrub par bya/ /de nyid las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /kun du gsal ba med na ring / /ye shes de nyid khyad par du/ /ye shes chen po yang dag nyon/ /mnyam nyid sems kyis nyugedabye ba las/ /mnyam par gzhag 9pas 'khor lo brtag /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes sa bon gyis ni sprulo rme/ /sku mdog dkar po bsgom par bya/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par ni/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung 18/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /phyag rgya chen po phyag gnyis kyis/ /snying ga'i 1/gnas su 79wa 381

btsir7)ba nyid/ /sku mdog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad gtso/ /kun tu 'od zer sna tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig sprin gyis spro/ /zung ltar rim pa'i cho ga yis/ /sngags kyi bzlas parakhurab tu grags / /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag gnyis kyis/ /bskor balgemakha' 'gro ma de bdego/ /ā li kā li risnyes bon ni/ /rtsu gi srad bus brgyu⑥ba nyid/ / 'di yishes bon rnal 'byor pas/ /bsgoms na myur du sangs rgyas thob/ /brgyad pa las sngags kyi bzlas pa dang sgom pa ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //'pho ba'i rnal 'byor mtshan nyid kyin/ /de nyid ji ltar rdo rje nyon/ /bzang po'i lam du rnal 'byor pas97/ /'gro ba mdzes pa khyod la bstan/ /ye shes dbang po nyan par 'tshal/ /sgo rnams dgu ni ji ltar lags/ /ye shes sgo yi dbye bas ni/ /yon tan skyon ni ji ltar lags/ /dus su srog ni 'chad pa yi / /yang dag rab tu sbyor ba nyon/ /legs pa'i lam ni mdzes pa'i gnas/ / ngan pa'itshwa )lam yang skyon rnams nyid/ / lte ba'i 11steng na thig le dang / /mig dang sna sogs rna ba dag12 /btung dang btung ba min pa'i sgo/ /mtshan nyid lte bar 'dod pa can/ /mtho ris thig les 32gzugs lus can/ /steng ni steng du gnas pa yi/ /'gro dang 'ong bar yongs su grags/ /sna las gnod sbyin dag tu 'gyur/ /rna ba dag las grub 3 )pa'i lha/ /gal te mig las shes 'gro na/ /mi rnams kyi ni rgyal por 'gyur/ /srid pa'i sgo las yi dgas te/ /gci las de bzhin byol song ngo / /dmyal ba brgyad ni btung min pas/ /de ltar spang phyir rigs kyi bu/ /srid pa'i 'pho ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gang phyir sgo 79wa 382

yi khyad par ni/ /'khor ba'i dbye ba yang dag 'byung / /de phyir sgo yi khyad par gyis/ /rnal 'byor pas ni mnyam gzhag0)pa/ /'chi ba'i dus kyisngo thob pa ni/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma bstan pa nyid/ /rimadzagul sogs pasasrin phye ba'i/ /'pho ba'i rnal 'byor dam pa nyid/ /bum pa dang por brtsams nas ni/ /sgo rnams thams cad rengs par byed/ /mchod rten rnams kyi lcags sgrog lnga/ /sgo yi bug pa'i bsgom pa ni/ /de bas dma' ba'i sgo nyid dos/ /sa bon chu ltar dkar po nyid/ /btung dang btung min⑥me yi ni/ / de yi nyes bon 'bar ba ltar / /de yi dang po dbugs kyi yang / /de la shin tu mnyam gzhag⑧pas/ /dbugs ni bum pa can bsgom bya/ /lus kyi rlung gi kha dog dang / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sems kyis ni/ /rlung gi59)sa bon rtsa ba rnams/ /rlung ni0mtha' yi rtsa ba can/ /thig le sgra dang ldan pa yis/ /sems kyi thenas bon gyis ni drang / /rdo rje can gyi〈rtes bon gyis/ /'jigs pa'i lcags kyu la sogs sbyar/ /gnas ni bcu dang hunyenyi shu ni/ /rtsa bzhi'i muganas las 'jigs mas dgug /go 'phang gnas ni go 'phang stekho/ /bug pa dgu yi steng mas so/ /mdzod 57skra dkar sa bon gyi/ /yi ge phyed dang gnyis kyis 3 sbyar/ /drag po'isngo sgra yis brjod nas ni/ /brgyad kyi mtha' yi hunges bon gyis/ /'jigs dang 'jigs pa'i sde tshan mi )/ /dang po la sogs dang po yi/ /yi ge phyed pas sbyar nas ni/ /rlung gis du nyas bon 'og ma las/ /sgra ni sgra yis bskul bar bya/ /rlung gi sa bon ldan pa dang / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sems kyis ni/ /gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhir ni / /de nas steng nas steng du mchog /rnal 'byor pas ni'i 2skra dkar bas/ /steng gi yi ge bza' bar bya/ /bu ga dgu yi steng mchog nas/ /'phral du yid 79wa 383

kyis 'pho bar byed/ /nyin zhing bram ze gsod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / /chom rkun las kyi longs spyod pa/ /'di yi lam gyis grol 'gyur te / /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur zhing / /srid pa'i skyon las shin tu grol/ /dper na 'dam las skyes pa yi/ /pad+ma gzi brjid dri ma med/ /de bzhin 'dam sogs lus kyis ni/ /ye shes sku ni rang 'dod pas/ /dus thob na yang 'pho bya ste/ /dus min lha ni gsod pa nyid/ /de phyir lus kyi mtshanalo17shes nas / /blo dang ldan pas rnal 'byor brtsam/ /rnal 'byor bsgrub bya'i khyad par las / /ji ltar de nyid rdo rje nyon/ /mnyam nyid sems kyi dngos po ni/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid thams cad las/ /snying gi dkyil 'khor ri dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi sa bon rnams/ /'di ni 5nyi ma'i 'od zer 'bar ngo bo sems kyis mtshon par bya/ /sngar gsungs stong pa nyid kyis ni/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ /hūm̐ la gnas pa'i sems kyis ni/ /gzugs la sogs pa thams cad gzhig /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sa bon gyis ni gzugs bskyed ldanas/ /pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par ni/ /ye shes mkha' 'gror 6bdag nyid bsam/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug nyid/ /spyan gsum dbu rgyan gyis ni brgyan/ /bzhad dang khro zhing sgeg pa dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /kun da 75zla ba'i mdog ltar dkar/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni spro bar bya/ /sems dpa' skyil mo krung du na gnas/ /dang por mda' ni dgod par bya/ /de bzhin gnyis par lcags kyu nyid/ /gsum par rdo rje 'phyar ba'o/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub 9zhags pa nyid/ /gnyis par dpag bsam shing lcug 1 ma/ /gsum par 79—384

gzhu yi cho gas khyab1)/ /'od zer phreng ba du ma dang / /dbugs ni g.yo ba med par bsgom/ /sa bon brgyad la sogs pa yis/ /yi ge rnam dgod dgod par bya'odusal/ /ā li kā li rab sbyor 5)bas/ /ji ltar btus pa'i sa bon bzhin/ /thams cad kha dog dkar po rnams/ /sa bon zla ba'i 'od zer ldan/ /pad+ma'i chu shing me tog gi tsho /snying la sgong skyes gzhag par bya/ /de yi dbus su ye shes dang ske/ /rnam par shes pa lhan cig tus)/ /dngos po'i ngo bos bsgom par bya /g.yo ba med cing 'tshe ba med/ /de nas phyi rol rnal 'byor rnams/ /rnam par mkhas pas gzung gebar bya/ /gnas gnyis kyi ni sems dang ni/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sems kyis ni/ / de yis nodabus su me nyid de/ /de yi steng du nyi ma der/ /ā li kā li ldan pa yin/ /sa bon de nyid dmar po'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yi khyad par du/ /dbyung dang rngub pa'i 9 bzlas pa bya/ /ye shes sa bon dbus su ni/ /'byung ba yis ni bsnun bya zhing / /bsnun nyu ripas snying ga'i nyu1ye shes ni/ /me tog lta bur bsnun par bya/ / dbyung dang dbyung 12min bzlas pas ni/ /dbyung nyusnyedang rngub pa'i rnal 'byor pa1 / /bdag nyid phyi rol du 8ni byed / /dbyung /rdzoba'i mtshan nyid mtshon pa dang / /rngub pa'i mtshan nyid mtshon par bya/ /dbyung dang rngub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi1 / /mtshan nyid de nyid bsgoms pas ni/ /mnyam gzhag 38dngos po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nas phyi rol rnams kyi lus/ /sgrub pa pos ni rnam par sprul/ /gzhan gyi sems kyi rjes su sems/ /rnam par mkhas pas shes par bya/ /bsgom dang bzlas pa'i khyad par gyis/ /mnyam par gzhag 19pa'i sems kyis ni//legs pa'i lam ni bsam byas na )/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de 79wa 385

nas ye shes gzugs gyur dang / /de phyir mar me'i sems kyis ni/ /rnam par mkhas pas las rnams byed/ /nyan thos la sogs de nyid ni/ /legs par bshadamanyupa bsgrags pa nyid/ /shel ltar sems ni brtan⑧byas nas/ /mar me'i rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /spros pa thams cad dmigs nas ni/ /spros pa nyid ni spros sna/med byed/ /rang bzhin rnal 'byor dmigs nas ni/ /'di dag thams cad yongs su spang / /kye bcom ldan 'das ye shes gang gis ye shes khyad par du 'phags lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga ru gsungs/ /gsang ba'i me long ye shes lha'i(ge/ /khro bo'i ye shes lha ma yin / /yi dgas ye shes nyi ma ste/ /dmyal ba'i 'jigs shing ngu ba nyid/ /gti mug ye shes byol song rnams/ /sems med brtan55)pa la sogs pa/ /mi la rnam shes khyad par ni/ /rnam pa lnga ru shes par bya/ /lnga yi dbye bas ye shes bsgrags / /glen zhing lkugs pas khebs pa yi/ /gyis pa'i shes pa'i〈)shes pa can / /ye shes de nyid khyad par dang spyi/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos nikhyad par las / /skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu/ / nga yi59)ye shes kyis bskulaphu )ba/ /mkhas pa77rnal 'byor bstan bcos 12la/ /'bad pas dad pa bskyed nyu par bya/ /phyi rol bstan bcos sgra la sogs/ /dper na gar mkhan kha dog bzhin/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos rjes mi btsal bas/ /bza' dang grol ba'i gnas su bya/ /snying po las ni snying po mchog /rnal 'byor zhal mchog khyodamatshal bshad/ /brgyad pa las mu stegs kyi ye shes 'jig tshipa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //sngags rnams kyi ni 1 mtshan nyid ni/ /rdo rje gtso bo rgyal po nyon/ /oṃ badzā 79wa 386

yi ge bcu drug ①po 'di rnams ni/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ mā rī rtsu swā hā/ 'od zer can gyi snying po'o②/ /oṃ mā rī rtsu ba'i li ba dā li ba dā ③li / ba rā 0ha mu khi ⑤su hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ pi shā tsi paṇ+ḍi sha ba ri sarba mā ri (nyasra sha ma ⑦ni rgyu hūṃ dum ho da ri phaṭa/ ri khrod ma shing lo can gyi'o / /oṃ brgyu ku shā kur+sha ⑨ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra pā sha brnya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra kā li ⑩tardza ya hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra musbyi groṇ+ḍi ༅rtsu/ oṃ badz+ra khri li tī la 8ya r+ghaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra muṅga tso'o ko ṭa 8ya hūm̐/ sngags 'di rnams ni shin tu grub pa ste/ don yod pa'i dngos grub sgrub 8pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki ni 0yi mo/ ba dzi gro ṇ+ḍa kṛ ṇ+ḍa 0rgyu phaṭa swā hā/oṃ dzaḥrgyu rba hoḥ/ sa ma ya ṭ+wāṃ/ dṛ tsobya hoḥ/ de ltar lan gsum bzhi lngar bzlas nas gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba 7yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa zla 0 ta bre ta pi shā tsor+sā (nyedā pa smra ra ḍā ka ḍā ki kyā zhuged ya i mi ba dzi groṇ+ḍa 6tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu sabra sirnyis ④pra yats+tshan+tu rtsu hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badz+ra hūm̐/ byin gyis brlab bupa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥrgyu sho dha ya sho dha ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rtsu phaṭa/ sa sbyang ba'i thusngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī rtsu phaṭa ⑥swā hā/ oṃ gi rī r+ghaṃ phaṭa buswā hā/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa tso'i hūṃ phaṭa dzña )swā hā/ oṃ bet+ta lī rgyu phaṭa 0swā hā/ sngags pas cho gas bsnun pa dang / gsad zhu pa dang / dgug pa dang / gar byed pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra si hi ni māṃ saswā hā/ oṃ badz+ra byā mi ā+o (9swā hā / oṃ badz+ra rdza 5gebu ke rkyu zhugyiswā hā/ oṃ badz+ra u lū kā phye rī 97 hā/ oṃ badz+ra ra dze ji lnga tsos hā/ oṃ badz+ra dīp+ta te dze au sa)swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra tsā ṣi ṇi tsū 0 ṣa ya sarba sa ṭ+wāṃ oṃ (shes hā/ oṃ badz+ra /sbo dze aḥswā hā/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ dbus su ste/ ye 79wa 390

shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /oṃ dzaḥs bam̐ hoḥkho ②ro/ mchod yon gyi ②sngags so/ /oṃ khaṃ ni rī ①rgyu khaṃ/ zhabs bsil gyi sngags so/ /oṃ t+t+waṃ lhaX / dri dang bshos gtsang ⑤la sogs pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ ha ho hrīḥ0swā hā/phyag rgya chen po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ku ru ku ⑦ru sa ma yā nidhi pa ti rtsu dzaḥ0snya hā/dgug pa'i sngags 0so/ / ha hi hu 7he ho haṃ/ yan lag drug la tsodagod pa'i sngags so/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud 8las byung ba bya ba thams cad yang dag par 'byung ba'i brtag ④pa'i rgyal po ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod nas / phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas rgyas pa/ /bcom ldan lha yis bshad du gsol/ /gang du gnas su bzhugs gyur pas/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu bcas par rol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ci rigs brtags pas sems 'dzin pa/ /nga tsoyis bshad par bya yis 0nyon/ /gang zhig de skad sngar gsungs pa/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor lus zhes nyunyebarjod par bya/ /sgo bzhi ji skad gsungs pa'o/ /lte ba'i dbus gnas pad chen po/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mngon par grags/ /gnas der gnas pa'i dpa' bo nihukye/ /dri med dri ma rnam par spangs/ /lus la gnas shing nag nog med/ /lus can kun la rnam par rol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 0rdzu 'phrul che/ /rnam par mdzad cing rab tu bsgyurabya/ /kha cig tu ni byang chub chen po'i sems/ /kha cig tu ni ji ltar spyod rjes zhunye'abrang / /kha cig 79—391

tu ni dga' ldan lha rnams lags6)/ /kha cigashetu ni〈'bab par gyur pa dang / /kha cig tu ni bltams ④pa rnam dag cing ge/ /kha cig tu ni khab nas gsal byungapodang ske/ /kha cig tu ni byang chub chen por mchod/ /kha cig tu ni bdud las mchog tu rgyal/ /kha cig tu ni mngon par rdzogs byang chub/ /kha cig tu ni 'khor lo rab tu bskor / /kha cig tu ni phas kyi rgol ba dgadu /lhan cig chos kyis ri'itshar ni gcod pa po/ /kha cig tu ni dngos grub kun dbang phyug / kha cig 1 sdudapal ldan 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /kha cig〈nyetu ni dpag bsam shing mchog kun/ /dngos grub dbang phyug bla na med pa nyid/ /de ltar la sogs mtha' yas mchog /sangs rgyas kun bdag sdom hurtepas ni/ /dngos dang nyasnodangos med rnam par grol/ /de phyir gti mug yongs su spangs/ /ā mili bung ba zhes byar brjod/ /bung ba rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid/ /ā brali nam mkha'i mthar gtugs par/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu gsang blo 'dzin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /dbang po kun gyi bdud rtsi dang / /las 0rnams thams cad skye ba nyid/ /de phyir thams cad bkug nas ni/ /rtsa ba'i nyi dbus su thim par bya/ /'jigs byed rdo rje sgra yis ni / /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor rdzas las ni/ /rlung dang me dang bdun pa'i don/ /rdo rje can gyi nyanas bon sbyar/ /thig le sgra yis yang dag mnan/ /char gyi rgyun zhes 1 brjod par bya/ /dbyangs kyi 2 chodang po mchog sa bon/ /de yi dbus su gzung 21bar bya/ /kā ni li me tog shes par bya/ /me tog rdo rje can gyi ni lus/ /ma mo kun gyi sa rnams kyang / /kun la 'khor ba bskyed paraloste'agyur/ /ye shes chu bo rgya mtsho 'dir/ /shes rab chu srin dbyangs kyi nyas nye/ /gnyis med 'dam 79wa 392

gyi dbus su ni/ /thabs kyi rnam pa'i myu gu nyid/ /bo0)du lta bur bya〈kyeb nyid/ /sbrang rtsi dang ni bdud rtsi'isko gnas/ /kāsang )li dang ni bdud rtsitso)nyid/ /chu dang me tog nang du 'khor/ /bdud rtsi7chu yi cho ga mchog /gnyis las lus ni skye bar 'gyur/ /gang du bdud rtsi dang ni chu/ /lnga yi bdag nyid du ni gsungs/ /me ni tsha ba nyid yin te/ /reg pas rlung ni du bar lta'i/ /chu ni gsher ba'i dngos po ste/ /sa ni gzugs su blta bar bya/ /ye shes rdo rje byin brlabs59)pas / /rnam pa lngar ni rab tu bskyed(tshe/ /yang ni chu ni kun gyi 3)dbyibs/ /de bzhin me yis zad par byed/ /de bzhin rlung ni rtag pa yi/ /sa ni dbang po'i gzugs can ma/ /r+ghaṃ gi glu yi rnam pa yis/ /rnal 'byor ma kun mnyes par byed/ /rdo rje yan lag dgyes pa'i mthus/ /spyan gyis gzigs par mdzad pa yonye/ /yi ge'i dngos posarang bzhin ni/ /stong par rol padza8nyid kyis ni/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam spangs pas19/ /snying po yang ni 'tshal ba nyid/ /ma lus pa yi / snabasam pa dang / /yi ge thams cad gzhom par gyis/ /gnyis hu)gnyis 'khyud 17pa'i rnal 'byor pas ri/ /chu rnams kyi ni dgos pa can/ /gnyis med chos ni thob pa ni 1/ /thar pa yang ni thob pa nyid/ /'khor ba'i bde bas 22rmongs pa la/ /grol ba yang ni spangs pa nyid/ /thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sa sngags kyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma ni lnga po rnams/ /sangs rgyas de nyid mtshon par bya/ /sgyu mar gnas pa sari tshodu ma kun / /sna tshogs gzugs kyis 25sems can smin/ /rdo rje brkyang pa'i dgos pa ni / /chos kyi rmongs pa bral bar byed/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'thar pa can/ /snying po chos la phyag 'tshol na 7cig /rigs kyi na/bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin 79wa 393

gshegs pa thams cad kyi glu 3)'dis rgyal ba thams cad kyis7bdag nyid las skye bar 'gyur ba la la'adi skad ces (ri)bka' stsal to/ /dgu (9pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skyedas ne)pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //gtor ma'i las chog ji lta hubar/ /rdo rje gtso bo rgyal po nyon/ /khru gang tsam gyi ④tshad du ni/ /dmar po'i dri yis7dkyil 'khor bya/ /dkar pos phyi rol gru gsum bya/ /mchod yon mchod sogs rim gro dang / /nya dang sha sogs bza' ba dang / /chang dang myos byed spro ba yang tso/ /g.yon du nye bar dgos pa kun / /g.yas pa dag tu chu yi nyu1snod/ /sngonarwarnyedu mchod yon dag gi snod/ /rdzas ni 'di5snyedag thams cad rnams/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis sbyang bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin nam15/ /yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas dgug par bya/ /me tog dmar pos bdug pa sogs/ /dri la sogs pa dbul bar bya/ /oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i pad+ma'i snod / /lce hūm̐ de nyid khyad par las/ /ye shes lcags kyu'i rab dbye bas/ /yid kyis thams cad dgug pa'o/ /kye bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi lho lcags kyulo8dur gsungs/ de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang po5)skye dgu'i bdag por brjod/ /de bzhin gnyis par sgrol ma nyid/ /gsum pa la ni rab mchog brjod/ /bzhi pa la ni mang po skyes/ /lnga pa la ni stobs zhesasko )bya/ /rigs lnga rnams kyi sngags 'di dag /ye shes lnga yis rab dbye bas / /ye shes chen po lnga po 'di 1/ /khyod la phan pa'i bsamasam 2pas bshad/ /ye shes lcags kyu'i rab dbye bas/ /las rnams kun la sbyar bar bya/ /gal nisnye79wa 394

te las la phan 'dod pas/ /rnal 'byor ma kun tshim par bya/ /'dod la dga' bar mi bya zhing / /longs spyod la ni sbyor ①mi bya/ /sems can don rgyu rnal 'byor pas/ /mchod pa thams cad yang dag brtag /dbyangs kyi bcu gsum las byung ba/ /gang zhing ②sla ba de rab grags/ /de yi dbus su sa bon gyi/ /ā li kā ③li mnyam sbyar ④bas/ /lha kun de nas tshim par bya/ /'bud pa sbar ba nyid dang ni/ /khyad par du ni bskol ba nyid/ /shel gyi gzugs kyis bskyed bya zhing / /de phyir thams cad brtag par bya/ / de yi ⑤dbus nas dublangs nas ni/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang bar bya/ /lhag ma la sogs dngos po kun / /phyi rol dkyil 'khor tshim par bya/ /g.yon pa'i cha yi snod dang ni/ /g.yas pa'i khro bo bstan par bya/ /rkang pas mnan cing steng du blta/ /spyi bor pho gyi ⑦rnam pa 'byung / /zla ba mar ngo'i dubacu bzhi dang / /khyad par du ni brgyad pa dang / / yar gyi ngo yi bcu pa la/ /⑨mchod pa mchod pa'i bdag nyid 'gyur/ /oṃ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo ⑩dang ni 'bab chu dang ske/ /khyim dang grong gi ngos dag dang / /zhing dang grong ni stong pa dang / /sems can snod dang thang stong dang / /chu la yang ni khyad par du'o/ /drag po nag 0po drag chen po/ /⑩lha mo yang ni mnyam par gnas/ /nag po thod pa can 'jigs 8rung / /dga' ④las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang / /gdol pa mo dang 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /lha mo dka' zlog 'thams cad du/ /rgyal ma 8dang ni rnam rgyal nyid/ /mi thub ma hunyedang gzhan mi thub/ /nag mo bzang mo nag mo che/ /rtse mo nag mo rnal 'byor mo/ /dbang mo zla mo 'jigs pa ma/ /gdug rtso pa can dang lam ba ཿhu'i/ /sum cu rtsa 73—395

gsum dbang phyug ma/ /g.yo ldan mar me 'jib 0)byed ma/ /grong du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs dang gzugs chen ma/ /mche ②ba gzugs ngan chagatsigs pa nyid/ /thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ④ba can/ /mthu chen lag na kha ṭī ga /lag na dgra sta ral gri dang / /rdo rje lag ma gzhu yi lag /mkha' 'gro ma yi (5)de nyid che/ /las rnams rjes su sgrub ⑥par byed/ /rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor rgyal mo meche/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen las/ /skyon med dbang phyug 'byin ⑧pa mo/ /rdo rje dbang phyug bka' lung 'dis/ /thams cad las ni thams cad dgug /oṃ ka ka ka rgya na ⑨ba ba brnya na kha kha khā da na sarba duṣ+ṭa nī ⑩ha na ha na/ gha gha kyā ⑩ta ya ghā 8ta ya a yortenu ka su shān+ti ku ru 8rgyu hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa dzaḥ8swā hā/ bdud rtsi'i ⑩bsam gtan dmigs nas ni/ /bdud rtsis ⑩kha ni dgang bar bya las sogs bsams tunyenas rnal 'byor dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni bsgom par bya/ /las rnams thams cad rab 'grub 'gyur/ /has ni kha dog 'phrog par byed/ /hos ni dri ni 'jig ⑩par byed/ /hrīḥs )ni brtson 'grus 'joms par ni0/ /rim pa 'di ni brjod par bya snye/ /rnam gsum lan gsum brjod pas ni/ /gsum gyis lha rnams tshim par bya/ /pad+ma'i dbang phyug gzugs gser mdog /gzi brjid dri chu rnam snang dang / /rdo rje'i dbang phyug myang ba ni/ /lag na rdo rje lha gsum dag /rnam pa gsum du shes par bya/ /'dir ni chos rnams bzang por )ltos/ /'du ba rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams / /rang bzhin gcig ri )pa nyid du zo/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni de (nyenas sbyin / /rol bcas mchog tu rjes bskor bas/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag pa 73wa 396

yis / /'dod pas bskor bar bya ba'o/ /rang 'dod lha yis11rnal 'byor gyis/ /ji ltar rab tu bsgyur bas〈ge'ajug /bde gshegs chos ni rin thang med/ /'dod chags dri ma rnam par bsala'/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa9)rnam par spangs/ /gus pas de la phyag 'tshol5gecig /tshigs bcad 'dis ni blang bar bya yang dag spyod pa'i de nyid 'di/ /gtsang sbra kun du rnal 'byor pa'i/ /ji ltar bde ba zhes byar brjod/ /yan lag yan lag bde gsol 'debs/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i sbyor ba yikho/ /sgyu ma yis ni rnam par brgyan/ /dngos po rnam grol phyag 'tshol cig /rdo rje dril bu'i sgra rnams kyis/ /ci 'dod pa yi bkra shis glus/ /hūṃ hūm̐ hūṃ/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /snying gsheru ni gzungalo)bar bya/ /de nas sems can kun sogs la/ /smon lam rnams ni gdab bya ba/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de ni sangs rgyas nyid thob gyur/ /ma bsgral5bye ba dag bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba dag bdag gis dgrol / /rnal 'byor bstan bcos bya ba'i dngos/ /da lhanyelta ru ni yang dag brtags / /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings nas/ /g.yon pa snying gar gzhag 32par bya / /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas ni/ /sa la bzhags3nyenas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ād+ma tiṣ+ṭha7rgyu swā hā/ phyi ni gebadag gi dbugs kyis ni/ /bdag gi lus la thim par bya/ /skad cig gcig pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag gi dngos pos mchod par bya/ /oṃ sasba duṣ+ṭa groṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍa tshegats+tsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ se gol gsum gtogs nas phyi rol gyi lha rnams gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /dgu pa las gtor ma'i hu tshomachod pa ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //79wa 397

gsang ba la ni rnam ri gnas nas/ /de la lha mo des zhus pa/ /sbas pa dam pa'i dngos spyod yul/ /bde gshegs kun gyi dkyil 'khor dang / /khro bo rnams dang lha rnams dngasngo / /thams cad lha ni khyod kyis gsungs/ /ji ltar nangakyil rnam gnas pa'i(5)/ /de nyid bla med bdag 'tshal yang / /bdag la da dung the tshom mchis/ /gang gi cho gas bris sku dang / /glegs bam yang ni bri bar bgyi/ /lha lags 'di dag mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /de bdag lang tsho7dal ba dang / /rgyas shing rnam rtog med pa dang / /khro med lkog 'phyas med pa dang / /shin tu cha phra mkhas spro dang / /bzod dang dad pa snying rjesaspuldan/ /de ltar gyur pa'i ri mo mkhan/ /yang na dam tshig can gyi yang / /ri mo mkhan gyis bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po dam pas dpa' bo shi ba'i ras sam/ ro la dkris pa'i ras sam/bu btsas bopa'i ras sam/ khrag chen pos btsos pa'i ras sam/ bud med kyi me tog gis rab tu bsgrubs pa'i ras 11rnams la sgrol ma dang / 'od zer can dang ske/ de bzhin du ni hu ri khrod ma shing lo can la sogs7)bri bar bya'o/ /de la 'di'i cho ga ni gsang ba'i phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas shin tu mnyam par gzhagashepas 'drir 'gazhug par bya'o/ /skyes pa'i thod par gnas par77ji ltar gsungs pa'i kha dog lnga sna sih+la dang / ga bur la sogs pa bsres tunyepa dang /ro'i skra'i por gyis bris sku 'jigs pa /6bri bar bya'o/ /dang por slob dpon gyis mnyam par gzhag pas shes rab dang ldan zhing / rgyan thams cad kyis rnam 79wa 398

par brgyan pa dang / dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas yan lag la ni ro shunyebasam zhing gcer bur gyur pa dang / de bzhin du yang〈pelhag ma dang / ma dag pas mkhas pas mi bya'o/ /kye bcom ldan 'das gal te sih+la la sogs pas〈kyebasres pa lags na/ de'i rtsotshe ji ltar ma dag pa5snyelags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /pho nya gtsang sbra dang po ste/ /gnyis pa la ni zhi bar7'dod/ /snod gcig tu ni zas nyid ni/ /gtsang sbra gsum pa nyid du gsungs/ /phyi rol rnal 'byor la dga' bas/ /gtsang sbra 'di dag yang dag brtsam/ /rang sems dri ma can gyur la/ /gnas ni 'di yis ci zhig dgos / /gang yang log pa'i chos gnas pa/ /'dod pa'i don kun 'dod pa ni⑦/ /khyi yi skye gnas brgyar 'gro ste/ /sme sha can du〈skye bar 'gyur/ /dper na kha cig mar don gnyer/ /dad pas chu ni bsrub7gyur kyang / /mar sar thob par mi 'gyur nyu )te/ /lus nyon mongs pa kho nar zad/ /'dzin dang mchod pa ma gtogs par/ /gzhan du bzang mo don med 'gyur/ /'tsho ba'i hunyathabs kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /rnal 'byor gzhan la brten nyu pa nyid/ /dung dang nya phyis mu tig rnams/ /gsum char rgyu las byung ba nyid/ /chos kyi sku yi lus can gyi / /thod pa la ni su zhig smod/ /mchod phyir thogs pa dag byed kyang / /dam pa'i chos kyi rim par gsungs/ /gtsang sbra ho ru ka dpal gnas/ /de phyir kun du rab 'bad pas/ /phyag rgya lhan cig sgrub pas mchod/ /shin tu bzhin mdzes snying rje can/ /gzugs dang lang tsho 1nyeskal bzang ma/ /gzugs bzang sgrub pa po la dga'/ /rang gi phyag rgya g.yon du gzhag1 /pir la byin brlabs 'dri spumakhan la/ /byin te bris sku 'jigs pa ni/ /dngos grub 79wa 399

thams cad rab ster ba0)/ /de nas yang dag bri bar bya/ /'jig rten gzhan la mi bstan zhing / /ri mo mkhan dang sgrub pos blta/ /glegs bam khyod la bshad bya yis(gyi/ /lha mo skal ba chen mo nyon/ /gro ga'am ta la'i 'dab ③ma la//glegs bam sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /sbrang chen snag tsha byas nas ni/ /mi yi rus pa'i sgyu bgu yis/ /dam tshig can gyis dunabri bar bya/ /glegs bam gyedang ni bris sku nyid/ /gal te skal ba med mthong na/ /skye ba 'dir ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol spyod yul min/ /dam tshig sems dpa' ⑦phyin par bya/ /res 'ga' tsam zhig bstan pa'o(3)/ /glegs bam lam gyi spyod yul du/ /skra dang mchan khung dag du sba/ /dam tshig sems dpa' sbyin par bya/ /dgu pa las bris sku dang glegs bam gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o sil snyan yang dag sbyor mtshan nyid/ /bshad par bya yis 0lha mo nyon/ /a ra a ra dzo dzo sma ra sma ra tsa ṭa rba hoḥ ra ṭa be+e ho hu lu hu lu hūṃ dzaḥs dzaḥ.a la a la hū ṇa hū ṇa hū ṇa/ hre hre hre hu rta ghi hu rta ghi ghi ghi ghi ta ṭa ghi ghi rta ṭa ghi sh+lau ta lhe ta ghi ta ghi hordo hajo do rtsu do hūṃ/ ka ka ka ka /kau kau kau/ kai kai kai/bo po bo kau bo kau/ dzi badz+ra badzi bo badz+ra brdza boḥ kaḥbo rkaḥbo keḥbo rmāḥbo rtsu bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo hūm̐ bh+yo/ ru lu ru lu ru lu r+ghaṃ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ bh+yo/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i'o/ /ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ/ ṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ/ ṭak+ki dzaḥ/ 'di ni rol pa'i'o/ /ta ḍa ba ta ḍa ba/ brasmre brasmre/ rta mgrin gyi'o/ /spyo smi phroṃ sgyi ā+oṃ zlo ṣ+ṭṛ sgyi kau/ hrī ṭī trī ñtsā trī ṭī/ gshin rje'i rgyal po'i'o/ /dz+rī dz+rī/ rku 79wa 400

ṭ+wāṃ rku ā+oṃ khan+ta kho khan+ta khe khan+ta kho/ pad+mo pad+mo/ dz+rī pad+mo dz+rī pad+mo/ blo spyo d+mo blo spyo spyo/ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ dz+rī spyo ā+oṃ spyo/ ṭhā rta spyo rta/ ā+oṃ dz+rī two/nyu) sgrol ma'i'o/ /de nas cang te'u'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /brdza shir+sha ②rtsa ba dang / /tsan+dan dmar po las byung dang / /gzhan rnams gang rnams de rnams ni/ /yid la 'dod pa rnams la bya/ /de yi tshad 'di bka' stsal pa/ /bcu gnyis pa dang bcu pa nyid/ /kha la sor ni drug dang lnga/ /dgu pa dang ni bcu gcig nyid/ /kha la de yi phyed nyid do/ /gzhan pa yi yang rnge'u ( )chung ni/ /thod pa las ni bskor ba nyid/ /spre'u'i pags cipas g.yogs pa'o/ /de bzhin kha sbyor gnyis la ni/ /pad+ma dag ni bri bar bya/ /bud med khrag gis mdzes pa dang 9ge/ /dur khrod skyes pa'i skra las ni/ /bkal nas rus pa gnyis ni bcing 6/ /khyim gyi me tog gnyis 3)kyis ni / /pad+ma ze 'bru gnyis pa la/ /dkyil 'khor nyid ni bri bar bya/ /mtshan mo bzhi mdo dag tu ni/ /rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis9she/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi mtshams su ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bri bar bya/ /der gnas g.yon pa'i ngos su ni/ /ji ltar dang por ming bzung ba/ /khe r+ghaṃ zhes ni brjod nas ni/ /chu skyar (7rkang pa'i rus pas gdab/ /de ltar g.yo ldan ma la sogs/ /thams cad 'gugs par byed par 'gyur/ /gal te 'ongs par bom gyur na/ /de tshe mkha' 'gro ma kun 'chi/ /nges pa nyid du 'grub 'gyur bas/ /ngas gsungs pa la the tshom med/ /gal te khros pas slob dpon gyis/ /cang te'u rdung 1)bar byed pa na / /de tshe mchi ma 'dzag cing ngu / /khyod ni dam tshig la ni khro bo sngon po mdzesal/ /dngos grub phyag na dbyig to tsherin chen bcings pa 'dzin/ /kye dpal ldan dpa' bo 'du bar 'khor ba sgrol ba 'khums/ /mkha' (1semadzes rnal 73—401

'byor ma yi ①nang du bdag thong shig② /tshogs kyi 'du ba bzang po nyid/ /lha mo skal ②ba chen mo nyon/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa mo/ /gang du zos pas 'grub 'gyur ba/ /dur khrod ri yi tshang tshing dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du 'am④/ /yang na (snyedaben pa'am bas mtha' ru/ /bza' ba 'di dag yang yidag brtsam/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /de bzhin bza' ba bca' ba ④nyid/ /chang ni (2)sgeg mo ru ni brjod/ /sbrang chang rab tu myos mar brjod / /bu ram chang ni (9)myos byed gsungs/ /snying po bdud rtsi rgun chang yinabo / /sangs rgyas kun gyi kla klo yis/ /bdud rtsi lam ni yan lag brgyad/ /rgyan 'brum sbrang rtsi dpa' bo gcig /nya phyis rtsub ⑩pa'i 'dod pa can/ /sings po bshang bar brjod pa ste/ /rtsabs 8dang bran mo sings por brjod/ /de ltar bza' ba sna tshogs dang / /chang dang nya dang yang dag ldan/ /dga' ba'i longs spyod skal bzang bas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub/ /a mra smin dang pa na si/ /rgun 'brum nā ri ke la 0dang / / ā lu ka ④la sogs pa nisko/ /'bras bu sna tshogs tha dad pa/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dbul bar bya / /'dis ni glu ⑩dang phyag rgya dang / /nges the 1par gar kyang khyad par du'o/ /ka ka ka ka ka ka ka ka /hi nyi hi hi hi hi hi hi/ d+mo smo 58/ hūṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ rgyu hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐/ hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hāyi/ i hā hā i hā hā/ hā hā hās )/ dzā ṭ+wāṃ dzā ṭ+wāṃ/ a i a i a istso/ rdza dzā/ dzi dzo dzā/ dzi dzā dzi dzā dzi dzā dzi dze+e dzo rdzo/ dzi te e/ hi hi hi hi tī/ hi nyi hi nyi tī/ hi hi hi hi tī/hi hi hi nyi tī/ nyi hi nyi tī/ lja tī tī hi nyi hi tī rdzo tī tī nyi nyi hi tī rdzo tī tī/kurdza hi nyi nye/ de ltar kla klos kun 'dar nyid/ /he ru ka yi sbyor bas gar/ /79—402

phyag rgya nyid kyang khyad par du'o/ /gang phyir lta stangs de khu tshur/ /lta stangs khu tshur rkang pas rkang / /ji ltar rnal 'byor rim pa las/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rnam par mdzad/ /sring ①mo'i bu mo sgyug mo dang / /ma dang sring ②mo yin na yang / /de rnams gang bar mchod nas ni / /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub par 'gyur/ /skyes pa'i thod chen ⑦cha gcig par/ /chang ni bzang pos yongs bkang ste/ /bla ma la dbul skal chen ma/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni rang yang btung ske/ /pad+ma'i lag pas blang ba dang / /de nyid kyi ⑤ni lag pas dbul/ /yang nas yang du phyag 'tshal ba/ /de la sgrub pa po yis bya/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba ⑥bya ba bzhi'i rtsonyede kho na'i rgyal po ste brtag pa dgu pa'o // //rdo rje slob dpon dam tshig gi/ /grub rtags lag na rdo rje nyon/ /dang por dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /snying ga (kyeyi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /rang gi dbang sogs rgyas pa yis/ /rang gis nang du zhugs pas na/ /rdo rje slob dpon mtshungs med pa/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gang phyir thos (7pa de nyid kyi0/ /bsam gtan spro ba nyid kyi phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'grub par ⑩'gyur / /rdo rje sems dpa' lhonyesnying po sogs/ /'bum du bzlas pas rab tu 'grub / /skal tsob kun gyi sngon grub tshepas/ /slob dpon chen po gdod nas grub/ /cho ga 'dis ni sems can rnams/ /rgyal bar 'gyur bar 8the tshom med/ /gnyis med spro bar bcas pa rnams/ /de nyid gnas shing tsogo cha bgos / /thams cad mkhyen pa hu snagang gang gi/ /rigs kyi rab tu dbye ba las/ /79—403

phyag rgya gang dang gang gsungs pa/ /de dang de ni7cho gas blangs②/ /de dang de nyid kyis ni bsgrubal/ /gti mug bdag nyid nges par ma/ /lha mo'am skye5geganyis bdag nyid skyes/ /gti mug rnam dag bsam gtan pas/ /blangs nas mngon du rnam snang rizhena'agyur/ /ma ni rig ma dam pa ste/ /gal te pha yis sngar bstan sko6)kyang / /de bzhin de nyid kyis kyang 'grub/ /bde ba chen pos bka' stsal to/ /zhe snang bdag nyid gdol pa mo/ /bu mo'ang9)gnod sbyin bu mo blang //zhe sdang rnam dag bsam gtan pa/ /mi bskyod pa ni mngon du 'gyur/ /'dod chags bdag nyid gar mkhan ma/ /sring mo'am klu mo lha min blangs/ /'dod chags rnam dag bsam gtan pa/ /'od dpag med pa kye)bsgom par 'gyur/ /phrag dog bdag nyid bzo shes ma/ /chu 'byung shermedaga' ma'am sring mo yi/ /bu mo yang dag blangs nas ni/ /phrag 1 dog rnam dag bsam gtan pa/ /dpa' bo don yod grub par 'gyur/ /nga rgyal bdag nyid mna' ma'am/ /rgyal po'i bu mo'am rig 'dzin ma/ /blangs nas nga rgyal rnam dag pa'i/ /bsam༄nyagatan pa de nor bu'i rigs/ /'byung gnas su ni 'gyur ba'o/ /spyan dang lhan cig sangs rgyas nyid12/ /mā ma tī 1 dang mi bskyod par/ /'grub 'gyur dkar mo lhan cig tu/ /pad+ma can dang sgrol ma ni/ /lhanam cig don yod grubalgepar 'gyur / /rin chen rin chen ma dang 'grub/ /rigs pas 'dod pa 'di dag 'grub / /gzhan yang 'dis ni khro bo yi/ /lha dang rgyal ba'i sras po dang / /khro bo rab gtum cho ga dang / /zhi la zhi ba'i cho ga yis/ /zhi ba rab tu 'grub par 'gyur / /'dod chags rgya chen zhen pa dang / /nga rgyal ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur / /de ltar dka' ba med pa'i thabs/ /kun mkhyen thugs rje bcas pas 79wa 404

bsngagasal/ /shin tu bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs/ /brtul zhugs dka' thubarkyaspyod pa spangs/ /de ltar bdud rtsi'i ro rnyed〈kyenas/ /nyon mongs gzhom phyir mi brtson gang / /ji ltar dka' thub brtul zhugs des/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni bya bar nus/ /rang gi bde ba'i thabs rnyed nas/ /gang zhig bdag don mi byed pa / /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid de yi ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni gang du 'gyur/ /yang ni de ni shes mi 'gyur/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas thams cad du/ /skye bo dam pas mthong ba nyid/ /las kun rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ /sangs rgyas chos la mi shes pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du/ /ji srid ma phyin bar du bya/ /bcu pa las slob dpon dang phyag rgya byin gyis brlab pa ste rab tu byed pa dang po'o de nas gang du rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa der 'di lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ste/ sa 'di dag dga' zhing mgu la rangs pas rnam pa drug tu g.yos nas bdud kyi gnas su cha lang lta bu'i sgra grags zipa dang / phyogs bcur bskal pa'i me lta bu'i skar mda' ltung ba dang / rgya mtsho chen po 'khrugs pa'i sgra dang ske/ thams cad du gnam rdo ltung ri ba dang / de nyid du bskal pa'i me'i gzugs lta bu'i ye shes kyi snang ba 'bar ba dang / phyag rgya'i skye gnas kyi snying por khams gsum thams cad snang ba dang / tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang ske/ chu bdag dang / brgya byin dang / drag po dang / me dang / stobs bzang po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / gnod sbyin dang / grub pa dang /dri za dang / mi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye dang / lha'i mchog dang / rig pa 79—405

'dzin pa dang / chus7)byung la sogs pa gang zhig gzhan⑧yang sum cu rtsa gsum du gnas pa'i lha rnams der 'ongs nas yang dag par dga' bas me tog gis ③mchod par byed do/ /pi bangasredang / gling bu dang / mu kuṇ+ḍasnyidang / tasbu ra dang / dung dang / zangs dung dang / nanishedang / pa ṭa ha dang / rdza rngas nam mkhar gnas te/ der7rtag tu mchod par byed do/ /lha'i bu mo dang ske/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po'i bu mo thams cad kyis gar byed pa dang /sil snyan du ma byed pa dang / mi 'am ci dang / gnod sbyin gyis glu len par byed cing gar byed pa dang / de la dga' ba dang bcas pas rgyal ba rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i sgras rtag tu rol par byed pa dngas/ gang zhig grub pa ⑨nam mkhar gnas pa'i lha 1 nornams kyis ni legs so'i rnam pa rab tu gsol bar mdzad do/ /gang zhig dga' ldan du gnas pa'i lha 31rab mchog dang / gang zhig lha'i bu dang ske/ rig pa 'dzin pa pa 32dang / 'og min gyi bar du 'ongs nas phyag 'tshal zhing me tog sna tshogs kyi hunyernam pa midang / dri sna tshogs kyisachar dang /bdug pa sna tshogs kyi khyad par gyisalgegs pa'i 0tshul gyis mchod par byed do/ /gzhan yang khyod la rgyas par bshad pa'i tshul gyis ci zhig dgos te/ bsgrub par bya ba'i bsod nams kyis khams gsum du skyes pa'i mchod pa de rnams kyis mchod par byed do/ /nyunyabacu pa las bde ba chen po'i dngos grub kyi mchod pa dang rim gro zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o/zhe// //rig ma'i skyes bum )grub pa ni(sto/ /gang du mchimanyezhing gang du gnas/ /bdag la the tshom 'di dag ni/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom 79wa 406

ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa ni/ gang du yangashemi 'gro/ gang du yang〈mi gnas/ thog ma dang / tha ma dang / dbus dang bral ba/ gnyis su med pa/ gnas gsum du snang ba/ thams cad7son pa/thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad pa/ thams cad kyi don thams cad sems can thams cad kyi sems la gnas pa/ sdig pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba / yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan par byas pa/ thams cad dang ldan pa/zhi ba/ mnyam pa med pa/ rtag tu 'char bar mdzad pa/ mgon po/ skyob pa / kun tu rtog pa spangs pa④/ dbyibs dang kha dog dang bral ba/ rgyal ba'i yang spyod yul ma yin pa/ rgyal po phyed par dka' ba'i phyir rdo rje/ nyon mongs pa'i nye bar gdung ba las grol ba'i phyir zla ba/ dogasalgepa med pa'i phyir seng ge/ gting dpag par dka' ba'i phyir chu'i phung po'o/ /de ltar dpe sna tshogs kyis rnal 'byor pa rnams kyisridaper bya'o/ /de nyid gcig pus sems can rnams kyi don byed pa dang / rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs pasashekyang bltamasalgepa ston pa dang / khab nas mngon par 'byung ba dang / gzhon nu'i rol rtsed mdzad pa dang / rab tu byungakheb dang / rdo rje gdan gyipha )sa mnan pa dang / bdud btul ba mnyam pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas pa dang /dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bstan pa dang / lha las babs pa nyams dga' ba dang / shin tu sna tshogs pa'i cho 'phrul dang / glang po che nor skyong 'dul ba dang / skal ba dang ldan pa'i skye bo dag pa gzhug pa7gledang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcad 8pa dang / bsod snyoms kyi hu lhung bzod la ltos pa med pa dang /'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo 'dul ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rgyal tshab 73—407

nyid dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po chen po ste/ de ltar rigs kyi bu 'di ltar khyad par du ma mi lam lta bur sangs rgyas kyi rol pa mchog tu ston par mdzad de/ gang zhig grub pa sgyu ma'i tshul gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi don mdzad do/ /bcu pa las sangs rgyas kyi sgyu ma ha)rnam par mdzad pa zhes bya ba du ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //gong du bshang gci khrag dang ni/ /nya dang sha yi sbyin sreg ni/ /lha ni khyod kyis gsungs pa nyid/ /ji ltar ye shes sems dpa' la/ /mi gtsang bas ni kha bkang rin/ /sdig pa ji ltar skye mi 'gyur/ /gal te sdig las ji ltar 'bras/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i sems can gang / /ye shes thabs ni rnam par spangs/ /phyis /rol dngos por mngon zhen pas/ /rtog pa'i dra bas dra bar byas/ /de yi sdig dang bsod nams kyis/ /cha gnyis rnam par rtog pa ste/ /'di rnams chos ni rang bzhin dag /ma skyes pa dang gnas med cing / /sems can ye shes 'phel ba'i phyir/ /don dam las ni bsod nams nyid/ /thabs ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan/ /skye ba dang ni spangs med na/ /bsod nams min la su zhig zhen/ /dper na sems can pha rol 'gro/ /chu klung chu yis gang ba la/ /shing dang rtswa ⑥ni bsdus nas ni/ /chu la gzings ni byas nas su/ /de la 'jus nas brgal〈stanas kyang / /spangs nas bde bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i pha rol du/ /chos dang chos min zhon nas ni/ /bde bas byang chub 'thobasnyepar 'gyur/ /chos dang chos min rnam par spangs/ /de phyir rtog pa'i dra ba ni/ /spangs nas zab mo'i 79wa 408

chos ni 'phel/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i lam/ /lam rig rnam par rtog mi bya/ /rnam rtog gti mug chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas pa/ /mkha' bzhin dri mnyemed par 'gyur / /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /sku gsung thugs ni 'dus pa yis(rim/ /nga rgyal las ni rgyal ba'i gzugs/ /rnam pa thams cad yongs su spangs / /rnam par shes pa rdzogs pas ni/ /skye ba 'dir ni ye shes can/ /bud med dang ni skyes pa'i lus/ /las ni du mas bskyed pa ston/ /mi shes pas kyang mi bya ste/ /sku yi rdo rje'i dam tshig go/ /sems can sna tshogs gdungakhub dang ske/ /kun rtog ngan pa'i ④rnam rtog gis/ /sems la smad par mi bya ste/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig go/ /phrag dog nyidasnyikyis ma rungs pas/ /tshig rtsub la sogs smra mi bya/ /rna ba bde bar byed pa nyid/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i dam tshig go/ /sha yi khams gnas sangs rgyas ni/ /rnam snang chen po rtse mor skye/ /rkang la mi bskyod gnas pa nyid/ /khrag ni rin chenashelta bur ni/ /nor bu chen pos7rnam par brgyan/ /rus pa la ni 'od dpag med/ /sems can rnams kyi rigs bcas 'bab/ /rtsa yi 'ching ba'i tshogs kyi sgor6)/ /don yod thub pa rgyal po nyid/ /khyod la gsang ba nga yis bshad/ /dam tshig ye shes rig pas bsten / /blo ldan thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /rtag pa ru ni bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /sred pa dang ni 'du byed 'phel/ /'di lnga thub pa'i rgyal pos nya cigasungs/ /bshang gci khu ba bad kun dang / /khrag dang yongs su 'dzag pa rnams/ /'byung ba bzhi ni yongs gzung 31nas/ /blo yis 3 rdzogs pa yongs bsgoms pas/ /gang zhig dam tshig bstan 1nyepar bya/ /thams cad du 79wa 409

ni zosanyepas 'byung / /dper na bud ②med byis pa yis / /gtam la7rjes mos smra ba yi/ /'du ba'i gtam ni brjod pa ste/ /lam yang 'ching bsnyimed par brjod/ /de lta'i cho gas rnal 'byor pa'i/ /legs pa'i lam ni ston pa'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / 6)mkha' 'gro ma dang /mkha' 'gro bye ba phrag brgyad cu dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge 'dun du ma'i 'khor thams cad dga' zhing mgu ba'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi9)ye shes thams cad kyis7thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pa thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang ske/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga'o9)/ /rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba de kho na nyid thams cad kyi gleng gzhi brtag pa'i rgyal po chen po ste bcu pa rdzogs so// // rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di ni paṇ+ḍi ta gā ya dha ra dang / bdag nyid chen po 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba las/ slad kyis thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis rgya dpe rtsa 'grel dang bstun nas hor kong bsabs shing 'gyur bcos legs par mdzad pa las bris so// tu )de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pas yang mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thig ler71tshothig le dag gi 12don/ /gtan phab yang dag gsal gsungs na/lha/ /bdag gi 79—410

dbus su rang byung bas/ /des na0)rang byung brjod par bya/ /rang byung zhes bya 'byung chen gyi/ /don ni rjes su dpag bya'i phyir/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu nyid ni lhag pa'i lha/ /lhag pa'i lha zhes bya ba ni/ /gong du gsungs pa'i khams rnams so/ /de rnams dbus su phul byung chel/ /zhes bya gtso bo'i gzugs kyis jo9/ /gsang ba mchog tu dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyidasnyirtag tu bzhugs/ /ji lta bur ni bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i0sdom/ /gzhan du ji ltar rnam pa 'dis/ /sdom pa mchog tu phan pa lagasal/ /gsang ba'i sgras ni yon tan can/ /gsang〈ba'ang yon tan du ni grags/ /rdo rje can ni yon tan can/ /'jig rten mchog dgyes smod pa spangs/ /gsang ba'i sgra ni kla klo'i skad/ /phyi rol rjes su btsal bas kyang7/ /'di ni mngon sum shes par bya/ /rjes dpag yon tan can gyi sgras/ /gang tshe sems ni mi mthong ste/ /sems zhes57bya ba 'di yang ni/ /yon tan can dang yon tan gsungs/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /gsang ba 'di la chos nyid gnas/ /de la thams cad bdag nyid ni/ /de ni〈rtethams cad rnam par gnas/ /de gang stong pa'i rdo rje can/ /sdug dang lhan cig dga' ba'o/ /gang tshe sems kyi gzugs kyis ni/ /sngo sogs mig gis mi dmigs shing / /rnam7sogs thos par mi 'gyur ba/ /de tshe sems ni ji ltacabur / /de tshe rjes dpag ji ltar lags/ /'di ni tsosna yis mi dmigs na/ /dri bzangs 3 snadabus su gnas sam ci/ /sems ni phyi rol mi dmigs shing / /de bzhin nye ba'i longs spyod med/ /ro ni mngar dang /2kha la min/ /de bzhin 73—411

du ni reg bya nyid/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /gsang ba 'di ni ji lta nyu)bur/ /rjes su dpag pas bsam par bya/ /ji ltar yi ge'i dbyibs su ni/ /phyin⑧pa yi ni ye shes nyid/ /gzhan du bcom ldan sgra ji ltar/ /lha zhes bya ba ji ltar lags/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nges don cil/ /mnyam par sbyor ba ci zhes bgyi/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni gang gi ming / /dra ba ji lta bu zhig lags/ /sdomasapa zhes bya5geci zhig bshad/ /de bzhin spyad par dka' nerab nyid/ /khyod kyis 'dod chags med gsungs ci/ /chags bral gemed pa de bzhin gzhan/ /dbu ma zhes bya gang gi ming / /bud med kun gyi sgyu ma ci/ /stong nyid gzugs khams la sogs pa/ /ci zhig bshad cing mnyam nyid sbyor/ /dang po rnam pa drug 'gyur dang / /sna tshogs pad+mar bris sku dang / /ā li kā li phyag rgya che/ /de nyid med sems rnal 'byor dang / /de nyid bzang po ji ltar lags/ /rnal 'byor nyid la mnyam gzhag dang / /phyi rol dag kyang yang dag bshad/ /zla ba nyi mas8)rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'byung51)ba ji lta bu zhig lags/ /bris pa dang ni ma bris pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor ji ltar gzhag0 )par bgyi/ /de bzhin sngags dang rgyud nyid dang / /gsang ba'i gnas ni mi 'tshal zhing / /pad+ma bzhi 11ni khyad par du/ /bdag dang bdag gi ji ltar lags / /de bzhin sems dang sems byung 3 nyid/ /sems kyi ngo bo ye shes gsungs / /de bzhin rnam par shes pa nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po dang ske/ /de bzhin chos dang chos can nyid/ /chu bo'i rgyud 1nyeni ci zhes bshad/ /rgya mtsho yang ni khyad par du'o/ /sna tshogs nyid ni khyod gsungs na/ /mang po ji ltar 'thob mi 'gyur/ /rnam shes ye shes khyod kyis gsungs/ /de bzhin bcud 79—412

kyis7len nyid dang / /g.yon brkyang la sogs ci lags dang / /gzhu yis rnam rgyal de bzhin gzhan/ /gtso dang〈snyegatso min sgra ci lags/ /brtag pa yang ni ci zhig gsungs/ /byang chub chen po'i chosashernams ni/ /sum cu rtsa bdun nang gi dang / /sku la sogs pa de bzhin gzhan/ /nyan thos rnams kyis khyod gsungs dang / /des kyangasredagos pa ci zhig mchis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che'i/ /rnam pa'i rnal 'byor gyis ni ci/ /tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug kyangs/ /de bzhin gsol ba ci yi don/ /'dod pa'i lha ni chung mar bcas/ /lha mo dka' zlogarnyugazugs bzangs57)ma/ /gong du skyabs su song ba nyid/ /gnyis gnyis sbyor ba 'dod mdzad pa/ /'di ltar sbyor ba'i 'thab mo dang / /de la gsang ba ji lta bu/ /rdo rje can gyis rdzun pa 4)/ /phyis ni tshig tu smra bar mdzad/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' yang57/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug dang / /zla ba sngar gsungs gzhan du ni/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /ji ltar rdo rje can zhi bas/ /khro bo'i gzugs can ji ltar lags/ /chos kyi sku ni ji ltar lags/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa ci zhig lags/ /sprul pa rdo rje nyid 'byung dang / /te ru ka ni ji ltar 37gsungs/ /pad+ma gar dbang ji ltar lags/ /gshin rje'i〈nyegazugs su ji ltaratshwa 'gyur/ /de bzhin du ni rta mchogasanyid / /ji ltar cho gas ci gsungs dang / /lha mo de bzhin khro bo nyid/ /kla klo 8khyod kyis bshad pa ni/ /des kyang dgos pa ci zhig mchis/ /re zhig⑩lha mo rnams kyi tshig /btu bar byas pa ji ltar lags/ /sngags kyi smra pos〈 7'di dag ni / /ji ltar rdo rje sems khyod kyis/ /thams cad yang dag rnam par shod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di skad bdag gis zhesatshwa bya ba la 79—413

sogs pa nas gzung7)ste/ dang por btsam par byas nas 'dir yang rjes su 'byung ste/ rigs kyi bu yang brjod par bya'o/ /gsang ba'i sgras ni bdun gyi rnam pa ste bdun pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /brgyad pa ni brjod du med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /gsang ba zhes bya ba'i sgras ni sems dang sems las byung ba gnyis su med pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gsungs so/ /de bzhin nyid du〈ro gcig pa nyid ngo bo gcig pas der zhugasang bar byung ba'i phyir gsang ba ste/nam mkha' thams cad du khyab par 'gro ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyi tshad de/dpal rdo rje sems dpa'itswaye shes kyi phyag rgya la sogs pa dang / rdo rje'i⑧lha mo dang ldan pa ni gnas so/ /kye bcom ldan 'das khyad par du 'phags pa'i gnas gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' su55 pa/ mchog ces bya ba ni khyad par du 'phags pa ste geyi shes dam pa'i yul lo/ /dgyes pa na7zhes bya ba ni nyams dga' ba na ste(8)/ dpe thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /spyan la sogs pa dang yang dag par sbyor bas dga' bar byed pas nyams dga' bar byed pa'i phyir dgyes pa na'o/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba dang / lha mo thams cad dang mnyam par 'gro bas nam mkha'i〈shekhams kyi mthas 3 gtugs par lha mo thams cad kyi bde ba 11chen por sbyor ba thams cad kyi bde ba dang ldan pa 'di las 'byung 32ba'i stobs ni gzhal du med deX / phan tshun du rab tu rangs pasalgedaga' bar byed cing / skyes bu rnams dang de rnams kyi dga' ba ni dgyes pa na'o / /thams cad bdag nyid ces bya ba ni thams cad kyi bdag nyid de/rigs kyi bu de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas gang sngar gsungs pa'o/ /de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gsungs te/ thams cad 79—414

bdag nyid kyis ni deshegasungs so/ /de ltar gyur pas thams cad bdag nyid ces bya ba 'dis gnas phun sum tshogs pa gsungs so/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i gnas su so so bskyedasapa'i rang bzhin gyis ji snyed btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus su rtag tu bzhugs so zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas dngasakun 'dis9)sangs rgyas kun te/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'o/ /rtag pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa de ⑤rnams kyis byas pa'i phyir ram/rang bzhin gyi phyir gnas ni sangs rgyas kun dngos zhes bya ste/ sgyu 'am rang bzhin lasnyedangos po'o/ /sems dpa' ni sems can gyi don la nus pa'i phyir ro / /rdo rje ni thabs dang shes rab kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi phyir ro/ /sems dpa' ni rnam par rtog pa thams cad kyis mi bskyod pa'i phyir ro/ /bde ba ni sngar gsungs pa'i dga' ba'i sbyor ba las shin tu ldan par zhi ba'i yid kyi rang bzhin gyi phyir ro/ /mchog ni khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ bde ba'i go 'phangashe'adi rnams kyi sems dpa' 'di rnams kyi don dam pa'i phun sum tshogs pa gsungs so/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i sdom/ /zhes bya ba mi 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gzhan nyid du brjod par bya ba'i phyir /tshomedogs pa bsu nas bka' stsal pa 'di ni zhes bya ba ni gang de skad du rigs kyi bu de geni gsungs pa de nyid/ sangs rgyas thams cad5nyemanyam sbyor7ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi7dra ba'i sdomatsha/ /zhes bya ba'i don to/ /lha mo thams cad kyis yongs su bskor cing / dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa ni skal hunyeb bzang po5nyeste/ rang gi bdag nyid kyi sgrub pa shin tu sbyor ba de nyid mchog tu 'dod chags rjepa dang ldan pa'o/ /79—415

skyes bu med pa'ishegar mkhan rang gi btsun7mo'i 'khor gyi nang du gnas pa'i phyiral shin tu don la rnam par mi g.yeng bas lha mo rnams dang yang dag par sbyor ba'i bde ba myongasnyibar bya'o/ /yang dag par sbyor ba ni rnal 'byor te zhes pa'o//brtan pa/ rtag pa(5)/ mchog tu yang yid srub pa'ostso)/ /yang na brtan pa ni9)rnam parashertog pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang mtha'i mtha' ji srid gnas pa'i phyir rtag pa'o/ /mchog tu yid srub pa ni lha mo thams cad kyi bde ba rjes su myong ba'i phyir rospu/ /brtan pa dang / rtag pa dang / mchog tu yid srub pa 'di ni brtan pa dang / rtag pa dang / mchog tu yid srub pa'o / /sangs rgyas kun zhes bya ba ni gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang /ro dang / reg bya ste/ yul gyi rang bzhin rnams so/ /rang gi bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyu mthun pas ci zhig byed ces7na/ 'di ni rang gi longs spyod dang /de rnams za bar byed do/ /gzhan du na ni tha dad pa'i dngos po la rang gisasngotshe nye bar longs spyod pa nyid ma yin no/ /ye shes kyi rang bzhin so sor skyes pa ni rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang shin tu mi spong ste/ rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba 32'dod chags kyi spyod pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin las gang zhig 'dod chags kyitshwanyespyod pa de rnams ni mirdo rje sems dpa'i cho ga 'dod pa'o/ /gang zhig rang bzhin bzang po de rnams ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi dngos grub 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar zhe snang dang / 'dod chags dang / ser sna dang / le lo la 7spyod pa rnams kyis he ru ka dang / pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / rdo rje nyi ma tshadang /rta mchog gi cho ga 'dod par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de lta de ltar 'dod chags la spyod pa la sogs 1 7pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis ji ltar dpal rdo rje sems 79—416

dpa' la sogs pa skyedamanya)par 'gyur brtso bskyed nas/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor las bskyed de/ rnal 'byor gyi gtam gyis slob ma 'dul bar byed dol/ /gtam ni brjod pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gtam ji lta bu lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gtam brjod pa ste/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i rang bzhin du byas pa'o/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i chos kyi sku'i rgyu mthun pa nyid kyis 5)ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rang bzhin la nye bar spyod pa'i phyir dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa bskyed pa'o/ /rang bzhin brjod par bya ste/ brtanam )pa zhes bya ba ni chos ri rab ltar brtan pa'o/ /dper na ri rab ༄rlung gis 6)bzlog par khyadaka' zhing rab tu gtum pas kyang 47bskyod par mi nus so/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'di ni 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / mu stegs can ngan pa'i rgol 9ba rab tu gtum zhing rab tu 'joms pas rang lhag par 'gro zhing bskyod par mi nus so/ /dur khrod du bzhugs pas kyang sems can thams cad kyi 3 )rgyud du rgyu zhing rnam par dag pa'i〈nye)sems chos kyi sgo du mar rjes su 'khor zhing / lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das 'khor bar bzhugs pa'o/ /brtan pa zhes bya ba ni gnas pa'i phyogs so/ /g.yo ba zhes bya ba hurteni sems can gyi rgyud las gzung nyurteste/ de rnams ni bcom ldan 'das kyis shes par bya'o/ /ji ltar rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid de rnams nyid de gzhan dang rnam pa gcig pa'i ngo bo ste/ de minyid kyi phyir bcom ldan 'das 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rnams la bzhugs so / /sems can nyid kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de/ dngos po'i 79—417

don dam pa la gnas pas de bzhin gshegs pa zhes gsungs so/ /g.yo ba nituspre'u lta bu snyiste/ gang zhig sems can thams cad kyi sems brtan pa'i phyir sems dpa' zhes gsungs so/ /'dzin pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin te/ nges par 'byed pas rdo rje nyid du 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir sems kho na g.yo ba nyid dukhugasungs shing phyi rol la7sogs pas ma yin te/ de rnams ni gcig dang du mas dngos po med pa'i phyir ro/ /thams cad ces bya ba ni ma lus pa'o/ /dngos po zhes bya ba ni gnas kyi don to/ /srid pa zhes bya ba ni skye ba'o/ /brtan pa dang g.yo ba zhes bya ba ni brtan pa dang g.yo ba'o/ /dngos po dang thams cad 'di ni dngos popo)thams cad de/ de ni brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad dngos po dang srid pa'o/ /brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni gang gi thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin 'di ni brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi bdag nyid tsho7)de/ de nyid kyi phyir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can gyis rdo rje 'dis52)bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kyi chos 9)nyid kyis brtan pa dang / g.yo ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi bdag nyid de/ 'dis7'di dag brjod par 'gyur ba'i〈mechos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa dang / me long lta bu la sogs pas〈nyabasdus par 'gyur ba rtag pa dang / mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga po thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs pa bsdus par 'gyur ba'o1ge/ /kun gyi sgras ni yongs su zhes bya bar gzung ñdza ngo / /mnyamatsha8par sbyor ba ni 'du ba'o/ /gang du zhe na/gsang bar te/ thams cad kyi chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bdag nyid du yin gyi gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /gang dang lhan cig zhe tshan/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 79—418

sems dpa' dang ste/ de dang yang dag pa'i rang gi ngo bosashesprul pa la sogs pa'i yan lag dgu yis so/ /'on kyang longs spyod rdzogs pa can du mdzad pa'i sku gcig gis thams cad nas de'i bdag nyid kyi chu dang 'o ma lta bur 'ong ba yongs su 'dzin to/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis phyi dang nang gi dngos po thams cad kyi nang du〈(de kho na skad cig gis ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mdzadam pa ltar rtogs shing shes so/ /de bas na sangs rgyas thams cad dang / de las gzhan pa rnams kyi lhan cig yang dag par sbyor ba ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /mnyam pa'i dus ni dbyer med pa'i dus te/ sbyor ba'i gnas kyis thams cad kyi desamachogesems tsam du snyoms par zhugs pas gcig tu gyur pa'i dngos pos phan tshun du bsdus pas dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyis thams cad du 'gro ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba zhes gsungs so/ /de bas na sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor bas ni phyogs bcu'i nam mkharasngon)'gro ba yang dag par mthong ba 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang (nyamanyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' 'gro mar gsungs so/ /dra ba'i sgras kyang sgyu ma'i rnam grangs su blta ste/shing la sogs pa rnams las sgyu ma'i rnam par sprul pa'i glang po chelo la sogs pa ltar mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams lus med kyis ⑧'dul ba'i sems can mi spong ri'o/ba'i phyir ro/ /dkar mo la sogs pa'i rdo rje lha mo'i gzugs la reg pa'i phyir de 7nyid gyur pas sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid kyis gang zhig zag pa med pa'i bde bas 3 1yid zhi ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa mang por 'gyur ro/ /de nas sdom pa'i sgras〈she79—419

brjod par bya ste/ si zhes bya ba ni bde ba'o/ /ba ra zhes7bya ba ni khyad par du 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /bud med kun ni gong du gsungs so/ /sgyu ma ni50ji skad du gsungs pa ste/ sgyu mas sgyu ma'i rang bzhin des5bzhes bya ba'i don to/ /de yang rang bzhin gyis grub ste grubalgepa rdzogs pa'o/ /ji ltar rang gi ngo bo yongs su gyur pa ④zhe na/ rang rnams dang57de rnams kyi gzugs can ni rang gi5shegazugs can te/ kun gzhi dang / nyon mongs pa can dang /yid dang / mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa de0)rnams yongs su gyur pa ni rang gi ngo bos yongs su gyur pa'o/ /bdag med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgom pas me long lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang ske/ so sor rtog 31pa dang / bya ba nan tan gyi rang bzhin la gnas nas ldog par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gang gi phyir rang gi ngo bo yongs su gyur pas tu bud med thams cad kyi sgyu ma'i rang bzhin gyi tu)dngos grub yin te/de'i phyir rnyed pa kun gyi tshabade spro bas/ /bud med thams cad 'grub par 'gyur / /zhes bya ba yin no/ /sna tshogs dang sgyu ma ni sna tshogs sgyu ma ste/ kha dog dang dbyibs sna tshogs pa las lha mo thams cad la sogs pa'i gzugs jokhu/ /de'i sna tshogs sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di bzung nas blo la gzhag 7par byas nas 'di skad bka' stsal pa/ 1 mkha' 'gro ma bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis 1)btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du son pa'i 17phyogs bcu'i nam mkhar ( )gang zhig 'gro ba 'di ༷ nyani sgyu ma sna tshogs kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba'i don to/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi bstan bcos kyi nang du rab tu grags padza rtemi gsal ba'i skad kyis rang gi brdar byas pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /73—420

mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa 'di ni mdor bsdus nas gsungs pa yin no/ /gang gi phyir bud med thams cad ni bcom ldan 'das kyi rdo nyurje lha mo'o/ /'khor bar byed pa'i kun gzhi rnam par shes pa la sogs pa rnam pa brgyad la gnas nas ldog pa'i mtshan nyid kyis me long lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes kyi sgyu ma'i rang bzhin gyis〈grub pa'o/ /de'i me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs pa ni 〈sna tshogs sgyu ma'i rang gi ngo bo ste/de rnams kyi sgyu mas nam mkhara'age'agro ba'i bya ba ste/5)/ de ni gzugs sna tshogs su 'gyur7te/ de'i phyir sna tshogs sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di ni mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya bar brjod par bya'o/ /kla klos〈de rnams kyi nam mkhar 'gro bamacha'aba' zhig gis bya ba ni mkha' 'gro mar brjod pa ma yin te/ dedza97skad du/ nam mkha' kun du spyod grub pa/ /mkha' nya )'gro ma zhes rab tu grags zhes71de'i phyir bshad do / /kun las zhes nyurtebya ba ni phyogs bcu'o/ /sna tshogs dang de'i phyag rgya ni sna tshogs phyag rgya ste/ spyan la sogs pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /gzugs brnyan gyi rnal 'byor gyis sems can gyi khams la phyag rgyas 'debs pa'i phyir des na phyag rgya zhes brjod do/ /sna tshogs zhes nyi bya ba ni thams cad kyi rang bzhin nam/dpal rdo rje sems dpa'apha thams cad dang / phyag rgya ni sna tshogs kyi phyag rgya'o/ /kun las sna tshogs tunyesdom pa yis/ /zhes nyunyabya ba ni rnam pa sna tshogs pa ste/bde ba'i mchog gis nam mkha' kun tu 'gro ba'i ngo bo ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /sangs rgyas skad dbyings zhes 3)bya ba ni sangs rgyas dpal rnam par snang mdzad la gnas nas mngon par ldog pa ni rang bzhin gyi shekhams rnams te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi rang bzhin gyi 79—421

khams rnams ni/ sangs rgyas kyi skad kyi dbyings7kyi sgras brjod de/ ji ltar dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la gnas nas ②mngon par ldog pa'i rgyu7rnams ni de'i rang bzhin ④khams rnams te ⑤mkha' 'gro ma'i sgras nam 6)mkha' la 'gro ba'i rang bzhin du bstan to/ /de bzhin du rnam par snang mdzad dang / mi bskyod pa dang / rin chen bdag po dang / 'od dpag tu med pa dang / don yod grub pa'ishekhams rnams su〈nyebalta bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma zhes bya ba ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la spyan la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i nam mkha' la 'gro ba thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang / de skad du dpal he ru ka la dkar mo la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i nam mkha' la 'gro ba thams cad he ru sa'i ⑨bdag nyid kyi tu ngemakha' 'gro ma dang / de skad du bdag med ma'i〈nyernal 'byor dang ldan pa lacardo rje ma la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i nam mkha' la 'gro ba thams cad dang〈nye/ bdag med pa'ikhebadag nyid kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang / de skad du ye shes dang ldan pa la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas yongs su bskor ba'i nam mkha' la 'gro ba thams cad ye 32shes kyi bdag nyid can gyi mkha' 'gro ma dang /de ltar sgrol ma dang lhan cig pad+ma can dang / pad+ma'i 'khor lo dang / gshin rje'i rgyal po dang / de skad du rta mchog dang / de bzhin du 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba nyid dang / gzhan yang yid la 'dod pa yang7rigs kyi rab tu dbye bas phye ba la mkha' 'gro mas de bzhin du yongs su bskor ba nyid〈nyedu brjod do/ /de skad du sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro (nyernams bstan nas/sdom pa bshad par bya ba'i phyir bde ba zhes bya ba ni gang zhig bcom ldan 'das 79—422

dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang lhan cig mnyam par sbyor bas gang zhig shin tu bde ba dang ldan par skyed7par byed do/ /de las cir 'gyur zhe na/ mchog ni khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ bde ba thams cad kyi thabs phul du byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de nyid kyi phyir sgyu ma thams cad kyi rab tu sbyor ba ste/ de yangasnyigazhan du7nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang mnyams par sbyor bas ni ma yin no zhes bya ba'i don to/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba'i rab tu sbyor ba nyid kyis gang zhig bde ba bskyed pa de nyid gang gi phyir si gyi sgras ma/brjod do/ /de'i phyir de'i rgyus gang zhig bde ba mchog khyad par du 'phags pa skyed ⑥par byed pa de nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi7yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa de'i rnam par dag pa sgyu ma lta bu'i chos rnams thams cad rtogs pasam④snying rje chen po skye'o/ /stong min zhes bya ba ni khams gsum dang / 'dod pa kun tu spyod pa'i yang dag pa ma yin par kun brtags pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir der yang dag pa ma yin par kun brtags pa'i7stong pa mtshwa )yin pas dngos po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /stong pa min pa'ang min zhes bya ba ni don dam par gzung 47ba dang 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i dngos po med pa ste/ gang gi ye shes kyis gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i dngos po med pa'i〈nyemangon sum du byas parwa de'i ye shes kyang rnam par rtog pa'i spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir dmigs par micha'agyur te/ de nyid kyi phyir de skad du yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi dbu mar rtogasalgepar bya'o zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de yang shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /zhes gsungs te/ de nyid kyi7thabs te snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi snying rje'i 79—423

bdag nyid kyi dmigs pa ni snying rje'i rang bzhin te/ de nas mdzes pa'i snying rje thabs zhesamunya)bya ba ni shin tu5sasnying rje yang tshemadzes pa'i snying rje ste/ btang snyoms kyis dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po'o/ /de nyid thabs te gang gisashin tu snying rje dang ldan pa'i thabs 'di ni mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin te/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad do/ /cir gyur pas zhe na/ chos dag byung bsnyizhes bya bar sbyor 4)ro/ /ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin parasnyiyang dag gsal zhe na/ shes rab ces bya ba ni chos rnams sgyu ma lta bur rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i rnam par brtag par bya ste/ de nyid bdag gi phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /pha rol tus7phyin pa zhes bya ba ni son tshipa ston pa ste/ shes rab pha rol phyin hu)gsal ba/ /zhe'o/ /gang gis zhe7rten/ rnam rtog med par lhag mos pas 3)zhes so/ /ci mdzad ce na/ brtags par ni sngon du bdag po'i nus pa las zhes bya bar dgongs sos/ /ci brtags zhe 8na/ brtags pa kun gyis zhes bya ba ni gzugs la sogs pa rang dbang du sgyu ma lta bu'i ngo bo'o ci'i mtshan nyid rnams las zhe tson/ rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams la/ /sems can don ni yongs su brtags/ /zhes pa ni snying rje'i dbang gis sems can gyi7rtedon rgyur 3)brtags pa'o/ /de brtags pas cir 'gyur zhe na/ sgra brnyan lta bur mnyam pa nyid/ /ces bya ba la sgra brnyan zhes bya ba ni brag ca'i5)sgra'o/ /des dbyangs mchog dang mnyam zhing mnyam par dbyangs kyi rjes su 'gro ba dang sgra rnam par rtog pa'i ngo bo dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas de sgra brnyan lta bur mnyam zhing du byede de ltar gyur par rtog tego/ /de ci zhe na/ de nas 'di ni chos ngag 22byung / /zhes bya ba ni de nas de'i phyir chos las5nyechos kyi don gyi 79—424
