bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (21)

tshog /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu h+ya badz+ra tan+t+ra rā dzal/ bod skad du/dpal gsang ba rdo rje rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo//dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa ru/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo mi gsung ba/ /bdag gis zab mo'i don ma rtogs/ /de phyir khyed kyis bdag la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nyon cig lha mo spyan bzang ②ring / /gsang ba'i 'khor lo shin tu zab/ /rgyud rnams kun tu ma gsungs pa/ /khyod kyi ngor ④mdzad nga yis bshad/ /gsang ba rdo rje rgyud kyi rgyal po las gleng bslang ba'i le'u ste dang po'o// //lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /gsang ba zhes pa ji ltar lags/ /de yi ⑤'khor lo ji ltar lags/ /de yi rdo rje ji ltar lags/ /de yi pad+ma ji 79—530

ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba zhes pa rnam pa bzhi/ /gsang ba'i pho brang dang po ste/ /de nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur phyir/ /gnyis pa rig pa'i pho brang ste/ /bzhi pa'i don ni rig pa'i phyir/ /gsum pa rta mgrinatu'akhor lo ste/ /de yi mgrin⑧par gnas pa'i phyir/ /bzhi pa gsang ba bde skyong ste/ /sdig pa spong phyir bde skyong yin/ /de rnams don ni gsangakhub ste / /brtul zhugs byed cing gtong phod che/ /e bo zab cing chags la dga'/ /khu ba 'dzag cing rak+ta 'bab/ /'di la ston gyis gzhan la gsang / /rdo rje pad+ma zhes bya ba/ /bzhi po gnas pa'i rten yin te/ /dper na khang rten ka ba bzhin / /rgyud kyi don ni rgyun yin no/ /gsang ba rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rgyal po las rtog pa sel ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /re re'i dbye ba ma 'tshal bas/ /'jig rten kun rdzob nyid du lhungaX / /'khrig pa'i zug rngu mi bzadasapas/ /bdag ni 'di nyid du ni 'gum/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba'i pho brang rim pa drug /'dab ma'i grangs ni nyisala'agyur ro/ /rta mgrinatso grangs ni dgu ru shes/ /gsang ba bde skyong rim pa gnyis/ /brgyad dang lnga bcu'i grangs yin no/ /rig pa'i pho brang 'dab ma lnga/ /rigs ni me tog lta bu'o/ /bha ga rab 'bring gsum yin te/ /rnal 'byor mkhas pas btsal bar bya/ /sman dang snum gyi ril bum yis/ /rnal 'byor sor mo la bskus la/ /gzhang kha nas ni phye mas bdug /gsang ba nas kyang snum gyis bdug /de nas rnal 'byor pho 'am mos/ /rtsa de sor mos legs par btsal/ /79—531

ring thung tshad ni sor gnyis nas/ /sor brgyad par ni gar gnas pa/ /shes rab bha ga che chung dang / /de bzhin bha ga granga'3)dro dang / /chu rnams che zhing bde ba chung / /de la rnal 'byor mkhas pa yis/ /bha ga che na bde ba chung / /bha ga che na chung ngu bya/ /chung na de bzhin bskyed par gsungs/ /grang na de bzhin bsro bar bya/ /chu rnams che na chung bar bya/ /'di 'dra'i bha ga gang la yod / /bud med 'di la bha ga mnga'/ /de phyir bud med bcom ldan 'das/ /thabs kyi rdo rje phra sbom dang / /ring ba dang ni thung ba ste/ /shes rab ji bzhin thabs la'o/ /de yi gnas su gzung gebar bya/ /gsang ba rdo rje rgyud kyi rgyal po las gsang ba rtog 0pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /e baṃ rnam pa'i dbus gang du/ /bde ba'i khyad par tshol ba la/ /'di las khyad par med dam ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /shin tu dben pa'i gnas btsal la bza' ba bcud can sna tshogs dang / /btung ba zhim po mang po dang / /gur kumasnyil sogs dri zhim dang / /shin tu 'jam pa'i stan bting 45)la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gnas bcu ru/ /dri zhim thig le re re bya/ /rnal 'byor pha yi gnas lnga ru/ /de bzhin thig le lnga yang bya/ /de nas mkha'abyu gsang byin gyis brlab/ /e las gru gsum gting ring bsam/ /de yi nang du paṃ las ni/ /pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad du bsam/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo bsam/ /'khor lo'i dbus su reg mi bzod na / /de nas thabs kyi rdo rje yang / /hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga bsam/ /oṃ las rdo rje mgo bor bsam/ /phaṭa las rdo rje bu na ga bsam/ /de nas bde ba'i stan 73—532

thog tu/ /sbyor ba rnam pa gsum bya ste/ /yan 3)lag thabs dang sbyor ba dngos/ /'khor lo nyi shu rtsa dgu 'tsho/ /chags pa skye ba'i dri yis byug /bde ba skye ba'i zas zos nas/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /thabs kyis gnas dgur 'o yang bya/ /shes rab kyis kyang gnas lngar bya/ /thabs kyis ri rishes rab pad+ma la / /'o byas pad+ma rgyas su gzhug /shes rab kyis kyang de bzhin no/ /chags pa skye ba'i rtags 'byung ste/ /de nas gcig gis gcig 'khyud nas/ /he ru ka dang phag mor bsam/ /shes rab rkang pa gnyis brkyang nas/ /thabs ni thabs ldan gyis bskyod nas/ /nang rtags phyi ru bstan pa'i phyir/ /shes rab ma la rtags gsum 'byung / /lus 'dar 'phar ba sku yi rtags/ /mi bzod skad 'don ngag gi rtags/ /shes pa brgyal cab thugs kyi rtags/ / de la ngo bor bshad pa'i phyir/ /riga'adi ni gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor te6/ /'di yis skra dkar gnyer ma spong / /nad kyi zug rngu thams cad 'joms/ /'di ni gsang ba'i bcud kyis len/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bsgoms pa min/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nyid la gnas/ /sbyin sreg /la sogs bya ba min/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje rgyud 'di ni/ /kun gyis thos par mi 'gyur te/ /glegs bam sor ni bcu gnyis bya/ /glegs bam gsang ba'i gnas su sba/ /yongs su smin pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /'ga' yis mthong gi gzhan la sba/ /gsang ba ston pa'i bla ma ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid pas btsun pa yin/ /gzhan yang 'dod pa'i stan thog tu/ /gsungs pa'i sbyor 2)thabs kun byas nas/ /lnga bcu nas bzung stong gi bar/ /rnal 'byor ma kun bde med kyang 59tsho/ /sbyor thabs mkhas pas bskyod byas nas/ /bcu gnyis ma dang bde ba mnyam/ /sbyor thabs mi shes rnal 'byor 1 pas/ /73—533

rlung mkhris bad kun kun nas skye/ /shes rab kyis kyang thabs la stekhya/ /sbyor thabs mkhas pa'i gshes rab ma/ /thabs kyis rtag tu bston par bya/ /sbyor thabs mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor pasadu/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gsang la bstenadu/ / lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /6)gsang la bsten pa ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ming sring tshul lam rje 'bangs tshul/ /pha ri7)spad tshul lam mkhan slob tshul/ /gzhan gyisanyemi rig ngo tsha bsrung / /dben pa'i gnas su sbyor ba bya/ /gal te ma bsten dam tshig nyams/ /tshe 'di nyid la dmyal bar ltung / /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /thabs med rnal 'byor ji ltar lags/ /bde ba khyad med ji ltar lags/ /phyag rgya ma bsten ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bde ba la gnas gsang ba'i don/ /khyod kyilo)ngor mdzad nga yis bshad/ /sbyor thabs mi shes rnal 'byor dang / /stan 3) yang gcig la mi 'dug ste/ /'dod chags bsam pa yang mi bya/ /gal te de 'dra bstenarwanyegyur na/ /'jig rten phal pa'i 'dod chags te/ /shi nas mnar med dmyal bar skye/ /'dod chags spyod pa shal ma ri/ /lcags kyi sor ni bcu drug pa/ /yar la 'dzeg5nyecing mar la 'bab / /thabs med rnal 'byor 'dra ba 'bod/ /de phyir sbyor thabs mkhas pas bsten/ /sbyor thabs las ni bde ba skye/ /de phyir bde ba khyad par 'phags / /bde ba thabs 32med lus zungs nyams/ /rlung mkhrisachabad kun kun nas skye/ /las kyi phyag rgyas rtag tu bsten/ /phyag rgyatsha ma bsten dam tshig nyams / /phyag rgya / snabasten pa'i dus su yang / /rnal 'byor ming sring brda yis mtshon / /gang zhig mdzub nyashemo ston pa na/ /'ongs sam zhes ni 'dri ba yin/ /79—534

sor mo gnyis ni ston pa dang / /mthe bo drang por ston pa dang / /de bzhin srin lag drang por ston/ /rdo rje bo la zhes bya ste/ /pad+ma rkak+ko0la zhes bya/ /de ltar ma byas dam tshig nyams/ / brda yi7bye brag ma lus pa/ /sa ṭasnyen shes par bya/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /rdo rje pad+ma dga' ba'i gnas/ /de ru gzungasab ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /de ru gzung ba rnam pa gnyis/ /rab kyi dbugs dang shes pas gzungal / /dang po btsan thabs sbyor bas gzung / /sbyor ba rnam pa bcu ru gzungashe/ /gcig ni sbom po khro mos gzungasnye/ /gzung7ba'i rten ni rnam pa bzhi/ /man ngag can gyis shes par bya/ /gal te de ru ma zin na/ /'khor bar lhung bas rang gis su/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi 7lha la bsdu/ /lce yis byang chub sems blangs la/ /ro ma'i 'khor lo ru ni bstim/ /de ltar ma byas dam tshig nyams/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /shes rab sbyor hu)thabs 'ba' zhig gca// /thabs kyisnyibaskyod pa 'ba' zhig gam/ /rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma/ /bde ba khyad par med dam ci/ /bde ba'i ngo bo ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bskyod pa bud med kyis kyang bskyod/ /sbyor thabs kyang ni thabs kyis bya/ /de lasalo rtabade ba khyad par 'phags/ /dper na dar dang snal ma bzhin/ /thabs kyis snalatswama'i cha tsam myong / /shes rab dar gyi sham bu tsam/ /de phyir rnal 'byor ma yi 8rgyud/ /rnal 'byor ma yisardzasa'agrub par gsungs/ /rgyud kyi nang na mchog yin pas/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg dbang bskur dang / /mchod dang bzlas dang gtor ma dang / /khrus dang bsrung ba la sogs pa/ /gsang ba 'di las gzhan na med/ /'bras bu'i nang na 'di 73—535

mchog ste/ /ye shes lnga yi spros dang bral/ /de nas lha mos 'khor dpag tu med pa dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dod chags kyi the tshom yongs su zad nas/bcom ldan 'das la kun gyis 'khyud nas gsanganyeba'i mchod pas bde ba chen po'i rosalgegang bar mchod nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /gsang ba'i yang gsang ba gsang ba ①rdo rje'ikhurgyud kyi rgyal po 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtog pa rgyu dang 'bras bu'i de kho na bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //gsang ba rdo rje'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba rdzogs rus// // paṇ+ḍi ta rat+natswabadz+ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab pa⑦// //bsdur mchan/530 7mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gle/ ③〈〈co 〉〉bzangs/ ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉kyis ngor/ 〈〈pe 〉〉kyis don/ ④〈〈khu 〉〉yis/531 la②〈〈g.yung 〉〉'grin/ ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉bsang / 3)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltung / 'a)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉zad/nya〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gnyis/ 95〈〈g.yung 〉〉'grin/ la〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ri lu/532 nya〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉drang / 2〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzung / 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rtogs/ nga)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉gum/ nya༄〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ting / 6 〈〈co 〉〉pa 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉re mig dgod/⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉bha/533 1)〈〈g.yung 〉〉yang / ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉'am/ 5〈〈co 〉〉kyi/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rgyal/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 de la ngo bor bshad pa'i phyir/ / pu 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ste/ 7)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ⑧〈〈co 〉〉spyod/ la〈〈khu 〉〉cing / 1nye 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sbyor byas/524 37〈〈co 〉〉skye/ tshi〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉pas/ 95〈〈co 〉〉ba/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉ma'i/ ⑤〈〈co 〉〉brten/6〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ / 7)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉phang 8)〈〈co 〉〉gyi/7)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉kyis/ tu ci〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bstan/ 11〈〈co 〉〉rten/ tuge〈〈co 〉〉mdzeg79wa 536

༄ga /dpal gsang ba thams cad gcod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/①༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ shrī gu h+ya sarba tshin+da tan+t+ra ②'o dza/ ③bod skad du / dpal gsang ba thams cad gcod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig ④na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang /thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la snyoms par bzhugs 55)so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams kyis g.yon gyi phyogs nas skor⑥ba lan gsum byas nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ho bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsang ba zhes pa ji ltar lags / /de yi gcod pa ji ltar lags/ /rgyud kyi don ni ji ltar lags/ /de yi rgyal po'ang ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gsang ba zhes pa rnam pa bzhi/ /dang po bum dbang dang 'brel ba'i/ /bskyed pa'i 73—538

rim pa'i rnal 'byor te/ /rten dang brten7)par bsgom pa ni/ /snod bcud gzung 'dzin rnam rtog rnams/ /spang phyir nga yis gsungs pa yin/ / de yi〈mikhyad par dgongs pa'i don/ /dang po stong nyid la sogs pa/ /rgyud gzhan du ni nga yis gsungs/ /rten dang brten57pa'i bye brag la/ /dang po rten gyi dgongs pa yang / /thugs ku'i༄yi ge hūm̐ las ni/ /mar me gcigashelas gnyis kyi tshul/ /kha dog nag po'i7ye 'phros pas/ /gru gsum rgya che gting ring bsam / /gru gsum sku gsung thugs yin te/ /dugashegasum 'joms pa dgongs pa'i don/ /logs ni rnam thar gsum yin te/ /lus ngag yid gsum las byung ba'i/ /mi dge bcu 'joms dgongs pa'i don/ /chos kyi sku ni dri med kyis/ /rang bzhin gyis ni kun la khyab/ /de phyir rgya chen dgongs pa'i don / /'phags pa nyan thos rang rgyal dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang / /chos sku rtogs pa ma yin pas/ /gting ring ba ru dgongs pas bshad/ /de nas thugs ma'ikhurtsu las yang / /rtsu 'phros pa las rdo rjer gyur/ /rdo rje gur du gyur pa yang / /dang po tshe yi bar chad dang / /gnyis pa thar pa'i bar chad shwe/de/ /bgegs ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /phyi yi bgegs dang nang gi bgegs/ /phyi yis tshe yi bar chad byed(spe/ /nang gis 1rtethar pa'i bar chad5)byed/ /bar chadanyernam pa gnyis bsrung ba/ /rdo rje gur gyi dgongs pa'i don / /yo las byung ba'i gong dang 'dra/ /dbyibs ni zla gam lta bu ste/ /rnam par rtog pa spong ba dang / /mi rtog pa ni skye ba la/ /dbang du byed pas dbang gisadon/ /ba dan bzhi yi dgongs pa yang / /chos rnams dus gsum gnas pa yi/ /dgongs pa yin par nga yis gsungs/ /ro las me yi tshadakyil 73—539

'khor ni/ /zur gsum drag po'i dgongs pa yin/ /rdo rje rtse gsum sku gsum don / /baṃ las chu yi dkyil 'khor te/ /zlum po spros pa zhi bar gsungs/ /bum pa chos sku'i yan lag bzhi/ /lo las gser gyi sa gzhi7)ste/ /gru bzhi rgyas pa'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje rtse lnga ye shes lnga/ /de steng na ri rab rtse mo brgyad/ /rnam thar brgyad kyi5kyedagongs pa yin/ /snod bcud rnam rtog mi mnga'i rtags/ /dur khrod brgyad ni g.yas dang g.yon/ /go rims bzhin du dgod par bya/ /re neri'i bye brag rnam rtog yang / /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /gnyen po'i stobs ni yongs su rgyas/ /shing rnams rim ri'ubazhin rtag tu dgod/ /rnam rtog mi dge bcu yi sne don/ /'joms pa'i rtags su phyogs skyong dgod/ /'dod chags zhe sdang ma rig pa/ /gdug pa 'joms phyir klu brgyad dgod/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyi nga rgyal gyis/ /lus dang ngag gimo sems can gyisad / /don mdzad phyir ni char sprin dgod/ /nang dngashegasang ba de bzhin no/ /de bzhin mthar thug bzhi pa yang / /snyan nas brgyud pa shes par bya/ /de nas nang du gzhal yas khang / /r+ghaṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad de/ /rtsibs brgyad rnam shes brgyad kyi 11dngos/ /yongs su gyur pas rnam snang sku/ /phyi nas bltasatshwa pas nang du gsal/ /de bzhin nang nas phyi ru ste / /thams cad gcig tu snang ba'i don/ /tshon hu chen sna lnga sku lnga'i don/ /kha dog lnga ni rigs lnga'i don/ /gru bzhi tshangs pa'i gnas bzhir gsungs/ /logs bzhi bsdu ba'i dngos po ste/ /sgo bzhi dran pa nyer gzhag miyin/ /ka ba brgyad ni rnam thar brgyad/ /gdung bzhi ye shes bzhi yi don/ /twa ra ṇa bil sogs pa kun/ /stobs la sogs pa yin par gsungs/ /de nas nang du 79—540

gdan rnams ni/ /pad+ma'i sa bon dbyangs las skyes/ /'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs kyis/ /ma gos rtags su pad+ma'i gdan/ /de steng nyi ma zla ba ste/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi brda(1)/ /dang po ro ni nga bdag gam/ /rnam rtog 'joms phyir gsungs pa yin/ /yan lag bzhi ldan gtso bo'i gdan/ /'khor lashere re gdan du sbyin/ /gtso bo'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir/ /dgongs pa'i don dang bcas pa yis(5/ /rten gyi dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'o/ /de nas lha rnams bskyed pa ni/ /skye ba bzhi yi tshul yin te/ /skad cig las byung rdzus pa'i tshul / /dper na chu gting las ni nya/ /rkyen las skyes rnga/ drod gsher skyes 4ri/ /dper na nyi mas pad+ma bzhin/ /spro zhing bsdu ba sgong skyes tshul/ /dper na rdo las zangs bzhin no/ /sbyor ba las byung mngal skyes tshu'// /yar la sreg ciltacing mar la gsokyi / /dper na spra tshil las ni gzugs/ /pho brang rnam par snang mdzad rdzogs3)/ /rjes su skyedamacho8)pa he ru ka /dnganang bskur bcom ldan mi bskyod pa/ /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan yin/ /mchod pa don yod grub pa'o / /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med/ /yan lag drug las byung ba yi9tsho/ /dngos grub 'di ni khyad par 'phags/ /de nas bzlas pa'am bsgom pa ni/ /dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i sna riste/ /rab kyis yongs su rdzogs pa yi11/ /bsgom pa'am bzlas pa bya bar gsungs/ /'bring gis gtso bo yab yum yin/ /tha mas hu dbu ma'i spyan la 'jug /dbu ma'i spyan la brtan gyur nas/ /sum cu nyanartsa bdun rdzogs par sgoms/ /'bring po yis kyang de bzhin te/ /gnas pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung / /bkod pa sems dang dman pa dbyibs/ /zab pa sngags dang thig le dang / /mthar thug chos dang yan lag bdun/ /'di yis bstan 73—541

pa shin tu zab/ /gong du gsungs pa thams cad kyang / /rnam pa bzhi ru shes par bya/ /re re la yang bzhi bzhi ste/ /du ma'i tshul ni shin tu zab/ /phyi dang nang ni sngags kyi don/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor phyi yi don/ /phyi la ltos nas nang yin te/ /de nyid gsang ba gsang ba'i don/ /las su rung ba mthar phyin don/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor phyi yi don/ /nang du dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid ni/ /phung po skye mched khams rnams la/ /re re lha ru byin brlabasatul / /lnga 'am drug gam sum cu bdun/ /g.yas g.yon steng 'og sgo la sogs/ /bla ma'i zhal las shes par bya/ /rdo rje snying pos yangakhugasol pa/ /sum cu rtsa bdun zhes bya ba'i/ /yongs su rdzogs pa ji ltar lags/ /bskyed pa zhes bya ji ltar lags/ /de yi rim pa ji ltar lags/ /gzhan yang rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang / /thun dang thun mtshams ji ltar lags/ /lta spyod zung du ji ltar 'jug /dpa' bos bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sum cu rtsa bdun yang dag rgyu/ /'bras bu gnyis med ye shes bskyed/ /de phyir 'bras bu sngon 'gro ba'i/ /rgyu ni gtso bor gyur pa yin/ /he ru kur gyur gcig la yang / /rgyu rnams yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ /gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /rgyu nor ba las ma yin te/ /gro las nas kyi myu gu min/ /ma tshang ba las ma yin te/ /'bru nyams pa las myu gu med/ /rgyu med pa las ma yin te/ /nam mkha'i me tog las ni dri/ /rgyu de rkyen med pa las min/ /nags sreg me la rlung med bzhin/ /de ltar yan lag bzhi ldan pa'i / /las dang po yis rnam rtog spang / /lha yi rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ /bskyed pa zhes ni gsungs pa yin/ /phyi dang nang du du ma'i cha/ /de yi rim 79—542

par bshad pa yin/ /rten gyi dkyil 'khor bye brag kyang / /khyams dang bla gab med pa dang / /bla gab bcas dang rnam pa gsum/ /mos pa'i dbang du gsungs pa yin/ /'khor lo bzhi yi dbye ba yis/ / nyin thun bzhi yi dbye ba yi/ ༷nyin mtshan bzhi ru gsungs pa yin/ /mtshams kyang bzhi ru shes par bya / /dbyug⑧ku chu tshod 'pho ba dang / /thun brgyad bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas / /thun dang mtshams ni mnyam par gsungs/ /mtshams kyi tshe na rnal 'byor pa/ /dbang po 'bring dang tha ma yis/ /lha rnams rdzogs par spro byas la//mar me gcig las gnyis kyi tshul/ /mchod pa la sogs tshul bzhin bya/ /lta ba zhes pa mnyam gzhag ste/ /rjes thob spyod pa ru ni bshad/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa las/ /rgyan drug 'chang ba'i spyod pa gnang / /gsang ba'i dbang dang 'brel ba lge/ /rgyan dang bdud rtsi'i spyod pa gnang / /rdo rje'ishogarigs dang rin chen rigs/ /pad+ma'i rigs dang las kyi rigs/ /spyod pa gnang ba nga yis gsungs/ /shes rab ye shes dang 'brel bas/ /gong du gsungs pa thun mong ste/ /khyad par phyag rgya'i spyod pa gnang / /lta ba mi ldan spyod pa dang //spyod pa mi ldan lta ba gnyis/ /'di ni gsang sngags dam sri ste/ /mnar med sems can dmyal bar skye/ /de phyir lta med spyod pa spang / /srin posakhros pa'i spyod pa'o/ /spyod med lta ba'ang spang ba ste/ /dka' thub kyis ni lus gdungs shing ske/ /phung sogs rnam snang la sogs la/ /brnyas pa rtogs6)ge skam po yin/ /des na lta spyod zung du 'jug /glang chen bzhengs kyang mnyam par bzhengs/ /glang chen bzhugs kyang mnyam par bzhugs/ /rdo rje snying pos yang zhus pa/ /bdud rtsi zhes pa ji ltar lagasag/ /de yi spyod pa ji ltar lags/ /de yi yon 73—543

tan ji ltar 'byung / /rgyan la sogs pa'i don rnams kun/ /gtsosahu)bos bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka'adza stsal pa/ /bdud rtsi rnam pa gsum du gsungs/ /dang por phyi yi bdud rtsi bsten/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga la/ /lcags kyu lnga ni dgod pa ste/ /brgyad dang bcu bzhi dang por 'dzag /si rla mi bskyod lud skam blang / /bcu gnyis bcu drug dang por 'dzag /he ru ka dang rnam snang dang / /lud skam snying po du blang bar bya/ /yar gyi ngo dang mar gyi ngo / /brgyad dang bcu bzhi bcwa rgyalnga la/ /thams cad bzang po'i dus su gsungasal/ /seng ge'i gzugs ni dkar po bzang / /lus ngag sdom zhing nyes pa med/ /'di ni sha yi sgrub 55)pa'i rten/ /glang po glang po chen po ste/ /ke ta ka yi rgyu ne nyid las/ /gla rtsi la sogs 'byung ba'i sha /ba lang gi wang ldan pa'i sha /rta ni rta yi ⑦rgyal po ste/ /kha dog dkar min dmar ba min/ /dbyibs dang kha dog mi 'gyur sha /mi ni skye ba bdun pa'i sha /lus ngag yid la mkhas pas brtags(2ri/ /bza' ba'i snod ni dum bu gcig /de yi nang du bsgrub par bya/ /rab 'bring tha ma'i mtshan ma ni/ /'bar dang dud pa sprosar+sha ba rnams/ /mtshan ma phyi yi yin par bshad/ /gzhan skyes don ni rgas chen sel/ /skad ma phyin na dngos grub med/ /skad phyung bas ni tshangs par 'gyur / /nang gi bdud rtsi rang byung yin/ /dril can bu ga dgu lam nyu nas/ /'dzag pa'i bdud rtsi rgyun chad nas/ /til gyi 'bru bzhin gang ba ste/ /a ba dhū tīr dbugs chud pas/ /steng gi drug pa'i rgyu ba yin/ /si h+la ga bur dbus na gnas / /'og gi drug pa rgyu ba yin/ /'di ni gsang ba'i bdud rtsi ste31/ /skra dkar gnyer ma 'chi ba spong / /spyod pa'i rnal 'byor rnam pa gnyis/ /gang 73—544

zag mchog dang las dang po/ /bskyed0)pa'i rim parasho legs gnas shing / /rigs su 'dzin pa spang ba'i phyir/ /phyi yi drug pa'i bdud rtsi sbyin/ /las dang po la phyi nang gnyis/ /'di yi nus pa'ang du ma ste/ /skra dkar med cing rnam rtog 'joms/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi la rab tu gnas/ /lnga pa goms par gyur pa yisal/ /drug pa gzung bar gsungs pa ste/ /kun rdzob steng gi sna rtse nas/ /sor bzhi nas ni dbus su bzhugasage/ /lte ba'i gnas su dbugs gnas pa/ /steng gi drug pa zin pa yin/ /'di yi nus pa'ang du ma ste/ /sred pa med cing yang ba'o/ /'dab chags rgyal po ji bzhin du/ /nam mkhar 'phur zhing ltungs5ba med/ /mchog dang chad pa'i dbus gnas pa/ /'og gi drug pa yin par bshad / /gang zag mchog la gsungs pa yin/ /'di yi nus pa'ang du ma ste/ /dril can bu ga 'gag par byed/ /rgyan gyi 6dang po zhe sdang 'joms/ /dur khrod chen po si h+la ling / /ru dra 'dul ba'i rim pa ste/ /bdud rtsis rnam rtog la sogs 'joms/ /phrin las bzhi ni thun mong yin/ /phyag rgyas 'dod chags rnam par dag /rdo rje snying pos yang gsol pa/ /drug pa zhes pa ji lta bu/ /gang zag mchog ni ji lta bu/ /'dod chags ji ltar rnam par dag /dpa' bos57)bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pan/ /g.yas g.yon steng 'og bzhi las ni/ /lnga pa nam mkha' 'byung ba yin/ /lnga pa rang bzhin med pa ste/ /drug pa zhes ni gsungs pa yin/ /dga' ba mchog dga' lhan cig dga'/ /bral ba'i dga' ba sngon 'gro bas/ /lnga pa bde ba chen po 'byung / /bde chen rang bzhin med pa dag /'og gi sgo yi drug pa yin / /de phyir drug pa 'dod pas kyang / /bzhi pa sngon du song ba yis/ /lnga 73—545

pa yongs su rdzogs pa bsgomatsho/ /dper na zangs kyi dngos po la/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi ②nus pa yis/ /zangs nyid gser du gyur pa ste/ /zangs las ma gtogs gser nyid dang / /lnga pa las gzhan drug pa ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gsungs so/ /lo dang zla ba zla ba phyed/ /nyin zhag dus drug dus gnyis la / /skad cig re tsam drug lasa'abyung / /las dang po yi spyod yul min/ /dper na chu yi snod nang du/ /bdud rtsi thigs pa gcig gzhag pa/ /chu ru nyams su myong ba las/ /cigasashos nyams su myong ba med/ /chu la brten4)nas bdud rtsi yang / /nyams su myong bar byed pa ste/ /de bzhin spros bcas7lnga pa la / /brten〈penas spros med drug pa 'byung / /rgyud gzhan⑧du ni nga yis gsungs / /mtshan ma lnga 'am ro brgyad dam/ /sa brgyad non nas mngon shes ldan / /las kyi phyag rgyasheyongs su spangs/ /ye shes phyag rgyal )la gnas shing / /phyag rgya chen po la 'jug pa/ /'di ni gang zag mchog yin te/ /'di yis drug pa zin par bshad/ /'dod chags zhes pa 'khor ba ste/ /rnam dag mya ngan 'das par gsungs/ /de nas gsang ba gnyis pa yang / /gsang ba'i dbang dang 'brel ba ste/ /rten cing 'brel pa zab mo'i don/ /dang po lha yi nga rgyal bya / /mkha'as3nya'agro rtsa ru shes par bya/ /dpa' bo byang chub sems su shes/ /'khor lo'i gnas dang 'khor lo dang / /de nas bsgrub bya shes par bya/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo nas/ /tshangs mdo'i bar du sor mo'i tshad/ /bcu tshan bzhi dang brgyad yin te/ /sor gsum la ni 'khor lo re/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin yin/ /dbang gipha/rteganas dang nyunye'akhor lo'i gnas/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /tshangs mdo me la gzhang kha rlung / /sor gsum sor bzhi 79—546

mkhas pas brtag /gnas gsum gsang ba'i gnas yin te/ /de bzhin gnas gsum rig pa'o/ /sor bzhi rta mgrin gnas yin te/ /sor brgyad gsang ba bde skyong gnas/ /rnal 'byor pha dang rnal 'byor ma'i/ /lus kyi rten gyi bye brag las/ /sor mo bzhi bcu brgyad nyid las/ /brgyad ni gsang ba'i 'khor lo'i gnas/ /bzhi bcu la ni 'khor lo gzhan/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya//thams cad sgal tshigs dbyugatugu ste/ /phyi dang nang du mkhas pas brtag /'khor lo la yang rnam pa gnyis/ /dang por 'khor lo gnyis pa rtsa/ /rkyen dang gsang ba rang bzhin dang / /dbang dang rnam pa bzhi ru gsungs/ /rkyen la gnyis te gsang ba bzhi/ /rang bzhin bcu drug dbang ni gnyis/ / tsaṇ+ḍa 'ikhuni nyi shu bzhi/ /'khor lo bzhi ru sbas pa ste/ /bla ma tshogs nang5gemathong na rgyab kyis7phyogs/ /man ngag gzhanasadu spel zhing 'phyar la dga'/ /'dod chags spyod phyir sbas pa'i rim pa nod/ /gab pa'i don la rgyabasngo )phyogs53)skur pa 'debs/ /gsang sngags bar〈shegacodamatho)rnal 'byor gzhan la gshe/ /'di ni mnar med sems tu )dmyal (1chen por skye/ /sangs rgyas stong (nyertsa gcig rdzogs tshe yi〈nyetshad/ /'di la sbas kyi thams cad la/ /nga yis sba bar ma gsungs te/ /de phyir rgyud gzhan du ni sbas/ /rgyud 'dir nga yis rgyas par bshad/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis g.yas g.yon cha/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi grangs su sbas/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis las ni zung / /bcu drug grangs su sbas pa yin/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis phyogs dang mtshams/ /brgyad kyi grangs su sbas pa'o/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo spyi bor sbas/ /gsang ba bde skyong lte bar sbas/ /bcu drug las ni zung 'gyur ba//brgyad kyi grangs su sbas pa yin/ /bcu drug las ni g.yas g.yon cha/ /sum cu 79—547

rtsa gnyis grangs su sbas/ /bcu drug las ni bzhi bzhir 'gyur/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i grangs su sbas/ /mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ru/ /ro drug la ni longs spyod pas/ /ro ma longs spyod 'khor lor sbas/ /rta mgrin0)'khor lo mgrin par sbas/ /brgyad las g.yas g.yon cha gnyis cha/ /bcu drug grangs su sbas pa yin/ /brgyad las g.yas g.yon steng 'og bzhi/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis grangs su sbas/ /brgyad las g.yas g.yon steng 'og bzhi/ /mtshams bzhi dang ni brgyad kyi cha/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi grangs su sbas/ /tshangs mdo'i me ni me la sbas / /snying ga ri chos kyi 'khor lo ru/ /chos kun rig pas rig pa sbas/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi las ni zung / /sum cu rtsa gnyis grangs su sbas/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi las ni bzhi/ /bcu drug grangs su sbas pa yin/ /drug cu rtsa bzhi las ni brgyad / /brgyad kyi grangs su sbas pa'o/ /gzhang kha rlung ni rlung las sbas/ /gsang ba'i gtum mo gtum mor sbas/ /'khor lo re tsho —la 'khor lo bzhi/ /phyi ru srog gi rnam par 'khyud/ /chu dang chu bran chu bo rnams/ /sna tshogs du mar 'bab byed kyang / /rgya mtsho chen por ro gcig ca'agyur/ /lte bar rol pa bde chen sku/ /rnam par thar dang stong pa dang / /de bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad ldan / /snying gas2chos kyi sku yin te/ /rnam thar la sogs de bzhin no/ /mgrin pa longs spyod de dang 'dra/ /bde chen sprul pa'ang de bzhin no/ /mtshan rnams steng la stong pa 'og /dang po'i nebade chen kha sbyor yin/ /rnam thar steng la dpe byad 'og /bde chen kha sbyor gnyis pa yin/ /gzhan ni zhal las shes par bya/ /stobs bcu rnam dag kha sbyor bcu/ /rlung ni sgrol ma'i ngo bo ste / /rtsa drug dbugs kyi rang bzhin gang / /me ni gos dkar rang bzhin te/ /79—548

zur rtsa gsum ni drod kyis gang / /rang bzhin gyis ni gnas pa la/ /brgyad dang lnga yi mtshan nyid la/ /brgyad la dbyangs kyi dang po brgyad/ /lnga la kā li dang po lnga/ /rig pa'i pho brang mtha' can lnga/ /rta mgrin0)dbyangs yig g.yon dang g.yas/ /a gnyis mthar gzhagasho 'dab dgu yin/ /gsang ba'i bde skyong 'khor lo ni/ /ma ning bzhi dang a gnyis dbus/ /byang chub sum cu rtsa bdun yin/ /de nas rtsa yi mtshan nyid kyang / /phyi yisastong phrag bdun cu gnyis / /sha la gnas nas tshil bu skyedabya/ /nang gi brgya dang nyi shu ni/ /tshil la gnas nas rkang skyed da)pa'o/ /gsang ba sum cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /rus par gnas shing ga pur skyed6)/ /de kho na yi ri/rtsa gsum ni/ /gsang bar gnas shing bde ba skyed/ /khang pa stong phrag bdun cu gnyis/ /khang pa re la khang pa 'bum(8)ske/ /khang pa der gnas srin bu'i rigs/ /stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis te/ /grangs ni 'bum du shes par bya/ /nang dang gsang ba'i rtsa la yang ske/ /srin bu'i rigs ni grangs su gsungs/ /de kho na yi tho)rtsa gsum las/ /'dod chags skyed pa'i srin bu dgu/ /nyin dang mtshan mo mtshams dang gsum//dgu ru mkhas pas shes par bya/ /rtsa der gnas pa'i ga bur yang / /bdud rtsi sbyor ba las byung ba/ /bdud rtsi la sogs gong du gsungs/ /yi las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / /ro las me'i〈medakyil 'khor bsatsho / /de steng a las ka pā la/ /po las pad+ma 'dab brgyad bsam/ /nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam / /de ru sha la sogs pa dgod/ /gtso bo'i steng du sor bzhi 'am/ /mtho gang tsam du bsam pa ni/ /yi ge go bzlog bsam par bya/ /sngon po dmar po dkar po ste/ /rtsu las gyur pa'i rdo rje bsam/ /de stengs hunyeyi ge mi bsams 1zu79wa 549

la / /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor steng du7bsam/ /'di ni bdud rtsi'i kha sbyor ro/ /sha lnga las ni gdan lngar gyur/ /lcags kyu bdud rtsi lnga ru 'gyur/ /las kyi rlung gis me bus te/ /zla ba gtso bo la sogs zhu/ /tha mal pa yi bdud rtsi yin/ /yi ge gsum dang nyi ma zhu/ /lha yi bdud rtsi zhes ni bya/ /'od zer gyis bkug ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi yin par nga yis gsungs/ /lan gsum bskorakhub sku gsung thugs/ /'di ni byin brlabs〈rnal 'byor ro/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang dang mchod/ /mchod pa'i rnal 'byor zhes ni gsungs/ /de nas rol pa'i rnal 'byor te/ /g.yas g.yon dgongs pa shes par bya/ /de nas zhu ba'i rnal 'byor yang / /mnyam pa'i rlung dang gtum mo'i mes/ /ye shes bzhi yi ngo bor gyural/ /cha gcig mi bskyodakyirnam snang ste/ /sha za'i mkha' 'gro mnyam pa nyid/ /cha gcigatsobya ba nan tan te/ /srin bu las kyi mkha' 'gro mchod/ /cha gcig rlung dang mkhris pa ste/ /mkhris pas bad kun la sogs pa/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /rtsa ni ye shes mkha' 'gro ste/ /so sor kun rtog ye shes mchod/ /cha gcigatso)rang bzhin med pa ste/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro mchod par mdzad/ /rlung ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste/ /rtsa ni ye shes mkha' 'gro yin/ /ga pur sha za'i mkha' 'gro ste/ /srin bu las kyi mkha' 'gro yin/ /gzhan yang rtsa la sogs pa la/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bye brag kun/ /go rims bzhin du shes par bya/ /sku ni las kyi mkha' 'gro ste/ /gsung ni sha za'i mkha' 'gro'ol/ /thugs ni ye shes mkha' 'gro yin/ /bde chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro'o/ /gzhan yang 'khor lo dbus nas7ni/ /mkha' 'gro'i bye brag shes par bya/ /dga' ba las kyi mkha' 'gro ste/ /mchog dga' sha za'i mkha' 'gro'o/ /rang 79—550

bzhin dga' ba ye shes yin/ /bde chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro'o/ /dpa' bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni nyi ma'o/ / tsaṇ+ḍa snyituni nyi shu bzhi/ /sbas pa'i 'khor lo bzhi ru nges/ /bde chen longs spyod 'khor lor bsdu/ /longs spyod chos kyi 'khor lor bsdu/ /gong du bsdu ba'i rim pa yang / /thig le la ni thams cad 'dus/ /dper na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig⑧nyid la/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer phyogs bcu du mar snang / /du ma'i 'od zer dkyil 'khor gcigashetu 'dus/ /dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po'i gdugs/ /shing gi 'khrul 'khor sbyor ba ji bzhin no/ /snying gasrechos kyi 'khor lor bsdus nas kyang / /nyi zla'i0dkyil na tsa na ka yi7tshad/ / de yisadabus su thig le yungs kurashetshad/ /sngags phreng7ba spu'i nyag5tem tsam gyis ni/ / g.yon bskor g.yas5)bskor dbyangs gsal7sbyal ltar 'khyil/ /de dag thig le'i rnal 'byor te/ /'di la sems ni brtanasa'agyur nas/ /de nas phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsgoms/ /zla ba ā li kā li la/ /ā༄nyeli nyi ma la thim nas/ /nyi ma zhabs bskyed〈nyel thim bsam/ /zhabs bskyed〈nyel sogs rim par thim/ /yan lag lnga ni ye shes lnga/ /de ni phra mo'i rnal 'byor te/ /de nas nā da phra mo la/ /sems ni rim par bsgom pa'o/ /de nas rang rig ye shes te/ /chos kun stong par ro gcig pa'o/ /gzhan yang chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /sprul pa yi ni 'khor lo gnyis/ /'bar ba dang ni 'dzag pa'i tshul/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /phyi yi rnam rtog rtsol ba ste/ /nang gi rnam rtog srog gi rlung / /srog rtsol gnyis 'gags5 — )dbu ma ste/ /kun rdzob steng gi sna rtse nas/ /sor bzhi nas ni rtsa gsum gcig /dbugs dgag5nyepa yi gnas yin pas/ /dang por de ru gzung bar bya/ /de 73—551

nas sprul pa'i gnas su gzung0)/ /yang na bgrangashebar shes par bya/ /de nas gsang ba gsum pa ni/ /shes rab ye shes dang 'brel ba'i/ /dga' ba'i mtshan nyid bshad pa'o/ /gzhang kha g.ya' zhing ba spu ldang / /dga' ba'i mtshan nyid mi dmigs pa/ /bcu gnyis rang bzhin yin par gsungs/ /byang chub sems rgyu mi rtog snyam/ /mchog dga' mi darigs nyi shu lnga/ /gsang ba'i nor bu yongs su gang / /lhan cig skyes dga' mi dmigs pa/ /chos kyi sku ni yin par gsungs/ /bde ba'i rgyun chad bral ba'i dga'/ /de yi mi dmigs gzugs sku gnyis/ /gzhan yang sngon du 'gro ba rnams/ /yan lag thabs dang sbyor ba dngos/ /dgongs pa dang bcas rim pa'o/ /skar ma'i tshogs ltar du mar spros mod kyang / /nyi ma zla ba lta bur zung du 'jug /nyi ma zla ba lta bur zung 'jug kyang / /sgra gcanas lta bur gnyis su med pa'o/ /rdo rje snying pos yang gsol pa/ /skar ma'i tshogs ni ji lta bu/ /zung du 'jug pa ji lta bu/ /gnyis su med pa ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /byang chub sum cu rtsa bdun ni/ / rgyu yi ltakhyad par spros pa'o/ /sku gsum dang ni ye shes lnga / /'bras bu'i khyad par spros pa yin/ /rgyu rnams bdun du bsdu ba dang / /'bras bu gsum du bsdu ba'otho/ /rgyu rnams 'bras bu la thim ste/ /'bras bu gnyis su bsgom par bya/ /chos kun sems kyi ngo bo ste/ /sems ni stong pa'i rang bzhin yin/ /thams cad stong par ro gcig pa/ /'di ni blang dor med pa'i dbyings/ /'dod chags rnam par dag bya'i phyir/ /'dod chags sku yi phyag rgya lnga/ /phyag rgya chen po ye shes gnyis/ /dam tshig chos dang las phyag rgya/ /'di la brten 7)pa shin tu zab/ /'di ni bde ba chen po ste/ /bskyed dang 79—552

rdzogs pa'i rang bzhin dag /bde chen 'khor lo rnam pa gsum/ /gsang ba'i sna rtse e la gnas/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo gang ba yin/ /rig pa la sogs de bzhin te/ /gsang7ba bde skyong ba la gnas/ /rang bzhin bde chen 'khor lo ste / /bde ba chen pos〈ros gang ba/ /til dang til mar ji bzhin no/ /dper na shing sna bcad pa las/ /'o ma 'dzag pa ji bzhin no/ /bde ba chen po de nyid las/ /skra yi rtse mo brgyas stong dang / /khri dang 'bum gyi rnam pa ste//dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste/ /gnyis pa du ba lta bu'o/ /gsum pa glog gi rnam pa ste / /bzhi pa mar me lta bu'o/ /'di dag kun gyi rim pa yang / /sprul pa la sogs rim pa bzhin/ /sprin gyi rnam pa skye ba ni/ /a ni skye ba'i mtshan ma yin/ /mar me lta bu 'chi ba yisaphyi/ /haṃ gi mtshan mar gsungs pa yin/ /lnga pa nam mkha' lta bu ni/ /gnyis su med papo)bar ma do'i/ /mtshan ma stong par shes par bya/ /gzhan yang 'dar ba la sogs pa/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /de nas gsang ba gsum pa yang / /shes rab ye shes 'brel ba ste/ /dga' ba bzhi yi7mtshan nyid kyang / /gzhang lam g.ya' zhing ba spu ldang / /lus 'dar dga' ba'i ngo bo yin/ /gsang ba rdo rje tsamachogelam nas/ /byang chub sems rgyu bde ba snyam/ /mchog dga' yi ni ngo bo ste/ /rdo rje pad+ma 'gags ⑨pa snyam/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo yin/ /bde ba'i rgyun chad bde ba snyam/ /bral ba dga' ba'i ngo bo yin/ /'di rnams kun gyi mtshan nyid kyang / /byang chub sems phyogs la sogs pa/ /gong du gsungs par shes par bya/ /dga' ba snang ba zhes bya ste/ /mchog dga' snang ba mched pa yin/ /rab tu dga' ba snang ba thob/ /lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal ba'o/ /ye shes bzhi yi rang bzhin 79—553

te / /bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i gnyen ponyeyin/ /rags7pa bzhi yisashegasang bar 'joms/ /phra ba'i bdud bzhi rang bzhin gyisaX/ /'khor lo bzhi ru 'joms pa yin/ /'khor lo la rten dga' ba bzhi/ /de nyid ye shes bzhi ru snang ske/ /de phyir bdud bzhi 'joms pa yin/ /'dod chags la brten dug gsum ni/ /nyon mongs pa yi bdud yin te/ /'dod chags rnam pa bcu gnyis yin/ /gsang ba'i bde skyong nyon mongs 'jomasal/ /kha dog dbyibs ni phung po'i bdud/ /rta mgrin⑧'khor lo phung po 'joms/ / sbas pa7bzhi ni lha yi bdud/ /rig pa'i 'khor lo lha bdud 'joms7/ /skye ba dang bcas 'chi ba ste/ /gsang ba skye med 'chi bdag 'joms/ /phra ba'i bdud 'joms de dang 'dra/ /skad cig bzhi dang sde pa bzhi/ /bzang po bzhi dang bden pa bzhi / /'byung ba bzhi dang yum bzhi dang / /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi la sogs pal/ /ye shes bzhi po 'di nyid las/ /khyad par gzhan ni mi 'byung ste/ /rnam par rtog pa'i bye brag dang / /gzhan yang mos pa'i bye brag dang / /chos tshul du ma'i bye brag gis/ /sna tshogs du mar gsungs pa yin/ /dbang gsum bgrod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /dge slong chen por gsungs pa ste/ /'di yi〈nyethams cad bya bar gsungs/ /rdo rje snying pos yang gsol pa/ /dge slong dbang gsum ji ltar lags/ /de yi bya ba ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dge slong la sogs rnam pa gsum/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin nyid kyi dge slong ngo / /gcig dang bzhi dang bcu dang ldan/ /nyis brgya lnga bcu'i go rims kyisaturnye/ /bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen dge tshul dang / /dge slong so sor thar pa yin/ /gtong dang gtong ba chen po 79—554

dang / /shin tu gtong dang rnam par gtongashe/ /bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen dge tshul dang / /dge slong byang chub sems dpa' yin/ /dkyil 'khor du zhugs dge ba ste/ /de la gnas pa bsnyen gnas yin/ /bdun dang ldan phyir chen posayin / /chen po 'di gsum bye brag kyang / /bum pa'i dbang ni dge ba ste/ /de la bsnyen pas dge bsnyen yin/ /de phyir bdun ldan chen po yin/ /gsang ba'i dbang ni dge ba ste/ /de yi tshul ldan dge tshul yin/ /bdun dang ldan pas chen po yin/ /dge ba shes rab ye shes te/ /de nyid slong bas dge slong yin / /bdun dang ldan pas chen po yin/ /chen po 'di gsum bye brag kyang / /phyir mi ldog pa gsum yin te/ /rnam par smin dang 'khor bsnyedang / /theg pa dman par ldog pa ni/ /spong ba gsum ni go rims bzhin/ /theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung zhing / /rig⑧'dzin theg pa 'bras bur gnas/ /'bras bu 'di gnas rnal 'byor pa/ /khyim pa'amasherdo rje 'dzin pa yiX/ /cha lugs su ni gnas byas la/ /dbang bskurasherab gnas la sogs bya/ /theg pa gsum gyi cha lugs kyis/ /gsang ba spyad par ma gsungs te/ /dper na rdo las zangs su 'gyur / /zangs las gser gyi rnam par rol bye/ /zangs kyi dus na rdo med do/ /gser du gyur pas rdo mi snang / /rigashe'adzin nyid kyi dge slong la/ /so sor thar dang byang chub sems/ /gnyis po54 )gnas pa nyid du ni/ /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gsungs so/ /de nas gsang〈nyab bzhi po hunyeyang / /bzhi pa'i dbang dang 'brel ba ste/ /rtag tu g.yo ba'i sems 'di nyid/ /gzugs la sogs pa bkug nas ni/ /bsgomatshwanyebyar lhan cig bcas pa dag /dbang du byas decabasgom par bya/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa yi/ /dmigs pa thams cad rnam 79wa 555

spangs te/ /sems nyid bsam du med pas na/ /cir7yang bsam par mi bya'o / /sems nyid stong par bcug nas su/ /stong pa sems su rab bcug nas / /stong dang mi stong la sogs pa'i/ /rtog pa bcom pas mkha' ltar 'gyur / /rten yod ma yin brten⑧pa med/ /dpe med gnas kyang yod ma yin / /de nyid gnas pa5)rdzogs pa ste/ /lhan skyes gnyis med rig pa'o/ /de nas spyodam④pa bka' stsal pa/ /khro tshul gar dang phyag rgya50rnams/ /sgyu ma tsam du ma shes par/ /phyag rgya chen por yang dag bsgoms⑥/ /dur khrod rgyal po dregs pa can/ /snying rje med cing sha khrag za/ /de yi gnas su skye bar 'gyur/ /phyi nang sbas dang mthar thug gi/ /dkyil 'khor du zhugs dbang mnos nas/ /bsgom7)dang bzlas pa la sogs med/ /gsang sngags bar du gcod cing gshe/ /rnal 'byor kun la skur pa 'debs/ /rdo rje spun tshig slob la 'phyarani/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams/ /bla ma la smod rnam smin gyis/ /mnar med sems can dmyal bar skye/ /rten cing 'brel pa zab ④mo yi/ /rtsa yi 'khor lo'i don ma rtogs/ /lcags gri nyaḥsor ni bcu drug pa/ /'dzeg 31pa ru ni nga yis bshad/ /gab pa'i gsang ba ma rtogs par/ /sbas pa mi dmigs rnam gsum gyis/ /thur 12du sems can dmyal bar skye/ /shing rta'i 'khor lo 'khor ba ltar/ /las kyi rnam par smin pas 'khor/ /shes pas rang gi rang rig dang / /rang rig bde ba gang 'dod dang / /rang rig sgyu mar /snyegang 'dod pa14/ /rang rig shel sgong lta bu dang / /dbyings dang ye shes la sogs pa/ /lta ba'i don nyid 'chad tshapa'o / /rgyud kyi don ni rnam pa gsum/ /bde chen 'khor lo rgyu yi rgyud/ /gsang ba'i sna rtse thabs kyi rgyud/ /gsang ba bde skyong 'bras bu'i rgyud/ /bum 79—556

pa rgyu yi rgyud du gsungs/ /gsang ba thabs kyi rgyud yin te0tsho/ /shes rab ye shes 'bras bu'i rgyud/ /skye ba rgyu yi rdzu rgyud du gsungs/ /'chi ba thabs kyi rgyud du gsungs/ /bar ma do ni 'bras bu'i rgyud/ /rgyud ces pa ni rgyun yin te/ /rgyal po chagasang ba ston pa ste/ /gsang ba rnam pa bzhi ru gsungs/ /bum pa las dang po la gsang / /gsang ba bum pa'i dus su gsang / /shes rab ye shes gsang bar gsang / /rang rig shes rab ye shes gsang / /gsang ba'i 'khor lo bzhi pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po dang /mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs ri rab kyi rdul snyed kyis bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /dpal gsang ba thams cad gcod pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs soge// //paṇ+ḍi ta ga ⑤ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o // //

mongs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /'dar dang 'phar dang drod la sogs/ /rtags nyid bsam gyisatumi khyab pa/ /lha bsgom rlung dang rtsa sogs pa/ /lam nyid bsam gyis7mi khyab pa/ /rang rig nam mkha'i sprin char tshul/ /pha rol phyin drug la sogs pa/ /rgyu nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /rgyu 'bras tha snyadashekun dang bral/ /rtsol ba rdul gyis ma gos pa/ /sprin med mkha' ltar ma bcos pa'i//spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid dag /rang rig bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /a ni shad5bdang sbrul sogs kyis(5)/ /bcu gnyis la sogs dbye ba yis/ /yi ge'i dbye ba rgyas pa'o/ /gzugs ni sdug dang mi sdug sogs/ /bcu dgu phra rab rdul gyi bar/ /sgra la sogs pa de bzhin te/ /sgra brgyad dri gsum ro drug ste/ /reg bya bcu gcig chos de bzhin/ /gang zhig 'dus byas ye'adus ma byas(7)/ /chos kyi dbye ba rgyas pa'o/ /theg pa gsum dang bcwa dun brgyad dang / /ji snyed 'du shes yod kyi bar/ /lta ba'i dbye ba 'o)rgyas pa'o/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /mthong lam bsgom lam mthar phyin lam/ /lam gyi dbye ba rgyas pa'o / /sems rtag bdudam —nortags 'byung ba'i rtags/ /rtags kyi dbye ba rgyas pa'o / /mu stegs rang rgyal nyan thos nas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i spyod pa'i bar/ /spyod pa'i dbye ba rgyas pa'o/ /rtag dang chad dang sgro skur nas/ /'khor dang mya ngan 'das mtha' dang / /thabs dang shes rab mtha' yi 3stobar mtha' yi dbye bsngo)rgyas pa'o/ /'dod chags la sogs nyi khri dang / /cig stong rtsa ba nye ba dang ske/ /zhe snang la sogs de bzhin te/ /nyon mongs dbye ba rgyas pa'o/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam par byang / /'dod chags che dang sbyin pa sogs/ /rgyu yi dbye ba rgyas pa'o/ /sems dang nam mkha' ye shes dang / /sangs rgyas 'od 79—563

gsal zung 'jug sogs/ /rang rig dbye ba rgyas pa'o/ /blos brtags mtshan mar snang ba dang / /sgro 'dogs pa dang skur 'debs dang / /rim min mos pa khyad par tshol/ /rdul tsam khas len blos 'jog cing / /sangs rgyas nyid kyang sgrub byed pa/ /gang ltar bcos kyang de mtha' ste/ /gang zhig mthar lhung0)lta ba de/ /rang rig gzhan rig sems ma yin/ /kun rdzob don dam gnyis ma yin / /rang rig rtog ge skam po dang / / mthar ltungardzoXdabu mar khas len pa/ /de ni sems nyid rang rig dang / /brjod med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i / /mi mthun pa yi phyogs yin te/ /de bral bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /rang rig ye shes chen po yin/ /sbyin sogs dkar po'i chos rnams dang / /rang rig spyi yi rnam pa yis/ /rang rig ye shes chen po la/ /thabs dang thabs las byung ba 'am / /rgyu dang 'chibras bu la sogs pa/ /rdul tsam tha snyad yod ma yin/ /rangadza 'byung ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ /'dod chag —/ la sogs skyon gyis kyang / /de la sgrib pa ma yin te/ /nam mkha' la ni sprin nga zhin no/ /rang rig gzhan rig bye brag gis/ /sem sa can sangs rgyas gnyis /snya dbye/ /rang rig sprin medam/5rinam mkha' la/ /gzhan rig rnam rtog nam mkhar mtshungs/ /sprin sogs 465rlung gis gtor byas te/ /sprin med mkha' 'dra snang ba nyid/ /gzhan rig rnam rtog 7bral ba la/ /sgrib bral sangs rgyas zhes bya ste/ /rang rig kho na tsam du zad / /dper na skyes bu nam mkha' lta ba la/ /sprin gyis skyes bu'i mig la bsgribs pa las/ /nam mkha' de la ma bsgribs 8ji bzhin no/ /grangs ni dang po gcig yin te/ /gzhan rig rang rig gyur pa las/ /dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min/ /'dir ni rang rig gcig kho na/ /de nyid rig cing nges pa'o//79—564

kun nasamanya nyon mongs rnam par byang / /gzung 'dzin thabs dang shes rab ste/ /bsam gyis mi khyab gnyis pa'o/ /lus ngag sems kyiskonarang bzhin las/ /rnam thar stong dang mtshan ma med/ /smon pa med dang sku gsung thugs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab gsum pa'o/ /byams dang snying rje dga' btang ྅snyoms/ /sa chu me rlung rang bzhin las/ /bzhi yi grangs su nges pa ste/ /dga' ba la sogs de bzhin no/ /rigs lnga yi ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /phung po lnga dang chags snang lnga/ /bsam gyis mi khyab lnga pa'o/ /pha rol phyin drug rang bzhin las/ /yul drug dbang po drug la sogs/ /bsam gyis mi khyab drug nyid de/ /brgya lasogs grangs ni bsam mi khyab/ /gang zhig rang rig gzhan 5rig gnyis/ /thog ma med nas gnas pa ste/ /lus dang grib ma'i tshul du gnas/ /rang rig med par gzham rig dag /so so skye bo'i dus na 'dod/ /'di yang rmongs chen ma rungs pa/ /gzhan rig (tshor/ spangs rang rig 'dod/ /'khor ba 7)spangs nasamanamya ngan 'das/ /kha cig 'khor ba mya ngan 'das/ /rig pas blang dor gnyis su rtogs/ /de la sogs pa lta ba'i gdon/ /rig pa 'dzin la 9brgya rtsa bcu/ /theg chen mdo sde stong phrag gsum/ /nyan thos rang rgyal brgya phrag gnyis/ /khyab 'jus drag po la sogs pa/ /lta ba'i gdon la bsam mi khyab/ /rang rig gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa ma bcos lhun gyis grub/ /bde ba chen po ros gang ba/ /khams gsum 'khor ba kun shes na/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni 'khor ba la / /'khor ba nyid ni mya ngan 'das/ /lta ba'i gdon 1 dang bral ba ste/ /rang rig med cing gzhan rig med/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyis ka spangs/ /sems med nam mkha' chos nyid med/ /'khrul pa med cing ma 'khrul med/ /79—565

theg pa med cing rim pa med/ /dman dang gya rnam gnyis ka med/ /ye shes med cing bde ba med/ /mtha' bral dbu mar mi7gnas pa/ /bsam mi khyab tu gnas pa ste/ /'di rtogs khong du chud pa dang / /mi 'jigs sgro skur mi rtsom pa/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyi thu7bo ste/ /rgyal sras kun gyi nang na mchog /rdo rje 'dzin pas byin rlob cing / /mkha' 'gro kun gyi mchod pa'i gnas/ /rigashe'adzin sa la 'jug pa ste/ /des kyang mnyam gzhag ge'abad de bslabasti/ /rig 'dzin sa la gnas par bya/ /rig 'dzin sa la gnas nas kyang / /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'jug /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar gnas te/ /bcwapo)lnga sa yi bdag nyid las/ /sku gnyis gzhan gyi don mdzad pa/ /gzhan gyi las dang smon lam stobs / /de yi stobs kyis snang ba las/ /yang dag nyid la snang rgyu med/ /rim pa rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /dang po bla ma'i gdams ngag dang / /rig 'dzin sa la gnas dron pa'i bar/ /rang rig spyi yi rnam pa ste/ /chos nyid yul du byas pa'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar gyur te/ /rang rig rang gi mtshan nyid ni/ /yul dang yul can la sogs pa'i/ /rtog med memakha' ltar snang ba yisari )/ /khams gsum brtan dang g.yo bcas pa'i/ /bdag nyid de nyid tshul gyis hunyeni/ /mnyam gzhag 12rjes thob kun spangs te/ /sgyu ma'i tshul du gang gnas pa/ /snang ba mthar phyin pa yi tshad/ /thun dang 'pho ba chu tshod dang / /dbyu hunyegu skad cig rim pa la/ /sems kyi bying rgod la sogs skyon/ /bral te dben par gnas pa ni / /snang med mthar phyin tshad yin te/ /rang rig phyi yi tshad bstan to/ /snang ba med cing sgyu ma med/ /bya btsal bo med cing bgrod pa med/ /rang byung lhun gyis 0grub pa ru/ /rtag tu mi 'gyur gang gnas pa/ /rang rig pa yi/79wa 566

mtshan nyid la/ /mthar phyin pa yi7tshad yin no/ /'dod chags ro yis myos pa dang / /sems bskyed sdom 'dzin dbang bskur dang / /tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'dusalgepa'i dus/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rgyu yikhudus/ /khyad par can du gsungs pa'o/ /gzhan yang rtog pa'i sems dang yang / /rtog med sems dang 'dres pa yi/ /gzugs la brtenasapa'i mig nyid kyis/ /rtog pa'i rgyun chad sems de nyid/ /sems kyi rgyun bral rgyu de nyid/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rgyu yishedus / /sgra la sogs pa'i de bzhin no/ /'dod chags zhe snang gti mug sogs / /nyon mongs rjes nas rgyu ba ste/ /byams dang sbyin sogs de bzhin no/ /bzod57sogs btang snyoms de bzhin te/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rgyus yi dus/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs dang / /byams dang snying rje spul sogs pa'i/ /mdor na dkar po'i chos rnams dang / / bzo dang sgyu rtsal la sogs dang / /bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa'i rim pa kun/ /skye ba gcig gam du mas ni/ /yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa dang / /'khor ba'i chos la gang skyo ba/ /bsam mi khyab la 'jug pa'i dus/ /bskyed dang rdzogs sogs mi gnas shing / /rdzogs pa chen por gang 'dod pa/ /de yang 'jug pa'i dus yin te/ /bdud rnams bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ /bar ma chod par 'jug pa'i dus/ /gzung ba'i thabs ni bcwa 37brgyad de/ /mkha' mnyam gzhi bcas gzhi med dang / /yul drug dus tsho/rtegasum brtenasanyu)pa dang / /lhan cig skyes nyid sgra la brten/ /sa chu me rlung sgra brten no/ /chos rnams gzod nas ma skyes pa'i/ /rang rig bsgom pa mkha' mnyam ste/ /bla mas7sems gzungatshamadang por gces/ /chos rnams thams cad sems yin te / /sems ni gzodarwa 79—567

nas ma skyes pa/ /gzhi bcas rang rig rnal 'byor ro/ /sems ni gzod nas rang rig pa/ /gzhi med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chosal/ /de brten sems gzung0)bla ma las/ /skyes bus 'bad de blang bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags zhe sdang dang / /gti mug rjes su mkhas pas gzung ge/ /lhan cig skyes gnyis 'byung bzhi la/ /brten te skye ba med par bsgom/ /bye brag sems gzungamachi bsam mi khyab/ /nyan thos la sogs theg chen la/ /man ngag yod pa ma yin te/ /lta ba spyod pa sems gzung dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu lam dang yang / /dus dang longs spyod rnal 'byor dang / /bdag don gzhan don dgongs pa dang / /ngal dub mtha' spangs tshegasam4)chung dang / / tshogs sogs 5pa yi khyad par dang / /khyad par rnam pa bcwa 6)lnga yis/ /rig 'dzin theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /kye ho bcom ldan 'jigs pa che/ /rang rig bsam mi khyab pa la/ /sbyin dang byams sogs dgongs pa ci/ /sku gnyis gzhan don gang las byung / /bsam mi khyab la legs gnas pas/ /de nyid ci lags phyi ru ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sbyin dang byams pa la sogs pas/ /gzhan rig rnam rtog 'gags pa dang / /sku gnyis sems can don mdzad pa'i/ /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas su/ /'byung ba'i rkyen du nges pas na/ /bsam mi khyab la mi gnas kyang / /sbyin sogs 'bad de bslab par bya/ /de la bsam mi khyab pa 'byung / /sku gnyis stobs dang mi 'jigs dang / /gzungs dang ting 'dzin las rnams kun/ /sbyin la sogs pa sbyin byas nas/ /bsam mi khyab pa 'byung bar nges/ /de nyid rtogs na bsam mi khyab/ /de nyid ma rtogs 'khor ba'i chos/ /dbul pos nor bu'i byi dor 73—568

bzhinaha)ske/ /bsam mi khyab la sems gzhag kyang / /bskyed rdzogs rim pas sems gnas nas/ /de ni sngon sbyangs 'phro can te/ /sems kyi yig namago gcad pa gcesal/ /rang sems las su rung ba na/ /de ni phyi rtags nang du ste / /de nyid nang rtags phyi ru 'byung / /lus la dri med srin bu med/ /skra dkar gnyer ma sogs med pa / /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rtags yin no/ /'khor ba sgyu mar snang ba dang / /sprin med mkha' ltar gang snang ba/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i rtags yin no/ /de nas 'khor 'dus pa de dag thams cad chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de kho na nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa la rjes su yi rang bar gyur to// //dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa rdzogs song ni// //paṇ+ḍi ta gas46 ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba shākya 7ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o/ /

༄ga /dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/1)tshotshon /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kha tsho nos ma tan+t+ra rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ dpal bde ba chen po ri la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la snyoms par 4bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe 'khor 'dus pa de dag gi 3rinang nas mkha' spyod ma dang / sa spyod ma dang / sa 'og na spyod pa ma gsum la bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal 'dzum pa mdzad de/ gsang ba'i don 'di gsungs pa/ dad ldan snying rjer ldan dang rtse gcig sems/ /lus ngag gus bcas gzhan la phan sems ldan/ /'jigs med brtul 56zhugs ldan zhing zab mo yi/ /lam la spro bar gyis la legs par nyon/ /mkha' 'gro khyod kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /nga yis 75khyod la bshad par bya/ /mkha' spyod steng sgo'i rlung yin te/ /79—572

sa spyod bar du thig le'i sgo/ /sa 'og spyod pa shu kra'i sgo/ /sgo gsum sku gsung thugs yin te/ /dang po mkha' spyod mtshan nyid kyang / /rnam pa gsum du shes bya ste/ /bems po'i rlung dang rnam rtog rlung / /kun gyi mtshan nyid ye shes rlung ske/ /mdor bstan de nyid rim pas dbye/ /gnyis med rlung ni ma ning ste/ /zung 'jug thabs dang shes rab rlung / /ldang 'jug sku gsung thugs kyi rlung / /snying dang gzhang kha mgrin pa dang / /lte ba lus kyis khyab pa ru/ /rigs lnga'i rlung ni khyab par gnas/ /rgyu ba bzhi ni 'byung ba'i rlung / /dngas snyigs 'byed pa brgyad du 'gyur/ /'di nyid rlung ni thun brgyad de/ /thun re la ni 'pho ba gnyis/ /rlung gi 'pho ba bcu drug yin/ /'pho ba gcig la chu tshod gnyis / /chu tshod re la dbyugasho1 gu gnyis/ /rlung gi dbyug dgu drug cu bzhi/ /de bzhin chu tshod sum cu ri tshoganyis/ /nyi khri mig 5stong drug brgya sogs/ /sems dang sems min 'dres pa'i rlung / /rags pa dang ni phra ba la/ /mkhas pas sems kyi bzhon 6)par gzung / /rnam rtog gzung 'dzin sems kyi 7/rta/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis 'gags dbu mar gnas/ /de nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rlung / /dbye ba thabs dang shes rab gnyis/ /'di rnams mkha' spyod rang bzhin te/ /de dag man ngag mkhas pas brtag /yon tan skyon dang rtags rnams kyis/ /rlung gisanamatshan nyid shes par bya/ /de dag kun gyi rten nyid kyang / /gzhol ma dang ni g.yon ma dang / /'di ni gzhu yi rnam par gnas/ /bems po rlung gi lam yin te/ /dbang po mngon sum lam yin pas/ /sna yi ri rab gling bzhi la / /nyi zla byang nub 9lhor rgyug gis/ /thabs dang shes rab skor sogs la/ /'bad pas sems ni gzung 1 bar bya/ /'di dag bems pos yang dag gnas/ /79—573

mi shes pa yi7)rab rib kyis/ /rin chen sems ni dri can byas/ /'di ni rnam rtog rlung yin te/ /'di nyid kyis5 ni lam gyur pa/ /ro ma dang ni rkyangasama'o//sbrul 'khyil /lta bu'i rnam pa ste/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni dmigs pa'i yul/ /gnas der rnam rtog rlung 'gag goshe/ /rang rig gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /'di nyid ye shes rdo rje'i rlung / /kun 'dar ma yi rtsa la brten56)/ / tsaṇ+ḍa 'i〈peni shing lta bul/ /rang rig ye shes spyod yul te/ /gnas der 'bad de rang rig gzung / /mkha' spyod rlung gi rang bzhin phyir/ /'di dag rdo rje'i lam yin no/ /de nas sa spyod bshad bya ste/ /rang rig ye shes gang 'dod pas/ / tsaṇ+ḍa lī ④yi bye brag brtag /dang por rang bzhin tsaṇ+ḍa 'i1)/ /gnyis pa gtum mo tsaṇ+ḍa snying/ /gsum pa kha sbyar tsaṇ+ḍa snyim/ /de bzhin gcer bu'i tsaṇ+ḍa lī/rte/ /de nyid la yang dbye ba ste/ /gcer bu gtum mo shin tu gtum/ /yang dag gtum mo gzhan sbyar dang / /bye brag kun la sbyar bar bya/ /gcer bu shin tu gcer bu dang / /shin tu gcer bu gcer bu sogs/ /'di dag kun la sbyar bar bya/ /dbye na rnam pa bcu gnyis te/ /yan lag bcu tshan bzhi dang brgyad/ /sa spyod ma yi rang bzhin te/ /stong phrag bdun cu nyi rtsa gnyis sogs/ /gzhan skyes kyi ni khro mo ritsam/ /phra ba de las bzlog pa'o/ /brgya dang nyi shu spa yi rtse/ /sum cusartsa gnyis skra yi rtse/ /lnga yi cha ste tshagatso bo gsum/ /gsum 'dus yungs kuralo 〉gyi ni tshad/ /dbus dang g.yas g.yon phra sbom dang 35/ /gnyis 'gyur bye brag shes par bya/ /dngas ma dang ni snyigs ma'i rtsar/ /rang bzhin du ni gnas pa la/ /yi ge lta bu'i rtsa mdud kyang / /dang po'i sgra ru gang shes pa/ /sa spyod ma yi rang bzhin no/ /gnas la sogs pa gzhan nas shes/ /'di nyid nor bu rin po che//79wa 574

'di la brten nas thams cad 'byung / /rigs 'cholas3)gnas 'chol tshad 'cholashedang / /dbyibs dang kha dog grangs la sogs/ /'chol pa las ni dngos grub min/ /de nyid bral ba'i rang bzhin ni/ /sa spyod ma yi50dngos grub ste/ /thams cad kun gyi rten yin no/ /sa 'og spyod ma'i go)rang bzhin te/ /de nas yang dag rab bshad pa/ /byang chub sems ni rnam pa gsum/ /dang po chos nyid sems yin te/ /'di ni shes brjod yul las 'das/ /gnyis pa rang rig byang chub sems/ /dper na rkyen gyis shel sgong bzhin/ /gsum pa bems po'i byang chub sems/ /sirla dang ni ga pur te6)/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyis su gsungasagye/ /las kyi rlung dang las kyi mes/ /g.yo ba kun rdzob byang chub sems/ /ye shes rlung dang ye shes mes/ /g.yo ba don dam sems yin te//dngas snyigs las ni rim pa yin/ /dbyibs dang kha dog las kyis ni/ /sems kyi khyad par shes par bya/ /las kyi rlung gis mi g.yo zhing / /las kyi me yis mi 'dzag par/ /kha ba lta bu'i mtshan nyid las/ /mi shigs haṃ gi dbyibs 'dra ste/ /nor bu kun+da'i mdog lta bu/ /dkar la 'tsher da dang gzi mdangs snum/ /bde ba chen po'i skur 'byung ba9)/ /'di nyi )ni don dam byang chub sems/ /dmar la dngas pa'i71rang bzhin la/ /khyad par bzhi ni thun mong ste/ /'di ni shes rab byang chub sems/ /de las bzlog pa'i dman pa gnyis / /'og sgor gnas shing srid pa skye/ /dman pa'i rkyen gyis g.yo bar byed / /de phyir don dam kun rdzob kyis/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /rgyu 'chol ba las dngos grub med/ /rkyen 'chol ba las de bzhin te/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /don dam sems kyi spyod yul min/ /kun rdzob tshor ba 79—575

bde ba'i yul/ /sa 'og spyod pa'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje gsum bsgom mi phyed pa / /de nyid rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /yi ge dang ni yan lag dang / /bsdus pa'i don dang spyi yi don/ /sbas pa'i don dang mthar thug don/ /sna tshogs sems las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /nor bu dang ni sil snyan bzhin/ /rtog med rten las sna tshogs 'byung / /ā li tshokā li nam ning dang / /drug tu sbyor ba brtag 3par bya/ /sgra mtha'i yi ge bsam mi khyab/ /yan lag rnam pa gsum yin te/ /rgyu 'bras brda cadang brda can dang / /brjod bya dang ni rjod byed do//de las bzlog pa bsdus par bshad/ /theg pa gsum dang de las gzhan/ /thun mong spyi ru nges pa ste/ /bye brag rang las shes par bya/ /sbas pa dbang dang sngags su dbye/ /sngags la bzhi ste dbang la gnyis/ /chos ni spyi dang bye 5brag go/ /de dag kun gyi nematshan nyid kyang / /bla ma'i zhal nas shese par bya/ /snod dang snod min bye brag kyang / /bla mas legs par brtag bya ste/ /de nyid yang dag rtogs 7gyur na/ /ston pa ched cing bstan pa med/ /bsam gtan 8la sogs 'jig pa med/ /sangs rgyas gzugs ni sna tshogs 'byung / /bya ba bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo sna tshogs bskor/ /dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya med rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /de rjes rnal 'byor nyid gsungs te/ /rnal 'byor nang pa de ltag la/ /phyi nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni / /shes rab snying po brtser 9gyur pa'i/ /thabs dang shes rab bsrub shing la / /gnyis med thugs kyis bsrubs pa las/ /bdud rtsi'i ro ni nyi shu bzhi/ /nor bu rin chen rgyud ces brjod/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dngos grub thams cad 'di las 'byung / /ji ltar ma dkrogs 'o ma las /79—576

'dod pa gang yang 'byung ba min/ /de bzhin lo grangs mang po las/ /dngos grub myur du 'byung ba min/ /de phyir rin chen nyi shu bzhi/ /bdud rtsi ro 'dra seng ge'i gzugs/ /gnas ni nyi shu bzhi nyid kyang / /sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs7te/ /mkha' 'gro nyi shu bzhi la gtad/ /phyag rgyalabazhi yis rgyas btab bo/ /dam du sba zhing dam du spel/ /rgya las 'das na⑧dam tshig nyams/ /sngags dang dbyibs dang chos bdag ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi charang bzhin te/ /de yi ngo bor rgyud kun brtag /sngags la gnyis te chos la gnyis/ /dbyibs kyang de bzhin shes par bya/ /re re'i bye brag dbye ba yang / /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /phyi nang sbas pa mthar thug bzhi/ /rgyud kun phyag rgyasnyibazhi yin te / /de nyid dbye grib mkhas pas brtag /de nyid rtogs na rgyud dang ldan/ /de las bzlog pa 'das pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyis ni tsaṇ+ḍa snyi'i/ /gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ /rtsa gsum gyis ni byin gyis brlabasarin/ /gnas ni nyi shu —rtsa bzhi ru//mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa bzhi la/ /rgyud ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi gtad/ /pu ru rab gtum gsang rdo rje/ /dza ru gtum mig gsang ba gcod/ /o ru 'od ldan bsam mi khyab / /ā0)ru sna rtse nam mkha' mnyam/ /go ru bstan blo nam mkha' che/ /ra ru mi'u thung sku gsung thugs/ /de ru lang ka rin chen phreng / /ma ru shing grib dam tshig che/ /ka ru e ra stobs po che/ /o ru 'jigs byed ye shes gsang / /tri riḍaru rlung shugs ye shes phreng / /ko ru chang 'thung ye shes 'bar/ /ka ru sgyu sna cim zla ba'i phreng / /la ru shin bzang rin chen 'bar/ /ka ru rta rna nyi ma'i 'khor / /he ru kha kha ye shes rgyal/ /bre ru 'khor shugs mkha' 'gro gsang 1nya/ /kṛ 32ru khaṇ+ḍa gsang me 'bar/ / sau ru shoṇ+ḍi 3lhagasang bdud rtsi/ /su ru 'khor lo 79—577

dur khrod rgyan/ /na ru shin dpa' rdo rje rgyal/ /si0)ru stobs chen ye shes rgyal//ma ru 'khor sgyur chags pa'i rgyal/ /ku ru brtson 'grus mkha' 'gro sdom/ /de dag gtad do legs par sbos/ /nang du tsaṇ+ḍa lī gedag ni/ /nyi shu bzhi ni gtadas pa ste/ /dang po gsang ba gnyis pa yangasnyi/ /rang bzhin yin te de nas dbang / /rkyen ni tha mas gsungs pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro khyed kyi rang bzhin te / /de nas dngos grub gang 'dod sbyin/ /dngos grub dam pa gang 'dod pasal/ /dbang dang dam tshig ldan byas te/ /rta dang glang po la sogs dang / /bu dang chung ma nor gyi dbyig /bsnyen bkur dag gis bsnyen byas te/ /bdud rtsi ro yi ra li las/ /bla ma'i zhal nas dngos grub blang / /yid la zung la dran par gyis/ /de nas 'khor 'dus pa de dag thams cad rjes su yi rang bar gyur to / /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba rdzogs sor// //paṇ+ḍi ta ga moya dha ra dang / dge slong shākya ye shes kyis zhus shing bsgyur ba'o // //73—578
