rgyud kyi rgyal po/1ri༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kha 2༄tan+t+ra rā dza/ bod skad du/dpal nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig rin na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /gzhan yang dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma grangs med pa dang thabs cig btu bzhugs so/ /de rnams kyi nang nas byang chub sems dpa' (dechen po rdo rje snying pos/ bcom ldan 'das la g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba lan gsum byas te/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod nas 'di skad ces gsol pal/ kye ho bcom ldan 'jigs sbyo6)pa che/ /bcom pa gang lags ldan pa gang / /'jigs pa gang lags chen po gang / /bdag la khyod kyis bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bcom pa bdud bzhi bcom pa ste/ /79—581

re re la yang bzhi bzhi ste/ /bcu drug grangs su shes par bya/ /ldan pa de yi gnyen po ste/ /dang po bum dbang bdud bzhi yang / /kha dog dbyibs la log rtog gis 1/ /bskyed pa'i gzung 'dzin du ma dag /phung po'i bdud du rab tu grags / /'dod chags zhe sdang la sogs pa/ /nyon mongs pa yi bdud yin no/ /yang dag lam ston bla ma med/ /zhe sdang ru drar skye ba yi/ /rgyu dang lam ston grogs ngan dag /lha yi bu yi rin bdud yin te/ /las dang nyon mongs pa yis rgyus / /srog 'chad pa ni 'chi bdag bdud/ /bskyed pa'i rim la legs gnas nas / /lha yi bu yi bdud kyang bcom/ /log rtog gedu ma'i rtog pa 'gag /des na phung po'i bdud bcom mo/ /rten dang brten 3)pa ro mnyam pas/ /nyon mongs pa yi bdud bcom mo/ /dus min 'chi dang tshe zad pas/ /'di dag 'chi bdag bdud yin te/ /tshe lo stong sogs thub pa yi/ /tshe yilo 'chi bdag bdud bcom mo/ /gzhan yang bdud 'joms bye brag ni/ /phyi yi tshe yi bcud kyis 7)len/ /grub na 'chi bdag bdud 'joms so/ /de bzhin lus kyi phung po ste / /longs spyod kyis ni nyon mongs 'joms/ /sems kyis lha yi bdud bcom ste / /rten dang brten ni sgyu mar ldan/ /de nas gsang dbang bdud bzhi yang //phyag mtshan khro tshul gar la sogs/ /phyi ru du ma phung po'i bdud/ /rags pas yid ni nyon mongs pas/ /nyon mongs pa yi bdud yin no/ /dman pa'i lam gang ston pa yi/ /bla ma lha yi bu yi bdud/ /phyi yi tshe yi bcud kyis len/ /de nyid 'chi bdag bdud yin no/ /gzhan yang bdud kyi bye brag ni/ /sgo gsum 'khrul par gang ston pa/ /bla ma lha yi bu yi bdud/ /sgo gsum las ni du ma'i cha / /de nyid ma shes phung po'i bdud/ /de nyid 'bad de bsgrubs ④byas kyang / /79—582

'bras bu mi 'byung sems nyon mongs/ /nyon mongs pa yi bdud yin te/ / de yis tshe yi bar chad byed/ /de nyid 'chi bdag bdud yin no/ 9)rlung sogs gnas pa'i tshul shes pas/ /lha yi bu yi bdud bcom mo/ /de nyid sgyu mar shes par bya/ /de nyid shes pas phung po dang / /nyon mongs pa yi bdud bcom mo/ /dngos po'i mthar lhung skye bas 'chi/ /rgyu med las skye 'chi ba ste/ /rgyu rkyen ma bskyed rang bzhin gnas/ /sgyu mas 'chi bdag bdud bcom mo/ /tshe la dbang sgyur ma lta bu/ /gnyen po'i stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /shes rab ye shes bdud bzhi yang / /rtsa dang shu kra la sogs pa'i/ /dman pa'i lam ston lha yi bdud/ /de nyid du ma phung po'i bdud/ /de sgom rang bzhin nyon mongs pas/ /nyon mongs pa yi bdud yin no/ /kha dog dbyibs ni skyes pas 'jig /de nyid 'chi bdag bdud yin no/ /gzhan yang bdud kyisabye brag kyang / /'dod chags chen po'i lam ston pa'i/ /bla ma lha yi bu yi tshubadud/ /dga' ba bzhi ni du ma ste/ /rgyud la spungs pas phung po'i bdud/ /rang sems nyon mongs nyon mongs bdudal/ /'khor bar〈ltung bas skye ba ste/ /skye ba las byung 'chi bdag bdudam/ /rnam par rtog pa skye bas so/ /'dod chags kyis ni 'chi bdag bdud / /ma spangs sum cuponadrug gnyis 7)dang / /nges pa sum cu rtsa drug gi/ /lam bsten bla mas lha bdud bcom/ /dga' bzhi sgyu ma rang bzhin med/ /bde chen ror 'gyur phung po bcom/ /'bras bu rang rig ye shes sbyin/ /rang sems nyon mongs sdug bsngal bral/ /nyon mongs pa yi bdud bcom mo/ /de yis 'chi ba dang bral bas/ /de nyid 'chi bdag bdud bcom mo/ /'og gi lam gyi bdud bzhi yi/ /dman pa'i stobs kyis zin pa ste/ /rgyal po dmangs 79—583

su babs pa bzhin/ /de nyid lam gyi bdud kyis zin/ /rgyal po rgyal sa shor ba bzhin / /bzhi pa dang 'brel bdud bzhi ni/ /gsum pa'i snod ①dang ldan pa la / /bzhi pa'i lam ston bla ma ni/ /lha yi bu yi bdud yin te/ /bdud gsum bla ma'i zhal nas shes/ /snod rigemin gsang ba sgrogs pa dang / /mar dang kha ra la sogs pa/ /'thungs te ma zhu dug 'gyur bzhin/ /khyad par bdud kyis zin pa ste/ /rigs ngan rgyal sa 'dzin pa 'dra/ /dbang dang gdams (kyengag 'brel bcas pa'i/ /bdud 'joms lam gyi stobs dang ldan/ /ye shes lnga 'am yon tan drug /ldan pa dag tu rab tu grags/ /bla ma gcig la snod bcud ④gnyis / /thob na de nyid dam pa ste/ /bla ma gcig la dbang thob nas/ /bla ma gcig la mnyan par bya/ /bla ma rnam pa gnyis su gsungs/ /phyi yi bla ma de nyid de/ /nang gi bla ma bdag po'i lha/ /bdud dang dgra yi sde rnams kun/ /thams cad 'jigs shing skrag byed pas/ /'jigs pa zhes ni gsungs pa ste/ /dgra dang bdud kyi g.yul las rgyal/ /dmigs pa lha sogs bdun dang ldan/ /de phyir chen po zhes ni gsungs/ /de'i tshe 'khor 'dus pa de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po 5rdo rje snying po dang / thams cad rgyud la dga' zhing mgu nas rjes su yi /erang bar gyur to/ /dpal nam mkha' chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs so // //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga na ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o// 79—584

bsdur mchan/581 3rimatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 2〈〈g.yung 〉〉khā sam/ 〈〈pe 〉〉khā/〈〈co 〉〉kho/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉cig ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉gcig shes〈〈pe 〉〉 sems dpa' / (pu 〈〈co 〉〉'jig582 19〈〈g.yung 〉〉gi/ mi〈〈g.yung 〉〉bu'i/ 5〈〈g.yung 〉〉yis/ (4)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rtogs/ (2〈〈g.yung 〉〉rten/〈〈pe 〉〉sten/ 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yis 7)〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉kyi/ (8)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsgrub/583 1)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 deyis bdud yin no/ / ②〈〈khu 〉〉gi/ ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bu'i/4)〈〈khu 〉〉'dud/ zhes〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ba/ 6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ 7)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉nyid/0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ 7)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉brten/584 1)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gnod/ ②〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉snon/ sa 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gdam/ ci〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gcud/ 3ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 chen po/ 46〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yid/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sgo / ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gā/
bsdur 'azas re'u migargyud 'byam/ (26)

༄ga /dpal sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po/3)༄༅sna /rgya gar skad du/ shrī kā ya bā rtsit+ta (snyetan+t+ra rā dza0/ bod skad du/dpal sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis 'dod chags che/ /mchog gyur 'di la yang dag gnas/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /khyod kyis bdag la bshad du gsol / /rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ /sku ni bum pa'i ngo bo ste/ /gsung ni gsang ba'i ngo bo 'dodabya/ /thugs kyang shes rab ye shes te/ /sangs rgyas spyan dang mā ma tī/ /dam tshig sgrol ⑤ma gos dkar ༅mo/ /rdo rje 'dzin la 'di skad gsol/ /rgyud kyi don la rab (pegoms shing / /smra ba'i tshig gis ma rmongs la / /gzhan gyi 'u)rtsod pas mi rdzi yang / /dbang dang man ngag ma thob par /dbang bskur rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs/ /sngags spyod ngal ba don med yin/ /shi nas sems can dmyal bar skye/ /de phyir gtso bos dbang bskur gyi/ /man 79—587

ngag yang dag bshad du gsol/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ /dang por bum dbang rim pa yang / /gnas ni shin tu bsngags pa btsal/ /bkra shis yid dga' shin tu snum/ /bkra shis bya rnams snyan par sgrogs/ /dpag bsam shing rgyas yod par 'dod/ /gzhan yang dur khrod shing gcig gam/ /chu ngogs 1dag la sogs pa ru/ /sa bdag sa yi nalha mo la/ /gtor ma sbyin sreg mchod yon gyis/ /sa bslang phyir ni mtho 5rnams gzugs/ /de nas dang po bsnyen pa dbul la/ /bsnyen pa gsum ni rab 'bring thar/ /mtshan ma grangs dang dus su gsungs / /re re la yang gsum gsum ste/ /mtshan ma gzugs dang 'od dang sgra / /grangs ni stong dang khri dang 'bum/ /dus ni bcwa 6lnga bcu gsum dang / /bdun du 7bsnyen pa rdzogs pa dang / /lha rnams bsnyen pas mnyes ri byas nas/ /lha dang slob ma rdzas rnams kun/ /lhag par gnas pa tshul bzhin bya/ /bkra shis lo grangs ldan pa yi/ /bu mos sa yi phyogs mthunas 'odapa'i/ /ku sha btsal la mtshan ma brtag /so shing rtse mor me tog dri/ /bsrung skud la sogs mtshan ma brtag /dbang gi dkyil 'khor bskyed par bya/ /dkyil 'khor slob ma rab 'bring tha/ /ting 'dzin me tog rdul tshon rim/ /gang dang ldan pa de nyid do/ /de nas mchod rdzas rim pa dgram/ /khaṃ bī 1 nor yi sngags kyis kyang / /de la rdo rje byab par bya/ /de nas 11ku sha la sogs pa/ / spogs pa'i 12cho ga dang bcas bya / /gzhan yang sngon du 'gro ba'i rdzas/ /bla ma mnyes nya par bya ba dang / /dkyil 'khor lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir/ /rta dang glang po ma he dang / /rin chen la sogs gter rnams dang / /spos dang mar me la sogs pa/ /brgya 'am stong ngam khri 'am 'bum/ /bla re rgyan dang ba dan sogs/ /byin brlabs 1 79—588

tshogs bsag phyi ru dgod/ /de nas slob 11ma gzhug par bya/ /khrus dang yan lag dri yis byug /kye ho khyod ni ji lta bu/ /'jig rten 'phrul 5)pa las sad na//he ru kur grags chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen por khyod rol lam/ /dad pa dang bcas spro bar gyis/ /rnam rtog dang bral rdo rje sems/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa po/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen por lung bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol / /pad+ma las byung bdag la stsol/ /gsang ba dgyes pa ④ bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal/ /legs so legs so rigs kyi bu /rgyal sras kun gyi nang na mchog /rnam rtog thams cad 'jig 5byed pas/ /gnyis med khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /mi bskyod bcom ldan dang mtshungs pa'i/ /zil gyis mi non khyod kyis blangs/ /dam tshig spyod pa spyad pa yi/ /mchog gi de nyid blang bar bya/ /thabs dang shes rab zung du sbrel/ /nam yang khyod kyis spang mi bya/ /tshangs spyod de bzhin bsam gtan la/ /'bad pas sems ni brtan par bya/ /chang ni rtag btung khro 6mi bya/ /de bzhin sha yang shes par bya / /gzhan gyi phyag rgya bsten par bya/ /'di ni dam tshig brgyad yin no/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /thun mong sdom dang sems skyed 7sbyin/ /bskor ba lan gsum phyag gsum bya/ /yol bas bar du bcad nas ni/ /mig la sogs pa lnga bkab la/ /lha grangs du yod me tog sbyin/ /kun byed chu yis bsalamacho skadag bya/ /me tog dang bcas rdo rje yang / /de yi snying la gzhag la bsgom / /slob dpon la ni brnyas 9byed sogs/ /ltung ba'i nyes pa brjod par 73—589

bya / /phyi yi rdo rje 'dzin pa dbab/ /sngon du sdig pa lan gsum dral/ /mig gis gzugs rnams mthong ba dang / /rna bas sgra dang sna yis7dri/ /lce yis ro dang lus kyis reg /dngos grub phrinashogelas so so ru/ /mkhas pas brtag par shes par bya/ /me tog dor te lha yang sbyin/ /'khor rnams gtso bo'i yan lag yin / /gtso bo'i mtshan nyid shes par bya/ /ji ltar gso ba'i sman pa yis/ /dbang po lnga yi zug rngu 'byin / /de bzhin sems dpa' chen po yis/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib kun/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis yang dag bsal bye/ /de la gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor bstan/ /dbang gi dkyil 'khor byang shar du/ /pad+ma 'dab rim brgyad pa ru/ /gzhag 6la rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur/ /chu khams mi bskyod me long gis/ /rdo rje rigs kyi phrin tholas 'grub/ /dbu rgyan rin chen 'byung ldan te/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin gyis/ /rin chen rigs kyi phrin las 'grub/ /'od dpag med pa'i rdo rje'i dbang / /so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin gyis/ /pad+ma rigs kyis phrinapo las byed/ /dril bu don yod grub pa ste/ /bya ba nan tan ye shes kyis/ /phrin las sna tshogs byed par 'gyur / /rigs las dras 9nas ming gi dbang / /rdo rje dang sbyar 1 rirdo rje sems / /rnam snang chen po'i ngo bo ste/ /chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin las/ /de bzhin nyid kyi mtshan nyid 'dzin/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri stengs su/ /rigs 11byed slob dpon dbang sbyin bya/ /bdud bzhi 'joms pas rgyal chen bzhi / /chos rnams mi nub rgyal mtshan gzugs/ /chos kyi sku yis kun la khyab/ /gdugs kyis 12steng nas dgab par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu brtul sna zhugs gnyis/ /phyag rgya dam tshig gsum po yin/ /dbugs dbyung ba dang lung bstan dang / /79—590

rjes su gnang dang phyir mi ldog /brtan par byed dang rnam pa lnga/ /gzhan yang rdzas kyi bye brag rnams/ /rin chen bdun la sogs pa kun/ /thun mong yin par nga yis gsungs/ /bum pa'i dbang la rnam gsum ste17)/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug dang bo yin/ /gnyis pa rig pa'i dbang yin te/ /brtan par byed pa gsum pa'o/ /de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /lus ni ri rab lhun po la/ /byang chub sems kyi gnas bcas nas/ /bde ba'i stan la gnas nas su / /gsang ba'i dbang gi ri)rten gyur pa/ /rig ma dang po btsal bar bya/ /dang po shes pas brtag pa dang / /bdag dbang yod par blang ba dang / /nyes pa dag par sbyang ba dang / /dkyil 'khor bskyed par bya ba dang / /bar chod bgegs rnams zhi ba dang / /bsrung dang de la tshogs kyis mchod/ /dri yi thig le du ma bya/ /g.yon na gnas pa de nyid dang / /bsrub dang bsrub bcas sbyor byasasnyedang / /bsrubs5mchilas bde ba'i chu rgyun gyis/ /lus kun khyab nas gsang ba ru/ /dkar la rtsa dmar lta bur 'dzag /dkyil 'khor du 'jug gong dang 'dra/ /ro ma'i 'khor lor byā sgrubasams la/ /lce de pad+mar byin brlabs te / / lce yi ri )rtse mor bh+yaḥbasams la/ /sih+la tsug pur 'dres pa yis/ /bh+yaḥl bzhag ste 8)de la bstim/ /so gnyis longs spyod mnyam sbyar la/ /dbus su mi dmigs bsgom par bya/ /gsang ba'i dbang la rnam gsum ste/ /rdo rje gtso mor sbyina'9pa dang / /sbom po khro mos sbyin pa dang / /rdo rje gre 1 tshangs sbyin pa'o / /shes rab ye shes dbang la yang / /dang por shes rab brtag pa ni/ /lus dang ngag dang yid dang gsum/ /mkhas pas brtag cing shes par bya/ /de nas khyad par lnga brtags te/ /rigs dang lang tsho longs spyod dang / /rgyan 79—591

dang gzugs kyi khyad par lnga/ /phyi yi brtag pa yin par gsungs/ /sems brtan rdo rje yi ni rigs/ /khyad par yin par nga yis gsungs/ /rnam rtog chung ba rdo rje yi/ /lang tsho'i khyad par yin par gsungs/ /mi rtog pas brgyan shes pa ste/ /rdo rje'i rgyan gyi khyad par yin/ /de nyid gsum du mi 'gyur ba/ /mi nub chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/ /rdo rje gzugs kyi khyad par yin/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa nyid/ /de yi ro la longs spyod pas17/ /rdo rje'i 55longs spyod khyad par ro/ /kun 'dar dam ste thugs kyi rigs/ /rigs kyi khyad par yin pa'ol/ /de nyid mda' ltar mkhrang cab ni/ /thugs kyi lang tsho'i khyad par ro/ /rtsa de dmar la dngas pa 5dang / /byang chub sems ni dkar la dngas/ /gnyis su med par gsal ba'i tshul/ /dper na nor bu ke ke ru/ /dar la brgyus pa ji bzhin du/ /thugs kyi gzugs kyi khyad par ro/ /la la nā 6dang ra sa nā / /a ba dhū tīr gnyis med la/ /thugs kyi longs spyod khyad par ro/ /dang por phyi la gnyis pa nang / /gsum pa gsang ba'i brtag pa'o/ /lus brtag pa ni sku yin te/ /ngag brtags pa ni gsung du 'gyur/ /yid brtags49thugs su 'gyur ba'o/ /sgyu ma tsam gyis dgongs pa'i don/ /kun la khyab par shes par bya/ /lus kyi drug la ngag gi bdun/ /sems kyi bdun po sgyu ma'i tshul / /dang por smig 1 rgyu chur 'khrul dang / /gnyis pa smig rgyu nyid yin te/ /gsum pa smig rgyu mi snang bzhin/ /de bzhin zhal nas shes par bya/ /chu la bdun no mar la gcig /dri ni bdun te sha la gnyis/ /sgo nga bzhi ste 'o ma gsum / /'di rnams btsal ba'i rten gyur pa/ /lo ni gsum bzhi yin par gsungasal/ / ka ra lhaganyis te bu ram gcig /chang ni gnyis su shes par bya /79—592

rgyan ni bye brag sna tshogs so/ /dgun dang de bzhin ston gyi sha /zhag gcig na ni bcud (1dang ldan/ /dbyar dang dpyid 90kyi sha rnams kyang / /drod dang ldan na bcud dang ldan/ /rang bzhin shi ba'i sha yin te/ /'dun pa byas na dam tshig nyams/ /rtsa ba lnga dang yan lag bcas/ /gzhan yang 'bras bu la sogs sman/ /mar dang bcas pas sbyar bar bya/ /sha yang mar gyis de bzhin no / /kham bas kun gyi bcud skyedang de/ /mngar 6)ba kun gyis ro tsas byed/ /bcud bskyed rin kyisha ni gzhon nu zhes/ /ro tsa 9sha ni bcwa nya )lnga yin/ /bcud bskyed sha dang mar gnyis kyang / /lnga dang lnga yi cha yis bsres11/ /chang ni mnyam por gsungs pa'o/ /ro tsa 12ba yi sha la yang / /'o ma sgo 1 nga cha mnyam par / /lnga gsum lnga gnyis gtso bor bya/ /kha ra'i chang ngam 'o ma 'am/ sha dang mnyam por sbyin par bya/ /'di ni yan lag spros bcas so/ /de nas mtshams bcad bsnyen pa dang / /dam tshig sna tshogs bya ba yang / /spros pa med pa'i yan lag yin/ /dbang bskur sngon du bsgom sapa'i don/ /dbang thob phyir ni nga yis gsungs/ /rig ma gtad dang man ngag sbyin/ /brda 15rnams bya zhing 'dod pa'i rtags/ /brtag pa shin tu spros pa med/ /phyag dang zhabs la sogs pas 'khyud/ /dang po'i sbyor thabs zhes gsungs so/ /dbu rgyan mgul rgyan la sogs pa/ /sbyor thabs chen po zhes bya ste/ /langs pa tsog pu gan rkyal 16dang ske/ /kha sbub 'phred dang lnga yin te/ /'di rnams kun gyi dgongs pa zab /dgongs med spyad kyi pa spyod byed pa/ /'di ni mnar med skye ba'i rgyu/ /tha mal pa las brgya 'gyur gyis/ /bum pa'i dbang dang 'brel pa'o/ /bum pa dang ni gsang ba ste/ /gsang ba las gzhan gsum pa ste/ /de yi rnam smin brjod mi 79—593

lang ske/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug rim pa ni/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya /yan lag bdun bsgoms sbyor ba dngos/ /khyad par rnam pa gsum las byung / /sngags dang sman ni dang po ste/ /gnyis pa sbyor thabs yin par gsungs/ /gsum pa ting nge 'dzin yin te/ /sngags dang sman gyis kun+da drang / /rked bcing tshad dang gnas pa'i tshad/ / drang ba'i 1tshad rnams shes par bya/ /'byung ba bzhi dang rigs mthun napa'i/ /rked bcing rked pa'i tshad dang mnyam//sor gsum sor bzhi dar ram men/ /gnas pa'i tshad ni rnam pa drug /rnam thar gsang ba'i pho brang gnas/ /skye mched rig par gnas pa'o/ /stong pa rta mgrin 'khor lor gnas/ /khams rnams gsang ba bde skyong gnas/ /'dab la sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnas/ /yang dag spong ba snying gar geganas/ /he ru kur ni ma gshegs shing 5/ /rdo rje mad(ra yis ma brgyab pa'o/ /drang ba'i tshad ni sor bzhi 'byung / /dang por khrus byas gnyis pa la/ /smanamachi tshodang snum dang dri dang gsum/ /sum cha sum gnyis stod smad du/ /lus la bskum3)zhing me la bdug /rtse gsum rtsa ni shin tu zab/ /ba sbrus8ba dang lcamachoshe ba dang / /ra 7 mnye ba dang nye'u shing dang / /ra mo shags dang yan lag bcas/ /rdo la sogs pa lnga sbyar dang / /gzhan yang sman dang snum dang dri/ /dar la sogs pa'i nang du blugs/ /sgo gnyis nas ni tho sdos bdug /zab pa'i sngags btab bsgoms byas 11na/ /dang por 12mtshan ma shes par bya/ /chags pa'i gzi ldan sna tshogs 'byung ske/ /tha ma'ang gsum mam bdun na 'byung / /dgongs pa'i bye brag shes gyur nas1 / /sngags dang sman gyi 1 khyad par ro/ /dgongs pa mi shes 'dod chags phyir/ /sman la sogs pa btsal mi bya/ /'di yi sdig pa bsam mi khyab/ /79wa 594

bdug pa'i sbyor thabs shes gyur na/ /dbus kyi rtsa yi kha 'byed pa/ /sbyor thabs khyad par yin par gsungs/ /bde chen go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /'khor lo'i go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /sku yi go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /ye shes go bzlog tu/sbyor ba dang / /'byung ba go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /yum gyi go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /thig le go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /bsam gtan go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /yi ge go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /stong pa'i dun/go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /dbugs kyi go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /dga' ba'i go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /gtum mo'i go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /rtsa yi go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /byang sems go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /g.yas g.yon go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /brdar riyi go bzlog sbyor ba dang / /rten gyi go bzlog sbyor ba rnams/ /kun mkhyen gyis lakyang ma gzigs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyi gsang / /byang chub sems dpa' kun gyi yum/ /sras rnams thun mong ma yin bskyed/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par ro/ /'di yi khyad par ma dpags 5par/ /zab pa'i don ni yod ma yin/ /dbang bskur ba yis sngon du yang / /gdams ngag sbyin par gsungs pa yin/ /gdams 7ngag de yis dbang thob 'gyur/ /shes rab ma la brten nas su/ /bde ba'i ye shes bskyed pas na/ /shes rab ye shes dbang du gsungs / /sih+la ga pur shes rab ste/ /de yi bde ba ye shes yin/ /sih+la shes rab ces 25bya ste/ /ga pur ye shes su ni bshad/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa shes rab ste / /de yi thig le ye shes yin/ /la la 9)nā ni ye shes so/ / ra sa nā sna ni shes rab ste/ / rtsa ni shes rab zhes bya ste/ /17byang chub sems ni ye shes so/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni shes rab ste/ /dpa' bo ye shes su ni bshad/ /dga' ba 79—595

gsum ni ye shes te/ /rang bzhin dga' ba shes rab yin/ /'og ni shes rab ces tsho1)bya ste/ /steng la ye shes su yang bshad/ /g.yon pa shes rab cesa'agebya ste//g.yas pa ye shes su yang bshad/ /chos dbyings shes rab ces bya ste/ /ye shes bzhi ni ye shes yin ri/ /phyag mtshan ming dang yi ge rnams/ /gzhan yang bye brag shes par bya/ /shes rab ye shes la yang gsum/ /tshig la bslab pa'ang gnang ba yin/ /gzugs brnyan la ni bshad pa ste/ /mngon par rtogs pas bsgom pa gsungs/ /e khri ri ma lnga'i 5rnam pa bzhi/ /e ni sa ste waṃ ni chu/ /ma ni me ste yā 6ni rlung / /e ni snying rje waṃ ni byams/ /ma ni dga' ba yā btang snyoms / /e ni spyan waṃ mā ma tī/ /ma ni gos dkar yā sgrol ma/ /e ni sbyin pa waṃ tshul khrims/ /ma ni bzod pa yā bsam gtan/ /e ni phyag rgya chen lapo ste/ /waṃ ni dam tshig phyag rgya yin/ /ma ni chos kyi phyag rgya ste/ /yā ni shes rab phyag rgya'on / /e ni shar te waṃ lho phyogs/ /ma ni nub phyogs yā byang phyogs/ /e ni sku yi thig le ste/ /waṃ ni gsung la ma ni thugs/ /yā ni ye shes thig 9 le'o/ /e ni sngon po waṃ ljang ku1 / /ma ni dmar po yā ser po/ /e ni mkha' 'gro waṃ lā ma//ma ni dum skyes yā gzugs can/ /e ni ye shes mkha' 'gro yin/ /waṃ ni rdo rje'i mkha' 11'gro yin/ /ma ni sha za'i mkha' 'gro ste/ /yā ni las kyi mkha' 'gro'o / /e ni 'gog pa waṃ ni lam/ /ma ni sdug bsngal yā kun 'byung / /e ni bde chen waṃ longs spyod/ /ma ni chos la yā sprul pa/ /e ni mtshan la waṃ stong pa / /ma ni rnam thar yā dpe byad/ /e ni rnam pa sna tshogs te/ /waṃ ni rnam par smin pa'o/ /ma ni rnam par nyed pa ste/ /yā ni rnam pa mtshan nyid bral/ /e ni chung ba waṃ 'bring po/ /ma ni lhag pa yā cher lhag /e ni g.yas nas me rgyu 79—596

ste / /waṃ ni g.yon nas rlung rgyu'o/ /ma ni 'og nas sa rlung rgyu/ /yā ni steng nas 3)chu rlung rgyu/ /e ni gnas brtan waṃ phal chen/ /ma ni bkur ba yā thams cad / /e ni bsnyen pa waṃ nye bsnyen/ /ma ni sgrubalgepa yā bsgrub che/ /e ni shar lho waṃ lho nub/ /ma ni nub byang yā byang shar )/ /e ni rgyud la waṃ ni sngags/ /ma ni ye shes yā gsang cab/ /e ni snang ba waṃ snang mched/ /ma ni snang thob yā 'od gsal/ /e ni bdag gi bzang po yin/ /waṃ ni dus kyi bzang po'o ma ni ye shes bzang por gsungs/ /yā ni rlung gi bzang po yin/ /e ni bdag gi gnas yin te/ /waṃ ni rnal 'byor gnas su bstan/ /ma ni gzhan gyi gnas yin te/ /yā ni rgyud kyi gnas yin no/ /e ni dga' ba waṃ mchog dga'/ /ma ni lhan cig yā dga' bral/ /e ni me long waṃ mnyam nyid/ /ma ni kun rtog yā nan tan/ /e ni chos sku waṃ longs spyod/ /ma ni sprul sku yā bde chen/ /e ni zhi ba waṃ ni dbang / /ma ni rgyas pa yā gsod pa/ /yi ge btus pa'i sngags chen cigacigasum / /oṃ ni sku yi 'khor lo ste/ /āḥni gsung gi 'khor lo'o/ /hūm̐ ni thugs kyi 'khor lo yin/ /oṃ ni rnam snang āḥ'od dpag /hūm̐ ni mi bskyod 6rang bzhin no/ /oṃ ni phyag g.yon hūṃ ni g.yas/ /āḥni dbus kyi snying ga 7yin / /oṃ ni g.yon gyi spyan yin te/ /hūṃ ni g.yas pa āḥnadabu ma/ /oṃ ni srog yin 974 rtsol ba/ /āḥni gnas par shes par bya/ /oṃ ni sku la hūṃ ni thugs / /āḥ1 rini gsung du shes par bya/ /oṃ ni lus la āḥ11ni ngag /hūṃ ni yid du shes par bya/ /oṃ ni thabs la hūm̐ shes rab/ /āḥni gnyis su med pa'o//oṃ ni g.yon gyi la la nā 12/ /hūm̐ ni g.yas kyi ra sa nanyusnye/ /āḥnya ni a ba dhū tī yin / /oṃ ni g.yas kyi ra sa rā15/ /hūm̐ ni g.yon gyi la la nās/ /āḥni de 79—597

bzhin dbus na gnas/ /oṃ ni ga pur rtsu sih+la/ /āḥni dkar dmar rtsa dag ①yin / /oṃ ni mchog dga' rtsu khyad (kyedaga'/ /āḥni rang bzhin dga' ba'i don / /dga' ba lhan cig skyes dgar 'gyur/ /lhan cig skyes pa dga' bar 'gyur / /rgyu la 'bras bu sbyor ba dang / / 'bras bu la yang rgyu sbyor dang / /②rgyu la rgyu yi sbyor ba dang / /'bras bu la yang 'bras bur sbyor/ /rgyu 'bras gnyis su med par sbyor/ /thabs la shes rab sbyor ba dang / /shes rab la yang thabs kyis sbyor/ /thabs la thabs kyis sbyor ba dang / /shes rab shes rab sbyor ba dgas /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med sbyor/ /sbyor ba 'di yi dgongs pa yang / /kun mkhyen gyis rdor kyang rtogs par dka'/ /a ni rnam snang mi bskyod pa/ /na ro rin chen 'byung ldan te/ /zla rdzune)tshes 'od dpag med pa yin / /thig le don yod grub pa'o/ /oṃ ni bde gshegs ⑨lnga rang bzhin/ /zhabs skyed don yod grub pa ste/ /'a (nyeni de bzhin 'od dpag med/ /ha ni rnam par snang mdzad de/ /zla tshes rin chen 'byung ldan yin/ /thig le mi bskyod rang bzhin no/ /zhabs skyed (7sgrol ma'i rang bzhin te/ /'a ⑩ni gos dkar ngo bo yin/ /ha ni rdo rje dbyings phyug ma/ /zla tshes mā ma 0khri rang bzhin / /thig le spyan du shes par bya/ /'byung ba lnga dang sku lnga dang / /'khor lo lnga dang dga' ba lnga/ /go rims lho bzhin du shes par bya/ /zhabs skyed bya ba nan tan yin/ /'a 'o ni mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /ha ni chos kyi dbyings yin te//zla tshes so sor rtog pa'o/ /thig le me long ye shes so/ /'di dag kun gyi dgongs pa'i don8/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi gsang / /kun tu gsang zhing dpyad par tshedaka'/ /yi ge tshul gyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /de nas byang chub 79—598

ldan 'das/ /gser dngul la sogs ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gser ni rnam pa gnyis yin te/ /rang bzhin dang ni bzor byas yin/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'chi ba bslus)/ /bzor byas pa ni rnam pa gnyis / /gser 'gyur gser gyi rgyan yin te/ /bdar rinaba'i gser gyis srid lamadza 'gegs/ /lo dang zla ba zla ba phyed/ /mkhas pas brtags 4shing shes par bya/ /dngul la sogs pa'ang bde bzhin te/ /mdor na snang zhing srid pa'i rdzas / /thams cad rin po che yin te/ /man ngag can gyis shes par bya/ /de nas bcud kyi56)rin po che/ /lus kyi ri rab lhun po la/ /rin chen gser gyi dbye ba yang / /thabs dang shes rab rin po che/ /shes rab rtsa yi rang bzhin te(pe / /thabs ni byang chub sems yin no/ /dmar dang dngas pa lde)shes rab ste/ /dkar dang dngas pa 49/thabs su gsungs/ /a ba dhū tī rin chen las/ /thig le du ma phreng ba yin/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /a ba dhū tī ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /a ba dhū tī'i sna terang bzhin las/ /steng du sgo lnga nyu1yang dag gnas/ /bar dang 'og tu'ang hurtede bzhin te/ /bskyed dang rdzogs dang rang bzhin las/ /yon tan skyon gyi mtshan nyid do/ /bde chen thig le haṃ yin no/ /o dang āḥrgyu ha nyinadang bzhi/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo ru/ /sku gsung thugs dang bde ba che/ /'bar ba bzhi ru yang dag bshad/ /sku gsung thugs dang bde ba che/ /mgrin pa ru ni 'jug pa bzhi / /snying gar tshayang ni 'dzag pa bzhi/ /sprul pa ru yang de bzhin te/ /chos kyi sku ni rin chen la/ /stong pa bcu drug phreng bar bshad/ /de nas shin tu gsang ba'i don/ /pad+ma rdo rje gnyis pa yang / /a tshab dhū tī rin po che/ /79wa 607

a phaṭa e dang waṃ dang bzhi/ /gsang ba'i thig le'atshobazhi ru bshad/ /a ni me long lta bu ste/ /phaṭa ni bya ba nan tan yin/ /e pani so so ra rtog pa ste/ /waṃ ni mnyam nyid ye shes so/ /rin chen chos dbyings ye shes te/ /rnam par thar dang stong pa dang / /mtshan dang de bzhin dpe byad rnams/ /a ni 'khor lo 'byung ba bzhi/ /phaṭa kyi gnas su ye shes lnga/ /e yi gnas su snyoms 'jug dgu / /waṃ gi gnas su lnga bcu brgyad/ /de kho na ru shes par bya/ /k+ṣa oṃ e ta sa bon bzhi45/ /yon tan skyon gyi mtshan nyid kyis/ /kun la khyab cing shes par bya/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'di yis gdon rnams ji ltar thub/ /byang sems dgag pa ji ltar lags/ /spa dkar gnyer ma ji ltar zhi tshol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rnam par rtog pa gdon yin te / /mtshan dang dpe 5byad spong ba dang / /phung po lnga ni bdud rtsi lnga/ /skye mched de ni lnga ru 'gyur/ /khams rnams rten gyi ngo bo ste/ /de rnams rten rtsi'i〈 kyingo bo ste/ /rnam rtog spong phyir rin po che/ /byang chub sems dgag rim pa yang ske/ /g.yas brkyang bas ni thabs kyis te/ /g.yon gyis shes rab rtsa mdud dgag /sa gas nam mkha' dgag par bya/ /zlum pos gsang ba'i sna rtser dgag /la la nā 7dang ra sa nān/ /a ba dhū tī'i 9nang chud pa/ /de ni nam mkha' zlum po ste/ /dper na sbrul gyi lce gnyis la/ /dug dang sman ni yod pa bzhin / /gzhan yang 'dug stangs bye brag gis/ /dgag pa'i sbyor ba shes par bya / /dgag pa srog dang rtsol ba'i rten/ /de ltar dbus su gnas pa dang / /rim nas rim par gyen la drang / /skad cig nas bzung 1 tsholo yi bar spa dkar gnyer ma'i rang bzhin dgag /gang la brten pa de yi 11tshad/ /lha mos 79wa 608

gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /dbus su gnas pa ji ltar lags/ /rim nas rim du ji ltar drang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /thabs zhes bya ba rtag pa'i mtha'/ /shes rab zhes pa chad pa'i mtha'/ /snyoms par 'jug pa dbu ma'i don/ /g.yas kyi srog ni rtag pa'i mtha'/ /g.yon gyi rtsol ba chad pa'i mtha'/ /de gnyis gnas pa dbu ma'i don/ /ro ma rtag pa'i byang chub sems / /rkyang ma khrag ni chad pa'o/ /kun 'dar 3)ma ru gang gnas pa/ /de ni dbu mar shes par bya/ /mchog gi dga' ba rtag pa'i mtha'/ /bral ba'i dga' ba chad pa'i mtha'/ /lhan cig dga' ba dbu mar bshad/ /oṃ dang hūṃ ni mtha'adza2)gnyis te/ /āḥ )yi rnam pa dbu mar gnas/ /ā li kā li mtha' gnyis te/ /ma ningam yi ge dbu ma yin/ /skyes pa bud med mtha' gnyis te/ /ma ning gnyis su med par gsungs/ /'di ni sgom 5pa zung du 'jug /de ni gnas par 6)dbu ma'i don/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa ru/ /'brel pa zung du 'jug par gsungs/ /bya ba'i rgyud dang rnal 'byor rgyud ci/ /snang ba zung du 'jug par gsungs/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa ru/ /steng sgo'i rlung la zung du 'jug /shes rab rnal 'byor bla ma ru/ /sih+la ga pur zung du 'jug /rim nas rim du drang sku ba yang / /gsang ba'i 'khor lo a la ni/ /bde ba rdzogs pa'i tshad bstan pa/ /pad+ma rdo rje 'gags 'o pa snyam/ /de ni yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshad/ /de nas gsang ba'i 'khor lo nas/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i bar du drang / /dang por 1 ride ltar shes par bya/ /de ltar sems ni brtan 11'gyur na/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo nas/ /gsang ba'i sna rtse bar du drang / /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /bcud kyi rin chen gang na gnas/ /de 79wa 609

ni shes pa su yis7shes/ /de yi brtagasho pa ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo yan chad du/ /a ba dhū tī tsan+dan gnas/ /la la ra kyis sbrul ltar gnas/ /gzhan rnams ba thag khug par gnas/ /'di rnams rang bzhin kun la gnas/ /rtsa dang 'khor lo 'di rnams ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying por gsungs/ /phyi yi rtsa dang nang gi rtsa/ /gsangs ba de bzhin mthar thug pa'i/ /man ngag yod pas shes par gsungs/ /brtag rinapa rnam pa gnyis su bstan/ /dang po lus kyi brtag popa ste/ /gnyis pa ngag tu shes par bya/ /lus la spyi dang bye brag gnyis / / sgu na 7rlung gi rang bzhin te/ /yan lag thung ba chu yi0)khams/ /yan lag rgyas pa sa yi khams/ /smad zheng 9 che ba me yi khams/ /sna tshogs du ma nam mkha'i khams/ /spyi ru dkar ba chu yi khams/ /dmar ba me ru shes par bya / /ser na de bzhin sa yi khams/ /sngo na rlung du shes par bya/ /yang na rlung gi khams yin te/ /drod rnams che na me yi khams/ /brtan na sa yi khams su gsungs/ /chu khams che na chu yi khams/ /de rnams kun ldan nam mkha'i khams / /'jug pa bde chen sa yin te/ /ldog pa sprul pa chu ru gsungs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud ni bye brag gis/ /sems kyi gnas su shes par bya/ /shu kra rlung la sih+la me/ /sprul dang chos su kha sbyar yin/ /gzhan yang mkhas pas shes par bya / /de nas bye brag gsungs pa yo ci/ /dbyibs dang kha dog mtshan ma gsum/ /kun la mkhas pas shes par bya/ /dang por dbyibs kyi brtag pa yang /dpral ba'i dbyibs la rnam pa bzhi/ /gru bzhi zlum po zla gam dang / /gru gsum du yang shes par bya/ /dkar po la sogs de dang 'dra/ /rna ba nas gzungs/lha79—610

rkang pa'i bar/ /kun la brtag0)cing shes par bya/ /skad ni phra dang sbom pa dang ske/ /ring du 'don dang thunga'ageb dang / /'dar ba la sogs bye brag rnams//mkhas pas brtag57cing shes par bya/ /rtags des brtag54)pa'i mtshan ma ni/ /rnam pa gsum du shes par bya/ /'dod chags sku dang zhe snang thugs/ /mun pa gsung du shes par bya/ /dang po 'dod chags dbye ba yang yar ngo mar ngo mtshams dang gsum/ /dbyibs dang kha dog skad gsum la/ /mkhas pa 'dod pa skye ba brtag /nyin bar bzhi dang mtshan bar bzhi/ /de bzhin skad cig thang cig rnams/ /mkhas pas brtag gecing shes par bya/ /mig 'dzums sne)ba spu ldang la sogs/ /dbyibs kyi 'dod pa 7 skye ba'i rtags/ /'dod pa'i gzugs ldan cung zhig dmar/ /sna bug dkar la sogs pa dang / /skad 'dar5shekha ni skam la sogs/ /'dod pa skye ba'i rtags thu su bshad/ /gzhan yang 'dod pa rgyas pa'i rtags/ /kha dog dbyibs la brtag nya ripar bya/ /sra phyir 'dod pa sa yi khams/ /chu la sogs pa de bzhin no/ /gsung dang thugs la'ang shes par bya/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /'dod chags zhes pa ji ltar lags/ /de yi chen po ji ltar lags/ /zhe sdang la sogs ji ltar lagasal/ /sku gsung thugs ni ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'dod chags nyon mongs 'khor ba ste/ /gab pa'i gsang ba ma gtogs77par/ /sbas pa'i gsang ba la zhen nas/ /srid pa'i sa bon mi zab 3gepas / /dper na rgyud kyi mda' bzhin du/ /'bras bu mnar med dmyal bar skye / /chen po mi rtog rang bzhin te/ /'bras bu gnyis med ye shes skyed/ /'dod chags zhes pa spang bya ste/ /de yi chen po gnyen por gsungs/ /'dod 79—611

chags zhes pa me tog ste/ /de yi chen po dri dang 'dra/ /gzhan yang bye brag shes par bya/ /zhe sdang la sogs gong dang 'dra/ /thams cad rten pa sku ru bstan 1)rka/ /brjod pa dang bral gsung du bstan/ /rnam rtog bral ba thugs su shes / /rnam rtogal)chung zhing gtong phod che/ /bla ma la gus snying rje che/ /gzhan yang bye brag kun shes pa/ /'di la bstan gyi kun la gsang / /bla ma yon tan kun ldan zhing / /dbang dang man ngag 'brel shes dang / /gsang ba'i don la ma rmongs shing / /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas/ /chos la ser sna med pa dang / /gsal la gsong por smra ba dang / /rigs bcasahoXkun gyis bkur ba dang / /las kyi phyag rgya ca'achang ba dang / /dam tshig dang ldan bla ma ste / /'di la bkur gyi 5thams cad la/ /bsnyen cing bkur bar bya ba min/ /de nas rin chen gsum pa ni/ /gnyis med lhan cig skyes pa ste/ /rtog bral spros pa med pa yin/ /de rtogs rin chen phreng ba'o/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /gab pa zhes pa ji ltar lags/ /de yi 'bras bu ji ltar smin/ /sbas pa zhes pa ji ltar lags/ /de yi 'bras bu ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gab pa zhes pa ye shes te/ /sum cu 6)rtsa bdun sku gsung thugs/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul sku gsum/ /dga' ba bzhi ru mdor bsdus pa/ /dmigs pa'i rkyen ni gsang ba'o/ /bdun dang ldan phyir chen po'o / /sum cu 7 rtsa bdun la sogs pa'i/ /gnyen po stobs kyis58ma zhugs par / /sbas pa pad+ma rdo rje gnyis/ /snyoms par zhugs na 'dod pa skye 9/ /'di ni rkun po 1 )ma rungs pa/ /dper na ljon shing rtsa ba las/ /yal ga me tog thams cad skyes/ /nyon mongs rtsa ba 'dod chags las/ /dug gsum la sogs 79—612

thams cad de/ /sbas pa'i gsang ba 'khor ba ste/ /gab pa mya ngan 'das par gsungs / /'khor ba mnar med dmyal ba dang / /dur khrod brgyad po dregs pa can/ /snying rje med cing sha khrag za/ /shing rta'i 'khor lo bzhin du gnas/ /mya ngan 'das pa sku gsum ste/ / skyob pa (1)mya ngan 'das gyur kyang / /'khor lo 'khor ba'i tshul du ni/ /tshogs kyi shugs kyi mthu yis su/ /sems can don la yang dag 'jug /chos sku spros bral nam mkha' bzhin/ /sku gnyis sprin dang char lta bu/ /sku gnyis sems can don mdzad pa/ /sems can las dang smon lam stobs/ /de yi stobs kyi〈(snang ba las/ /yang dag nyid la snang rgyu med/ /sku gsum de nyid bzhi bcu'i don/ /dur khrod la sogs brda ru shes/ /sum cu 3rtsa gnyis chos sku'i brdangs/ /brgyad ni gzugs sku gnyis kyi brdar/ /gzhan yang brda yi bye brag ni/ /sbom po gsang ba'i rdo rje'i brda/ /khro mo gsang ba'i pad+ma'i brdal/ /sgu 6dang drang ba yon tan skyon/ /mdzub 7mo la brten namathe'u chung ni/ /nga yi gan bdu tshur shog yin/ /mthe bo la brten mdzub 7mo bar/ /khyod kyi gan du 'ong gis yin/ /mthe bong mdzub 11gnyis zur gsum ni/ /bha ga rgyas sam dri ba yin/ /bha ga rgyas pa zlum por 12ston/ /bde ba'i gnas su 'du ba yang / /srod dam nam gung tho rangs gsum/ /mdzub 1 tshigs dang po nas gzung skonas/ /tha ma'i bar du brda 7yin no/ /sku gsung thugs kyis byin brlabs 7kyis/ /lan gsum bar du nan tan gnad/ /gzhan yang brda yi bye brag rnams/ /rgyud rnams kun tu ma gsungs pa/ /gnas ni thabs kyi 'dug stangs so/ /nye gnas shes rab 'dug par gsungs/ /zhing ni thabs kyi bza' ba'i tshogs/ /de bzhin shes rab nye ba'i zhing / /'du ba thabs ni 'ong ba ste/ /79—613

shes rab 'ong ba nye 'du yin/ /tsusdo ①thabs kyi stan dang rgyan/ /shes rab de bzhin nye ts+tshabazhu/ /dur khrod thabs kyi rnam rtog bral/ /de bzhin shes rab nye dur khrod/ /gzhan yang brda ①yi bye brag rnams/ /kha dog de bzhin dbyibs dang yang / /yan lag tshul las shes par bya/ /de nas lha mo la dusogs pas mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /dpal rin chen phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po ⑤gsang ba ste rang bzhin gyis gsang ba rdzogs soyi// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po rin chen rdo rje dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa⑨/ slad kyis kyang dpe phyi mo la gtugs nas bcos pa'o//bsdur mchan/6༷2 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉le/tshoge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dzo/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉khyed kyis/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉khyod kyi/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzangs/〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gzangs/ sa〈〈g.yung 〉〉 de rnams su yi spyod yul lags/ /6༷ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ga ga ri/ (ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yis/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉sgong / ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉mo yi 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉mo yis/ rdoge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sku/ (6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉nas/ ⑦〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gyi/2〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉phyi'u/ 98〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gnan/ ⑩〈〈khu 〉〉gzhin/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉du ma phreng bar/ 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bo/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ra a ra 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ma ra/④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gtags/ (ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉drur+ya/ 8〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rlabs/0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sogs/ po〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgong / 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉des bdugs/〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉des gdugs/6༷4 3)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rag ta/ tshon〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉skog ((〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yis/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉 na/ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉bye'u sban/ tsho6〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉byug ()〈〈g.yung 〉〉khyar/ (nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉bad pa rag ta/ 〈〈pe 〉〉pad ma rag ta/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉kar sha pa ni/ 〈〈li 〉〉dkar sha pa ni/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉79wa 614

tshog /dpal dam tshig chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/1) ༄༅gi /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā sa ma ((ya tan+t+ra rā dza ②nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal dam tshig chen po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la snyoms par bzhugs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po dang / rnal 'byor ma grangs med pa'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la zhal 'dzum pa mdzad nas/ dam tshig gi rim pa bka' stsal pa/ dam tshig dang ni mi ldan na/ /bsgrubs kyang 'grub par mi 'gyur te/ /rgyu med pa yi 94)'bras bu bzhin/ /tshe yi dus byas dmyal bar 'gro/ /de phyir dam tshig shin tu bsrung / /sangs rgyas bla ma las thob phyir/ /thun mong ma yin bla ma yi/ /lnga bcu'i bdag nyid bsrung bar bya/ /73—617

thun mong brgyad dang bcu bzhi ste/ /de rnams nges pa shes par bya/ /de rnams spyi yi dam tshig ste/ /bye brag dam tshig bsrung7)bar bya/ /phung po lnga ni rigs lnga ste / /'byung ba lnga ni yum lnga'o/ /skye mched sems dpa' sems ma yin/ /gzugs phung rnam par snang mdzad la/ /brjed dang brnyas pa la sogs spang / /de la mchod dang bstod sogs bya/ /don dam par nidzabarang rig ste/ / tshogs bsags phyir na nga yis gsungs/ /tshor ba la sogs de dang 'dra/ /sa ni sangs rgyas spyan yin te/ /spyod lam gsum du ma yengs shig(ge /gang du gsungs pa'i tshul bzhin bsrung / /chu la sogs pa de bzhin no/ /mig la sogs pa de bzhin no/ /gzugs la sogs pa de bzhin bsrung / /dkyil 'khor du zhugs rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhin du mchod/ /brnyas shing gshe ba la sogs spang / /sems can pho dang mo kun la/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dam tshig bsrung / /bza' ba la sogs dus su yang / /bdud rtsi sbyor bas dam tshig bsrung / /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams la/ /rang gi spyod dang gzhan spyod la / /rjes su yi rang dam tshig yin/ /mdor na snang zhing srid pa'i rdzas/ /dam tshig bsrung zhing mchod pa'i phyir/ /lus kyi nyes sdom sku yin te/ /ngag gi nyes sdom gsung du gsungs/ /yid kyi nyes sdom thugs su gsungs/ /oṃ gyi 'od zer dkar po yis/ /'dod khams dag par gyur pa ni/ /sku yi dam tshig bsrung ba'o/ /de la mchod dang bstod sogs bya/ /bsdu ba'angapo)tsha du shes par bya / /āḥ6ni kha dog dmar po yis/ /gzugs khams dag pa'i gsung dam tshig /hūm̐ gi kha dog nag po yis/ /gzugs med dag pa'i 87dam tshig go/ /oṃ ni spyi bor yang dag gnas/ /āḥni de bzhin mgrin par gnas/ /hūm̐ ni snying 79—618

garashesgro dang bsdu/ /sku yi mkha' 'gro bcu gnyis su/ /'dod khams dag pa'i〈pedam tshig go/ /gsung gi mkha' 'gro bcu gnyis su/ /gzugs khams dag pa'ishedam tshig yin/ /thugs kyi mkha' 'gro bcu gnyis su/ /gzugs med dag pa'i〈pedam tshig ste/ /oṃ dang āḥdang hūm̐ la bsduduge/ /oṃ ni rgyu yi sku bcu gnyis/ /āḥni lam gyi sku bcu gnyis/ /rtsu ni 'bras bu sku bcu gnyis/ /bde ba chen po'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa'o/ /dpal ldan chos kyi sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ / ye shes gcig gyur sdom pa'o/ /(5)sprul pa yang ni sku gsung thugs / /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa'o/ /bde chen snying po haṃ nyid la/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs dang yang / /ye shes dang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /oṃ dang āḥdang hūṃ dang yang / /yan lag bzhi bzhir thub pas gsungs/ /rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu la/ /bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad shes par bya/ /i dang haṃ gnyis rang bzhin gyi/ /sngags kyi ngo bor shes par bya/ /sngags kyi grangs ni nyi khri stong / /drug brgya bzlas par shes par bya/ /lag pa bskyod pa rang bzhin gar/ /rkang pa rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ro/ /de ltar gnas na dam tshig go/ /gzhan yang dam tshig bye brag yang / /'jig rten tha snyad spang ba'i phyir/ /mi bskyod rnam snang la sogs dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje pad+ma dang ske/ /ji ltar rol pa'i spyod pa kun/ /tha snyad kyang ni lam la 'jug /gzhan yang gsang ba'i dam tshig ni/ /rtsa ba bzhi dang yan lag bcu/ /theg pa che la smod pa dang / /gsang ba'i don la skur ga 'debs dang / /rnal 'byor kun la gnod pa dang / /sems can kun la 'tshe byed pa/ /'di gsang ba ni 79—619

dam tshig yin/ /sbas pa bsrung ba'i rim pa yang / /ma byin blang ba'i dam tshig ste / /'dod pa chen po dang ldan pa'i/ /'dod chags spyod pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /rang gi dam tshig bsrung ba'i phyir/ /brdzun du smra ba bzhi pa yin/ /ro tsa'ilo1)sha dang bcud kyi sha /kha ba'i chang dang mngar ba'i chang / /mar la gcig ste 'o ma gnyis/ /gzhan ni gsum ste yan lag bcu/ /'di ltar dam tshig yin par gsungs/ /bdud rtsi nyid la dus gsum du/ /bcom ldan sku gsung thugs kyi ste/ /dang por yungs kur 5tha ma yang / /byi la'i kham gyi ri tshul du bza'/ /mtshan mo shes rab sku gsung thugs/ /nyin mo thabs kyi sku gsung thugs/ /nyi ma nub dang nyi ma shar/ /nyi ma gung ni thabs kyi dus/ /nam srodas nam ni langs pa dang / /nam gyi gung ni shes rab dus/ /dus drug mchod pa rgyun mi gcadarka/ /dam tshig 'di las ma nyams na/ /phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma 5rnams kyis(5na/ /mchod dang bsrung ba la sogs byed/ /gzhan yang gsang ba'i bye brag la/ /gsang ba sgom pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /lus la me dang khrag mi gdon7/ /srog gam zug rngu'i phyir ma gtogs / /srog chags 'dod pa spyod mthong 8na/ /rang gi rnal 'byor shor mi bya / /dam tshig bsrung 9phyir dben par 'dug /las su rung na g.yeng bar kho'akhyam / /'di skad ces bya yan lag brgyad/ /bdag gi 11bcu bzhi yin par gsungs / /thos pa'i dus gcig lnga bcu'i don/ /bcom ldan 'das ni rtsa ba bzhi / /de bzhin gshegs pa yan lag bcu/ /sku gsung thugs ni lus ngag yid / /rdo rje mi phyed phyir dam tshig /btsun mo dam tshig gis brgyan mdzes/ /bha ga mnyam par 'jog 12pas so/ /snyoms pa dus gsum mi 'gyur ba/ /79wa 620

bzhugs pa bde ba'i ngo bo la'o/ /rdo rje snying po la sogs pa/ /bye brag yin par nga yis gsungs/ /e ni yan lag brgyad yin no/ /rba ni bcu po'i rang bzhin te/ /ma ni lnga bcu'i rang bzhin no/ /lnga 1)ni gzhan rnams yin par gsungs / /e ni srog chags gsod pa 3)ste/ /baṃ ni ma byin len pa'o/ /ma ni brdzun du smra ba'o/ /rdzadza )ni 'dod chags spyod pa'o/ /e ni sku yi dam tshig ste/ /baṃ ni gsung gi dam tshig go/ /ma ni thugs kyi dam tshig go/ /yā bcini bza' ba'i dam tshig go/ /dus gsum dam tshig ma bsrungs na/ /'jig rten pa dang 'bum 'gyur ba'i/ /rnam smin che bar nga yis gsungs / /dam tshig nyams pa'i mtshan ma ni/ /lus kyi nyes pa sna tshogs 'byung / /ngag gi nyes pa sna tshogs smra/ /kha dog dbyibs rnams 'gyur ba dang / /lag gi rdzas rnams mi thub cing / /'bras dang shu ba la sogs 'byung / /de tshe rnal 'byor nyams pa des / /dam tshig nyams pa shin du bsam6)/ /bla ma rdo rje spun gral du/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor sprul byas la/ /gser dngul la sogs brgya 'am stong / /rta dang glang po la sogs dang / / be+e ḍūr+ya 57dang man shel dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan brgya 'am stong / /mar me la sogs de bzhin no/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo chen po bskor/ /tshogs bsags pas ni nyams pa gso/ /gal te nyams pa ma gsos na/ /nyams pa de dang rnal 'byor gzhan/ /gnas gcig dang ni chu gcig gam/ /yul dang lam gyi gnas gcig gam/ /skad cig tsam yang 'dug mi bya/ /'dug na nyes pa bsam mi khyab/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg dbang bskur dang / /gtor ma mchod dang bzlas pa dang / / ril bumatshon mig sman la sogs dang / /zhi rgyas la sogs las rnams dang / /'jig rten mtshan 79—621

ma brgyad dag dang / /'jig rten 'das pa'i mtshan ma bzhi/ /sangs rgyas pa yi mtshan ma gcig /gzhan yang dngos grub ma lus pa/ /dam tshig 'di las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /'bru rnams sna tshogs skye 'gyur ba/ /rin chen sa las skyes pa bzhin/ /dam pa sku gsung thugs yin te/ /de las 'das na 'tshig nyapar 'gyur/ /ji ltar 2bu ni med pa'i khyim/ /shi ma thag tu stong par 'gyur/ /de bzhin dam tshig 'di med na/ /mnar med sems can dmyal bar skye/ /pi wang gling bu sbyor kun sogs/ /rgyud dang bral na brdung mi rung / /de bzhin dam tshig med gyur na/ /sngags bzlas bsgom pa la sogs pa/ /'bras bu med par brlag par 'gyur/ /nas las nas kyi myu gu skye / /dam tshig las ni rdo rje 'chang ske/ /tshe 'dir thob par gsungs pa ste/ /dus ni gzhan min rtsod ldan dusal/ /bstan bya gzhan min nga yis te/ /skye ba gzhan min pha dang ma/ /man ngag gzhan 5min sa ma ya/ /bzhi ni yin par gsungs pa'o/ /de ltar dam tshig dang ldan pa/ /bud med 'du zhing dga' bar 'gyur/ /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma mo ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mtshan mar ston/ /nor dang bran dang g.yog 'khor dang / /rgyal po'i 'khor yul la sogs 'du/ /ngag ni snyan cing bde bar 'gyur/ /srog gcod la sogs tshig smras kyang / /sems can skrag par mi 'gyur ro/ /lus kyis 6sems can bsad byas kyang / /rnam smin 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /sku ni thob par gsungs pa'o/ /ngag gis phra ma'i tshig smras kyang ske/ /nyes par mi 'gyur gsung thob 'gyur/ /yid kyis 7mnar sems bsams byas kyang / /nyes par mi 'gyur thugs thob 'gyur/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i yon tan no/ /e ma'o rgyud ni ngo re mtshar/ /dpal dam tshig chen po'i 79—622

rog /dpal stobs po che'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/((༄༅ga /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā ba 2kyil tan+t+ra rā dza / gum/ bod skad dul/ dpal stobs po che'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ dpal sdom pa'i snying po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa mo dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dpa' bo'i tshogs dang / lā ma la sogs pa mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / ma mo'i tshogs kyis bskor nas btsun mo'i bha ga la snyoms par bzhugs so/ /'jig rten na ni cher grags pa/ /dgra ni chen po drug yin te/ /ji ltar nyi ma nub pa'i tshe/ /grong khyer 5 gyi ni mi rnams kyis kyi/ /rta dang glang po la sogs pa/ /rdzas rnams yongs su 'phrog par byed/ /thams cad dbul por skye bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin yul drug gi ni dgras/ /shes rab nyi ma nub pa'i tshe/ /ma rig pa yi 7)mun pa la/ /79—625

so so'i 1skye bo thams cad kyi/ /ye shes lnga la sogs pa yi/ /rdzas rnams yongs su 'phrog par byed/ /bde ba med pa'i gnas su skye/ /dgra de yongs su gzhom pa'i phyir/ /mchod pa med cing bzlas pa med/ /gtor ma sbyin sreg 5)dkyil 'khor med/ /klog dang sgom pa bsam gtan med/ /g.yeng ba'i tshes dang skar ma'i tshogs/ /thams cad spangs te bde ba yi/ /stan tsho la bdag nyid legs 'dug ste / /shes rab ye shes bsrub par bya/ /shing rta yi ni 'khor lo ltar/ /yul la yang dag rgyug pa'i sems/ /de dag las 5ni bzlog nas su/ /las kyi rlung ni chen po g.yos/ /ye shes me ni chen po 'bar/ /rnam rtog sreg ste bdud rtsi'i ros/ /til gyi tsho6'bru bzhin gang ba ste/ /skye ba med pa'i gnas su gzung 7/ /de nas sems ni brtan gyur nas/ /mtshan mar snang ba 'gag par 'gyur / /de nyid las ni bzlog nas su/ /rang sems stong par bsgom par bya/ /chos la bdag med rtogs pa na/ /de tshe sems ni rtogs par 'gyur/ /thams cad stong par ros gang ste/ /bde ba chen po'i sku zhes brjod na/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa ste/ /'di la bsal 9ba ci yang med/ /bsnan 1 par bya ba ci yang med / /de nyid mthong bas rnam par grol/ /rigs gcig dang ni rigs gsum dang ske/ /rigs lnga rigs ni brgya la sogs/ /de nyid 'di la tha dad med/ /ji ltar glang po rnyed 1 gyur nas/ /glang po'i rjes ni mi btsal ltar/ /sems kyi de nyid rnyed gyur na/ /rnam rtog gang yang mi btsal lo/ /ji ltar dug ni 'dod pa la / /sman nyid dug tu sbyar te byin12/ /sman las dug 'byung sbyor ba yang /sman pa mkhas pas sbyor ba shes/ /gzhan yang mar dang kha ra dang / /mar gyi snying po la 12sogs pa/ /'thungs te zhu na sman du 'gyurang/ /de bzhin nga yis 79—626

gsungs pa yang / /drang ba'i don dang nges pa'i don/ /sgra ni ji bzhin ji bzhin min/ /dgongs pa dang ni dgongs pa min/ /bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du/ /yongs su brtags nas nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yi mos pa 'am/ /gzhan gyis mkhas pa 'jug mi bya/ /ji ltar skye bo blun po ste/ /dgra ru gyur pa'i skye bo yis/ /sman yin byas te dug byin na/ /sman du dmigs te dug zos na/ /zos pa'i rjes la 'chi bar 'gyur/ /thabs rnams thams cad sgyu mar shes1/ /shes rab brjod du med par gsungs/ /ji ltar rig pa mkhas pa yis/ /dug ni dug gis 'byin par byed/ /ji ltar me yis lde)tshig pa la / /de bzhin me yis gdung bar bya/ /ji ltar 'dod chags che ba la /'dod chags nyid kyis spang bar bya/ /ji ltar zhe sdang che ba la/ /zhe sdang nyid kyis spang bar bya/ /de bzhin gti mug che ba la/ /gti mug nyid kyis spang bar bya / /dper na rlung ni mar me 'jig pa'i rgyu/ /de nyid nags sreg me yi rigrogs su 'gyur/ /de bzhin 'dod la brten 4pa bde ba'i yul/ /dug gis dgra 5)rnams bcom nas gnyis med thob/ / ril bu 6mig sman la sogs pa / /'di nyid 8las ni thams cad 9byung / /ji ltar pha rol thabs ldan pas/ /gzings la brten nas pha rol 'gro/ /pha rol phyin nas 'dor bar byed/ /de bzhin rang rig tshol bas kyang / /bud med sgyu ma la brten 1 te/ /rang rig ye shes thob par bya/ /rang rig ye shes thob pa dang / /bud med sgyu ma dor bar bya / / zab mo'i dgongs pa ma shes shing / /11zab mo'i dgongs pa ma rtogs par / /zab mo'i spyod pa spyod par byed/ /sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung //ji ltar ri yi rtse mo nas/ /skyes bu 'ga' zhig lhung 'gyur na/ /de ni lhung ba 73—627

chen por 'gyur/ /gzhan yang dar gyi srin bu yis/ /rang la rang gis 'ching bar byed/ /mtshan mo me yi srin bu yang / /rang gis rang ni sreg par byed/ /sgyu ma tsam gyi tshul gnas shing / /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam par grol/ /spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi/ /mtshon bya mtshon byed ma yin te/ /lta ba'i dbus na gnas pa yi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa'o/ /dpal stobs po che'i rgyud las mngon par rtogs7)pa'i le'u ste5 nodang po'o// //gang zhig brtag par byed pa yang / /gnas ni shin tu bsngags pa ru/ /khru do pa yis maṇ+ḍal la/ /dang po ba yi rnam lnga yis/ /sor gcig tsam du byug par bya/ /de nas dri chen dri chu yis/ /byugs te me tog sngon po dgram/ /rgyan la sogs pas mdzes par brgyan/ /bum pa lnga ni phyogs dang dbus/ /de nas bzlas pa khri 'am 'bum/ /bdud rtsis4)chu ru byin brlabs7te/ /gang zhig brtag pa'i mi de la/ /dang po mtshams gcad khrus byas te/ /slogashone)pa nag po phyir bzlog gon/ /skra ni gyen bcings sha bcings dang / /ber ka thogs te shar sgor gzhag /tshil chen me mar shar du gtam7)/ /nub tu me long dngul la sogs / /dag pa de la sman lnga dang / /dri lngas byugs tepo)bkru bar bya/ /de nas me long nang du yang / /gdon gyi mtshan ma brtag bya ste/ /gtso bo'i sngags kyi mtha' ru ni/ /gdon gyi ming dang sngags btags she)na/ /lha yi gdon la sogs pa kun/ /mtshan mar 'byung ba the tsomatsha1 med/ /mi de rgyan ni tha dad de//lha la sogs mthong bye brag go/ /dus ni 'byung po'i nyi ma sogs/ /mtshan ma sna tshogs byung 31ba'i tshe/ /de tshe gdon ni dbang du bsdu/ /tshe dang bsod nams 79—628

longs spyod dang / /mdza' bshes zug rngu la sogs pa/ /gdon la sogs pa bsal0)ba'i phyir/ /dpal ldan mkha' 'gro ma la sogs/ /brtag pa'i rdzas kyi bye brag kyang / /mchod dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs/ /bskor la mtshan ma brtagashon)par bya/ /dbang bskur dus su ye shes kyang / /dbab pa de bzhin sdig la sogs/ /mtshan ma me long dag la ni/ /brtags da rite gzhan yang ci 'dod pa'i/ /mtshan ma brtag la 4bla ma yi/ /zhal nas yang dag shes par bya/ /nad kyi zug rngu dbyung ba'i phyir/ /gso ba'i rig pa las gsungs pag /rlung dang bad kun mkhris pa dang / /'dus pa dang ni yan lag bcas/ /gnas bzhir 'khor lor gnas pa ste/ /lus kun khrus byas gnas bzhi ru/ /sngags pas lag pas mnye bya ste/ /me long dkyil du brtagasams)byas na/ /rlung la sogs pa shes par nges/ /dem7rjes 'khor lo de nyid la/ /gso ba'i sbyor ba shes par bya/ /dug ni brtag 7)pa'i rim pa yang / /nad grol yan lag thams cad la/ /gang du dug zhugs mtshan ma brtag /de nas gso ba'i sbyor ba yang //sman dang sngags dang chu sbyar te/ /mkhas pas brtags 8nas gso bar bya/ /dpal stobs po sheche'i rgyud las mtshan ma thams cad brtag pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o // //gang zhig bsrung ba'i rten de yang / /gang dang ldan pa'i rim pa yis/ /srung7ba'i 'khor lo brtsam par bya/ /gtso bo'i bzlas pa khri 'am 'bum/ /bsnyen pa byas te de nas yang / /gser ram dngul las 11bzo byas te/ /nang du dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa 'am/ /yang na 'dab brgyad lte bar bcas/ /rdo rje 79—629

ra ba la sogs bya/ /yungs kur la 37sogs 'bru lnga dang / /rin chen lnga dang sman lnga dang / /de nang gzhags ste rab gnas bya/ /yongs su rdzogs nas bcing bar bya/ /gzhan yang gro ga'am shing shun nam/ /dur khrod dag gi ro ras la/ /bsang dang bgegs bskrad tshul bzhin bya/ /bzlas pa gong dang 'dra ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs gyur na/ /sngags kyang yongs su rdzogs par bri/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo yis/ /lus ngag yid la bsrung bar bya//yongs su ma rdzogs zur drug la/ /dpa' bo drug gi sngags bris te/ /bsrung ba'i lus la mtshan par ribasgom/ /rtsibs mtshan drug la g.yung drung gi/ /yi ge drug ni bris pa ste/ /bsrung bya'i lus la mtshan par 4bsgom/ /dbus su yi ge k+ṣa bris te/ /bar chad thams cad bsal bar bsam/ /cho ga yongs su rdzogs bya ste/ /bzo byas snod ni kha dog sgyur5/ /legs par sbas te spyi bo 'am/ /mgrin pa 6de bzhin dpung pa yi/ /tshangs pa'i bu ga longs spyod mnyam/ /sor bzhi dag 7tu bcing bar bya/ /gzhan yang nad pa'am rnal 'byor pa/ /ngag la srung na dang por yang / /gdon bsal 8bsangs te gnas gsum du/ /thig le gsum byas sngags gsum dgod/ /gzhan yang gnas ni sum cu shebadun/ /thig le byas te sngags rnams dgod/ /de nas go cha mtshan ma yang / /tshul bzhin mthun 1 par shes par bya/ /de nas stan nam mal cha la/ /oṃ āḥbadz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rtsu phaṭa/ / sgom mam 1 gzhan la'ang bri bar bya/ /gzhan yang lag 12pa g.yas pa yis1lha/ /mthil du gur kum 1 dag sbyar te/ /g.yon gyi sbom mo khro mo yis15/ /spyi bo dpral ba rna ba mig /sna dang kha dang mgrin pa dang / /dpung pa snying ga lolte ba dang / /'og gi snod gnyis yan lag la/ /sngags dang 73—630

bcas pas 1)legs par 'tsho/ /gzhan yang skud pa sna lnga la/ /sngags dang bcas na bsrung bar 'gyur/ /dpal stobs po che'i rgyud las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /de nyid la ni phyag 'tshal te/ /rdo rje snying pos yang zhus pa/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo de ltar na/ /ye shes bye brag ji ltar lags / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ye shes kyis ni de nyid kyi/ /rtog pa rab tu bshad par bya/ /de la ye shes kyi ni gnas/ /rnam pa lnga ru shes bya ste/ /phyi dang nang dang gsang lderab dang / /rab tu gsang dang gsang ba che/ /nga yis bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /de la phyi yi ye shes ni/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan dang 'brel pa'o/ /de ltar rtogs 5)pa phyi'i ye shes/ /nang gi phung sogs lha ru cartogs/ /de nyid dang bral ye shes so/ /de nas gsang 5ba'i ye shes ni//rtsa dang rlung dang thig ler rtogs/ /rtog pa de dang bral ba ni/ /gsang ba'i ye shes yin par bshad/ /dga' ba mchog dang bral ba'i dga'/ /lhan cig skyes dga' gang yin pa/ /bde bar rtog pa rnam rtog ste/ /de spong rab gsang 5ye shes so/ /de nas ye shes chen po bzhi/ /dang po ro mnyam mtha' spangs pa'i/ /ye shes de nyid yod pa la/ /rnam rtog spong ste de bzhin 'jog /de nyid rang rig chen po ste/ /de nyid ye shes chen po 'o/ /de ltar shes na rdor 'dzin gyi/ /sa ni nges par thob pa'o/ /dpal stobs po che'i rgyud las ye shes brtag pa'i le'u ste bzhim pa'o// //79—631

de nas ye shes chen po yinya/ /brtag⑧pa de nyid bshad par bya/ /dang por lke chiro mnyam gyur pa'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi ro mnyam la/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan cal sogs pa/ /phung po khams dang skye mched sogs/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang / /dga' dang mchog dga' bral ba dang / /de la sogs pa thams cad kun/ /sgyu ma tsam du shes par bya/ /de nyid gzhan rig ces bya ste/ /rang rig sems kyi de nyid la/ /gnyis su med par bsgom pa ni/ /de nyid ye shes chen po ste/ /mthar phyin brtag pa rdzogs pa'o/ /dpal stobs po che'i rgyud las ye shes chen po brtag pa'i 5le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa dang / rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dpa' bo dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / ma mo'i tshogs thams cad rjes su yi rangs 6nas phyi nang pa gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod nas / g.yon phyogs nas lan gsum bskor ba byas nas mi snang bar gyur to/ /dpal stobs po che'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs son // //paṇ+ḍi ta ga 9ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur 1 ba'o//79wa 632

༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ shrī dzñā na gu h+ya tan+t+ra rā dza(2na/ bod skad du/dpal ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo / /byang chub dzon phyogs chos 4)sum cu 5 rtsa bdun gyi/ /rang lus rtsa yi 'khor lo bzhi'i 96)gtso bordo / /snying po de la yang dag phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang bzhi'i de nyid bdag la gsungs/ /nyon cig rdo rje snying po'i bdag /bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lha rnams kyi/ /de nyid dang por bshad bya ste/ /drug cu tsho rtsa bzhi dpe 9byad yin/ /sum cu 1 rtsa bdun byang chub phyogs/ /lnga ni ye shes lnga yin te/ /dpa' bo gcig pa chos kyi dbyings/ /phyag mtshan sku mdog gzhan nas gsungs//gu phya'i rdo rje dril bu'i tshad/ /nas dang sor tshigs yin par 'dod/ /de nyid thabs dang shes rab yin/ /don dam nyid la dbyer med de/ /bsgom bya med de sgom 11pa med/ /bsgoms pas thob pa ci yang med/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis 79—635

bskyed du med/ /sems kyi gzhi tsho1la sku lnga dang / /ston pa med cing bstan pa med / /'jigs dang rnam rtog kun dang bral/ /de nyid bzhi pa'i de nyid do/ /dang po rlung gi de nyid de/ /srog rtsol tshonaganyis ni a dang haṃ/ /a ni chos rnams thog ma nas/ /ma skyes pa yi don yin no/ /haṃ ni gzung chos 'dzin gnyis kyis stong ske/ /ldang 'jug gsum ni sku gsung thugs/ /sems kyi gzhi dang sku lnga dang ske/ /rnam par thar dang stong pa dang / /de bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad sogs / /de dag rlung gi de nyid de/ /de nas thig le'i de nyid kyang / /nyi zla thabs dang shes rab ste/ /sngags kyi phreng ba mtshan dpe yin/ /thig le ye shes lnga rang bzhin/ /gnyis su med pa'i de nyid yin/ /phra mo la2)sogs gzhan nas shes/ /de nas 'og gi sgo dag ni/ /de nyid yang dag bshad bya ste/ /rtsa gsum sku gsung thugs ngo bor/ /rtsa lnga ye shes lnga yin no/ / tsaṇ+ḍa 'i55)ni nyi shu bzhi / /de nyid ye shes nyi shu bzhi/ /chos sku'i phrinam las nyi shu bzhi/ /kha sbyar thabs dang shes rab ste/ /'dzag dang 'bar ba gnyis med yin/ /'khor lo bzhi ni sku bzhi ste/ /drug ni de nyid drug yin te/ /sgrol ma rlung gi de nyid de/ /me ni gos dkar ngo bo nyid/ /bcu drug stong pa bcu drug yin/ /bzhi ni ye shes bzhi yin no/ /rnam par thar dang stong pa dang / /de bzhin mtshan dang dpe byad dang / /rig sngags snyoms 'jug phra ba dgu/ /ye shes lnga bcu la sogs pa/ /rtsa 'dab de nyid yin par nges/ /rtsa de gnas pa'i rim pa yang / /'khor lo ba thag khug pa las/ /g.yas g.yon sbrul ltar 'khril ba ste/ /phyi yi g.yas g.yon gzhu lta bu/ /gsum pa'i dbang gis 8/de nyid kyang / /sih+la shes rab chos dbyings te/ /ga pur thabs kyi ye shes bzhi/ /rtsa ni 'og min gnas 79wa 636

yin te/ /dga' ba mchog dga' byang chub phyogs/ /rang bzhin dga' ba chos sku ste/ /bral ba'i dga' ba gzugs sku gnyis/ /bcu drug stong pa bcu drug go//rgyud kyi tshul du sgyu ma tsam/ /gang zhig rang rig 'dod pas kyang / /dang por ngo bo7shes bya ste/ /de nas de nyid shes parasngosabya/ /gal te de nyid mi shes par / /zab mo'i lam nyid sgom byed na/ /'bras bu med cing brlag par nges/ /lha yi de nyid ma shes na/ /dur khrod gnas pa'i srin po 'dra/ /de bzhin dur khrod srin mo 'dra/ /spyod pa'i de nyid ma shes na/ /grong khyer 2ciganas pa'i smyon /pa pa 'dra/ /khyi phag srin po rak+ṣa 'dra/ /phyag mtshan de nyid ma shes na/ /brgya byin lag na mtshon thogs 'dra/ /phyag rgya'i de nyid ma shes na/ /rgyal po pangs 5nigi btsun mo 'dra/ /rlung gi de nyid ma shes na/ /brgya byin spyi bo'i dud pa 6)'dra / /rtsa yi de nyid ma shes na/ /tsan+dan shing gi sbrul sogs 'dra/ /lus kyi gnyer ma dag dang 'dra/ /lus kyi dri ma chu dang 'dra/ /thig le'i de nyid ma shes na/ /tsan+dan shing gi 'dzer 75pa 'dra/ /'khor lo'i de nyid ma shes na/ /brgya byin lag na 'khor lo 'dra/ /de bzhin srid pa'i 'khor lo 'dra/ /pad+ma'i de nyid ma shes na/ /'dam bu tshal gyi pad+ma 'dra/ /stug po'i de nyid ma shes na/ /mchod rten gyi ni 'khor lo 'dra/ /kha sbyor de nyid ma shes na/ /thal mo g.yas g.yon sbyar ba 'dra/ /gnas kyi de nyid ma shes na/ /'khor lo sgyur rgyal pho brang 'dra / /byang sems de nyid ma shes na/ /mi gtsang sgo yi lud pa 'dra/ /sih+la'i de nyid ma shes na/ /mtshon sogs las byung khrag dang 'dra/ /dga' ba'i 9de nyid ma shes na/ /smad 'tshong ma yi 1 'dod chags 'dra/ /spang bya'i de nyid ma shes na/ /grong khyer 11med pa'i rgyal po 'dra/ /gnyen po'i de nyid ma 79wa 637

shes na/ /rgyal po med pa'i grong khyer 'dra/ /rang rig de nyid ma shes na/ /'dus byas nam mkha' stong pa 'dra/ /gzhan yang de nyid bcwa 3)brgyad ni/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /thams cad sgyu ma'i tshul dang ni/ /mi lam glog dang sprin lta bu/ /de nyid shes na grol bar 'gyur/ /kye ho mgon po thugs rje che / /rang rig ye shes tshol ba la/ /rang dang gzhan gyi sde pa la/ /'di la khyad par med dam ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /khyad par chen po de nyid de/ /gzhan ni khyad par dbang bzhi dang / /de yi lam gyi de nyid brtags/ /chad pa bdag dang dbang phyug dang / /phya ldenadang byed pa po nyid las/ /rgyu sogs rgyud las khyad par 'phags/ /gang zag bdag dang bral ba'i phyir/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen dang / /rlung sogs chos kyi bdag gis bcings/ /dman dpa rnams kyi snang bas khyab / /theg chen rang bzhin lha yis khyad/ /rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po sogs/ /de nyid kyi ni khyad par che / /legs par bstan gyis legs par bzung 5/ /de nas 'khor thams cad dga' zhing yid rangs par gyur to/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' ye shes gsang ba'i de kho na nyid kyi rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs so6// //rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra mā la 7dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o// //79—638

༄lta /rgya gar skad du/ shrī dzñā na mā la tan+t+ra rā dza(snye/ bod skad du/dpal ye shes phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye lags gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /gsang ba bla na med pa yi/ /lta ba zhes pa gang gang (gelags/ /spyod pa gang dang gang lags pa/ /gtso bos bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /lta ba shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gdod nas spros bral lhun gyis grub/ /rang rig ye shes dbyings na gsal/ /ma rig mun pas bsgribs (4pa med/ /shes rab snying po rtser byung ba/ /lta ba kun gyi yang rtse yin/ /don dam rang rig ye shes la/ /blang ba med cing dor ba med/ /dman dang gya rnam gnyis ka med/ /bsgom pa po med bsgom bya med/ /dmigs med gnas su snying rje dang / /dmigs med gnas su shes rab gnyis/ /blo dang lhan cig (gegacig gyur pa/ /nam mkhar 79—641

nam mkha'i rang bzhin no/ /rang rig ye shes gang 'dod pas/ /mtshan ma'i rnam rtog 1bsgom pa min/ /dman pa rnams la skur mi gdabasno/ /de nyid la yang sgro mi gdags/ /dang por bskal par bsgoms pa dang / /rang rig skad cig thob pa gnyis/ /brgya stong la sogs char mi phod/ /dpe dang bgrang bar mi nus te/ /dper na mtsho dang rlabs rjes bzhin/ /dngos po sgomathong)pa bsgom pa min/ /dngos med sgom pa sgom 5pa min/ /dngos dang dngos med ro mnyam na/ /ma bsgoms na yang bsgoms pa nyid/ /bsgom dang mi bsgom 6gnyis ka med/ /'od gsal de la sems zin na/ /gzung 'dzin dgra yi dpung rnams 'joms/ /phyogs bcu 'jig rten khams bcas pa'i/ /dpa' bo mkha(ra 'gro mchod pa'i gnas/ /rab kyis mnyam gzhag 7)rjes thob spangs/ /'bring gis rjes thob stong par ltan/ /tha mas rjes thob sgyu mar lta' / /seng ge lta bu'i lta spyod ni/ /bzhi pa yin par nga yis gsungs/ /de nas spyod pa'i rgyal po bshad/ /spyod pa rnam pa gsum yin te/ /kun tu bzang po bhu nya su ku/ /a ba dhū tī gsum yin no/ /spyod pa'i dus dang gnas dang zas/ /gang zag dang ni dbye ba dang / /ngo bo dang ni tshad dang yang / /thabs dang dgongs pa dgos pa dang / /mkhas pas kun la sbyar bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rigs71dang rdo rje'e 12rigs/ /rin chen rigs dang pad+ma'i rigs/ /las kyi rigs dang spyod pa lnga/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa yin/ /sdom pa gsum la gnas pa dang ne/ /dkon mchog gsum ni 'dzin 1 pa dag /sangs rgyas kyi ni mchog gi spyod / /rdo rje dril bu nya phyag rgya 'dzin/ /bla ma 'dzin pa rdo rje'i spyod/ /dam tshig yid 'ong dus bzhi ru/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rin chen spyod/ /theg pa gsum 79—642

dang dam chos 'dzin/ /pad+ma gar gyi spyod pa yin/ /dam tshig thams cad ldan pa dang / /ma grol la sogs dgrol ba ni/ /rta yi rgyal po'i spyod pa yin/ /za ba nyal ba 'chag pa gsum/ /rnal 'byor chen pos gnas bya ste/ /g.yeng bas g.yeng ba spong ba ni(1)/ /bhu su ku yi spyod pa'o/ /rgyan 'chang ba dang bdud rtsi myang ske/ /phyag rgya bsten dang rnam pa gsum/ /a ba dhū tī'i 3spyod pa ste/ /rgyan la drug ste phyag rgya lnga/ /bdud rtsi bcu ste mi gtsang bas/ /mi gtsang 'khrud pa'i spyod pa'o/ /gnas ni kha na ma tho med/ /phyi nang g.yeng med gnas yin no/ /rtog pas 'joms pa slob pa'i dus/ /grub na rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i dus/ /thabs ni gzhan gyis mthong ba dang / /sgro dang skur pa med pa'o/ /dgongs pa gnyen 3po'i stobs yin techo / /rnyed dang bkur sti grags pa dang / /zug rngu'i kha zas ma yin te/ /bla ma'i dus thabs legs bsten blang / /kha zas rnam rtog chung ba yi / /las dang po yis bya bar gsungs/ /dbye ba gsum dang bye brag ni/ /gong du gsungs pa kho na'o/ /ngo bo rtog med sems de nyid/ /gtsang smes6'gags dang sprul pa ston/ /'di nyid 'grub pa'i tshad yin no/ /dgos 7pa la yang gnyis yod de/ /gtsang sme spang ba dgos pa las/ /dgos napa dngos la rnam pa bzhi/ /rang sems brtan g.yo brtag 9pa dang / /phyag rgya khyad par tshol ba dang / /des 'dul gang zag gzhug pa dang / /mi mos skur pa dgag pa'o / /gsang sngags rgyal ngo/'i lta spyod kyis/ /'khor gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 1 tshogs / /dus 1dang brgyal dang 'gyel gyur pas/ /dbugs dbyung ba yi 12ting 'dzin gyis/ /thams cad dran pa slar rnyed nas/ /thams cad mgrin gcig 'di skad gsol/ /dngos po ro mnyam gyur pa yi/ /lta ba 'di yang ngo 79wa 643

mtshar che/ /g.yeng bas g.yeng ba spangatub yi/ /spyodabapa 'di yang ngo mtshar che / /chos rnams stong par ro mnyam na/ /lta dang mi lta ga la yod/ /gtsang sme bdud rtsi ro gcig la/ /spyod dang mi spyod ga la yod/ /dbang bskur ba dang rdo rje 'dzin/ /mnyam gzhag rjesam thob ga la yod/ /thams cad sems kyi ngo bo la / /gzung dang 'dzin pa ga la yod/ /'jigs byed chen pos bka' stsal pal/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrib g.yogs kyis/ /rin chen sems ni dri can byas/ /zla ba rab rib sel byed de/ /mig gis rang gi rdul mi mthong / /sems kyis rinyade nyid ma rtogasashone par/ /tha dad gzung 'dzin sna tshogs 'dzin/ /de phyir lta ba'i rgyal po bstan/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib kyis/ /bdud rtsi'i de nyid ma shes te / /gtsang dang mi gtsang la sogs brtags / /de phyir spyod pa'i rgyal po bstan/ /gnas pa'i rkyen dang g.yeng ba'i rkyen / /de phyir zung 'jug rgyal po bstan/ /rkyen dang dbang po rab 'bring gis / /mnyam gzhag narjes thob rgyal po bstan/ /mi shes pa yi she/rab rib kyis / /'khrul pas gzung 'dzin gnyis su brtags/ /de phyir sems kyi rgyal po bstan / /lta spyod 'di la nan tan gyis/ /de nas thams cad dga' zhing mgu nas yi 1 rangs te/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod nas mi snang bar gyur to / /dpal ye shes phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po lta spyod zung du 'jug pa rdzogs theṭa31ske// //rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra mā la 1 dang / dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o // //79wa 644

sor bzhi phyi ru 'byung bar nges/ /'bring la sor gnyis tha ma la/ /sor dang nas kyi tshad kyis 'byung 3ri/ /sbom phra gzhan skyes phra mo tsam/ /dang posabya gdong nyid na gnas/ /rnam thar sor gnyis skye mched bzhi/ /stong pa bcu drug khams bcwa da brgyad/ /nyi shu lte bar nyi shu lnga/ /snying gsabaru ni gnas pa'o//sman la sogs pa kun ldang bas/ /drang sniba'i sbyor ba brtsam par bya/ /rnam snang sku rags bcing ba ri'u)dang / /rgyab yol dbul dang mchod pa dbul/ /gdan khri dbul dang sku khrus dbul/ /sman mchod dbul dang me mchod dbul/ /de nas reg bya'i mchod pa dbul/ /kun rdzob lce yi 7)rtse mo 'am/ /khro bo mdzub semo'i rtse mo la/ /bdud rtsi ril bus9legs byas te/ /mkhas pas reg bya'i mchod pa dbul/ /mngon du shes pa gdon mi za/ /bde ba chen po'i mchod pa yis / /khams gsum mchod pa gdon mi za/ /dar ram men tri sor bzhi'i tshad / /rked par ska rags 1 nodabul bar bya/ /sprul pa'i g.yas dang g.yon gnyis su/ /ras bal la sogs rgyab 31yol dbul/ /shing bu rigs dang mthun 32pa yin/ /sbom phra rigs kyi bdag po tsam/ /dri med sman dang snum ldan pa'i/ /zug rngu mi skyed mchod rdzas kyis/ /be+e ro tsa na'i lam du mchod/ /dri zhim chu yis khrus byas te/ /khrus kyis lus la mchod pa dbul/ /sman dang snum gyi phye ma yis / /sgo gnyis dag tu mchod pa dbul/ /shin tu dro ba'i me dag bis/ /gtum mo'i nyi me la mchod pa dbul/ /rked pa'i tshad mnyam ka ti ka /gdan khri bstab 7pa'i mchod pa dbul/ /de yis 'drongs par gdon mi za/ /de nas rgyas par bya ba yang / /gzhan ni gong dang 'dra ba ste/ /phyi nang 'dod pa'i mtshan ma kun/ /rgyas par byed pa'i las yin te/ /rgyas pa'i sbyor ba gsum 79wa 648

byas na/ /dper na me tog pad+ma bzhin/ /de nas dbye ba'i rim pa yang / /gong du gsungs pa thun mong71)ste/ /dus gsum lce yi rtse mos kyang / /bskyodaponan nges par〈kyekha 'byed do/ /de nyid gsum ni me rang bzhin/ /me 'bar ba yisho tshorkyen gyur pa/ /rlung nyid yin par gsungs pa ste/ /rkyen des me nyid 'bar bar bshad/ /gzhan yang rkyen gyi bye brag dang rin)/ /srog rtsol rlung ni dbu mar dgag /bum pa zhabs med rlung phul nas/ /sgo dgu phyi rol drag tu bud/ /lus kyi ngal dub cha mnyam ste46)/ /sbyor ba rdzogs na bde ba'i rkyen/ /bde ba las ni rdo rje 'chang / /bde ba yis ni bde ba 'grub/ /rgyu bde ba las 'bras bu bde/ /rgyu yi nang na 'di mchog la/ /'bras bu'i nang na 'di mchog go/ /de nas bde ba'i rkyen gyur pa/ /srid pa 7dgag dang rlung dgag pa/ /gnas nas gnas su rten gzung na/ste/ /g.yas brkyang bas ni ro ma dgag /dpa' bo g.yas nas mkha' 'gro g.yon/ /g.yon brkyang thobs ni rkyang ma ste/ /sa gas kun 'dar 1 ma ru gzung / /de bzhin zlum pos dbu mar gzung / /de dag kun gyi bye brag kyang / /dpa' bos g.yas dang gzhan gyis g.yon/ /de bzhin kun la sbyar bar bya11/ /gzhan yang gzung ba'i bye brag kyang / /dril can bu gu dgu lam gyis/na/ /rlung rgyu phyi ru bus byas te/ /rkang lag drag tu bsgrims byas na / /zin par 'di la the tsom med/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis/ /thun mong du ni bya bar gsungs/ /bai ro tsa na las kyi rlung / /gzhan yang lam brgyad rlung rnams dag /dang po nyid du bsdams 1 byas na/ /zin par 'di la the tsom med/ /dbye ba bsdam pa'i man ngag go/ /byed pa spel mar song gyur na / /mi zin pa la the tsom med/ /gnas gsum dag tu k+ṣa bsams te/ /79wa 649

dbugs gsum pa yis yar drangs te/ /lte ba'i gyen la drangs kyang zin/ /'di ni gang zag mchog gis yin/ /mdzes pa'i spyi bo de nyid la/ /gyen du bkan dang thur du bkan/ /drang por g.yas g.yon btsan thabs la/ /ka ti'i gzer ni btsan thabs gcig /sbom po khro mos mnan pa ste/ /bla ma'i zhal nas ma blangs na/ /lus kyi nad bzhi kun nas skye/ /chu 'gags ga17chu so spangs la sogs/ /lus smad nad sna nyi shu 'byung / /gzhan yang btsan thabs bcu gnyis ni/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /bla ma mnyes par bya ba'i phyir/ /lus srog longs spyod thams cad kyis/ /dus gsum maṇ+ḍal dang bcas mchod/ /lus srog btang bar phangs pa bas/ /man ngag dam pa de bas phangs de bas btsan 2thabs legs par sba/ /man ngag chu bo'i rgyun 'dra bas/ /de nyid rgyud du shes par bya/ /zab mo'i don ston rgyal por gsungs/ /rdo rje phag mo la sogs rnams/ /gsang ba'i gsang ba rmad byung 'di/ /khyod la gtad do dam du sbos/ /kun la spel na dam tshig nyams/ /kye ma rgyud kyi don 'di la/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma yis tshogs / /thams cad ngo mtshar cher skyes te/ /dga' zhing mgu nas yi 45rang ngo ske/ /dpal ye shes 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang ba las kyang cher tsigasang ba rmad du byung ba rdzogs so // // sing gha nala'i gling gi rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra k+ṣ-imā la 10dang / dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o// //73—650

bzhi dag /me yi phreng ba'i tshad yin no/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis bcwa 0)brgyad dag /ye shes rgyal po'i ldang rdogetshad do/ /bdun cu rtsa brgyad rkang pa phyed/ /chags pa'i rgyal po'i tshad yin no/ /tshigs su bcad ②pa nyi shu lnga/ /ye shes bsam pa'i ldang tshad do/ /dgu bcu go brgyad las byung ba/ /ye shes gsang ba'i tshad yin no/ /nyi shu thams (depa gang yin pa/ /gsang ba rdo rje rgyal po'i tshad/ /brgya dang nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni/ /rdo rje rgyal po ra li'i getshad/ /lnga bcu rtsa gsum yi ge bcu/ /dur khrod rgyan gyi ༅ldang tshad do/ /sum cu rtsa gsum yi ge ni/ /bcu drug mkha' 'gro ma sdom tshad/ /lnga bcu yi ge bcwa (7lnga las/ /byung ba gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgyal/ /bzhi bcu yi ge nyi shu bzhi/ /nyi ma'i 'khor lo'i gzhung tshad do/ /sum cu yi ge bcu drug las/ /byung ba zla ba'i phreng tshad do/ /de nas nges par ⑧bshad bya ste/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo gang ston pa/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje'i dam tshig dag /ston pa dam tshig chen por nges/ /dgra drug ston pa stobs po che/ /dbang bzhi dgag sgrub gsang ba gcod/ /rang rig de ston bsam mi khyab/ /yi ge gsum ston rin chen 'bar/ /sgo gsum lam ston nam mkha' mnyam/ /bcom ldan la sogs the com 79༄med/ /ston pa nam mkha' chen po ste/ /dbang bzhi'i de nyid gang ston pa/ /ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud du nges/ /lta spyod rmad du gang byung ba/ /ston pa ye shes phreng bar nges/ /gleng bslang rnam pa lnga yi don/ /ston pa mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud/ /he ru ka dpal gang ston pal/ /me yi phreng ba'i rgyud du grags/ /dbang gsum don ni gang ston pa/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ra lir nges/ /snod bcud rin chen ston byed pa/ /rin chen phreng ba'i ra lir nges/ /lhan cig ri skyes ston ye shes bsam/ / rdo rje rnyog pa 79—655
