༄ga /dpal rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/0))lhun /rgya gar skad du/ shrī rat+na dz+wa la tan+t+ra rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/dpal rin chen 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ dpal kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he he rdo rje snying po dang / /mkha' spyod ma la sogs pa dag /sgo gsum legs par bsdus nas ni/ /ra li chen po'i dbye ba nyon/ /la las byung ba thabs kyi rgyud/ /ra las byung ba shes rab rgyud/ /i phyis (ges las gnyis med rgyud/ /thabs ni sku ste shes rab gsung ri ri/ /gnyis med thugs su shes par bya/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin las/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi byung ba'o/ /a la la ho e ma'o/ /thabs ni la las ji ltar byung / /ra las shes rab ji ltar byung ske/ /a las gnyis med ji ltar byung / /sku gsung thugs su ji ltar 'gyur/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir ji ltar dbye/ /e ma'o mgon pos 445bshad du gsol/ /'jigs byed chen pos bka' stsal pa/ /a las a ba dhū tī ste/ /'di nyid las ni 73—659

gnyis ①med rgyud/ /'byung ba'i gnas dang rgyu ru brtags②/ /la las la la nā ②yi rtsa/ /de las thabs kyi rgyud byung ba'i/ /rgyu dang gnas dang ngo bor brtag /ra las ra sa nā ④yi rtsa/ /'di nyid las ni shes rab kyi/ /ra li 'byung ba'i rgyu dang gnas/ /ra ni chags phyir shes rab ste/ /shes rab yi ge bcu drug brdal/ /la ni nub phyir thabs yin te/ /thabs kyi yi ge bcu bzhi'i brdayi/ /thog ma nyid nas ma skyes pa/ /a ni gnyis med rang bzhin te/ /gnyis med blo yi spyod yul min/ /blo dang sgra ni kun rdzob phyir/ /g.yas ni thabs yin la la nāl/ /g.yon pa 2shes rab ra sa nāsti/ /a ba dhū tī gnyis su med/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med kyi/ /ra li'i ngo bo shes par bya/ /'dod chags rdul la lus ni thabs / /la la nā ༅ni sku yin te/ /gti mug mun pa ngag dang yang / /shes rab ra 0sa nā 8ni gsung / /zhe sdang snying stobs yid yin te/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'gyur ba'o/ /sku la brgyad de gsung la brgyad/ /thugs la brgyad de nyi shu bzhi/ / ra li 8nyi shu bzhi ru nges/ /gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / / tsaṇ+ḍa lī 8dang phyag dag dang / /mkha' 'gro 8'byung po nyi shu bzhi/ /de nyid brda 7ru nges pa ste/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye bas so/ /gnas dang mkha' 'gro ra li dbye/ /sku gsum du ni de nyid bsdu/ /dang por rgyud kyi nges pa dang //rgyu yi ⑩gnas dang gnas nges pa/ / gtad sa snyinges dang go rims 7nges/ /grangs nges rigs nges bcwa lngar du )nges/ /mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa yi/ /dman pa'i rim pa dang por gsung 0/ /dman pa sa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /de rjes rnal 'byor nyid yin te/ /skyes pa 'dul phyir rnal 'byor rgyud/ /phyi nas rnal 'byor ma rgyud ni/ /bud med yongs su gzung phyir ro/ /dang po rtsa ba'i 73—660

rgyud gsungs te/ /de nas bshad pa'i rgyud nyid do/ /de nas rgyud ni phyi ma'o/ /de rjes phyi ma'i phyi ma ste/ /rim pa bcu ni bskor ba ste/ /snod ngan dman pa'i rim pas gsungs/ /me tog snying po'i bcud bzhin du/ /phyi yi phyi nas bdud rtsi yi/ /ra li'i snying po snying po rgyud/ /dang por la las sku yi rgyud/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mas zhus nas/ /sku yi mkha' 'gro brgyad la gtad/ /de rjes ra las gsung gi rgyud/ /gsung gi mkha' 'gro brgyad la gtad/ /phyi nas a las thugs kyi rgyud/ /thugs kyi mkha' 'gro brgyad la gtad/ /gnyis med ye shes bdud rtsi'i ro/ /lus las lus gsal mig gi lus/ /gsal ba'i phyir na sgron ma ste/ /seng ge'i gzugs 'dra bdud rtsi'i ro/ /nyi ma'i 'od 'dra zla ba'i zer/ /'brug gi sgra 'dra rgya mtsho'i 0)gting / /chu bo'i rgyun la'adra ri rab lhun / /u dum bār 'dra'i ②zhing gi rdul/ /'di la 'dod 'dod tshol ba dang //rtog ge pa yis dpyad du med/ /gal te rang 'dod dpyad gyur na/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro khros gyur te/ /mgo lus tshal pa brgya ru 'gasaXge/ /de bas rang gi chung ma dang / /bu dang yul 'khor lus ngag gis/ /bla ma dam pa mnyes bya ste/ /chu bo'i rgyun 'dra'i man ngag blang / /kye ma'o (snyemagon po snying rje can/ /ra li'i dbye ba de ltar na/ /de yi chen po ji ltar lags/ /nang du nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /nges pa slar yang bdag la gsungs/ /rdo rje can gyis bka' stsal pa/ /ma spangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis/ /ra li 'di ni chen por nges re re la yang chen po bdun/ /gang zhig 'bras bu 'dod pa la/ /rgyu nyid gtso bor gyur pa ste/ /sā yilu las ni myu gu bzhin/ /de phyir dang po rgyu mi spang / /lhan cig skyes gnyis rgyu yin te/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa dang / /lhan cig lhan cig 73wa 661

skyes pa'o/ /thun mong dang ni thun mong min/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes bya'i phyir//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal yin te/ /de nyid ston pa'i bka' las 'das/ /de las 'khrul pa snying re rje/ /phung sogs rtsa dang shu kra ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyu yin te/ /log rtog 'khrul pa rgyur 'dod dang / /ngo bo ma grub rgyur 'dod dang / /kun rdzob byang sems rgyur 'dod pa/ /'di ni rmongs pa ma rungs pa/ /phung po 'byung ba dbang po dang / /phyi yi skye mched dman po'i ②rgyu//brtags pa rgyur 'dod snying re rje/ /nam mkha'i me tog gi dri gang / /rang bzhin gnas pa'i rtsa rlung sogs/ /khyad par lam gyi rgyu yin te/ /rang bzhin gnas pa ma shes par/ /log par rtogs pa snying rje nyams/ /don dam byang chub sems kyis ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rgyu/ /bla ma ma bsten ②de las 'khrul / /kun rdzob shu kra 55)rgyur 'dod pa/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu 'khrul pa'o/ /rkyen med rgyu yis 'bras mi 'byin/ /de phyir rkyen ni spang mi bya/ /ye shes rlung dang ye shes me/ /lhan skyes gnyis med rkyen yin te/ /de nyid spang bar mi bya zhing ske/ /las kyi rlung dang me nyid dang / /gzhan du'ang de nyid sbyar bar bya /srid pa len dang bde ba len/ /las mi spang zhing bde ba yang / /mi spang ba ni bzhi pa'o/ /lus dang lus kyi snying po'i (chos/ /gnas dang gnas chen mi spang ba / /lnga ba drug pa yin par 'dod/ /de nyid phyi dang nang du shes/ /phyi ni dbye ba ma spangs pa'o/ /snang ba dang ni mun pa'i cha/ /gang ba dang ni stong pa'i cha/ /'pho ba ma spangs brgyad pa'o/ /rgyu yi gnas dang 'bras bu'i gnas/ /de nyid mi spang shes par bya/ /rin po che yi zhepho brang du/ /rten ni mi spang shu kra gzung tshone/ /gal te de ru ma 97)zin na/ /shor ba mi spang ro mar bstim/ /79—662

gnyen po mi spang gzugs sku gnyis/ /ma spangs pa ni bcu gnyis pa'o/ /nor bu'i rten las skyes pa yi/ /bde ba la rten dbang po yi/ /sgo bsdu ngo bo ma spangs pa'o/ /gong 'og khyad par shes byas nas/ /sgyu mas gnyen po ma spangs pa'o / /dga' ba mchog dga' shes byas te/ /sngon du 'gro ba ma spangs pa'o/ /'khor ba lugs las bzlog bya ste/ /gnas nas gnas su zlog nya)byed pa/ /gnas kyi khyad par ma spangs pa'o/ /de nyid rim par 'pho gebyed pa/ /bla ma'i bla ma las brgyud shes/ /'khor ba 'jug ldog bye brag ni/ /'pho ba ma spangs rnam pa gnyis/ /ye shes me ni cher 'bar bas/ /phung po 'byung ba dbang po sogs / /thams cad bdud rtsir (5༄gyur pa ni/ /rkyen gyi khyad par ma spangs pa'o / /lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga dang / /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po kun/ /bde ba'i ngo bor gang snang ba/ /ngo bo'i khyad par ma spangs pa'o/ /de nyid sgyu ma'i rang bzhin med/ /gnyen po'i khyad par ma spangs pa'o/ /bzhin mdzes mig yangs phyag rgya ni/ /ldan pa phyag rgya 94)ma spangs pa'o/ /dam tshig chos kyi phyag rgya dang / /de nas ye shes phyag rgya che/ /phyag rgya'i tsho khyad par ma spangs pa'o / /chags pa'i phyag rgya las yin te/ /dam tshig chos ni ma ning gi/ /phyag rgya gnyis su shes par bya/ /ye shes phyag rgya chen po gnyis/ /grol ba'i phyag rgya yin par 'dod/ /phyag rgya'i dbye ba ma spangs pa'o/ /dang por gsang ba'i 'khor lor te/ /phyi nas rang bzhin 'khor lor yin/ /'khor lo'i dbye ba ma spangs pa'o/ /dang por gsang ba'i gtum mo ste/ /gnyis par rang bzhin gtum mo ni/ /gtum mo'i dbye ba ma spangs pa'o/ /las kyi rlung dang me gnyis ni / /kun rdzob 'khor ba'i rkyen yin te/ /ye shes rlung dang me gnyis ni/ /79—663

don dam gnyis med rkyen yin te/ /rkyen gyi dbye ba ma spangs pa'o/ /srid pa bskyed ①cing 'dzag pa bde/ /kun rdzob shu kra'i las yin no/ /srid pa mi len rang rig skyes/ /don dam byang ②sems las yin no/ /las kyi dbye ba ma spangs pa'o/ /sbyor thabs rtsa ni rgyas pa dang / /kha 'byed pa yi nilas yin te/ /sbyor thabs bzhi la ma rmongs pa/ /'di ni ma spangs nyi shu brgyad/ /spyi mthun dulas las grub pa yi/ /mi drug la sogs grangs kyis bstan/ /rang rig ye shes gang 'dod pas/ /bla ma'i dus thabs legs bsten ⑤te/ /mi spang nges pa'i gdams 4)ngag blang / /'di nyid rdo rje 'chang gi rgyu/ /de las byung ba khyad par 'bras / /dang por cha ste thig le dang / /tshul dang tshul can mchog gzhan mchog /'di nyid de nyid drug yin te/ /de nyid drug ni tsaṇ+ḍa snyisti/ /re re la yang bzhi bzhi ste/ / tsaṇ+ḍa lī (2)ni nyi shu bzhi/ /ra li nyi shu rtsa bzhir nges/ /phyi ru gnas ni nyi shu bzhi/ /spyan dang phyag rgya 6)nyi shu bzhi/ / tsaṇ+ḍa lī 0dang ra li yi / /phyi dang nang du grangs su nges/ /he he dpa' bo ༅rdo rje 'chang / /ra li'i the 'byung ba'i rgyu gang lags/ /ra li'i nyustengo bo gang gang lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sku dang phyag mtshan rags skipa kun/ /ra li'i ngo bo dman pa'i lam/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod sa 'og spyod/ /sgo gsum la gnas khyad par gyi/ /ra li'i ngo bor gsungs pa yin/ /dga' ba bcu drug rten dang bcas / /zab pa'i ra li'i ngo bor brtagasatshi/ /rang rig stong pa thabs dang bcas / /mthar thug ra lir shes par bya/ /a ni thog mar ma skyes pa/ /la ni nub dang skyong ba ste/ /ra ni chags dang rin po che/ /ra las 'dod chags khrag yin te/ /la las zhe sdang khu ba'o/ /a las gti mug khu ba ste/ /sems can 79—664

ra li'i rang bzhin te/ /ye shes lnga dang sa bcu sogs/ /kun la ldan pas ra lir gnas/ /sku yi ra li spyi bo yi/ /gtsug tor dag las byung ba'o/ /gsung ni ljags kyi dbang po las/ /thugs kyi ra li thugs ka 3)nas/ /byung ba rnam par nges pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje yi(kye/ /spyan rnams la ni rim bzhin byung ske/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gnas la ste(9/ /spyi bo la sogs dag las byung / /phyag gi mthil nas rim pas byung / /bla ma'i zhal nas blang ④bar bya/ /bye brag 'byung ba'i sgo yin te/ /he he sems can sangs rgyas kyi/ /rang bzhin sa dang lam ldan te/ /zla ba bcu sogs sa sogs ni/ /brdzus skyes la sogs ji ltar lags / /'on te sangs rgyas min nam ci/ /sems can thams cad gdod (zhedam nas / /sangs rgyas yin par gsungs pa ste/ /brdzus (6༄skyes sgong skyes drod gsher sogs/ /sems kyi gnas bcu sa bcu ste/ /rnam shes brgyad ni byang chub lnga/ /mkhan po sems kyi rgyal po ste/ /rang bzhin dag pa chos gos yin/ /rang bzhin gnas pa kha spu bregs/ /a dang haṃ gnyis sngags kyi don/ /thams cad (pesems la gnas pa ste/ /sems med sangs rgyas ma yin te/ /ngam grog la sogs bems po yi/ /sems nyid sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ /sems can sangs rgyas rang bzhin no/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul dang yang / /bag la nyal dang kun tu rgyu/ /nus pa'i tshul dang mngon sum tshul/ /gzugs can gzugs med mkhas pas brtags(she/ /sangs rgyas sems can de bzhin no/ /de ltar sems can sangs rgyas pas/ /ra li sems can rang bzhin phyir/ /lus la sku yi phyag rgyas gdab/ /ngag la gsung gi phyag rgyas gdab/ /sems la thugs kyi phyag rgyas gdab/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du/ /dngos po ro mnyam 79—665

0421༄ga /dpal ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/0)༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ shrī tshwa na rā dza tan+t+ra rā dza.e/ bod skad du/dpal ye shes rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/kye ma sangs rgyas kye sangs rgyas/ /kye ma sangs rgyas mdzad ②pa legs/ /gang phyir sems can thams cad kyis/ /mya ngan 'das pa thob bya'i phyir/ /dad dang brtson 'grus rdzogs byas te/ /bla ma'i rjes su 'jug par bya/ /rang rig gnyis su med pa la/ /gzhan rig gnyis su 'dzin pas 'khrul/ /gzod banas ma skyes ma grub la/ /skye dang grub par 'dzin pas 'khrul/ /dngos po ro mnyam gyur pa la/ /dman dang gya rnam 'dzin pas 'khrul/ /'khor ba yongs su shes pa nyid/ /mya ngan 'das par brjod pa la/ /sangs rgyas sems can rtog pas 'khrul / /rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa la/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis skye bas 'khrul/ /brda 5dang tha snyad bral ba la/ /blo yi spyod yul byed pas 'khrul/ /mtha' bral 79wa 674

dbu stimar gnas pa la/ /rtag dang chad par 'dzin pas 'khrul/ /shes brjod yul las 'das pa la/ /bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pas 'khrul/ /dngos po mtshan ma la sogs pa'i/ /rnam rtog ②kun gyis stong pa la/ /dngos por rjes su 'dzin pas 'khrul/ /rang nyid gnyis su med pa la/ /bden pa gnyis su 'dzin pas 'khrul/ /gdul bya sna tshogs 'dul ba yi/ /theg pa du ma'i gong 'og la/ /sgro dang skur ②pa 'debs pas 'khrul/ /sems can 'khrul pa sna tshogs kyis/ /las kyi ④rnam smin la sogs la/ /lta bas skur pa 'debs pas 'khrul / /rang rig gzod ⑤nas 'od gsal la/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan la sogs pa/ /rdo rje 'dzin par 'dod pas 'khrul/ /'khrul pa dang ni 'khrul pa'i gzhi/ /'dod chags 'dod chags chen po ste/ /'khrul gzhi kha'akhrul pa las 'das na/ /'dod chags chen po bcom ldan 'das/ /zhe sdang zhe sdang chen po dang ge/ /de bzhin zhe sdang bcom ldan 'das/ /gti mug gti mug chen po ste/ /de bzhin gti mug bcom ldan 'das/ /'di yis nges par grol 'gyur gyis / /'di spangs gzhan gyis grol ba min/ /bdag po lha dang bla ma spun / /bdag po lhan cig rnal 'byor tsam/ /theg pa spyi bsdus de las gzhan/ /skye bo'i bems po cha dang brgyad/ /de dag rang rig thob pa'i rgyu/ /de phyir dam tshig gtso bor bsrung / /'bras bu'i khyad par rang rig 'byung / /kye ma mgon po kye sangs rgyas/ /'dod chags dbye ba de ltar na/ /de yi ngo bo ji ltar lags / /zhe snang la sogs de dang 'dra/ /rdo rje snying po snying rje che/ /legs par nyon la yid la zung / /las dang las kyi rnam smin gyi/ /rgyu 'bras mi shes gti mug ste59/ /lus sems kun nas 'khrug 7pa dag /zhe sdang yin te sgo 79—675

gsum gyis/ /kun nas bslang ste ①rnar bu'i mthar/ /sa bon 'byung ba 'dod chags so/ /dbang sogs ngo bo gang las shes/ /'dod chags la sogs chen por nges/ /rang rig ngo bo gang la gnas/ /'og ma spong ba'i gnyen po ste/ /ngo bor ༅sgyu mar gang shes dang / /dbang po'i sgo bsdus thabs yin no/ / gong ma ②skye ba'i rgyur ④'gyur ba'i/ /phyir yang chen por gyur pa ste/ /gzhan gyi don du gyur pa dang / /de las gzhan dag mos 'gyur dang / /mang po mi mos spong ba dang / /nyon mongs spyi yis zil ma non/ /bye brag 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs / /zil gyis mi non 'og ma yi/ /rnam rtog gang yang mi skye dang / /nyon mongs spyi dang bye brag spong / /gnyen po yin par nges pa dang / /nyon mongs skra rtse tsam mi skye/ /gnyis ni gong dang 'dra ba ste/ /bcu gnyis 3)'dod chags chen po dag /bcom ldan 'das su gsungs pa ste/ /zhe sdang la sogs de bzhin no/ /zab mo'i lta spyod ma rtogs par/ /sngags spyod bzlas pa la sogs byed / /de dag ngal ba don med yin/ /de dag bla ma dam pa las/ /man ngag dam pa btsal bya ste/ /'khrul pa dang 6)ni 'khrul gzhi 3/las/ /sad par byed pa'i cho ga blang / /de'i tshe rgyud kyi don la dga' zhing rjes su yi rangs par 9shesagyur to/ /dpal ye shes rgyal po zhes bya ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs so9ḍa // //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga 1 7ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o//79wa 676

༄ga /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/①༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ḍā ki (2dgu h+ya tan+t+ra rā dza / bod skad du / dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye ho mngon rdzogs mgon po kye/ /dbang rnams dam pa yod dam ci/ /gtso 'khor khyad par med dam ci/ /sems can dang ni sangs rgyas la / /bye brag tha dad med dam ci/ /dam tshig che chung ji ltar mchis/ /de nyams bshags thabs yod dam ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rnam rtog gzung 'dzin dgag pa dang / /rang rig ye shes blugs ④pa'i phyir/ /dbang rnams sgyu ma tsam du yod/ /rnal 'byor sems kyi ngo bo ru/ /dbang ni nges pa kho na ste/ /lus ngag kun nas bzang ba la/ /de phyir sems kyi dri ma ni//'khrud dang gtor dang sreg 9napa dang / /mkhyen pa'i rten dang go (zhe'abyed pas/ /sa dang chu dang me dang rlung / /nam mkha' lta bur gsungs pa ste/ /dang po 79wa 678

gnyis pa gsum pa dag / rim gyis 3)ma bgrod dbang mi thob/ /bskyed pa'i rim la ②legs gnas shing / /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs 'di rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsung ②/ /gang zag mchog dang las dang po/ /mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa dang / /mngon par rtogs pa'i yan lag go/ /'di yis ngan 'gro srid las ④grol/ /dbang dang man ngag 'brel pas so/ /de nas bzhi pa zhal gyi dbang / /sngon du 'gro dang mi 'gro med/ /'di ni dbang gi rgyal po ste/ /slob dpon sems kyi rgyal po yin / /'di ni rang rig bzhi pa'i dbang / /'di yis thams cad grol bar 'gyur / /'di la rtag tu phyag sogs bya/ /rdo shing 'dra 'bag la sogs pa'i/ /gzugs brnyan ⑤yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /ras dang tshon la sogs pa yiyi/ /gzugs brnyan yongs su rdzogs pa la/ /byin brlabs ye shes dbab byas nas/ /lha yin zer nas mchod sogs te/ /bcos ma la sogs de ltar na/ /phung sogs ye nas sangs rgyas la/ /ci yi phyir na mchod mi byed/ /de nas gzhan yang dbye ba dag /'khrul pa dang ni 'khrul pa'i gzhige/ /bcos ma nye bar bcos ma dang / /'dra ba yin pa lta bu yi/ /dbang bzhis grol bar mi 'gyur te / /log pa'i sred pas srid par 'ching / /'khrul pa'i 'khor los 'khor bar 'khor/ /de bas dngos grub (de'adod pas kyang / /lha yi bu yi bdud spangs tso)te/ /bla ma dam pa rtag tu bsten/ /yid ches rigs dang nges pa skye/ /lung gi tshad ma yin pa dang / /'og ma spangs shing gong ma thob/ /man ngag tshad ma yin pa blang / /mos pa'i rjes su 'brang byed cing / /che ba'i nga rgyal la gnas shing / /'jig rten lta spyod dang 'dres pa'i/ /snod bcud blang bar mi 79—679

bya'o / /de nas gtso 'khor bye brag kyang / /gnas kyi khyad par dbus su ste/ /rgyan gyi khyad par thal ba'o/ /rigs kyi khyad par drug pa'i rigs/ /de nas gtso 'khor bye brag kyang / /phyag dang zhabs sogs khyad par gyis/ /gtso bo 'khor las khyad par 'phags/ /dper na pha rol phyin drug las/ /shes rab pha rol phyin med na/ /pha rol phyin pa lnga dag gis/ /pha rol phyin pa'i ming mi thobarka/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gang gnas pa'i/ /de nyid kyi ni dkyil 'khor tenya)ske/ /gang zhig dbus su mi gnas na/ /'khor rnams dkyil 'khor du mi 'gyur / /dper na rgyal po med pa yi/ /grong dang grong khyer ji bzhin no/ /de bzhin dam tshig bye brag kyang / /rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /yan lag dam tshig de dang 'dra/ /thugs kyi dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /sku gsung dam tshig de dang 'dra/ /srog gcod dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /brdzun dang ma byin len pa dang / /'dod chags dam tshig de dang 'dra/ /lta ba'i dam tshig nyams gyur na/ /spyod pa'i dam tshig de dang 'dra/ /tshul 'chos mi dge mos pa tsam/ /dam tshig nyams pa de dang 'dra/ /dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po dang / /bral ba'i ②rin chen bdun po de dag gis/ /'khor los sgyur niba'i ming ni mi thob bzhin/ /bla ma'i zhal nas thams cad shes par bya/ /de nas sangs rgyas sems can yang / /rdul tsam khyad par med mod kyang / /rang rig gzhan ④rig rkyen dag dang / /rang sems las su rung ba dang / /ma rung pa (snyedang las kyi mtha'/ /log pa dang ni ma log pa/ /don byed nus dang mi nus pa/ /yongs su rdzogs dang ma rdzogs pas/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis su snang / /tha dad par ni mi brtag 76ste/ /chu khams gser dang nam mkha' bzhin/ /rang 73—680

bzhin gyis ni dag par 'dod/ /rang sems rang gis rtogs pa na/ /sems can gdod nas sangs rgyas so/ /rdo rje phag mos yang zhus pa/ /srog gcod la sogs dam tshig gi/ /dbye ba khyed ①kyis bdag la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rang gi lus ngag sems g.yos kyang / /gsod pa'i 'du shes ma skyes na/ /srog gcod nyams pa chung ngur nges/ /gzhan gyis gnod par tshor ba dag /nyams pa 3)'bring du gsungs pa yin/ /de las bzlog pa chen por nges/ /gang zhig ma byin chung blangs kyang / /gzhan la nyon mongs cher skyes na/ /de nyid nyams pa 'bring du nges/ /cher blangs nyon mongs chung na 'bring / /chen po las ni nyon mongs cher/ /de ni chen po kho nar nges/ /tshul 'chos ltung ba chen po ste/ /mi shes pa dang bag med dag /brjed ngas sel sogs 'bring du gsungs/ /gzhan yang dam tshig nyams pa yi/ /che 'bring chung ngu'i ldang tshad dag /rang dang gzhan dang gnyi ga 4yis/ /rgyu rkyen dag las shes bya ste/ /ltung ba'i ngo bos zin pa dang / /phyi nang rdo rje slob dpon gyis(she/ /spyan sngar dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs(6na/ /tshul dang mthun (7stepar bshad pa (na bya/ /dam tshig gong 'og bye brag gis/ /bla ma'i dkyil 'khor shes par bya/ /gzhan yang bshags pa'i bye brag la/ /sbyin sreg (9rigis ni sdig bsreg tshephyir/ /nang gi sbyin sreg nyu1chen po brtsam/ /zab pa'i me ni rgyun gzhag nyonamedanyusnyem/ /thabs kyi rgyun gzhag 1 me yin te/ /lo bdun dang 12ni lo gcig dag /phyi yi rgyun gzhag tshechen po'i me/ /zla ba bdun dang gsum dag ni/ /'bring du gsungs te zhag bdun sogs/ /rgyun gzhag 51 tshome ni chung ngur gsungs/ /rgyas pa la sogs de bzhin te/ /rang bzhin gdod nas gnas pa yi/ /gtum mo ye 79—681

shes me rang bzhin/ /'di ni rgyun gzhag chen po'i me/ /thog mtha' med par gnas pa'i phyir/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i bud shing sogs/ /ye shes me yi bud shing yin/ /man ngag can gyis bsregs byas na/ /nyams pa'i shing sogs 'tshig par nges/ /dgang shigazar la sogs de bzhin te/ /rgyas pa la sogs de dang 'dra/ /rgyud 'di gtad kyis legs par zung / /thams cad dga' zhing mgu bar gyur/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs theṭa(mi // //rgya gar gyi mkhan po gā ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/678 tshematshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ga ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉tsā/ pa)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉lugs/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ⑥〈〈khu 〉〉sgo/679 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rims kyis/ 〈〈li 〉〉rims gyis/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉pa/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gsungs/ngas〈〈co 〉〉pas/ 2〈〈g.yung 〉〉bsnyan/ tsho6〈〈g.yung 〉〉pa'i/ (3)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhi/ 2〈〈li 〉〉'grub/⑨〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉spang / 68 ①〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ste/ 92)〈〈g.yung 〉〉ba ri/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsgyur/ sbyong)〈〈g.yung 〉〉bzhan/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rungs pa/ tsho67〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rtag681 1)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉khyod/ (0〈〈g.yung 〉〉ste/ ( ni〈〈khu 〉〉nges/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gnyis ga〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gnyi 1 955〈〈g.yung 〉〉slo dpon gyi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉slob dpon gyi/ ༅〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gzhengs/(3)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉'thun/ po)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉par/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsregabo〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sreg nya1〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg 32〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag nyunye〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉me/8〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag me〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dag ⑩⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag682 4)〈〈g.yung 〉〉de gang / 95)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sto/79wa 682
683bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (38)

༄ga /dpal gsang ba me 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/tsho sheX༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ shrī dz+wa la asdi gu h+ya (snyetan+t+ra rā dza / bod skad dul/ dpal gsang ba me 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ bcom ldan 'das bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la snyoms par bzhugs 2so/ /de'i tshe 'khor 'dus pa'i nang na rdo rje phag mos gsol pa/ rnal 'byor gang lags 'pho ba gang / /'chi ba gang lags shi ba gang / /ro ni gang lags ro chen gang / /de bzhin shi ba chen po gang / /thal ba gang lags thal chen gang / /tsha tsha gang lags tsha tsha yi//chen po 75gang lags gnas ni gang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /thabs dang shes rab snyoms 'jug lagye//rnal 'byor zhes ni gsungs pa yin/ /dus min lha ni gsod pa ste/ /dang por 79wa 684

'pho ba'i rtags dang yang / /dus tshod nges par shes bya ste/ /bar chad med pa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /'khrul 'khor bcas te khyad par gyis②/ /'bras bu 'byung bar 'pho bar nges/ /khams dang 'byung ba so sor thim/ /srog gi rtsol ba la thim ste/ /rtsol ba rnam shes la thim pa'i/ /skad cig dang po 'chi ba ste/ /rdo rje can sogs rigs bzhi dang / /rnam snang tha dad bral ba yi/ /skad cig dang po shi ba ste/ /de nas zhag bdun bar du gzhag /lus kyi mkha' 'gro mya ngan 'das/ /de ni ①shi ba chen por grags/ /lus ni ta la'i mgo bo 'dra/ /'di nyid ro zhes gsungs pa ste/ /ye shes dbab dang ye shes brtan/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod sa 'og spyod/ /spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga byaru/ /dri yi thig le gsum byas te/ /sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab/ /thog mar dri zhim sna tshogs kyis / /khrus byas gnas ni bcu gnyis su/ /dri yi thig le bcu gnyis bya/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin gyis brlab/ /gzhan yang rgyan ⑤la sogs pa kun/ /dngos su gnas pas rab tu nges/ /ri mor bris pa 'bring po ste/ /dri yi thig le tha mar nges/ /g.yas brkyang la ⑥sogs 'dug stangs kyis/ /he ru kur grags chen por bzhengs/ /rang rig ⑦bdag po gang yin pal/ /ho ru ka ru nges pa dang / /de la dus drug mchod pas mchod/ /'di dag ro ni chen po ste/ /'chi ba zhes ni rnam rtog ste/ /mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid ⑨par byed/ /rang bzhin bsregs pa thal ba ste/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten ⑩nas/ /chos sku gzugs brnyan 0rim bzhin brtsig /yang na bum pa lta bu yi/ /gzhal yas ⑫khang pa brtseg mar brtsigatso /mi 'chi bcu phyed snying po dang / /tsan+dan gur kum ④la sogs pa'i/ / dri yis byugs shing bsgo bar bya/ /tsan+dan dmar po la sogs 79—685

pa'i / /97dri zhim ldan pa'i shing bu 'am/ /yang na 'bras bu yod pa yi/ /bud shing tshad dang mthun ②pa yis/ /thab khung chen por rdzogs par brtsig /bla ma dam pa mnyes byas la/ /zhal nas yang dag shes par bya/ /zur bzhi rgyal po chen po bzhi/ /phyogs bzhi mi 'jigs seng ge brgyad/ /ka ba bzhi dang gdung bzhir ldan/ /cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /rig pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhug ①pa dang / /sngar gyi dbang thob rdzogs par bskur/ /de nas rgyun gzhag (geme sbar te/ /me lha la sogs gzhan dang 'dra/ /de nas rig pa de nyid kyang / /me (5)yi khang pa mdzes pa 〈peru/ /rang bzhin spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol/ /me mchod 97)sdig pa bsreg pa yi/ /sngags dang rdzas sogs gzhan dang 'dra/ /me dang du ba rlung sogs kyis)/ /mtshan ma mkhas pas brtag bya ste/ /bkra shis rtags rnams byung na legs/ /med na sdig pa bsreg par bya/ /dung la sogs pa byung na rab/ /ma byung na yang cho ga rnams/ /rdzogs pa las byung rus pa rnams / /'di ni thal po)ba chen po ste/ /de las gzhan pa 7thal bar gsungs/ /de nas rus pa zhag gsum ni/ /gur kum la hunyesogs dris gtor te/ /rus pa'i mtshan ma brtag bya ste/ /kha dog dbyibs dang dri dang ro/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /gdon bsal khrus bya rus pa brdung / /ma nyams dum bu gcig pa la/ /dri sogs bsgos pa'i nang du ste/ /dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /steng du seng ge'i khri dag la/ /seng ge rgyal chen 'og gi rgyanahurte/ /steng nas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan te/ /gnas der rus pa gzhag hu byas la/ /me tog byas nas zhag lnga ru/ /bsnyen 6pa byas te drug pa la/ /gdung byung sta gon bdun pa la/ /tsha tsha rab tu gnas par bya/ /dang por ro bsregs mdus 79—686

su yang / /shi ba dang po nas bzung ①ste/ /zhag lnga ro yi bsnyen pa ste/ /drug pa ro yi sta gon no/ /bdun (mig dur khrod rab tu gnas/ /dang por snang ba gnyis par ro/ /gsum pa rus pa mya ngan 'das/ /mya ngan 'das pa rnam pa gsum / /gzhan la med cing rang la med/ /dman la med cing de rjes med/ /thabs su ma gsungs shes rab kyi/ /rtsa rgyud ②bshad rgyud phyi ma dang / /phyi ma'i phyi mar ma gsungs pa'o/ /mya ngan 'das pa rnam pa gsum/ /bdud rtsi sgron ma ra li yi/ /rgyud du khyod la nga yis bshad/ /de nas tsha tsha'i rim pa yang / /snang ba rgyal po la sogs la/ /mthun ④pa'i gtam gyis sa sogs blang / /mi snang sa bdag la sogs la/ /gtor ma me yis sa sogs blang / /de nas skud pa rnam lnga yang / /phan pa rdo rje can dang yang / /gzi brjid gar dang rdo rje rgyal / /srad bus sa gzung sa sbyang sogs/ /cho ga gzhan dang mthun (nyepar bya/ /dur khrod gnas su rtsa ba yi/ /dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs par bya lha grangs du yod gtor ma gtang / /sbyin sreg gyedag gis zhi byas te/ /gcig gam lnga 'am bdun nam ni/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig brgya rtsa brgyad/ /ci nus par ni gdab par bya/ /dus ni mtshan mo shes pa ste/ /dang po la ni 9)dkyil 'khor gyis(de / /phyag rgya chen po rdzogs pa ste/ /gsum pa bzhi pa gnyis pa dag /chos kyi sku yi gzugs brnyan gdab/ /bum dbang sa la gdab pa ste/ /gsang dbang sa dang chu la gdab/ /gsum pa me dang rlung la gdab/ /bzhi pa nam mkhar gsungs pa'o/ /dang po 'pho bas ma lhung la/ /gnyis pa ro bsreg ma lhung ba'o/ /gsum pa tsha tshas ma lhung na/ /'chi ba slu skyiba'i dam pa ste/ /srid pa'i 'chi ba las grol nges/ /dman pa'i 'pho ba la sogs pas/ /lhung zhing 79—687

'chi ba kho nar nges/ /de bas srid las grol 'dod pas/ /bla ma dam pa rab mnyes te/ /'pho ba la sogs gdams stingag blang / /rgyud 'di gtad kyis ②legs par zung ①/ /de'i tshe 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa chen po yang g.yos par gyur to/ /mchod pa sna tshogs pa'i char yang bab bo/ /dpa' bo dang byamakha' 'gro ma dang dur khrod na gnas pa'i ro langs chen po thams cad rgyud kyi don la rjes su yi rangs par ⑤gyur to/ /dpal gsang ba me 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs so༅// //paṇ+ḍi ta ga ④ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis dubasgyur ba'o // //bsdur mchan/684 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ag ne gu h+ya ya/②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dz+ra/ ④〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉zhugs/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉pos/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa/685 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gyi/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉nas/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉kha/⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉brgyan/ ⑥〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉las/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gi/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉pa'i/6)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉khrid/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rten/ /0〈〈g.yung 〉〉brnyen/ ⑩〈〈li 〉〉g.yas/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉brtseg ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉gum/686 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 driyis la sogs pa'i/ / 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dri yis byugs shing bsgo mar bya/ /tsan la sogs pa'i/ / ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'thun/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhug ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉mi/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉pu/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉mched/ ni〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉kyis/⑨〈〈li 〉〉bal/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉sa gzhan la/ 〈〈pe 〉〉thos gzhan la/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉gum las/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉gum la/ 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉brgyan/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhag ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉brnyen/7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sreg687 4)〈〈li 〉〉gzung / ②〈〈khu 〉〉mdun/ ②〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉brgyud/ ④⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'thun/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉79wa 688

tshog /dpal gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/07༄༄na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī a mṛ 2ta gu h+ya tan+t+ra rā dza0/ bod skad du/dpal gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ bcom ldan 'das dpal bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ dkyil 'khor dbye ba ji lta bu/ /sngags dang gtor ma ji lta bu//sbyin sreg ④rimachod 5sogs ji lta bu/ /khyod kyis bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang po dkyil 'khor dbye ba yang / /phyi la gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor te96/ /nang du lus kyi dkyil 'khor ro/ /gsang bar bha ga'i dkyil 'khor te/ /bzhi pa rang rig 'byang chub sems/ /de rnams lha yi mtshan nyid kyang / /sku mdog phyag mtshan rags pa'i lam/ /khro 79wa 690

tshul drug cu stim bzhi dang / /'bar ba'i gar dgu phyag rgya ②drug /mtshan nyid sgyu ma lta bu yis/ /tha mal pa yi rnam rtog spong / /lus kyi dri 'khru zhe sdang dag /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur gyur pa'o/ /'di dag phyi yi dkyil 'khor te/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gang gyur pa/ /de nyid kyi ni dkyil 'khor te/ /rdo rje can dang phan pa dang / /de bzhin rdo rje gzi brjid dang / /pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin rta bdun rdo rje sems/ /snying po yongs gzung edakyil 'khor te/ /de dag phyi yi dkyil 'khor yin/ /de nas nang gi dkyil 'khor yang / /rnal ④grol steng du gdan khri rlung / /rang rig ⑤bdag po'i lha yin no/ /dang por de nyid shes bya ste/ /rags pa dang ni phra ba dang / /zung 'jug sgo gsum nyi khri dang / /chig stong drug brgya rgyu ba btsam/ /las ni rags pa'i lam 'joms shing / /ngag gi dri 'khru gti mug dag /sprul pa'i sku yi rgyur gyur pa/ /mkha' spyod rlung du shes par bya/ /gang zhig snang ba bsgom pa dang / /de bzhin mun pa bsgom pa dag /nyin dang mtshan mor rab tu grags/ /gnod mdzes lta stangs dman pa ste/ /tshul de de las bzlog pa'o/ /dang por yid bcing sna rtser bya/ /de bzhin sems bcing (0rlung bcing yang / /nam mkha' sor bzhi de nas stong / /de nas bar du thig le yang / /yan lag dang bcas yan lag med/ /shin tu yan lag ༷8)med pa ste/ /yan lag bcas pa bcu gsum yonyeste/ /thabs la thabs kyi 7sbyor ba ni/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /ma ning 'dus huXpa'i sgo ru gsungs/ /de nas 'og sgor tsaṇ+ḍa lī'i/ /kha sbyor dang ni stug po sogs/ /rkyen dang bcas dang rang bzhin dang / /bdag sbyang ba dang gzhan sbyang dang / /gtum mo rang bzhin sbar ba dang / /gtum mo go 73—691

bzlog sbar ba dang / /gtum mo rkyen gyis sbar ba dang / /gtum mo zhar la sbar ba dang / /gtum mo bye brag sbar ba dang / /spyi yi ①gtum mo sbar ba dang //grol ba'i rang bzhin gtum mo dang / /chags ②pa'i rang bzhin gtum mo ste/ /nang gi lha yi ngo bo ste/ /gsang ba'i lha yi ring ba'i rgyu/ /de nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ②yang / /dbang po gnyis sbyor kun du ru/ /de yi phyir na bha ga yin / /dga' ba la sogs sgyu ma yibya/ /phra ba'i lam spong las yin te/ /sems kyi dri 'khrud 'dod chags dag /rang rig sems kyi rgyal po'i rgyu/ /de nas bzhi pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /chos sku skye med nam mkha' bzhin/ /rang rig stong pa 'od gsal la/ /bsgoms pas nyes pa ma yin te/ /ma bsgoms ⑤pas kyang nyes pa min/ /bsgom pa nyid kyang rtog pa ste/ /mi bsgom ⑥pa yang rtog pa nyid/ /bsgom du rdul tsam med pa la/ /yongs su skad cig med pa 'di / /lha yi rgyal po yin par 'dod/ /dkyil 'khor rnams kyi mchog gyur pa/ /rang rig ye shes me ⑦bo che/ /thams cad 'di la gnas pa ste/ /dper na 'khor los sgyur khyaba'i rgyal po dag /yul dang grong khyer dag tu mi 'gro yang / /yul na 'dod pa thams cad sdud ponyepa ltar/ /mchod dang gtor ma la sogs pa'i / /las dang bya ba sna tshogs kun/ /sems kyi de nyid shes gyur na/ /thams cad 'di la sdud 7par nges/ /las ni zab pa'i lam spong ste/ /sgo gsum rnam dag dug gsum 'joms/ /gzugs sku gnyis ni 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /sbyin sreg 37rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /spyi yi thun mong yin par gsungs/ /de nas nang gi sbyin sreg 8kyang / /lte ba snying ga 8spyi bo mgrin/ /rigs ni nges pa'i thab khung ste/ /sku ni spyi bo gsung mgrin pa/ /snying gar 0thugs te yon tan 73—692

dang ske/ /phrin las gtum mo gnyis su nges/ /rlung dang rtsa dang thig le dang / /rang bzhin gnas pa'i ye shes me/ /me lha dag pas bdag po'i lha/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam rtog ①dag /sreg zhurdzas bsreg ste ( steme mchod bya/ /nye bar zhi ba sbyin pa dang / /rnam rtog sreg phyir sbyin sreg ④ste/ /rang lus ye shes me yis ni / /rtog pa'i bud shing bsreg bya ba/ /'di ni sbyin sreg (detshad ma ste/ /til sogs sdig par nges pa 'am/ /las kyi me nyid ye shes sam/ /bsregs pas nges par tshig gam ci/ /sreg 6)rdzas rtog pa sreg byed me/ /dbang pos spyod yul ma yin te/ /de phyir las kyi me nyid la/ /til sogs bsregs bapa'i las byas kyang / /nges par sdig pa tshig mi 'gyur/ /mchod pa la sogs de bzhin no / /bstan pa tsam du nges pa ste/ /rgyud ni don dam ma yin te/ /don dam rtogs pas bstan pa med/ /dgang gzar blugs gzar la sogs pa/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /de nas gsang ba'i sbyin sreg tshanakyang / /thab khung lte ba'am sna rtse ste/ /chags grol gnas ni nges pa dang / /rang bzhin dang ni gsang ba yi/ /gtum mo ye shes me sbar te/ /g.yas g.yon dgang gzar blugs gzar gyis/ /shu kra rtsa dang rlung sogs 995)kyi/ /phra mo'i rtog pa'i sreg tshe rdzas bsreg /bde ba'i me lha mchod par bya/ /zhi rgyas las kyi rim pa dang / /bzhi pa zhal nas shes par bya/ /de nas sngags kyi dbye ba yang / /phyi yi sngags ni oṃ āḥ// /nang du bdud rtsi'i tsomatshan nyid de/ /gsang bar mchog tshad dbus na gnas/ /mthar thug mtha' bral rang rig go/ /spos sogs phyi yi mchod pa ste/ /bdud rtsi la sogs nang du'o/ /gsang bar bde ba'i ro yis mchod / /mthar thug stong pa'i ro yis hurtemachod/ /'bras sogs phyi yi gtor ma 73—693

ste / /dman pa'i bgegs sogs zhi bar byed/ /a ba dhū tī'i ka dhipā lar/ /sha sogs bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gnas/ /rnam rtog bgegs chen zhi bar byed/ /bde ba (michen po'i bdud rtsi'i ros/ /phra ba'i gdon chen zhi byas pa/ /'di ni gsang ba'i gtor mar gsungs/ /rang rig stong pa'i bdud rtsi'i ros/ /bde chen gdon ni zhi byas pa/ /'di ni bzhi pa'i gtor mar nges/ /phyag 'tshal skor 97ba la sogs dang / /sbyang sogs bla ma'i zhal nas shes/ /gang gi phyir na sbyin sreg ni( kyi/ /dngos grub dam pa ster ba dang / /rnam rtog sreg phyir sbyin sreg ('uste/ /shing sogs sreg pa sbyin sreg ⑥min/ /mnyes pa'i don gyis mchod pa ste/ /spos sogs phul bas mnyes pa med/ /rang sems las su rung ba dag /mnyes pas mchod pa chen po ste/ /gdon dang gnod pa zhi ba dang / /bar chad zhi dang dngos grub dag /'byung ba'i phyir na gtor ma ste/ /'bras sogs phyi yi gtor ma yis/ /gdon sogs zhi bar mi 'gyur te/ /rang gi sgo gsum rnam rtog dag /gdon la sogs par snang ba ste/ /'khrul pa'i rnam rtog ma spangs par / /gdon sogs zhi bar mi 'gyur phyir/ /sgo gsum rnam rtog 'joms pa yi / /sems kyi gtor ma gtor ma'i mchog /gdon dang gnod pa zhi ba dang / /dam tshig gso dang lha rnams 'go/ /dngos grub thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /phyi nang gtor mar nges pa'o/ /rgyud rnams nye bar zhi ba dang / /lus las (ge 'byung phyir lha yin te/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor lha ma yin/ /lus dang yan lag lha ma yin/ /kha mig la sogs lha ma yin/ /lus las ma byung g.yeng ba'i phyir/ /dbang po sgo gsum g.yeng ba dgag /rang gi lus la rang lus 'byung / /sgo gsum zhi phyir lha zhes brjod/ /yid skyob phyir na sngags yin te/ /rang sems 79—694

las su rung ba dang / /rnam rtog gdon rnams las skyob phyir/ /'di ni sngags kyi rgyal por gsungs/ /gzhan yang dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /thams cad bla ma'i zhal nas blang / /rgyud 'di gtad kyis nan tan gyis/ /de'i tshe 'khor 'dus pa thams cad rgyud kyi don la yi rangs par ①gyur to/ /dpal gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs sol//rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga ②ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis brjo/ra ba'o// //bsdur mchan/69 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sri/la〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dz+ra/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 la/ ⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ste/⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉bzhin/691 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ (kye〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉brgya/ 9 )〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzung / rige〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉rnam/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gi/ yi〈〈khu 〉〉ma/ 97)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉cing / (8)〈〈g.yung 〉〉yag lan/ ⑨〈〈co 〉〉sum/ bo〈〈g.yung 〉〉dang thabs kyis/ 〈〈pe 〉〉la thabs kyis/ nyu)〈〈g.yung 〉〉lus//7)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgo tsan ḍa li/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sgo tsaṇ+ḍa li/692 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bo'i/ (0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉chag ci 〈〈co 〉〉 'khor/ (pe〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yis/ phyin〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgoms/ yi〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgom/ 7༄〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉mi/ dunan〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉los sgyu/ 〈〈co 〉〉lor sgyur/ (ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsdud/ 0〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bsdud/ 751ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ka 8〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉kar/693 4)〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉rtogs/ tshoge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ci (〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉te/ 9ba(5zhi/phyir〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ⑨〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉srogs/0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg (7)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rtsi rtse 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉yi/694 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉tā'i kā/ 〈〈li 〉〉ti'i ku 〈〈co 〉〉ci ku (〈〈khu 〉〉bar/ ri nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bskor/④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg na/ 〈〈li 〉〉sreg na/ 95)(7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg du ra〈〈khu 〉〉la/79wa 695

༄ga /dpal dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po/①༄7na /rgya gar skad du/ shrī thā shā ni a lo kā phyir tan+t+ra rā dza / /bod skad du/ /dpal dur khrod rgyan gyi rgyud kyi rgyal po/ /dpal bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs byed che la phyag 'tshal te/ /zhabs la spyi bos legs btud nas/ /dur khrod gang lags rgyan gang lags/ /rgyud ni gang lags rgyal po gang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /legs so rdo rje snying po legs / /legs par nyon la legs par zung pe/ /dang por dur khrod bshad bya ste / /dur khrod spyi dang bye brag gnas/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol te/ /rdo rje ra ba'i nang rol du/ /'jigs pa chen po spyi yi gnas/ /bye brag shar la sogs pa ste/ /snod kyi zhen pa bzlog pa yang / /lcags ri nag po tshun chad del/ /rdo rje ra bas de nyid do/ /chen po khru ni nyi shu ste/ /chung ba khru gang tshun (7chad do/ /de las gzhan pa'i ⑦dkyil 'khor ni/ /tshad las nges par 'das pa'o/ /rnam 79—697

shes tshogs brgyad rnam rtog hu)brgyad/ /mi mnga'i rtags su dur khrod brgyad/ /phyogs dang phyogs bral dag (getu dgod/ /tshogs brgyad yon tan brgyad ldan pa'i / /rtags su shing brgyad rim pas dgod/ /de bzhin gdug pa brgyad bcom pa'i/ /rtags su klu brgyad rim pas dgod/ /tshogs brgyad mi dge bcu bcom pa'i/ /rtags su phyogs skyong rim pas dgod/ /lus ngag gnyis kyis sems can gyi/ /don mdzad phyir ni char sprin dgod/ /de nyid dur khrod 'jigs pa che/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med rgyu ge/ /rnam rtog zil gnon brgyad por bshad/ /mdzes pa'i phyir na rgyan yin no/ /de nyid gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/ /dang por dur khrod bshad par bya/ /shar du gtum drag nag po che//lho ru ha har dgod ser che/ /nub tu mi bzad dmar po ste/ /byang du tshang tshing ljang gu 0che/ /me ru g.yer ka can yin te/ /bden bral mtshams ⑤su 'bar ba 'dzin/ /rlung mtshams dmyal sogs gnas pa ste/ /dbang ldan du ni dbyibs can no(6)/ /bhu tse ri khi gtsa sha ni/ /sa stengs shar gyi phyi ru dgod/ /pa ta li dang bā sa ni/ /sa 'og nub kyi phyi ru dgod/ /dur khrod 'di rnams mtshan nyid kyang / /'bar ba tshig dang ma tshig sogs/ /keng rus thod pa la sogs dang / /ro langs 'byung po'i tshogs dang bcas/ /ce (nyespyang sgra yis 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /shar du shi ri sha yi shing / /lho ru a shad ⑨tha yi shing / /nub tu wang ge ling gi shing / /byang du tsū 6ta'i shing du nges37/ /gong dang mtshungs pa n+ya gro da12/ /parka ti lcug pā thā dag /me nasadabang ldan mtshams su dgod/ /ji ltar grags pa'i gzugs su 'dod/ /shar du dbang po gnas pa ste/ /lho ru gshin rje gnas pa'o/ /nub tu klu (snyedabang gnas pa ste/ /byang 79wa 698

du gnod sbyin yang dag gnas/ /shar lhor ①me ni gnas pa'o/ /lho nub mtshams su srin po gnas/ /nub byang mtshams su rlung dgod de/ /byang shar mtshams ②su dbang ldan dgod/ /nyi zla shar la sa bdag nub/ /ji ltar grags pa'i gzugs su dgod/ /shar du nor rgyas gnas pa ste/ /'jog po lho ste stobs rgyu nub/ /pad+ma byang la pad chen me/ /hu lu hu lu srin por dgod/ /rigs ldan rlung mtshams dgod pa ste/ /dung skyong dbang ldan mtshams su'o/ /gdug pa sbrul gyi gzugs su dgod/ /kha dog rigs kyi dbye bas dbye/ /shar du char sprin dkar por dgod/ /lho ru pu mi ti dgod do/ /nub tu 'jigs pa rnam par gnas/ /byang du a ba yang dag gnas/ /sngo nya mer lani yang dag gnas / /ghā nya srin po'i mtshams su dgod/ /rlung gi mtshams su par sha na/ /gtum po 'di brgyad char sprin brgyad/ /btsod 0kyi mdog 'dra gur kum ⑤mdog /nam mkha'i mdog 'dra du ba'i mdog /sprin gyi mdog 'dra sprin gyi gzugasayi / /shar la sogs pa bzhi bzhi ste/ /'di dag nang rtags phyi ru 'byung ske/ /dang por spangs pa phun sum tshogs/ /de nas ye shes phun sum tshogs / /rang rig don ni phun sum tshogs/ /gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa yin⑦ / /rtags su 'jigs pa 'di dag gnas/ /de nas nang gi dur khrod sogs / /pags (kyepa rdo rje ra ba ste/ /rus pa (shesardo rje gur du nges/ /dpung pa nye ba'i dpung pa ste/ /brla dang de bzhin nye ba'i brlam/ /brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad du nges/ /rje ngar nye ba'i rje ngar bzhi/ /lag /glengar nye ba'i lag 12ngar bzhi / /brgyad ni nang gi shing brgyad do/ /tshigs dang de bzhin nye ba'i tshigs/ /steng dang 'og tu bzhi bzhi ste/ /nang gi phyogs skyong yin par 'dod/ /mthil 79wa 699

dang de bzhin nye ba'i mthil/ /steng 'og de bzhin klu brgyad do/ /rtse dang de bzhin nye ba'i rtse/ /brgyad ni char sprin brgyad yin te/ /bskyed rim ①rnam rtog mi mnga'i rtags/ /dur khrod brgyad ni nang na gnas/ /rtsa rlung ngo bo shes pa rgyas / /de phyir nang gi shing brgyad gnas/ /rags pa'i gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir / /nang na klu brgyad yang dag gnas/ /bdag spyod gzhan yang ②spyod pa'i phyir / /char sprin brgyad ni nang du gnas/ /de nas gsang ba'i dur khrod kyang //sna rtser rtsa brgyad dur khrod brgyad/ /lte bar rtsa brgyad shing brgyad do/ /snying gar rtsa snobargyad phyogs skyong brgyad/ /mgrin par rtsa brgyad klu brgyad de/ /spyi bor rtsa brgyad char sprin brgyad/ /gsang bar rnam rtog mi mnga'i durtags/ /dur khrod brgyad ni gsang bar gnas/ /thams cad bde bar snang ba'i phyir/ /gsang bar shing brgyad yang dag gnas/ /phra ba'i mtshan ma'i rnam rtog gi/ /gdug pa 'joms phyir klu brgyad dgod/ /bde ⑤bas bdag spyod gzhan sbyor bas / /de yi phyir na char sprin dgod/ /de nas bzhi pa'i yidur khrod kyang / /rnam shes brgyad ni de nyid brgyad/ /dur khrod brgyad du nges pa'o/ /dur khrod sogs brgyad de nyid shing / /lhag ma gsum dang tshor tshogs lnga/ /brgyad ni phyogs skyong brgyad du nges/ /nyon mongs drug dang de yi gnyis/ /brgyad po dag ni klu brgyad do/ /lnga dang bzhi dag gsum dag ni/ /de dag bzhi pa'i char sprin brgyad/ /gzung 'dzin rnam rtog mi mnga'i rtags/ /bzhi pa yi ni dur khrod brgyad/ /stobs sogs mkhyen pa'i yon tan rgyas/ /rtags su shing brgyad nges pa'o/ /rnam rtog gdug pa 'dul ba yi/ /rtags su klu brgyad nges pa'o/ /gzugs sku gnyis kyis (7)sems can gyi/ /don mdzad rtags su char sprin brgyad//79—700

phyogs skyong bla ma'i zhal nas shes/ /de dag kun gyi bye brag kyang / /bla ma'i zhal nas shes par bya/ /rgyun chags phyi nang rgyud ces bya/ /rgyal po khyad par 'phags pa'o/ /gzhan yang nga yis gsungs pa'i bka'/ /gsung gcig 1)nyid du gsungs gyur kyang / /du ma nyid du so sor snang / /chos tshul du ma'i bye brag dang ske/ /mos pa du ma'i bye brag dang / /'du shes ②du ma'i bye brag gis/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /sems gzung yan lag bsam mi khyab/ /nga yi rjes su 'brang ba yi/ /bla ma sa rab non pa dang / /de nyid bcu ldan mngon shes skyes/ /de gsung bcu drug mtha' yi bar/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhas pas spyad/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi lung bstan pas/ /brtsams la bzhi yi mtha' yis nges/ /de lta'i man ngag ma thob par/ /sngags kyi lta spyod gang spyod pa/ /rang yang phung la gzhan yang phung / /mthong ba'i chos la dmyal sogs 'tshed/ /de bas dngos grub 'dod pa yis/ /bla ma dam pa mnyes byas te/ /man ngag dam pa blang bar bya/ /nges pa'i lta spyod ma rnyed par/ /gsang ba'i lta dang spyod pa dang / /mos pa'i rjes su gang byed dang / /nyon mongs zil non la sogs dag /gsang sngags lta su bur spyad pa spyod/ /'di dag rkun tsho po ma rungs pa/ /mthong ba'i chos la dmyal bar skye/ /dang po srid pa skye ba yang / /yar ngo mar ngo mtshams dang gsum/ /sih+la'i dang po tha ma dang / /'bras bu sred pa skye ba yi / /dus der kun du ru byed na/ /'byung ba'i rlung gi nang zhugs na/ /nad gzhi 95)bsdus shing nad gzhi rirme skyed/ /srog dang tshangs par spyod pa 'byung / /de la 'dod pa'i mtshon chas ni/ /g.yeng ba me 5shesadang gtar ka bya/ /phyi nas rigs kyi bdag pos so/ /srid par skye ba'i dus tshod kyang / /rgyun chad zhag 79—701

0426༄ga /dpal rdo rje rgyal po chen po'i rgyud/ 1)༄ska /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra rā dza ma hā tan+t+ra/ bod skad du/dpal rdo rje rgyal po chen po'i rgyud/ dpal sdom pa'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la rdo rje snying po la sogs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grangs med pa dang thabs cig natu bzhugs pa'i dus su phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa'i mchod pas mchod nas / bcom ldan 'das la mngon du phyogs pa dang / bcom ldan 'das 9bzhal 'dzum 47pa mdzad de/ rdo rje snying po la sogs pas gsol pa/ rdo rje gang lags chen po gang / /rgyud ni gang lags rgyal po gang / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /don gyi rdo rje rnam pa bzhi/ /dbang bzhi'i grangs su shes par bya/ /rnam rtog 'joms phyir rdo rje ste/ /de la rnam pa bzhi yin te/ /phyi 73—704

nang gsang ba rab gsang gnyis/ /rtse gsum rtse gcig rtse lnga pa/ /rtse dgu pa ni nyid yin no/ /bcu gnyis de nyid rdo rje ste/ /rtags kyi rdo rje bzhi ①yin no/ /gnyis su med pa rtse gcig pas/ /rnam rtog thams cad spangs pa yin/ /rtse gsum sku gsung thugs yin te/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'joms pa'i phyir na bshad pa yin/ /rtse lnga ye shes lnga yi rtags/ /me long mnyam nyid so sor rtog /bya ba nan tan chos dbyings shes/ /nyon mongs lnga ni spangs pa ste/ /zhe sdang nga rgyal 'dod chags dang / /phrag dog gti mug 'joms par byed/ /rdo rje rtse dgu gang yin pa/ /ye shes rtse dgu bshad pa ste/ /khams gsum sa dgu 'joms par byed/ /'dod khams gzugs khams gzugs med khams/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems/ /rig 'dzin sangs rgyas ye shes che/ /sa dgu la ni gang sgrib pa'i/ /sgrib pa sbyong bar du byed pa yi/ /rdo rje rtse dgur bstan pa yin/ /rdo rje rtse mo bcu gnyis pa/ /'khor ba'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi/ /spong ba'i ye shes bcu gnyis yin/ /ma rig pa las 'du byed de/ /'du byed rkyen gyis rnam par shes/ /ming dang gzugs dang skye mched drug /reg dang tshor dang sred dang len/ /srid pa skye dang rga shi ste/ /de rnams spong ba'i gnyen po ste/ /chos kyi ye shes mngon du byas(ba/ /de las ye shes drug rang bzhin/ /de las sku gsung thugs ngo bo/ /de las skye mched drug sangs rgyas/ /de las gnyis med reg gapa ni/ /de las nyams myong bde chen po / /rang rig de nyid sred pa ste/ /chos kun ston byed len pa ste/ /srid pa longs spyod rdzogs sku yin/ /skye ba sprul pa'i sku ru bshad/ /rga shi rgyun dang mya ngan 'das/ /'od gsal stong chen ngang du thim/ /de phyir rdo rje bcu gnyis pa//79—705

rdzas kyi rdo rje bzhi yin te/ /'bigs shing rno ba zur gsum ste/ /gru bzhis rdzas rnams brdar byas pas/ /'jam zhing dang la 'joms par byed/ /pha lam zlum pos rtsub pa 'joms/ /zur lngas thams cad ci dgar byed/ /de nas chen po'i don bshad de/ /dmigs dang bsam pa spyod pa dang / /brtul zhugs ①brtson 'grus smon lam dang / /de bzhin ye shes chen po ste/ /re re la yang bdun bdun sbyar/ /de phyir chen po zhes ni bstan/ /rgyud ni rnam pa lnga yin te / /phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang / /rab tu gsang dang gsang ba che de rnams rgyun du gnas pa la/ /rgyu yi rgyud du bstan pa yil/ /de rnams don ni ji bzhin rtogs/ /'bras bu'i rgyud du bstan pa yin/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis med pa/ /rgyu ni gnyis su med pa yi/ /rang rig ye shes mthar thug pa/ /mthar thug bla na med pa'i rgyud/ /rgyal po la yang lnga yin te/ /phyi nang gsang dang rab tu gsang / /shin tu gsang ba chen po ste/ /de rnams don la dbang bskur dang / /de yi mi mthun phyogs 'joms phyir/ /de phyir rgyal po lnga ru bstan / /rdo rje snying pos yang gsol pa/ /bcom ldan 'das ni ji ltar lags/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs ni ji ltar lags/ /btsun mo'i bha ga ji ltar lags/ /rdo rje gang lags snying po gang / /dpa' bo gang lags mkha' 'gro gang / /dpag tu med pa ji ltar lags/ /thabs cig gebazhugs pa ji ltar lags/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i/ /mchod nas zhes pa ji ltar lags/ /mngon phyogs 'khod pa ⑦ji ltar lags/ /zhal 'dzum mdzad pa ji ltar lags/ /gzigs pa zhes pa ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nyon mongs dang ni 'chi bdag bdud/ /phung po'i 73—706

bdud dang lha yi bdud/ /bdud bzhi bcom pas bcom pa'o/ /ldan pa yon tan drug ldan phyir/ /dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba ①bzang / /ye shes phun sum tshogs pa la/ /drug po de ldan zhes bya ba/ /'khor ba'i chos ni mya ngan te/ /de ltar bral phyir 'das pa'o/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad de bzhin gshegs//thams cad dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor bcas /btsun mo zhes bya chos kyi dbyings/ /de las byung phyir bha ga ste/ /dbyer mi phyed pas bzhugs par bshad/ /rdo rje chos rnams 'jigs pa che/ /snying po ye shes chen po ste/ /sogs pa mang po'i don yin bte/ /dpa' bo zhes pa rnam pa lnga/ /phyi nang gsang ba la sogs kyi/ /rnam par rtog pa 'joms phyir yin/ /mkha' la 'gro bas mkha' 'gro ste/ /rtsa sogs la yang shes par bya/ /thams cad de las byung ba'i phyir/ /ma zhes nga bayis gsungs pa yin/ /de yi don la mi dpogs pas/ / de yi ④phyir na (pedapag tu med/ /thabs cig yibazhugs zhes bya ba 'di/ /de nyid don dang dbyer med phyir/ /gcig gi don du bshad pa'o//gnyis pa ma yin de dus su/ /phyi nang ma yin mchod pa ni/ /phyi yi mchod pa bshad par bya/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /dri dang lha bshos btung ba dang ske/ /rol mo sil snyan dbyangs nyid dang / /sgeg dang rgod medang gar nyid dang ske/ /rta dang glang po rin chen sogs/ /de nas nang gi mchod pa ni/ /bha ga btsums (shel ku tsa btsir/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang btung ba lnga/ /byang chub sems dang ldan byas te/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /de la sogs pas mchod par bya/ /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig 73—707

le ste/ /de nyid gnyis med bde ba yis/ /rtsa dang rlung sogs thig les mchod//de nas rab gsang mchod pa ni/ /dang po dga' dang mchog dga' dang / /dga' bral de bzhin lhan askyes dga'/ /bde ②ba'i khyad par de nyid kyis/ /rang bzhin dga' sogs thams cad mchod/ /de nas bla med mchod pas ②ni/ /rang rig stong par rtogs pa yis/ /'od gsal de nyid chos kyi sku/ /de nyid bla med mchod pa mchog /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/rdo rje snying po la sogs pa'i 'khor rnams dga' zhing mgu nas rjes su yi ④rangs par gyur te/ g.yon phyogs nas bskor ba byas nas so so'i rdzu 'phrul gyis mi snang bar gyur to/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa rdo rje rgyal po'i rgyud rdzogs sophyi// //rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra mā la (yedang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'ol// //

༄gi /dpal ye shes bsam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/①༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ shrī dzñā na ā sha ya tan+t+ra rā dza(gye/ bod skad du/dpal ye shes bsam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma'i 'khor grangs med pa dang / ye shes gsang ba'i gnas na thabs cig ༷ tu bzhugs pa'i dus su dpa' bo ye shes mkha' 'gro zhes bya bas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la spyi bos gtugs te④/ thal mo sbyar nas gsol pa/ bcom ldan ye shes mnga' bdag che/ /ye shes kyi ni rang bzhin dang ske/ /ye shes skye gnas gang dang gang / /rgyal po ji ltar lags pa dang / /gang la dbang byed gang gis 'dul/ /de nyid bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dpa' bo ye shes mkha' 'gro nyon/ /ye shes zhes bya rnam pa lnga/ /de nyid don la shes pa dang / /log rtog (bshes 73—710

pas ma bsgribs phyir/ /spyi bo'i ye shes bshad pa'o/ /me long ye shes mnyam nyid dang / /so sor rtog dang bya nan tan/ /chos dbyings ye shes lnga pa'o①/ /de la me long ye shes ni/ /dper na g.ya' dag me long la/ /gzugs brnyan ②gsal bar snang ba bzhin/ /de bzhin sems kyi me long la/ /nyon mongs g.ya' ②ni dag byas na/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan sgyu mar mthong sems kyi me long gang yin la/ /sgyu ma tsam du snang ba de/ /tha dad mi phyed mnyam ye shes / /mnyam nyid ye shes gang yin pa/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam de ni/ /las dang mtshan nyid ma 'dres pa/ /de nyid so sor rtog ye shes/ /de nyid nan tan sgrub byed de/ /de nyid don grub ye shes te/ /thams /bcad chos dbyings gzhan min te/ /de phyir chos dbyings ye shes yin/ /ye shes skye gnas gang yin pa/ /kha sbyor dbus kyi rtsa brgyad do/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med tshul/ /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang / /ye shes bzhi po skye ba'i gnas/ /de dag kun 'dus lte ba ni/ /chos dbyings ye shes skye ba'i gnas/ /me long ye shes mnyam nyid dang / /so sor rtog dang bya ba grub/ /chos dbyings ye shes la sogs pa/ /bdag po byed pa'i phyir dang ni/ /zhe sdang dang ni nga rgyal dang / /'dod chags dang ni phrag dog dang / /de bzhin gti mug la sogs pa'i/ /nyon mongs thams cad 'joms pa'i phyir/ /rgyal po zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /ye shes mkha' 'gros yang gsol pa/ /byang chub sems ni ji ltar lags/ /de nyid dbye ba gang lags dang / /de yi gnas dang gzung ba'i gnas/ /nges par bzlog pa'i tshul nyid dang / /de nyid kyi ni 'bras bu dang / /rtags dang yon tan gang lags pa/ /de nyid bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das 73—711

kyis bka' stsal pa/ /byang chub sems ni rang rig ste/ /dbye ba'i don ni gnyis su bstan/ /de yi gnas ni rtsa yin te/ /gzung ba rig pa'i 'khor lor tenyu)rka/ /nges par bzlog pa'i thabs dag ni/ /go bzlog pa yi tshul yin no/ /de nyid 'bras bu gnyis med rtogs/ /rtags ni lus la khrag byung dang / /ba spu langs dang 'dar ba dang / /kha zas dad chung lus yang dang / /skra dkar gnyer ma dengs pa dang / /le lo med dang brtson 'grus ldan/ /de la sogs pa'i rtags rnams 'grub/ /de nas yon tan bshad pa ni/ /rkang mgyogs sa steng sa 'og gi/ /'jig rten dngos grub gang yin dang / /'jig rten las 'das thob ②par 'gyur/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi gnas/ /rang rig 'od gsal de nyid dor / /ye shes rang (4bzhin gnas yin te/ /rtags ni 'od gsal de nyid do/ /'bras bu chos sku 'chang chen po'i/ /sa ni nges par thob pa'o / /rnal 'byor sems gzung bsgom pa brtag /lus sems tshags su bcug nas ni/ /rang gi sems kyi de nyid la/ /de nyid dbyer med bsgom par bya/ /de yis thob med 'bras bu thob/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'i 'khor thams cad rjes su yi rangs (5)nas de kho na nyid bla na med pa'i mchod pas mchod de mi snang bar gyur to/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa ye shes bsam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs so96)// //paṇ+ḍi ta ga 7ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur 8riba'o // //79—712

mdzod spu ste/ /u ni spyan smig lhonyemathon mthing la/ /ba yi rdzi ma lta bu'o/ /u tshems bzhi bcu mnga' ba ste/ / ṛ rī ༅tshems mnyam tshems thags bzang / / '-i lī (0tshems dkar ro bro mchog /e ni 'gram pa seng ge 'dra/ /e ljags shin tu srab pa ste/ /o ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang ldan/ /au ni dpung mgo shin tu zlum/ /oṃ ni bdun mtho ba ru gsungs/ /aḥni thal gong rgyas pa ste/ /'di dag bcu drug g.yas bskor ④ro/ /de nas g.yon bskor ⑤mtshams nas kyang ske/ /a ni lpags (6)srab mdog gser 'dra/ /ā ni bzhengs bzhin ma btud (pepar / /phyag gnyis pus mo sleb pa'o/ /i ni ro stod seng ge 'dra/ /khri ⑧ni shing n+ya lagro lta bur/ /chu dang zheng ni gab pa'o/ /u ni mdzod spu ⑩g.yas su 'khyil / /u ni spu rnams gyen du phyogs/ / ṛ mdoms sba rtsomab sbubs su nub/ /rī kyebarla legs par zlum pa'o/ /bla 8ni zhabs long tshigs mi mngon/ / thā ni 8phyag zhabs 'jam zhing gzhon/ /lī 8ni phyag mthil zhabs kyi mthil/ /'jam zhing gzhon sha rgyas pa'o/ /e ni phyag zhabs dra bas 'brel/ /e ni sen mo ring ba ste/ /o ni phyag dang zhabs mthil la/ /'khor lo dang ni ldan pa yin/ /au ni zhabs ni shin tu gnas/ /oṃ zhabs rting tshepa yangs pa ste/ /aḥni byin pa ri dgas ni/ /e na ya yi lta bu ste/ /spyi bo'i mi shigs snying po haṃ/ /ston pa sum cu 7rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /ka ni sen mo zangs mdog 'dra/ /kha ni sen mo mdog snum pa/ /ga ni sen mo mtho ba ste/ /gha ni sor mo rnams skum pa/ /nga ni sor mo rnams rgyas pa/ /tsa ni sor rnams byin gyis phra/ /tsha ni rtsa 12rnams mi mngon pa/ /dza ni rtsa mdud med pa yin/ /dzha nyarteni long bu mi mngon pa/ /nya ni zhabs mi mnyam pa med/ /ṭa ni seng ge'i stabs su gshegs/ /ṭha ni glang po'i 73—715

stabs su gshegs/ /ḍa ni ngang pa'i stabs su gshegs/ /bha ni khyu mchog stabs su gshegs/ /ṇa ni g.yon phyogs ldog cing gshegs/ /ta ni mdzes par gshegs pa ste/ /tha ni mi g.yo bar gshegs pa/ /da ni sku la 'khril bag chags / /dha sku byi dor byas pa 'dra/ /na sku rim par 'tsham 3)pa'o/ /pa ni sku gtsang pha sku 'jam(2)/ /ba sku rnam par dag pa'o/ /bha ni mtshan rdzogs ngo bo nyid / /ma sku kho lag 9 )yangs shing bzang / /ya ni gom pa snyoms pa'o/ /ra sku shin tu gzhon mdog can/ /la ni sku la 'khrul pa med/ /wa ni sku lus rgyas pa ste / /sha ni shin tu grims pa'o/ /ṣa ni yan lag thams cad mdzes/ /sa gzigs rab rib med cing dag /ha dku (4kyiskum pa nyid yin te/ /k+ṣa ni dku (5)skabs phyed pa'o/ /ya ni dku (6snyoms pa yin te/ /ra ni phyal phyam med pa 9)yin / /la ni lte ba zab pa ste/ /wa ni lte ba g.yas su 'khyil/ /snya na)ni kun nas mdzes pa ste/ /dha ni kun spyod gtsang ma yin/ /'di dag thabs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /g.yas nas bskor ba bzhi bcu yin/ /de nas g.yon gyis ⑨bzhi bcu ni/ /ka ni sku sme gnag bag med/ /kha ni shing bal ltar 'jam phyag /ga phyag ri mo mdangs yod pa/ /gha phyag ri mo zab pa dang / /nga phyag ri mo ring ba'o / /tsa zhal ha cang mi ring ba/ /tsha zhal gzugs kyi gzugs brnyan snang / /dza dzha 〉ljags mnyen ljags srab pa/ /nya ni ljags dmar ngo bo ste/ /glang po'i nga ro 'brug sgra ṭa/ /ṭha ni gsung snyan mnyen 'jam pa/ /ḍa rto mche ba zlum dang rno/ /ṇa ni mche 11dkar ta tshems mnyam/ /tha ni mche ba byin gyis phra/ /da shangs shin tu mtho 12ba dang / /dha shangs shin tu gtsang ba'o/ /na ni spyan 'od rnam par dag /pa pha spyan bzang rdzi ma stug /ba ni dkar nag phyed 79—716

pad+ma'i / /'dab ma'i mdangs 'dra pad+ma'i spyan/ /bha ni de bzhin smin mtshams ring ske/ /ma ya asmin mtshams smin spu mnyam/ /ra ni de bzhin smin ma snum/ /la ni phyag ring rgyas pa'o(ba/ /de bzhin wa ni snyan shal mnyam/ /snyan gyi dbang po ma nyams sha /dpral ba legs par 'byes pa ṣa/ /sa ni dpral ba'i dbyes che ba/ /ha ni dbu dag shin tu rgyas/ /dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag k+ṣa/ /dbu skra ⑧stug pa ya yin te/ /de bzhin dbu skra 'jam pa ra/ /dbu skra mi 'dzing ba ni la/ /dbu skra mi gshor rlo ba ni wa/ /dbu skra dri zhim ḍa ⑤yin te/ /phyag la dpal gyi be'u dang ni/ /bkra shis g.yung drung 'khyil bas brgyan/ / sdong ris (6)lta bu nye ⑦yin te/ /lte ba sprul pa'i snying po i/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur (3naldan / /a ni phyi nang stong pa nyid/ /ā ni stong pa nyid stong pa/ /i ni chen po stong pa nyid/ /khri ni don dam stong pa nyid/ /u ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid/ /lca ni 'dus ma byas stong pa/ /ṛ 79༄ni mtha' las 'das stong pa/ /rī tsheni thog mtha' stong pa nyid/ /bla mni dor ba med pa stong / /lī nyurteni rang bzhin stong pa nyid / /e ni chos rnams thams cad stong / /i ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong / /o hunyeni mi dmigs stong pa nyid/ /o ni dngos po med stong nyid/ /i ni ngo bo stong pa nyid/ /dngos med ngo bo stong nyid aḥ/ /mgrin pa longs spyod snying po ma / /shes rab stong pa bcu drug rtsa/ /gzugs 7can gzugs rnams la lta ba/ /rnam par thar pa dang po a/ /nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas/ /phyi rol gzugs rnams la lta ba/ /rnam thar gnyis pa ka yin no/ /sdug pa rnam par thar pa'i lus/ /mngon sum byas nas rdzogs pa ni/ /de dag rnam thar gsum pa tsa/ /gzugs kyi 'du shes las tshe'adas pa/ /sna tshogs 'du shes yid mi 79—717

byedarka/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas la gnas ṭa/ /nam mkha' 0)mtha' yas las 'das te/ /rnam shes mtha' yas la gnas shing / /rnam shes mtha' yas rdzogs pa tags/ /rnam shes mtha' yas las 'das nas / /ci yang med pa la gnas te/ /de nyid rdzogs pa pa yin no/ /ci yang med pa las 'das te/ /'du shes med min la gnas te/ /'du shes med min rdzogs pa yaX 'du shes med min la (nya'adas te/ /'du shes tshor ba 'gog pa'i lus/ /mngon sum byas nas rdzogs pa ni/ /rnam par (mthar pa brgyad pa sha /snying ga ④chos kyi 'khor lo r+ghaṃ/ /gtso bo rnam thar brgyad dang ldan/ /'di (gyedag rtsa yi rnam par gnas / /'khor lo'i rgya ni sor gsum ste/ /sems can kun la rang bzhin ⑨gnas / /de phyir sems can sangs rgyas yin/ /sna tshogs sdud ⑩pa'i mtshan nyid kyang / /ring du 'byung zhing thung du gnas/ /smin mtshams kyi ni mdzod spu bzhin / /chos kyi 'byung gnas lte 37ba la/ /g.yas g.yon bu ga lnga lnga ste/ /steng 'og kha yi bar nas 'byung / /ro ma shar du mngon du phyogs/ /rkyang ma nub ste 'og gi char/ /ro mas rkyang ma la 'khyud cing / /g.yas pa'i cha ru zung 'jug nyid/ /rkyang mas ro ma la 'khyud cing / /g.yon gyi cha ru zung 'jug nyid / /g.yas g.yon rtse mo sku gsung thugs/ /de sgra sngags su rab tu grags/ /sngags dang rgyud dang dngos grub sogs/ /de nyid las ni byung bas na/ /sems can sangs rgyas rang bzhin no/ /skye ba bzhi yi rim pa yang / /snod bcud yab yum la thim ste/ /yab yum nyi ma zla bar 'gyur/ /snang ba'i thig le yang dag bcas/ /'di dag nang gi mngal kyi skyes tshul/ /ā li kā li nyi zla ste/ /sems ni thig le'i ngo bor gnas/ /nang gi sgong skyes yin par 'dod/ /kā 79—718

dang ā las nyi zla ste/ /rang byung ①jig le drod gsher yin/ /de dag skad cig rkyen med las/ /rang bzhin 'byung ba rdzus skyes so/ /rkyen med sbyor ba sgong sogs las/ /bde ba skye dang bde ba'i rgyu/ /thams cad dran pa gsang ba yi/ /mngal nas skyes pa'i tshul yin te/ /yar la sreg dang mar la gso/ /gnas gsum nyi shu bzhir 'pho yin/ /phyi nang 'dod pa'i mtshan ma yis/ /rtsa rgyas bde ba ster ba dang / /rin po che yi pho brang du/ /sems 'dzin gsang ba'i sgong skyes yin/ /nang gi 'dod pa'i mtshon cha yis/ /bde ba skye ba drod gsher skyes / /gang gi rkyen gyis ma skyes par/ /gdod nas bde ba'i rgyur (bskyes la/ /bde ba skyes pa rdzus skyes so/ /gtum mo go bzlog rkyen gyis sbar/ /gtum mo rkyen gyis sbar ba dang / /gtum mo go bzlog sbar ba dang / /gtum mo rang bzhin sbar ba ni/ /mngal skyes sgong skyes drod gsher skyes/ /rdzus skyes rim par sbyar bar bya/ /du ma'i gzhi bcas gzhi bcas dang / /gzhi med shin tu gzhi med de/ /mngal skyes sgong skyes drod gsher skyes/ /rdzus skyes bzhi char rim par sbyar/ /rgyu dang lam ste 'bras bu kun/ /skye ba bzhi yi ngo bor gcig /de phyir sangs rgyas sems can gnyis/ /dngos po ro mnyam gyur pa la/ /log rtog (lde)sgyu mas gnyis su 'khrul/ /rdo rje snying po snying rje che/ /nang dang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor yang / /nga yis bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /sku yi dkyil 'khor spyi bor bsgom/ /gsung ni mgrin pa thugs ni snying / /yon tan lte ba phrin las ni/ /sna rtse dag tu bsam par bya/ /'bar ba bzhi yi a la yang / /rdo rje phag mo rab tu grags/ /haṃ ni bde mchog he ru ka /dpa' bo gcig pa yin par 'dod/ /bdun pa dang ni dgu pa dag /gsum pa hūṃ las rab tu 79—719

grags②ske/ /bcu gsum pa dang bcwa ②lnga pa/ /bcu dgu oṃ las rab tu grags/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga nyi shu dgu/ /haṃ gi ngo bor yang dag gnas/ /sum cu ⑤bdun dang drug cu ④bzhi/ /a yi dkyil 'khor yin par nges/ /rtsa ni rdo rje phag mo ste/ /g.yas g.yon phyag la dbu ma zhal/ /dpa' bo byang chub sems yin te/ /skye mched bcu gnyis dngas ma yang / /bcu gnyis phyag tu rab tu grags/ /'byung bzhi'i dngas ma zhal bzhir nges/ /mdzes pa'i phyir na rgyan du bshad/ /gsung mchog bla ma'i zhal nas blang / /g.yas g.yon steng 'og sgo bzhi ste/ /'dom (snyegang mnyam pa gru bzhi yin/ /bdud rtsi lnga ni tshon rtsi lnga/ /rtsa ni thig gi rang bzhin te/ /ka ba brgyad ni rkang brgyad do/ /so sen ba spu twa ra sogs/ /mkhas pas brtag cing shes par bya/ /'di dag rang bzhin dkyil 'khor te/ /dper na rang byung gser dang 'dra/ /'di ni bcos ma ma yin te/ /rang rig ye shes gzugs brnyan ni/ /gzugs brnyan dkyil 'khor bsgom pa min/ /rdul tshon 96)la sogs bri ba min/ /spos la sogs pas mchod pa min/ /rdo shing lha la phyag mi bya/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i sangs rgyas la/ /rang bzhin mchod pas rtag tu mchod/ /sku ni dgun dus rang bzhin te/ /'byung ba'i sku gsum zla ba gsum/ /gsung ni dpyid dus ngo bo ste/ /'jug pa'i sku gsum (7)zla ba gsum / /thugs ni dbyar dus ngo bo ste/ /gnas pa sku gsum zla ba gsum/ /ye shes ston gyi dus yin te/ /sku gsung thugs ni zla ba gsum/ /dang po rgyu yi sa pa yin/ /'khor lo chags pa dmar po la/ /yi ge rnams ni dkar pos gnasal/ /lam gyi sa mo pa rnam pa gnyis/ /ring ba dang ni nye ba'o/ /de nas 'bras bu'i sa pa yin/ /'khor lo yang dag gnas pa ste/ /'khor lo de rnams 79—720

lha rnams kyang / /sku mdog phyag mtshan kun dang bral/ /rang bzhin gsal ba dri ma med/ /shel ltar gsal ba dri ma med/ /mi mthong 1)mthong ba'i ngo bo can//zab cing phra ba'i rang bzhin can/ /phyi ru sku mdog phyag mtshan lha/ /nang gi shin tu phra ba'i gzugs/ /gsang ba'i bde ba lha ru nges/ /de las bzlog pa bzhi pa'i lha/ /lus las byung phyir lha zhe 'am/ /rgyud rnams dag byed phyir na lha / /chags pa'i phyir na lha yin te/ /rgyal po shes rab rang bzhin te/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyi/ /chags pa chen po'i rgyud gsungs so/ /de nas sa chen po yang cher g.yos par gyur te/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po yang babs par gyur to/ /de nas dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyang rgyud kyi don la dga' zhing mgu ste rjes su yi rangs dunanas mi snang bar gyur to/ /dpal chags pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs sol// //rnal 'byor ma tsan+d+ra mā la 0dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba'ol//

tshog /dpal mkha' 'gro ma'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/nya༄pha /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ḍā ki nī saṃ ba ra tan+t+ra rā dza na 'a ma/ bod skad du/ dpal mkha' 'gro ma'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/ dpal bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bde ba chen po'i ros gang bas/ /thams cad stong par gyur nas kyang / /ho he mgon po rdo rje 'dzin/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni ji ltar lags/ / de yi tsho sdom pa ji ltar lags/ /dam tshig bsrung ba ji ltar lags/ /rdo rje phag mo bdag la gsungs/ /nyon cig rdo rje phag mo nyon/ /dang po dam tshig mtshan nyid kyang / /rtsa ba dang ni yan lag bcas/ /rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dag /kun nas 'khrugs te gzhan gyi yang / /sgo gsum kun 'khrugs chen po ste/ /rang bzhin casgo gsum 'khrugs 5pa 'bring / /nyams pa 'bring du gsungs pa yin/ /rang gzhan 'khrugs pa tha ma yang / /nyams pa chung ngu yin par 'dod/ /re re la yang gsum gsum ste/ /nyams pa 73—724

che 'bring dgu ru dbye/ /rang la mnar sems ma skyes kyang / /gzhan la mnar sems skyes pa yi/ /bdag gi g.yeng bas rkyen byas pa/ /de nyid nyams pa 'bring du bshad/ /rang la mnar sems cher skyes kyang / /gzhan la nyes pa chung bas na/ /'di lnga 15nyams pa 'bring du bshad/ /g.yeng ba'i rkyen gyis gang nyams kyang / /'di ni ltung ba yang bar gsungs/ /rang gi dam tshig bsrungs pa yi(kye/ /lta spyod gang la gzhan ma mos/ /zab mo'i don la skur 'debs pa/ /ltung ba che 'bring yang bar bshad/ /rang gis ma nyes gzhan cher 'khrugs/ /'di ni nyams pa chung rdzunadangur bshad/ /re re'i dbye ba gzhan nas shes/ /de nas snod kyi mtshan nyid kyang / /phyi yis rang gi sgo gsum dag /'khrugs pa che chung rim pas dbye/ /rang sems 'khrugs na phyi rol la/ /bsnun sogs nyams pa chen por 'gyur/ /g.yengs pas nyams pa 'bring chung ngu / /mdor na rang bzhin dam tshig dang / /bcas te bye brag dam tshig las/ /gnyis su med par mkhas pas gsungs/ /dam tshig las ni rdo rje 'chang / /de nas mkha' 'gro mtshan nyid kyang / /mkha' 'gro rtsa ru gnas pa ste/ /phag mo yungs kur 4 tsam gyi tshad/ /gzhan ni lnga yi tshad tsam ste/ /gsal la rang bzhin med pa'o/ /ka nas g.yas bskor 5ka yi bar/ /mkha' 'gro drug cu 6bzhi ru nges/ /ka sogs zung rtsa kyinamakha' 'gro ste/ /phyi nas rtsa re mkha' 'gro re / /mkha' 'gro nas bskor mtshams kyi bar/ /sum cu 9 rtsa bdun mkha' 'gro ma/ /lte ba sprul par yang dag gnas/ /a sogs brgyad ni mkha' 'gro brgyad/ /de bzhin zung rtsa mkha' 'gro bzhi/ /snying ga 1 tshoru ni yang dag gnas/ /zung rtsa gsum ni mkha' 'gro re/ /gzhan rnams rtsa re mkha' 'gro re/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi mgrin 79—725

par gnas/ /rdo rje phag mo lte bar gnas/ /gzhan ni spyi bor yang dag gnas//de nas sdom pa bshad bya ste/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bde chen po/ /bde de sdom par yang dag bshad/ /gang zhig bde ba khyad par can/ /nges par sdom hu)pa yin par 'dod/ /rdo rje phag mo mi 'da' sbyonabs/ /sdom pa dam tshig tu ni bshad / /mi phyed pas ni phyag rgyar sadagasungs/ /rdo rje phag mos yang zhus pa/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu gang lags/ /rkyen dupeni gang lags dus gang (lde)lags/ /tshad ni gang lags bsrung dus gang / /lus ngag dam tshig ji ltar dbye/ /dang por nyams pa'i rgyu nyid kyang / /mi shes pa dang bag med dang / /nyon mongs ldan dang ma gus dang / /brjed ngas tshone dran pa mi gsal ba/ /'di drug dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu/ /bla ma ma bston grogs ngan 'grogs)ri/ /mdor na sgo gsum g.yengs nasapa'i yul/ /de dag nyams pa'i rkyen du gsungs/ /gdon gyis 97bar chad chang gis myos/ /log lta skyes dang khengs grags 'dod/ /nyon mongs zil non bla mas skyo/ /'dod chags chen po skyes pa dag /dam tshig nyams pa'i dus yin te/ /spyir ni rtsod ldan dus su gsungs/ /gdon sogs gzhan gyis byin brlabs 7tshe/ /bsrung ba'i 'du shes sngon song na/ /chen po rdzogs kyang chung ngur gsungs/ /'du shes sngon du ma song na/ /bag med nyams pa so na gnas/ /gdon sogs rang gis ma mthong na/ /de yang nyams pa chung bar gsungs/ /'khor bas skyo dang rnam smin dran/ /bla ma dran dang 'dod pa skyes/ /bar chad 11bral ba bshags pa'i dus/ /sbyor ba dngos gzhi rtsonyamajug dang gsum/ /gang rdzogs tshad ni mthar phyin te/ /che 'bring dbye bas shes par bya/ /sbyor ba ltung ba chung ngu ste/ /dngos gzhi 3 ltung ba 'bring du 79—726

'byung ske/ /mjug rdzogs lhung ba chen por nges/ /rgyan dang phyag rgya phyag mtshan dag /'chang ba bsten 0)pa'i dam tshig yin/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams ni/ /bza' bar bya ba'i dam tshig go/ /sems can dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la/ /longs spyod mchod pa gang byed pa/ /blta bar bya ba'i dam tshig gos / /rang gzhan rinanasgyu mar gang shes pa/ /shes par bya ba'i dam tshig go/ /sgo gsum sku gsung thugs su bsam/ /bsrung bar bya ba'i dam tshig go kyi/ /nyon mongs dug paradrug gzung 'dzin kun/ /rang rig skye ba med par bsgral/ /bsgral ba'i dam tshig chen po yin/ /dam tshig don du dam tshig dag /dus drug dus gnyis lo bar du/ /brtul zhugs can gyis dam tshig bsrung ne/ /dngos grub don du rtag tu bsrung / /skad cig tsam yang gnang ba med/ /rang gi lus kyi nyes pa las /gzhan gyi lus kyi nyes 'byung ba/ /'di ni sku yi nyes par bshad/ /rang gi lus kyi (7)nyes pa las/ /gzhan gyi ngag gi nyes 'byung ba/ /bdag gi sku yi nyams pa ste / /gzhan la gsung gi nyams par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang mkhas pas tshonashes par bya/ /rang la rtsa ba'i nyes pa las/ /gzhan la yan lag nyes 'byung dang / /legs pa las ni nyes 99)'byung sogs/ /bla ma'i zhal nas shes bya ste/ /'bad de dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /dam tshig de yi don rnams la/ /'khor rnams 'jigs shing skrag gyur te/ /rdo rje phag mos yang zhus pa/ /dam tshig 'di yi don rnams ni/ /zab cing rgya che rtog 1 par dka'/ /mgon po khyod kyis bzhes par zhu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bdud rtsi khar zos 11slar la dor ba med/ /ngan skyugs phyir dor slar la za ba med/ /rang rig byang chub bdud rtsi'i ro tshor na/ /log rtog 'khrul pa'i rgyu 'bras ga la tshol/ /de bas 79wa 727

bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (45)

༄tshog /rgya gar skad du/ shrī asdi mā la ge tan+t+ra rā dza( / bod skad du/dpal me'i phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo / /ha ha hi hi ho te cadakye/ /bdag la khyed la zhu ba mchis/ /shrī ni gang lags ho gang lags/ /ru ni gang lags ka gang lags/ /dbang bzhi ho ru ka gang lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs rnam par spangs/ /5ru ni tshogs dang bral ba nyid/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas so/ /de lta'i dpal ldan te ru ka /rtag tu lus dang sems la gnas/ /de nyid la yang rnam pa bzhi/ /dbang bzhi grangs kyis nges pa ste/ /dang po bum dbang he ru ka /sku dang phyag mtshan snang 6)ba'i tshe / /rang sems las su rung ba ste/ /de tshe 'jig rten tha mal pa'i/ /rgyu drug rkyen bzhi 'bras bu bzhi/ /spangs pa'i phyir na (7he zhes brjod/ /las dang nyon 79wa 730

mongs tshogs dang bral/ /de yi phyir na ru zhes brjod/ /'jig rten tha mal rnam rtog gi/ /gzung 'dzin gang yang mi gnas pa'i/ /phyir na ka zhes gsungs pa'o/ /thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug pas/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis 'gags rdziganyis su med/ /de yi phyir na shrī ru brjod/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa te ru ka /phag mo la gnas tshogs dang ldan/ /zag med rgyu rkyen kun dang ldan/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis kyi tshul/ /de nas gsang dbang he ru ka /nyi zla phyag mtshan yig 'bru'i tshogs/ /bskyed rim na rgyu rkyen kun spangs te/ /rlung sogs las su rung bas na/ /de yi phyir na he zhes brjod/ /phyi yi sbyin sreg gtor ma dang / /mchod pa dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i/ /tshogs dang bral ba'i phyir na ru/ /bskyed pa'i rdo rje phag mo dang / /dmigs dang lta spyod gang la yang / /mi gnas phyir na ka zhes brjod/ /bskyed pa'i gzung 'dzin gnyis med ma'o / /phyir na shrī zhes gsungs pa ste/ /rgyu rnams lam la sogs dang ldan / /rlung sogs thabs dang shes rab tshul/ /rlung sogs sgyu ma'i ngo bor gnas / /rtsa rlung rang bzhin gnas la sogs/ /nang gi rgyu dang rkyen sogs ldanal/ /nang gi dpal ldan te ru ka /de nas gsum pa'i he ru ka /rlung sogs rang bzhin gnas pa yi/ /rgyu spangs phyir ni he zhes brjod/ /rlung sogs lam la brten pa yi/ /tshogs dang bral phyir ru zhes brjod/ /rlung dang rtsa dang thig le dang / / tsaṇ+ḍa lī ri༄yi kha dog dang / /dbyibs la mi gnas phyir na ka /sems nyid bde bar gnas pas so/ /nang gi thabs dang shes rab med / / de yi smyon/phyir na shrī ru gsungs/ /mig ser nad kyis btab pa ltar/ /rang sems bde bar gnas pas so/ /sems nyid bde bar gnas pa dang / /73—731

bde ba la bsten 1༄tshogs dang ldan/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyu rkyen ldan/ /sems dang bde ba tha dad med/ /sems dang bde ba gang gnas pa/ /mchog dang chad pa'i dbus gnas pa/ /gsum pa'i dpal ldan he ru ka /de nas bzhi pa'i te ru ka /rang rig stong par gnas pa'i tshe/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rgyu rkyen bral / /de yi phyir na ho zhes brjod / /pha rol phyin drug bde ba'i lam/ /thams cad stong par ro gcig pas/ /tshogs gnyis bral phyir ru zhes brjod/ /bde ba tsam la'ang mi gnas phyir/ /ka zhes ( nges par brjod pa yin/ /sems nyid rang rig stong par gnas/ /stobs sogs phun sum tshogs pas na/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa dang / /gzugs sku'i rgyu rkyen la sogs ldan/ /shrī zhes bya ba mngon par brjod/ /dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med/ /dngos por ro mnyam mtha' yas pa'i/ /sems kyi de nyid la gnas pa/ /bzhi pa'i dpal ldan he ru ka /bdud rnams kun la tho 'tsham zhing / /lhan cig bskyes pa'i dur khrod rol95/ /mi gsal gsal ba'i rang bzhin med/ /snang zhing gsal la rang bzhin med/ /me long bzhin 'dra chu zla bzhin/ /mkhas pas 'bad de 'khrul pa spang / /de ltar don ni ma rtogs par/ /kha cig sku mdog phyag mtshan ri la / /ho ru ka yi rnam par rtog /kha cig gzugs brnyan rnam par rtog /kha cig rang gi ngo bor 'dod/ /de bzhin rtsa dang rlung 'dod sogs/ /de bzhin rang rig he ru ka /bla ma ma bsten brtson 'grus med/ /shes rab mi ldan bzod sogs med/ /rigs dang rig pa'i nga rgyal can/ /khe dang grags pa rnyed dang dga'/ /rgyu des log rtog sna tshogs bskyed/ /de bas ho ru kur grags pa'i/ /dngos grub 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /dad ldan gus bcas 73—732

pha rol phyin/ /rdzogs byas bla ma dam pa las/ /man ngag yang dag blang bar bya / /ma mo'i tshogs kyis yang zhus (19pa/ /he ru ka dpal de ltar na/ /rdo rje phag mo ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje gsum ste phag mo tshonaganyis/ /don gyi rdo rje de nas brtags9sder/ /tha ma rdzas kyi rdo rje ste/ /don gyi rdo rje bzhi pa ste/ /gzung 'dzin rnam par rtog pa yis/ /mi phyed phyir na rdo rje ste/ /dbang bzhis rdo rje re re'o/ /rtags kyi rdo rje gsum yin te/ /rtse gsum rtse lnga rtse dgu ste/ /rtse gsum sku gsung thugs kyi rtags/ /rtse lnga ye shes lnga yin te/ /khams gsum sa dgu 'joms pa yi/ /rtags su rdo rje rtse dgu'o / /rdzas kyi rdo rje bzhi yin te/ /zlum po la sogs rnam pa bzhi/ /mi shes dri mas ches gos pa'i/ /dud 'gror skyes pa'i phag mo dang / /shes rab char byung phag mo ste/ /de nyid rnam pa bzhi ru nges/ /bum dbang zhe sdang gti mug phag /gsang dbang rlung gi gti mug phag /gsum pa chags dga' gti mug phag /bzhi pa chos dbyings gti mug phag /'di nyid khyod la legs par gtad / /thams cad rjes su yi 4)rang ngo / /dpal me'i phreng ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po shrī he ru ku'i nges par 'byung ba rdzogs sor// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po ga 6ya dha ra dang / lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur cing zhus pa'o//79wa 733
