༄ga /dpal mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/1༄ho /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ḍā ki nī gu h+ya dz+wa (nal tan+t+ra rā dza ri/ bod skad du/ dpal mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba 'bar ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal bde ba chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kye a la la ho/ kye a la la ho/ mkha' 'gro gang lags ma gang lags/ /gsang dang rgyud dang rgyal po gang / /nyon cig byang chub sems dpa' khyod/ /mkha' 'gro bzhi ste ma ni gsum/ /gsang ba drug ste rgyud brgyad do/ /rgyal po bcu dgu dag tu bstan/ /dang po mkha' 'gro dbye ba yang / /rags pa'i rtog pa spang ba'i phyir/ /bum pa'i dbang dang 'brel pa yi/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan dang po'ordo / /sku mdog phyag mtshan spang ba'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i dbang dang 'brel pa yi/ /rlung dang rtsa sogs tsaṇ+ḍa smi(ge / /'di dag mkha' 'gro gnyis pa ste/ /dman pa rnams la sku dang phyag /rlung dang rtsa sogs kha dog dbyibs/ /de nyid spang bar bya ba'i phyir/ /shes 79—735

rab ye shes dang 'brel pa'i/ /lhan cig skyes pa dga' ba'i ro/ /'di dag gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro ste/ /mkha' 'gro 'di rnams rim pa las/ /dman pa rnams 1la phra ba'i gzugs/ /lus sems tshor ba bde ba las/ /'das pa'i bde ba chen po dag /spang 2 phyir rang rig ye shes te / /sems kyi de nyid stong ba'i ro/ /de nyid mkha' 'gro bzhi pa ste/ /shes brjod kun gyi yul ma yin/ /de nyid lnga la sogs pa yi/ /mkha' 'gro 'di rnams rim pa yang / /sku mdog phyag mtshan rags 0pa'i gnyen/ /rlung dang rtsa sogs bum dbang spong / /bde bas rlung dang rtsa sogs spong / /rang rig stong pas bde ba spong / /gzugs sku gnyis kyis stong pa spong / /de phyir gong ma gnyen por 5bshad/ /rags pa phung sogs bum dbang rgyu/ /bum dbang gsang dbang rgyu yin te/ /gsang ba gsum pa'i rgyu ru nges/ /bde ba rang rig skyed pa (6yi/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu nges pa ste/ /'bras bu bzhi dang mi mthun bzhi/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rim pa'o/ /ma ni rnam pa gsum yin te/ /'dod chags chen pos bcom ldan 'das/ /zhe sdang chen pos bcom ldan 'das/ /gti mug chen pos bcom ldan 'das/ /nga rgyal la sogs de dang 'dra/ /thun mong (7ma yin sras 'byung bas/ /ma zhes gsungs pa yin par 'dod/ /snod min gsang ba sgrogs thos pa/ /skrag pa thun mong tsho rim yin bskyed/ /bskyed pa'i phyir na (9ma zhes bya/ /skye ba gcig gis sangs rgyas pasal/ /sras rnams thun mong ma yin skyed/ / de yi 11phyir na nya ma zhes bya/ /thun mong bla ma'i zhal nas shes/ /de nas gsang ba bshad bya ste/ /bdud rtsi drug dag gsang ba ste/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ro/ /reg bya de bzhin chos yin te/ /rgyud ni dbang bzhi ngo bo ste/ /brjod bya rjod (12byed 79—736

brgyad du bshad/ /gsang ba lnga ni rgyal po lnga/ /lta ba spyod pa zung 'jug lam/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu sa la sogs/ /bcu dgu rgyal po yin par gsungs/ /kye bo (1)dpa' bo 'jigs pa che/ /gnod sbyin gzugs dang srin po gzugs/ /gzhan yang bdud la sogs pa'i gzugs/ /sna tshogs ston na ji ltar bgyi/ /lha 'am klu la sogs pa'i gzugs/ /sdug pa ston na ji ltar bgyi/ /gnod sbyin sgra dang srin po'i (gesgra/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i sgra grag na/ /de la bdag gis ji ltar bgyi / /tshangs pa'i bsgra dang ngang pa'i sgra/ /sgra snyan byung na ji ltar bgyi/ /bya rgod dri dang gla (sku)rtsi dri/ /ngan skyugs la sogs dri byung na/ /de la bdag gis ji ltar bgyi/ /gur gum tsan+dan (derig pur sogs/ /dri zhim byung na ji ltar bgyi/ /bdud rtsi la sogs drug cu rirmesogs/ /bzang po ston na ji ltar bgyi/ /ngan skyugs la sogs dman pa'i ro/ /sna tshogs ston na ji ltar bgyi/ /reg bya lcags kyi spu gri sogs/ /rtsub pa byung na ji ltar bgyi/ /dar men la sogs lus kyis reg /'jam pa byung na ji ltar bgyi/ /'jig rten chos rnams sna tshogs dang ske/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i chos rnams ston/ /de la bdag gis ji ltar bgyi / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gzugs ngan khong khro mi bskyed cing ske/ /gzugs bzang 'dod par mi bya ste/ /de la lus kyi phyag rgya du cibastan/ /lan byed dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yi/ /dngos grub sprul pa yin par nges/ /brtul zhugs can gyis dngos grub blang / /lan med bdud kyi bar chad de/ /bdud bsal ba yi cho ga brtsam / /kun la mkhas pas sbyor bar bya/ /sgra snyan 'dod pa mi bskyed cing 9/ /'jigs pa'i sgra la khong mi khro/ /de la btang besnyoms sems bya ste/ /rdo rje glu 11yis brtag par bya/ /de bzhin dri bzang mi 79wa 737

rgyal po zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /rdo rje snying pos yang gsol pa/ /re re'i bye brag ma 'tshal 1bas/ /de yi dbye ba bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje rnam pa gsum yin te/ /don gyi rdo rje de nas rtags/ /rdzas kyi rdo rje dang ni gsum/ /de nas don gyi rdo rje bshad/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pas mi phyed phyir/ /don gyi rdo rje bshad pa'o/ /dbang bzhi rdo rje re re ste/ /rdo rje bzhi ru bshad pa yin/ /rtags kyi rdo rje gsum yin te/ /rtse gsum rtse lnga rtse dgu pa/ /rtse gsum sku gsung thugs kyi rtags/ /rtse lnga ye shes lnga yi rtags/ /rtse dgu khams gsum sa dgu'i rtags/ / rdzas kyi 92༄rdo rje bzhi yin te/ /bum pa'i dbang dang 'brel pa yi/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan la sogs lhasbyon)/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog ni/ /'jig nga dang 'joms pas rdo rje'o/ /gsang ba'i dbang dang 'brel pa yi/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le la/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis su gang rtog pa/ /'jig cing 'joms pas rdo rje'o/ /shes rab ye shes dang 'brel pa'i/ /lhan cig skyes dga' la sogs la/ /gzung dang 'dzin par gang rtog pa/ /'jig cing 'joms pas rdo rje yin/ /bzhi pa'i dbang dang 'brel pa yi/ /rang gerig sems nyid tshoyestong nyid la/ /gzung 'dzin gnyis su gang rtog 7pa/ /'jig cing 'joms pas rdo rje'o/ /de nas rtags kyi rdo rje ni/ /rtse gsum sku gsung thugs su bshad/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'jig cing 'joms pas rdo rje ste/ /rtse lnga ye shes lnga yi rtags/ /nga rgyal la sogs rnam pa lnga/ /'jig cing 'joms pas rdo rje'o/ /de nas rdzas kyi rdo rje ni / /rnam pa bzhi ru bstan pa ste/ /zur gsum rno la 'bigs pa dang / /gru bzhi dag ni gsal bar byed/ /zlum pos rdzas rnams 'joms par byed/ /zur 79—742

dgod thabs ji ltar lags/ /de rnams dbus kyi lte bar ni/ /yi ge dgod pa gang dang gang / /gtum mo 1nisbar ba ji ltar lags/ /zla ba nyi ma ji ltar lags / /gnas ni gang du gzung bar bgyi/ /rkyen gnyis 'khor lo ji ltar lags / /go bzlog tshul ni ji ltar lags/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo bzhi gang lags / /de rnams kyi ni dgongs pa dang / /de la dga' sogs ji ltar 'byung ske/ /stong pa bcu drug ji ltar lags/ /sa yi rim pa ji ltar lags/ /de rnams kyi ni dgongs pa dang / /dgos pa'i dgongs pa ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nyon cig dpa' bo rdo rje khyod/ /khyod la bshad kyis legs par zung / /rtsa rnams kyi ni rang bzhin ni/ /nam mkha' gnyis med thams cad bskyed / /der gnas rlung gi rang bzhin ni/ /g.yo ba rnam shes g.yo ba yin/ /thig le stong nyid ngo bo ste/ /stong nyid bsam du med pa'o / /thig le grangs ni bcu drug ste/ /rtsa dang rlung yang de bzhin no/ /de nas sems gzung bstan pa ni/ /rtsa rlung dang ni thig le la/ /gnyis med rtse gcig sems dang po/ /'khor lo'i grangs ni bzhi yin te/ /bde chen 'khor lo longs spyod chos/ /de 'og sprul pa'i 'khor lo ste/ /de tsho re la yang bzhi bzhi ste / /bcu drug grangs su shes par bya/ /me rlung gnyis ni rkyen yin te/ /ro ma'i 'khor lo nyid dang ni/ /spyi gtsug 'khor lo dbang bskur gnas/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo bzhi yin te/ /bde skyong 'khor lo dang po ste/ /rta mgrin 'ilongs spyod 'khor lo yin/ /rig pa'i 'khor lo gsum pa'o(5)/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo bzhi yin no/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi grangs su bstan/ /rtsa rnams rang bzhin nga yis bshad/ /rtsa ni sa yi rang bzhin te/ /rlung dang thig le'i rang bzhin 79—746

gzung ske/ /go bzlog lugs su bzlog pa ste/ /mthar thug gnas su gzung ba'o/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo bzhi pa ni/ /gsang ba bde skyong 'khor lo ste/ /hūm̐ ni lte bar dgod byas nas/ /'dab 14rim lnga bcu brgyad kyi grangs/ /gsal byed lugs bzhin dgod par bya/ /dbyangs yig rim gnyis dag bkod ②nas/ /tha ma bzung ste spangs pa'o/ /sdig pa spong phyir bde skyong ste/ /de phyir bde skyong zhes ni bshad ri/ /rta mgrin (4'khor lo'i 'dab 5)bzung la/ /dbyangs yig lugs dang lugs min dgod/ /lte bar u ni dgod par bya/ /bde ba'i longs spyod myong ba'i phyir/ /rta mgrin 'khor lo ru ni bshad/ /rig pa'i 'khor lo 'dab 6rim lnga/ /lte bar haṃ ni dgod byas nas/ /'dab ma lnga la oṃ rtsu ṭ+wāṃ 7a/ /g.yas nas rim gyis nadagod par bya/ /bzhi pa'i don ni rig pa'i phyir/ /rig pa'i 'khor lo zhes ni bshad/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo rim pa drug /lte ba 'dab bzhi 'dab nyam brgyad/ /bcu drug sum becu hu)rtsa gnyis te//drug cu 15rtsa bzhi bshad pa yin/ /lte bar a ni dgod pa ste/ /e baṃ ma yā nyusnyede rnams ni/ /'dab sam bzhi la g.yon nas dgod/ /'dab bem brgyad la dgod bya ba/ /sde brgyad kyi ni dang po brgyad/ /g.yon gyi rim pas dgod par bya / /'dab 15ma bcu drug gang yin pa / /ma mo bcu drug g.yon nas dgod/ /'dab 1 ma sum cu 19gnyis sogs la/ /dbyangs yig yi ge bcu drug ni/ /g.yas dang g.yon gyi rim pas dgod/ /'dab 3 ma drug cu 21rtsa bzhi la/ /g.yas nas kā li lugs bzhin dgod/ /ā li rim gnyis g.yon nas dgod/ /gsang ba'i dbang bskur na ba yi /phyir/ /gsang ba'i 'khor lo zhes ni bshad/ /de nas ro ma'i 'khor lo ni/ /'dab rim gnyis la lte bar bcas/ /ma ning 79wa 748

༄ga /dpal rdo rje grub pa dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/9)༄7༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra sid+dha 9badzā la si ba ra tan+t+ra rā dza95da/bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje grub pa dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ /dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa cho)dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das dga' ldan gyi gnas rin po che'i khang bzangs kyi 7denang na byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang / dga' ba'i 'od dang / dri ma med pa'i 'od la sogs pa dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor dpag tu med pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi de kho na nyid 9sgrubatsun mo'i bha ga la snyoms par bzhugs 7pa'i dus su rigs sgyu ma'i dbang du mdzad de thams cad kyis 987lha'i phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa'i mchod pas mchod pa'i dus su byang chub sems dpa' byams pas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ thal mo sbyar nas gsol pa/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /de nyid don dam gang 79—752

yin pa/ /dpal dang rdo rje don dang ni/ /dra ba sdom pa rgyud kyi don/ /des bstan sdom pa ①gang yin pa/ /de nyid bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /byams pa la sogs 'khor rnams kun/ /phyi rol don la g.yengs pa'i ②sems/ /nang du bsdus (sne)la rtse gcig nyon/ /dpal ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /de nyid mchod pa'i 'os yin la/ /gnyis med bde bas mchod par bya/ /rdo rje zhes bya ye shes lnga/ /gzung 'dzin rtog pas mi phyed phyir/ /rdo rje zhes ni bstan pa yin/ /de nyid don la rtse gcig pas / /chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po'i/ /sa ni nges par 'thob (4pa'o/ /dra ba zhes pa mang po'i don/ /kun rdzob gzhan rig tu bstan pas(ge/ /grangs mang (yergya cher bstan pa ni/ /nam mkha' dang mtshungs sdom pa'i don/ /nam mkha' dang mtshungs rang rig ni/ /sems kyi de nyid stong pa'i ro/ /skad cig de yi largyun nyid la/ /rgyud ces bya bar bstan pa yin/ /dpal rdo rje grub pa dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud las mtshan gyi rgyud bstan 8)pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //de nas gzhan yang nga yis bshad/ /ye shes skye ba'i rgyu dang gnas/ /rkyen dang de bzhin dmigs pa'i yul/ /bye brag ming gi rnam grangs dang / /don gyi rnam grangs gang yin dang / /phan yon dang ni 'bras bu dang / /don dam de nyid chos kyi dbyings/ /de nyid 'dir ni bshad par bya/ /rgyu ni rang rig ye shes te/ /rgyu med rgyu yi rang bzhin can/ /rang rig sgyu 9rimar byung ba ni/ /bde chen 'khor lo nas brtsams te/ /'khor lo bzhi 'am brgyad gnyis bshad/ /de bzhin nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ /ye shes skye ba'i rten yin la/ /gnas ni de dang 73—753

mnyam pa'i gyo)rtsa/ /grogs ni ye shes rlung yin te/ /ye shes rlung gi bzhon ②pa la / /zhon nas de nyid byung (kyeb yin/ /grangs ni snga ma ltar shes bya/ /ngo bo thig le nyid yin te/ /thig le mdud pa'i grangs su shes/ /de yi phan yon gang yin pa/ /gzung (pe'adzin rnam par rtog pa yis/ /phyin ci log tu brtags pa yi / /rnam par rtog pa spong ba yin/ /'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen po'i/ /sa ni nges par thob pa'o/ /dpal rdo rje dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud las ye shes kyi rgyu dang gnas la sogs pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /'khor lo rnams kyi dbye ba ni/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab (zhenam ni/ /sum cu 96)rtsa gnyis grangs yin no/ /de nas longs spyod 'khor lo ni/ /'dab ma bcu drug dag tu bstan/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i 'dab ma ni/ /drug cu ⑦ma bzhi dag yin no/ /bde chen 'khor lo sor bzhi ste/ /longs spyod 'khor lo sor bcu drug /chos kyi 'khor lo sor bcu gnyis/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo sor bcu drug /bde chen 'khor lo'i lte ba ru/ /haṃ ni dkar po thur bltas bsam2/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i lte dbus su/ /oṃ ni dmar po gyen bltas bsam/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte dbus su/ /r+ghaṃ ni sngon po thur bltas bsamartson/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i lte dbus su/ /āḥ ni dmar po gyen bltas bsamanyurte/ /dang po'i 'khor lo'i 'dab ma la/ /dbyangs kyi yi ge bcu drug ni/ /lugs 'byung lugs min dgod par bya/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i 'dab 8ma la/ /dbyangs yig bcu drug rim 3gebazhin dgod/ /chos kyi 'khor lo'i 0'dab ma la/ / lī 73—754

māṃ dzā ṭ+wāṃ/0) /yi ge 'di rnams g.yon nas dgod/ / oṃ ṭ+wāṃ s+thā (kyes/ /mtshams nas g.yas su dgod par bya/ /sprul pa'i 'dab sam bzhi rtsibs la/ /gsal byed yi bge sum cu ⑤gnyis/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog tshul dgod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rtsa gsum ni/ /dbus nas drang por gnas pa ste/ /rtsu ni dkar po gyethur bltas pa/ /mar gyi rtse la thug 9)par dgod/ /g.yas na ⑧thabs kyi rtsa gnas te/ /kā sti'i sum cu martsa gnyis ni/ /thabs la lan gsum bskor byas na⑨/ /lugs 'byung 'og tu kha bltas dgod/ /g.yon na shes rab rtsa gnas la/ /ma mo dbyangs yig bcu drug ni/ /gyen la bltas pa dgod par bya / /sgal (3tshigs la gnas srog la brten(8/ /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i gnas der ni/ /rin chen dang 'dra 'dud 8pa ni/ /dgu por gnas pa bya gdong tshul / /chos kyi dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ /bde ba rag 7ster ma ni bzhugs/ /gzhan yang rkyen gyi 'khor lo gnyis/ /gru gsum gnas su yi ge raṃ/ /de ni yongs su gyur pa las/ /me yi 'khor lo gru gsum pa/ /tshad ni sor gsum nyid yin te/ /lte bar ro ni dmar po bsamanyane/ /'dab nyu ma gsum la oṃ āḥrgyu/ /gru gsum zur la dgod bya ba/ /rdo rje rtse gsum bsam par bya/ /rlung gi gnas su yi ge yo/ /de nyid yongs su gyur pa las/ /mdog nag gzhu yi dbyibs 'dra la(nyel/ /tshad ni sor bzhi nyid yin no/ /dbus su 'dab 1tshem lnga yin te/ /lte bar yaṃ ni nag po bsam/ /'dab 2 snam lnga la dha lnga dgod/ /ba dan lnga yis mtshan pa'o/ /rlung gis tsho nyedam tshig me sbar bas/ /dam tshig me yis gtum mo bskul / /'khor lo gsum bsregs 22nyid pa tsam/ /yi ge haṃ ni bsros pa yis/ /haṃ bzhu bdud rtsi'i char yang bab/ /lte ba'i gnas su thig ler gyur/ /rgyun du 73wa 755

'bar bar gyur pa yis/ /rin chen dbyibs 'dra'i nang slebs nas/ /rang bzhin dga' ba nyams myong bas/ /rang gi sems kyi snying po'i ro/ /bzhi pa'i dpal ldan ho ru ka /de nyid rtogs par gyur pa yis/ /chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po'i/ /sa ni nges par thob pa'o/ /dpal rdo rje grub pa dra ba'i sdom pa'i rgyud las 'khor lo bzhi bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /yid bzhin nor bu dang mtshungs pa'i/ /nges don du ni nga yis gsungs/ /de yi don la khyed rnams kyis/ /rtse gcig sems kyis yid la zung / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang ske/ byams pa dang / dga' ba'i 'od dang / dri ma med pa'i 'od la sogs pa dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor dpag tu med pa thams cad dga' zhing mgu nas rjes su yi rangs stinas lha'i mchod pa rnam pa du mas mchod pa ni nam mkha' la rin po che'i char dang / sgeg pa dang / rgod pa dang /dga' ba'i mchod pa'i rnam pa dang / ba ṭa ha rinal sogs pa'i mchod pa dang /gzhan yang lha'i me tog dang / spos dang / mar me dang / zhal zas kyi mchod pa ro brgya na pa dang / btung ba'i mchod pas mchod de/ gzhan yang nang dang / gsang ba dang / gsang ba'i gsang ba bla na med pa'i mchod pa chen po rmad du byung bas mchod nas lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ so so'i rdzu 'phrul gyis mi snang bar gyur tongari/ /dpal rdo rje grub pa dra ba sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po rdzogs so(5// //79—756

rgya gar 3) mkhan po ga 1)ya dha ra dang / lo:: ba dge slong shāspru/ ye shes kyis bsgyur ②cing zhus pa'o//bsdur mchan/752 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ kun)〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sidha/①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉dz+ra/ ④〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa'i/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉bzang kyi/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bzang gi/⑥〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 nyid/ (7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉zhugs/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉kyi/752 4)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉don ni/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉g.yeng ba'i/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sdus/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉thob/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa/ yi〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉med/⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉de'i/ 2〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sdom/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉rgyu/754 ①〈〈co 〉〉par/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gzhon/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉'byung / ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈khu 〉〉bzung /⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉mdab/ yi〈〈g.yung 〉〉brgyu/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sam/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉mthur bltas sam/ bo〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 /⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sam/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉mdab/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rims/ ④〈〈khu 〉〉lo/755 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉lo mi pi rta/ 〈〈co 〉〉lo me paṃ te/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 traṃ hri/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 tre gli/ la〈〈g.yung 〉〉mdab/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yig ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/ dul〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉por/ ⑦〈〈khu 〉〉thugs/ ⑧〈〈co 〉〉nas/ ⑨〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ka 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bcu/'oḥ〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉nas/ ma〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rgal/ ri 12〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rten/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉mdud/ 8〈〈khu 〉〉reg ④〈〈li 〉〉gsam/ rtso 7〈〈g.yung 〉〉mdab/ nyanye〈〈co 〉〉ba/ (17〈〈li 〉〉mdab/ bu 〈〈g.yung 〉〉mdab/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gi/ tsho 2〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg756 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yid rang / 〈〈co 〉〉yi rang / ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉ta ha/ 〈〈pe 〉〉ta ṭa/ kyi〈〈li 〉〉rgya/ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉te/ tshoge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sto/757 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gā/ ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgyur/79wa 757
brtsar 'azas re'u migargyud 'bum/ (5༷)79wa 758

༄ga /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po don gyi rgyud/1tsho༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta gsarba tan+t+ra/ bod skad du / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po don gyi rgyud/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje bdag /snying po mchog ni bzhugs pa'i sku/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la gzigs te / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku/ /sna tshogs gzugs can sems 'di ni/ /mtha' dang bral ba yin med kyi/ /srid dang 'khor bar rab tu grags/ /de na rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad gsol/ /kye ho rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /nam mkha'i bdag po sna tshogs lus/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag rig sngags rgyal/ /skye med dbyings nas snang byed 'khrungs/ /'gro drug 'dren pa khyod kyis gsungs/ /nyid kyi zhal nas thigs pa shor/ /ke 73—759

ke ru dang margad dang / /spug dang rdo yi snying po dang / /rin chen kha dog sna lnga pas / /ye shes gzhal yas kha dog spras/ /nyid las mi gzhan 'jigs byed dang ske/ /rgyal sras dad pa gtam nyan dang / /'gro ba 'dul ba'i 'khor rnams sol/ /de nas bcom ldan shāka thub kyi/ /gsung gi dgongs pa mkhyen nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi/ /rang 'byung ye shes bsdu ba mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs kyis 'di skad du/ /ched du rjod pa rnam par mdzad/ /gang zhig rtsol med bde chen don/ /lhan cig skyes pa ma mthong na/ /sgrub dang rtsol ba ci spyad kyang / /byis pa don med ga chad du/ /rdzas bzung ba ni 'ching ba nyid / /rten 'brel sgom pa gnyis pa'o/ /don med nyams myong 'dod pa yang / /'ching ba'i rgyu ste gsum pa'o/ /kha cig e ri'i thal bas byugs/ /dbang phyug nam mkha'i rdzas rnams sdud/ /'ching ba'i rgyu ste bzhi pa'o/ /gleng stigazhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// //mtha' dang bral ba'i rang bzhin la/ /gzung 'dzin nad kyis ci la 'ching //gdod nas dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ /bag chags mtshan mas ci la 'ching / /skye 'gag med pa'i chos nyid la/ /rgyu 'bras nad kyis ci la 'ching bsam dang bral ba'i ye shes la/ /rtog dpyod nad kyis ci la 'ching / /e ma'o rnam dag sems nyid klong / /lhan cig skyes pa bde ba'i mchog /'od gsal sna tshogs dus na bde/ /rnam dag 'khor lo bde ba la/ /bsnun pa'i blo gros log pa yis/ /srid rgyu nges pa'i rtsa bar 'khyams/ /gzhan yang ston pas 'di skad gsungs / /zhen chags can gyi gdul bya la/ /bde ba chen po bcos tshonasam sbyin/ /79—760

khong khro can gyi gdul bya la/ /g.yo ba rlung gi bcos ma sbyin/ /'dod pa chu bzhin gdungs pa la/ /bkri drang rang rgyud bcos ma sbyin/ /kun tu rmongs pa'i yid can la/ /stong pa snying rje bcos ma sbyin/ /ston pas de skad bka' stsal pas/ /'khor rnams bsdu ba rnam mdzad de/ /de bzhin gshegs la 'di skad gsol/ /ye nas rnam par dag pas na/ /khams gsum 'khor ba ji ltar lags / /glo bur pa zhig lags 'gyur na/ /thog mtha' yod par mi 'gyur ram / /yang na rdo rje sems sogs pa/ /dmyal bar 'tshed par mi 'gyur ram/ /'khor ba bde ba grub pa na/ /sbyang btub bam ni ci zhig gu/ /de skad gsol nas mi snang gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pas bka' stsal pa/ /nga la nyan pa khyed legs so/ /rtse gcig yid kyis dang bar byos/ /ma nges kha dog 'ja' tshon las / /rigs kyi khyad par tha dad snang / /ldan la lha mi gcig pa'o/ /ma bsdus gcig tu rdzogs pa'o/ /smra ba'i seng ge 'jigs (1)pa med/ /bka' yi dgongs pa shin tu zab/ /margad blo yis mching bu len/ /sna tshogs kha dog rigs su bsgyur/ /dper na swa ste ka bzhin no/ /ka ran da yi skye bzhin no/ /brtags shing brtags shing skye bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes sku/ /khyab bdag nam mkha'i sna tshogs gzugs/ /deng bdag sems dpa'i lus su 'gyur / /'gro ba'i mgon pos de skad du/ /bshad nas 'khor rnams dengs gyur te/ /phyogs gcig tu ni 'khod gyur nas/ /bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad gsol/ /lta ba'i rang bzhin ji lta bu/ /ma bcos ngo bo ji lta bu/ /ye shes spyod pa ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /legs so 'dus pa'i tshogs chen pos/ /rnam pa drug gi mtshan nyid de/ /khyad par 73—761

bdun dang mtshan pa'i dpe/ /bcu bzhi rnam pa ci rigs su/ /bcu gsum ma nor zhes su bshad/ /lhan cig skyes pa khyab gnas pa/ /mngon sum dbang gi ngo bor shar/ /sbyin pas bzlog nas bltas pa yis/ /nam mkha' las 'bab bde skyong nas/ /thur du 'khor lo drug rim du/ /a ta rak+ta hu)bde ba len/ /ye shes zer zhing sdug bsngal skye/ /rmongs pas mya ngan sdig pa 'dzin/ /de mi spong ba'i 'ching bar 'gyur/ /si dha'i tshul du dge slong gnyis/ /dbang rdzogs zer zhing bde ba spyod/ /'chi 'phos nas ni dmyal bar song / /rgyal po'i khab ni btsun mo can/ /tshom du sdud cing reg pa yis/ /ye shes gzhan la 'chad cing ston/ /'chi 'phos dur khrod sa ga yi/ /smad 'tshong ma yi srin bur skyes/ /'jig rten khams gzhan sems dmyal du/ /shin tu 'tshed cing 'bod par 'gyur / /py-ik+ṣa'i drung na a ko ta/ /bka' yi bsgo ba rnam par byed/ /kha sbyor ba ni ye shes zhes/ /bzhin bzang ma la legs par dgod/ /tshe 'phos nas ni ngu 'bod skyes/ /'chad pa'i skyes bu de phyir nges/ /khyod kyis 'dri ba bstan par bya/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ma bcos pa/ /mi rtogs lta ba mi dmigs shes//mi g.yo ngo bo mi 'da' dam/ /de skad gsungs nas mi snang gyur/ /'dri ba'i rtog pa dang po chod/ /'chad pa'i skyes bus yang gsol pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma gnyen gcig pu/ /dam phog pa ni ji ltar lags/ /dbang gi rang bzhin ji ltar lags/ /rtog pa gnyis pa dris pa las/ /lta ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba yi/ /gang la ming de skad bya yi/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs/ /mtshon pa'i dpe ni 'di skad gsungs/ /nag po 73—762

brtsegs pa pad pa ti/ /gri ta dang ni mang ka hu)dang / /phag dang glang po gzhon nu ma/ /zla ba chu shel glang seng dang / /o da chu bo gsum 'dres dang / /gser dang nam mkha'i ri bo me/ /gsum pa bcu bzhir shes par gyis/ /de bzhin nyid ldan dam pa ste/ /de las gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /dmyal bar yang dag 'tshed par bshad/ /e ma'o rang rig skal chen po/ /nam mkha'i sprin la 'bud par byed/ /byis pa rang bzhin mi shes pas/ /bcos med rang bzhin spro bsdu byed/ /rnam dag 'od gsal sgrib pa med/ /ye shes rgya mtshor zhugs rmongs pas/ /kun tu 'ching ba'i mdud pa nyid/ /kun tu 'ching ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i mda' 'phangs kyang / /bsnun pa'i blo gros log pa yis/ /gcig dang du mas sems bslad pas/ /rmongs pa nga rgyal spel bar byed/ /rlung gi rgyu ba dril ba'i lha/ /yig 'bru kha dog go bar byed/ /yid dang rlung ni rgyu ba na/ /snang ba 'gags pa ye shes so/ /de nyid log pas 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /tshangs pa yi ni tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ /spar bas lha nyid 'od du zhu/ /ka sogs g.yas dang g.yon du a/ /yig mgo tshig dang gsos pa dang / /stong phrag bdun cu'i rtsa lam nas/ /bab pa bde ba skyed par byed/ /don dam pa'o zhes su smra/ /rmongs pa bsdoms pas mdud pa grol/ /zag pa skyes pas 'ching bar 'gyur/ /lhan cig skyes pas rigs pa yis/ /ci rigs pa ru gzhan la ston / /grol bar 'gyur zhes nga mi smra/ /e ma'o blo ni gnyis su snang / /ji ltar spyad kyang grol mi 'gyur/ /dbang gi le'u ste gsum pa'o// //gang la ming de skad bya ba'i/ /ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs/ /de 73—763

nas rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /rtog pa gsum la gcad pa'i phyir/ /stan las langs te 'di skad gsol/ /nam mkha'i bdag po sna tshogs lus/ /sgom pa'i rang bzhin ji ltar lags/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje dpa' khyod la/ /phyag 'tshal rdo rje rang byung sems/ /phyag rnams dag pa 'od gsal dbyings/ /phyag 'tshal 'dud cing phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /'gro ba'i bla ma ye shes gzugs/ /gsung gi thigs pa lhan cig skyes/ /rnam dag rang rig dbyings la 'dud/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /kye ma sems dpa' rdo rje nyon/ /mngon du gyur pa sgom pa'i mchog /sna tshogs 'bar ba ye shes drod/ /ci yang mthong la med rtogs na/ /ma mthong gnas na mthong ba ru/ /mthong na 'gag cing bltas na skyel/ /shes rab ye shes 'od po che/ /ci dgar bzhag na bde ba 'gog /ye shes rgya mtsho ye gsal la/ /sangs rgyas sgom par mi mdzad do/ /de la gnyen po yod dam ci/ /rigs pas ston pa 'ching ba'i nad/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi/ /bde ba de ni ston mdzad dam/ /rdo rje sems dpa' khyod nyid kyis/ /bstan par nus sam 'on te ci/ /bsnyad du med pas brjod dang bral/ /bsgrub tu med pas dpe dang bral/ /mtshon du med pas tshig lam chad/ /lhan cig skyes pas bsgrub tu med/ /mngon du gyur pas bsgom du med/ /dpyad du med pas bcos dang bral/ /ma yengs blo yis rtogs pa'o/ /bsgom pa'i le'u 'di bshad pa'i tshe/ /'chad pa'i skyes bu nyid kyang ni/ /brgyal nas sa la 'gyel gyur te/ /lha min rig sngags 'chang ba rnams/ /so sor byer te dengs par gyur/ /lha yi bu mo stong phrag ni/ /chos la rdul mig rnam par dag /byang chub sems dpa' nyanyi khri yang / /de ma thag tu mngon sangs rgyas/ /'jig 73—764

rten khams ni drug g.yos pas/ /'ur 'ur po dang chem chem gyis/ /khams gsum po ni 'dar bar byed/ /de yi mod la sems rdzogs pa/ /ngo mtshar skyes nas 'di skad gsol/ /e ma'o sangs rgyas kun gyi rje/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas pa bde ba'i mchog /skal ldan 'dul byed gnyen gcig pu/ /'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron/ /khyod kyi thugs kyi ye shes kyis/ /ma rig sgo nga'i ling thog bsal/ /rnam dag ye shes khyod la 'dud/ /dga' mgu rangs nas gsol pa dang / /thams cad 'dud cing 'khod par byed/ /sgom pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //de skad bcom ldan shākya thub/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la gzigs te/ /bka' yi bsgo ba 'di skad mdzad/ /legs so 'dus pa'i tshogs chen rnams/ /yang dag ye shes la zhugs pas/ /rnam rtog 'ching ba'i nad dang bral/ /mtha' dang bral ba'i rang bzhin la/ /bzlog pas bltas pa tha dad 'dzin/ /gnyug ma'i rang bzhin lhan cig skyes/ /de yang bcings pas ci la mthong / /gang gis de nyid mngon gyur pa/ /de la sdig pas ci la 'dzin/ /dus gsum 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa/ /de la byin gyis rlob par mdzad/ /de la gal te gzugs yod na/ /dpag gam gzhal du btub bam ci/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ /de la ci rigs skyob par byed/ /gnod sbyin mthu chen thob pa yang ske/ /srung ba rgyun du byed par 'gyur/ /grul bum srin po gdon rnams kyis//de yi bsam pa yongs su bsgrub/ /nad dang shu ba 'bras dang rims/ /de yi lus la 'byung mi 'gyur/ /bskal par bsags pa'i sgrib pa yang / /skad cig ma yis 'byang bar 'gyur/ /rgyun du zhugs dang lan cig 'ong / /phyir mi ldog 79—765

pa'i sems dpa' yis/ /de yi gzi brjid 'phel bar byed/ /de bas sems dpa' chen po nyon/ /khyab pa'i 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /de nyid pha rol phyin drug ldan/ /yi ge med dang rig pa'i gsung / /dam pa'i don la 'jal bar nus/ /don gyis chos nyid 'jal bar ston/ /bla ma'i zhal nas dris na skye//rtogs na rnal 'byor skyes bu de/ /nam mkha'i rdul phran ston par 'gyur/ /ma rabs sgyu ma'i tshig la 'dzin/ /lhan cig skyes pa mthong ngam ci/ /gal te mthong na brtag par 'gyur/ /brtags na yengs te 'khyam par 'gyur/ /gnyis kyi blo la mya ngan snang / /kha dog gcig tu bsgyur ba yi/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo mchog /rnal ma la gnas 'ching grol 'gyur/ /gang zhig bla ma'i drin shes dag /skye ba med pa nyid du ston/ /bla ma'i bka' drin mi shes pa/ /de yis lhan skyes ci la mthong / /lhan cig skyes pa de yis bcings/ /de la 'gro ba skye zhing 'ching / /tha dad gzengs pas nad du gyur/ /dus dang gnas su bgrangs pas ldog /bdag dang gzhan du bltas pas ldog /'di dang phyi mar bsnyad pas gol/ /skye med lhan skyes bcos pas 'ching / /de skad bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad/ /'chad pa'i skyes bus 'di skad bstod/ /e ma'o rnam dag ye shes sku/ /khyab bdag gsung gi lde mig sgo/ /ma rig sgrib pa dral ba'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa ye shes sku/ /e ma'o rnal 'byor thugs kyi bcud/ /'gro ba sdug bsngal gzir las bsgral/ /ma skyes lhan cig 'gag med cing / /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phan yon gyi le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po'i don gyi rgyud rdzogs so // //73—766

rje btsun gu ru'i zhal snga nas dang / lots+tsha ba seng kur nyushākya 'od kyis pham thing du bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa'o②//bsdur mchan/759 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/76 ①〈〈khu 〉〉gling / ②〈〈khu 〉〉bcom/761 ①〈〈khu 〉〉'jig762 ①〈〈khu 〉〉rek+ta/763 hu)〈〈khu1 〉〉ga764 ①〈〈khu 〉〉dpa'i/765 ①〈〈khu 〉〉gar/ ②〈〈khu 〉〉po'o/bsdur 'bras re'u migargyud 'bum/ (51)79wa 767

༄ga /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dur khrod kyi rgyan rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba/(nya tsho༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ shrī (2༄tsakra saṃ ba ra natan+t+ra rā dza a ta thā sā na ④ a lo kā par nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal 'khor lo (6)sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po dur khrod kyi rgyan rmad du byung ba zhes bya ba/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa (3dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so/ /de nas rdo rje 90snying po la sogs pa'i dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis phyi'i mchod pa dang / nang dang / gsang ba dang k+ṣa/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ho bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /dpal zhes bgyi ba ji ltar lags/ /'khor lo zhes pa gang la bgyi / /sdom pa nyid kyang ji lta bu/ /rgyud kyi don ni ji ltar lags/ /de bzhin rgyud kyi rgyal po ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dpal ni gnyis 79wa 768

med ye shes te/ /'khor lo rnam pa bzhi ru brjod/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid do / /dang po phyi yi ①'khor lo ni/ /sku mdog phyag mtshan lha yi sku/ /drug cu ④rtsa gnyis rim pa ste/ /ye shes dam tshig sku gsung thugs/ /dkyil 'khor phyogs mtshams rim pa bzhin/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog pa ni/ /tha mal gcod pas phyi ru bshad/ /gnyis pa nang gi 'khor lo ni/ /gnas sogs sa bcu'i rim pa rnams/ /mtho ris sa stengs (kyes 'og dang / /'khor lo sgo la dgod pa ni/ /phyi rol spros pa gcod pa'o/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i (ge'akhor lo ni / /sprul pa chos dang longs spyod dang / /de bzhin bde ba chen po ste/ /rtsa chen sum cu ⑤tsa gnyis kyi/ /gnas su gyur pas sdug bsngal gcod/ /dga' ba dang ni mchog dga' dang / /rnam par (yedaga' ba'i gnyen po ni/ /bde ba stong pa mi rtog gsum/ /dbyer med rtogs pas lhan skyes la/ /de kho na yi 'khor lor brjod/ /sdom pa phyi nang gsang ba nyid/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /nga rgyal la sogs nyon mongs pa/ /gnyen pos ye shes ngang du sdomatshu/ /bdag dang dngos por lta ba dang / /tha mal pa yi rnam rtog kyang / /dag pa lha yi 9)'khor lor sdom/ /gzod nas lus la grub pa yi/ /rtsa dang rlung dang byang sems dang / /a ba dhū tī'i (8)nang du sdom/ /bde ba stong pa mi rtog dang ske/ /dngos dang dngos med ye shes kyang / /dbyer med gnyug ma'i ngang du sdom / /rgyud ces bya ba rgyun yin te/ /gnas skabs gsum gyi dri ma dang / /'jug dang zhugs dang nges pa yis/ /rgyu dang thabs dang 'bras bu ste/ /dang po 'khor ba'i rang bzhin la/ /gnyis pa thun mong mya ngan 'das/ /rgyal po zhes pa rnam pa bzhi/ /'og ma'i yon tan ldan pa dang / /nges pa'i don la 73—769

dbang byed dang / /gnyen po ye shes che ba dang / /gzhan ①la khyab pas rgyalapo yin / /rdo rje snying pos yang gsol pa/ /dur khrod brgyad ni ji ltar lags/ /de yi dgongs pa ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyis/ /dur khrod rnam pa bzhi ru 'gyur/ /dang po phyi yi dur khrod ni/ /rdo rje ra ba'i nang rol lam/ /yang na ②phyi rol grwa ①rnams su/ /lugs 'byung lugs las bzlog pa ni/ /gtum drag dang ni tshang tshing dang / /'bar bas 'khrugs pa'i keng rus dang / /'jigs sde rnams ni shar sogs kyi/ /phyogs su g.yon nas bskor te gnas/ /ha har rgod ④pa dbang ldan te/ /dpal gyi nags tshal byin zar ⑧ro/ /'jigs pa'i mun pa bden bral du/ /rlung mtshams ki li ki lir sgrogs/ /shar du ha ri ba phye la/ /gtum drag dkar po glang po'i gdong / /byang du byang chub shing bu la/ /gha ra ser po mi yi gdong rka/ /nub du mya ngan med shing la/ /'bar 'khrugs dmar po chu srin gdong ske/ /lho ru tsā ti'i ⑥shing bu la/ /'jigs sde ⑦nag po ma ho'i gdong / /me ru ka ran tsa na ste④/ /dpal gyi nags tshal ra gdong dmar/ /bden bral ardzu'i shing bu la/ /'jigs pa'i mun pa ma he'i gdong / /rlung du srid grub shing bu la/ /ki li sgra sgrogs ri dgas gdong / /dbang ldan n+ya gro dha shing la/ /ha har rgod ⑨pa ba glang ⑩gdong / /g.yas na gri gug thod pa g.yon/ /shing lo'i steng na stod phyung ngo / /shar du brgya byin dkar po la/ /rdo rje sdigs mdzub 7glang po zhon/ /byang du lus ngan ser po la/ /dbyug pa 'dzin cing gter la zhon/ /nub tu chu bdag dmar po ni/ /chu srin zhon nas zhags pa thogs / /lho ru gshin rje nag po la/ /ma he zhon nas be con thogs/ /shar lho 73—770

me lha dmar ser la/ /ra la zhon nas me thab 'dzin/ /lho nub srin po smug nag la/ /ral gri thogs nas mi la zhin/ /nub byang rlung lha mdog sngon po/ /ri dgas ①zhin nas 'phan ni 'phyar/ /byang shar dbang ldan dkar po ni/ /khyu mchog zhon nas rtse gsum thogs/ /thams cad rang rang rig mas 'khyud/ /nor rgyas dang ni 'jog po dang / /stobs kyis (kyergyu dang pad+ma dag /shar nas brtsams te g.yon du dgod/ /pad+ma che dang mtha' yas dang / /rigs ldan dang ni dung skyong ni/ /g.yas kyi phyogs nas dgod pa'o/ /sgra sgrogs pa dang rmugs pa dang / /mun pa can dang kun tu 'khyil/ /shar nas byang gi phyogs su dgod / /'khrigs pa gang ba 'bab pa dang / /drag po sprin tshogs mtshams la dgod / /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang / /las dang dam tshig rnal 'byor ma/ /sna tshogs 'jig rten mkha' 'gro rnams/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /ro la spyod cing mkha' la rgyu/ /gzhan yang rnal 'byor mchod rten dang / /chu dang me sogs rim pa ste/ /gza' dang par ta grub pa rnams/ /rol pa chen po'i tshul du gnas/ /'byung po'i gdon dang ro langs dang / /stag dang khyi dang ce spyang dang / /wa dang lug pa bya rgod dang / /phyed tshig pa medang rnam par dbyangs④/ /mgo bo lus po keng rus (5)rnams/ /a la be+e gyi ⑤sgra sgrogs pa / /de nas nang gi dur khrod ni/ /lus kyi skra sen spu la sogs/ /skye zhing 'jig par byed pas na/ /dur khrod chen po lus la dgod/ /de nas gsang ba'i dur khrod ni/ /rtsa chen sum cu brtsa gnyis nas/ /'byung 'jug gnas pa'i rlung rnams ni/ /dbugs rgyu zhes pa dur khrod do/ /rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad dang / /dngos po'i rtog 3)pa sna tshogs pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi dur du 79—771

mchi6)la/ /gsang ba rig pa'i ye shes khrod/ /de nas dur khrod dgongs ②pa ni/ /rnam shes dag pas dur khrod la/ /phyogs skyong mi dge bcu po spong / /sangs rgyas brgyad kyi mtshan ma shing / /thugs rje'i rtags su shing brgyad la/ /zhing skyong sngags kyi theg pa bsrung / /gdug pa 'joms phyir klu brgyad dgod/ /mchod rten rang sangs rgyas kyi gnas/ /rnal 'byor brtul bzhugs spyod pa byed//chu ni brjod bya zab pa la/ /me sogs rtog ④pa bral ba'o/ /rdo rje snying pos yang gsol pa/ /bcom ldan 'das ni ji ltar lags/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sku dang gsung thugs ji ltar lags/ /btsun mo'i bha ga ji lta bu/ /bzhugs pa'i don ni ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /nyon mongs bdud dang 'chi bdag bdud/ /lha yi bu dang phung po'i bdud/ /bdud bzhi bcom pas bcom pa la/ /ldan pa yon tan drug nyid de/ /dbang phyug dang ni gzugs bzang dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /ye shes phun sum tshogs pa ni/ /drug po de la ldan zhes gsungs/ /'khor ba'i chos ni mya ngan te/ /de dang bral phyir 'das pa'o/ /(5)'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /'gro ba'i don mdzad de bzhin gshegs/ /thams cad dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gnas/ /btsun mo zhes pa chos kyi dbyings/ /de la yod phyir bha ga ste/ /mi phyed pas na bzhugs zhes bya/ /rdo rje (65snying pos yang gsol pa/ /dpa' bo zhes pa gang la bgyi/ /de bzhin dpa' mo nyid kyang ci/ /de yi mchod pa ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dpa' bo la yang rnam bzhi ste/ /bum pa'i dbang dang 'brel pa yi/ /lha yi 75rnal 'byor bsgoms pa yis/ /tha mal pa yi 98)rnam rtog 79—772

spong ske/ /des na phyi yi dpa' bor bshad/ /gsang ba'i dbang dang 'brel pa yi//rtsa rlung thig le bsgoms pa yis/ /mtshan ma'i rnam rtog 'joms pa ni/ /nang gi dpa' bor bshad pa yin/ /gsum pa'i dbang dang 'brel pa yi/ /dga' ba bzhi yi don bsgoms pas/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rtog pa 'joms de ni gsang ba'i dpa' bo yin/ /bzhi pa'i dbang dang 'brel pa yi/ /gnyis su med pa gang bsgoms pas/ /tha dad rtog pa 'joms pa'i phyir/ /de kho na yi dpa' bor bshad/ /dpa' mo la yang rnam pa bzhi/ /ma ni shes rab pha rol phyin / /gdod nas spros bral lhun grub la/ /lta ba'i zhen pa spong ba ni/ /de ni phyi yi dpa' mor bshad/ /nang du rtsa dang thig le sogs/ /rang bzhin med par byed pas ma/ /gsang bar dga' ba bzhi rnams la/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pas mtshi/ /rang rig sems kyis ngo bo ni/ /nam mkha' lta bur gang bsgom pa/ /de kho na yi dpa' mo'o/ /mchod pa yang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /phyi nang gsang ba de kho na/ /dang po phyi yi mchod pa ni/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dang ske/ /dri dang lha bshos btung ba dang / /rol mo sil snyan dbyangs nyid dang ske/ /gzugs dang sgra dang dri dang ni/ /ro dang reg bya 'jam pa dang / /'khor lo rin chen glang po rta/ /btsun mo dmag dpon blon po rnams/ /phyi yi mchod pa thun mong ngo / /rang gi lus las byung gyeb yi/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang btung ba dang / /sha lnga lhag pa'i rdzas rnams ni/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kyi / /'khor lo rnams la mchod pa nang / /de nas gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/ /rang snang thabs kyi rig tsho rim yis/ /skra gzung ngabha ga ku tsa btsir/ /rtsa dang rlung dang thig le sogs/ /dga' ba mchog dga' dga' bral dang / /lhan 79—773

cig skyes pa'i bde ba mchod/ /rang rig stong par rtogs pa yi/ /'od gsal de nyid chos sku la/ /zhen pa rnams dang bral ba ni/ /bla na med pa'i mchod pa'ol/ /rdo rje 1)snying pos yang gsol pa/ /gtor ma zhes pa gang la bgyi/ /de yi phan yon ji ltar 'byung / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gtor ma rnam pa bzhi ru gsungs/ /phyi nang gsang ba de kho na/ /dang po phyi yi gtor ma ni/ /thun mtshams lha yi mdun nyid du/ /ro las me dang yo las rlung / /skyed gsum a las dum gcig pa'i/ /nang du bdud rtsi sha lnga la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba yis/ /lha rnams mnyes par byed pa dang / /mkha' 'gro dgyes par byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa nang gi gtor ma ni/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /lus ni lha yi 'khor lo la/ /rtsa ni ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /srin bu las kyi mkha' 'gro mchod/ /gsum pa gsang ba'i gtor ma ni/ /'khor lo bzhi yi ka pā lar/ /rlung dang thig le bdud rtsi la/ /dga' ba gsum gyis byin brlabs te/ /lhan cig skyes pa mchod par bya/ /de nyid bzhi pa'i gtor ma ni/ /phyi nang dngos po'i gtor ma kun/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi pad snod du/ /don dam sems kyi gsum sngags kyis/ /bde ba chen po'i ngang la mchod / /phan yon dngos grub ster ba dang / /phyi nang bar chad sel ba dang / /zas kyi rtog pa choms pa dang / /khams dang skye mched rtas pa dang / /rgas sra lus kyi mdangs ldan zhing / /skra dkar gnyer ma spong ba dang / /dngos po'i gdon las grol ba dang / /'khor ba'i pha rol son pa'o/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /sems kyi rang bzhin ji lta bu/ /de las 'khrul nas ji ltar 'khor da/ /ma 'khrul don la ji ltar gzhag(mi /de las yon tan ji ltar 79—774

'byung ske/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sems las ma gtogs sangs rgyas dang / /sems las ma gtogs chos gzhan dag /sangs rgyas kyis kyang ma gzigs shing / /ma gsungs gsung bar mi 'gyur te/ /des na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sems kyi gsang 'di gsang ba'i mchog /khams gsum brtan dang g.yor bcas pa①/ /snang ba myong zhing grub pa med/ /de phyir 'khor ba'i ming yang med/ /thog mar ma skyes rang bzhin dag /glo bur sangs rgyas ming yang med/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis ma yin/ /kun rdzob don ②dam gnyis ma yin/ /rang bzhin rig pa 'od gsal sogs/ /smrar med brjod du med pa ste/ /dper na lkugs pas (0ro myong 'dra/ /ras dang shel 'dra'i (4)rang bzhin la/ /log rtog ⑤ci sogs rnam par 'khrul96/ /khams gsum brtan dang g.yor snang zhing / /'dod pa'i byang chub sna tshogs dang / /de dag spyod pa sna tshogs dag /de nyid g.yeng dang rnam rtog ste/ /rang gis 'khrul nas rang gis 'ching ske/ /rang gis gsod cing rang gis za/ /rang gis ltung zhing ri zirang sdug bsngal / /rang rig ye nas spros bral la/ /sgra dang tha snyad 'jug na 'khrul/ /rang rig ngang (shegis 'od gsal la/ /ma rig mun pas bsgribs na 'khrul/ /dngos po stong par ro mnyam la/ /blang dang dor bar byed na 'khrul/ /'dod yon ngang khyagis 'gag pa la/ /de dag dka' bas spong na 'khrul/ /rang rig ye nas stong pa la/ /'dod yon lnga la brten bon 'khrul/ /dman dang gya rnam med pa la/ /sgro dang skur pa 'debs na 'khrul/ /gdod nas spros bral lhun grub la/ /sgom dang mi sgom byed na 'khrul/ /sangs rgyas sems can gnyis med la/ /de dag gnyis su 'dzin na 'khrul/ /don dam kun rdzob gnyis med 79—775

la / /bden pa gnyis su 'byed na 'khrul/ /sangs rgyas 'khor ba'i chu bo rgal/ /skye 'gag gang ltar 'dod kyang 'khrul/ /stong nyid ro la mi gnas par/ /dngos po mtshan mar bzung 0sten 'khrul/ /sems kyi glang chen mi 'dul bar/ /g.yeng ba'i sems su 'dug na 'khrul/ /rnam rtog rlung gis bskyod pa la/ /rang rig ye shes 'dod na 'khrul/ /rang sems rang gis ma mthong bar che ba'i nga rgyal smra na 'khrul/ /rang rig nyams su ma myong bar/ /dkar po'i chos rnams spong na 'khrul/ /sangs rgyas ma 'khrul sems can 'khrul/ /rang bzhin ma 'khrul rang rig 'khrul/ /sems nyid ma 'khrul bag chags 'khrul/ /sangs rgyas las 'khrul sems can de/ /rang rig las 'khrul gzhan rig snang / /sems nyid las 'khrul bag chags 'byung / /des na rang sems 'khrul pa dag /don du snang ba rab tu skye/ /skye ba med bzhin skye bas 'khrul/ /lcags bsregs sa gzhi rang gi sems/ /me sogs byed pa gzhan na med/ /bkres skom sdug bsngal rang gi sems/ /zas skom bkres (snyepa gzhan na med/ /brdeg btsog lcag tshon)bzhus rang gi sems/ /srog gcod shan pa gzhan na med/ /'gro ba thams cad rang sems kun/ /rang gi sems su ma shes na/ /de yis sangs rgyas spangs pa nga yin/ /bla ma dam pa rtag tu bsten/ /theg chen zab mo'i mdo rgyud blta/ /bsgom du med pa'i don bsgoms na/ /ma bsgoms na yang bsgom pa'i mchog /de ltar gyur pa'i mkhas pa la/ /stong par mi 'gyur gang yang med / /de las /mya ngan 'das pa 'byung / /sku dang stobs la sogs pa kun/ /nor bu'i tshul du rang bzhin 'byung (5)/ /de dag sems kyi rang bzhin (7no/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /rten gyi gang zag rnam pa du/ /rgyud kyi 79—776

rnam ①grangs du zhig mchis/ /gdul bya gang la rgyud rnams bshad/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sems can sangs rgyas rang bzhin pas/ /gdol pa ko lpags mkhan la sogs/ /gzugs ngan gsod pa'i don gnyer ba/ /theg pa 'di las 'grub par 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgom napa dang ske/ /gtso bo yab yum bsgom pa dang / /dbu ma'i spyan la sems 'dzin pa/ /bskyed rim ⑧spros dang bcas pa'i lam/ /rigs la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor gyis④ / /lha sogs bu mo mtshan ldan la/ /chags pas chags pa spong ba ni/ /las kyi phyag rgya chags pa'i lam/ /gnas pa rtsa dang g.yo ba rlung / /bkod (5)pa byang sems dman pa dbyibs/ /zab pa sngags dang thig le dang / /mthar thug yan lag bdun bsgoms pa/ /chos kyi phyag rgya grol ba'i lam/ /rten yod ma yin brten pa med/ /dmigs pa thams cad rnam bsal tsho67te/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i don bsgom pa/ /phyag rgya chen por rang byin brlab/ /de rnams gnyis su bsdu ba ste/ /gang zag mchog dang las dang po/ /las dang po la phyi nang gnyis/ /mchog la yang ni phyi nang gnyis/ /dbang bzhi bgrod pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen dge tshul dang / /dge slong chen po 47)gsungs pa ste/ /'di yis rgyud rnams 'grub par 'gyur/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud ni rnam pa gsum/ /bshad rgyud sum cu nartsa gnyis te/ /yan lag rgyud ni grangs las 'das/ /rtsa ba chen po phyi ma dang / /phyi ma'i phyi mar bsdus pa yin/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang / /dmangs 79)rigs gdol pa gdul don du/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med do/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /gnas gang du ni gtso bo bsgom/ /thabs ni 73—777

rnam pa du zhig mchis/ /de bzhin thabs las byung ba ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ri rtse dur khrod ro steng du/ /gcer bu skra bshig lhor bltas te/ /ā li kā yis lus bsrungs la/ /dpa' bo'i 'khor lo bsgom par bya / /smin par byed pa dbang bzhi la/ /grol ba bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi lam/ /lam gnyis la ni brten nas su/ /sngags pas byang chub bsgrub par bya/ /bum pas lus kyi dri ma 'khrud/ /gsang bas ngag gi dri ma 'khrud/ /gsum pas sems kyi dri ma ste/ /de ni kun tu brtags pa la/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa / /bkru ba'i phyir na bzhi pa bshad/ /gnas dang ldang ba nyid dang ni/ /'jug dang yongs su rdzogs pa dang / /byin gyis brlab dang dbang bskur dang //ting ༅'dzin mchod pa bskyed rim la/ /nye bar bsdu ba rdzogs pa'i rim rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas su/ /rdo rje can gyis ((chos 'chad do/ /stong pa mngon gyur chos sku la/ /mtshan dpe /skabade ba longs spyod sku/ /rol pa'i mdzad pa sprul sku la/ /sku gsum dbyer med bde chen ngang / /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /gang gis bsgrubs na 'grub par 'gyur/ /gang la bar chad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'khor bas skyo nas sdom gsum ldan/ /thos che dang ldan mtshan nyid bzang / /dben par dkyil 'khor bris smra bcad/ /chos gos gyon la bdud rtsi spyad/ /thun bzhir bsgrubs na 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhen ri pa che ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /lta ba'i bar chad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /g.yeng ba che ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /bsgom pa'i bar chad 5'byung bar 'gyur/ /dam tshig nyams pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /spyod pa'i bar chad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /le lo che ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /'bras bu'i bar 79—778

chad 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das/ /rgyud kyi ngo bo ji lta bu/ /rtsa ba'i rgyud ces gang la bgyi/ /bshad pa'i rgyud ces gang la bgyi/ /'byung ba'i dus ni ji lta bu/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin la/ /rgyud rnams kun gyi ngo bo 'dus/ /yod pa rgyu la bsgrub pa lamacha/ /mngon 'gyur 'bras bu'i ngo bo yin/ /thog mar gsungs pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /phyi nas gsungs pa bshad pa'i rgyud/ /don rnams ston pas rtsa ba la/ /gsal bar byed pa bshad pa'i rgyud/ /bskal pa rdzogs ldan sum (2raganyis dang / /rtsod ldan dus bzhi'i rim pa yis/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhir gsungs te/ /bya spyod ①rnal 'byor bla med do/ /lha mos gsol pa bcom ldan 'das / /zab mo'i rgyud 'di gang la sba/ /ji lta bu la sbyin par bya/ /ster na lung nod ji ltar bya/ /bka' 'di rgya (4)yis ji ltar gdab/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /snying rje med cing khro la gdug(ge /khengs shing chags pa tshul khrims med/ /dad med rigs ngan bla mas skyo/ /thos chung snying ring rnams la sba/ /dpa' zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyu (6dmed / /dad ldan rigs bzang 9medagatong phod che/ /thos mang dam tshig ldan chol sbyin / /dbang bzhi bgrod pa'i sngags pa yis/ /sngon du bla ma mnyes byas la/ /yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu la/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor na tshogs kyis mchod/ /ji ltar rdo rje 'dzin pa yis/ /lha mo rnams la rgyud gtad ltar/ /de bzhin gsang ba'i rgyud sde rnams/ /zung la sgrub pa ched du gyis/ /lan gsum brjod la rgyud rnams sbyin/ /phyi rabs dus kyi snyigs 99ma la/ /chags sems gyong ba'i slob ma ni/ /gus pas mi zhu g.yo sgyus 'dodang/ /thos nas khungs sub rang che 79wa 779

༄ga /rgyud kyi rgyal po rnyog pa med pa zhes bya ba/6)༄༅bha /rgya gar skad du/ a nā bi la ②tan+t+ra rā dza phyinā ma/ bod skad du/rgyud kyi rgyal po rnyog pa med pa zhes bya ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo /sems can rnams la phan 'dod pas༅/ /rnyog med rab tu bshad par bya/ /snang ba med cing dpe med pa/ /tshig gi yul las rnam par 'das/ /zhi zhing bdag med dag pa nyid/ /mtshan med mtshan gzhi 6)rnam par spangs/ /ngang gi ⑥sangs rgyas 'di nyid tshul/ /mtshan med ⑦mtshan gzhi (nyernam par spangs/ /khyad par du yang mdor bsdus pas/ /bdag gis gsal bar bshad pa yin/ /rmongs pa rnams la phan 'dod pas/ /snying rjes 'di ni bstan pa yin/ /kha cig stong par 'dod pa dang / /kha cig thig le'i gzugs can dang / /kha cig khyab 'jug tshul gyis kyi)ni/ /blo dman dag ni 'jog par byed/ /de nyid nges par yang dag par/ /rgyu yi gnas kyi spyod yul nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu ma grub 79—783

na / /bsgom tsho1)pa med cing byang chub med/ /rgyu yi yid ches spangs pa 'di/ /thog ma tha ma med pa'i bdag /sgyu nama'i ye shes las byung ba/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ston par byed/ /kha cig drag po'i rang bzhin du/ /kha cig zhi ba chen po che / /kha cig phyag da rgya'i rang bzhin gzugs/ /kha cig 'dar zhing g.yo ba dang / /glu gar de bzhin sil snyan dang / /lha yi sngags ni brjod pa nyid/ /kha cig sngags ni yang dag dgod/ /kha cig dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / /dbang la sogs pa brtag pa dang / /'byung dang 'byung las gyur pa'i lus/ /de ltar la sogs mtha' yas mchog /sangs rgyas la sogs rdo rje brtags/ /gang tshe sems ni legs gnas pa/ /de bzhin nyid kyi spyod yul nyid/ /dkyil 'khor de bzhin 'gyur ba ni/ /phan 'dod rnams ni rinoshes par bya/ /phung po la sogs tshogs rnams kyis55/ /gang zhig khyad par gyis bcos pa/ /lus ngag yid gsum bcos pa'i phyir/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor zhes byar gsungs/ /phung sogs gzhan sogs mthong ba'i phyir/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor zhes byar gsungs / /sems kyi dkyil 'khor dag pa ste/ /rang bzhin med par bsgom par bya/ /me long lta bu gcig nyid de/ /dang po grwar 6ni rtogs par bya/ /so sor rtog pa zhes gsungs pas/ /shar gyi grwar 75ni rnam par brgyan/ /bya ba nan tan khyad 'phags pa/ /byang gi grwar 98ni rnam par spros/ /mnyam nyid ye shes chen po ni/ /bag chags med grwa 95rjes rtogs byed/ /gzhan du'ang dkyil 'khor gru 1 bzhi pa/ /grwa yi dbus ni thams cad du/ /de nyid 'di ni rab 'jug pas/ /ye shes spyod 11yul du ni brtag /sgo 12bzhir yang dag brjod pa ni / /de bzhin dran pa bzhir byung 12ba/ /de bzhin grwa skobazhir gsungs pa ni/ /79—784

sbyin pa bzhi ni rnam dag pa1)/ /dbus su dkyil 'khor gzugs su ni/ /mi bskyod pa yis ②rnam par brgyan/ /zhi dang chos don brgyan pa las/ /de dag thams cad dkyil 'khor 'grub/ /dra ba dra phyed ((zla ba sogs/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bris pa dang / /rta babs la sogs thams cad ni/ /ting 'dzin yan lag rta babs nyid/ /sems kyi mthar thug brjod pa ste/ /de nyid rang bzhin las ni gsungs/ /gang zhig sems kyi (perab 'phel ba/ /ting 'dzin yan lag rnam par gnas/ /de nyid dra ba zhes su gsungs/ /dra ba phyed pa phyed du ste/ /dril bu do shal brtag (5)pa ni/ /rang gi btsun mo rtogs par byed/ /sgra brnyan rnam pa lta bur ni/ /chos rnams thams cad so sor rtogs/ /chos rnams ma skyes mthong ba'i phyir/ /de nyid rgyal mtshan phreng bar gsungs/ /bla re la sogs (phyiragang bres pa/ /dngos po la 57)sogs dang por nges/ /sems ni bla re zhes byar bshad / /dam pa'i don las (8)gsungs pa'o/ /gos phreng de dag thams cad ni / /rnam pa sna tshogs snang ba nyid/ /gang zhig rdo rje rnam pa'i sems /dga' ba'i ye shes kyis (9 ni mtshan/ /de yi 'og tu rtag tu gsungs/ /grwa yi mtshams ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje rin chen rtogs pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje 7rin po che yis spras/ /zla ba nyi ma gang /nyagasungs patsha/ /thabs dang shes rab don 6nyamathong phyir/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid sems/ /ye shes 'dis ni rnam par brgyan/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje skyes/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor du ni gsungs / /sku gsung thugs ni nye ba'i phyir/ /rnam pa gcig tu mtshan nyid med / /bla ma slob ma rnams gsal bar/ /rab tu 'jug pa de nyid gsungs/ /sbyin sreg thuyang ni bshad pa yang / /lha rnams tshim pa nga yis brjod/ /rnam 79—785

rtog med pa'i sems gang ni/ /thab khung sgra yis mtshan pa 6)nyid/ /bye brag phyed pas me nang du/ /gzugs kyi phung sogs lnga po rnams/ /sems las byung ba'i yam shing nyid/ /thams cad kyi ni sreg galugs bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa gang byung ba/ /yam shing zhes ni rab tu grags/ /de ltar sbyin sreg ③bshad nas ni/ /rab tu gnas pa brjod par bya/ /sku gsung thugs la rtag tu ni/ /gang zhig sgi sems ni brtan gyur pa/ /de nyid rab tu gnas par brjod/ /phung po rnams kyi dngos po ci/ /gang zhig sngags kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /de ni gsal bar brjod par bya/ /yid rnams kyis ni skad du yang / /gang zhig gsang ba bdag gis brjod / /skye ba med cing snang med pa(ge/ /mtshan gzhi ⑥mtshan nyid rnam par spangs / /gsang ba'i don ni rtogs pa'i phyir/ /'di ni nga yis sngags su gsungs / /sngags ni gsal bar bshad nas ni/ /lha rnams yang ni brjod par bya / /phung po khams dang skye mched kyi/ /rang bzhin gyi ni legs gnas gang / /yang dag byang chub thar pa nyid/ /de kun yang dag rab brtags shing / /gal te sems kyi nyer brtags gang / /lha zhes bya bar yang dag bshad/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya las/ /de nyid du ni yang dag gsungs/ /lha la gsol btab rnal 'byor ni/ /gsal bar nga yis brjod par bya/ /de nas skyil lakrung bcas nas ni/ /sna yi rtse mor bltas nas kyang / /rang gi rang bzhin rnal 'byor gyis / /de nyid mthong ba gzhag par bya/ /snying ga'i 2gnas su lag pa gnyis/ /'bad pas mnyam par sbyar nas su/ /mi rtog pa yi 6nyerang bzhin du/ /gang tshe sems ni rab rgyu ba/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag /de tshe de la skye bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag /myur bar byin 79—786

gyis rlob par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa'i bdag /thugs kyi rdo rjes gsungs pa bzhin/ /rnal 'byor sangs rgyas thams cad 'gyur/ /nga ①yis gsal ②bar brjod pa ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi grub sbyin pa/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog gsang ba'i don/ /thabs dang shes rab spyod yul don/ /sems can don du snying rje che/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab sgrub ①pa/ /sna rtse'i ④dkyil 'khor nga yis gsungs/ /de dag thams cad dbyibs tsam du/ /mdor bsdus thams cad ma byas so/ /res 'ga' (snyedam tshig 'khor lo yang / /de nyid zhes bya ma gsungs so/ /rtogs pa cung zad tsam gyis ni/ /gang 'grub de ni res 'ga' ⑥yang / /gsung gi 'khor lor gsungs pa yin/ /rnam rtog med par lhag mos pas/ /sgrub po dam pas bsgrub par bya/ /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /bshang ba dang ni gci ba nyid/ /dam tshig zhes bya rab 'bad par/ /gang zhig bdag gis tshig gsungs pa/ /de rnams kun la de bzhin gshegs/ /de rnams tha snyad tsam gyis gnas/ /gang tshe dam tshig 'dod chags sems/ /des ni de nyid rab tu spyod / /gang tshe sems ni chags gyur pa/ /de ni sems can yod ma yin/ /de la kun tu rtog pa yi/ /khrag ni za bar 'gyur ba'o/ /khrag ni chen po zos nas ni / /'od dpag med pa'ang bza' bar bya/ /gang zhig chos rnams las skyes pa / /khu ba'i sgrar ni bsgrag par ⑨bya/ /de tshe ma skyes rtogs pa'i phyir/ /bza' bar yang dag gsungs pa nyid/ /dngos po kun gyi mnyam pa nyid/ /sha chen du ni rab tu dbye/ /mi dmigs pa yi (nyernal 'byor gyis/ /bza' ba zhes byar mngon par brjod/ /gang zhig rab tu 'dzag pa'i sems/ /nus pa'i rjes 79—787

su sbyor ba las/ /phyag rgya las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /de yang gci ba'i sgra yis brjod / /chos dang chos min nges pa'i sems/ /sbas pa'i char ni gnas pa 'di / /chos rnams thams cad rab rtogs pa'o/ /bshang ba za bar yang dag brjod / /dam tshig nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni/ /'di rnams thams cad gsal bar bshad / /'di rnams don ni rtogs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid 'gyur / /dpal bde ba dam pa rtogs par byed pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa chen po mkha' 'gro ma dra ba sdom pa'i brtag pa rnyog pa med pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so0)// //( gergya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha (kyer dang / bod kyi lots+tsha ba dge slong shākya ye shes kyis brjo/ra ba'o//bsdur mchan/783 91)mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉na ba lo/〈〈li 〉〉nā bi lo/ 〈〈co 〉〉nā li baṃ/ 75)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dz+ra/ (ge〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉pa/tshan〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉bzhi/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉nyid/ ⑦〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉gis/(8)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bzhi/ 9)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gyi/784 91)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉sgom/ 〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉bsgoms/ 90〈〈g.yung 〉〉rgyu/ ③〈〈g.yung 〉〉 phyagaca〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉kyis/ 555〈〈g.yung 〉〉kyi/ 97〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉grur/ (7)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉grur/ 98)〈〈g.yung 〉〉grur/ 〈〈snar 〉〉zur/ (9)〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gru/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉grub / 37〈〈khu 〉〉spyan/ 5nye〈〈g.yung 〉〉bsgo/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bya/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉ga785 91)〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉dge ba/ (2〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉pa yi 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉pa'i/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉phye/945〈〈khu 〉〉kyis/ 5〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉brtags/ (6༄〈〈g.yung 〉〉las stsogs/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉la stsogs / 〈〈pe 〉〉las sogs/ (7〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉las/ ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉chos ni/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉 ye shes kyis/79wa 788

༄ga /dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba/(nyerwa༄༅bha /rgya gar skad du/ shrī 2so ba ra kha sa ma tan+t+ra rā dza nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba / 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa nadus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga la bzhugs so/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs 4kyis rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/kye bcom ldan 'das gsang ba bas kyang ches gsang ba/ gsang ba chen po de bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rdo rje snying po khyod nyon cig /srog dang lnga pa de bzhin du/ /lam dang 'bras bu nyid yin no/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das srog gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /srog ni 'dzin par byed pa ste/ /sngags dang rlung 79—790

dang rten nyid do/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lnga pa gang lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sangs rgyas lnga dang 'byung ba lnga / /lnga pa yang ni gcig nyid do/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das lam gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ smin pa dang ni grol ba'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ smin pa'i lam ni gang lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bum pa gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa'i rang bzhin ngo bo ste/ /de yi rnam pa de la gnas/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das grol ba'i lam gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /①snying rje chen po las skyes pa/ /dga' ba'i shugs las rnam par grub/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med mchog /bde ba chen po lam yin no/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po ni gang /dga' ba ni gang / thabs ni gang / shes rab ni gang / gnyis su med pa ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dmigs pa med pa snying rje'i mchog /dga' ba gnyis med bde ba che/ /thabs ni he ru ka dpal nyid/ /shes rab rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /gnyis su med pa zung 'jug mchog /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ho ru ka ni gang lags/ rnal 'byor ma ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ho ru ka ni phung po nyid / /phung po yang ni te ru ka /khams ni rdo rje ma dpal te/ /rdo rje ma dpal khams nyid do/ /skye mched de yang de bzhin du/ /lha yi ngo bor shes par bya / /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das phung po'i te ru ka gang lags / khams kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 73—791

bka' stsal pa/ /he ru ka dpal bdag nyid dngos/ /dri ma med pa'i kha dog can / /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa ste/ /drug gis brgyan cing dgu dang ldan/ /zla tshes 6)sna tshogs rdo rje dang / /rigs kyi bdag pos rnam par brgyan/ /spyan gsum dag gis mdzes pa ste/ /chags pa med pa'i sham thabs can/ /shes rab rang bzhin rnal 'byor ma/ /bas dmar po'i (mikha dog can/ /gcer bu phyag rgya lngas (gubargyan cing / /dag pa lnga bcu'i 2phreng bas mdzes/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i snod bsnams (57pa/ /yab la 'khyud cing brkyang bskum bzhugs/ /gnyis med bde ba la dgyes pa/ /chu skyes nyi ma'i dbus na 'gying snyo/ /khams nyid kyang ni lha nyid do/ /dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dum bu ste le'u dang po'o// //rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ni 7gang lags/ ngo bo nyid kyis 'od gsal ba ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /brtan dang g.yo ba thams cad kun/ /shes rab rang bzhin ma nyid de/ /lnga pa'i ngo bo 'od gsal nyid/ /ma skyes rtog pa bral ba'i sku/ /brjod du med cing bsam mi khyab/ / rtog pa tshonamed pa nam mkha'i dbus / /gnyis med bde ba'i rnam pa can/ /gsal ba'i rang bzhin g.yo ba medal/ /gnyis su med pa bde ba'i mchog /'bras bu lam gyi rnam pa'o/ /dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i dum bu ste le'u gnyis pa'o// //79—792

rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par rtog pa rnam par dag 1)pa ni gang lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sngags dang sbyin sreg tshigator ma dang / /dbang gi rnam par dag pa dang / /maṇ+ḍal dang ni de bzhin du/ /bum pa'i ngo bo lhar shes pa/ /sngags kyi de bzhin gnas pa'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sngags ni gang / sbyin sreg ②ni gang ske/ gtor ma ni gang / dbang ni gang / maṇ+ḍal ni gang / bum pa ni gang ske/ sngags kyi de bzhin nyid ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ sngags ni gsang sngags rgyal po ste/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he te ru ru kai rtsu 4rgyu phaṭa / ḍā ki nī dzā ⑤la sasba ra swā hā/ oṃ hrīḥha ha lhu 6)rtsa phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki ge'i ye badz+ra waṇ+ḍa nī ye hūṃ tshode/ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye rtu 79rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ gsang sngags rgyal po 'di dag gis/ /bskal pa stong la sogs pa yi/ /sdig pa ma lus dag byed chu/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /'khor lo dag gis rnam par mdzes/ /a shwat+tha dang n+ya gro da / /drur ba la sogs de bzhin du/ /bzhi pa'i ngo bor yang dag shes/ /sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga/ /gyen du phe 7gyi sgra bsgrags pas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun dgyes/ /dbang ni tha ma'i lam nyid do/ /bdud rtsi chu yis legs byugs nas/ /me tog dmar pos mchod pa'o/ /rin chen snod bzangs rbu gyis mdzes/ /dpa' bo bdud rtsi dag byed chu/ /zhal bzhi sngags kyi 'od zer gyis/ /gdug pa ma lus kun 'dul zhing ske/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i rnam pa can/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ kye bcom ldan 'das skye mched 1 kyi mkha' 'gro ma gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gcer bu thal ba'i mdog can te/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul 79—793

rnams 'grim/ /lnga pa dang ni drug pa'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sngags ni gang / gtor ma ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ oṃ dz+wa la mu khi ḍā zhu)kyi nī kai ka ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ri nā ②ya ni ḍā ki nī rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ ma ḍi ra ḍā ris)kyi nī bya/ phaṭa/ oṃ pa ra mu khi ḍā ki nī hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ u ri lu ka ti ḍā ki nī rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ a ra ṇa ma ṇi (yenge ki nī hūṃ phaṭa/ chu skyes dag gis rnam brgyan cing / /bdud rtsi lnga yis rnam par mdzes/ /dpa' mo drug ni mnyes par 'gyur/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das smin pa'i lam ni gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bzhi pa'i rang bzhin ngo bo ste/ /de yi rnam pa de la gnas/ rdo rje snying pos gsol pa /tsho7ste bcom ldan 'das rnam pa'i ngo bo ni gang / sprul pa'i ngo bo ni gang lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rnam pa'i ngo bo lha nyid de/ /sprul pa tshogs kyi bdag por bshad/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das tshogs kyi bdag po ni gang / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dbang gi kha dog dmar po ste/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /sprul pa 'khor lo'i rtsibs la gnas/ /brkyang bskum tshul gyis mnan (35pa'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bsnyen par bya ba gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /bsnyen par bya ba sngags nyid de/ /oṃ ga ṇa ⑨pa ta ye swā hā / nag po 'bru yi ril bu risal/ /bsnyen dang sgrub pa'i lhar gnas pa/ /sngags kyi ngo bor shes par bya/ /dpal bde mchog nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i rgyud las/ las sna 1mtshogs kyi dum bu ste le'u gsum pa'o// //bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems 79—794

dpa' rdo rje snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje gnod gnas la sogs pa dang / rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa'i 'khor de dag rjes su yi ①rangs te/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //kha che'i mkhan po dzñā na badz+ras rang 'gyur du mdzad pa rdzogs theṭa0yiske 00bsdur mchan/79 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉thi/②〈〈g.yung 〉〉pa'i/ ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉gyis brlabs/791 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉 min pa dang ni grol bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/792 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉tshe/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉ra ga'i/ ni〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉lnga/ ④〈〈li 〉〉bcu yi/ (nye〈〈li 〉〉rnams/〈〈co 〉〉rnams/ 0〈〈pe 〉〉'gyis/ ⑦〈〈g.yung 〉〉 ni/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉rtag tu/792 ①〈〈co 〉〉dgu/ ②②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉bsreg ④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rgyu/ ⑤〈〈co 〉〉nga/ yi〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉rgyu/ ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉sarba bud dha ḍā / 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sarba budha nge gi/ 〈〈pe 〉〉sarba bud rta ḍā ki/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ni ye rgyu/ ⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 / ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dha/ 0〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉dze/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉mchod/794 ①〈〈khu 〉〉sbo/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉na/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉 ḍi ra/ 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ḍa ri ḍā/ 〈〈khu 〉〉snyi ra ṭā/④〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉ni/ ⑤〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉hu/ (7〈〈g.yung 〉〉na ma/ 〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉na ma ni/⑦〈〈li 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 bcom ldan 'das smin pa'i lam ni snying pos gsol ba/ ⑧〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉gnan/⑨〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉na/ ⑩〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ri lu/ tsun〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉 sna/795 ①〈〈g.yung 〉〉yid/ (kye〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈li 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉sto/ ②〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉 ye dharmānye tun te ṭ+wāṃ ba ga lasnya ba tu/ snyam dza gi shu r+ghaṃ/ 〈〈li 〉〉 yedharmā to ṣān ma hā tha ma ṇaḥ/ me ga la bha ba tu/ shu snyam stu sarba dzā ga rta/ shu bha/ me ga lo bha ba tu/ shu lham stu sarba dzā ga rta/ shu / shu r+ghaṃ/〈〈co 〉〉 ye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he turnye ṣā na ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e rba bā dri ma hā tha ma ṇaḥ////me ga lo lha wartu/ shu r+ghaṃ ma sna sarba dzā ga rta/79wa 795

༄ga /dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khros pa'i mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud/9)ri༄zag /rgya gar skad du/ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā la gro dha nā tha ra ha du su sirnyi bha ba tan+t+ra nā mtshi/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po khros pa'i mgon po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 9༄kun mkhyen pa'i/ /ye shes mngon par mkhyen pa yis/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'joms byed pa/ /bka' yi 'khor lo bshad par bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thogs pa med cing gdon mi za ba bde ba chen po (gezhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas su ni/ /kun mkhyen bde gshegs bzhugs gyur pa/ /mya ngan 'da' bar mi mdzad cing / /de srid mtshungs med sems can don/ /rgyun mi 'chad 6par 'gro ba kun/ /srid pa'i zhags pas 'jigs med par/ /byams pa'i thugs kyi brtson 'grus kyis/ /rtag tu sems 73wa 797

can don rnams mdzad/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' ①thug par/ /smon lam rnam par sbyong byed cing / /snying rjes don brtson sems kyis ni/ /dpa' bos srid pa sbyong bar mdzad/ /sna tshogs gzugs can nor bu bzhin/ /'di ni rgyud rnams kun du yang / /kla klo'i (geskad kyis sbas pa ste/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'joms pa po(ge/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam gyur pa'i/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag nyid che/ /myur du dngos grub ster byed pa/ /'phral du yang dag yid ches byed/ /bsam pa gang bdang gang dag gis/ /mi rnams sems dang mthun tshormepar 'jug /de dang de yi gzugs sprul te/ /sna tshogs g.yogs te bde bar bzhugs/ /de phyir 'bad pa du ma yis/ /sna tshogs tshul gyis mthun ⑥par bya/ /bdag nyid sangs rgyas he ru ka /dpa' bo rnal (pe'abyor ma tshogs can / /rang gi lha yi rab sbyor bas/ /bdag nyid ye shes mchog 'grub 'gyur/ /'di yis rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang / /dkyil 'khor ba dang zhing skyong tshogs/ /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod gnas/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug mgon po che/ /sku gsung thugs dang phrin (shelas tshogs/ /ye shes yon tan rigs kyi lha/ /nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas/ /lha mo chen mo bka' 'bangs bcas/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas dus kun du/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mgon po che/ /bde ba chen po'i rol pa yis/ /ye shes gsang ba bsam mi khyab / /tshe 'di nyid du 'grub 'gyur zhes/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs / /thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' (9shel ni mtshan nyid med/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus pa/ /'gro kun sgyu ma lta bu yin/ /brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yibo/ /'gro ba dmigs su med pa ste/ /mthong ba dang 73—798

ni thos la sogs/ /thams cad sgyu ma lta bur 'char/ /gang gis skye bo 'ching gyur pa/ /de nyid yongs shes rnam par grol/ /phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni/ /sa gsum bde ba chen por bsgyur/ /nyon mongs med na 6)ye shes med/ /nyan rang byang chub lam las ring / /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /'byung ba bzhi la sogs pa rnams/ /thams cad gdod nas dag pa yi/ /ye shes chen po'i byin brlabs (༄kyis/ /dngos po du ma gsal bar snang / /ye shes med par skye mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kyis rab bskul/ /de bas bla med rgyud 'di ru/ /'bad de dad pa bskyed par ②bya/ /gsang ba'i sdom pa bla na med/ /dang po bla ma'i dam tshig dag /thob pas rgyu dang 'bras bu 'byung / /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin te/ /brtan pa dag ni longs spyod yin/ /nges par brtan pa mya ngan 'da'/ /rnal 'byor gyi ni dam tshig gnas/ /brda yi sbyor ba gsang ba dang / /dbang bskur bas ni dngos grub ster/ /bla ma de bzhin gshegs pa dang / /rgyal ba byang chub sems dpar bcas/ /dkyil 'khor bdag ④po bla na med/ /sngags pa tshanagasang ba 'dir zhugs gang / /yang dag bla ma bsten par bya/ /'dir ni byang chub sems kyis ni/ /bsnyen pa nye bar bsnyen pa yidang / / bsgrub pa bsgrub (7pa chen po yi/ /khyad par rim pa rtags dang dus/ /las la sbyar ba shes par bya/ /ji srid las kyi sbyor ba yis/ /mgon po 'khor bcas mnyes gyur na/ /las dang dngos grub sna tshogs pa/ /myur du 'grub par the tshom med/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsang ba mngon par byang chub pa'i le'u ste dang po'o// //73—799

de nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gsung rmi lam lta bur nye bar gsan ①te/ gsung rdo rje'i tshig 'di ༷migasungs so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pyo gang zhig gis/ /sgyu ma brag cha'i bsgra brnyan ltar/ /yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas dag tu/ /dngos grub thams cad bsdus pa sgrubasti/ /bskal pa bzang po 'di la ni/ /byung ba'i mgon po ma lus pa/ /kun gyi snying por gyur pa ni/ /gsang ba zhing skyong mgon po che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mgon po 'dis//bstan pa bsrung 95)bar mdzad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la sogs pa dang / rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to༅/ /gang du rdo rje'i theg pa che/ /gsang ba bsdus pa'i yang dag lam/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srung labyed pa'i/ /snying po 'bras bu lam byed pa/ /snyigs ma lnga ldan dus nyid du/ /'dren pa ye shes bstan pa bsrung 9she/ /'di nyid gsang ba'i sgrub pa gang / /rdo rje'i theg pa 'dir bstan gsol/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang ske/ de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ shes rab snying rje zung 'jug pa/ /ting 'dzin gang du sgom gyur pa/ /bla med dkon mchog bstan pa ste/ /rgol ba ngan pa bzlog 9she par mdzad/ /thub pa mchog gi bstan pa la/ /'dzin dang skyong dang srung bob gsum/ /lnga brgya dus kyi snyigs ma la/ /bdag tu 'dzin pa spong bar mdzad/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan par/ /gsang ba gcig pu bsgrub par bya/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /gsang ba'i bde ba chen po dbyings la rab tu bzhugs 17pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka rdo rje 79wa 800

rang ①rig pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dbus su sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lhun gyis 2grub pa'i gnas gsang ba rang byung bla na med pa'i rdo rje rab tu rgyal ba'i snying po mi phyed pa'i rdo rje'i ting nge (sne)'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i snying po ye shes kyi dngos grub sgrub cing bdud kyi g.yul las rab tu rgyal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i chos mi zad ④pa yang dag par 'byung ba zhes bya ba ston par mdzad do/ /rdo rje gzhi phyil gnas pa'i cha / /gter gyi bum pa kha khyer 6)ldan/ /dus kyi rgyal po 'od gsal ba/ /chu 'dzin phyogs tsam phyed ldan nyid/ /sgra dang sgra las khyab pa ste/ /du ma ma yin gnas pa'i yul/ /dam tshig gsang ba 'byung rdzunab las/ /rgyal ba rin chen 'bar ba'i gtso/ /phyogs dus med par rang byung ba/ /chos 'byung pho brang dkyil 'khor du/ /rigs kyi yon tan ldan par ni/ /nam mkha'i rgya mtsho 'bras ldan pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa lhun gyis grub(8)/ /mi phyed lhan cig skyes pa rgyal/ /pho (9)brang gsang ba'i gzhal yas khang / /dkyil 'khor rin chen 'od 'khrug pa/ /ge sar pad+ma'i dbus su ni/ /kun nas zlum por 'khor ba ni/ /tshad med phreng bas brgyan 7pa ni/ /bkod pa dpag med rim par ldan/ /ri rab lhun po mchog byung ba'i/ /de nyid kun nas yongs bskor ba'i/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ri rnams te/ /shin tu mnyam zhing mtshungs par 'khor/ /de nyid rim pa yongs su brtan/lha/ /bye brag mtshungs med dmar chen mtsho/ /rim pas chu gter 'o ma'i gnas/ /'byung ba bsdus pa mi lus kyi/ /phung po rus pa'i ri bo la / /phyi nang mnyam pa'i tshad can gyi/ /lhun gyis grub 8par bstan pa yin/ /de las dngos po sna tshogs kyis/ /tha dad snang ba ye shes gzugs/ /rang byung 73—801

bde ba chen po nyid/ /mnyam pa ①med pa kun tu 'byung / /dus gsum de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /'byung gnas snying po rdo rje'i gdan/ /rdo rje skyil krung ②mi phyed las/ /thog mtha' med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa'i/ /'dod chags rdo rje'i skur ldan pa/ /lho phyogs bya rkang ri dang ni/ /dpal gyi ri la mdun phyogs pa/ /dhā gan ka ṭa ④par pa ta/ /pad+ma ge sar rgyas pa'i dbus/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas rtag par gnas/ /dpal ldan dga' ba'i khang pa brtsegs/ /gsang ba sngags kyi rgya mtsho yi/ /ma lus rgyal ba bgrod pa'i yul/ /gsang ba chos kyi dbyings chen po/ /dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor du/ /kla klo'i yul gyi mi rnams dang / /lha dang lha min dri zar bcas / /gsang chen yongs su rdzogs pa yi/ /rang byung ye shes pho brang du/ /tshangs dbang khyab 'jug dbang phyug bdag /dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir bcug nas kyang —/ /skye bo chags du can rab 'dul phyir/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i snying po gsung ⑥/ /phyogs bcur gnas kyi sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs/ /gang gā'i ⑦klung gi bye snyed kyi/ /khrag khrig ri rab rdul mnyam pa/ /de dbus seng ge'i khrir ri nas bzhugs pa'i/ /thub pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la / /rdo rje snying po sems dpa' che/ /bla gos phrag pa gcig gzar te/ /pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs/ /thal mo sbyar te 'di don zhus/ /gsang chen khyad par 'phags pa yi/ /lhun gyis grub ri'i pa'i phyag rgya che/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i lam/ /dus dang gnas dang gang zag ste/ /spyod yul bstan pa'i khyad par gyi / /grub 'odang sgrub pa phrin nyurtalas tshogs/ /thabs dang stobs dang 79—802

'jug pa ste/ /rim pa mngon byed rgyur ldan pa/ /de nyid bcom ldan gsung du gsol / /zhes gsol to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das hu)rdo rje 'dzin pas bka' stsal pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /dga' zhing mgu la rab dang ba'i②ske/ /sems dpa' chen pos gsang ba'i don/ /rab tu zhus pa legs so legs / /shin tu rmad du byung ba yi/ /gdul dka' ma lus gdul don du/ /byang chub sems kyi ye shes mdzod/ /khyod la yang dag bstan par bya/ /de nas dngos grub thams cad kyi/ /grub pa rab tu ster byed pa/ /rgyal ba kun gyi snying po ste/ /gsang ba las kyi rim pa nyid/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//bstan pa bsrung ①zhing bka' la gnas/ /dam tshig 'dzin pa'i zhing skyong la/ /mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug gtso/ /dpal ldan rig bya'adzin thams cad la/ /mchog tu gyur pa'i las sgrub pa/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po ni/ /'dis ni lha min 'dus pa yi/ /g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa yin/ /lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pas/ /mchod 'os (5)gtso bor gyur pa yin/ /dpal ldan lha mo chen mo ⑥dang ske/ /nag mo re ma tir gyur pas/ /lcam dral gyur pas bstan pa bsrung (7)/ /sku dang gsung dang thugs gsang ba/ /phyi nang de nyid kho na'i don/ /yon tan phrin ⑧las dbang phyug tu/ /dam tshig mgon po zhing skyong ba'i/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i 51 dīgatso bo ste/ /gzhan yang sa 3lhagasum dbang byed pa'o/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud 32las gsang ba spyi la dgongs pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'ol// //de nas gsang ba bshad bya ba/ /'di nyid rtso bla med sgrub pa po/ /'khor 73wa 803

ba'i rgya mtshor lhung (7ba yi/ /sems can duḥkha ②gzigs nas ni/ /ji lta ji ltar grol 'gyur ba/ /de dang de yi thabs ston mdzad/ /dus ni bskal pa bzang po yi/ /rdzogs ldan tha mar gyur pa yi/ /dpag med dus las 'das nas ni/ /gnyis ldan dang ni gsum ldan las/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi rim pa la②/ /bcom ldan tshe lo brgya pa'i dus/ /de nyid bstan pa'i snyigs ma yi/ /lnga brgya rjopa yi dus kyi mthar/ /shin tu gdug cing rtsub pa yi/ /mi srun pa yi dus kyi tshe//de tshe mgon po'i bstan pa 'byung / /gang zag la yang gnyis su bshad/ /bsgral bar bya ba'i gang zag dang / /sgrol bar byed pa'i sgrub po ste/ /dang po bstan pa 'jig byed cing / /dkon mchog gsum po smod pa dang / /bla ma la sdang bdag la smod/ /de dag la sogs bya bar bshad/ /sgrub pa po ni rnam pa gsum / /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor ma/ /dag cing sbyangs te ting 'dzin gsal / /rim pa go 'phang thob pa ste/ /thun mong dunaspyi dang bye brag tu/ /dam tshig gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /gnas kyi khyad par 'byung ba yang / /bsnyen pa'i dus dang bsgrub (6༄pa dang / /las la sbyar ba'i dus shes pas/ /yid 'ong dben dang dur khrod sogs/ /bsam gtan 'phel dang khyad par ro(7)/ /yul dang dbang po'i spyod yul du/ /mthong ba dang ni thos pa dang / /reg pa dang ni dran pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor pa yi snang ba dang 8)/ /ma lus dngos po gang shar ba/ /bde ba can du shes par bya/ /bstan pa kun las bsdus pa ni/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam las kyang / /gsang ba 'bras bu lam byed pa/ /rdo rje theg pa 'di nyid de/ /bstan pa 'dzin skyong srung spudang gsum/ /'di ni khyad par bsrung 47ba yin/ /grub pa bsnyen pa'i ting 'dzin dang / /nye bar 79—804

bsnyen pa'i ting ①'dzin dang / /dpal ldan khrag 'thung (gele shes che/ /rnam dag mtshan nyid kun grub pa/ /bde ba'i bsod nams rgyun gnas pa/ /rnam dag stobs ni rgyas par byed/ /bsnyen pa'i dus su rang lha yi/ /ho ru kur ni ②gnas pa yi/ /mdun du bka' sdod dam tshig gi/ /mgon po phyag bzhi bsgom par bya/ /de nas thugs ku'i ④rang sngags las/ /'od 'phros 'khor ba'i bzlas pa las/ /khyad par du ni sgra bcas dang / /shin tu dal bar bzlas pa ⑤bya / /nye bar bsnyen ⑥pa'i dus su ni/ /bdag nyid he ru ka las ⑦ni/ /rgyu phyung mdun du 'od 'phros pas/ /bskyed cing mthar ni nye bar bsdu/ /sgrub (kyepa'i dus su mgon po yi0/ /rgyas 'debs spyi bor te ru ka /de nyid gsang sngags phyogs bcas pa/ /de nyid sems dpa' sum brtsegs 8bsam/ /gsang ba zhing skyong rgyal po che/ /cho ga gsum gyis sgrub pa'i tshul/ /'jig rten 'jigo rten 'das pa'i bdag /thams cad bde chen gnas pa la/ /dus gsum 'khor lo gsum du gnas/ /brtul zhugs 'dzin pas 'thob par 'gyur/ /sgrub pa chen po bla na med/ /ye shes mgon po chen po nyid/ /khā thagadong la sogs lha mo brgyad/ /rim pa bzhin du yongs su bskor/ /dkyil 'khor pho brang dbus su yang / /dur khrod du ni mgon po rol/ /'jig rten gsum na rnyed dka' ba/ /dam tshig spyod pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /rtag tu rang sngags sbas pa ste/ /rab tu 'bad de gsang bar bya'o/ /phrin kyi las khyad par gang yin pa/ /las la sbyor ba rim shes bya/ /rengs par byed dang skrod pa dang / /rmugs par byed dang brgyal 0du 'jug /rnam par rmongs dang lkugs par byed/ /dug gis 'dzin dang 'on long dang / /rang sha rang gis za byed cing / /gshis 873—805
