ngan dug dang khrag tu skyug /'di dag dus min 'chi byed pa/ /las kyi khyad par yongs su bstan/ /char dbab pa dang sprin dral ①dang / /thog dang ser ba dbab pa dang / /rang phyogs su ni bzlog cing bsrung ②/ /byad ka bzlog dang ngag bcing dang / /nus pa gzhom dang cho 'phrul dang / /phran tshegs las kyi gsang ba'o/ /thabs ni las kyi rim pa ste/ /rten gyi gang zag 'ga' zhig gisal/ /dang por bla ma mnyes par bya/ /gnyis par dbang bzhi thob pa dang / /gsum par byin gyis brlabs nas ni/ /bka' bsgo'i ④rjes gnang tshul bzhin dul/ /ma nor 'jug pa'i go rims 90shes/ /rten tshul khyad par shes par bya/ /stobs ni chos rnams thams cad la/ /sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang / /yang dag bden pa'i stobs kyis ni/ /rang bzhin med par rtogs pas 'byung / /'jug pa thun mong ma yin pa/ /byams pa snying rje byang chub sems/ /tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don la sems pa po/ /mngon du byed pa nyer sgrub ste / /dus dang grangs dang mtshan ma ste/ /dang po bar dang tha mar yang / /gtso bo dang ni 'khor rnams kyi/ /gang grub rab 'bring tha ma ru/ /rtags kyi dbye ba bstan pa yin/ /rgyu ni thogs pa med pa yi/ /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba ste/ /mngon sum du ni 'byung ba la/ /gang gis dgag par mi nus pa / /de las 'bras bu phun sum tshogs/ /snying po smin pa bzhin du 'byung / /gang du thogs med rdo rje yi/ /snying po zad pa med pa'i don/ /yang dag ye shes snang ba po/ /bla ma'i drin las thob par 'gyur/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsang ba'i rim pa bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o // //79—806

de nas dbang ldan bdud 'joms pa'i/ /sgrub 17pa yang dag rab tu bshad / /gsang ba'i mgon po chen po yi/ /sbas pa'i yum dang bcas pa yi/ /gsang ba mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang / /lhan cig tu ni dgyes par rol/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba'i dpa' bo ni/ /zhal gcig pa la spyan gsum pa/ /mi thung khros pa ut+pal mdog /mgo skyes gyen 'greng rngam pa'i sku/ /ro yi gdan la bzhugs mdzad cing / /klu brgyad rgyan gyis brgyan pa po/ /khros pas char sprin nag po ltar/ /me stag phung po lta bu yi/ /spyan gsum drag po'i lta bas 92rigazigs/ /glang po'i tshul can stobs ldan pa/ /rgyu ma'i do shal dpyangs ( pa yi/ /mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng bas bklubs(ge/ /shin tu mi srun sgeg pa'i sku/ /bdud 'dul chen po lha yi lha/ /nyams ldan gzi brjid phun sum tshogs/ /ma rig mun sel sgeg pa'i nyams/ /rmad byung chos sgrogs bzhad par ston/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa dpa' bo ste/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad 'jigs nga ra ston/ /log ( lta spong byed gcigs 968pa'i nyams/ /gdug pa tshar gcod snying rjes khrosaXste/ /ngo mtshar nyon mongs 'joms mdzad cing / /khro chags mi g.yo zhi ba'i thugs/ /g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug ra bsnams/ /g.yon gyi dang pos thod khrag 'dzin/ /g.yas kyi phyoganyis pas ral gri 'debs/ /g.yon pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ⑩'dzin par mdzad/ /gsung gis ha ha zhes sgrogs pa/ /log par lta ba 'joms par mdzad/ /stag gi pags nyu7pa'i sham thabs can/ /sna tshogs chu skyes nyi mar bcas/ /rang byung rol pa'i stabs nyu kyis gnas/ /de yi mdun du gtum pa mo/ /lha mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ /mun pa'i mdog 79—807

can zhal gcig ri)stem/ /phyag gnyis spyan gsum khro tshul can/ /gri gug thod pa bsnams (0par mdzad/ /yab la phyag rgya drug gis brgyan/ /yum la lnga ②yis rgyas btab gnasañtsa / /sku dang gnyis med 'khril bar bzhugs/ /me 'od phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /ye shes rgya mtsho'i 'khor srungs du ma/ /shar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'phrog ma dang / /lho phyogs glang sna ma zhes bya/ /nub kyi srin mo ral pa can/ /byang du sa yi gtsug yin no/ /gang du rgya mtsho chu ngogs yidang / /nag po'i chu dang 'dra ba'i sku/ /ma rungs 'joms byed nag po che/ /'bad pas snying rje bskyed pa nyid/ /gsad par bya ba brjod pa nyid/ /snying rje med na mi 'grub pas/ /de phyir snying rje bskyed par bya/ /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang ske/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'khrug byed pa/ /zhe sdang rigs kyi ting ⑦'dzin gyis / /re zhig 8tsam du gsad 49par bya/ /gzas pa'i sha la rtag tu rol/ /kun tu gtum pa'i shugs 'chang ba/ /yul dang yul du rol byed pas/ /shing rnams la ni gnas nas kyang / /dkyil 'khor zhing rnams skyong bar byed/ /dur khrod gnas kyis yongs su bskor/ /ma mo'i gnas sogs khyab ⑩par byed/ /klu yis mchod pa'i zhing skyong ba/ /me yi ri17bye mas yongs su bskor/ /sgo dang mig gis khyad 12par 'gyur/ /gtso bo'i sngags kyis /rtelus can te/ /sgrub pa po yi lus la gnas/ /de dag rim par dus bstan pa/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i sngags pa yis/ /sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams khyad par las/ /'bru nag gtor ma rab tu shis/ /sha chen gyis ni brgyan pa yi/ /tshogs rdzas pū dza mugus pas dbul / /phyi nang gsang ba khyad par las/ /bstan pa'i tshul gyis phrin (7las las / /bye brag rgyun dang gnas skabs pas/ /grub dang sgrub pas mngon du 79wa 808

'gyuranyu)ske/ /dus rnams kun tu zhe sdang gis/ /rnam pa kun tu gzhom mi bya/ /yul min pa la gsad bya lan/ /rnal 'byor dam 2tshig las nyams phyir/ /grub pa nam yang yod mi srid/ /khyad par ye shes bla med pa/ /dam tshig mgon po gesgrub pa yi/ /dam tshig 'di ni rmad po che/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i lam sbyor mdzad / /byang chub sems kyi zla ba 'di/ /yar ngo mar ngo rab tu gnas/ /yar ngo yis ni skyed ⑤byed la/ /mar ngo la ni 'grib par byed/ /yar ngo yi ni bcwa ⑨lnga la/ /byang chub sems kyi 3)mkha' 'gro yang / /bde ba chen por 'du bar dumadzad/ /'di ni nges pa'i don du gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor lha nyid lus nyid yin/ /gzhan du lha dang dkyil 'khor ni/ /btsal yang rnyed par mi 'gyur zhes/ /'dren pa dpa' bos rtag (rtenatu gsungs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba la/ /drag po kun gyi srog gyur pa/ /yon tan phrin bolas dbang phyug gi / /phyi nang gsang ba'i bdag po yin/ /ston pa gnas pa'i rang bzhin lasam / /'khor lo dgug bya gnyis med bstim/ /dngas nyu2snyigs las ni rgyu 'bras dang / /gnas pa khyad par rten 'brel te/ /'khrul dang 'khrul pa ma yin panyunye/ /khams gsum kun la dbang byed pas/ /'jig rten las dang ye shes kyi/ /mgon po'i khyad par mngon du 'byung / /gdags pa tha snyad khyab pa po / /thun mong bar ni bstan pa yin/ /'di dag las dang skye bo las/ /sgrib pa thun mong lha yi cha/ /dngos dang brgyud chepas lung bstan pa/ /srog dang srog ma yin pa ste/ /rgyu dang rkyen dang bskul ba yis/ /gsang sngags bzlas pa mngon par phye/ /'di ni mngon du 'byung ba'o/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsang ba mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u ste bzhi 79—809

pa'o // //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /he ru ka dpal mgon nyid kyi①/ /gsang ba'i sprul pa nag po che/ /'di yi sgrub rim bshad par bya/ /gsang ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs mchog ༷ ste/ /skal ba can la sbyin par bya/ /gang du sgrub pa'i sa phyogs su/ /mi mthun g.yeng ba spang byas nas/ /de nas nag po bsgrub ③par bya / /'gro ba kun la rab bltas nas/ /tshad med byang chub sems kyi ①blos/ /snying rje chen po (lde)bskyed byas nas/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas ni/ /lhor bltas skra grol gcer bu yis/ /dang por skad cig tsam gyis ni/ /rang lhar bskyed pa'i snying ga yiru/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang / /bsil (7zhing 'od dang bcas pa bsam/ /de'i pyogesteng ro las nyi dkyil 'khoral/ /rta bdun 'od zer tsha ba dang / /me yi rang bzhin 'phro ba bsam/ /de dbus yi ge rtsu nag po/ /ye shes lnga yi marang bzhin can/ /de yi 'od kyis hunyesnang ba las/ /dpag med kha dog bzhi hu bcas bsam/ /rang bzhin gnas su 'phros pa 8las//bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lha/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bcas pa dang / /nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas/ /mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ /skyabs su 'gro dang mchod pa dbulas/ /sdig pa bshags pa la 8sogs bya/ /bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol/ /de rjes dngos po thams cad kun/ /ma lus stong pa nyid gzhug cing / /oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhāḥtsosarba dharmāḥ0swa bhā ba shurnyo3rta8/oṃ badz+ra shud+dhāḥyisarba dharmāḥbadz+ra shurnyo3rtadu — ri/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhāḥ 0 sarba dharmāḥyo ga shurnyo3rta(ge / zhes brjod par bya'o/ /phyi dang nang gi dngos po kun/ /gdod 79—810

nas dag pa'i ngang du bsam/ /de nyid hūm̐ dang bcas pa yang ①/ /nā da tsam du gnas pa las/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang las ni/ /tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi khyab par bya/ /de las sa bon 'di dag ni9na/ /'chad bzhin pa las rim pas bsam / /yo las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang / /ro las me yi dkyil 'khor dang ske/ /bo dkar chu yi dkyil 'khor te/ /lo las gser gyi sa gzhi nyid/ /de steng r+bha chalas ri rab 'byung / /de dag phyi nang ngo bo nyid/ /de dag steng gi cha la yang / /dbus su paṃ las pad+ma ni/ /sna tshogs pad+ma rgya che ba/ /lte ba ge sar bcas dbus su/ /ha las sna tshogs rdo rje ni/ /kha dog lnga dang ldan par bsam / /de dbus ro las nyi ma yi/ /hūm̐ yig sa bon las byung ba/ /sa gzhi ma lus rdo rjer gyur/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams rdo rje dang / /ral gri 'khor lo mda' dang ni/ /phur bu ④gri gug kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang ni/ /rtse gsum nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar⑤/ /du ma rnam par 'phros nas ni/ /shin tu rgya che bsam par bya/ /bla re ra ba sogs rdzisadang ni/ /gur gyi rnam par mtshams bcing bya/ /me 'od 'bar ba khyab 3)par 'gyur/ /'di dag bsrung po7ba'i khyad par ro/ /rbu ⑨las byung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ /rtsibs bcu pa ni yongs su 'khor/ /de steng tshur las nyi dkyil 'khoram/ /de yi dbus su rtsu mdzad do/ /zhal gsum phyag ni drug pa ste/ /rin chen klu dbang rgyan dang ldan/ /rol pas rnam par sgeg par bsam/ /ro las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /de steng 8rgyu bcu rnam par bsam/ /de las khro bo'i rgyal po bcu/ /zhal phyir gzigs pa rnam par bsam/ /khro bo de dag re re zhing / /phyogs skyong bcu po gdan la ni/ /bkug nas gnyis med bzhugs par bsam/ /de las nyurtagasang sngags brjod 73—811

tsam gyis/ /phur bus gdab dang brdung bar bya/ /des ni bla med mchog ①dag 'gyur tshol/ /khro bo de dag re re zhing / /brtan par bya phyir gsang sngags brjod/ /oṃ dkar 'khor lo dang bcas pa/ /'od ldan de las spros bsdus pas/ /bcom ldan rang bzhin yangs shing khyab/ /'od du zhu nas gzhal yas khang / /rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa/ /gru bzhi sgo dang rta babs bcas/ /rdo rje dang ni nor bu yi/ /'od zer 'khrugs pa'i rnam pa'o/ /pho brang nang sem zlum po la//re mig dgu pa 3)rdo rjes bskor/ /phyi ni pad+ma mu khyud bcas/ /de yi nang na e yi dbyibs/ /drag po'i gnas su bsam par bya/ /dbus ma'i nang du paṃ las ni / /pad+ma nyi gezar bcas pa bsam/ /ā li kā li 'dus pa las/ /de las nam mkha'i sa bon te/ /nam mkha' las ni hūm̐ byung ste/ /gnyis med zhugs las 'od du zhu/ /de la rdo rje gri gug bsam/ /'od kyi snang bas khyab pa las/ /skad cig gis ni sku rdzogs pa/ /nag po chen po bsam par bya/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dpa' bo chen po rol pas bzhugs/ /yab yum gnyis su med par bsam/ /de ltar yab yum rdzogs bskyed nas/ /mkha' gsang byin gyis brlab bya ste/ /sngags brjod pas ni dgyes pa bskyed/ /de las dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa las/ /yum gyi mkha' dbyings bde chen du/ /so sor cho gas bskyed byas la/ /phyi rol du ni rim gyis 'byung rme/ /dang por gtso bo'i rgyan dang bcas/ /rdzogs par phyung ste dhū tī nyanas/ /gyen du thugs ku'i 2pad+ma las/ /'thon te 'gro ba'i don byas la/ /slar 'dus rang la thim gyur pa/ /dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs su gnas/ /de las rim pa ji bzhin du/ /phyung nas so so'i tsogadan la 79—812

bzhugs / /gtso bo'i phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro bzhi/ /zhal gcig phyag ni bzhi pa ste/ /gar stabs ldan pa'i lha mo ni/ /g.yas brkyang ba ni rnam par 'gying hunye//dpa' mo ②bde ba'i skur bskyed pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ske/ /sna tshogs pad 'dab chal gnas pa/ /nyi ma la gnas mgon po ni/ /shar du sku yi mgon po dang / /lho ru yon tan mgon po dang / /nub tu gsung gi mgon po dang / /byang du las kyi mgon po ste/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /gri gug thod pa bsnams ④pa'o/ /so so'i tshigayon du yum re re/ /gtum mo dang ni drag mo dang / /zlog khyenyebyed ma dang dpa' mo ste/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyan rjodang bcas/ /de yi phyi yi gru chad la/ /bde 9〈sna'adzin pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /gnyi 'dzin dang rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /so so'i yum dang bcas pa ste/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'bar ba'o/ /de yi phyi rol sgo dang grwar/ /lha mo brgyad po gar gyis rol/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ /gar stabs ldan pas bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams rdzogs pa dang / /de nas gtso bo yab yum dag /snyoms par zhugs pas 'od du zhu/ /de nas lha mo bzhi yis ni//rdo rje tshad med ⑨dbyangs kyis tsobaskul/ /e baṃ si ta u ḍa na nī ma'i/ dza ti dha ma dha ma/ gha ma gha ma 0i ka ma/ dha dha sha ri dha ro/ sa ni sa sa sa ni ga ma sa sa sa/ ri ga mo bu ma te sa ri sa ra sa ri ri sa ni sha /ma hā ma a dha 12ma sa sa/shu tra ni sā sa sā/ sa ni sa ri ta gha ma i r+ghaṃ/ a ta ma ta ya/ sa sā pa pa/ma ya a ba sa hai yin ma a i/ de ltar bskul bar gyur pa colas/ /de ltar nye bar gsan nas ni/ /thugs rje'i ngang las bzhengs mdzad de/ /nag po gsang ba'i bu dang bcas/ /shin tu 'jigs shing 'bar ba'i sku/ /bdud 'dul chen 79—813

po rgyan dang bcas/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu bar mdzad/ /de nyid brtan dang mnyes par mdzad/ /sku gsung thugs ni rgyas gdab cing / /ye shes gzhug dang dbang bskur dang / /byin gyis brlabs dang mchod pa dang / /sngags kyis bsten phyed 3)bzlas pa bya/ /bdud rtsi myang dang bstod ②cing bskul/ /ting 'dzin don bsam nyer bsdu ( bya/ /de nas ldang bar gyur pa na/ /gnyis pa lha rnams thams cad kun/ /skad cig gis ni rdzogs bya ste/ /de yi ngang la ting nge 'dzin/ /gsang ba khyad par rdzogs ④par bya/ /rnam rtog bag chags kyis bcings la/ /rtog pa dag pa'i thabs mchog ldan/ /rnam rtog rang bzhin yongs shes na/ /de nyid thob tu med pa ste/ /bde ba chen po yang dag 'byung / /chags pa med pas kun du spyad/ /'di de'i rang bzhin rnal 'byor pa/ /rig ma rnams la rol byed na'ang / /de nyid shes la bcing med de/ /rnam par rol pa'i tshul mchog go/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsang ba lha'i gnas mngon par 'byung ba'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// //de nas yang dag bshad bya ba/ /gang du sngags kyi yi ge dang / /bzang po'i sngags kyi phreng ba 'di/ /rdza rnga bcings pa dudakyilas shes bya/ /re mig bdun pa'i grangs kyis ni/ /kun nas mnyam (6)par dgod par bya/ /mkhas pas dbyangs dang gsal byed ni/ /sde tshan rim pas phye ba nyid/ /kun nas bskor ba'i tshul gyis ni/ /rim pa bzhin du btu bar bya/ /sde tshan drug pa'i lnga pa ni/ /ha yi 'og nas 7ciganas pa blang / / usma ṣa 98)yi bzhi pa nyuganyid/ /wa 'og gnas pa de nyid de/ /sde tshan gnyis pa'i dang po ste/ /pa yi steng na gnas pa 0blang / /79—814

an+tas+tha yi gsum pa ste/ /ya yi steng ma yang dag blang / /sde tshan brgyad pa'i bzhi pa ni/ /ma yi steng na gnas pa sbyar1)/ /sde tshan dang po'i gnyis pa nyid/ /nya yi 'og na gnas pa sbyar/ /sde tshan dang po'i lnga pa ste/ /ḍa yi 'og na gnas pa sasbyar/ /sde tshan dang po'i bcwa (5)lnga pa/ /dha yi steng na gnas pa yi/ /zla tshes thig les brgyan par bya/ /sde tshan dang po'i rngubacu bzhi pa/ /de yi 'og ma'i yi ge la/ /dbyangs kyi bcwa /de lnga pa yin te4)/ /dha yi 'og mas brgyan par bya / /de nyid thog mar sbyin bya yin/ /sde tshan drug pa'i gnyis pa nyid(7)/ /na yi 'og na gnas pa ste/ /bzhi pa yi ni thog ma gang / /ra yi 'og ma sbyar byas te / /thog ⑧mar 'byung ba'i drug po ste/ /'di ni yid bzhin po)nor bu ster/ /tsha yi steng na gnas pa gang / /bha yi 'og ma rnam par blang / /ṭa yi steng mas brgyan par bya/ /ha yi 'og na gnas pa dang / /wa yi tshe'og ma gzung zhunyabar bya//pa yi steng ma nyid btu bya/ /ya yi steng na gnas pa las/ /nya yi steng mas las kun byed/ /ma yi steng gnas yi ge nyid/ / ra yi 12'og ma sbyar byas la/ /nyis 'gyur rte /tshonyeyi steng mas brgyan/ /tsa yi steng na gnas pa la/ /i yi steng ma drung du bzhag /'di ni dngos grub 'byung ba'i gnas/ /nga 7yi steng ma'i yi ge la / /dha yi steng mas yang dag brgyan/ /rig byed mngon sum dang por gnas/ /ma lus ye shes skur mgyur pa'o/ /ṣa tshayi 'og na gnas pa la/ /bha yi 'og ma'i yi ge dang / /ṇa yi 'og nas rab sbyin dang / /pa yi thog the tshom yang dag blang / /tha 'og ḍa 'og stan du sbyar/ /tsa sa par gnas yi ge dang / / dzha yi steng the'um bdag po ste/ / sa yi 39bar na gnas pa bzung / /kha dang a yi bar gnas pa//ta yi 'og ma nya steng )ldan/ /ma yi steng gnas tsā ri lha'og sbyar/ /thig les 79—815

brgyan pa nyis 'gyur sbyar/ /tsa yi steng na gnas pa la/ /a ①yi steng mas brgyan pa drung / /'di ni sbas pa'i snying po ste/ /rang srog yi ger (migasang ba'o//da yi steng ma'i yi ge la/ /dha yi steng mas brgyan par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che/ /snying po bzlas pa'i rig pa ste/ /bkra shis pa ni thog mar sbyar/ /na yi steng mas yang dag brgyan / /dza yi gong ma dha steng 0sbyar/ /sa la bar gnas ḍa steng (desbyar/ /thig le nā das brgyan par bya/ /na yi'og dha steng ⑦mgo bor sbyin/ /'di las ma steng (8)ri 'og ldan/ /thig le zla tshes dag gis mtshan/ /tsa yi steng na gnas pa la/ /ra yi 'og ma drung du sbyin/ /bha steng 6)gnas pa la 'og sbyar/ /nya yi 'og ma yang dag ldan/ /sha sa bar gnas nya 'og sbyar/ /'di ni gsang ba'i bzlas pa ste/ /bya ba stobs ldan nyid yin no/ /gang du mngon par phyogs pa yi/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po yi/ /gsang sngags mchog tu gyur pa 'dis/ /stong dang brgya pa bcur 'gyur gyis/ /rigs ni dam pa'i sa la gnas/ /thob pa yul dang yul du gnas/ /pha yi 'og ma dang por blang / /ha yi 'og ma blang byas la/ /tha yi steng ma sbyin par bya/ /ḍa yi steng ma'i drung nyid du/ /sha yi thog mas brten 7par bya/ /pha yi steng ma 0btu bar bya/ /la yi steng ma'i yi ge la/ /ḍa yi steng mas stan du sbyar/ /nya yi steng ma nyis 'gyur la/ /phyi ma nya yi 'og mas brgyan/ /e yi 'og gyur bsdus nyu)pa la / /sha yi steng ma drung du sbyar/ /la yi 'og ma rgyan du byas/ /nya yi tso'og gis 7sbyin par bya/ /o yi 'og na gnas pa la/ /nya yi 'og mas brgyan par bya / /da nyugeyi 'og mar gnas pa la/ /thig le cin da dag gis brgyan/ /da yi 'og ma'i yi ge la/ /u yi steng ma sbyin par bya/ /tsha yi steng na gnas pa gang / /73—816

bha yi 'og ma rnam par blangs/ /ta 0)yi steng mas brgyan par bya/ /dha yi 'og ma gnas pa dang / /wa yi 'og ma gzung ②bar bya/ /sa yi steng ma nyid bsdus byas / /ya yi steng na gnas pa las/ /nya yi 'og mas ④de la brgyan/ /nya yi 'og ma kun gyi rten/ /sa yi steng ma blang bar bya(snye/ /bha yi steng na gnas pa la/ /la yi 'og mas brgyan par bya/ /pha (7yi steng ma nyid de blang / /dzha yi 'og ma nga steng dang / /ba yi steng na gnas pa la/ /u yi steng ma yang dag blang / /e yi 'og gnas yi ge la/ /dha yi steng ma mgo bor sbyin/ /la tha bar gnas pa la yang ske/ /ṇa yi steng mas brgyan par bya/ /ma steng ⑦jig le nā das brgyan/ /rta ⑧'og gnas pa'i yi ge la/ /da steng khas yi steng ma dang / /pha 'og ta yi 'og mas brgyan/ /dzha yiyi gong na 'ormiganas pa dang / /ma yi steng ma sa steng tsoganas/ /ya yi steng ma nyid dang ldan/ /dzha thege'og nya yi steng ma la/ /dha yi steng mas mgo bor brgyan/ /ḍa 8yi 'og ma sha steng tsheldan/ /thig le nā das ⑩brgyan pa'o/ /ḍa 8yi steng mas (3tsha nyid du/ /sha yi thog mas brten lho)par bya/ /pha yi steng ma btu bar bya/ /la steng bu gnas pa ṭa steng sbyar —1/ /nya yi steng du nyis 'gyur bsang rtel/ /phyi ma'i nya yi 'og mas brgyan/ /dbyangs yig dang po ka 'og can/ /sa steng du )gnas pa nyid dang yang / /u steng gnas pa yang dag bcas/ /sa steng buganas pa thig les brgyan/ /nya yi steng ma'i gnas pa la/ /i yi 'og gnas ga mdun snyiganas/ /ta 9 3yi 'og ma mgo bor sbyin/ /nga steng gnas pa ṇa 'og sbyar/ /la steng du tshoganas pa ṭa 'og bcas/ /la 'og zur gnas sbyar bar bya / /bha yi 'og ma'i yi ge la/ /ma steng — gnas pa stan du byas/ /sha'i ni)'og dza yi rdurtesteng mar sbyar/ /ṇa 'og gnas pa nyid drung ste sto/ /bha steng thaganas pa'i 79—817

'og mas brgyan/ /sha steng ①drung du sbyin par bya/ /la steng sha yi thog ②ma la/ /phyi ma nya 'og gnas pas mdzes/ /ṭa 'og sha thog ②thig les brgyan/ /sha thog ṛ yi (ge'og mas brgyan/ /ba thog la steng (5)gnas pa sbyar/ /de la nya 'og sbyin par bya/ /bha (besteng (myiganas pa la 'og ldan/ /nya 'og dag gis yang dag mdzes / /ka ga bar gnas pa nyid la/ /nyis 'gyur du ni bsdu bar bya/ /gha steng gnas pa de nyid la/ /nya 'og brgyan pa nyid du bya/ /ma yi thog ma ḍa ⑧'og bcas/ /gha steng (geganas pa nyid dang ni/ /wa 'og gnas pa ṭha 0'og sbyin / /ha 'og ṇa yi 'og mar ldan/ /de yi nyis 'gyur shes par bya/ /kha 'og (lham yi yi ge la/ /u ṛ 3)bar gnas sbyar bar bya/ /ma steng pha 'og 'og tu sbyin / /de ni nyis 'gyur sbyar bar bya/ /tsha yi steng ma pha thog drung / /ṣa hunyeyi thog ma drung du gnas/ /de ni zung du sbyar bar bya/ /ma steng gnas pa skes thog drung / /nyis 'gyur rim par shes par bya/ /sha thog gnas pa wa thog drung ske/ /lan gnyis su ni brjod par bya/ /ka 'og gnas pa pha stan 8pa/ /ba 'og stan du byas pa 7nyid/ /nyis 'gyur dag tsho/ 7tu shes par bya/ /bha steng 8gnas pa ṭa steng 3/drung / /ṣa yi 'og ma stan du byas/ /sha'i ( 7steng ḍa yi 37'og mas brgyan/ /dha 'og i thog stan du sbyar/ /pha yi steng ma drung du bzhag /ha yi 'og ma ṇa 'og ldan/ /pha thog drag por 'gyur ba'o/ /sha steng tshetha yi 'og mas brgyan/ /'di nyid rim pa mngon spyod pa'i/ /mā tsho snyer ya yi thog mar sbyar/ /ma yi steng gnas ri 'og sbyar/ /nyis 'gyur thig le nā das brgyan/ /tsa yi steng na gnas pa la/ /i yi steng ma brgyan pa drung / /bha thog tha thog gnas pa sbyar//de la nya yi 'og mas brgyan/ /ma steng 30gnas pa nya srina'og ni/ /yang dag stan 79—818

du bya ba'o/ /'di ni dri med bde ba'i gter/ /snying po gsang sngags 'di nyid ni / /gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /nag po chen po ①'khor dang bcas/ /ma lus zhing skyong 'khor dang bcas/ /dur khrod ro la ce ②spyang dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams 'du ba bzhin/ /nges par 'du bar byed pa ste/ /bstan pa rgya mtsho srung byed pa'o/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i (kyebar du ni/ /de yi bgegs rnams ma lus pa/ /til 'bru tsam du byed par mdzad/ /snying po 'di ni zlos byed cing / /gang du nyi ma gcig tu yang / /ma chad mngon par sems pa ④yi/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor la/ /'jigs pa kun las srung (chub dang / /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa dang / /de bzhin dbang dang mngon spyod la/ /thogs pa med par 'grub par 'gyur/ /ji srid mtshan ma ma byung gi/ /bar du 'bad de bsgrub par bya/ /mtshan ma byung nas bla ma yi/ /man ngag bzhin du las la sbyar / /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsang ba (9)sngags kyi le'u ste drug pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /yang dag ye shes bskyed 9pepa po/ /gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /gtum po de tshonyeyi gsang ba'i yum/ /lha mo bzhi dang bcas pa yi/ /gsang sngags btu ba 997bshad par bya/ /dbyangs yig bcu bzhi pa dag la/ /thig le nā das rnam par brgyan/ /rig byed mngon sum dang por gnas/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa dang //bdun pa yi ni dang po nyid/ /an+tas+tha yi gsum pa ste/ /dang po'i gsum pa thog tu sbyin/ /lnga pa'i lnga pa gsum pas brgyan/ /gnyis pa yi 0ni dang po la/ /79—819

an+tas+tha yi gsum pas brten①/ /dbyangs kyi bcu gsum pa yis brgyan/ /drug pa yi ni dang po dang / /dbyangs kyi dgu pas ②gnas der sbyar/ /gnyis pa yi ②ni dang po dang ④/ /an+tas+tha yi gsum pa dang / /de nyid kyi ⑤ni gnyis pa dang / /lnga pa yi ni dang po la/ /dbyangs kyi bdun pas steng 'og sbyin/ /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pa mgo bor sbyin/ /gsum pa yi ni dang po la/ /drung du lnga pa'i lnga pa sbyar/ /lnga pa'i bzhi pa dag dang sbyar/ /dang po'i dang po'i drung du ni/ /gnyis pa'i gsum pa sbyar ba dang / /mthar gnas las kyang ⑥phyi ma yi7/ /de la dbyangs kyi gsum pas brgyan/ /an+tas+tha yi dang po la/ /dbyangs yig bcu gcig pa yis brgyan/ /brgyad pa yi ni bzhi pa la/ /dbyangs yig drug pa dag gis brgyan/ /thig le nā das mdzes pa'o/ /drug pa yi ni gnyis pa nyid/ /bzhi pa yi ni thog ma ⑤sbyar/ /'di ni gsang ba'i gtum pa mo/ /drag cing shin tu cher 'jigs byed/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i rigs ⑨'dzin gter/ /bkra shis pa ni thog mar sbyar/ /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa la//dbyangs yig bdun pa steng 'og sbyar/ /thig le nā tsodas mdzes pa yin/ / usma ṣa hu yi bzhi pa la/ /dbyangs yig drug pa dang sbyar ba/ /an+tas+tha yi gnyis pa sbyar/ /de nyid thig les mdzes par byas/ /gnyis pa'i dang po blang byas la//dbyangs kyi dgu pa blang nyunyeb nyid/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ / usma ṣa 8yi bzhi pa dang / /gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang / /dbyangs yig bcu pa sbyar bar bya/ /bdun rnyipa yi ni gnyis pa dang / /gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang / /lnga pa'i dang po btu bar bya/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /dbyangs yig bcwa 8lnga pa yis brgyan / /gnyis pa'i lnga par gnas pa'otshe/ /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa 79—820

dang ske/ /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /drug pa yi ni bzhi pa dang / /phyi ma'i yang ni bzhi pa la/ /lnga pa yi yang lnga pa la/ /dbyangs kyi gsum pas brgyan par bya/ /dang po yi ni dang po dang / /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /dbyangs kyi lnga pas brgyan par bya/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po dang / /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa la/ /an+tas+tha ①yi dang po sbyar/ /mthar gnas pa yi gsum pa dang / /bdun pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /drug pa yi ni bzhi pa sbyar/ /lnga pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /dbyangs kyi dgu pa'i yi ge la/ /lnga pa'i gsum pa gdags par bya/ /usma ṣa zhuyi gsum pa la/ /lnga pa'i dang po sbyar bar bya/ /thig le nā das yang dag brgyan/ /drug pa yi ni gsum pa dang / /an+tas+tha ③yi dang po ste/ /yi ge gsum gyi bdag nyid kyis / /nyis 'gyur dag tu sbyar bar bya/ /usma ṣa ④yi bzhi pa la she/ /dang po'i drug pa dang sbyar ba/ /an+tas+tha ⑥yi gnyis pa sbyar/ /thig le nā das brgyan par bya/ /'di ni gsang ba'i yum dag gis/ /snying po sbas pa mchog gyur pa/ /lha mo nag mo ye shes che/ /sngags ni drag cing sdud pa'o/ /de nas ye shes lnga ldan pa'i/ /rig byed mngon sum dang por bzhagatso /drug pa yi ni lnga pa dang / /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa la/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po nyid/ /arnyasba duyi gsum pa ste/ /dang po'i gsum pa thog tu sbyin/ /dang po'i bcu drug pa mtha' bya/ /mthar ni hūṃ phaṭa sbyar bar bya/ /sde tshan gnyis pa'i dang po la / /an+tas+tha ⑨yi gnyis pa sbyar/ /dang po'i dgu pa blang ba nyid/ /drug pa yi ni lnga pa la/ /thig le nā das brgyan pa'o/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po la/ /drung du de nyid lnga pa sbyar/ /gnyis pa'i dang po de nyid dang / /dbyangs kyi dgu pa sbyar bar bya/ /mthar gnas pa yi bzhi pa la/ /bdun pa yi ni gnyis pa sbyar/ /79—821

de la thig le nā das brgyan/ /gnyis pa yi ni dang po la/ /an+tas+tha ①yi gsum pa dang ske/ /bdun pa yi ni gnyis pa sbyar/ /lnga pa'i dang po nyid la yang ② /dbyangs kyi bdun pa steng 'og sbyar/ /bdun pa yi ni gnyis pa la/ /thig le nā das mdzes byas pa'o/ /'di dag kun gyi thog ma dang / /tha mar yang dag brten par bya/ /'di ni ḍā ki bzhi dag gi / /snying po sbas pa mchog tu gsungasal/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsang sngags rim par bstan pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad par bya/ /gsang ba sngags kyi 'khor lo las/ / mthar ni hūṃ phaṭa sbyar bar bya/ /④lha yi 'khor lo rgya mtsho nyid/ /lan tshwa chu rgyun 'bab pa'i ngang / /gangs kyi thigs ⑤pa bdud rtsi'i chu/ /me tog mdangs gsal snying po yi/ /ge sar ze 'brur ༅ldan pa la/ /'dab rgyas ye shes nyi shar bas / /rang grol mdangs 'bar rab tu rgyas/ /rdo rje rin chen ral gri dang / /'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dag las/ /'khor ba'i rgyun galas 'od zer 'phro/ /steng 'og dag las rim pa ni/ /'khrug ④cing gcod pa'i gri gug gis/ /las dang phrin 9skulas rang byung du/ /byed cing bskul ba'i las grub pa/ /phyi nang gsang ba 7rim bzhin du/ /dbab dang sngags pa zlog hunyepa ste/ /rtsa ba yan lag las bzhir 'gyur/ /dang po thun mong dgu pa ste/ /gnyis pa bye brag phye ba ⑫dang ske/ /bskyed pa'i ye shes mi zlog rtso pa/ /klungs su chud pa phyag rgya che/ /snying po gcig la dus gsum du/ /'gyur med de nyid dbye ba nyid/ /gcig las du ma'i ngo bo canami/ /'jig rten pa dang ye shes che/ /mi 'gyur ba dang 'gugs 79—822

pa dang / /las rnams byed pa'i srog gyur pa/ /gsang sngags 'khor lo 'di dag ni/ /bye brag rnal 'byor pas shes bya/ /oṃ ma hā kā la rtsu r+ghaṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ku'u zhu)wa ma hā kā lā ②ya rtsu hūṃ ( phaṭa/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ tabya thā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā (peya/ shā sa rna u pa hā rī tsā/ e ṣā partsi/ ma ⑤kā laḥ.a yo/ i rda ñtsa)rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri tsā/ ya di pra ti dzñā/ sma char si ta dā/ e (nyen duṣ+ṭa satwa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ groṇ+ḍa groṇ+ḍal/ brnya brta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da hanyu )/ pa tsa pa tsa/ sarba dus / di na me ke na mā ra ya zhun hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ma hā kā li ni kro dha sa ki la rak+ṣi tsā 4)tsaṇ+ḍa ak+ṣi hunyele hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hrīḥs kā li ma hā kā li rak+ta māṃ (snyese na/bhak+ṣa ṇi a mu 8ka su/ sab lo ⑩ste bha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥmi hre ro hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/oṃ ka rā hu 7mi mi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ kung kā lo hrīḥ42rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ kā la ra tri /7)ro hūṃ phaṭa/de las dngos dang nyams su yang / /nag po chen po'i zhal ston dang / /tha ma rmi lam lung ston pa/ /mi nag bong thung gsus snye )'phyang dang / /bya nag khwa ta la sogs 'ong / /de yang rab 'bring tha ma yi/ /bye brag rtags sum̐ 'char bar 'gyur / /grangs ni bdun 'bum dag dang 2lhani/ /mngon sum gsal ba'i nges pa 'char/ /khri phrag bdun dang khri phrag dgu/ /stong phrag bdun gyis zhunye bar 'gyur / /thabs dang shes rab bcas pa yi/ /sngags kyi stong phrag bcu dag ni/ /dus ni zla drug zhag bdun par/ /rnal 'byor smra ba bcad de bzlas/ /mi tshig bar ma chod pa yi/ /gsang sngags phrin du snyelas nges par 'grub/ /thun mtshams mchod dang gtor ma dang / /bstod dang bcol bskul las la 'bad/ /rang nyid he ru kur gsal ba/ /ri rab steng du yum bcas bsam/ /de mdun nag 79wa 823

po chen po nyid/ /gsal ba bskyed tshul dbye ba yis/ /rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs pa ni/ /mngon sum lta bur blta bar bya/ /bdag dang mdun gyi mgon po yi/ /thugs ku'i stis bon rang sngags las/ /de ltar spro bsdus ting 'dzin bsam / /de ltar dus dang gzhan du yang / /rten bcas dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa dang / /rten btsugs brtan (mibyed de nyid bsnyen/ /de nas rten bcas tsam gyis ni/ /nges par de yi mdun song ba/ /mchod dang gtor ma bsham par bya//sha chen bsreg zhuspos phul nas ni/ /dmigs pa gtod par byabyed pa dang / /gang la bya ba'i bsgrub bya de(de)/ /dmigs pas bkug cing bstab 6)pa dang / /gtor mar dbul rigezhing bka' bsgo kun bya/ /lha dang bral zhing nyes pa bsgo/ /de nas ma nyes nyes pa bsgragatsor /dpang btsugs las 7la bcol bskul bya/ /de yis nges par 'grub par 'gyur/ /de las khyad par phrin 0las ni/ /lha sbyin dang ni mchod sbyin sogs/ /bsgral ba'i zhing de gang yin pa/ /de yi zag pa'i rdzas rnams dang / /phung shul sa dang g.yul sprad sa/ /grog mkhar sa la ⑫sogs pa rnams/ /bsdud nyu)chad sa la bong bu'i chus/ /sbrus 8te ling ga sta gon bya / /de nas dben par song nas ni/ /mar ngo yi ni tshes brgyad dam/ /bcu bzhi la sogs sgrub dus la/ /gza' skar shin tu drag po la/ /de nas 'khor lo bri bar bya/ /rgyu ni ro ras shing shun dang / /zhing lpags dag la dug sna dang / /khrag dang dug gi me tog gi/ /du ba mtshan ngan thod chags la/ /mchog phur bstod pa'i snag tshas bri/ /rgya skyegs dag gis bsres la bri/ /tshad dang ldan pa'i mu khyud ni/ /rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa la/ /nang du ling 32tshe dgu pa bya/ /phyogs bzhi dbus dang lnga por ni/ /gru gsum nag po sa bon bcas/ /las 79wa 824

rnams byed pa rlung yig dang / /ma hā kā la 'bru bzhi dang / /steng non oṃ dang badz+ra ste/ /de yi phyi ①rim rtsibs brgyad la/ /a mu kai dang ba yi ni/ /yi ge bcu gsum gnyis gnyis pa/ /g.yas skor (midag tu dgod par bya/ /de yi phyi rim ②pad 'dab ④brgyad/ /sgo mtshams lha mo'i 'khor lo'i sngags/ /ming spel bcas pa dgod par bya/ /de yi nang gi gru chad bzhir/ /r+ghaṃ gnyis phaṭa dang bcas pa la/ /ming spel bcug la bri bar bya/ /khyad par sbas pa'i 'khor lo ni / /dbus su rlung gi sa bon nyid/ /phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro ma bzhi gnas/ /phyogs bzhir sngags kyi phreng ba las/ /phyi rol rtsibs la gcod phyepa'i sngags/ /'dab ⑥brgyad cha la tsaṇ+ḍi stika /mtha' rten snga ma dag dang mtshungs/ /yang na rim pa gsum pa yi/ /gsang sngags ma hā kā ri skul yi/ /phrin tho)las khyad par dgod par bya/ /'dis ni shin tu mngon spyod myur/ /thabs dang shes rab khyad par dang / /steng 'og bar gyi dbye ba yis/ /zangs dang lcags kyi gri gug gis / /bla dang tshe srog don snying la/ /myur du 'khor bas gcod par byed/ /sdud byed 'phrog cing len pa'i srog /bsgral ba rdo rje rigs kyi las/ /thun mong du ni bya ba yin/ /khyad par 'khor lo dril bya ste/ /dus kyi rim pas las la sbyar/ /'di ni kun du mnan pa ste/ /las kyi gshin rje'i gnas su gtad/ /'khor lo la yang bsnyen bopa dang / /bsgrub 37pa go rims nyartenor mi bya/ /'dis ni 8bya ba mi 'grub med/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsang sngags dang 'khor lo bsgrub 7pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po yi/ /rnal 73—825

'byor ting hu)'dzin la zhugs te/ /mngon par spyod pa brtsam par bya/ /khyad par dur khrod pa yi shing / /lha 'dre gtum po gnas pa las/ /ma mo'i bye brag brtags pa las/ /bcad pa mgo mjug ma nor bar/ /gnyis gshags ②de nas sngags bris la/ /bsdams te zla ri ba mig gis ni/ /phye ba'i ④bdun phrag gsum pa la/ /legs par gzhag ste na tshad du bya/ /dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa la gzugs gyen/ /gzhan yang bsgrub bya'i gzugs dag ni/ /zur gsum tshud pa sngags dang bcas/ /ming spel bskul tshig ldan pa ni/ /grangs ni rab 'bring tha ma ste/ /ci rigs par ni bya bar gsungs/ /yang na 9)ro sgrom shing dul yang //byang bu byas la yinaliṅga bri/ /gzhan du mgon po yab yum gyi/ /'khor lo legs par bris pa dang / /bsgrub 7bya srog gi 'khor lo ni/ /gri gug lnga pa 'khor ba dag /de dag bar du bcug pa dang / /yang na mgon po'i 'khor lo dang / /bsgrub bya du yod liṅga 37rnams/ /de yi nang du dril bar bya/ /'khor lo tshon tsoskud rnam lngas dkri/ge/ /de yi phyi rol ku sha yi/ / rtswa yis ④mi gzugs byas nas kyang ske/ /rang mdun gru gsum nag po yi/ /nang du gzugs de gzhug nyanyepar bya/ /de la lha dang dbye ba dang / /nyes pa bsgo zhing bsgrag par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid lha dang ni/ /mdun du nag po chen po ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /yum dang bcas pa bskyed pa dang / /spyan drangs tshamachod cing bstim par bya/ /las mgon rnams dang ma mo bzhi/ /rgyal chen bzhi dang phyogs skyong bcu/ /lha srin sde brgyad ma lus dang / /gzhan yang dur khrod sha za dang ske/ /ma mo ro langs ce nyu sbyang dang / /stag dang dred dang bya gcan /shesogs//bya rog khā ta la sogs pas/// /yongs su bskor cing phrin ri )las byed/ /de nas 79wa 826

rang dang mgon po dang / /lha mo bzhi la sogs pa yi/ /sa bon las ni 'od zer yang / /lcags kyu lta bu dpag med pas/ /bsgrub bya de dag ma lus pa/ /snying gi srog rtsa nas drangs ①te/ /rang dbang med par rlung gis bteg /myur du 'ongs pa lamadog nyams pa/ /rid cing skra 'dzings shin tu 'dar/ / yid yed ⑤sngang zhing skrag pa de/ /zhags pas bcings dang bsdams pa dang / /dril bu la sogs sgra yis ni/ /shin tu dbang po myos gyur te/ /de yi rnam par shes pa ni/ /ming dang bcas pa'i gzugs la bstim④/ /de yi dus su gsang sngags ni / /phrin ⑤las sngags rings mtha' ru ni/ /ā kur+sha ya dzaḥzhes brjod/ /mgon po nag po yab yum gyi/ /lte bar gru gsum lcags khang ni/ /btson dong mun khang gnas pa bsam/ /de las thar dus med par bya/ /de nas dong de ⑥ro g.yam la/ /rdo rje rgya gram bris pas mnan/ /mtha' mar las sbyor dus su yang ske/ /bsgrub bya'i them pa'am lam dag tu/ /mnan pa byas la phrin 7las bcol / /gal te de nyid sbyin sreg gis/ /las sbyor bsgrub bya'i chu rjes sogs/ /dri ma gos dang skra sogs dang / /tsha ba gsum dang dug sna dang / /khrag dang skye tshe shang tshe dang / /da dhu ra dang de la sogs/ /sa sna gzhan dang sbyar bar bya/ /bong bu'i chu dang bsres nas ni/ /'jim pa byas la g.yog /kyepar bya/ /dug chu ro sol dag gis ni/ /de la byug cing gnas lnga ru/ /seng ldeng lcags phur btab la gzhagaspu /de yi 7lus po thams cad la/ /spra tshil gyis ni byug par bya / /de la drag po'i shing gi (tsheni/ /tsher ma sna tshogs btsugs 8la gzhag /nyi /gru gsum e yi nang du ni/ /de gzugs phyi gan chadag tu gzhag7 /kha nang dur khrod thal bas brdzang / /de nas dong kha bcad la gzhagatso /de la thun bzhir 73—827

bya ba'am/ /dus drug dag tu bya thu ba ni/ /rnal 'byor pa yis lhor bltas ②la/ /nyin ( ri)phyed mtshan phyed dus su bya/ /yang na dus bzhir las la sbyar/ /phyogs kyi ḍā ki bzhi yis ni/ /dgug gzhug bstim dang bsngags ④par bya/ /de nas thod pa mtshan ngan du/ / yungs kur (shenyungs nag la sogs pa'i/ /thun rdzas rnams la sngags bzlas shing / /dus dus dag tu brdeg par bya/ /skabs skabs dug gi chu yis brdeg /gal te gu gul nag po dang ⑥/ /sha chen dag gis bdug par bya/ /yang na 'bras phub (7)me la ni/ /spra tshil ma zhu tsam du bsrol/58) /de nas sngags kyis brdeg par bya/ /'dis (9)ni nye bar 'grub par 'gyur / /de ltar cho ga'i thabs 'di yis/ /dgra yi khang par bya rog dag /mang po 'ba' zhig skad 'don dang / /lus la tsha bas thebs la sogs/ /du ma'i cho 'phrul 'byung bar 'gyur/ /dang por nang rtags gsal bar 'char/ /phyi rtags rim gyis 'byung bar 'gyurartsa/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las drag po'i mngon spyod bstan pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //de nas gdug pa 'dul /1don du/ /nag po chen po khros pa yi/ /bsgrub ⑫pa'i rim pa mchog gyur pa/ /gzhan yang rab tu bshad par bya/ /rje btsun ⑫he ru ka dpal dang / /nag po chen po'i lha tshogs rnams/ /nam mkhar ④mngon par bltas lonas ni/ /bdun po yongs su dag par bya/ /bzod par gsol la 57gshegs su gsol/ /de rjes stong pa'i ngang las ni/ /tshad med bzhi po bsam par bya/ /byang chub sems kyi ngang las ni/ /pad+ma zla nyir gnas pa yi / /hūm̐ yig nag po 51 bsam par bya/ /de yi 'od kyis khyab pa las/ /bsdus 79wa 828

shing skad cig yongs gyur pa/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po ni/ /zhal gcig pa la spyan gsum pa/ /phyag gnyis sku mdog shin ①tu nag(mi /dbu skra kham nag gyen du brjesal/ /g.yas pa gshin rje'i lce 'dra ba'i/ /gri gug rnon po 'dzin par mdzad/ /g.yon pa thod pa khrag bkang bsnams ge/ /thod pas skra mtshams bcings pa dang / /yan lag thung zhing rags pa'i gzugs/ /mche gtsigs 'jigs su rung ba ste/ /ltos 'gro brgyad dang rin chen brgyad/ /rgyu ma'i ga sha stag lpags can/ /mi mgo rlon pa'i phreng ba 'phyang / /zhal nas khrag 'dzag gad rgyangs can/ /phyag rgya zhu)drug gis sku la spras/ /drag po'i nyams dang ldan pa ste/ /skad cig tsam gyis bskyed par bya/ /de yi thugs kur (rme nyi ma la/ /ye shes sems dpa' gsal bar dmigs/ /ting 'dzin sems dpa' dang bcas pa / /rten dang brten ⑦par bcas pa bsam/ /de la 'di yi gsang sngags byung ske/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya rtsu rtsu phaṭa/ ji srid skyo (8)bar ma gyur pa/ /gsang sngags phreng ba bzlas par bya/ /de nas sha chen spos bsreg 3)cing /gzhan yang dug dang khrag la sogs/ /bduge pa'i du bas mchod par bya/ /ma sha 'bras dang so ba dang / /'bru nag me tog byug pa dang / /sgron ma lnga dang mi 'chi lnga/ /khu ⑩ba chan dang chang la sogs/ /gtor ma nag po che la dbul/ /mchod dang bstod pa tshul bzhin bya/ /'di yi nye bar spyad pa ni/ /bsgrub bya'i zag pa'i rdzas rnams dang / /tsha ba gsum la sogs pa la/ /gang gi ming dang bcas pa'i gzugs/ /byas te dug gis byugs nas kyang / /tsher mas bkang ste thab khung du/ /'bras phub 7me la gdung la sogs/ /bya ba sna tshogs las byas na/ /skad cig gis ni brlag par byed/ /rdo rje slob dpon smod byed 79—829

cing ske/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'jig byed pa/ /dkon mchog gsum la sdang ba dang ske/ /sems can kun la 'tshe ba rnams/ /'di dag nag po chen pos sgrol①/ /yan lag dag gi sha chod la/ /mgon po nag po'i zhal du gsol/ /yang na de yi spyi nas ni/ /til tsam du ni mdzad du gsol/ /khrag gi rgyun yang ②'thung bar mdzod/ /de ltar phrin snelas las bcol bya/ /de nas sbyin sreg ④brtsam par bya/ /phung shul g.yul sprad la sogs pa/ /dur khrod sol bas byug byas te//gru gsum rim pa kha skyer 55)ldan/ /de yi nang du drag po'i shing / /tsher ma can gyis brtsig (6༄par bya/ /mchod dang bsreg rdo rdzas gtor ma dang / /bsgrub bya'i liṅga sha chen dang / /yungs kur bcas pas 58)yongs su bskor/ /sngags pas lhor bltas ting 'dzin zhugs/ /me lha bskyed cing dgug gzhug bya/ /liṅga phur btab gtubs kladabyas la/ /me sbar bsregs pas lha bol mchod/ /gsang sngags 'dod yon sgyur nyunyeldan pa/ /phrag gcig gis ni lan cig 8ste/ /lan grangs rol mtsho'i khyad par gyis/ /phyir mi zlog hu cing srog gtor byed/ /de rjes gsol gdab bcol bskul bya/ /shin tu myur bar rtags rnams 'grub/ /nag po chen po'i gsang tshaba'i las/ /ma grub lan gsum spogs pa dang / /sa bon 'phrog cing gcud tshepas 'grub/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las drag po'i sbyin sreg tsobastan pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dur khrod gnas pa'i zhing skyong dang / /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i nyu zhing skyong bcas/ /de dag rim pa bshad par bya/ /rdo rje rigs kyi pho nya mo/ /drug cu 1 rtsa bzhi'i phrin nyu)las dang / /'di nyid gsang 79wa 830

ba'i mgon po yi/ /thabs mchog 'di ni kun du sbas/ /dpal ldan mgon po rdo rje can/ /khro ①bo de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ /dkyil 'khor dbus bzhugs dpa' bo ni/ /shin tu 'gying zhing 'bar ba'i sku/ /le (2tshe dgu pa'i dbus su ni / /sna tshogs pad+ma nyi dbus la/ /dpa' bo chen po phyed skyil rdo tshul/ /zhal gcig (9pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum byi (5)ru la ltar dmar/ /sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /phyag rgya lnga ldan gar gyis rol/ /dang pos gri gug thod pa dang / /gnyis pa ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /klu brgyad rgyan gyi phrin las can/ /de yi thugs mar yiganas pa yi/ /sa bon spro dang bsdu ba'i dngos/ /oṃ ma hā kā la ā kun+ta ya ma ma pra ⑦sha ma nā (kyeya ha sa ma ya /⑨/ thams cad sdud cing dbang byed pa/ /skad cig tsam gyis bskyed par bya / /de yi shar gyi le 7tshe la/ /drag po shin tu 'jigs pa ste/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ /mthing nag rngam pa'i tshul du gnas/ /de yi mdun du rgan byed ma/ /g.yas su mi sdug drag po chen// /g.yon du 'jigs ma gnas pa tsodang / /rgyab tu u ma 1nyarnam par rol/ /nag tsopo'i lho yi phyogs su ni / /drag po chen po du ba'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ /thod phreng gis brgyan gtsigs 15pa'i tshul/ /de yi mdun du rnam rgyal ma/ /g.yas su rnam par rgyal ba ma/ /rgyab tu mi sdug yom gnas la/ /g.yon du gzhan gyis mi thub ma'o/ /lha gter mnyam gnas nub phyogs su/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa/ /mdog ser rgyu ma'i phreng bas dkris / /shin tu bzhad pa'i tshul du gnas/ /de yi mdun du nag mo che/ /g.yas su drag chen drag shul can32/ /rgyab tu nag sbom ma ni gnas/ /g.yon du bzang mo mche ba 73—831

can / /nag mo zhi khyab byed byang phyogs su/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pal/ /char sprin nag po'i mdog 'dra ba/ /shin tu gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba / /de yi mdun du dbang mo ste/ /g.yas su zla ba mo zhes bya/ /rgyab tu drag tu sdang ba la/ /g.yon du rna ba 'phyang ba'o/ /gtso bo nag po chen po ni/ /shar lho mtshams kyi gnas bzhugs pa/ /gtsigs pa can ni shel gyi mdog /stag lpags gos kyis dkris pa'o/ /mdun du lha mo 'phrog byed ma/ /g.yas su 'bar byed ma (miganas la/ /de yi rgyab tu 'jib byed ma/ /g.yon du yul skyong ma gnas so/ /gtso bor gyur pa'i sku yi ni/ /lho nub mtshams su bzhugs pa ni / /mi sdug pa ni du ( ba'i mdog /shin tu mi srun gzugs 'chang ba/ /gzig gi ko ba rlon pas dkris/ /mdun du 'jigs byed 50drag mo che/ /g.yas su gzugs chen 55)mo zhes bya/ /rgyab tu mche ba gtsigs ma ste/ /g.yon du thod can ma yin no/ /nag po chen po'i sku yi ni/ /nub byang mtshams kyi grwar bzhugs (6)pa/ /dga' bar ldan pa pad dmar tsamadog /glang po'i pags (nyepa 'dzin pa'o/ /de yi mdun du thod phreng 'dzin/ /g.yas su phreng ba 'dzin ma ste//rgyab tu tri shul rige'adzin ma'o/ /g.yon du ltos 'gro bsnams pa'o/ /gtso bo nag po chen po yi/ /byang shar mtshams su gnas pa ni/ /log srid can gyi rdza gsar tshemadog /spre'u'i pags 17pa 'dzin pa'o/rte/ /de yi mdun du ral gri ma/ /g.yas su dgra sta nyuge'adzin ma ste/ /rgyab tu rdo rje mda' thogs ma/ /g.yon du rdo rje 8gzhu ma'o/ /khro bo'i pho nya 'di dag ni/ /zhal gcig phyag bzhi gar gyis rol/ /dang po gri gug thod pa 'dzin/ /gnyis pas ḍā 'im ru dang ni/ /tri shu tshel ni 'dzin par mdzad/ /pho nya'i rnal 'byor ma 'di dag /'di dag phal cher zhal 79wa 832

gcig la/ /phyag gnyis gri gug thod pa can/ /nag mo ser dang hu)dmar ljang ste / /phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /dur khrod gnas su rol par mdzad/ /pho brang de yi phyi rol du/ /zhing skyong rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /ka ṭa ha re (mika rta shing / /sharnyi ba la yab yum can/ /kol+la ②kyir ni ro yi shing / /gharnya pā ④la yum dang ldan/ /dha ra par ta pa ⑤yi shing / /e gi pā yil yab yum sbyor/ /ko ṭir dhi pa pa dhi shing / /dzā ⑦la pā la yab yum sbyor/ / gi ra tsar te ④a mra'i lashing / /shwa ra dha sa gnyis med gnas/ /o ṭa dbyangs can ka na ku'i/ /ka pā la yi lha srub byed/ /sa ṭa bha rur dza 8ti'i 'bras/ /ghan stod da nyunyepa lhan cig sbyor/ /o la pu 3deri ra ma khonyuste/ /ha ti pa yi rna ba can/ /ha na mo ha yab yum sbyor/ //rmi ra bar rtsa ba'i sdong / /tsan+d+ra tsos ni go ṭa'i 8bdag /ma ri ṇa bar thang sgron shing / /byin 8pa ཿtra pā tshilar ldan/ /nā ga ba rar sa shing can / /keng rus ldan pa rol par 'gyur/ /sur+sā par ri dzā 3)lu'i shing / / bu yi 8rkang pa rtag tu rol/ / dzā la ( )snya rar khang brtsegs shing / /bum pa can de bde bar rol/ /bha sna gu bar drag klog 27'khrug /dzā 2snyeṭa tri pa mnyam par gnas / /so sa par ni tril sha'i 2)shing / /sgra gcan sgrogs pa'i yum 2 nadang bcas / /tsa ri ṭa pa'i ka ran tsar/ /mdzes pa shaka geti can yum 7ldan/ /o ṭa dzo — tshoya par a sho ༷ )ka'i/ /shin tu sgra gcan gsang demor bcas/ /gzung 'dzin sa sar ka ko li/ /sred pa dpa' bo dbang phyug bcas/ /k+ṣi ri ke par sā su )la'i shing / /lhun po 'bar ba dbang phyug bcas/ /k+ṣi ri ki sar sā gispela'i shing ske/ /lhun po 'bar ba lhan cig bcas/ /bha yang ma 'bur 'byung po'i 82shing ske/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa gnas byed pa'o/ /pu ṭa nar ni dha du pa'i/ /79wa 833

a bha ke ba brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /rā dza ghi har dza pa na/ /sna chen dzi li sgra gcan no/ / khang pa 0)can du rang byung brag /thub dka' rgyal mtshan 'dzin mar bcas/ /ma hā tra (5)yer tsan+dan shing / /sna tshogs dbang phyug dbang bskur bcas / /'di dag k+ṣe tra pā la ni/ /zhing skyong zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ /gri gug cang te'u lagayas pa na/ /g.yon pa thod khrag rtse gsum can/ /yum ni so so'i phyag mtshan ldan/ /skye gnas las byung sgra sgrogs mdzad/ /rtag tu sgrub pa po rnams kyis(pe/ /lus la yang dag gnas nas ni/ /dngos grub ster byed stobs mchog byed/ /'di dag zhing skyong thugs brtse bas/ /rtag par mtshan mo 'du bar mdzad(5/ /'di dag sa gsum khyab pa ste/ /sna tshogs mdog can 'bar ba'o/ /oṃ shīn+ti yik+ṣi pa rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā smṛ ti 7)rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ bha lan pū hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shang ka ri hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ kā lā 98)dhi pa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ya bha lan hūm̐ phaṭa / oṃ be su bha ga hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ par+ṇa sa na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la ha nyi (rje)rtsu phaṭa / oṃ tī li tī mali pho phe phaṭa phaṭa/ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ (17/ ka ha ka ha/ hro hro hro hro/ pa tsa pa tsag1ge/ hūm̐ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ ha hā/ ḍa ḍā ro rī ro rlor+shazu/skru mru skru k+shi/ khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ/ ru ru ru rus/ ḍi ḍo ḍi ḍi/ kai kai rka kai/ /mi tsurto shāmi /mi/ kre kri kṛ kre/ saṃ si si si baṃ baṃ baṃ 4 8 yo yo yaṃ /sgo :spro :spro phe zenatso/ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ r+ghaṃ/ k+ṣi k+ṣe k+ṣe k+ṣe/ klo khri rlu rlu/ māṃ dzā r+pā r+pā chaswā hā/ yul ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi 12/ /drag po'i zhing skyong nyi shu bzhi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo yi/ /sa gsum rnam par khyab nas gnas/ /'di dag gsang ba'i sngags yin te/ /gzhan du nam yang 'khrul bar 'gyur/ /oṃ ḍā ki 3re'i/ ka /sna ta na/ bha zhu rib brnya na/ kha kha khā hi brnya 2tshen/ sarba duhā matso/ ha na 73—834

ha na/ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba pā pa stim mu ka su shīs ②ku ru hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ 'di dag grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /dngos grub stsol bar the tshom med/ /'di nyid dkyil 'khor dgod pa yis/ /sna tshogs phrin dulas byed pa ste/ /dur khrod brgyad kyi bdag po mchog /pho nya legs brten 'khor lo yin④/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las dur khrod kyi bdag po (snyernams dang ske/ pho nya ba khyad par ba (nyarnams dang ma mo dang zhing skyong gi phrin ⑦las bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang nyi shu bzhi/ /gsang ba'i mgon po 'di nyid kyis/ /dkyil 'khor pho brang gnas pa'o/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang sngags bstan par bya/ /pho nya legs skyes rnal 'byor ma/ /rgya mtsho dang ni ro yis ni/ /phye ba'i rdo rje nor bu dang / /pad+ma ral gri'i rigs dang ni/ / bde gshegs ye shes dam tshig gisal / /sna tshogs sha za'i ma mo rnams/ /gnas skyes yul dang grong gnas pa/ /klu yis mtshon pas kun du phye/ /oṃ hai ra khi ni swā hā/ ḍū tri ④ni/ ḍa sha ka ra li ni/ dzā mel mu khi ni/ bā yu be ga ni/ pra tsaṇ+ḍi ni/ ru dra 37ak+ṣi ṇi / ma hā nā si ⑩ni/ a se ni ya ma ni/ khrini /—rteni/ lasmyu ni8/ bi dza ya mni/ shrī dzā tson ye/ shrī dzā lho tshoya ka ra khyinyurte/ shrī badzi ṇi'orte/ kai kā 4 )li ni/ kā la rā ( rtsetri ṇiṣ+ka/ pra kro dha mu khi ni / kā la dzi hā tsho snyeni/ ga rā ༷ zili ni/ badz+ra r+bha ra bā kā ra ni 3/ dhu ru si ni/ ya ni ma na i ka ri ṇi/ sri ( 47ka ra sa ti'i ni/rat+na mā li ni/ sru tra a k+ṣi ṇi / ku su li ni/ khutri ṇizhurte/ badz+ra pra bha ni 6/badz+ra kā la ya du)ni/ sa ma pañtsa ni/ ka ma ni bhi/ tsi tā sartali ga ni/ shu ki ni/79—835

sarba dhi ni/ sru tra 6)ri khyi(kye/ gha las ni/ pad+mā zhuk+ṣi ṇil/ dza la dza la kha ḍi bha ba bhu dhi ni/ shrī sto ra ṇi/ tsan+t+ra le kha ni/ tsan+t+ra sa)mu khi ni/ haṃ yis warmi khyi(pe / wā gi (8)me shwa ra khyi97/ snyi ta ru dra ye/ ka ra ṇi 0swa ka bhi ru sa ni mṛ ⑪dha ni dhi/ ghu ri ṇi/ sha ṣi nilhan/ su shrī sgro na/ bca hu3bha ra ṇiñtsa/ shrī mu khi ni / bska la 0ni/ ka li ni/ ha ri ṇi thā tsole/ pad+mo ni/ na gra pa ak+ṣi ṇi/ṭī 0ma la tsaṇa gri ṇi hunyes hā/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa 39sarba yo gi ni kā me du )shwa ri/ sarba duṣ+ṭa gardzo gadz+dza groṇ+ḍi groṇ+ḍa rnams phaṭa/ tshes brgyad dang ni nya ba dang / /nyi shu dgu dang dgu stong dang / /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi /las ni the tshom med 'grub pa'o/ /dbyug gu drag po'i gyelo nya dang / /chu tshod kyi ni ma mo dang / /'pho ba gnod sbyin brgya ri ci phrag gnyis/ /thun ni pho nya brgya du nyedag go/ /dus sbyor bcu gnyis gnas pa'i yul/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi de yi phyed/ /rtsa rlung yi ge khams la rgyu/ /'ching grol tshar gcod rjes 'dzin pa'o/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las phyi dang 2snyenang gi dngos po pho nya ma'i shu nyelas bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /nag po chen po gtum po ni/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs ljags 'dril cing / /a la la yi da sgra sgrogs pa/ /rab 'jigs bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis ni/ /gsang ba mchod byed lha mo brgyad/ /kun nas gar gyis rol pa ste/ /'di yis phrin tsho — las dbang thob byed/ /oṃ badz+ra ka wu ba nu ma hā kā ta/ yi ra no/ rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ gro risteza sa kā yi du rgyu rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ bha ga byā ghā yi ri de: rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ bha na su ba rā yi ci no/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ si ma lā yi zhunye73—836

rtsu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bha na shā nā 3)sri hūṃ rtsu phaṭa/ oṃ kro ṇi (0dha ka rā sri 95)rgyu rgyu phaṭa/oṃ u lū kā ④rgyu rgyu hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ga ru ḍa sa gā kyai pyoge rgyu phaṭa/ 'di ni dpal nag po chen po 'khor lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa'i sngags so/ /mtshan phyed dus na gtor ma 'bul/ /sha lnga dang ni bdud rtsi lnga/ /myos byed stobs dang bcas pas mchod/ /gsang ba sgrub pa'i mchog tu bshad/ /bsnyen pa sngon yidu song ba yis / /dben par dug dang tsha ba dang / /sa la dgra bo'i gzugs bya ste/ /gro ga 'am ni ro ras la/ /rgya skyegs dug dang khrag rnams kyis/ /bya rog mo yi rus pas ni/ /gzugs bris de yi snying gar nil/ /e yi rnam pa'i 'khor lo la / /mā ra ya yi mtha' can gyi/ /man ngag bzhin du bri bar bya/ /de nas rkang pa nas brtsams te/ /dril la dur khrod skra yis dkri(8)/ /sngar gyi gzugs kyi snying ga stiru/ /bcug ste tshigs dang lte ⑩ba sogs/ /dug dang bcas pa'i tsher ma gzugs/ /de nas sngags pa 7'dod lha yi/ /nga rgyal chen po rab ldan pasal/ /snying ga'i hūṃ las tuge'od 'phros pasalhonye/ /lha la bka' bsgo rnam 7shes ni / /man ngag can gyis dgug par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la che ge mo ā kun nyugedza dzaḥ/ baṃ hos dgug pa dang / /gzhug dang bcing dang myos par bya/ /de nas tsha ba dug gis brab/ /de bzhin bdun phrag nyi shu gsum/ /zla ba gcig tu las bsgrubs tsol/ /drag po'i rtso thab tu tsher ma dang / /bra ma'i me la bsro bar bya / /des kyang 'dud 12par mi byed na/ /bstan pa bde la gnas pa'i phyir/ /snying rje chen po nyurterab bskyed de/ /gri lcags las byas mtshon gyis gtub ḍa ni/ /khrag dang dug dang tsha ba dang / /tsher ma ling gar bcas te bsregs/ /thal ba bla ma'i man ngag ltar/ /mnan dang chu bor dor bar bya/ /gzhan yang mi shis tsho sto79wa 837

thod pa la/ /dug gi myu ①gus gzugs bris te/ /de yi lce la ud ma ②ni/ /ming spel bris la thod pa gnyis/ /kha sbyar skud pa nag pos dkril/ /nag po'i gos kyis gtums nusanas ni/ /mi shis byas phyogs dag tu mnan/ /bsnyen dang sgrub (7pas mnyes gyur na/ /'chi dang smyo bar 'gyur bar ⑦ni/ /the tshom yod pa ma yin no/ /yi dgas 6)sam ni dgra bo gang / /gro ga la ni gzugs bris la/ /snying gar lasngags 'dis bskor bar bya/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la che ge mo mā ra ya rtsu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags bris gtor mar gzhugahu ) /de nas bsgrub ⑩sngags bzlas par bya/ /de yi rjes la gtor ma dbul/ /mgon po nag po 'khor bcas la/ /sha khrag rkang 8sogs bstabs nya byas nas/ /gtor mas bsad ⑫pas bsgral bya ste/ /dmigs par bya ba myur du brlag /gzhan yang gdug pa pha rol te/ /nus pa cung zad yod gyur na/ /rang shed rang la dbab pa'i phyir / /ngag mnan sbyor ba 'di ltar bya/ /gro ga 'am ni ro ras la/ /khrag dang dug dang bdug tshepa yis/ /gzugs ni lces khengs sngags bri ba/ /stam+bha ming spel ldan pa bskor/ /phyin ci 8log tu dril la bcing tso/ /zag pa'i rdzas sogs sa la ni/ /tsha tsha byas pa'i nang bcug la/ /bstim zhing mnan la mdun byas la / /rnal 'byor spro bsdu phyag rgya bcing / /thun gyis brabs la bzlas pa bya/ /las bcol zhag bdun thun bzhir bya/ /de la sngar bzhin byas nas ni/ /gnod pa'i sa phyogs dag tu mnan/ /myur du 'grub par the tshom med/ /thod pa 'am ni snod gzhan du/ /sbyin sreg hu)byas pa'i thal ba de/ /thun rdzas kyis brab liṅgar bcas/ /yang na drag po klu la gtad/ /gru gsum dong bcug brdzi bar bya / /kha bcad ri canas ni drag po yi/ /nges par thob par the tshom med/ /79—838

de ltar las la sbyor dus su/ /nyes pa bsgo ba'i thabs shes nas①/ /srung byed nyes pa 'di ltar bsgrag(kye /bstan pa 'jig par byed pa yi/ /dgra bo srung byed lha khyod nyon/ /gdug pa'i sems ldan dgra 'di yis/ /dkon mchog bla ma la smod cing / /rnal 'byor la snang sems can 'tshe/ /sgrub pa po la brnyas gyur pas / /dpag tshad stong du lhung ba yi(mi/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong ④gyur pas / /bdag gis myur du bsgral nas ni/ /gzugs kyis lha rnams mchod pa yin / /khyed kyis srung bar ma byed par/ /sdig can 'di ni myur du spongs/ /zhes brjod par bya'o/ /bstan pa bsrung 3)ba'i bsam pa dang / /snying rje chen po ldan pa yis/ /yengs pa med par byas gyur na/ /nges par 'grub par gdon mi za/ /brgya byin dag gi (6)srog kyang g.yo/ /sdig can dgra bgegs smos ci dgos/ /byang chub sems dang rab ldan na/ /ngo bo nyid kyis 'grub par gyur na / /dpal mgon po chen po rin)dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las lha mo'i 'khor lo dang las bsgrub 1)pa bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /gsang ba'i cho ga nyams dga' ba/ /dpal ldan lcam dral thams cad kyitshe/ /sgrub pa rab tu nyams dga' ni/ /mgon po kun gyi gnas 'di ni/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag drug pa/ /dang po gri gug thod khrag 'dzin/ /spyan gsum mthing nag rngam pa yi/ /g.yas g.yon bar mas 'o)phreng ba dang / /ḍā /snyem ru ni 'dzin cing brdung tshon/ /tha ma gnyis kyis kha ṭ+wāṃ dang / /sdigs mdzub 8zhags pa 'ching 8bar mdzad/ /klu brgyad kyis brgyan khrag ⑩'dzag zhal/ /sa bon rang sngags phreng ba can/ /rgyas rmo tshobatab 79wa 839

pas ni byin brlabs lho)shing / /rdo rje sems dpa' dbu brgyan pa/ /n+ya gro dha yi shing la brten/ /bi nā (geya ka mnan par bsam/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la k+ṣi k+ṣe tra bi spyon bi nā ya ka nī ge rtsu phaṭa swā hā/ sha chen bsregs spos phul nas ni/ /skyo bar gyur na gsang sngags bzlas/ /de la gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /khyad par byin brlabs (༄gyur par bya/ /phrin tshilas thogs pa med pa ⑥'grub/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya ma hā kā (pe' ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sku'i mgon po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa skṛ (8)da hūṃ phaṭa/ yon tan gyi mgon po'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ⑨ma hā kā la rak+ṣa ru dri ba ṣa ༅ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsung gi mgon po'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra kṛt+ta tsaṇ+ḍa mamā ra ya nyu2ma hā kā kyisal tsista la hrīḥ8dzaḥ/ las kyi mgon po'i sngags so/ /oṃ skom hā kā (loli ha na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/ yi ge bcu pa'i gsang ba'i mgon po'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍi shwa rī 8ye swā hā/ gtum po 3nyemo'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍi tsa tī nyu)ye swā hā/ drag mo'i tsho 5sngags so/ /oṃ kā li ka 0ye swā hā/bzlog dbyed ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ ku li she ṣa rī ri 3ye swā hā/ dpa' mo'i sngags sol/ /oṃ shrī ri stem hā kā la ga ṇa mi tri dzaḥ bde tsho —snye'adzin ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ re dan ti ma hā kā li shotri shu la sab sha hūm̐ na dzaḥ/ rtse gsum 'dzin pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la kro tri gaṇ+ḍi ri shes ya hūṃ phaṭa/ gnyi tsa)'dzin pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ri note tsi tso ta ka ra ma rā tsā zhun phaṭa/ rgyal mtshan zhu'adzin pa'i sngags so/ /gsang ba bed ri ci 'dzin mgon po yisasu༄/ /lha ma yin gyi grong khyer ni / /sum brtsegs la gesogs khang bzangs shusternams/ /khro bo tsan+dan bed bsnams ru kyis/ /lha dmag bye ba dung phyur rnams/ /phyung nas brlag (3par mdzad pa yi/ /grong khyer 'bum phrag brgyad cu du/'am/ /rlag sko )byed bdud 73—840

'dul chen po ste/ /'di nyid g.yon gnas 7lha mo ni/ /kun du dgyes nas gar stabs gnas②/ /oṃ shrī ma hā kā 50la du peṃ stini dza a mu ku'i mgo bo la ru dra hūṃ bh+yoḥs/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā nyal (7)trag rak+ṣe du (8)bo ni dzaḥmun nag shig bh+yoḥyi)/ mu shi bh+yoḥ0/ che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la rak+ṣa tri hunyeya k+ṣa/ ru dra sa ma ya/ sarba sha hūm̐ (/snyen ru tsa pa lā ya/ ma ra ṇa 3)rbad rbad/ dri rbad lipu rbad pu/ tshal pa tshal pa/ ni sha tsoku ru sa ma ya/ che ge mo/ gtubs 8gtubs mdza dza/ oṃ ru ru tsom ma bh+yaḥhuste/ ma ma sha rtsu/ tsit+ta la hro dz+rī/ mā gu ra ya rbud rbud/ re shaṃ bhā du )ta ya ghā rngo )ta ya/ kā 3lo yo bha 7 —9sha ni ma hā kā la/yak+ṣa shā hunyes na/ a pa ka ri di na me ke ( 9na me ru ru ma ma bh+yaḥ2 pho/ tsit+ta la hro hro rbad / tri ri pri tri ka hi 7 :swā hā/ ti ka pa tra pu zhes/ a tra ni )ka ti sba du1mo sha mo sna / tig pug shig /ku mi ta rbad shig rbud 82sod/ gaṇ+ḍi so)'dzin pa'i khro bo che / /ma rungs klad hu9pa 'gems par byed/ /tsa muṇ+ḍi ldan rol pa ste/ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i las la shis lha/ /kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin pas ni/ /dgra bgegs lus ngag yid la 'debs/ /gtum po thogs sre'abebs mig sgyur ma/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba'o/ /gang du keng rus rgyal mtshan bsnams/ /bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs skrag byed/ /'di nyid legs ldan rgyal po che/ /rdo rje bse gdong sna tshogs gdong / /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs 'di dag gis/ /gsang sngags rim pa sa) bstan pa'o/ /thun mong khyad par bye brag gis/ /lus kyi mtshan nyid rtags bcas pa/ /grub pa kun du bgrod pa'o/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las dkyil 'khor ba'i mgon po dang yum dang bcas pa'i gsang sngags dang phrin rasnyelas kyi le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //79wa 841

de nas bden pa tsam gyis ni/ /grub pa stsol bar mdzad pa po0)/ /dngos grub 'byung gnas rim pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bshad par bya/ /bya rog g.yang gzhis ④brgyan pa yi/ /nag po phyag bzhi pa yi sku/ /gsang zhing dam tshig ldan pas bri/ /de ni (kyisku yi rten 4༄du bshad/ /gser dngul la (gesogs kyis bris pa'i/ /nag po chen po'i snying po dang / /nye ba'i snying po bris pa rnams / /gsung gi rten kunadu 'dod pa'o/ /bya rog sogs dang rta nag snying / /khyi yi snying dang mi yi snying / /rin chen lnga dang bcas pa rnams/ /thugs kyi rten du gzung ri rabar bya/ / snying gi (kyernam pa thams cad dang / /nya sha la ⑨sogs 'bru yi chan/ /sman gyi rnam pa thams cad dang / /bsnyen pa'i gtor ma bya ba yin/ /rdzas dang gta' 3 rigator steng dang 'og /steng nas dar nag gur gyis dbub/ /sha lnga sman lnga myos byed bcas/ /rgyun du thugs dam bskul phyir mchod / /rta nag lug nag g.yag rog la/ /mgul du snying po bris la gdags/ /de yi ngo bo legs phul la/ma/ /phyi yi rten du bya bar bshad/ /nag po ras sam dar la yang / /rin chen lnga dang bcas pa yis/ /nag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa / /bris pa nyin gcig 512gis rdzogs nas/ /bar chad med par rab gnas bya / /gsang rten lus la bcang ba'o/ge/ /sna tshogs 'bru nag dpal byas pa'i/ /gtor ma mi shas ri brgyan pa dgatshe /pho brang rten dang brten par bcasatso /nang gi rten du slob pa'o/ /skyes pa grir shi'i mthod phreng ni/ /yon tan ldan phyir rtag tu sba/ / mi gsod 512mtshon las byas pa yis7/ /rdo rje gri gug rtsu bris pa / /phrin 2 rilas byed pa'i khyad par ro/ /dam tshig gnas pa'i rnal 'byor 73wa 842

pas / /nyams dga' dben pa'i gnas nyid du/ /lha mo'i rten yang 'di ltar ro / /rigs med kyi 0)ni thod pa la/ /gsang sngags yi ge 'di dag ( ni/ /bris pa tsam gyis las 'grub byed/ / bsgrub pa ②mi dgos dunus (snyepa 'byung / /dur khrod sol bas sngags 'di bri/ /oṃ shrī de wi tsa muṇ+ḍa rak+ta tsa muṇ+ḍi/ se ga (6)mor / dha ke sang ①ha si ta/ mu khi duka ra ha ra/ tī la tī la/ phre k+ṣa ti ta sa na sa ta phroṃ phroṃ ⑨la la ta ya/ ka bā la ma lā dha ra ni yi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ /thod pa'i nang du 'khor bar bri/ /phyi yi rten du bshad pa yin/ /bong bu nag mo'i thod pa la/ /rten pa lha mo'i sku bris pa/ /nang gi rten nyurtedu bshad pa yin/ /nal 'gri'i snying ni ma nyams pa/ /mtshon gyi rtse la bkon la gzhagati /gsang ba'i rten du gzugs par bya/ /bu mo'i thod pa ja ril dang / /gri gug dar gyis gtums ④pa dang / /dri bzang mtshon gyis bdug par bya/ /de kho na nyid ⑫rten du bshad/ /de nas nub phyogs dag nas ni/ /gsum gyis khur nas 'ongs pa'i rdo/ /mi nag gsum gyis 'di skad brjod/ /sku gsung 7thugs kyi bdag nyid can/ /rdo rje mgon po 'khor bcas pa/ /rang bzhin gnas nas sku bzhengs rngul/ /'dir ni bstan srung bzhugs su gsol/ /lan gsum brjod nas gzhug 8par bya/ /rol mo'i sgra dang spos dud dang / /sna tshogs rol mos bsu nas kyang / /phrin lho las gang 'grub rim shes bya/ /'di ni rang bzhin rten yin no/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las phyi nang gsang ba dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten gzugs pa'i le'u ste bcwa pu snalnga pa'o // //73—843

de nas gzhan yang bshad par bya/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po yi/ /bka' yi tshogs kyis 'khor gyur pa/ /'di ni kun du shes par bya/ /las kyi mgon po rnams dang ni/ /lha mo chen mo 0)'khor dang bcas/ /lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pa/ /pho nya mngag gzhug las byed pa'o②/ /gzhan yang phyogs skyong bcu dang ni/ /klu chen brgyad dang lha chen brgyad/ /gza' chen brgyad dang rgyal chen bzhi/ /rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad de/ /gnod sbyin brgyad dang 'phrog (gema'i bu/ /sha za dang ni ma mo dang / /'jig rten pa dang dam tshig gnas / /zhing skyong ma lus 'khor dang bcas/ /'di dag las kun byed pa yi/ /'jig rten skyong ba bzhi bcas pas/ /grub pa rab tu stsol mdzad pa/ /lha dang lha min mi 'am ci/ /sto 'phye grul bum srul po dang / /lus srul grib gnon skem byed sogs/ /nam mkha' lding dang dri za dang / /'byung po ma lus 'dus pa kun/ /'di dag sgrub la grogs byed cing / /mthu stobs dpung dang nus pa yis / /bsrung cigazhing bar chad nges par sel/ /sgra gcan 'dzin pa'i rā ⑤tu la//'di la 96༄sogs pa thams cad la/ /tshogs kyi gtor mas cher mchod na/ /dpal dang 97rdzu 'phrul myur du ster/ /'di dag 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ nye dang nye ba'i mtshan ma dang / /rtags 7zhenadang cho 'phrul du ma 'byung / /sku gsung thugs kyi rtags dang ni/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i (9༄rtags gyur pa/ /dngos dang nyams snang rmi tshelam dang / /sprul pa'i phrin 31las nges 'byung ba/ /gtso bo nyid dang 'khor rnams kyi/ /rim pa rjes su 'brel par 'byung / /rtags byung nas ni las la bskul/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gtso bo dang 'khor du bcas pa mchod par bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //79wa 844

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dpal ldan nag po chen po 4)yi thar pa'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ /dbang bskur cho ga bshad par bya/ /'dis ni bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs/ /de las rgyal bar byed pa yi/ /cho ga bzang po bla na med/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po bzheng bar 97bya/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas dag tu/ /rgyud shes yang dag bla ma la/ /snod ldan dag pa'i slob ma yis / /gsol ba lan gsum gdab byas la/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog sngon 'gro yin/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa ma lus dang / /rgyal ba mgon po ma lus dang / /dbang phyug dam pa'i dkyil 'khor dang / /dbang bskur gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum brjod nas gnang gyur pas/ /dang po bsnyen pa brtsam ( rapar bya/ /mtshan ma nye ba'am 0tshul shes nas/ /de nas sngon 'gro brtsam par bya/ /dang po bgegs rnams nyer zhi yi/ /phrin (gelas mchod pa gtor ma yi/ /ye shes lha rnams mchod pa dang / /lus dang ngag dang yid kyis ni/ /sdig pa bral zhing bgegs dbyung ba'i/ /sngags dang bcas pa'i yungs kur gyis/ /me sbar bsreg (nadang bral bar bya/ /de rjes sa phyogs gtsang rtsonam las/ /sa brtag pa dang sbyang bar bya/ /sa blangs nas ni bka' thob pas/ /brko (8)zhing ro lnga bsal bar bya/ /de nas bsrung (7)zhing bcag par bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs nas ni/ /rdo rje gom pa'i gar stabs kyis/ /rtsu rtsu drag po'i sgra 7brjod pas/ /phyogs kun bcing bar mabyas nas ni/ /bgegs la bka' bsgo gtor ma sbyin/ /slob ma kun la bsrung 32byas la/ /rdo rje mgon po chen po yi/ /ting nge 'dzin du gnas pa la/ /gsol ba gdab 1 pas gnang ba sbyin/ /khyad par bdud rtsi 79—845

'khyil pas bsrung 0)/ /yang dag ye shes sems dpa' che/ /'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal byed pa/ /rgyal ba ma lus bstan skyong che/ /de nas lhag par gnas pa brtsam(mi / /sa 'dzin lha mo nyid mchod pas/ /bka' ②byin nas ni thim par blta / /bum pa bkra shis yang dag ldan/ /ma nyams mtshan nyid ldan pa lnga/ /kha tshar ma nyams ras zung dkri/ /snying po sman dang 'bru lnga sogs/ /spos dang rin chen dag gis dgang / /rgyun 'bab chu yis gang ba dang / /'bras ldan shing gis kha brgyan pa'o/ /de nas bsrung (geba'i 'khor lo yi/ /bka' yi khro bo rnam par bsgom(5)/ /dkyil 'khor dri yi thig le la/ /me tog gcal dubakrem lha rnams ni/ /bskyed cing mchod la gnyis med bstim/ /so shing dor dang ltas brtag pa/ /bsrung 7skud ku sha sbyin par bya/ /de nas sems bskyed sdom gnas pas / /dam tshig gsang ba sbyin par bya/ /khyad par lha la gsol btab nas/ /rdul tshon dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /dang por ye shes thig gdab cing / /phyi nang dam tshig nges par gdab58༄/ /go rims ma nor nges pa'i tshul/ /srad bu shes rab can thig gdab/ /tshon ni byin gyis brlabs nas kyang / /spra ⑨brtag rdul tshon rim par dgye/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta ⑩babs bzhis ni mdzes pa yi511/ /zlum skor nyu2lo brang le nyu3tshe dgu/ /dbus ma e dbyibs drag po nyid/ /phyi rol pad+ma 'dab brgyad pa/ /lha khyams bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /'dod yon rin chen sked bad dang / /dra byed ④ba ku li yi phreng / /yang na kha bad mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /chos 'khor ri dgas tsogadugs dang bcas/ /thod skam pad+ma'i phreng bar ldan/ /dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su 'khor8/ /rdo rje me 'od 'bar bas 'khrigs/ /dam tshig ye shes gnyis med pa'i/ /gsang 79—846

sngags nye ba ①sngags par gnas/ /brtan (bzhing mchod la gsol ba gdab( )/ /nye bar brgyan cing yongs su bskor/ /de nas slob dpon bdag 'jug bya/ /sbyin sreg ④las ni rab tu shis/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las gsang ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor gsal 95)bar byed pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang rnam bshad bya/ /yang na le yitshe dgu ldan pa'i/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad phyi rol du/ /mu (7)khyud 'khor lo rim gsum la/ /e dbyibs zhing skyong rim pa dgod/ /lha dang sa bon phyag mtshan ni/ /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyas mtshan/ /slob ma khrus byas rgyan btags (8)te/ /maṇ+ḍal me tog phyag bya zhing ske/ /ras kyis stimig ni bkab nas su/ /dang por me tog dor 7bar bya/ /mtshan ma mthong bas legs par drang / /sgo bzhi nas ni nang 'jug cing / /gu gul bdug cing ting 'dzin gyis/ /nag po chen po'i lha tshogs kyang / /nges par spyan drangs hunyebastim par bya/ /de las nges par rtags zhu rnams byung / /yang na so so'i mgon por bskyed/ /ye shes sems dpa' byin gyis brlab/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor gtso bcas las/ /'od 'phros rang byin brlabs par gyur8//mthong ba dri dang bdud rtsis gtor/ /gdong g.yogs bkrol cizhing lha ngo bstan//de nas dbang po'i bye brag gis/ /nges par rim pas dbang bskur te/ /bstan pa 'dzin cing bstan pa skyong / /bstan gepa srung bar byed pa yi/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa 'phel mdzad pa/ /sku yi mgon po 'khor bcas kyis/ /bla med dngos grub sbyin pa'i phyir/ /yang dag ye shes dbang bskur 0ro/ /sku 79wa 847

gsung thugs dang yon tan dang / /phrin 1)las lha yi khyad par ro/ /me long ye shes dbang nyid can/ /rdo rje rigs kyi 5rimagon po yis/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang du ni/ /zhe sdang dag pas dbang bskur ro/ /mnyam nyid so sor rtog pa dang / /bya ba nan tan chos kyi dbyings/ /ye shes lnga yi rigs kyi gtsang / /nges par dbang bskur bstan rdo par bya/ /phrin rdo kyilas bzhi yi dbang yang bskur/ /lha mo brgyad kyis las rnams 'grub/ /bum pa spyi bor byin pa dang / /thod pa'i bdud rtsi blugs pa yis/ /gsang ba bde chen ye shes nyid/ /rang byung dri med dbang bskur ba'o/ /de rjes bha (zhenadzi gtad pa yis/ /nus pa thogs med sbyin byed yin/ /sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba mchog /lha dang sngags kyi zab pa'i chos / /ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya che/ /'di nyid dngos grub kun gyi gter/ /zab cing rgya che'i don sgrub 4)pa/ /skal ba can la sbyin par 'os9)/ /he ru ka dang nag po che/ /bla ma tha dad med pa la/ /tshogs kyi 'khor los legs mchod cing ske/ /zhabs la gtugs la smon lam gdabanan/ /'di ni thob par the tshom med / /phrin 9skulas kun du grub ster byed/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabs pa'i le'u ste bcwa hu )brgyad pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /dpal ldan mgon po de nyid kyi/ /phyogs bzhi yongs su skyong ba yi/ /rgyal po chen po rnam pa bzhi/ /shar phyogs nas ni yul 'khor srung 11/ /lho phyogs nas ni 'phags skyes po/ /nub phyogs nas ni spyan mi bzang / /byang phyogs nas ni rnam thos sras/ /sangs rgyas 79—848

bstan pa srung byed pa/ /'di nyid grub pa ster byed pa'o/ /rab tu dben zhing gtsang ba dang / /bkra shis nyams dga'i 0)sa phyogs su/ /rnam thos sras ni bsgrub par bya/ /sa gzhi ba yi lci bas byug /dri bzangs (btsan dan dkar dmar dang / /a ga ri —ru dang du ru /lnga) /kha che gi hang kunasna tshogs sman/ /bsreg (6)cing tshogs pa'i sman du bya/ /maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi mda' gang ba/ /dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi rta babs dang / /rin chen khang pa yid 'ong ba/ /pho brang rin chen las grub pa/ /sna tshogs pad+ma rin chen gling / /gter dang dpag bsam ljon shing bcas/ /ka ba stong phrag du ma yis/ /rab tu rgyas shing ⑦yongs su bskor / /lte ba rin chen mu khyud la/ /lha mo brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ /bar ma lha khyams mdzes pa la/ /gnod sbyin chen po brgyad kyis bskor/ /phyi ma ra bas bskor ༷8)ba la/ /klu chen brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ /sgo bzhir (9)gnod sbyin bzhi bkod pa/ /dbus su rin chen seng ge'i khri/ /sna tshogs pad+ma ge sar bcas/ /de dbus zla ba dar gyi bogadan/ /de la sku gsung thugs kyi gnas / /sa bon phyag mtshan sku dgod bya/ /sna tshogs mchod pas yongs bskor te / /'bras dang gro dang 'bru sna la/ /gtor ma shin tu bzang bar bsham/ /khyad par me tog sna tshogs ni/ /nā 511ga ge sar ku mu da/ /puṇ+ḍa ke 12ba ba ku li//brtsi nyunyeka dang tsam pa ka /dha nu ka 7ri ma li kyinyis/ /su ti ka dang ut+pa la/ /pad+ma mja tsher ba dang / / daṇ+ḍid pa la si1 sogs pa'o/ /sna tshogs chu dang bsreg nyusnyespos tshogs/ /gu gul khyad par bsreg 19par bya/ /ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi dang / /khur ba 'bras chan rdu 7zhun mar dang / /zhal zas bye brag thams cad dang / /snang gsal mar me byug pa dang / /sgra snyan sna tshogs mchod pa'i rdzas/ /79wa 849

gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /'phan dang bla re la 0)sogs pa/ /sna tshogs dar gyi lda ldi dang / /de ltar bkod pa legs brgyan nas/ /bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas kyang / /rang lhar bskyed pa'i sa bon las/ /'od 'phros mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la/ /rab tu 'phros pas 'od du 'bar/ /de las dbus su rgyal chen ni/ /sku mdog gur gum mdog 'dra ba/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyananan/ /seng ge'i khri la legs bzhugs pa'i/ /phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /rin chen 95ci'abar ba'i rgyal mtshan can/ /g.yon pa ne'u le'i snod can las/ /kha nas rin chen skyug par bsam/ /gnod gnas dbang po gang ba bzang / /nor bu bzang ri4 dang rta yi bdag /yang dag shes dang 'brog gnas dang / /lnga rtsen pi tsi (5༄kuṇ+ḍa li/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang phyag mtshan bcas/ /re re'ang du mas yongs bskor nas/ /shin tu gsal zhing brtan par bsam/ /de nas sa bon las 'phros te/ /rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs la/ /mchod cing bstod de gnyis med bstim/ /khyad par gsol ba gdab par bya/ /rgyal ba mgon po 'khor bcas pa'i/ /yid 'ong khang bzangs (9pho brang 'di/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i char 'bebs pa'i/ /rin chen gter gyi dngos grub gsol/ /oṃ be+e 7 swā hā/ oṃ be+e shra ba ṇa ya cig hā/ oṃ dzam+bha lā ya tho)swā hā/ oṃ puṇ+ḍi bha dā ya cingaswā hā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha drwa ya swā hā/511 ma ku be rā ya ⑫swā hā/ oṃ saṃ pra dza nā ya 1 swā hā/ oṃ gu h+ya sba nā ya miswā hā/ oṃ pā: kā ya tsheswā hā / oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa lā ya teswā hā/ dang po lcags kyu'i phyag rgya ste/ /gnyis pa rin chen 'bar ba nyid/ /gsum pa kun nas bstod par bya/ /de nas gtor ma dbul bar bya/ /gsol ba btab nas phrin nyurtelas bcol/ /de nas ye shes 73—850

gshegs su gsol/ /der gnas pa ni bzhugs par bya/ /phyi rten nang rten khyad par bsti/ /rim pa 'khor lo sngags dang bcas/ /mis mi mthong bar sbas te bcang / /khyad par rtags ni gsal bar 'byung / /nye ba'i mtshan ma nges mthong nas/ /dngos grub blang zhing gtor ma dbul/ /sbyin sreg ②las kyis myur du 'grub/ /gsang sngags 'bum phrag bcu yis ni/ /'bras bu yid la 'dod kun 'grub/ /kha skong me yi mchod pa (9bya/ /gton ma chen po dang bcas pa④/ /lan bdun nye bar bsnyen pas 'grub/ /'di ni lha rnams kun gyi gter / /sgrub pa po la stsol bar mdzad/ /dpal mgon po ༅chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las khyad par du 'phags pa rnam thos sras gnod sbyin chen po brgyad dang bcas pa bsgrub pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /'phags pa chen po de nyid la/ /klu chen brgyad kyis yongs bskor ba/ /rim pa 'di ni bstan par bya/ /khyad par sa bcu'i dbang phyug che/ /dpal ldan thugs rje'i bdag po nyid/ /zhal gcig phyag ni gnyis pa nyid/ /spyan gsum cung zad khro ba'i ('u tshul/ /sku mdog dmar dang ⑦snang khu'i (kyemadog /rin chen 'bar ba'i dbu rgyan can/ /sku la dar ber sum rim la/ /sna tshogs cod 'ogan rgyan gyis spras/ /phyag rgya borin chen 'bar ba bsnams/ / lha yi nyunyeb dan mdzes pa22'phyar/ /g.yo/na pa mchod rten sku gdung bsnams/ /ne'u le'i rkyal ba nor skyug 'chang / /'khor du khyad par klu chen brgyad/ /sku lus mi yi rnam pa la/ /sbrul mgo bdun pa'i gdengs ka can / /phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba nas/ /yid bzhin nor bu legs bsnams /lha79—851

pa / /sems dpa'i 'dug stangs phyed skyil 511can/ /thams cad gtso (kyil 'dud par byed/ /nor rgyas pad+ma nyid dang ni/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang 'jog po nyid/ /pad+ma che dang hu lu che/ /dung skyong rigs ldan brgyad po nyid/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i (5ranang dag gi/ /pad+ma la ni gnas bcas te/ /de ltar bskyed la ye shes pa/ /spyan drangs mchod la gnyis med bstim/ /dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rnal 'byor la/ /yid 'ong dngos grub stsol bar 'gyur/ /oṃ shrī ④badz+ra yak+ṣa bai shra ba ṇa ya (5)rtsu phaṭa/oṃ ba ru ṇa ya tsho6 swā hā/ oṃ a nas ya ri rnyiswā hā/ oṃ tak+ṣa kā tshon/ya swā hā/ oṃ shaṃ kha pā lā ya (9)swā hā/ oṃ kur ko ṭā ya 51 snaswā hā/ oṃ pad+mā ya r+shakāswā hā/ oṃ ma hā pad+mā ya 1 swā hā/ oṃ ku li kā ya 1 swā hā/ der 1 cini gsang sngags bzlas pa yis/ /sngags kyi 'od zer spro bsdu bya/ /de nas klu rnams thams cad la/ /yid 'ong gtor ma dbul bar 12bya/ /nā 16ga ge sar pus pa dang / /rgya mtsho lbu 3 —tshob a ru ra / / dzā ti pa 18la gur gum dang / /tsan+dan dkar dmar pu shel tse/ /dbang po lag dang snying zho 17sha /chu srin sder mo le brgan dang / /'gron bu dung dang mu tig dang / /nya phyis gla 2 )gor zho sha dang / /mkhal ma zho sha rma bya'i mdongs/ / rta ru 21rgyan 'brum mdar gsum dang / /gser gyi bye ma ras skud dang / /'o ma dang ni 'bru sna lnga/ /rin chen sna tshogs ma lus pa/ /khyad par du ni dbul tsho 3bar bya/ /de nas mchod cing bstod bya ste/ /dngos grub gang 'dod stsal dgebar bsam / /de nas rizhi ba'i sbyin sreg 25bya/ /gsang sngags khri phrag bcu bzlas nas / /rtags byung nas ni dngos grub blang / /dpal mgon po ( 9chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las rgyal po rnam thos sras la klu chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //73—852

de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /drang srong sras mchog de nyid la/ /lha mo brgyad kyis yongs bskor ba'i/ /thabs nyid rnal 'byor pas shes bya/ /rin chen bdun pa'i khang bzangs su/ /nor bu sna tshogs gdan bzhugs pa'i/ /'phags pa sku mdog bai ḍūr+ya(1)/ /zhal gcig phyag drug spyan gsum pa/ /rin chen sna tshogs du mas spras/ /gdug pa klu yis nyer brgyan cing / /g.yas kyi dang po rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi dang po zhesarin chen snod/ /bar ma gnyis ni rdo rje dang / /pad+ma 9 ci'abar ba bsnams pa dang / /tha mas zhags pa tho ba 'phyar / /stag gi pags rigepa'i sham thabs can/ /dar gyi cod na pan dag gis mdzes / /skad cig gis ni bsam par bya/ /oṃ badz+ra 'bi ru ka /ku be ra ād+ma 97ka /ma hā yak+ṣa rā dza rat+na (she sidhi rgyu swā hā/ gsang sngags 'di ni brjod pa yis/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams mdun 9)du 'gugs/ /oṃ tsan+d+ra kākhyi1 ri swā hā/ oṃ su bha drwa yi rtsomaswā hā/ oṃ da'i yi nyugeswā hā/ oṃ gu kyā yi 1lhaswā hā/ oṃ su dat+ta yi 36swā hā/oṃ de byi mas hā/ oṃ ār+sā yi ltaswā hā/ oṃ sa ra swa 176 swā hā/ zla 'od can ma rab bzang ma/ / /sbyin byed ma dang gsang ba ma/ /rab sbyin ma dang dpal lha mol/ /'phags ma dang ni dbyangs ldan te/ /thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma / /kun tu rgyal ba 'od 'phro ma/ /gdu bu dpung rgyan mgul rgyan dang / /zhabs gdub do shal legs brgyan cing / /dar dang nor bus rnam par mdzes/ /dkar dang ser dang drur /9ba'i 'od/ /gser 'od pad+ma rā ga dang / /ut+pal pad+ma rā ga dang / /ut+pal puṇ+ḍa rī 2 tshoka dang / /pa la sha yi mdog mtshungs pa/ /'od kyi phreng bas 'khrigs pa'i nang / /rin chen sgrom bu gter gyi snod/ /rin 79wa 853

chen gzhong pa dung chos dang / /be tsu ra dang nor bu me/ /dpal be pañtsa tshili ka ste/ /g.yon pa kun tu pad+ma bsnams/ /sgeg cing 'gying dang ldan par bsam / /gtso bos lha mo brgyad po bskul/ /lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyis/ /rin chen char pa phab tshinas ni/ /bka' chabazhin bgyid pa rnam par bsam/ /mgon po myur du bskul ba'i tshe/ /gtso bos mi 'jigs seng ge chibs/ /thun mong gi ni las byed pa'o/ /stobs ldan glang chachen rab brtan chibs/ /khyad par sgrub pa'i las rnams byed/ /g.yu (snye'abrug sngon po chibs yinas ni/ /snang srid ma lus dbang du sdudapyo ci/ /dbang du byed pa'i las rnams dang / /khyad par sbyin sreg 90drag po ni/ /bzhad tsoradang rngam pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /myur du las la 'gro ba yin/ /phyi nas bogasang ba'i rim shes pa'i/ /stong phrag bcu yis 'grub pa ste/ /'di ni rin chen ga'u'i zhuchenang / /rin chen 'bar ba'i 'khor lo la/ /gsang na sngags yi ge'i phreng ba can/ /sa bon spro bsdus 8ting 'dzin bsgomacha / na mo be+e shra ba ṇa 8badz+ra mu sa la/ mu su na sti/ tri shu la i ku ⑩sha /pā sha pa ra 8shu/ brnya mud ga ra lā lang k+ṣi ta/she/ hasta suhū/ na mo na maḥsarba zhu )de wa ta su tsi ta/ kṛ ri spen ṭa su/ ma hā tī la tī lā g.ya/ sarba gra hā/a ka ri ṣa ṇi du rje ya bi dza ā(༄/ dza yo draste/ bha ga bān/ nā da 0ku be rā/ k+ṣi sbyiti sa ti tsakra ti ni/ ka la ka la/ nā sbyo nyed ku be ra ki ri ki li/ nā da 4teku be ra/k+ṣi 8 )ti pa ti/ tsakra ti ni/ bi dza sum hā bha ga ba ni/ nā mad ku be ra/ bi nunyekra ta/ drang srong ka ra la/ ban budha na/ re'u dunatra/ dhi h+ya sa/ gu rgya0/ka na ga na ba ri biṅgā/ be+e shra ba ṇa tshon/ bha ne bha ne/ gi ba na ba si ti/ ku ti ku ti she/ ku be ra/ nā sacad ku be ra/ na maḥsngo )stu te rgornyeswā hā/ 'di ni khyad par 79wa 854

sgrub pa ste/ /gsang sngags stiganod sbyin stong sde'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'di yis skul chabar byed/ /gar mkhan mchog ces bya ba yi/ /lha ni du mas yongs bskor ba'i/ /'di ni bskyed cing spyan drang ba/ /spyan drangs ( rimachod cing bstod pa dang / /gang sgrub las la bskul bar bya/ /'di yis rnal 'byor dgos pa sgrub/ /zhi bas nad gdon ma lus la(she/ /dbang gis khams gsum ma lus bsgyur/ /rgyas pas nor dang 'bru sogs 'phel/ /mngon spyod kyis ni gdug pa 'dul/ /nor bu bzang pos gter la spyod/ /yang dag shes kyis dus gsum mthong / /gang ba bzang pos longs spyod 'phel/ /gtsug na 'khyil pas tshe dpal ster/ /'brog gnas rgyal bas dud 'gro spel/ /gnod sbyin lnga po 'di dag gis/ /sa gsum g.yo bar byed pa ste/ /'di dag sgrub pos mchod gyur na/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal rnams ster/ /rang nyid lhag pa'i lha yis ni/ /sa bon las 'phros lcags kyus ni/ /'di dag srog gi dbang po la /dbang byed las byed mi zlog (ge'agyur/ /gnod sbyin rnams la shing thog dang / /klu rnams gtor mas kun du mchod/ /lha mo a ru ra yi 'bru/ /ma lus myur du mchod pa'o/ /gang po dang ni mdzes ma dag /khyad par mngag gzhug (6)gyur pa'o/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa bsgrub (7pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'o // //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba2 / /sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ /'khor ba'i srid pa ji srid par/ /byang chub sems kyi chos rnams ston/ /ri 79—855
