bo'i rtse dang nags tshal brag /rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang shing gcig sa/ /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod de17/ /gnas 'di dag tu bsam gtan bsgomal/ /las kyi mgon po 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gru gsum pho brang la gnas pa/ /dur khrod gzhal yas 'bar ba ni/ /me dpung 'bar ba 'phro ba'i dbus/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa/ /sku mdog nag cing mche ba rno/ /yan lag thung zhing gsus pa rina'aphyang / /thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan byas/ /spyan gsum sdang mig khro tshul ston/ /bzhin bsgyur 4 mi sdug lus can ni/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar/ /g.yon pa dam nyams snying khrag gis/ /thod pa bkang nas gsol bar mdzad/ /dug sbrul gdug pas lhu tshigs brgyan/ /dbu spa dmar ser gyen du brjes/ /mi thod rlon pa'i do shal byas/ /ro yi gdan la brdzis nas kyang / /drag po'i nga ro sgrogs pa'i gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi mgon po ni / /gsod byed rngam byed sgrol byed cher/ /bsgrub bya nges par sgrol yiba'i tshe/ /sku yi mgon pos 7dam nyams kyi/ /lte ba'i srog rtsa gcod par byed/ /gsung gi mgon pos dam nyams kyi/ /mgrin 8ri pa nas ni khrag rnams 'dren/ /rdo rje thugs kyi mgon po yis/ /snying gi dkar nag mtshams su yang / /bya rog mchu ni btsugs nas kyang / /srog rtsa myur du gcod par byed/ /pho nya sha za'i gdong can gyis/ /spyi gtsug nas ni 9rim la 'jib/ /las byed ma mo tsaṇ+ḍi nas/ /gsang ba'i mdoms 7sor dngas 11ma rngub/ /rtsa 'jib ma dang khrag 'thung kyisnyem/ /srog 'phrog mas ni las la sbyor/ /nyin mtshan dus las 'da' mi byed/ /'di dag gsang sngags ma yengs bzlas/ /dus gsum dag tu ting 'dzin 'bad/ /rtsa ba'i sngags ni srog yin te/ /gsung gi dngos grub snying po yin/ /nye ba'i 79—856

snying pos thugs bskul ba'o/ /ye shes sa bon mi shigs pa/ /dngas 1)ma'i gnas par de bshad do/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan las/ /rim par bzlas (gepas bsam gtan 'grub/ /rtags rnams nye bar ma byung na/ /'bad pas bsten cing mchod par bya/ /gzhan du 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /oṃ ma hā kā la gu na skṛ ②da hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la du trag shad dzaḥ(se ma hā kā la si ti ya ma (6)du dzaḥ( ā li sprikā li mnyam ldan pa'i/ /rtsa brgyad phreng ba rab tu bsgrags / /rim par byin brlabs (77ldan bya'i phyir/ /bzlas pa brgya rtsa brgyad du bya/ /bgrang phreng nus par ldan pa yis/ /las ni myur bar shis pa yin/ /shel gyis zhi ba chen po 'grub/ /mu tig gis ni rgyas pa la/ /dred po'i so yis gsad ⑩pa 'grub/ /de gnyis 'gyur ba bong bu'i so/ /snang dang skrad pa rnga )spemo'i so/ /ka sogs rnam dag yum bcu drug /byis pa 'tsho byed 12dbang sogs la / /dbyangs dang gsal byed rnams bsres 32pas/ /bzhi yis lhag pa'i pad 'bras shing 8/ /lung tang nyusnyedamar po bdun gcig drug /yang na tsan 1stodan 'bru dgu 'am/ /rgyu skar phyed pos rtso tshogangs mnyam pas/ /lung tang 1 rmenag pos rmongs byed nus/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed phyed sbyangs pas/ /ru dāk+ṣa ti ni mngon spyod la/ /de lta'i cho ga shes pa yis/ /tshar gcad 3 7phan gdags las rnams spyad/ /gsang sngags yi ge'i 'khor lo ni/ /mgal 37me bzhin du bskor bar bya/ /de ltar dus bzhir bsgrub par bya/ /des ni nye bar 'grub par 'gyur / /des kyang grub par ma gyur na/ /rang nyid ye shes nag po yi rta/ /gdug pa 'dul bar bsams nas ni/ /las byed mgon po'i srog rtsa 'phrog /de ltar bskul bas las la sbyor/ /gzas pa po de sgrol bar byed/ /gal te las 79—857

la 'gyangs pa na/ /srog gi thigs pa blang ba dang / /gsang sngags snying po go bzlog cing / /lte zhi)ba dkrugs pa'i las byas na/ /shi sa bstan par 'gyur ba ste / /srog ni dmar len byed par 'gyur/ /ma rungs 'dul ba'i las 'di dag /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung 5gyib las/ /gzhan du byas na nyes par 'gyur / /sbyin sreg dang ni mnan (5)pa dang / /de bzhin zor dgye las bya ba/ /gsad ④pa rang gshed gnad la dbab/ /de las myur bar rtags byung tshe/ /thugs dam bskang zhing gtor ma 'bul/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i mchod pa dang / / de dag nar (snyemar 'grub par 'gyur/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud las las nye bar bsgrub ⑥par bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu ②gnyis pa'o // //de nas gzhan yang bshad par bya/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas/ /nag mo mngon par 'byung ba yi/ /las kyi dngos grub cho ga bshad/ /dam tshig gsang ba'i sngags pa yis/ /brag nag rtse mo rno ba yi(8)/ /kha lhor bltas pa'i brag phug gam/ /gzhan yang ri bo'i zom mam (9)rtse/ /shing gcig dur khrod ma mo'i gnas/ /rab tu 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /maṇ+ḍal dang ni mchod pa dang glu/ /gtor ma legs par bshams nas ni/ /sha chen bsregs spos phul nas kyang / /bar chad bgegs rnams bskrad par bya/ /gru gsum khrag dang dug gis byug /dug shing tsher ma can gyis brtsig⑩ /gzhan yang liṅga byas pa la / /mi bsad malcags kyu tri shu la/ /de yi lus la gdab par bya/ /tshil chen mar me zur gsum pa/ /btang nas bdag nyid lhar bskyed la/ /dkyil 'khor 73—858

gru gsum legs gnas pa/ /ma hā kā la phyag bzhi pa/ /mdog nag khrag 'dzag 1)me dpung dbus/ /zhal gcig spyan gsum 'bar ba ste/ /g.yas kyi dang po chu gri ②dang / /'og ma tri shul (mirtse gsum pa/ /g.yon gyi dang pos mda' gzhu dang ske/ /gnyis pas mgo bo khrag 'dzag bsnams/ /dur khrod kyis brgyan sham thabs can/ / de yi ④g.yas dang g.yon gnyis su/ /sha za gnyis ni gnas par bsam/ /las kun byed pa'i pho nyar bskul/ /dang po lha mo chen mo ni/ /e dbus gsang sngags las grub pa'i/ /zhal gcig ⑤pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /spyan gsum shin tu sku mdog gnag⑥ /shin tu rngam zhing sgeg pa'i sku/ /g.yas kyi dang po ral gri 'chang / /'og ma shag ti 'bar ba can/ /g.yon gyi dang po rtso)thod khrag 'dzin/ /'og ma kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams pa'o/ /ral pa kham nag gyen du brjes / /mche gtsigs thod pa dug sbrul brgyan/ /glang po'i stod g.yogs stag sham dang / /re lde nag po'i sham thabs gsol/ /bong bu gwa dmar steng 2nas ni / /phyed krung la'abar bas bzhugs pa'o/ /yang na zhal gcig ⑩phyag gnyis ma / /ral gri ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin/ /dam tshig bskyed la ye shes dgug /phrin ⑩las bcol bar bya ba'o8/ /oṃ shrī 8ya de wī 0kā li kā skoli ma hā kā nyunyeli bh+yo rgyu / oṃ ru ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭa bā to si tri nyi 7tsa pa la a shug me bh+yo dzaḥtso ma hā kā li de wī ka rā li bi kṛ ta ka la rā tri ṇi/ tsaṇ+ḍa rū pi ṇi yis hūṃ phaṭa/ rag mo tsi ta ༷ — byekha rag ma rtsu bh+ya0ཿ/ oṃ ma hā kā li rdo rtede wī grosno bha skru gta kha kha khā hi khā nyi/ da ha da habu/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ sbo ṭa ya sbo ṭa 2geya/ khā ti hūṃ phaṭa / bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga dang / /skyes pa grir shi'i snying khrag gis/ /nag po chen po'i gtor mar blugs/ /ma genyams grir shi'i rba blangs la/ /ma hā ru 79—859

dra 1)bstims nas ni/ /mgo bo lho nub mtshams su bstan/ /rkang pa byang shar mtshams su bstan/ /gan rgyal tshogebazhag la bsgral bar bya/ /de yi sha dang khrag dang ni/ /pags po nopa tshil bu rkang mar bcas/ /klad ④pa klad rgyas zhag dang ni / /dbang po lnga dang don snying lnga/ /rus pa'i bye brag thams cad kyis/ /ye shes nag po chen po dang / /dpal ldan nag mo re ma ti/ /las kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas/ /pho nya bran g.yog dur khrod gnas/ /ḍā ki'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang / /tshogs de yi sha yi tshogs rnams kyis/ /nag po stong gi thugs dam bskang / /de yi khrag dang chu ser gyis/ /ma mo bye ba'i thugs dam bskang ske/ /phyir de yi 975chu rgyus rus pa rkang / /sha za 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang ri ri/ /mkha' 'gro lnga dang lha mo brgyad/ / de yi phrin ⑨las mgon po dang ske/ /sha za 'khor dang bcas la dbulam/ /phung po bsgral ba'i tshogs kyis mchodam/ /rnam shes bsgral ba'i ye shes bsgyur/ /mi bskyod pa yi zhing khams su/ /rgyal ba'i sras bu bskyed pa yin/ /rnal 'byor 'chi ba slu ba dang / /bar chad thams cad zlog par byed/ /ma rungs 11bstan la sdang nyugezhing 'tshe/ / sgrub la rka/geganod na las 'di bya/ /gzhan du byas na brlag par 'gyur/ /de yi sha la sbyin sreg (1 sabya/ /tshil ni zhun 1 chen mar me bya/ /glud 8rgyas thod pa'i rnga lpags shwe/bya / /pags 1 pa tshogs kyi gdan du bya/ /bsregs pa'i rus pa tsha tsha bya/ /'dis 19ni mgon po 'khor bcas tshogs/ /mnyes par 'gyur zhing pyo )thugs dam bskang 21/ /gzhan yang phran tshegs las kyi gsang ba ( snyerab tu bshad par bya'o / /dkyil 'khor ba'i lha'i phrin tsho snyelas kyi rnal 'byor dang rab tu ldan pas zhi ba'i las sgrub pa la ni bil ba la sogs pa la sbyin sreg du snyebargya rtsa brgyad du bya'o//73—860

'bras ldan gyi shing gang las rgyas pa'i las sgrub lhonyen stong phrag gis bya'o/ /khri ②ḍi ra'i shing dang dmar ba'i shing gis ni dbang gi las (kyisgrub na khri phrag gis bya'o / /shin tu rtsub pa'i tsher ma dang ldan pa'i shing dag gis ni mngon (7spyod la 'bum phrag gis bya bar shis so/ /bskrad pa la ni shing gi lo ma rlung mar dugebyung ba'i tshe sa la ma lhung bar blangs te gzugs brnyan (67bris nas yul gzhan gyi hor khra la btags te gtang 9)bar bya'o/ /gal te bzlog par 'dod na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ④gi thal bas gtor zhing ba ser skya'i 'o mas lus bkrus na zhi bar byed do/ /rus phye sna tshogs pa la khrag byugs te gzugs brnyan bris la dgra bo de'i 7phyogs su gtor bas ni sha za chen pos 'dzin 7par byed do/ /yang na ce phonyespyang gi sha la sbyin sreg 8byas 'o)te dur khrod du thal ba phyar nas lhag ma gzas cipa po'i sgo la gtor nas btang nyusnyen dur khrod kyi ce 'onyasbyang gi tshogs rab tu 'du zhing ngu la sgo la sder mos 'brad par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu lan gsum byas na ce lho 7sbyang gis za bar 'gyur ro/ /gang du thog gis shi ba'i rus pa la rab tu bsngags 8te ri bong gi thod par bcug ste shing rkang gcig pa'i rtse mo la btags na thog 'bab pas 'chi bar 'gyur ro/ /yang na de nyid kyi gzugs byas te de nyid dang rigs mthun 7pa'i rus pa rnyed na yungs kur 3 7gyis brdeg cing pha mes kyi dur khrod du grib 0so lhags pa dang sbas te gtor mas mnan cing dong brus 6par sbas la ro bsregs pa'i g.yam pas mnan na rigs 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /grog mkhar gyi sa la gzugs byas la/ de la dug dang til mar gyis zhugebyugs la 'bras phub kyi me la rab tu bsro zhing sngags brdegs ri rin rims tsha ba chen pos btab par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan pa la ni spra tshil gyis byugs shing tsher ma'i rigs mang po 79—861

btab par byas nas dus ma yin pa'i rlung la phyar hunyen yul gzhan du gshis ngan du 'chi bar byed do/ /mtsho nang gi nya se ba bzung ste 0gro ga la liṅga bris pa de bag zan gyi gzugs dang bcas pa la rab tu bsngags te slar btang ①na chu grir ④myur du 'chi bar byed do/ /bse shing la liṅga bsregs te sgo khang du sbas na spangs pa chen pos btab par 'gyur ro/ /gal te grog mkhar gyi sa la gzugs byas te mchod rten rnying (sa pa'i 'og tu 'byung po'i nyi ma la mnan yinas ro g.yam gyis kha bcad 3)na ni 'khor dang bcas pa nus pa med cing rab tu gnon par 'gyur ro//de nyid kyi zag pa gang yin pa dang phung shul nas sa blangs te gzugs brnyan byas la gnas kyi sar rus pa'i phur bus btab 'a༄na ni 'on pa dang long ba dang yan lag nyams pa dang lkugs par 'gyur te/ klu gnas pa'i sar sbas na dbang po nyams pa nyid byed do/ /gal te sa phyogs der char mi 'bab par gyur na ka ra bī (9)ra'i shing btsugs la ba dmar ser gyi 'o ma gtor bar byas pas klu gnas pa'i sar song nas rang boting nge 'dzin du gnas pas bka' bsgo na char chen po 'bab par byed do/ /bal po se'u'i hu)shing dang 'brug shing du bcas pa g.yab cing klu gzir na char 'bab cing sprin sad par byed do/ /gal te sprin dral ⑫bar 'dod na rlung lha'i gtor ma byas la rlung gi ba dan g.yab par bya'o/ /khrag sna tshogs pa yungs kur yungs 8nag tu sbyar te 7klu gnas pa'i sar sbyin sreg tu byas nas tshebazlas pa'i thun bar du gtor na ser ba mod la 'bab par 'gyur ro// yungs kur yungs tsonag thal chen la rab tu bsngags nyu tshonas gtor na ser ba mod la gcod par byed do/ /dha du nyunyera'i shing la sbyin sreg ⑩byas na smyo bar 'gyur ro/ /nim pa'i shing gis ni rengs par byed do/ /me tog ban dhu ri ka 79—862

dang pa la sha ①yis dgug (snyepar 'gyur ro/ /tsan+dan dkar po'i sbyin sreg ②byas na gang la yang gso bar byed do/ /a ru ra'i sbyin sreg ④gis myur du zhi bar byed do/ /ma he'i 'o mas bkrus na bcings pa thams cad grol lo/ /a ka ⑤ru'i shing dang 4)'bras bu dang ldan pa'i shing dang gcig tu bsregs te mtshor dor na rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /glang po che'i rus pa la gi hang triskadang bcas pa'i glang sna can gyi me tog dang ser ba'i rigs kyi me tog dang bcas pa kun dga' dur bar sbyin sreg ⑨byas na 'byor pa phun sum tshogs par byed do/ /de dag thams cad sngags dang bcas pa'i nus pa tso'agrub bo/ /drang srong gi rus pa ri bo'i rtser sbas te 'bru snas mchod pa 51nyebyas te chu bo rgyun du 'bab pa mthong ba'i sar spyod yul du 'gyur 8na rigs thams cad rab tu 'phel bar byed do/ / a mra'i nyuge'abras bu dang shing thog dzi tsin ta ka dang dza lu 8dang dzi ba ka rnams la snod du bkang ste gtor ma byas nas sku gzugs kyi mdun du phul na ni gnod sbyin gyis 'byor pa thams cad spel bar 'gyur ro/ /phur bus 8gdab cing yungs kur 8thal chen gyis mtshams bcad par gyur na gnod pa thams cad las bsrung 3lhebar 'gyur ro/ /dpal mgon po chen po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud 8las sna tshogs pa'i las kyi rab tu byed pa bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'o// //de nas gzhan yang bshad bya ba/ /shin tu gsang ba bla na med/ /nag po mngon par 'byung ba yi/ /las kyi dngos grub cho ga bshad/ /dpal nag mo hu)chen po'i phyogs kyi phrin 2 )las kyi lha mo la/ shar gyi lha mo 'phrog mas 'gugs pa'i las byed do(sto/ / lho yi 3 lha mo glang sna mas 'ching ri snyeba'i las byed do/ /79wa 863
